papers.title: On the Diffusibility of High-Dimensional Latents
papers.abstract_en: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) enable diffusion models to operate in the feature spaces of pretrained visual encoders. However, many off-the-shelf encoders are not optimized for faithful reconstruction, discarding fine-grained visual details. As expected, finetuning these encoders for image reconstruction recovers such details. However, perhaps counterintuitively, this procedure reduces the effective dimensionality of the resulting representation, and the altered geometry has downstream effects on generation. Specifically, we show that using the standard velocity prediction in flow matching in this high-dimensional space requires the model to fit orthogonal noise directions outside the low-dimensional signal manifold, making optimization inefficient. This motivates using the clean data parameterization ($\boldsymbol{x}_{0}$-prediction) instead, which focuses learning on the underlying signal manifold. Across experiments with multiple strong-reconstruction encoders, we show that $\boldsymbol{x}_{0}$-prediction consistently improves text-to-image generation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为重建而微调视觉编码器会降低表征的有效维度，使 flow matching 的标准速度预测被迫拟合信号流形之外的正交噪声方向、优化低效；改用 x0-prediction 把学习集中在低维信号流形上，在多个强重建编码器上一致提升文生图生成性能。
Motivation: 现成视觉编码器不为忠实重建优化、丢弃细粒度细节；为重建微调虽能找回细节，却改变表征几何，使高维空间中的扩散训练变低效。
Method: 在 Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) 框架下分析微调后表征的有效维度与几何，指出 flow matching 的 velocity prediction 需拟合流形外正交噪声方向，转而采用 clean data parameterization（x0-prediction）作为训练目标。
Result: 在多个强重建编码器上，x0-prediction 一致提升 text-to-image 生成性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 高维（实为低有效维度）表征空间中的扩散应改用 x0-prediction，把容量用在信号流形上而非流形外噪声方向。

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification
papers.abstract_en: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.
papers.comment: Published in the proceedings of CLEF 2026. Code: https://github.com/petekirby/contrastive-av
papers.journal_ref: Experimental IR Meets Multilinguality, Multimodality, and Interaction (CLEF 2026), LNCS 17087, pp. 92-102, Springer (2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用对比学习做作者归属验证 (authorship verification)，训练出 ModernBERT Bi-Encoder，在 PAN21 作者归属验证任务上达到 98.4% 准确率，优于所测试设置下的分类式方法。性能关键因素为损失函数、batch size、训练时长、预训练模型、输入上下文长度与随机文本片段数据增强。
Motivation: 作者归属验证中分类式训练路线的表现受限，需要确定哪些训练配置因素真正决定模型性能。
Method: 采用对比学习训练 ModernBERT Bi-Encoder，对比分类式基线；考察损失函数、batch size、训练时长、预训练模型选择、输入上下文长度以及随机文本片段 (random text span) 数据增强这些因素对性能的影响。
Result: 在 PAN21 authorship verification 任务上取得 98.4% accuracy；在所测试设置下对比学习优于分类式方法。
Conclusion: 对比学习加 ModernBERT Bi-Encoder 是作者归属验证的有效路线，且性能由损失、batch size、训练时长、预训练模型、上下文长度与随机片段增强共同决定。

papers.title: StudentBench: AI and human tutoring yield equivalent GRE learning gains
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence offers an unprecedented opportunity to augment human capabilities, yet progress at the frontier has focused primarily on advancing model capabilities. We introduce StudentBench, a suite of AI teaching evaluations and a public platform that enables large-scale data collection with over 175,000 student-AI messages to study whether large language models (LLMs) produce learning gains equivalent to human tutoring. Using StudentBench, we measured learning gains on Quantitative and Verbal GRE questions across 2,383 human participants receiving AI tutoring, human tutoring, or no tutoring. We establish that AI tutoring is statistically equivalent to expert human tutoring for GRE learning gains (p = .015), and in five of the seven GRE domains, the best performing AI tutor surpassed the human tutor, on average. In a second study, expert human tutors compared LLM-generated lesson plans and practice problems through 2,028 pairwise rubric evaluations. Together, the two studies clearly separate AI tutors across: (1) lesson planning, (2) practice-problem creation, (3) conversational pedagogy, (4) cost, and (5) engagement. Surprisingly, one AI tutor achieved learning gains equivalent to human tutoring (p = .044) at 918 times lower cost (USD 0.0052 for AI versus USD 4.81 for human, per percentage point gained). For Quantitative GRE sessions, faster AI replies correlated with more student messages, more messages with more correct practice, and more correct practice with larger learning gains (all p < .002). The StudentBench platform is freely available at https://studentbench.org.
papers.comment: 47 pages, including references and appendices. Project site: https://studentbench.org. GitHub: https://github.com/Handshake-AI-Research/studentbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StudentBench 用 175,000+ 条学生-AI 消息与 2,383 名参与者的 GRE 辅导实验，检验 LLM 辅导能否达到人类专家辅导的学习增益。结果显示 AI 辅导与专家人类辅导统计等效（p = .015），七个 GRE 领域中五个由最佳 AI 导师平均超过人类导师，且单个 AI 导师以每提高一个百分点 0.0052 美元对人类 4.81 美元（918 倍）的成本达到等效增益（p = .044）。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 研究聚焦模型能力本身，而 LLM 能否在真实学习增益上替代人类辅导这一规模化教育问题缺少大规模对照证据。
Method: 构建 StudentBench 评测套件与公开平台，收集 175,000+ 条学生-AI 消息；第一项研究让 2,383 名参与者随机接受 AI 辅导、人类辅导或无辅导，在 Quantitative 与 Verbal GRE 题目上测学习增益；第二项研究由专家人类导师对 LLM 生成的教案与练习题做 2,028 次成对 rubric 评估，从教案设计、练习题生成、对话教学法、成本、参与度五个维度区分各 AI 导师。
Result: AI 辅导与专家人类辅导在 GRE 学习增益上统计等效（p = .015）；七个 GRE 领域中五个最佳 AI 导师平均超过人类导师；一个 AI 导师以 p = .044 达到等效增益，成本为每提高一个百分点 0.0052 美元对人类 4.81 美元，低 918 倍；Quantitative GRE 会话中更快的 AI 回复与更多学生消息、更多消息与更多正确练习、更多正确练习与更大学习增益均正相关（all p < .002）；第二项研究含 2,028 次成对 rubric 评估。
Conclusion: 在 GRE 辅导这一设定下，LLM 可以在统计等效的学习增益上以约 1/918 的成本替代专家人类辅导，且回复速度是提升参与度与练习正确率进而放大增益的可操作杠杆。

papers.title: Where Should I Join? Robot Group Joining via Language-Guided Goal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Social navigation typically assumes a specified goal and focuses on reaching it while respecting social conventions, whereas robot group joining requires predicting where to join based on the group's real-time activity and formation. This is a highly semantic task, yet an important capability for applications such as robotic guide dogs and autonomous mobility scooters. We formulate language-grounded robot group joining: given an observation and a natural-language description of a target group, the robot identifies the relevant group members and predicts socially compliant joining poses. For grounding, we generate structured candidate subsets through recursive spectral partitioning and rank them with a language-conditioned image--geometry model. Given the grounded group, a goal predictor leverages human-formation priors to produce a multimodal energy--orientation map over feasible robot poses. Experiments on conversations, queues, and audiences across varying group sizes, crowd densities, and visual ambiguities show that our method achieves competitive grounding accuracy with sub-second inference and outperforms all baselines in joining-pose prediction. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate group joining in both static and dynamically changing interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器人加入人群组 (group joining) 形式化为语言引导的目标预测：由递归谱分割生成候选子集、语言-图像-几何模型排序完成 grounding，再用人体队形先验输出机器人位姿的多模态能量-方向图。在对话、排队、观众三类场景上 grounding 准确率具竞争力且推理亚秒级，joining-pose 预测超过全部基线，实机在静态与动态交互中均完成加入。
Motivation: 社交导航默认目标已给定，而机器人加入人群需依据群体实时活动与队形预测加入位置，是导盲犬、自主代步车等应用缺的能力。
Method: 递归谱分割 (recursive spectral partitioning) 生成结构化候选子集，语言条件化的 image-geometry 模型排序完成 grounding；目标预测器借人体队形先验，在可行机器人位姿上产生多模态能量-方向图 (energy-orientation map)。
Result: 在对话、排队、观众场景，覆盖不同群体规模、人群密度与视觉歧义的实验中，grounding 准确率具竞争力且推理亚秒级；joining-pose 预测超过全部基线。实机实验在静态与动态变化的交互中均实现组加入。
Conclusion: 语言 grounding 加队形先验的目标预测足以支撑机器人在真实人群中选择合规加入位姿，且推理速度满足实机部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Advances in generative models have improved video fidelity, enabling long-horizon generation, interactive world modeling, and evolving visual environments. Autoregressive (AR) video generation extends visual sequences through causal rollouts. However, a fundamental bottleneck emerges: as the generated sequence expands, practical models must operate under strictly bounded context windows, storage, and computational limits. Consequently, critical historical information, e.g., entity identities, dynamic states, and intervention-induced causal changes, often leaves the active context long before its relevance diminishes. Overcoming this limitation and maintaining temporal persistence constitutes a fundamental memory problem. We present a systematic and comprehensive review of memory mechanisms in AR video generation. We formulate memory operationally as persistent historical information maintained across outer AR steps, capable of influencing future generation even after the originating evidence is no longer locally accessible. Building upon this unified framework, we organize the literature through five complementary perspectives: (I) Forms, the representational carriers of history; (II) Functions, the specific semantic and physical information requiring preservation; (III) Operations, the lifecycle of writing, reading, updating, managing, and integrating memory; (IV) Learning, the optimization of memory behaviors under closed-loop rollouts; and (V) Evaluation, the paradigms for diagnosing genuine memory capabilities. We conclude by synthesizing open challenges, including composable and resource-aware memory architectures, trustworthy state updating, self-rollout learning, and standardized evaluation. By bridging representations, mechanisms, and learning paradigms, this paper establishes a structured foundation for developing reliable, memory-conditioned video generation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于自回归 (AR) 视频生成中记忆机制的综述：把记忆操作性定义为跨外层 AR 步骤保持、且在原始证据已不在局部上下文后仍能影响后续生成的历史信息，并按 Forms、Functions、Operations、Learning、Evaluation 五个互补视角组织文献。结论给出可组合与资源感知的记忆架构、可信状态更新、self-rollout 学习与标准化评测等开放问题。
Motivation: AR 视频生成的上下文窗口、存储与算力被严格限制，实体身份、动态状态与干预引起的因果变化往往在相关性消失前就滑出活跃上下文，长时程生成因此难以保持时间一致性。
Method: 以统一框架把记忆定义为跨 AR 步骤持久的历史信息，再从五个视角组织已有工作：Forms（历史的表示载体）、Functions（需保留的语义与物理信息）、Operations（写入、读取、更新、管理、集成的生命周期）、Learning（闭环 rollout 下记忆行为的优化）、Evaluation（诊断真实记忆能力的评测范式）。
Result: 综述给出五视角分类体系与记忆的操作性定义，并综合出开放挑战清单：可组合与资源感知的记忆架构、可信状态更新、self-rollout 学习、标准化评测。
Conclusion: AR 视频生成的记忆问题可被统一表述为跨外层步骤持久化历史信息，需要同时打通表示、机制与学习范式才能构建可靠的记忆条件化视频生成系统。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Even Sharper Bounds for Transductive Learning and Its Applications
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sharper Transductive Local Complexity (STLC), a localized complexity method for transductive learning under uniform sampling without replacement. The construction starts from a Bernstein-type concentration inequality for the supremum of the test--train empirical process. Its proof uses the modified log-Sobolev inequality for the swap walk and a two-parameter entropy closure. A peeling argument with a surrogate localization functional then gives excess-risk bounds with the same fixed-point and confidence terms as the classical inductive local Rademacher-complexity bounds, without the additional logarithmic confidence factor in earlier transductive results. For realizable learning over a binary class of VC dimension $\dVC$, with training size $m$, test size $u$, and $u\ge m\ge\dVC$, STLC yields $\cO\{\dVC\log(me/\dVC)/m\}$. This matches the standard inductive rate and, when $m\ge9$, is within a logarithmic factor of the transductive minimax lower bound of order $\dVC/m$. For transductive kernel learning, STLC gives a spectrum-adaptive excess-risk bound without the multiplicative imbalance factors appearing in the earlier local-complexity bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sharper Transductive Local Complexity (STLC)，在不放回均匀抽样下给出与归纳式 local Rademacher 界同形的 transductive excess-risk 界，去掉早期结果中额外的对数置信因子与乘性不平衡因子。可实现情形下界为 O{dVC·log(me/dVC)/m}，m≥9 时距 transductive 极小极大下界 dVC/m 仅差一个对数因子。
Motivation: 早期 transductive 局部复杂度界带有额外的对数置信因子和乘性不平衡因子，且未与归纳式界及 transductive 极小极大下界对齐。
Method: 从 test–train 经验过程上确界的 Bernstein 型集中不等式出发，证明用 swap walk 的 modified log-Sobolev 不等式与双参数熵闭合；再用 peeling 论证加代理局部化泛函得到 excess-risk 界。
Result: 可实现学习、VC 维 dVC、训练规模 m、测试规模 u 且 u≥m≥dVC 时，STLC 给出 O{dVC·log(me/dVC)/m}，与标准归纳速率一致；m≥9 时距阶为 dVC/m 的 transductive 极小极大下界仅差一个对数因子；transductive kernel learning 得到谱自适应 excess-risk 界，无早期局部复杂度界中的乘性不平衡因子。
Conclusion: transductive 学习的局部复杂度界可以做到与归纳式界同形且不损失置信项，速率上逼近 transductive 极小极大下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason About Runtime Behavior? A Repository-Level Dynamic Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in coding tasks, but their ability to reason about code execution remains unclear. Existing repository-level QA benchmarks mainly evaluate static code understanding and often rely on LLM-based evaluation, while execution-reasoning benchmarks are mostly limited to snippets or functions. We introduce SWE-Flux, a repository-level benchmark for dynamic execution reasoning containing 480 execution-grounded instances across 12 real Python repositories, with gold answers automatically harvested from instrumented test executions rather than written manually or judged by LLMs. The benchmark covers singletest and multi-test questions over control flow, loops, program state, dataflow, exceptions, and program invariants. Evaluating five LLMs shows that this task remains challenging. The best model achieves only 37% accuracy. Models perform better on localized behavior such as invariants, intra-procedural control flow, exceptions, and simple loops, but struggle with dataflow, inter-procedural execution, precise state reasoning, and suite-level aggregation. Finally, we show that the oracle-harvesting pipeline can generate fresh benchmark variants using input perturbation. It successfully harvests valid variants for almost 90% of the selected instances, and the resulting variants are substantially more challenging for the evaluated models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出仓库级动态执行推理基准 SWE-Flux：480 个执行锚定实例、覆盖 12 个真实 Python 仓库，金标准答案由插桩测试执行自动采集而非人工撰写或 LLM 判分。评测五个 LLM 后最佳模型仅 37% 准确率，数据流、跨过程执行与测试套件级聚合最难；输入扰动生成的新变体对约 90% 选中实例采集成功且明显更难。
Motivation: 现有仓库级 QA 基准只测静态代码理解且常依赖 LLM 判分，执行推理基准又局限于片段或函数，无法衡量模型对真实仓库运行时行为的推理能力。
Method: SWE-Flux 覆盖单测试与多测试问题，题型含控制流、循环、程序状态、数据流、异常与程序不变量；金标准答案由插桩测试执行自动采集，并用输入扰动生成新基准变体。
Result: 480 个执行锚定实例、12 个真实 Python 仓库；评测五个 LLM，最佳模型准确率仅 37%；模型在不变量、过程内控制流、异常与简单循环上较好，在数据流、跨过程执行、精确状态推理与套件级聚合上吃力；oracle 采集管线对约 90% 选中实例成功产出有效变体，且变体对被测模型明显更难。
Conclusion: LLM 对仓库级运行时行为的推理仍是短板，尤其在数据流与跨过程状态上；基于执行的 oracle 采集可低成本扩充更难的动态基准变体。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Phases of Repulsive Self-Attention: Chaos, Attention Condensation, and Emergent Locality
papers.abstract_en: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics of a minimal recurrent transformer with $N$ normalized tokens, $Q=K=I$, and a negative value map $V=-I$. Similarity-based attention selects nearby representations, while the negative value map drives tokens away from the selected field. This feedback can continually reorganize both the representation geometry and the attention network. For $d=2$, the tokens lie on a circle, where the regular polygon is an exact fixed point. As the attention feedback strength $γ$ is increased, the polygon loses stability through a flip bifurcation, giving rise to period-two motion, chaos, and cluster-exchange or cluster-flip states. Despite this temporal complexity, attention remains diffuse as $N\to\infty$ at finite fixed softmax sharpness $β$. Attention condensation instead emerges in the scaling regime $β\sim N^2$. In the hard-routing limit, repulsive updates amplify local perturbations and routing-partner switches transmit them ballistically, producing an emergent butterfly cone in representation space. High-dimensional geometry provides a distinct route to localization. For $d=N\to\infty$, simulations from Gaussian initial conditions provide evidence for a condensation transition at $β=O(1)$, driven by dynamically generated finite overlap gaps. Depending on $γ$, the resulting phases include diffuse simplex-like states, consensus flips, condensed active routing with signatures of chaos, and fragmented cluster flips. These results establish temporal activity, attention condensation, and geometric clustering as distinct collective phenomena, and show that sparse attention can sustain persistent dynamics rather than freeze it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Q=K=I、V=-I 的最小循环 transformer 中，排斥性负值映射与相似度注意力构成反馈，随反馈强度 γ 增大，d=2 的正多边形不动点经 flip 分岔失稳，依次出现周期二、混沌与 cluster-exchange/cluster-flip 态。注意力凝聚 (attention condensation) 只在 β~N² 标度下出现，有限 β 时 N→∞ 仍弥散；d=N→∞ 时高维几何在 β=O(1) 即可由动态生成的有限 overlap gap 触发凝聚相变。
Motivation: 注意力动力学何时冻结、何时维持持续活动缺少可解的最小模型；相似度选择与负值排斥的反馈如何同时产生时间混沌与几何凝聚尚无统一刻画。
Method: 研究 N 个归一化 token 的最小循环 transformer，取 Q=K=I、V=-I，相似度 softmax 注意力选择近邻而负值映射排斥所选场；d=2 时 token 落在圆上、正多边形为精确不动点，做分岔分析；d=N→∞ 时从 Gaussian 初值做数值模拟。
Result: γ 增大经 flip 分岔产生周期二、混沌与 cluster-exchange/cluster-flip 态；有限 softmax 锐度 β 下 N→∞ 注意力仍弥散，凝聚需 β~N²；硬路由极限下扰动经路由伙伴切换弹道传播，在表示空间形成 butterfly cone；d=N→∞ 时模拟给出 β=O(1) 处凝聚相变的证据，相包括弥散 simplex-like 态、consensus flips、带混沌特征的凝聚活跃路由、碎裂 cluster flips。
Conclusion: 时间活动、注意力凝聚与几何聚类是三种不同的集体现象；稀疏注意力可以维持持续动力学而非使其冻结。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reordering a set of mathematical rules without changing its meaning should preserve the correct answer, but must a model's internal representations stay invariant too? We investigate this question using synthetic multi-step function-composition problems, each presented under multiple rule orderings with the same correct answer. We measure accuracy and permutation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which quantifies how distinctly ordering patterns are represented relative to variation across problem instances. Across 16 language models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters, we find a pattern: models that solve reordered problems more accurately represent different rule orderings more distinctly. Layer-averaged permutation SNR is positively rank-correlated with accuracy in every synthetic setting we evaluate, with Spearman correlations reaching 0.86. These findings highlight a distinction between answer invariance and representation invariance: successful mathematical rule composition can accompany distinct internal representations between equivalent rule orderings. This motivates distinguishing answer invariance from representation invariance, and offers a representational perspective on mathematical reasoning beyond answer accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成多步函数复合任务上，把同一组数学规则重排后正确答案不变，但模型内部表征并不不变：解重排题越准的模型，越把不同规则顺序编码得彼此可区分。16 个 1B–8B 语言模型中，层平均置换信噪比 (permutation SNR) 与准确率在每个合成设置上都呈正秩相关，Spearman 相关最高达 0.86。
Motivation: 只看答案准确率无法区分模型是真正学到了顺序无关的规则复合，还是靠依赖顺序的内部表征碰对答案；需要一个能刻画表征是否随等价重排而改变的度量。
Method: 构造合成多步函数复合问题，每题给出多个规则排列顺序且正确答案相同；在 16 个参数量 1B–8B 的语言模型上测量准确率与置换信噪比 (permutation SNR)，该指标刻画不同排序模式的表征相对跨题目实例变化的可分辨程度，并对各层做 layer-averaged 后与准确率求秩相关。
Result: 在全部所评估的合成设置中，layer-averaged permutation SNR 与准确率的 Spearman 秩相关均为正，最高达 0.86；覆盖 16 个 1B–8B 参数的语言模型。
Conclusion: 答案不变性与表征不变性应当分开：成功的数学规则复合可以与等价规则顺序之间明显不同的内部表征共存，评价数学推理不能只看答案准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HaRP: High Dynamic Range Photosequencing through Dual Reversed Shutter Scanning
papers.abstract_en: The adoption of CMOS sensors in mobile photography is frequently compromised by the rolling shutter (RS) effect, which introduces geometric distortions and motion artifacts. Particularly, recent rolling shutter with global reset (RSGR) mode, while mitigating some RS issues, also incurs major limitations, including reduced capture speed and compressed dynamic range. To address these problems, we propose a novel dual reversed scanning setup utilizing both RSGR and inverted RSGR views. This solution not only handles the inherent flaws of RSGR by synchronizing complementary exposures to balance the dynamic range across the frames but also introduces an effective method for HDR photosequencing under highly dynamic scenes. Our proposed network first accommodates row-wise complementarity and manages visual shifts by row-adaptive feature alignment. Subsequently, the hallucination module, built upon a correlation-guided mixattention block, integrates the mutually reinforced features to recover missing details. In addition, we construct a coaxial imaging system to collect a real-world dataset, enabling robust training and evaluation beyond numerical simulation. Experimental results demonstrate the twofold benefits of our solution in mitigating RSGR limitations and advancing HDR reconstruction techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CMOS 手机摄影中 rolling shutter with global reset (RSGR) 模式带来的采集速度下降与动态范围压缩，提出双反向扫描 (dual reversed scanning) 设置，同步互补曝光来平衡各帧动态范围，并在网络中用行自适应特征对齐处理行级互补与视觉位移，再由 correlation-guided mixattention 的幻觉模块融合互补特征恢复缺失细节。自建同轴成像系统采集真实数据集用于训练与评测，实验结果同时体现缓解 RSGR 限制与推进 HDR 重建两方面收益。
Motivation: CMOS 传感器的 rolling shutter 效应引入几何畸变与运动伪影；RSGR 模式虽缓解部分 RS 问题，却带来采集速度下降和动态范围压缩，高动态场景下 HDR 拍摄受限。
Method: 硬件上采用 RSGR 与反向 RSGR 双视角的 dual reversed scanning 设置，同步互补曝光；网络先用 row-adaptive feature alignment 处理行级互补与视觉位移，再用基于 correlation-guided mixattention block 的 hallucination module 融合互相增强的特征恢复缺失细节；并搭建 coaxial imaging system 采集真实数据集，支撑超越纯数值模拟的训练与评测。
Result: 实验结果体现双重收益：既缓解 RSGR 的采集速度与动态范围限制，又推进 HDR 重建技术；评测基于自建同轴成像系统的真实数据集，而非仅数值模拟。
Conclusion: 双反向扫描的互补曝光加上行级对齐与相关性引导融合，可同时解决 RSGR 的固有缺陷并支持高动态场景下的 HDR photosequencing。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimal-Norm Univariate Two-Layer ReLU Classification: Exact Solutions and Global Optimality with Skip Connections
papers.abstract_en: We study minimal-norm interpolation and $\ell_2$-regularized logistic-loss minimization for binary classification by univariate two-layer ReLU networks. We give complete geometric characterizations of the optimal classifiers in function space, resolving how the solutions depend on whether hidden-layer biases are included in the parameter norm. When biases are unpenalized, the minimal-norm interpolators are exactly the continuous piecewise-affine functions that hug every label switch and have kinks of the appropriate convexity. When biases are penalized, the minimizer is unique in function space, has exactly one kink in each intermediate same-label segment, and is therefore a sparsest positive-margin classifier. We further show that adding a free affine skip connection leaves these function-space solutions unchanged but fundamentally improves the parameter-space landscape: every KKT point of the constrained problem becomes globally optimal, whereas suboptimal KKT points can occur without the skip connection. We establish analogous global-optimality and geometric results for sufficiently weak $\ell_2$-regularization of the logistic loss. In the unpenalized-bias case, we identify an additional sparsity-like restriction, implying that most minimal-norm interpolators cannot arise as small-regularization limits of margin-normalized logistic-loss minimizers. Numerical experiments across varying dataset complexity and network width support the predicted landscape and sparsity phenomena.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 两层 ReLU 网络的最小范数插值解在函数空间与参数空间的几何结构、以及偏差是否计入范数如何改变解，此前缺少完整刻画；优化上还存在非全局的 KKT 停滞点。
Method: 在一元输入设定下对最小范数插值与 ℓ2 正则 logistic 损失做函数空间几何刻画，区分偏差惩罚与不惩罚两种情形；引入自由仿射 skip connection 分析 KKT 点的全局最优性，并对足够弱的 ℓ2 正则化建立对应的全局最优性与几何结论；辅以不同数据集复杂度与网络宽度的数值实验。
Result: 偏差不惩罚时最小范数插值器恰为紧贴每个标签切换、拐点具相应凸性的连续分段仿射函数；偏差受罚时函数空间解唯一、每个中间同标签段恰有一个拐点，为最稀疏正间隔分类器。加 skip connection 后约束问题的每个 KKT 点全局最优，不加则可出现次优 KKT 点。弱 ℓ2 正则下有类似结论；不惩罚偏差时另存在一种稀疏性限制，意味着大多数最小范数插值器不可能是 margin 归一化 logistic 最小化的小正则化极限。数值实验覆盖不同数据集复杂度与网络宽度，支持所预测的 landscape 与稀疏性现象。

papers.title: MultiVENT-Raw: A Benchmark for Retrieval and Reasoning over Raw Videos
papers.abstract_en: Online information is increasingly consumed in video format. Much of this comes in the form of *raw video*: continuous footage taken on a cell phone, with a hand-held camera, or via CCTV, which is then directly uploaded to social media platforms and content sharing services. Whereas professional or even amateur-edited footage tends to feature scripted speech, chyrons, graphics, and metadata that help contextualize its subject matter, raw video typically contains none of these things, making it a much more challenging medium for information retrieval and machine understanding. To facilitate progress in this domain, we release MultiVENT-Raw, a multilingual collection of nearly 120,000 primarily raw videos (over 5,300 total hours), paired with 130 events and 222 event-centric queries, along with human-annotated video relevance judgments and human-extracted key facts for relevant videos. MultiVENT-Raw supports both a retrieval task---to identify videos in the collection relevant to a query event---and a generation task---to summarize event-related videos into a coherent report for a target user. We benchmark strong baselines on MultiVENT-Raw, showing both tasks to be challenging even for some of the latest multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布 MultiVENT-Raw：约 12 万条多语种原始视频（逾 5,300 小时）、130 个事件与 222 条事件中心查询，配人工相关性判断与关键事实，支持事件视频检索与报告生成两项任务。强基线（含最新多模态模型）在两项任务上均表现吃紧，说明无脚本、无字幕条的 raw video 仍是机器理解难点。
Motivation: 线上信息大量转为手机/CCTV 直传的 raw video，缺少脚本语音、字幕条、图形与元数据，检索与机器理解远难于剪辑视频，此前缺少配套评测集。
Method: 构建多语种 raw video 集合，标注事件相关性判断与关键事实，定义检索（按事件查询找相关视频）与生成（把相关视频汇总成面向目标用户的连贯报告）两项任务，并在其上跑强基线。
Result: 数据集含近 120,000 条视频、逾 5,300 小时、130 个事件、222 条事件中心查询；基线测试显示两项任务对部分最新多模态模型仍具挑战性。
Conclusion: raw video 的检索与报告生成是当前多模态模型尚未解决的开放任务，MultiVENT-Raw 提供了配套评测载体。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Predicting the Progression of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis
papers.abstract_en: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis is defined as a lateral curvature of the spine that develops during adolescence, without known cause. The condition can result in significant pain and disability, and often progresses rapidly during adolescence. The objective of this paper is to predict the progression of the condition in a temporal sequence from ages 9 to 24, as measured from a sequence of Dual X-ray Absorptiometry (DXA) scans. To this end, we train a transformer model that takes in the curve of the spine to predict curve progression. The model is trained using a large-scale synthetic dataset of spine curves and their time series, covering different curve types and different progression patterns. We show that the model is able to generalise from synthetic to real data by evaluating it on a dataset of real DXA scans covering multiple time points. We find that fine-tuning the model on real data gives a significant boost to performance. The model is able to accurately predict spine curve progression in both scoliosis and normal cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用在大规模合成脊柱曲线时间序列上训练的 transformer，从 DXA 扫描序列预测 9–24 岁青少年特发性脊柱侧弯 (AIS) 的曲线进展；模型可从合成数据泛化到真实多时点 DXA 数据，在真实数据上微调后性能显著提升，对侧弯与正常病例均能准确预测进展。
Motivation: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯常在青春期快速进展并致残，但进展预测需要覆盖多种曲线类型与进展模式的纵向标注数据，真实 DXA 序列难以大规模获取。
Method: 训练一个以脊柱曲线为输入的 transformer 预测曲线进展；训练数据为覆盖不同曲线类型与不同进展模式的大规模合成脊柱曲线及其时间序列，随后在真实多时点 DXA 扫描数据集上微调。
Result: 在覆盖多个时间点的真实 DXA 数据集上，模型能从合成数据泛化到真实数据；在真实数据上微调带来性能显著提升；在脊柱侧弯与正常病例上均能准确预测脊柱曲线进展。
Conclusion: 合成曲线时间序列加真实数据微调这条路径可用于 9–24 岁脊柱侧弯进展预测，微调是取得准确预测的关键一步。

papers.title: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing exoskeleton assistance across operating conditions is constrained by the time and physical effort required to collect user feedback. We examined whether a user's preference landscape varies smoothly across operating conditions and when this continuity supports learning from limited feedback. We propose Context-Continuous Preference Learning (CCPL), a Gaussian-process preference model that shares observations across nearby contexts while retaining context-specific utility estimates. We evaluated CCPL through simulations and retrospective analyses of ankle and elbow exoskeleton preference data from nine healthy adults. In simulations, CCPL improved reconstruction and preference-based Bayesian optimization relative to independent learning when preferences varied smoothly, but showed negative transfer when continuity was weak. In both human studies, full-data reference landscapes estimated separately for each participant and context tended to be more similar between nearby operating conditions. With five exposures per context, CCPL increased mean reconstruction correlation with these references from 0.644 to 0.720 for ankle assistance and from 0.476 to 0.526 for elbow assistance relative to independent learning. The five-exposure budget was approximately 37% lower for ankle and 17% lower for elbow than the estimated independent-learning budgets needed to match these correlations. CCPL also improved held-out response prediction relative to independent learning, while benefits over pooled learning varied. These findings support context continuity as a basis for sharing preference observations under limited feedback, although benefits for online personalization in humans remain to be established.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Context-Continuous Preference Learning (CCPL)：用高斯过程偏好模型在相邻工况 (operating condition) 间共享反馈，同时保留各工况独立的效用估计。在 9 名健康成年人的踝/肘外骨骼偏好数据上，每工况 5 次暴露时，相对独立学习把与全数据参考景观的平均重建相关从 0.644 提到 0.720（踝）、0.476 提到 0.526（肘）；偏好平滑变化时有效，平滑性弱时出现负迁移。
Motivation: 外骨骼助力个性化需要逐工况收集用户偏好反馈，耗时且体力成本高；关键未知是偏好景观是否随工况平滑变化，以及这种连续性何时足以支撑少量反馈下的学习。
Method: CCPL 是高斯过程偏好模型，在邻近 context 间共享观测并保留 context 特定的效用估计；评估方式为仿真加踝与肘外骨骼偏好数据的回顾性分析，对照独立学习 (independent learning) 与合并学习 (pooled learning)，并做基于偏好的 Bayesian optimization。
Result: 仿真中偏好平滑变化时 CCPL 改善重建与偏好式 Bayesian optimization，平滑性弱时出现负迁移。9 名健康成年人数据、每 context 5 次暴露下，与全数据参考景观的平均重建相关：踝 0.644 → 0.720，肘 0.476 → 0.526（均相对独立学习）；达到该相关所需的五次暴露预算比独立学习估计预算约低 37%（踝）与 17%（肘）。留出响应预测也优于独立学习，相对 pooled learning 的收益不一。
Conclusion: 在有限反馈下，context 连续性可作为共享偏好观测的依据；但摘要指出其在人体在线个性化中的收益仍有待确立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Repairability of Inexact Solvers in Recursive State Estimation with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recursive state estimation often executes approximate numerical solutions inside a feedback loop, where highly accurate local steps do not guarantee better overall results. For a fixed linear Kalman model, we characterize when a correction within a prescribed subspace and norm budget can meet a local admissibility tolerance, and how the defects actually executed affect the finite-horizon covariance response. Centering each defect on the exact gain for the implemented covariance separates current solve error from inherited gain drift. Expanding the exact residual-drift identity reveals opposing quartic contributions beyond the quadratic response: innovation-covariance inflation enters positively, while local-gain reoptimization enters subtractively. Under matched initialization, an absolute sixth-order remainder bound, uniform over bounded defect sequences at fixed horizon, gives sufficient conditions for quadratic under- or overprediction. Machine learning proposes bounded corrections, while a learner-independent residual certificate and verified fallback govern execution of classical and quantum candidates without changing the reference estimator. In a power-grid tolerance study, learned correction lowers the minimum conjugate-gradient iteration count for deployment without fallback relative to uncorrected solves under the same residual certificate. Gains reconstructed from a variational quantum linear solver and from an annealing-based binary encoding, with small-scale terminal measurements on superconducting hardware and sampling on a quantum annealer, are executed through the same interface. By linking local repairability to nonlinear error propagation, the framework evaluates approximate solvers and learned corrections through independent certification and finite-horizon response, providing a practical basis for studying hybrid quantum--classical computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定线性 Kalman 递归状态估计中，把每步求解缺陷以实现协方差下的精确增益为中心，可把当前求解误差与继承的增益漂移分离，并证明六阶余项界给出二次欠/过预测的充分条件。在电网容差研究中，学习到的修正在相同残差证书下降低了免回退部署所需的共轭梯度最少迭代次数；变分量子线性求解器与退火二进制编码重建的增益经同一接口执行。
Motivation: 递归状态估计的反馈环内常嵌入近似数值求解，局部高精度步并不保证整体结果更好，缺少把局部可修复性与有限时域协方差响应联系起来的判定条件。
Method: 对固定线性 Kalman 模型，刻画指定子空间与范数预算内修正满足局部容差的条件；展开精确残差-漂移恒等式得到四次项（新息协方差膨胀为正、局部增益再优化为负）与绝对六阶余项界；用机器学习提出有界修正，配合学习器无关的残差证书与已验证回退执行经典与量子候选解算器，不改动参考估计器。
Result: 在电网容差研究中，学习修正使相同残差证书下免回退部署所需的最少共轭梯度迭代次数低于未修正求解；增益分别由变分量子线性求解器（超导硬件小规模终端测量）与退火二进制编码（量子退火机采样）重建并经同一接口执行。
Conclusion: 局部可修复性经独立认证与有限时域响应可评估近似求解器和学习修正，为混合量子-经典计算研究提供实用基础；六阶余项界给出二次欠/过预测的充分条件。
Relevance: 38

summary_sections.result: 在电网容差研究中，学习修正使相同残差证书下免回退部署所需的最少共轭梯度迭代次数低于未修正求解；增益分别由变分量子线性求解器（超导硬件小规模终端测量）与退火二进制编码（量子退火机采样）重建并经同一接口执行。
summary_sections.conclusion: 局部可修复性经独立认证与有限时域响应可评估近似求解器和学习修正，为混合量子-经典计算研究提供实用基础；六阶余项界给出二次欠/过预测的充分条件。

papers.title: The Skin-Restricted Reinhard Transform:Uniqueness under a Lightness-Preserving Constraint
papers.abstract_en: Catalog skin recolouring has to change pigment and leave shading alone. The classical Reinhard map does not make that split: it rescales lightness by the ratio of standard deviations, and a flat reference swatch therefore flattens the limb. This paper formalises the correction used in our pipeline, the skin-restricted Reinhard transform. It is the diagonal affine map in CIE Lab that translates lightness, matches the chromatic mean, and clamps the chromatic gain to [0.72, 1.18], with moments taken on the central 84% of each channel. A diagonal affine map has six real parameters. The shading constraint forces the lightness gain to +1 and the lightness shift to the difference of means; one-dimensional quadratic optimal transport on each chromatic axis, followed by Euclidean projection onto the gain interval, fixes the other four. Inside that family the four conditions determine every parameter. The content of the result is the forced lightness gain; it is not a uniqueness claim outside the diagonal affine class. For Gaussian marginals the chromatic step is not merely the best affine map: it is the unrestricted Wasserstein-2 map. The same formulae with trimmed moments remain optimal because a positive affine image commutes with quantile trimming. On hands, arms, legs, and feet of nine photographs and three reference tones, the map keeps the lightness contrast ratio at 0.974 +/- 0.029 with chromatic error 0.77 CIE Lab units. Reinhard matching, the linear Monge map, and histogram matching reach a smaller chromatic error only by cutting lightness contrast to about half.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出皮肤受限 Reinhard 变换：在 CIE Lab 对角仿射族内，用保持明度的约束强制明度增益为 +1、明度平移取均值差，色度增益由一维二次最优传输后投影到 [0.72, 1.18]，从而改肤色不改明暗。在 9 张照片的手臂腿脚与 3 种参考色调上，明度对比度保持 0.974 ± 0.029、色度误差 0.77 CIE Lab 单位；Reinhard、线性 Monge 与直方图匹配虽可把色度误差压得更低，却把明度对比度砍到约一半。
Motivation: 目录肤色重着色必须只改色素、保留阴影，但经典 Reinhard 映射用标准差之比缩放明度，平坦参考色块会把肢体明暗压平。
Method: 在 CIE Lab 上定义对角仿射映射：明度做平移、色度匹配均值、色度增益截断到 [0.72, 1.18]，矩在每通道中央 84% 上取；明度约束把 6 个实参数中的明度增益定为 +1、明度平移定为均值差，其余 4 个由每条色度轴的一维二次最优传输 (quadratic optimal transport) 加欧氏投影到增益区间确定。高斯边缘下色度步是无限制的 Wasserstein-2 映射；正仿射映射与分位数截断可交换，故截断矩下公式仍最优。
Result: 在 9 张照片的手、臂、腿、足与 3 种参考色调上，明度对比度比保持 0.974 ± 0.029，色度误差 0.77 CIE Lab 单位；Reinhard matching、线性 Monge 映射与直方图匹配可取得更小色度误差，但明度对比度降到约一半。
Conclusion: 在对角仿射类内，四条条件唯一确定全部参数，且被强制的是明度增益为 +1；该唯一性不外推到对角仿射类之外。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from \emph{task-state contamination}, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort subsequent decisions. We propose the \textbf{Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)}, which models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress rather than simulating tool responses. AEWM combines \textbf{Action Judge} to distinguish \textsc{Critical}, \textsc{Exploratory}, and \textsc{Noisy} decisions with \textbf{State Revision} to edit noisy reasoning--action continuations from the same observed history. \textbf{EditAct} integrates these capabilities with real execution, directly changing the state underlying subsequent decisions rather than merely providing critiques. We train AEWM across Search, Terminal, and Software Engineering through mid-training and supervised fine-tuning. AEWM achieves 70.5\% macro-F1 on our Action Judge benchmark, exceeding the strongest frontier baseline by 10.6 points. Across six benchmarks and three agent backbones, EditAct improves average scores by 3.2--6.7 points over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, rejection sampling fine-tuning on verified EditAct trajectories, termed \textbf{AEWM-RFT}, improves over Self-RFT by 2.2--2.6 points across three domains without online AEWM guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)，不再模拟工具返回，而是建模推理与动作如何改变任务状态：Action Judge 把决策分为 Critical/Exploratory/Noisy，State Revision 从同一观测历史改写含噪的推理-动作续写，EditAct 再把编辑直接落到真实执行状态上。Action Judge 基准 macro-F1 达 70.5%，超最强前沿基线 10.6 个点；六个基准、三种 agent backbone 上 EditAct 平均分提升 3.2–6.7 个点。
Motivation: 语言世界模型预测高熵、依赖执行的工具返回，而真实反馈本就可得，重建价值有限；同时 agent 的历史里会残留无依据假设与过期计划（task-state contamination），扭曲后续决策。
Method: AEWM 由 Action Judge（区分 Critical、Exploratory、Noisy 三类决策）与 State Revision（在同一观测历史上编辑含噪的推理-动作续写）组成，EditAct 把编辑接入真实执行、直接改写后续决策所依赖的状态；在 Search、Terminal、Software Engineering 三类环境上用 mid-training 与 supervised fine-tuning 训练，并衍生出 AEWM-RFT（对已验证的 EditAct 轨迹做 rejection sampling fine-tuning）。
Result: Action Judge 基准 macro-F1 70.5%，比最强前沿基线高 10.6 个点；在六个基准、三种 agent backbone 上 EditAct 相对最强基线平均分提升 3.2–6.7 个点；AEWM-RFT 在三个域上比 Self-RFT 高 2.2–2.6 个点，且推理时不再需要在线 AEWM 引导。
Conclusion: 把世界模型的职责从模拟工具响应改为编辑任务状态，能直接改善长时程 agent 决策；编辑能力蒸馏进轨迹后，即使去掉在线引导仍能保留增益。

papers.title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision. DART outperforms its latent only parent on the full protocol, restores the temporal structure of motion, and re-couples predicted motion to the scene; at larger scale it further improves prediction quality, closing nearly half the remaining gap to an oracle-informed interpolation reference. Finally, we report an unexpected finding about evaluation: pixel error alone rewards frozen predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结自监督 latent 空间里的 flow 世界模型在操作任务上会静默丢失运动：预训练 flow 根本不移动被操作物体，仅用 latent 损失重训只会把静止换成瞬移式运动。作者把失败归因于 anchor-sparse 的 latent-only 监督从未指定变化应发生在时间轴何处，提出 DART（decode-augmented rollout training）在保持表征冻结的前提下只重训 flow、加入 decode-path 监督，恢复了运动的时间结构并把预测运动与场景重新耦合。
Motivation: 冻结 latent 空间中的 flow 世界模型训练稳定且便宜，但 latent-only 监督缺少沿时间轴的变化定位信号，导致操作所依赖的运动属性丢失，且重训无法修复。
Method: DART 保持预训练表征冻结，只重训 flow，用经过解码路径 (decode path) 的 rollout 监督补充 anchor-sparse 的 latent-only 信号；评测协议同时对照 latent-only 父模型与 oracle-informed interpolation 参考。
Result: DART 在完整协议上超过其 latent-only 父模型，恢复了运动的时间结构并使预测运动与场景重新耦合；在更大规模上进一步提升预测质量，缩小了距 oracle-informed interpolation 参考剩余差距的近一半。另报告评测层面的发现：仅用像素误差会奖励冻结（不动）的预测。
Conclusion: 运动丢失的根源在训练信号而非表征，冻结表征下补上 decode-path rollout 监督即可修复；同时像素误差单独使用会系统性偏袒不动的预测，评测需改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Holographic Reduced Representations with Clifford Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Vector Symbolic Algebras project data structures into a hyperdimensional vector space through the application of their vector algebras to randomly generated atomic vector symbols and fractional power encodings of real-valued data. Embedding unstructured data remains an open question. We present \textit{Clifford-VAE}, a variational autoencoder that learns to project data onto a Clifford torus in arbitrary dimensions. Experiments using the MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10 datasets demonstrate that Clifford-VAE produces representations that are competitive with those produced by Gaussian and Hyperspherical VAEs for semi-supervised classification tasks while outperforming Gaussian and Hyperspherical counterparts in the VSA benchmark tests of self-binding and unbinding, role-filler recovery, and bundle capacity. Clifford-VAE provides a principled technique for grounding perceptual data into a symbolic reasoning framework, providing a new approach to a long-standing problem in the VSA literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Clifford-VAE，把数据学到 Clifford torus 上的表示，作为把感知数据接地到向量符号代数 (VSA) 的手段。在 MNIST、FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 上，半监督分类与 Gaussian、Hyperspherical VAE 相当，而在 VSA 的 self-binding/unbinding、role-filler recovery、bundle capacity 基准上超过两者。
Motivation: VSA 用随机原子向量和分数幂编码投影数据，但非结构化数据如何嵌入仍是开放问题，感知数据难以接地到符号推理框架。
Method: Clifford-VAE：变分自编码器，将数据投影到任意维度的 Clifford torus 上，输出表示接入 VSA 的绑定、解绑与捆绑操作。
Result: 在 MNIST、FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 上，半监督分类表现与 Gaussian VAE、Hyperspherical VAE 竞争；在 VSA 基准测试 self-binding 与 unbinding、role-filler recovery、bundle capacity 上优于这两类对照。
Conclusion: Clifford torus 上的变分表示为把感知数据接地到 VSA 符号推理框架提供了有原则的做法，是 VSA 文献中长期问题的一个新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Collective Dynamics with Differentiable Gaussian Representations
papers.abstract_en: Collective responses depend on individual differences, contact opportunities, and accumulated experience. Learning their dynamics from aggregate counts requires connecting a population's response distribution to both current observations and future behavior. We introduce Differentiable Gaussian Dynamics (DGD), which learns this connection through three components: a Gaussian mixture representing heterogeneous response propensities, differentiable aggregation of contact intensity and behavioral probabilities, and feedback recurrence that updates subsequent responses. Reparameterized integration and temporal recurrence let aggregate prediction errors jointly train the distribution, observation functions, and feedback parameters. On four windows from KuaiRand-Pure and Online Retail II, DGD achieves lower joint behavioral negative log-likelihood than a DeepAR adaptation with a joint-behavior head. In Retail 2010, its one-day behavioral-count MAE is 4.71 versus 6.88 for this adaptation. Learning the distribution reduces behavioral negative log-likelihood by 10.82% relative to a fixed Gaussian in KuaiRand's standard-recommendation window; removing feedback dynamics raises joint KL from 0.0340 to 0.2577 in a controlled experiment. These results establish the value of learning population representations and their feedback process from aggregate observations. Code is available at https://github.com/OranAi-Ltd/oransim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Differentiable Gaussian Dynamics (DGD)，用高斯混合表示个体异质响应倾向，经可微聚合把接触强度与行为概率映射为聚合计数，再用反馈递推更新后续行为，使聚合预测误差联合训练分布、观测函数与反馈参数。在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 Online Retail II 的四个窗口上，DGD 的联合行为负对数似然低于带联合行为头的 DeepAR 改造版；Retail 2010 单日行为计数 MAE 为 4.71（对照 6.88）。
Motivation: 从聚合计数学习群体响应动力学，需要把响应分布同时连接到当前观测与未来行为；个体差异、接触机会与累积经验使这一连接难以用固定分布或无反馈的计数模型刻画。
Method: DGD 含三个组件：表示异质响应倾向的高斯混合、对接触强度与行为概率的可微聚合、更新后续响应的反馈递推；用重参数化积分 (reparameterized integration) 与时序递推，让聚合预测误差联合训练分布、观测函数与反馈参数。
Result: 在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 Online Retail II 的四个窗口上，DGD 联合行为负对数似然低于带联合行为头的 DeepAR 改造版；Retail 2010 单日行为计数 MAE 4.71 对 6.88；在 KuaiRand 标准推荐窗口，学习分布使行为负对数似然相对固定 Gaussian 降低 10.82%；受控实验中去掉反馈动力学使联合 KL 从 0.0340 升至 0.2577。
Conclusion: 群体响应的分布及其反馈过程应当从聚合观测中一起学习：学习分布可降低行为负对数似然，去掉反馈递推会显著抬高联合 KL。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Differentiable Gaussian Dynamics (DGD)，用高斯混合表示个体异质响应倾向，经可微聚合把接触强度与行为概率映射为聚合计数，再用反馈递推更新后续行为，使聚合预测误差联合训练分布、观测函数与反馈参数。在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 Online Retail II 的四个窗口上，DGD 的联合行为负对数似然低于带联合行为头的 DeepAR 改造版；Retail 2010 单日行为计数 MAE 为 4.71（对照 6.88）。

summary_sections.method: DGD 含三个组件：表示异质响应倾向的高斯混合、对接触强度与行为概率的可微聚合、更新后续响应的反馈递推；用重参数化积分 (reparameterized integration) 与时序递推，让聚合预测误差联合训练分布、观测函数与反馈参数。
summary_sections.result: 在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 Online Retail II 的四个窗口上，DGD 联合行为负对数似然低于带联合行为头的 DeepAR 改造版；Retail 2010 单日行为计数 MAE 4.71 对 6.88；在 KuaiRand 标准推荐窗口，学习分布使行为负对数似然相对固定 Gaussian 降低 10.82%；受控实验中去掉反馈动力学使联合 KL 从 0.0340 升至 0.2577。
summary_sections.conclusion: 群体响应的分布及其反馈过程应当从聚合观测中一起学习：学习分布可降低行为负对数似然，去掉反馈递推会显著抬高联合 KL。

papers.title: Memory Attention
papers.abstract_en: Language models typically construct attention values from contextual hidden states, even when some of their content may be reusable across contexts. We investigate whether token-indexed memory can replace the dedicated value projection when complemented by contextual information. We propose Memory Attention (MA), which forms values by combining layer-specific token memory with contextual keys. The memory supplies token-specific representations, while the keys preserve context dependence. At inference, normalization can be folded into the memory tables, reducing value construction to lookup and addition. Token-indexed retrieval also enables CPU offloading with prefetching, reducing GPU parameter storage. Under matched training token budgets and with additional memory parameters, experiments across attention configurations show improved language modeling and average downstream performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memory Attention (MA) 用层专属的 token 索引记忆表替代注意力中专门的 value 投影，value 由记忆查表与上下文 key 相加得到；推理时归一化可折叠进记忆表，使 value 构造退化为查表加法。在匹配训练 token 预算、且记忆参数更多的条件下，跨多种 attention 配置的实验显示语言建模与下游平均性能均提升，token 索引检索还支持带预取的 CPU offloading 以降低 GPU 参数显存。
Motivation: 标准 attention 的 value 来自上下文 hidden states，但其中部分内容可跨上下文复用，专门的 value 投影因此存在冗余。
Method: 提出 Memory Attention：value 由 layer-specific token memory 与 contextual keys 组合而成，记忆提供 token 特异表示、key 保留上下文依赖；推理时把归一化折叠进记忆表，token 索引检索配合 prefetch 支持 CPU offloading。
Result: 在匹配训练 token 预算并额外增加记忆参数的设置下，跨多种 attention 配置的实验给出改进的语言建模与平均下游性能；推理侧 value 构造化为查表与加法，GPU 参数存储因 CPU offloading 而减少。
Conclusion: token 索引记忆加 contextual key 足以替代专门的 value 投影，同时换来查表式推理与更低的 GPU 显存占用。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Translation: General Forgetting Mitigation Does Not Preserve MT-Specific Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting. Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks. We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF): instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control. We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data. Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning. Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在机器翻译微调中，通用灾难性遗忘缓解方法并不能保住 MT 特定指令遵循 (MT-IF)：Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) 把通用基准平均分下降压到 1.7 分（标准微调为 11.0 分），但其正式度与语法性别的控制分数仍接近标准微调；只有混入控制任务数据能保住这些控制，且该收益不迁移到同任务的未见 prompt。
Motivation: 遗忘缓解方法通常只用通用基准的保持度来评估，而机器翻译微调真正需要保住的是修改译文的 MT 特定指令（formality、grammatical gender、length control），两者是否一致没有被检验。
Method: 比较三类缓解方法：锚定辅助数据、锚定模型输出、锚定基座模型参数；先用 Llama 3.2 1B Instruct 做筛选研究，再在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 上用双向 Arabic-English 与 Spanish-English 平行数据微调，并分别测通用基准与 MT-IF 控制项。
Result: EWC 在两个阶段都最能保住通用能力：8B Spanish 模型上通用基准平均分仅降 1.7 分，标准微调降 11.0 分；但 EWC 的 formality 与 grammatical gender 控制分数仍接近标准微调。只有 data mixing with control-task examples 能保住这些控制，其收益不迁移到同任务的未见 prompt。
Conclusion: 通用基准上的遗忘缓解排名不能外推到 MT 特定指令遵循：参数正则化方法（如 EWC）保通用能力但不保控制项，数据混合保控制项却过拟合到见过的 prompt 形式。

papers.title: Quantum score matching with applications to learning thermal states
papers.abstract_en: Score matching has driven major advances in classical generative learning by enabling models to learn from data without evaluating intractable normalization constants, or partition functions. Yet, extending this principle to quantum learning requires rethinking its foundations, as quantum states are described by noncommuting density operators rather than scalar probabilities. The noncommutativity creates fundamental challenges not only in defining quantum scores, but also in developing a training framework with efficient circuit implementations and rigorous theoretical guarantees. In this work, we bridge this gap by establishing a general quantum score-matching framework with end-to-end theoretical guarantees. Applied to Gibbs-state learning, our approach avoids additional thermal-state preparation and achieves information-theoretically optimal sample complexity in the high-temperature regime for Hamiltonians with bounded locality and interaction degree. This positions score matching as a new route to state-of-the-art performance in learning quantum Gibbs states. Beyond these theoretical results, numerical simulations show that our method remains effective even when gradients are estimated inaccurately under limited measurement budgets. Experiments on IBM quantum hardware further demonstrate that quantum score matching is NISQ-friendly: without any error mitigation or correction, it reduces the relative Hamiltonian-parameter error from 64% to approximately 10%. Together, these results extend score matching into an experimentally realizable paradigm for quantum-state learning.
papers.comment: 57 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, with an accompanying GitHub repository at https://github.com/dongsnaq/Quantum-Score-Matching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经典 score matching 推广到非对易密度算符，建立带端到端理论保证的量子 score-matching 框架，用于 Gibbs 态学习时无需额外热态制备。在高温、哈密顿量局域性与相互作用度有界的条件下达到信息论最优样本复杂度；IBM 量子硬件上不做误差缓解或纠错，相对哈密顿量参数误差从 64% 降到约 10%。
Motivation: 经典 score matching 靠绕开配分函数取得成功，但量子态由非对易密度算符描述而非标量概率，量子 score 的定义、可高效线路实现的训练框架与严格理论保证都缺失。
Method: 建立通用量子 score-matching 框架并给出端到端理论保证；应用于 Gibbs 态学习时绕开额外热态制备，理论分析覆盖高温区、有界局域性与有界相互作用度的哈密顿量，并给出信息论最优样本复杂度。
Result: 高温区对有界局域性与相互作用度的哈密顿量达到信息论最优样本复杂度；数值模拟显示在测量预算有限、梯度估计不准时方法仍有效；IBM 量子硬件实验在无误差缓解与纠错条件下把相对哈密顿量参数误差从 64% 降到约 10%。
Conclusion: score matching 可成为学习量子 Gibbs 态的新路线，并且在 NISQ 设备上可直接实现，无需误差缓解或纠错。

papers.title: When and Where to Trust the Teacher: Unifying On-Policy Distillation and GRPO through Entropy-Calibrated Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) supervises mathematical reasoning through final-answer correctness, but provides little guidance on individual tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense feedback on student-generated responses, yet teacher preference need not reflect correctness. Recent hybrids combine OPD and verifier-derived advantages or reweight task credit using teacher ratios. However, teacher guidance enters after verifier-based group normalization, and token reweighting need not preserve the total task credit assigned to each response. We introduce Unified Entropy-Calibrated Credit Redistribution for GRPO (UECR-GRPO), which integrates verifier and teacher signals within a single GRPO-style update at both the response and token levels. \emph{Path-Utility Unification} (PUU) combines verifier reward and a teacher-to-anchor path log-ratio in a single KL-regularized objective. Its on-policy implementation uses a length-normalized teacher score and combines both rewards before group normalization and PPO clipping, allowing teacher evidence to influence the response ranking. \emph{Entropy-Calibrated Redistribution} (ECR) then uses the signed teacher--old-policy token gap to redistribute the verifier-derived component. Full-vocabulary teacher entropy attenuates uncertain guidance, while a response-wise zero-sum projection preserves the total task credit and its token-wise sign before clipping. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, UECR-GRPO achieves average \(\mathrm{Avg@12}\) accuracies of 17.21\% and 65.09\% with Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students, respectively, exceeding the strongest baseline at each scale by 0.89 and 0.56 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UECR-GRPO，把验证器奖励与教师偏好在 GRPO 的响应级和 token 级统一进同一次更新：PUU 用长度归一化的 teacher-to-anchor 路径对数比与验证器奖励在组归一化和 PPO 裁剪前合并，ECR 用带符号的教师-旧策略 token 差重分配验证器分量，并以全词表教师熵衰减不确定引导、以响应级零和投影保住总任务信用。五个数学推理基准上 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Qwen3-4B 学生的 Avg@12 分别为 17.21% 和 65.09%，比各规模最强基线高 0.89 和 0.56 个百分点。
Motivation: RLVR 只按最终答案正确性给奖励，对单个 token 几乎没有指导；已有 OPD 与验证器优势的混合方法让教师信号在组归一化之后才进入，且 token 重加权会破坏每条响应的总任务信用。
Method: UECR-GRPO 含两个组件：Path-Utility Unification (PUU) 在单个 KL 正则目标中合并验证器奖励与 teacher-to-anchor 路径对数比，on-policy 实现用长度归一化教师分数，在组归一化与 PPO 裁剪前合并两种奖励以影响响应排序；Entropy-Calibrated Redistribution (ECR) 用带符号的教师-旧策略 token 差重分配验证器分量，全词表教师熵衰减不确定引导，响应级零和投影在裁剪前保持总任务信用及其 token 级符号。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准上，UECR-GRPO 的平均 Avg@12：Qwen3-1.7B 学生 17.21%，Qwen3-4B 学生 65.09%，分别比各规模最强基线高 0.89 和 0.56 个百分点。
Conclusion: 教师信号必须在组归一化之前与验证器奖励合并，并在 token 级重分配时用熵加权与零和投影保住总任务信用，才能在数学推理 RLVR 中稳定超过强基线。

papers.title: ForgetMimic: Motion Unlearning for Reinforcement Learning Humanoid Control
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid control, leveraging human demonstrations, has achieved diverse, agile, and natural locomotion behaviors through reinforcement learning (RL). While this paradigm has yielded remarkable performance in physical humanoid control, how to eliminate specific motions from learned policies remains insufficiently explored. Addressing this issue is motivated by pressing safety and privacy concerns: the removal of malicious, poisoned, or suboptimal motions, as well as copyright-protected motions subject to the right to be forgotten under regulations such as the GDPR, is of critical importance. To this end, we propose {ForgetMimic}, the first motion-level unlearning method designed specifically for physical-world humanoid control. The core idea of ForgetMimic is as follows: given a policy $π_θ$ trained on $N$ motions, our method degrades performance on a target subset of $K$ motions while preserving the effectiveness of the remaining $N-K$ motions. Furthermore, we identify and resolve two key training mechanisms in robot control that lead to unlearning failure. We conduct extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 motions, including Dance, Fight, Flip, and others. Experimental results demonstrate that ForgetMimic effectively eliminates memory of designated motions while maintaining the normal operation of all other motions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForgetMimic 是首个面向物理人形机器人控制的运动级遗忘 (motion-level unlearning) 方法：在 N 条运动训练的策略上，定向压低目标 K 条运动的表现，同时保住其余 N-K 条。作者识别并修复了机器人控制中导致遗忘失败的两个训练机制，在 Unitree G1 与 H2 上覆盖 Dance、Fight、Flip 等 12 条运动的实验中，指定运动的记忆被有效消除，其余运动保持正常运行。
Motivation: 基于人类演示的 RL 人形控制策略无法剔除特定运动，而移除恶意、中毒、次优或受版权保护（GDPR 被遗忘权）的运动是安全与隐私上的现实需求。
Method: 给定在 N 条运动上训练的策略 π_θ，对目标子集 K 条运动做性能退化、同时保持 N-K 条有效；并识别与修复机器人控制中导致 unlearning 失败的两个训练机制。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 与 H2 两类人形机器人、共 12 条运动（Dance、Fight、Flip 等）上的实验显示：指定运动的记忆被有效消除，同时其余所有运动维持正常运行。

papers.title: Shopping by algorithm: How agentic AI deploys human heuristics as a surrogate consumer
papers.abstract_en: Consumers increasingly delegate purchasing decisions to Large Language Models (LLMs) acting as surrogate consumers. Using "Tool-Lab," an adaptation of information-board process tracing that places product attributes behind costly tool calls, we examine how marketing pricing cues (i.e., just-below pricing and promotional framing) influence AI shopping agents. Across eight commercially deployed LLMs from three providers, we trace pre-choice information acquisition. Under zero cost, pricing cues rarely mislead. Imposing acquisition costs under a vague goal prompt leads LLMs to omit diagnostic attributes required to compute unit price and choose suboptimal choices resembling human heuristics. Relative to a specific goal prompt that mainly preserves diagnostic search and choice optimality, a vague goal prompt under constraints creates a search-mediated vulnerability. This research demonstrates that marketing heuristics in delegated AI shopping are governed by storefront information architecture, not necessarily immutable LLM flaws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把商品属性放在有成本的 tool call 后面（Tool-Lab），在八个商用 LLM 上追踪 AI 购物代理的搜前信息获取：零成本时定价线索几乎不误导；一旦引入获取成本且目标提示模糊，LLM 会跳过计算单价所需的诊断属性，做出类似人类启发式的次优选择，而具体目标提示基本保住诊断性搜索与选择最优性。结论是委托购物中的营销启发式由店面信息架构决定，而非 LLM 固有缺陷。
Motivation: 消费者越来越多地把购买决策委托给 LLM，但营销定价线索何时会真正操纵 AI 代理、何时不会，此前缺少过程层面的证据；这关系到店面信息设计是否构成对代理购物者的可乘之机。
Method: 改造信息板过程追踪 (information-board process tracing) 为 Tool-Lab，把产品属性隐藏在有成本的 tool call 之后，追踪三个提供商、八个商用部署 LLM 的搜前信息获取；实验操纵定价线索（just-under pricing、promotional framing）、信息获取成本，以及 vague 与 specific 两种目标提示。
Result: 在零成本条件下定价线索很少误导 LLM；引入获取成本并配合 vague goal prompt 后，LLM 省略计算 unit price 所需的诊断属性，选择类似人类启发式的次优选项；specific goal prompt 则主要保留诊断性搜索与选择最优性。
Conclusion: 委托 AI 购物中的营销启发式由店面信息架构（属性获取成本与目标提示具体度）塑造，而非不可变的 LLM 缺陷，因此可通过信息设计而非改模型来缓解。

papers.title: Memory-Conditioned Diffusion Model for Generalized Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Langevin equations describe non-Markovian dynamics in which the evolution of resolved variables depends on their past. We propose a memory-conditioned diffusion method for learning stochastic flow maps of these dynamics from observed trajectories, without identifying a memory kernel or reconstructing unresolved variables. A compact, recursively updated bank of exponential filters enables the flow map to retain predictive history over multiple time scales without conditioning on long observation windows. The next-step distribution is conditioned on the current observation and this memory state, whose storage and update costs are independent of the history length for a fixed bank size. Predictive criteria guide the memory budget, with reference-assisted selection in the vector benchmark, and an optional linear projection further reduces the conditioning dimension. A kernel-based score estimator generates conditional samples without training a score network, and these samples are used to train a neural flow map for autoregressive simulation. Three numerical examples assess long-memory retention at small conditioning dimension, predictive compression in coupled vector dynamics, and non-Gaussian conditional distributions and intermittent events. The non-Gaussian example reproduces conditional asymmetry and burst statistics in a stochastic model of the plasma scrape-off layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出记忆条件化的扩散方法，用一组递归更新的指数滤波器作为紧凑记忆库，直接从观测轨迹学习广义 Langevin 方程的随机流图，无需辨识 memory kernel 或重构未解析变量。记忆库的存储与更新代价与历史长度无关，可在小条件维度下保留多时间尺度的长记忆，并在等离子体刮削层随机模型中复现条件非对称与 burst 统计。
Motivation: 广义 Langevin 方程的非马尔可夫性要求流图携带历史信息，但直接条件于长观测窗口代价高，辨识 memory kernel 或重构未解析变量又都很困难。
Method: 用固定大小的指数滤波器组（bank of exponential filters）递归维护记忆状态，下一步分布条件于当前观测与该记忆状态；记忆预算由预测准则指导，向量基准上用 reference-assisted selection 选维，并可加线性投影进一步降条件维度。kernel-based score estimator 直接生成条件样本（不训练 score network），再用这些样本训练神经流图做自回归模拟。
Result: 三个数值算例分别检验：小条件维度下的长记忆保持、耦合向量动力学中的预测压缩、以及非高斯条件分布与间歇事件；非高斯算例在等离子体刮削层 (plasma scrape-off layer) 随机模型中复现了条件非对称与 burst 统计。
Conclusion: 以固定大小的指数滤波器记忆库替代长历史窗口，可以在与历史长度无关的开销下学到保留多时间尺度记忆的随机流图，并覆盖非高斯与间歇事件这类条件分布。

papers.title: AnchorReasoning: A Visual Grounding and Causal Reasoning Dataset in Long-Tail Autonomous Driving Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to long-tail autonomous driving, but existing driving datasets provide limited supervision for connecting decision-critical visual evidence with reasoning and planning. We introduce AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset built on WOD-E2E, containing 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements across four major categories and 19 fine-grained types. Each frame is organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) that links decision-critical element identification and localization, element attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. We further develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning strategy that progressively learns these hierarchical capabilities, together with an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating localization quality. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Across models, 5-s ADE and FDE decrease by 7.84 and 11.86, while RFS Frame and Cluster improve by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens and 0.32 s/frame lower inference latency on average, demonstrating the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorReasoning 在 WOD-E2E 上构建 416,119 帧、395,379 个决策关键元素的视觉接地推理数据集，每帧组织为 VG-CoT 链并配课程式监督微调。八个 VLM 骨干上，5 秒 ADE/FDE 分别下降 7.84 与 11.86，RFS Frame/Cluster 提升 1.66 与 1.70，同时少用 18.5 个推理 token、每帧延迟降 0.32 秒。
Motivation: 现有驾驶数据集对把决策关键视觉证据连到推理与规划的监督有限，长尾场景下 VLM 缺少接地式推理训练信号。
Method: 在 WOD-E2E 上标注 416,119 帧、395,379 个决策关键元素（4 大类、19 细粒度类型），每帧构成 VG-CoT：元素识别定位、属性与影响、动作理由、动作与轨迹规划；配课程式监督微调 (curriculum SFT) 逐级学习，并提出物体尺寸感知的接地指标评估定位质量。
Result: 在八个通用、具身 AI 与 AV 专用骨干上，5-s ADE 与 FDE 平均下降 7.84 与 11.86，RFS Frame 与 Cluster 提升 1.66 与 1.70；同时平均少用 18.5 个推理 token、每帧推理延迟降低 0.32 秒。
Conclusion: 视觉接地、以决策为中心的监督能同时改善 VLM 的接地推理与轨迹预测，并在更少 token 与更低延迟下取得这些收益。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LEAP-CBF: A Safety Filter for Uncertain Systems with Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Control barrier functions (CBF) are a popular safety filter to ensure safety for nonlinear dynamical systems. However, when the system is subject to uncertainties and disturbances, this requires the use of robust variants of CBFs, which can be difficult to construct and can be overly conservative, especially for high-dimensional systems under input constraints. In this work, we propose a new approach to solve these challenges by introducing Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP), a certificate that quantifies the robustness of a given state against disturbances in terms of the effort required by the disturbance to cause failure. We show that LEAP is a CBF for the undisturbed system, but can also be used to construct a safety filter that is robust to disturbances whose cumulative effort is bounded. We propose a method for constructing LEAPs with on-policy deep reinforcement learning. Next, we demonstrate LEAPs in simulation on a variety of multi-agent systems with disturbances and uncertainties. Finally, hardware experiments on a quadruped and quadrotors validate that LEAPs are well suited to tackle the disturbances and uncertainties from real-world robotic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP)：用「扰动需付出多大累计努力才能致失效」来度量状态鲁棒性，并据此构造对有界累计扰动鲁棒的安全滤波器。LEAP 用 on-policy 深度强化学习构建，在多智能体仿真与四足、四旋翼硬件实验上验证了对真实机器人扰动与不确定性的适用性。
Motivation: 非线性系统在不确定与扰动下需用 robust CBF，但这类证书难构造且在高维加输入约束时过于保守。
Method: 引入 LEAP 证书，量化扰动致失效所需的努力；证明 LEAP 是未扰动系统的 CBF，并用于构造对累计努力有界扰动鲁棒的安全滤波器；用 on-policy 深度强化学习构建 LEAP。
Result: 在含扰动与不确定性的多智能体系统仿真中演示 LEAP；四足与四旋翼硬件实验验证 LEAP 适用于真实机器人系统的扰动与不确定性。
Conclusion: 以「扰动致失效所需努力」为证书可在不依赖难构造的 robust CBF 的前提下得到对有界累计扰动鲁棒的安全滤波器。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Semantic Segmentation from High-Resolution Depth and Ultra-Low-Resolution RGB
papers.abstract_en: As mobile robots become increasingly integrated into everyday environments, privacy risks arising from onboard cameras have become a growing concern. Ultra-low-resolution (ULR) RGB can mitigate visual privacy exposure at the source, but ULR appearance alone substantially limits semantic and spatial understanding. We therefore introduce a privacy-preserving asymmetric sensing setting that combines high-resolution (HR) depth with ULR RGB, preserving dense geometry while restricting fine-grained visual information. To address the severe information imbalance between HR depth and ULR RGB, we propose a joint 2D framework using HR geometry to guide semantic-oriented RGB reconstruction and RGB-D segmentation. Despite reliable frame-level predictions, consistent scene-level understanding remains challenging under the asymmetric HR depth--ULR RGB setting. We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that consolidates 2D semantic features for 3D segmentation. Experiments on ScanNet show that our method achieves the best 2D and 3D segmentation performance among privacy-preserving approaches and delivers the strongest zero-shot transfer to SUN RGB-D and SceneNN. Privacy recoverability analysis shows that our proposed HR depth--ULR RGB input reduces the recoverability of sensitive data, and real-robot experiments demonstrate the utility of the resulting 3D semantics for object-goal navigation.
papers.comment: Xuying Huang and Swithinraj Moses Daniel have equal contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出隐私保护的非对称感知设置：用高分辨率深度 (HR depth) 保留稠密几何，配合超低分辨率 RGB (ULR) 在源头限制细节泄露，并给出从 2D 联合框架到端到端 2D-to-3D 管线的语义分割方法。在 ScanNet 上该方法在隐私保护类方法中取得最好的 2D 与 3D 分割性能，并在 SUN RGB-D 与 SceneNN 上零样本迁移最强，同时降低敏感数据可恢复性，其 3D 语义可用于目标导向导航 (object-goal navigation)。
Motivation: 移动机器人车载相机带来视觉隐私风险，ULR RGB 能在源头减少暴露却严重削弱语义与空间理解，而 HR depth 与 ULR RGB 之间存在信息不平衡，帧级预测可靠但场景级一致理解仍困难。
Method: 提出 HR depth + ULR RGB 的非对称输入；用 HR 几何引导面向语义的 RGB 重建与 RGB-D 分割的联合 2D 框架；再以端到端 2D-to-3D 管线聚合 2D 语义特征做 3D 分割。
Result: 在 ScanNet 上，所提方法在隐私保护方法中取得最佳 2D 与 3D 分割性能，并在 SUN RGB-D 与 SceneNN 上给出最强零样本迁移；隐私可恢复性分析显示 HR depth–ULR RGB 输入降低敏感数据可恢复性；真实机器人实验展示所得 3D 语义对目标导向导航的可用性。
Conclusion: HR depth 搭配 ULR RGB 可在压低隐私泄露的同时保住足以支撑 3D 分割与导航的语义信息，非对称感知是隐私与效用之间可行的折中。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 提出隐私保护的非对称感知设置：用高分辨率深度 (HR depth) 保留稠密几何，配合超低分辨率 RGB (ULR) 在源头限制细节泄露，并给出从 2D 联合框架到端到端 2D-to-3D 管线的语义分割方法。在 ScanNet 上该方法在隐私保护类方法中取得最好的 2D 与 3D 分割性能，并在 SUN RGB-D 与 SceneNN 上零样本迁移最强，同时降低敏感数据可恢复性，其 3D 语义可用于目标导向导航 (object-goal navigation)。

papers.title: MicroQonv: Reshaping Convolution Tensors for Efficient Microscaling in Training and Inference
papers.abstract_en: Microscaling quantization techniques are increasingly used to represent neural network parameters with 8 bits or fewer while preserving near-full precision accuracy. However, applying these methods efficiently in convolutional layers is not straightforward. A naive approach transfers full-precision weights and activations to processing units and quantizes each tensor twice, resulting in much more memory movement than expected. Additional overhead comes from the activation tensors, whose sizes grow substantially because of the im2col transformation applied before quantization. We propose MicroQonv, a way to combine microscaling with convolutional layers' forward and backward operations by quantizing each tensor only once and quantizing the activation tensor before applying a modified version of im2col: channel-batch-first im2col. MicroQonv reduces the quantization cost by a factor of $\times2$ for weights and gradients, and by up to $\times9$ for activations, at a negligible accuracy cost. It reduces memory movement and storage by up to $\times7.53$ compared to their full-precision counterparts. This way, MicroQonv reduces microscaling-quantized activation memory movement by $\times3.5$ for state-of-the-art object detection models YOLOV8nano and $\times2.2$ for YOLOV26nano. It also enables 4-bit microscaling in a quantized latent replay strategy for continual learning at the edge, improving accuracy by +5.7% to +11%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MicroQonv 把 microscaling 量化嵌进卷积的前向与反向：每个张量只量化一次，并把 im2col 改成 channel-batch-first、在变换之前先量化激活。权重与梯度的量化开销降 2 倍、激活最多降 9 倍，内存搬运与存储最多降 7.53 倍；在 YOLOV8nano 上激活内存搬运降 3.5 倍、YOLOV26nano 上降 2.2 倍，并使边缘持续学习的 4-bit microscaling latent replay 策略精度提升 5.7% 到 11%。
Motivation: microscaling 量化在卷积层上效率低：朴素做法把全精度权重和激活搬进处理单元并各量化两次，且 im2col 使激活张量显著变大，带来远超预期的内存搬运。
Method: 将 microscaling 与卷积前向、反向算子结合：每个张量只量化一次；激活在改造版 im2col（channel-batch-first im2col）之前量化；并把 4-bit microscaling 用于边缘持续学习的 quantized latent replay 策略。
Result: 权重与梯度的量化开销降低 2 倍，激活最多降低 9 倍，精度代价可忽略；相比全精度对应实现，内存搬运与存储最多降低 7.53 倍；microscaling 量化后的激活内存搬运在 YOLOV8nano 上降低 3.5 倍、YOLOV26nano 上降低 2.2 倍；4-bit latent replay 策略精度提升 +5.7% 到 +11%。
Conclusion: 卷积中的量化次数与 im2col 的顺序是 microscaling 开销的主因，先量化激活再做 channel-batch-first im2col 可同时压低搬运、存储与量化成本，并让 4-bit microscaling 在边缘持续学习上可用。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Object Removal via Attention Masking, Latent Anchoring, and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Removing an object from a real image requires more than synthesizing plausible content within a mask: the method must suppress residual object features, preserve the unedited scene, and generate replacement content that is consistent with the surrounding background. This paper approaches object removal from a stage-based perspective and proposes a zero-shot framework for constrained latent inpainting with a frozen pretrained Stable Diffusion model, requiring no task-specific training or model fine-tuning. The method integrates SAM-based mask construction, BLIP image-caption conditioning, DDIM inversion, background-weighted masked null-text optimization, decoder self-attention masking, hard outside-mask latent anchoring, and localized renoise--denoise refinement into a unified pipeline. The method is evaluated through qualitative examples, quantitative local-consistency metrics, and ablation studies. The results demonstrate effective object removal and context-consistent replacement content. The ablations indicate that background-weighted masked NTI is particularly beneficial for structurally complex backgrounds, whereas the no-NTI variant is sufficient in other evaluated examples. Repeated refinement further reduces object remnants and boundary artifacts remaining after the primary editing pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样式的图像物体移除框架：在冻结的 Stable Diffusion 上做受限 latent inpainting，无需任务训练或微调，组合 SAM 掩码、BLIP 图文条件、DDIM 反演、背景加权 masked null-text optimization、decoder 自注意力掩码、mask 外硬 latent 锚定与局部 renoise–denoise 精修。消融显示背景加权 masked NTI 在结构复杂背景上特别有效，其余例子用无 NTI 变体即可；重复精修进一步减少主编辑后残留的物体痕迹与边界伪影。
Motivation: 真实图像中移除物体不只是在掩码内合成合理内容，还要抑制残留物体特征、保持未编辑场景不被破坏，并生成与周围背景一致的替换内容。
Method: 冻结预训练 Stable Diffusion 做受限 latent inpainting 的分阶段零样本流水线：SAM 构建掩码，BLIP 提供图像描述条件，DDIM inversion 得到初始 latent，背景加权 masked null-text optimization (NTI) 优化无文本嵌入，decoder 自注意力掩码抑制残留特征，mask 外 hard latent anchoring 保持未编辑区域，最后做 localized renoise–denoise 精修。
Result: 通过定性示例、量化局部一致性指标与消融研究评估：结果展示有效物体移除与上下文一致的替换内容；消融表明背景加权 masked NTI 对结构复杂背景特别有益，其余被评估例子中无 NTI 变体已足够；重复精修进一步减少主编辑后残留的物体痕迹与边界伪影。
Conclusion: 物体移除应按阶段拆解为抑制残留、保持场景与生成一致内容；背景加权 masked NTI 只在结构复杂背景上必要，重复精修用于收尾残留与边界伪影。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Local Geometric Mixing via Dobrushin Contraction with Applications to Diffusion Path Monte Carlo and the Proximal Sampler
papers.abstract_en: Local geometric mixing localizes geometric mixing by requiring geometric convergence to equilibrium in total variation only over finitely many transitions. It accommodates local convergence rates and captures rapid local equilibration, even when global mixing is much slower. We establish and discuss local geometric mixing bounds through Dobrushin contraction. We then apply this approach to Diffusion Path Monte Carlo, a recently proposed Markov chain Monte Carlo method, aimed at leveraging advances in score-based modeling, whose ideal transitions coincide with those of the Proximal Sampler. Our analysis covers both the ideal method and its implementable Metropolis-adjusted counterpart, providing mixing guarantees under minimal assumptions. For the ideal method, these guarantees complement recent spectral gap estimates, which we develop into mixing time bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出局部几何混合 (local geometric mixing)：只在有限步转移上要求总变差意义下向平衡态的几何收敛，从而容纳局部收敛速率、刻画远慢于全局混合时的快速局部平衡。经 Dobrushin 收缩建立混合界，并用于 Diffusion Path Monte Carlo 及其 Metropolis 调整版本，在最小假设下给出混合保证。
Motivation: 全局几何混合要求所有转移上统一的几何收敛，会掩盖快速局部平衡、且对基于 score 的 MCMC 方法难以在弱假设下验证。
Method: 以 Dobrushin 收缩建立局部几何混合界；应用于 Diffusion Path Monte Carlo（其理想转移与 Proximal Sampler 一致），同时覆盖理想方法与可实现的 Metropolis 调整版本，并把已有谱隙估计发展为混合时间界。
Result: 在最小假设下为理想方法与 Metropolis 调整版本给出混合保证；理想方法的保证与近期谱隙估计互补，并由此导出混合时间界。
Conclusion: 把几何收敛限制在有限步转移上，配合 Dobrushin 收缩，可在最小假设下为 score-based MCMC（含 Diffusion Path Monte Carlo 与 Proximal Sampler）给出可验证的混合与混合时间界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Open Pipeline and Dashboard for Systemic-Risk Evidence under the EU AI Act's Code of Practice
papers.abstract_en: Claims about AI safety reach audiences well beyond the AI community, yet many rely on opaque evidence or static assessments, when supporting evidence is accessible at all. We present the Systemic Risk Index, an open evaluation pipeline and dashboard built to make empirical evidence more transparent and traceable to the public. Our work organizes 19 public benchmarks into four systemic-risk categories defined by the EU GPAI Code of Practice---CBRN, cyber offense, harmful manipulation, and loss of control---and evaluates models using harm-preserving perturbations and simulated deployment contexts. The interactive dashboard lets users alternate between average and worst-case aggregation, vary how model capability affects the aggregate score, and trace each risk rating to its benchmark evidence. Across 18 models, scores fall by 14 to 37 points under worst-case aggregation, highlighting information that can be hidden by an average assessment of model risk. LLM judges show agreement with human graders comparable to human--human agreement ($κ= 0.78\text{--}0.82$), and a blind audit finds that $83\%$ of sampled transformations preserve the original harm. In a survey ($N = 21$), most participants report that scores are easy to understand and that the dashboard encouraged them to view model evaluations under different settings
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, submitted to EACL 2027 Systems Demonstration track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Systemic Risk Index：把 19 个公开基准按 EU GPAI Code of Practice 的四类系统性风险（CBRN、网络攻击、有害操纵、失控）组织成可追溯的开放评估流水线与交互式 dashboard。18 个模型在最坏情形聚合下分数比平均聚合低 14 到 37 分，说明平均值会掩盖单基准上的高风险表现。
Motivation: 面向公众的 AI 安全论断常依赖不透明证据或静态评估，读者无法把风险评级追溯回支撑它的基准。
Method: 流水线用 harm-preserving perturbations 与 simulated deployment contexts 评估模型，dashboard 支持在平均与最坏情形聚合间切换、调节能力对总分的影响方式，并把每个风险评级链接回其基准证据；LLM judge 与人工评分对照，另有盲审与 N=21 用户调查。
Result: 18 个模型在最坏情形聚合下分数下降 14 到 37 分；LLM judge 与人工评分者一致性 κ=0.78–0.82，与人人一致性相当；盲审显示 83% 的抽样变换保留原始危害；N=21 调查中多数参与者认为分数易懂且 dashboard 促使其在不同设置下查看模型评估。
Conclusion: 模型风险评级对聚合方式敏感，平均评估会隐藏单基准上的高风险信号，因此风险分数应可切换聚合口径并逐条追溯到基准证据。

papers.title: BronchoTop: Bronchoscopy Navigation via RGB-Only Topological Localization
papers.abstract_en: Accurate localization of the bronchoscope within the bronchial tree is essential for clinicians to be able to reach target lesions, perform biopsies and avoid misidentification of airway segments during diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. However, existing navigation systems typically rely on patient-specific CT scans or additional external sensors, increasing cost, setup time and patient radiation exposure. This work presents BronchoTop, a real-time, RGB-only framework for topological bronchoscopy localization that eliminates the need for patient-specific data. BronchoTop estimates scope location relative to a generic airway model through four modules: lumen detection and tracking, lumen-branch label association, probabilistic scope location estimation, and switch verification. By using only standard bronchoscopy video input, BronchoTop provides practical, real-time navigational assistance to physicians. Evaluation on phantom, simulated and real data demonstrates state-of-the-art accuracy, improving existing approaches performance by over 20% on real bronchoscopy sequences. BronchoTop is the first published framework including both the localization algorithms as well as all the real data used, together with code to generate additional simulations, encouraging and facilitating further developments and benchmarking. The results highlight BronchoTop's potential to enhance procedural safety, efficiency and accessibility in clinical and robotic bronchoscopy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BronchoTop 用纯 RGB 支气管镜视频做拓扑定位，通过腔道检测与跟踪、腔道-分支标签关联、概率位置估计和切换校验四个模块，在通用气道模型上实时给出内镜相对位置，无需患者特异 CT 或外部传感器。在 phantom、仿真与真实数据上达到 SOTA，真实支气管镜序列上比现有方法提升超过 20%。
Motivation: 现有支气管镜导航依赖患者特异 CT 或外置传感器，带来额外成本、准备时间和患者辐射暴露，限制了临床可及性。
Method: 四模块流水线：lumen detection and tracking、lumen-branch label association、probabilistic scope location estimation、switch verification；输入仅为标准支气管镜视频，定位参照通用气道模型，并开源定位算法、全部真实数据与生成额外仿真的代码。
Result: 在 phantom、仿真和真实数据三类评测上均展示 SOTA 精度；在真实支气管镜序列上相对现有方法性能提升超过 20%。
Conclusion: 仅凭 RGB 视频即可在通用气道模型上做实时拓扑定位，为临床与机器人支气管镜提供无需患者特异数据的导航辅助，并配套公开数据与仿真代码以支持基准比较。

papers.title: LightMIS: Ultra-Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Without a Stage-Wise Decoder
papers.abstract_en: We present LightMIS, a scalable family of ultra-lightweight convolutional networks for 2D binary medical image segmentation without a learned stage-wise decoder. LightMIS aligns the outputs of a five-level encoder to a common resolution using Scale-Aligned Projection blocks, aggregates them once, and refines the fused representation with an Adaptive Fusion Cascade. The cascade combines Adaptive Kernel Fusion with the proposed Progressive Receptive Fusion module, which uses temporary channel expansion, complementary depthwise receptive fields, and progressive cross-branch information transfer. We evaluate LightMIS-T, LightMIS-S, and LightMIS using five-fold cross-validation under a common nnU-Net v2.3.1 protocol on DRIVE, Kvasir-SEG, DSB18, BUSI, ISIC-2017, and ISIC-2018. Full LightMIS contains 0.131 M parameters and requires 0.575 GFLOPs for a $3\times256\times256$ input, achieving modality-macro Dice and IoU scores of 86.71% and 78.99%, respectively. Mobile U-ViT obtains 86.75% Dice and 79.07% IoU, so the observed differences are 0.04 and 0.08 percentage points. Relative to Mobile U-ViT, nnWNet, and nnU-Net, LightMIS reduces parameter count by 90.58$-$99.61% and GFLOPs by 82.54$-$96.14%. On an Arm Mali-G52 MC2 GPU, all LightMIS variants achieve full GPU delegation, with median delegated latency ranging from 53.31 ms for LightMIS-T to 138.31 ms for LightMIS. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy$-$complexity trade-off and on-device execution feasibility for the evaluated tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/AndreiiArhire/LightMIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LightMIS 是一族超轻量 2D 二值医学图像分割卷积网络，不用学习式分阶段解码器：用 Scale-Aligned Projection 把五级编码器输出对齐到同一分辨率，仅聚合一次，再经 Adaptive Fusion Cascade（Adaptive Kernel Fusion + Progressive Receptive Fusion）精修。在 nnU-Net v2.3.1 统一协议、五个数据集五折交叉验证下，完整版 0.131 M 参数、0.575 GFLOPs，modality-macro Dice 86.71%、IoU 78.99%，与 Mobile U-ViT 仅差 0.04 和 0.08 个百分点，参数量比基线少 90.58–99.61%。
Motivation: 医学图像分割的高精度模型参数量与计算量大，难以部署到端侧设备；同时分阶段解码器带来额外开销。需要在保持接近 SOTA 精度的前提下把模型压到可在移动 GPU 上全 GPU 委托执行的量级。
Method: 五级编码器输出经 Scale-Aligned Projection 对齐到公共分辨率后一次性聚合，再由 Adaptive Fusion Cascade 精修，该级联组合 Adaptive Kernel Fusion 与新提出的 Progressive Receptive Fusion（临时通道扩张、互补 depthwise 感受野、跨分支渐进信息传递）。在 DRIVE、Kvasir-SEG、DSB18、BUSI、ISIC-2017、ISIC-2018 上按 nnU-Net v2.3.1 协议做五折交叉验证，含 LightMIS-T/S/完整版三档规模。
Result: 完整版 LightMIS 0.131 M 参数、3×256×256 输入 0.575 GFLOPs，modality-macro Dice 86.71%、IoU 78.99%；Mobile U-ViT 为 86.75% Dice、79.07% IoU，差距仅 0.04 与 0.08 个百分点。相对 Mobile U-ViT、nnWNet、nnU-Net，参数量减少 90.58–99.61%，GFLOPs 减少 82.54–96.14%。Arm Mali-G52 MC2 GPU 上全部变体实现完整 GPU 委托，中位委托延迟 53.31 ms（LightMIS-T）至 138.31 ms（完整版）。
Conclusion: 去掉学习式分阶段解码器、只做一次融合精修，可以在参数量和 GFLOPs 大幅下降的同时把 Dice/IoU 保持在与 Mobile U-ViT 基本持平的水平，并在 Arm Mali-G52 MC2 上实现可落地的端侧执行。
