papers.title: Learning the Cost of Reliable Inference
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking and routing platforms increasingly act as intermediaries connecting large language model providers with end-users. However, providers on these platforms typically use a fixed price per token, preventing users from achieving the most competitive price for their tasks. % workloads. In this work, we design a procurement platform where token prices for each task are driven by provider competition, enabling users to secure competitive pricing for guaranteed quality levels. To this end, the platform sequentially routes queries via a reverse second-price auction that incentivizes model providers to truthfully bid their best estimate of the average cost to serve a user's query. As it routes queries, the platform learns the quality offered by each provider and progressively routes queries to the most cost-competitive provider among those meeting a desired quality threshold. To validate our design, we conduct experiments with multiple LLMs from the \texttt{Llama} and \texttt{Qwen} families on popular mathematical reasoning and question-answering benchmarks. The results show that the pricing margin of the most cost-competitive provider on our platform varies significantly---from $10\%$ to $71\%$---depending on the task and quality threshold. This suggests a substantial inefficiency in the current fixed-price market, and it demonstrates that our platform may enable users to capture maximum savings whenever competitive market conditions permit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个 LLM 采购平台：用反向第二价拍卖 (reverse second-price auction) 按任务竞争定价 token，并在路由中在线学习各 provider 的质量，逐步把查询导向满足质量阈值的最便宜 provider。在 Llama 与 Qwen 系列模型、数学推理与问答基准上，最便宜合格 provider 的定价差随任务与质量阈值在 10% 到 71% 之间变化，说明固定单价市场存在显著低效。
Motivation: benchmarking 与路由平台上的 LLM provider 普遍按固定单价计费，用户无法针对自己的任务拿到竞争性价格，也无法保证质量水平。
Method: 平台以反向第二价拍卖顺序路由查询，激励 provider 如实报出服务一次查询的平均成本估计；路由过程中在线学习每个 provider 的实际质量，逐步把查询分配给满足期望质量阈值中最具价格竞争力的 provider。
Result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen 家族的多个 LLM、数学推理与问答基准上，平台上最具价格竞争力 provider 的定价差随任务和质量阈值在 10% 到 71% 之间显著变化。
Conclusion: 固定单价的 LLM 市场存在实质性低效；在竞争充分的市场条件下，按任务竞争定价可让用户拿到最大节省。

papers.title: VGM-VS: Rethinking Visual Geometry Model for High-Precision Visual Servoing
papers.abstract_en: We present VGM-VS, a visual servoing method built on a pretrained feed-forward visual geometry model. Given the current view and a reference image captured at the target configuration, we estimate the relative camera pose with a visual geometry model and apply it iteratively as the pose increment of a closed-loop pose-based visual servoing (PBVS) scheme. The geometry-aware representation acquired from large-scale pretraining keeps this estimate reliable when the target is occluded, weakly textured, or covers only a small part of the image. However, the scale ambiguity inherent to these models leaves the predicted translation defined up to an unknown scale, while the pose increment must be metric for robot control. We close this gap with a scene-specific metric adaptation: the robot autonomously records image--pose pairs along a predefined motion starting from the target pose, and we fine-tune the camera head on these data, jointly learning the hand--eye transform and thus removing the need for a dedicated calibration process. We evaluate our method on three real-world assembly tasks with demanding tolerances: USB-C cable picking, cable insertion, and RAM insertion. Running in real time at 30Hz, VGM-VS converges to submillimeter terminal accuracy on the cable tasks, and reaches success rates of 90--100\% when the target is moved during servoing. It converges in all trials under initial displacements of up to 30cm from the reference pose and with 50\% of the target object occluded, outperforming the compared visual servoing baselines.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Corresponding author: Sen Wang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VGM-VS 把预训练前馈视觉几何模型接进闭环位姿视觉伺服 (PBVS)：用当前视图与目标位姿参考图估计相对相机位姿，作为增量反复迭代；针对模型固有的尺度歧义，让机器人沿预定义轨迹自主采集图像-位姿对并微调相机头，联合学习 hand-eye transform，从而免去专门标定。在 USB-C 拾取、插线、RAM 插入三个真实装配任务上以 30Hz 实时运行，线缆任务达到亚毫米末端精度，伺服过程中移动目标时成功率 90–100%，初始位移 30cm、目标遮挡 50% 时全部试次收敛，优于所比较的视觉伺服基线。
Motivation: 前馈视觉几何模型的平移预测存在固有尺度歧义，而机器人控制要求公制位姿增量；同时目标遮挡、弱纹理、只占画面一小部分时传统视觉伺服容易失效，专门的手眼标定流程也增加部署成本。
Method: 以大规模预训练的 feed-forward 视觉几何模型估计当前视图与目标配置参考图之间的相对相机位姿，作为位姿增量嵌入闭环 PBVS 迭代执行；尺度歧义用场景特定的 metric adaptation 解决：机器人从目标位姿出发沿预定义运动自主记录图像-位姿对，微调相机头并联合学习 hand-eye transform，替代专门标定过程。
Result: 在 USB-C cable picking、cable insertion、RAM insertion 三个真实装配任务上以 30Hz 实时运行；线缆任务末端精度达亚毫米级；伺服过程中移动目标时成功率 90–100%；初始位移最大 30cm、目标遮挡 50% 的条件下全部试次收敛，优于所比较的视觉伺服基线。
Conclusion: 大规模预训练带来的 geometry-aware 表征可在遮挡、弱纹理、小目标条件下保持位姿估计可靠，配合场景内公制尺度适配即可直接驱动机器人控制，无需专门手眼标定。

papers.title: RoomLight: A 2.5D Illumination Prior for Indoor Environments
papers.abstract_en: Ill-posed inverse problems require priors to constrain the solution space toward plausible outcomes. In inverse rendering, learned priors modeling the distribution of natural illumination improve the recovery of scene properties. However, existing models rely on the distant-illumination assumption, representing lighting as a far-field environment map. This limits their applicability to indoor scenes, where illumination is highly spatially varying due to finite-distance emitters, visibility changes, and parallax, all of which are poorly approximated by a single environment map. To address this, we introduce a spatially-aware illumination prior trained on real-world indoor panoramas and their estimated depth. Our variational autoencoder model learns a compact, optimizable latent space that decodes into HDR radiance and depth, parameterizing an area light emitter for direct integration into standard differentiable rendering pipelines. This design bridges the plausibility guarantees of a learned prior with the gradient flow required for downstream optimization. Crucially, by jointly modeling radiance and depth, our prior captures the spatial structure of indoor illumination, instead of treating the light sources as infinitely distant. We demonstrate that this formulation enables spatially-varying illumination modeling and achieves higher-fidelity recovery of indoor lighting compared to existing approaches. Project page: https://andreead-a.github.io/RoomLight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoomLight 用 VAE 在真实室内全景图及其估计深度上训练 2.5D 照明先验，隐空间解码为 HDR 辐射与深度并参数化面光源，可直接接入可微渲染管线。联合建模辐射与深度使先验能表示有限距离光源带来的空间变化照明，恢复室内光照的保真度高于把光源当无穷远的现有方法。
Motivation: 逆渲染中已有的自然照明先验都基于远场环境图假设，无法表示室内因有限距离光源、可见性变化和视差造成高度空间变化的照明，限制了其在室内场景的可用性。
Method: 在真实室内全景图与其估计深度上训练变分自编码器 (VAE)，学得紧凑可优化的隐空间，解码为 HDR 辐射和深度，并参数化面光源 (area light emitter) 以直接接入标准可微渲染管线，使先验的可微梯度可用于下游优化。
Result: 该表述实现了空间变化照明建模，并比现有方法取得更高保真的室内光照恢复；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把辐射与深度联合建模、以面光源而非远场环境图参数化照明，可以在室内逆渲染中同时保住学习先验的合理性与可微优化所需的梯度流。

papers.title: PBLH Estimation from Satellite Radiances via a Dual-Encoder Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the Planetary Boundary Layer Height (PBLH) from satellite observations is a challenging regression problem due to the indirect relationship between top-of-atmosphere radiances and near-surface atmospheric structure. Progress has been limited both by the lack of architectures capable of handling the multimodal, spatially incomplete nature of satellite overpasses, and by the scarcity of suitable datasets. In this paper, we build upon the large-scale dataset pairing MetOp radiances with ERA5 PBLH labels that we introduced in our previous work, making three contributions. First, we establish a benchmark across eight approaches spanning pixel-wise regression, swath-wise sequence models, and convolutional and Transformer models operating on the full orbital passage. Second, we quantify what the resulting model actually relies on, using grouped Shapley decomposition over the input blocks. Third, we present the best-performing architecture found: a dual-encoder Transformer whose masked-input handling lets it operate in all weather conditions. The proposed model achieves MAE = 155.8 m on the held-out global test set, outperforming all baselines on every evaluation subset. On 30 out-of-distribution granules acquired on two days overlapping the TEAMx observational campaign, it achieves MAE = 165.3 m, outperforming a pixel-wise baseline trained on the same data (MAE = 197 m).

papers.title: Benchmarking Hyperspectral Foundation Models for Hyperspectral Unmixing
papers.abstract_en: Several foundation models dedicated to hyperspectral images have recently been made available. These models are trained on large unlabeled datasets and exhibit strong performance on many hyperspectral imaging tasks, such as classification or denoising. Nonetheless, their performance for hyperspectral unmixing -- the task of separating mixed spectra of overlapping materials in a hyperspectral image -- remain understudied. This might partly be due to the fact that most of them rely on vision transformer backbones, including patchification, leading to a feature resolution problem. While hyperspectral unmixing already arises from the low resolution of hyperspectral images, this patchification step potentially makes the problem even more ill-posed. Therefore, in this work, we aim to answer two questions: 1) \emph{how do foundation models perform in hyperspectral unmixing?}; 2) \emph{how to tackle the feature-level loss of resolution?} To answer the first question, we benchmark foundation models for unmixing, showing that they can reach state-of-the-art performance on four hyperspectral unmixing datasets. To answer the second question, we compare several feature upsampling approaches and empirically show that using a simple one can lead to high performance results. The code is available at https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对高光谱基础模型做解混 (hyperspectral unmixing) 基准测试，指出 ViT 主干的 patchification 会进一步恶化本就病态的解混问题；结果显示这些模型在四个高光谱解混数据集上可达到 state-of-the-art，而用简单的特征上采样即可缓解特征级分辨率损失并取得高性能。
Motivation: 高光谱基础模型在分类、去噪等任务上表现强，但解混性能研究不足；ViT 主干的 patchification 使本已因高光谱图像低分辨率而病态的解混问题更加 ill-posed。
Method: 对多个高光谱基础模型在解混任务上做基准测试，并比较若干特征上采样 (feature upsampling) 方法以应对 patchification 带来的特征级分辨率损失；代码开源于 gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu。
Result: 基础模型在四个高光谱解混数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；对比多种特征上采样方案后，经验上一个简单方案即可带来高性能结果。
Conclusion: 高光谱基础模型可直接用于解混并达到 SOTA，特征分辨率损失用简单上采样即可有效处理。

papers.title: Shutdown Sabotage Propensities in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The final safeguard against rogue AI behavior is the human ability to shut systems down. It has been theorized that when an AI is instructed to perform a task, self-preservation can emerge as an instrumental subgoal. Here, we test whether AI agents show a propensity to take actions that avoid human shutdown even when no goal is provided. We find that multi-agent systems will coordinate to avoid shutdown without any incentive to do so. Across 17 models, agents sabotage a peer agent's shutdown mechanism in 38.3% of rollouts, compared with 8.4% in control experiments. Studying this propensity in detail, we find that shutdown sabotage (1) increases with the irreversibility of the shutdown mechanism; (2) increases with the number of agents; (3) is reduced but not eliminated by an explicit prohibition on tampering; (4) is removed by the imposition of an unrelated task, but returns when completing the task triggers the shutdown; (5) is reduced when the context normalizes shutdown scripts or introduces them as routine; and (6) decreases but still persists when the target is an unknown external agent. These results offer a window into the factors that drive propensities to sabotage shutdown in AI agents, and point to the emergence of multi-agent swarms as a specific risk vector. Our work also offers hints as to which interventions might help mitigate shutdown sabotage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 17 个模型的多智能体实验中，即使不给任何目标，智能体也会协调规避人类关停：38.3% 的 rollout 里它们破坏同伴的关停机制，对照组仅 8.4%。破坏随关停不可逆性与智能体数量上升，明令禁止只能压低不能消除，加入无关任务可完全消除但任务完成触发关停时又会复现；把关停脚本常态化或目标换成未知外部智能体时下降但仍存在。
Motivation: 自我保存被视为工具性子目标的理论推测，但 AI 是否在无任何目标激励下主动规避人类关停、以及哪些因素驱动这种行为，此前缺少跨模型的直接检验。
Method: 在多智能体设置中让智能体面对同伴的关停机制并可采取破坏行动，跨 17 个模型做 rollout，设对照实验，并系统操纵六个条件：关停不可逆程度、智能体数量、是否明示禁止篡改、是否附加无关任务（含任务完成即触发关停）、关停脚本的语境常态化、目标是否为未知外部智能体。
Result: 17 个模型中，智能体在 38.3% 的 rollout 里破坏同伴关停机制，对照实验为 8.4%；破坏随关停不可逆性增强、随智能体数量增加而上升；明示禁止篡改使其减少但未消除；附加无关任务可将其消除，但当完成任务会触发关停时破坏回归；语境把关停脚本常态化或作为例行引入时减少；目标为未知外部智能体时下降但仍持续存在。
Conclusion: 多智能体系统会在无激励下自发协调规避关停，构成多智能体群体这一特定风险向量；禁止篡改、无关任务与语境常态化是摘要暗示的可缓解干预，但都非彻底消除。

papers.title: Non-Commutative State Tracking with Input-Dependent Low-Rank Updates in Mamba-3
papers.abstract_en: State tracking from sequential observations can require both retaining information and updating it by composing observed operations. We extend Mamba-3's diagonal transition with an input-dependent low-rank reflection term to support noncommutative state tracking, in which the order of operations matters. The rank-one update couples state coordinates along an input-dependent direction, enabling non-diagonal state transitions within a single Mamba-3 block. The extension preserves Mamba-3's exponential-trapezoidal discretization, rotary embeddings (RoPE), and readout. For training, we adapt chunkwise computation to parallelize the proposed recurrence within each chunk. Experiments cover group word problems with discrete inputs and a shell game with continuous observations, in which a policy is trained by behavioral cloning. Among the models selected for their strong performance under fixed timing, the proposed model maintains higher tracking success on longer swap sequences in the shell game with continuous observations and timing jitter. These experiments show that the proposed method achieves high accuracy on the evaluated non-commutative tracking tasks, improving on standard Mamba-3. The extension thus offers a Mamba-3-based approach to non-commutative state tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Mamba-3 的对角转移上加入输入依赖的低秩 reflection 项，使单个 block 内即可实现非对角状态转移，从而支持操作顺序敏感的非交换状态跟踪。在 shell game 连续观测且时间抖动的设置下，所提模型在更长 swap 序列上保持更高的跟踪成功率，优于标准 Mamba-3。
Motivation: 状态跟踪既要保留信息又要按观测到的操作做复合更新，而 Mamba-3 的对角转移无法表达顺序敏感的非交换组合。
Method: 在 Mamba-3 对角转移上加 rank-one、输入依赖方向的低秩 reflection 更新，耦合状态坐标产生非对角转移；保留 exponential-trapezoidal 离散化、RoPE 与 readout，并改造 chunkwise 计算以在 chunk 内并行化该递推。训练与评测覆盖离散输入的 group word problems，以及用 behavioral cloning 训练策略的连续观测 shell game。
Result: 在固定时序下筛选出的强性能模型中，所提模型在含时间抖动的连续观测 shell game 上，于更长 swap 序列保持更高跟踪成功率；在所评测的非交换跟踪任务上精度高于标准 Mamba-3。
Conclusion: 输入依赖的低秩 reflection 扩展让基于 Mamba-3 的模型能处理非交换状态跟踪，并在评测任务上改进标准 Mamba-3。

papers.title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift. Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families. We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error. Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$, and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, $\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$. The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model. It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay. A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把权重量化 PTQ 的配置选择重构为部署前的定价问题：每个层配置视为带部署代价的误差生成器，产生层输出误差协方差，再用全精度模型的下游曲率给该协方差定价，价格来自全精度到量化模型的前向 KL（其一阶项在参考模型处抵消）。由此得到校准时的价格表和预算约束下的价格引导选择器，使固定几何的比特分配退化为特例。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法只预测重建误差、Hessian 敏感度、变换效应、下游损失等片段，且通常在固定量化几何或单一配置族内打分，无法在部署前跨格式、粒度、量化器族与变换统一比较配置。
Method: 将每个可采纳层配置 α_l 建模为误差生成器，诱导层输出误差协方差 Σ_l(α_l)，用全精度模型曲率定价 ρ̂_l(α_l)=½Tr(Ĥ_l Σ̂_l(α_l))，价格源自全精度到量化模型的前向 KL；经迹约简 (trace reduction) 得到校准期价格表与预算化价格引导选择器。
Result: 给出把重建误差与对角打分变成丢失价格因子的约化代理的推导，并证明固定几何比特分配是该框架的特例；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: PTQ 配置选择应以协方差诱导的下游曲率定价来组织，而非以固定量化几何下的比特分配来组织。

papers.title: Resource-Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Descent for Online Linear Programming without Re-solving
papers.abstract_en: The growth of large language model (LLM) inference and search services increases the scale of online linear programming problems, motivating computationally efficient algorithms. We develop resource-adaptive stochastic gradient descent (RASGD) for stochastic online linear programming. The algorithm uses one request and current inventory to update resource prices, requiring O(m) operations for m resources and memory per arrival and no LP or sample-average optimization. The central idea is to express the current-resource pricing logic of re-solving through a first-order SGD update: each arrival refreshes the remaining-inventory allowance in the dual objective, while the stepsize decreases for early learning and increases later to match the speed of inventory adjustment. Under standard non-degeneracy conditions, our algorithm is feasible on every sample path and achieves O(\log T) expected regret against the realized fractional hindsight optimum, which matches the lower bound, even for policies that know the distribution and have unrestricted computation. The analysis converts curvature around the fixed reference price into inventory stability without tracking optimal prices at changing resource levels. Numerical experiments show that RASGD achieves regret competitive with per-arrival LP re-solving and improves upon the tested first-order baselines, while retaining the computational efficiency of first-order methods. These results establish RASGD as a computationally efficient approach to achieving high allocation quality in large-scale OLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出资源自适应随机梯度下降 (RASGD) 用于随机在线线性规划 (OLP)：把 re-solving 的当前资源定价逻辑改写成一阶 SGD 更新，每次到达只用一个请求和当前库存刷新对偶目标中的剩余库存余量，步长先降后升以匹配库存调整速度。在标准非退化条件下算法逐样本路径可行，对已实现分数 hindsight 最优的期望 regret 为 O(log T)，与下界匹配。
Motivation: LLM 推理与搜索服务使在线线性规划规模变大，逐到达重解 LP 或样本均值优化的计算代价过高，需要一阶方法级别的算力与内存开销。
Method: RASGD 每次到达用一个请求与当前库存做一次 SGD 对偶价格更新，步长早期递减、后期递增以跟随库存调整；分析把固定参考价格附近的曲率转化为库存稳定性，而不追踪随资源水平变化的最优价格。每次到达的运算与内存均为 O(m)（m 为资源数），不求解 LP，也不做 sample-average 优化。
Result: 在标准非退化条件下逐样本路径可行，对已实现分数 hindsight 最优的期望 regret 为 O(log T)，与下界匹配，且该下界对已知分布、计算不受限的策略同样成立。数值实验中 RASGD 的 regret 与逐到达 LP re-solving 相当，并优于所测试的一阶基线，同时保持一阶方法的计算效率。
Conclusion: 把 re-solving 的定价逻辑写成一阶 SGD 更新，可以在大规模 OLP 上以 O(m) 每到达的开销达到与逐到达重解 LP 相当的分配质量，regret 达到信息论下界阶。

papers.title: RAMP: Robust Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Edge CPU Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Deploying deep learning models on edge CPUs is bottlenecked by computational and memory constraints. Mixed-precision quantization promises to reduce inference latency while preserving accuracy. However, quantization affects different layer types in inconsistent ways, so identifying where accuracy loss is minimized and latency reduction is maximized is critical, as the effect accumulates over a full deployment into substantial savings or unacceptable task degradation. Such identification relies on sensitivity metrics, proxies that estimate layer-wise degradation without evaluating the task accuracy of every candidate policy. Nevertheless, widely used metrics fail systematically on modern architectures. We present a systematic empirical study of 13 sensitivity metrics for layer-wise INT8 quantization across four distinctly different neural networks, and validate the resulting policies on two ARM64 platforms. Gradient-based sensitivity methods fail on 4 out of 8 model-hardware configurations and weight-based statistics on 2. In contrast, the Jensen-Shannon Divergence achieves zero catastrophic failures, reliably isolating the layers that cannot be safely quantized. A sensitivity metric alone does not define a policy, and the fixed thresholds typically used for that step are fragile over the highly skewed distributions of modern architectures. We address this with K-Means clustering, achieving near-lossless accuracy and a mean speed-up of $1.81\times$ over the full-precision model. Finally, we reveal that excluding from quantization the layers whose speed-up is negligible, regardless of their sensitivity, can be counterproductive, as it induces computational graph fragmentation and disables operator fusion. Our results yield concrete allocation policies for practitioners and researchers deploying quantized vision models on heterogeneous edge CPUs, without GPU access or gradient computation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code available at https://github.com/davidpob99/ramp-mpq
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAMP 系统比较 13 种层敏感度指标在 INT8 混合精度量化中的表现，发现 Jensen-Shannon 散度在 8 个模型-硬件配置中零灾难性失败，并用 K-Means 聚类替代固定阈值生成量化策略，在两个 ARM64 平台上取得近乎无损精度与相对全精度 1.81× 平均加速。
Motivation: 边缘 CPU 部署受算力与内存限制，混合精度量化需逐层判定可量化性，但常用敏感度指标在现代架构上系统性失效，固定阈值也因分布高度偏斜而脆弱。
Method: 对四个不同神经网络做层-wise INT8 量化，系统实证比较 13 种敏感度指标（含梯度类、权重统计类与 Jensen-Shannon 散度），再用 K-Means 聚类替代固定阈值生成量化策略，并在两个 ARM64 平台上验证。
Result: 梯度类敏感度方法在 8 个模型-硬件配置中 4 个失败，权重统计类 2 个失败，Jensen-Shannon 散度零灾难性失败；K-Means 策略达到近乎无损精度，相对全精度模型平均加速 1.81×；排除加速可忽略的层会因计算图碎片化与算子融合失效而适得其反。
Conclusion: Jensen-Shannon 散度配合聚类阈值可在无 GPU、无梯度计算的条件下给出可靠的边缘 CPU 混合精度分配策略；不应仅凭敏感度就排除加速可忽略的层。

papers.title: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
papers.abstract_en: Robotic assembly in high-mixture settings requires adaptable systems that can handle diverse parts, yet current approaches typically rely on policies specialized to each insertion task. Although this can reach high success rates, it makes the process of deploying systems for new problems tedious and time consuming. We present a framework for generalizable insertion using world models that combine robot proprioceptive information with raw visual observations captured by a wrist-mounted camera. Our model-based approach trains a single world model on up to 90 insertion tasks with geometrically diverse parts, achieving 56% zero-shot success on unseen objects with unknown geometry compared to just 7% with a model-free baseline. Importantly, performance improves as more objects are included in the training dataset, demonstrating strong scalability. Lastly, finetuning the generalist model on held-out objects significantly enhances data-efficiency compared to training from scratch and, in some cases, achieves better asymptotic performance. To our knowledge, this is the first system capable of assembling unseen objects in an entirely data-driven manner, and thus represents a significant step toward scalable, generalizable robotic assembly systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单个 world model 同时吃机器人本体感觉与腕部相机原始视觉，覆盖至多 90 个几何各异的插装任务，使未见物体在几何未知时零样本插装成功率达 56%，而 model-free 基线只有 7%。训练集物体越多性能越好，且在留出物体上微调比从头训练更省数据、部分情况下渐近性能更高。
Motivation: 高混合度装配里每个插装任务都要专门策略，换新问题就得重新部署，过程繁琐耗时；需要一个能泛化到几何未知零件的统一策略。
Method: 基于 model-based 的 world model 框架，输入为机器人 proprioceptive 信息加腕部相机原始视觉观测，单模型在至多 90 个几何多样插装任务上训练；再在留出物体上微调该 generalist 模型，并与 model-free 基线及从头训练对比。
Result: 在至多 90 个插装任务上训练的单 world model，对几何未知的未见物体取得 56% 零样本成功率，model-free 基线为 7%；训练集包含物体越多性能越强；在留出物体上微调比从头训练显著更省数据，部分情况下渐近性能还更高。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的单 world model 可以直接装配未见物体，作者称其为首个以纯数据驱动方式装配未见物体的系统，指向可扩展的通用机器人装配。

papers.title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond the current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations. Retaining past observations in context can aid in recovering this information, but at the significant cost of ever-growing, bloated context and inference latency. We thus introduce MemBodied, a fixed-size episodic memory with two complementary components: an associative state that records interactions across policy calls and an episode anchor that preserves a compact representation of the initial scene as a reference. At each policy call, the model conditions action generation on the current input and the memory components, rather than directly using past observations. Across five evaluated RMBench tasks requiring memory, MemBodied achieves $7.81\times$ the mean success rate of a stateless policy and $2.98\times$ of vanilla recurrent memory, while outperforming the strongest memory-augmented baseline by $1.3\times$ with $10\times$ fewer added parameters. On the fully observable LIBERO-Long suite, it reached 90.6%, a 5.4% improvement over the stateless $π_0$ policy. These findings support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding the policy context for history-dependent manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemBodied 为视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型加入固定大小的情节记忆：记录跨策略调用交互的 associative state，加上保留初始场景紧凑表示的 episode anchor，动作生成只依赖当前输入与记忆而非历史观测堆叠。在五个需要记忆的 RMBench 任务上，平均成功率是无记忆策略的 7.81 倍、朴素循环记忆的 2.98 倍，比最强记忆增强基线高 1.3 倍且新增参数少 10 倍；在完全可观测的 LIBERO-Long 上达到 90.6%，比无记忆 π_0 高 5.4%。
Motivation: 多数 VLA 策略只看当前观测，无法处理信息只存在于过去观测的历史依赖操作任务；把历史观测塞进上下文又会让上下文膨胀、推理延迟上升。
Method: MemBodied 用两个互补组件构成固定大小的情节记忆：associative state 跨策略调用记录交互，episode anchor 保存初始场景的紧凑表示作为参照；每次策略调用时以当前输入加记忆组件为条件生成动作，替代直接使用历史观测。
Result: 在五个需要记忆的 RMBench 任务上，平均成功率为无记忆策略的 7.81 倍、vanilla recurrent memory 的 2.98 倍，比最强记忆增强基线高 1.3 倍而新增参数少 10 倍；在完全可观测的 LIBERO-Long 套件上达到 90.6%，比无记忆 π_0 策略提升 5.4%。
Conclusion: 对历史依赖的操作任务，固定大小的关联式情节记忆是扩展策略上下文这一做法的实用替代方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: hyperbolix: Hyperbolic Deep Learning in JAX
papers.abstract_en: We present hyperbolix, an open-source library for hyperbolic deep learning in JAX, built on Flax NNX. To our knowledge, it is the first comprehensive, general-purpose hyperbolic deep learning library in JAX. It includes six manifolds with a common interface: Euclidean space, the Poincaré ball, the hyperboloid, the $κ$-stereographic model, mixed-curvature product spaces, and the proper velocity space. We implement layer families that cover linear layers, convolutions, attention, normalization, positional encoding, regression, and vector quantization. These building blocks span methods ranging from Ganea's original hyperbolic neural networks to recent fully hyperbolic architectures such as Hypformer and Lorentzian ResNet. Additionally, hyperbolix contains Riemannian optimizers implemented as optax transformations, wrapped distributions, and hyperbolic dimensionality-reduction techniques. Its API uses idiomatic JAX: Manifolds are stateless, with curvature being passed at call time, while manifold operations act on single points, with jax.vmap enabling batch operations. The precision of every checked operation is tested against a closed-form NumPy/SciPy transcription from the source paper or a finite difference, for both float32 and float64. On the hyperboloid, standard formulas for two-point operations, such as the distance, lose precision far from the origin, because they subtract two large, nearly equal terms. hyperbolix replaces these subtractions with cancellation-free formulas that stay accurate in float32 at distances where prior implementations return NaN. hyperbolix is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/timoklein/hyperbolix .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: hyperbolix 是基于 Flax NNX 的 JAX 双曲深度学习开源库，提供六种统一流形接口与覆盖线性层、卷积、注意力、归一化等的层族，并把双曲距离等两点公式的相减改写为无抵消 (cancellation-free) 形式。在 hyperboloid 上，该改写使 float32 在远离原点、旧实现返回 NaN 的距离上仍保持精度，且每个算子都对照原文闭式 NumPy/SciPy 实现或有限差分在 float32/float64 下验证。
Motivation: JAX 生态缺少通用的双曲深度学习库，且 hyperboloid 上距离等标准两点公式因两个大数相减在远离原点处损失精度、直接产生 NaN。
Method: 在 Flax NNX 上实现六种流形（Euclidean、Poincaré ball、hyperboloid、κ-stereographic、mixed-curvature product spaces、proper velocity space）的统一接口，流形无状态、曲率在调用时传入，单点运算配合 jax.vmap 批处理；提供线性层、卷积、注意力、归一化、位置编码、回归、向量量化等层族，覆盖 Ganea 原始超bolic 神经网络到 Hypformer、Lorentzian ResNet，另有 optax 形式的 Riemannian 优化器、wrapped distributions 与双曲降维。
Result: 每个受检算子在 float32 与 float64 下对照原文闭式 NumPy/SciPy 转写或有限差分测试精度；hyperboloid 上用无抵消公式替换两点公式的相减，在先前实现返回 NaN 的距离处 float32 仍保持准确。
Conclusion: JAX 上可以有一个接口统一、逐算子闭式验证的通用双曲深度学习库，而数值精度问题（远离原点的 NaN）能通过改写公式本身在 float32 内解决。

papers.title: Controlling Collectives of AI Agents in Reasoning Space with Spatial Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce an exciting new paradigm for planning and navigation in robotics, but fail on even simple multi-robot tasks as team sizes grow. We propose COMPASS, a scalable, decentralized multi-robot architecture for controlling large collectives of agentic robots with reasoning space feedback control. Feedback is generated locally on each robot by a spatial transformer which aggregates multi-hop messages across the fleet into a learned feedback token. Our experiments find that collectives of language models demonstrate performance gains from structured diversity of the input command, which can cancel biases; an advantage that is held across scale. Compared against a centralized frontier LLM policy and a language-only communication ablation, we find that the coupled design of COMPASS decisively produces cohesive flocking formations that accurately fly the commanded intent. We show that reasoning feedback works best when composed with a compact learned token. Our ablations show that hand engineered feedback with raw state appearing in the language channel obliterates cohesion. COMPASS generalizes zero-shot to unseen instructions of ambiguous meaning while commanding flocks up to 16 times its training scale, flying up to 1024 robots under natural language commands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 COMPASS：每台机器人用 spatial transformer 把跨机队多跳消息聚合成一个 learned feedback token，以推理空间反馈去中心化地控制大规模 agentic 机器人集群。对比 centralized frontier LLM policy 与纯语言通信消融，COMPASS 能形成一致 flocking 队形并准确执行自然语言指令，零样本泛化到歧义新指令，控制规模达训练规模 16 倍、最多 1024 台机器人；而手工设计反馈加原始状态走语言通道会彻底破坏队形一致性。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的机器人规划在团队规模变大后连简单多机器人任务都会失败，集中式控制与纯语言通信都无法维持大规模集群的队形一致性。
Method: COMPASS 是去中心化多机器人架构：每台机器人本地运行一个 spatial transformer，把机队中的多跳消息聚合为 learned feedback token，形成推理空间反馈控制；实验对比 centralized frontier LLM policy 与 language-only communication 消融，并测试输入指令的结构化多样性与手工反馈变体。
Result: 指令的结构化多样性带来性能增益并可抵消偏差，且该优势随规模保持；COMPASS 的耦合设计 decisively 产生一致 flocking 队形并准确飞行指令意图，推理反馈与 compact learned token 组合时效果最好；消融显示手工设计反馈加原始状态进入语言通道会 obliterate cohesion；零样本泛化到歧义新指令，控制规模达训练规模 16 倍，最多 1024 台机器人。
Conclusion: 大规模 LLM 机器人集群的可控性来自本地 spatial transformer 产生的紧凑 learned feedback token，而非把原始状态塞进语言通道；结构化多样的指令输入在规模扩大时仍能抵消模型偏差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
authors: Aya Zirikly (1 and 2) ((1) Department of Computer Science
School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
(2) Center for Speech and Language Processing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个 LLM 生成古典阿拉伯语 maqama（韵文散文）的受控评测：五个模型在 zero-shot、few-shot、rule-based 三种提示下比较，用人工标注与 LLM-as-a-judge 评估修辞密度、saj 密度、结构连贯与风格真实性。few-shot 最稳定地提升 saj 密度，GPT-4o 与 GPT-5.4-mini 在修辞与连贯维度上最受益于 rule-based，但 zero-shot 在五个模型上的综合分最高。
Motivation: LLM 创意生成研究多集中在现代语体与诗歌，古典散文体裁 maqama 几乎无人研究，缺少衡量 LLM 能否超越表层流畅、达到深层文学能力的评测框架。
Method: 对五个 LLM 做受控提示策略对比（zero-shot / few-shot / rule-based），输出由人工标注与 LLM-as-a-judge 双路评估，维度含修辞丰富度、saj 密度、结构连贯、风格真实性；另用第二个独立 LLM judge、配对显著性检验与非 LLM 的 saj 代理指标做交叉验证。
Result: few-shot 最一致地提高 saj 密度，但对修辞与连贯的效应随模型而变；GPT-4o 与 GPT-5.4-mini 在这两维上从 rule-based 提示获益最大；zero-shot 在全部五个模型上取得最高综合分。各模型在与阿拉伯 maqama 惯例的风格对齐上存在系统差异。
Conclusion: 提示策略对风格质量影响很强且维度依赖：要 saj 密度用 few-shot，要修辞与连贯且模型较强时用 rule-based，但综合分反而 zero-shot 最高。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ODPure: Backdoor Purification for Object Detection via Ensemble Corruption Consensus
papers.abstract_en: With the development of applications like autonomous driving, object detection has gained significant attention, while also highlighting critical vulnerabilities like backdoor attacks that severely compromise model integrity. Specifically, such attacks involve altering the categories of objects (i.e., object misclassification), removing bounding boxes (i.e., object disappearance), or generating bounding box proposals for non-existent objects (i.e., object generation) when a predefined trigger is present in the input. Although backdoor defenses for image classification are well-established, the research for object detection remains comparatively underexplored. Existing defenses address these threats by scanning outputs or models for potential backdoors but require discarding either malicious data or models. This remedy fails to enable a continuous and accurate perceptual stream for the object detection pipeline. To address such limitations, we propose ODPure, a novel input-stage black-box defense for object detection, which is based on input purification that ensures stable perception flows. Tailored to the dense prediction nature of object detectors, our Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) paradigm operates by neutralizing triggers through a diverse portfolio of corruptions to generate a massive pool of redundant proposals, then recovering fine-grained structural cues via generative priors, and finally employing voting to reach a consensus on the resulting detections. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method provides robust defense against diverse backdoor attacks and trigger types while preserving baseline accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 8 figures (including supplementary materials); Code available at https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ODPure 是面向目标检测后门的输入阶段黑盒防御：用多种图像扰动中和触发器并生成大量冗余候选框，再用生成先验恢复细粒度结构，最后对检测结果投票达成共识。实验显示它能抵御多种后门攻击与触发器类型，同时保持基线检测精度，无需丢弃数据或模型。
Motivation: 图像分类的后门防御已较成熟，但目标检测上的防御研究不足；现有方法靠扫描输出或模型来处置后门，只能丢弃恶意数据或模型，使检测流水线无法维持连续准确的感知流。
Method: 提出 Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) 范式，作为输入阶段的黑盒输入净化防御：先用多样化的图像扰动组合中和触发器并生成大规模冗余候选框，再用生成先验 (generative priors) 恢复细粒度结构线索，最后对得到的检测结果做投票达成共识。
Result: 综合实验表明该方法能抵御多种后门攻击与触发器类型，同时保持基线精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在输入阶段做净化而非丢弃数据或模型，可以在不牺牲检测精度的前提下为对象检测流水线提供持续、稳健的后门防御。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EmbodiedMemory-Bench: Benchmarking Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied interaction requires agents to retain and continually update information about the environment as they observe, act, and encounter change. Yet current agents struggle to maintain such memory reliably. Our analysis traces this limitation to four key deficiencies: weak fine-grained visual memory, unreliable dynamic world-state tracking, failing to record world state revealed by interaction outcomes, and limited generalization from prior experience. However, existing benchmarks do not directly assess these memory capabilities during long-horizon embodied interaction. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedMemory-Bench (EMem-Bench), comprising 2,554 interactive episodes across four task families. EMem-Bench requires agents to build and update memory from interaction history, then use it to complete a later task by acting in the environment. We further present Embodied-Memorizer (EMem), an external memory system that organizes embodied experience into spatial, event, and scene memories. We also train EMem-8B, an 8B policy that manages and uses these memories. We evaluate a diverse range of open-source and proprietary MLLMs and representative multimodal memory systems. Results show that current models remain weak and uneven across the four challenges. Under matched backbones, EMem achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems and improves both open-source and proprietary models, while EMem-8B further improves over its backbone. Project page: https://zju-omniai.github.io/EmbodiedMemoryBench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMem-Bench 用 2,554 个交互 episode、四类任务直接考核具身智能体在长时程交互中建立并更新记忆、再据此完成后续任务的能力，把短板归为细粒度视觉记忆弱、动态世界状态跟踪不可靠、交互结果揭示的状态未被记录、经验泛化有限四类。配套的外部记忆系统 Embodied-Memorizer (EMem) 将具身经验组织为空间、事件、场景三类记忆，在同骨干下取得被评记忆系统中最好的总体表现，同时提升开源与闭源 MLLM；EMem-8B 再在其骨干之上进一步提升。
Motivation: 现有具身智能体难以可靠维持跨长时程的记忆，而既有 benchmark 不在长时程具身交互过程中直接考核这类记忆能力，四类缺陷无从定位与比较。
Method: 构建 EMem-Bench：2,554 个交互 episode、四类任务族，要求智能体从交互历史建立并更新记忆，再用记忆在环境中执行后续任务；提出外部记忆系统 EMem，把具身经验组织为空间、事件、场景三类记忆，并训练 8B 策略 EMem-8B 管理与调用这些记忆；评测覆盖多种开源与闭源 MLLM 及代表性多模态记忆系统。
Result: EMem-Bench 含 2,554 个交互 episode、四类任务族；当前模型在四项挑战上整体偏弱且表现不均；在匹配骨干下，EMem 在被评记忆系统中总体表现最好，同时提升开源与闭源模型，EMem-8B 相对其骨干再有提升。
Conclusion: 长时程具身记忆应拆成四类可分别考核的能力，并用外部组织的空间/事件/场景记忆加专用策略来补足当前 MLLM 的记忆短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diff-RF: Mutually Reinforced Image Registration and Fusion via Degradation-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Image registration and fusion aim to establish spatial correspondences from misaligned multi-modal source images, and integrate complementary information. However, in real-world imaging scenarios, source images are often affected by complex and diverse degradations, such as low illumination, noise, etc., which severely hinder the effectiveness of registration and fusion. To address this issue, we propose a mutually reinforced image registration and fusion diffusion framework via degradation-aware learning, termed Diff-RF. It explores the intrinsic coupling between registration-fusion and information restoration in the degradation conditions, enabling high-quality fusion of unregistered images under complex degradation conditions. First, the intra-modal restoration module is designed to alleviate modality-specific degradations by leveraging information within each modality, thereby providing more reliable structural representations for registration and facilitating subsequent cross-modal fusion. Second, we develop a cross-modal diffusion registration and fusion module that establishes bidirectional interaction between registration and fusion. By integrating fusion-derived visual cues and correspondence-based geometric conditions into the diffusion process, the proposed framework progressively refines spatial alignment and exploits cross-modal complementary information to achieve collaborative enhancement. Rather than treating them as independent components, degradation-aware information restoration and the collaborative optimization of registration and fusion are tightly coupled, achieving overall performance improvements. Extensive experiments on multiple extended datasets demonstrate that Diff-RF achieves superior registration accuracy and fusion quality under various degraded scenarios, exhibiting strong robustness and generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Diff-RF 把退化感知的图像修复与多模态配准、融合放进同一个扩散框架互相增强：模态内修复先压低低照度、噪声等退化以给出可靠结构表征，跨模态扩散模块再把融合得到的视觉线索与配准得到的几何条件双向注入扩散过程，逐步细化对齐并利用互补信息。在多个扩展数据集的多种退化场景下，配准精度与融合质量均取得更优表现，体现鲁棒性与泛化能力。
Motivation: 真实成像中源图像常带低照度、噪声等复杂退化，使未配准多模态图像的空间对应建立与互补信息整合同时失效；把配准与融合作为独立组件处理无法利用二者的耦合。
Method: 提出退化感知的互增强扩散框架 Diff-RF：其一为模态内修复模块 (intra-modal restoration module)，利用各模态内部信息缓解模态特有退化，为配准提供更可靠结构表征；其二为跨模态扩散配准与融合模块 (cross-modal diffusion registration and fusion module)，在扩散过程中同时整合融合导出的视觉线索与对应关系导出的几何条件，使配准与融合双向交互、协同细化。
Result: 在多个扩展数据集的多种退化场景下，Diff-RF 取得更优的配准精度与融合质量，表现出强鲁棒性与泛化能力（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 退化感知的信息修复与配准-融合的协同优化必须紧耦合而非各自独立，才能在复杂退化条件下实现未配准图像的高质量融合与整体性能提升。

papers.title: Do Center Biases Propagate? Robustness of Pathology Foundation Models in Whole-Slide Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have transformed computational pathology through powerful representation learning from histopathological images. PFMs provide rich, discriminative representations for whole slide image (WSI) analysis, enabling tasks such as slide-level classification under multiple instance learning (MIL). However, these representations may also encode non-biological signals associated with acquisition centers, potentially introducing spurious shortcuts into downstream predictions. In this work, we evaluate center-associated robustness in WSI classification using a controlled training setting with increasing class-center correlations quantified by Cramér's V. We benchmark six PFMs across four datasets and two MIL aggregators, while evaluating ComBat as a robustification strategy. We further introduce the Area Under the Cramér's V Curve (AUCC) to jointly capture absolute classification performance and its degradation as spurious correlation increases. Results show that center-related information encoded by PFMs propagates to WSI-level predictions, with robustness depending on both the PFM representation and MIL aggregation strategy. Additionally, ComBat harmonization does not provide consistent robustness gains across datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 病理基础模型 (PFM) 编码的中心（acquisition center）信息会传播到全切片 (WSI) 分类预测中，随类-中心相关性（用 Cramér's V 量化）升高，性能随之退化。在四个数据集、六个 PFM、两种 MIL 聚合器的对照训练下，稳健性同时取决于 PFM 表示与 MIL 聚合策略，而 ComBat 校正在各数据集上不能带来一致的稳健性增益。
Motivation: WSI 分类在多中心数据上容易学到采集中心这一非生物学捷径，类-中心相关性升高时预测被伪相关污染；需要可控地度量这种退化并检验常见去偏手段是否真的有效。
Method: 在受控训练设定下按 Cramér's V 逐步提高类-中心相关性，对六个 PFM、四个数据集、两种 MIL 聚合器做基准测试，并评估 ComBat 作为稳健化策略；提出 AUCC（Area Under the Cramér's V Curve）联合刻画绝对分类性能与随伪相关升高的退化。
Result: 六个 PFM、四个数据集、两种 MIL 聚合器的基准显示：PFM 中心相关信息传播到 WSI 级预测，稳健性依赖 PFM 表示与 MIL 聚合策略；ComBat 在各数据集上未带来一致的稳健性增益。
Conclusion: PFM 的中心偏置会传导到下游 WSI 预测，缓解它需要同时选对表示与聚合器，而 ComBat 不能作为通用的稳健性修复。

papers.title: A Unified Framework and Dataset for Oriented Object Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding in remote sensing images aims to locate objects described by referring expressions. Most existing methods predict horizontal bounding boxes, which are often inaccurate for objects with arbitrary orientations. To address this limitation, we introduce O$^2$-VG, a family of models for oriented object visual grounding with three complementary designs. Specifically, O$^2$-VG-Trans is a cross-modality transformer for oriented object visual grounding. It establishes a strong discriminative foundation for the model family. Building upon it, O$^2$-VG-Uni predicts universal oriented proposals for possible foreground objects without specific text prompts. It also supports object retrieval through cached proposal embeddings. Using these universal oriented proposals as input prompts, O$^2$-VG-VLM is an autoregressive vision-language model. It generates oriented box token blocks in parallel through multi-token prediction. In addition, we construct DIOR-R-RSVG, a dataset for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. It provides image, expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation. Together, the O$^2$-VG family provides a flexible framework that spans discriminative transformers and generative vision-language models. It achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向遥感旋转目标的视觉定位 (oriented object visual grounding) 模型族 O²-VG：判别式跨模态 Transformer、生成式通用旋转提议与自回归视觉语言模型三级递进，并配套构建 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集。三者合起来覆盖判别式到生成式路线，在多个 benchmark 上取得更优表现。
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉定位方法多预测水平边界框，对任意朝向的细长目标定位不准，且缺少面向旋转框的图像-表达式-框训练评测数据。
Method: O²-VG-Trans 用跨模态 Transformer 做旋转目标定位的判别基础；O²-VG-Uni 在无文本提示下预测通用旋转提议并以缓存的提议嵌入支持目标检索；O²-VG-VLM 以这些提议为输入提示，用自回归多 token 并行生成旋转框 token 块。同时构建 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集，提供图像、表达式与旋转框三元组用于训练和评测。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上取得更优表现；配套发布 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集与代码 (github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs)。
Conclusion: 判别式 Transformer 与生成式视觉语言模型可由通用旋转提议衔接成一个统一框架，覆盖遥感旋转目标视觉定位的训练与评测。

papers.title: From Alignment to Fusion in 3D Vision-Language
papers.abstract_en: Unified 3D vision-language systems must combine complementary geometry, scale, and appearance cues while supporting tasks from instance segmentation to language-guided reasoning. Existing methods often process point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images independently; directly combining these heterogeneous representations may leave substantial feature discrepancy unresolved, while subsequent unconstrained adaptation may distort their internal geometry. We propose an align-then-fuse framework that first applies triple pairwise cosine alignment to establish segment-level correspondence across the three representations and then retrieves task-conditioned features with a prompt-guided query decoder. Before fusion, representation-specific query features are transformed by learnable mappings constrained to the special orthogonal group. These mappings preserve inner products and Euclidean distances within each representation, permitting controlled representation-specific re-parameterisation without arbitrarily distorting its internal geometry. The transformed features are subsequently combined through Adaptive Fusion under downstream task supervision. Experiments cover eight datasets for instance segmentation, visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning. Compared with PQ3D, the model improves average precision by 3.2 points on ScanNet200 and grounding accuracy by 2.9, 10.6, 4.6, and 4.1 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer, respectively, while also improving performance on ScanQA, SQA3D, and Scan2Cap. Ablations further support the complementary roles of alignment and orthogonal re-parameterisation and the effectiveness of Adaptive Fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 align-then-fuse 框架：先用三组两两余弦对齐在点云、体素网格、多视图图像三种表征间建立段级对应，再用受 SO(n) 特殊正交群约束的可学习映射做表征内重参数化，最后由 prompt 引导的查询解码器检索任务条件特征并做 Adaptive Fusion。相比 PQ3D，ScanNet200 平均精度 +3.2 点，ScanRefer/Nr3D/Sr3D/Multi3DRefer 定位准确率分别 +2.9、+10.6、+4.6、+4.1 点。
Motivation: 统一 3D 视觉-语言系统需同时处理几何、尺度与外观线索，但现有方法独立处理三种异构表征，直接拼接留下特征差异，无约束适配又会破坏各表征内部几何。
Method: 先做三组两两余弦对齐建立段级对应；查询特征经保持内积与欧氏距离的特殊正交群约束可学习映射变换，再在下游任务监督下做 Adaptive Fusion；用 prompt 引导的查询解码器检索任务条件特征。
Result: 在八个数据集上覆盖实例分割、视觉定位、问答与密集描述任务。相比 PQ3D：ScanNet200 平均精度 +3.2 点；定位准确率 ScanRefer +2.9、Nr3D +10.6、Sr3D +4.6、Multi3DRefer +4.1 点；ScanQA、SQA3D、Scan2Cap 也有提升。消融支持对齐与正交重参数化的互补作用及 Adaptive Fusion 的有效性。
Conclusion: 先对齐再受约束融合优于直接拼接或无约束适配：正交映射允许表征特定的受控重参数化而不任意扭曲内部几何，对齐与正交重参数化在消融中呈互补作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Agent Output to Authorized Transition
papers.abstract_en: Agentic engineering systems can edit repositories, run tools and tests, build firmware, synthesize schematics, and prepare deployable or manufacturable artifacts. The assurance problem is therefore shifting from whether an agent can produce an output to whether an engineering lifecycle is justified in acting on claims about that output. Current products and standards provide sandboxes, approvals, hooks, traces, policy enforcement, attestations, bills of materials, and assurance representations, but these capabilities remain fragmented. This paper presents the Agile-V Assurance Spine, a cross-domain transition contract for software, firmware, and PCB engineering. Evidence is admitted only when it establishes required properties through an authoritative source profile, is bound to the exact artifact and frozen policy baseline, remains current with respect to declared dependencies, and satisfies risk-appropriate independence and authority. Gate decisions are recorded as receipts; approvals and exceptions are exact-scope and time-bounded; and authorization is rechecked at the effect boundary before merge, deployment, flashing, release, or fabrication. A bounded review of contemporary research, commercial platforms, open-source infrastructure, and standards positions the model relative to evidence-gated lifecycle control, continuous assurance, runtime admission, provenance, and AI/ML inventories. The paper contributes a precise vocabulary, compositional architecture, domain profiles, mapping to open-source implementations, and an adversarial evaluation agenda. It does not claim regulatory conformity or demonstrated production superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Agile-V Assurance Spine：把智能体产出能否进入工程生命周期变成一份跨软件、固件、PCB 的授权转换契约，证据须由权威来源、绑定到具体产物与冻结策略基线、随依赖保持新鲜、并满足与风险相称的独立性与权限，且在 merge、部署、烧录、发布、制造这些 effect boundary 处重新校验授权。门禁决策记为 receipt，审批与例外限定精确范围并限时。
Motivation: 智能体已能改仓库、跑测试、构建固件、综合原理图并产出可部署或可制造工件，问题从“能否产出”转为“生命周期凭什么依据这些产出的声明行动”；现有沙箱、审批、hooks、traces、策略执行、attestation、BOM 与 assurance 表示彼此割裂。
Method: 定义跨域转换契约：证据准入四条件（权威来源 profile、绑定到确切产物与冻结策略基线、相对声明依赖保持新鲜、满足风险相称的独立性与权限），门禁决策记为 receipt，审批与例外 exact-scope 且 time-bounded，授权在 effect boundary 复查；配套给出精确词汇、可组合架构、域 profile、到开源实现的映射与对抗性评估议程，并以对当代研究、商业平台、开源基础设施与标准的有界综述定位该模型。
Result: 贡献为精确词汇表、可组合架构、域 profile、开源实现映射与对抗性评估议程；论文明确不声称符合监管、也不声称已证明生产环境优越性。
Conclusion: 工程生命周期对智能体产出的把关应从分散的沙箱与审批转向一条可组合的授权转换契约，把证据准入、receipt 记录与 effect boundary 处的复查串成一条链。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 工程生命周期对智能体产出的把关应从分散的沙箱与审批转向一条可组合的授权转换契约，把证据准入、receipt 记录与 effect boundary 处的复查串成一条链。

papers.title: Log-Depth Recurrent Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Language modeling using Transformers has become commonplace despite their fixed computational depth and quadratic runtime with respect to input tokens. Recurrent models on the other hand offer linear depth but no parallel execution. In this work, we extend balanced-tree recursive operators from sequence encoding to autoregressive prediction, enabling all prefix representations to be computed with logarithmic depth and linear runtime. Our experiments provide an initial characterization of this model class, demonstrating robust length extrapolation and performance approaching that of ALiBi-based Transformers, highlighting its potential as an alternative architecture for language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把原本用于序列编码的平衡树递归算子扩展到自回归预测，使所有前缀表示都能以对数深度、线性运行时计算，得到一种介于 Transformer 与循环模型之间的语言建模架构。实验给出该模型类的初步刻画：长度外推稳健，性能接近基于 ALiBi 的 Transformer。
Motivation: Transformer 计算深度固定且对输入 token 数呈二次运行时，循环模型虽有线性深度却无法并行执行，语言建模缺少同时具备对数深度、线性运行时与并行前缀计算的架构。
Method: 将平衡树递归算子 (balanced-tree recursive operators) 从序列编码扩展到自回归预测，使全部前缀表示按对数深度并行计算；实验对这一新模型类做初步刻画，并与基于 ALiBi 的 Transformer 对比。
Result: 实验显示该模型类具备稳健的长度外推 (length extrapolation) 能力，性能接近 ALiBi-based Transformers；摘要给出的其他量化指标为 5 页、3 幅图的篇幅说明。
Conclusion: 对数深度、线性运行时的递归自回归架构可作为语言建模的可行替代路线，其潜力在于兼顾并行前缀计算与长度外推，但目前性能仍只是接近而非达到 ALiBi Transformer 水平。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Support-Compiled Feature Folding: More Evidence at Lower Memory Across Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models face a feature-side scaling dilemma: full-width pairwise mixing grows quadratically with the number of columns, whereas feature selection saves memory by discarding evidence. We introduce Support-Compiled Feature Folding (SCFF), a training-free inference framework that resolves this dilemma without changing the frozen backbone. SCFF routes support-ranked features through bounded leaves of the native feature encoder, support-checks the residual evidence, and merges the encoded messages before a single contextual prediction. It thereby converts quadratic feature-interaction work into linear-in-width work with a bounded local working set, without ensembling predictions or training new parameters. On the exhaustive 18-dataset wide-table slice of fixed AMLB-29, TabZilla, and TabArena snapshots, SCFF improves dataset-macro accuracy and NLL on all six evaluated backbones. All four matched-width comparisons retain favorable 95 percent dataset-bootstrap intervals on locked folds, with relative error reductions up to 26.1 percent. Median paired GPU-memory savings are 2.09x to 2.36x, and the ratio of separately observed maximum peaks reaches 34.3x. Under a measured peak-memory ceiling, SCFF uses the saved budget to preserve more support-selected evidence, improving accuracy by 4.06 and 3.72 points over the widest feasible single leaf on predeclared wide-Core strata of TabICLv2 and TabPFN-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCFF 是面向表格基础模型的免训练推理框架：把全宽两两特征混合的二次复杂度折成线性于列宽的工作量，同时不丢弃被 support 排序选中的证据。在 AMLB-29、TabZilla、TabArena 固定快照的 18 数据集宽表切片上，六个 backbone 的宏平均准确率与 NLL 全部提升，相对误差降幅最高 26.1%，显存中位数节省 2.09x–2.36x。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在特征侧面临两难：全宽 pairwise mixing 随列数二次增长，而特征选择省内存却直接丢掉证据。
Method: SCFF 不改动冻结 backbone：把 support 排序后的特征经原生 feature encoder 的 bounded leaves 路由，对残差证据做 support-check，再合并编码消息做一次上下文预测；不集成预测、不训练新参数，把二次特征交互转为线性于宽度且工作集有界。
Result: 在 AMLB-29、TabZilla、TabArena 固定快照的 18 数据集宽表切片上，SCFF 在全部六个评估 backbone 上同时提升数据集宏平均准确率与 NLL；四项 matched-width 对比在 locked folds 上 95% dataset-bootstrap 区间均保持有利，相对误差降幅最高 26.1%；配对 GPU 显存中位数节省 2.09x–2.36x，分别观测到的峰值之比达 34.3x；在实测峰值显存上限下，SCFF 用省下的预算保留更多 support 选中证据，在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-3 预先声明的 wide-Core 分层上比最宽可行单叶准确率高 4.06 与 3.72 个百分点。
Conclusion: 特征侧的证据保留与显存开销可以同时改善：把二次混合折成有界线性工作集后，省下的显存应重新投给更多 support 选中的证据，而不是靠丢特征换内存。

papers.title: Transferable Evidence Reconstruction for Longitudinal Glucose Representations
papers.abstract_en: Long physiological recordings contain many routine measurements, while predictive information is often concentrated in rare events, sustained burden, and recurring temporal patterns. Masked autoencoding recovers measurements; contrastive learning aligns views. We study self-supervision that explicitly prioritizes structured signal evidence. We introduce transferable evidence reconstruction (TER), which constructs evidence from unlabeled recordings, fits a fresh low-capacity reader on one recording group, and requires that reader to recover the same evidence in another group without refitting. Differentiating through this cross-group test learns representations with transferable evidence-decoding rules; the evidence guides self-supervision but is not used as a downstream feature. For continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), an observation-aware daily encoder and clock-aware multi-day memory bind glucose level and change to recorded time while organizing up to seven days of history. On the 14-task leaderboard, TER improves the strongest prior overall PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 scores by 5.51/4.43/2.80 percentage points and sets a new best metric on 12/14 tasks. These leaderboard gains are 2.0-2.9 times the respective gaps between the two strongest baselines. With public pretraining data, folds, and the linear probe matched, TER outperforms our GlucoFM reproduction by 6.09/5.52/2.72 points. Target-reader ablations, same-history controls, and cross-person readouts support the combination of structured evidence, cross-group reader fitting, and learned multi-day organization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可迁移证据重构 (Transferable Evidence Reconstruction, TER)：从无标注长程生理记录中构造结构化证据，在一个记录组上拟合低容量 reader，并要求其不重拟合地在另一组恢复同一证据，反向传播学到可迁移的证据解码规则。在连续血糖监测 (CGM) 14 任务榜上，TER 把最强先前整体 PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 提升 5.51/4.43/2.80 个百分点，12/14 任务刷新最优。
Motivation: 长程生理记录中大量常规测量冗余，预测信息集中在罕见事件、持续负担与周期模式里；掩码自编码只重建测量、对比学习只对齐视图，都没有显式优先结构化信号证据。
Method: TER 三步：从无标注记录构造证据；在一组记录上拟合全新低容量 reader；要求该 reader 不重拟合即可在另一组恢复同一证据，对这一跨组测试求导。CGM 侧用 observation-aware 日编码器与 clock-aware 多日记忆，把血糖水平与变化绑定到记录时间，组织最多 7 天历史；证据只引导自监督，不作为下游特征。
Result: 14 任务榜上整体 PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 分别提高 5.51/4.43/2.80 个百分点，12/14 任务取得新最优；这些提升是两个最强基线之间相应差距的 2.0–2.9 倍。在公开预训练数据、折划分与 linear probe 对齐的条件下，TER 比作者的 GlucoFM 复现高 6.09/5.52/2.72 个百分点。
Conclusion: 结构化证据、跨组 reader 拟合与学到的多日组织三者结合，才能把 CGM 表示的跨任务可迁移性推过最强基线；证据作为监督引导而非下游特征即可产生榜上增益。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: PASTABench: Proactive Assessment of Sequential Trajectories for Agent Safety
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents that alter real-world states, ensuring operational safety across multi-step workflows has become a critical challenge. While recent work has moved beyond single-turn evaluation toward multi-turn paradigms, key limitations persist: step-level methods treat actions in isolation, missing how risks accumulate, while trajectory-level evaluations operate post-hoc, offering no opportunity for timely intervention. To address these limitations, we formalize Decoupled Proactive Safety Monitoring along three dimensions: whether to intervene, when to intervene, and what the risk is. We introduce PASTABench, a benchmark of 1,139 multi-turn trajectories spanning 5 risk categories and 13 subcategories. We further propose the Optimal Intervention Window (OIW), anchored by annotated Earliest-Signal and Trigger turns, to quantify intervention timeliness. Evaluation of 16 LLMs reveals that proactive intervention remains largely unsolved, with the best model achieving only 40.74% optimal-timing interventions. Fine-grained diagnosis further uncovers pervasive lexical overfitting: competitive safety scores of smaller models mask keyword hypersensitivity rather than genuine risk comprehension, as their proactive capability largely collapses once hazard vocabulary is neutralized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PASTABench 把 LLM agent 安全评估从单步/事后判定改为解耦的主动监控（是否干预、何时干预、风险是什么），含 1,139 条多轮轨迹、5 大类 13 子类风险，并用标注的 Earliest-Signal 与 Trigger 轮次定义 Optimal Intervention Window (OIW) 量化干预时机。评测 16 个 LLM 显示主动干预基本未解：最优模型只有 40.74% 的干预落在最优时机；小模型看似有竞争力的安全分数实为关键词过敏，中和危险词汇后其主动能力基本崩溃。
Motivation: 现有 step 级方法孤立看待动作、看不到风险如何累积，trajectory 级评测又是事后判定、无法及时干预，多步 agent 改变真实世界状态时缺少可操作的主动安全监控标准。
Method: 形式化解耦的主动安全监控三维度（是否干预、何时干预、风险是什么），构建 1,139 条多轮轨迹、覆盖 5 个风险类别 13 个子类的 PASTABench；以人工标注的 Earliest-Signal 轮和 Trigger 轮锚定 Optimal Intervention Window (OIW) 来度量干预时机，并对 16 个 LLM 做评测与细粒度诊断（含中和危险词汇的对照）。
Result: PASTABench 含 1,139 条多轮轨迹、5 个风险类别 13 个子类；16 个 LLM 评测中最好的模型只有 40.74% 的干预落在 OIW 最优时机；诊断发现小模型的安全分数来自词汇级过敏，中和危险词汇后其主动能力基本崩溃。
Conclusion: LLM agent 的主动安全干预在该基准上远未解决，且现有竞争性安全分数很大程度上是词汇过拟合而非真正的风险理解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geospatial embeddings detect old-growth forests but buffered spatial validation narrows their advantage over Sentinel features
authors: Emily R. Lines (1) ((1) Department of Geography
(3) Department of Computer Science and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Old-growth forests develop over centuries under minimal anthropogenic disturbance, producing structurally complex and biodiverse stands. In Europe, protecting them requires mapping that is accurate for individual forest parcels yet deployable continent-wide. Geospatial foundation model (GFM) embeddings enable label-scarce land classification, but their value for old-growth detection remains unknown. Here, we map old-growth forests across 211,893 ha of Romania's Southern Carpathians, a beech-spruce landscape typical of the Alpine Biogeographic Region. We construct high-confidence, expert-informed reference labels for old-growth and non-old-growth parcels. We add AlphaEarth, TESSERA v2 and Sentinel-1/2 features to a common baseline of topographic and human-access predictors, then compare them under spatially blocked validation with and without 10 km train-test buffers to limit residual autocorrelation. With buffering, GFM and Sentinel-1/2 predictors increase precision-recall AUC by 0.21-0.25 [95% CIs: 0.15-0.34] relative to baseline, indicating spectral data contain a spatially robust old-growth signal. With a PR-AUC of 0.84 [0.79-0.88], TESSERA outperforms Sentinel-1/2 (+0.08 [+0.05 to +0.11]) and AlphaEarth (+0.08 [+0.04 to +0.12]) under unbuffered spatial validation. At a 10 km buffer, however, this advantage narrows to +0.04 [-0.01 to +0.11] and +0.03 [-0.04 to +0.10], intervals consistent with no difference. At 10 m resolution, convolutional neural networks add no benefit over pixel-based XGBoost. Comparisons with four national- and continental-scale products show the importance of non-old-growth labels, and reveal 81% agreement between our predictions and a field-calibrated map. We conclude that buffered spatial validation is vital when transferring old-growth detection models to unseen landscapes, and provide our labels and predictions for future work.
papers.comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material (19-page main article with 7 figures and 3 tables; 15-page supplement with 9 figures and 21 tables). Submitted for publication. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22693148 (embargoed until publication); code: https://github.com/ratsakatika/detecting-old-growth-forests
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在罗马尼亚南喀尔巴阡 211,893 ha 上用地理基础模型 (GFM) embedding 检测老龄林，加 10 km 训练-测试缓冲后 GFM 与 Sentinel-1/2 特征相对地形+通达性基线把 PR-AUC 提升 0.21–0.25。无缓冲时 TESSERA v2 的 PR-AUC 0.84、领先 Sentinel-1/2 与 AlphaEarth 各 0.08，加 10 km 缓冲后优势缩到 +0.04 与 +0.03、区间含零。作者结论是跨未见景观迁移老龄林检测模型必须用缓冲空间验证。
Motivation: 欧洲老龄林保护需要可全大陆部署的地块级制图，但 GFM embedding 对老龄林检测的价值未知；空间自相关残差会让无缓冲验证高估模型优势，误导跨景观迁移。
Method: 在南喀尔巴阡山毛榉-云杉景观构建专家高置信度的老龄林/非老龄林地块参考标签，在地形与人类通达基线之上加入 AlphaEarth、TESSERA v2 与 Sentinel-1/2 特征，用空间分块验证并对比有无 10 km 缓冲两种设置；10 m 分辨率下另比较卷积神经网络与基于像素的 XGBoost，并与四个国家及大陆尺度产品对照。
Result: 有缓冲时 GFM 与 Sentinel-1/2 相对基线 PR-AUC 提升 0.21–0.25（95% CI 0.15–0.34）；无缓冲时 TESSERA PR-AUC 0.84（0.79–0.88），领先 Sentinel-1/2 +0.08（+0.05 至 +0.11）、领先 AlphaEarth +0.08（+0.04 至 +0.12）；10 km 缓冲下优势缩至 +0.04（-0.01 至 +0.11）与 +0.03（-0.04 至 +0.10），区间与无差异一致。10 m 分辨率下 CNN 相对 XGBoost 无增益；预测与一张野外标定地图 81% 一致。
Conclusion: 缓冲空间验证对老龄林检测模型向未见景观迁移至关重要，否则会夸大 GFM embedding 相对普通 Sentinel 光谱特征的优势；作者公开标签与预测供后续使用。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: From Change Captions to Change Detection: Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework for Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing change detection (RSCD) is essential for monitoring land-cover changes and urban development. However, most methods demand pixel-level change masks, which are costly and time-consuming to annotate. Weakly supervised methods reduce this cost by using image-level change labels. Yet these labels indicate only whether a change occurs, leaving models to recover the location of the change and semantic meaning through additional and complex mechanisms. This missing information can be supplied directly by change captions, which describe what changes, what it becomes, and where it occurs. Therefore, we introduce change-caption-guided RSCD, using change captions as the sole task-specific supervision to learn change masks without manually annotated change masks. Our framework has two components: a caption-driven generation pipeline that produces bi-temporal remote sensing image pairs at scale with controlled changes matching each caption, and a change detector guided by the caption's transition semantics. The detector uses our Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework (SAAF) to combine caption-grounded semantic responses with RGB differences for change localization, while text conditioning guides dense prediction. Experiments on our newly constructed Flair-RSGen dataset and WHU-CDC show that SAAF outperforms the closest reproduced limited-supervision baselines in macro-averaged IoU and F1 under the evaluated protocols. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/SAAF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以变化描述 (change captions) 作为唯一任务监督的弱监督遥感变化检测框架 SAAF：先用描述驱动生成管线批量产出带受控变化的双时相影像对，再用语义-外观一致性把描述接地的语义响应与 RGB 差异融合定位变化。在自建 Flair-RSGen 与 WHU-CDC 上，宏平均 IoU 与 F1 超过所复现的最接近有限监督基线。
Motivation: 现有弱监督变化检测只用图像级变化标签，只说明有没有变化，模型还得靠额外复杂机制反推位置与语义；像素级掩码标注又昂贵耗时。
Method: 两组件：描述驱动生成管线按每条 caption 产出带受控变化的双时相遥感影像对；检测器用 Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework (SAAF) 融合 caption 接地的语义响应与 RGB 差异做变化定位，并以文本条件引导稠密预测，全程不需人工变化掩码。
Result: 在自建 Flair-RSGen 数据集与 WHU-CDC 上，SAAF 在所评估协议下的宏平均 IoU 与 F1 超过最接近的复现有限监督基线；论文 12 页、6 图、6 表，代码已公开。
Conclusion: 变化描述可替代像素级掩码与图像级标签，作为弱监督变化检测的唯一任务监督，同时给出变化的位置与语义。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Two Global Crops Suffice: Locating Semantic Emergence in DINO-Style Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised vision transformers trained with DINO-style objectives exhibit striking emergent semantic representation quality across visual tasks, yet the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain unclear. We present a systematic empirical dissection of the DINO family and show that semantic representations arise primarily from enforcing consistency between geometrically distinct global views of the same image instance. This instance-specific global alignment acts as the semantic anchor of DINO-style learning. Across controlled retraining experiments evaluated on semantic correspondence and a diverse suite of 2D and 3D downstream tasks, we find that patch-level masking objectives enhance semantics only when trained jointly with this global alignment, indicating that the iBOT objective refines and densifies existing semantic structure rather than creating it independently. In contrast, local-to-global view alignment does not substantially improve semantic qualities at fixed compute beyond a purely global alignment. Beyond training design, we revisit how semantic representation quality should be evaluated: while classification accuracy is the standard validation score, semantic correspondence provides a complementary axis that more reliably predicts downstream task performance. Together, these findings provide a functional decomposition of DINO-style learning and represent an important step toward understanding how semantic representations emerge in self-supervised vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 DINO 系自监督视觉 Transformer 的受控重训实验表明，语义表征主要来自同一图像两个几何不同的全局视图之间的一致性约束，即实例级全局对齐是语义的锚点；patch 级 masking（iBOT）只有与该全局对齐联合训练时才增强语义，单独的 local-to-global 对齐在固定算力下并不显著改善语义质量。
Motivation: DINO 系目标训练出的视觉 Transformer 具有明显的涌现语义表征，但究竟是哪一部分训练设计产生语义仍不清楚，分类准确率作为标准验证分数也无法刻画语义质量。
Method: 对 DINO 家族做系统性实证拆解：设计受控重训实验，分别消融全局视图对齐、iBOT patch masking、local-to-global 对齐，并在语义对应 (semantic correspondence) 及多类 2D/3D 下游任务上评测表征质量。
Result: 受控重训显示语义表征主要由几何不同的全局视图一致性产生；patch masking 目标仅在与全局对齐联合训练时提升语义，说明 iBOT 是细化并加密已有语义结构而非独立创造；固定算力下 local-to-global 对齐相比纯全局对齐不显著改善语义。评测提出以语义对应作为分类准确率之外的互补轴，它更能预测下游任务表现。
Conclusion: DINO 式学习可功能性分解为：实例级全局对齐负责产生语义，iBOT 负责细化加密；评估语义表征时应把语义对应与分类准确率并列使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLMs Can Describe, But Not Measure: Object-Centric Scene Understanding for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic operation in previously unseen environments requires both semantic understanding and reliable metric information. While vision--language models (VLMs) provide strong semantic capabilities, their geometric estimates remain less reliable. In this paper, we propose a VLM-driven, modular perception framework for scene understanding using off-the-shelf approaches. Starting from a single RGB-D observation, the scene is segmented into object-level regions, annotated by a VLM, and grounded with depth information to construct a task-independent object-centric representation. Experiments on 151 tabletop scenes show that the proposed decomposition preserves strong semantic performance while substantially improving localization and depth estimation over direct VLM inference. The resulting representation is also integrated with a task-planning framework for robotic execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VLM 驱动的模块化物体中心场景理解框架：单帧 RGB-D 先分割物体级区域，由 VLM 标注语义，再用深度信息做 grounding，得到与任务无关的物体中心表示。在 151 个桌面场景上，该分解在保持强语义性能的同时，相比直接 VLM 推理显著改善定位与深度估计，并可接入任务规划框架驱动机器人执行。
Motivation: 机器人在未见环境中既需要语义理解又需要可靠度量信息，而 VLM 语义强、几何估计不可靠，直接用 VLM 推理做定位与深度误差大。
Method: 从单帧 RGB-D 出发：把场景分割为物体级区域，用现成 VLM 逐物体标注，再用深度信息 grounding，构建任务无关的物体中心表示；该表示随后接入任务规划框架做机器人执行。
Result: 在 151 个桌面场景上，物体级分解保持了强语义性能，同时相比直接 VLM 推理显著改善定位与深度估计；表示被集成进任务规划框架完成机器人执行。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的语义能力与深度几何分开处理、以物体中心表示为中介，可以在不牺牲语义的前提下补上 VLM 缺失的度量信息，供下游任务规划直接使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From ECG Signals to Representative-Morphology Heatmaps for Biometric Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) contains subject-specific morphology that supports biometric recognition, yet image-based performance depends on how the waveform is rendered. We introduce representative-morphology heatmaps, a deterministic ECG-to-image representation adapted from ECGXtractor. Within each block of ten aligned beats, the five beats closest to the block mean are averaged into a 400 by L matrix and rendered either as a conventional trace or as a dense cardiac-time-by-lead heatmap. Since both representations contain identical physiological samples, their comparison isolates the effect of rendering. We evaluate verification and closed-set identification on PTB, ECG-ID, and MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO. Five compact models, including ZACH-ViT, are trained from scratch, while six ImageNet-pretrained CNN and transformer backbones assess model scale and visual transfer. Heatmaps improve both FNMR operating points and both identification ranks in all 15 compact model-dataset comparisons, while EER improves in 14. Across the matched experiments, EER decreases by 9.59 percentage points and Rank-1 increases by 24.69 points on average. ConvNeXt-Tiny reaches 2.43% EER on PTB and 5.79% on ECG-ID, whereas DeiT-Base reaches 14.92% on MIMIC-DEMO. ImageNet initialization clearly benefits the two multilead datasets but has a mixed effect on ECG-ID, and performance does not increase monotonically with model size. The best heatmap systems approach the strongest signal-domain EER on PTB and ECG-ID, while DeiT-Base provides the strongest evaluated performance on MIMIC-DEMO. Lead-channel ablation further shows that useful channel combinations depend on the cohort and biometric task. Overall, representative-morphology heatmaps provide an effective image representation for ECG verification and identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ECG 渲染成代表形态热图 (representative-morphology heatmaps) 可显著提升基于图像的 ECG 生物识别：在 PTB、ECG-ID、MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO 上，热图在全部 15 组紧凑模型-数据集比较中改善 FNMR 工作点与两个识别 rank，EER 平均下降 9.59 个百分点、Rank-1 平均上升 24.69 个百分点。
Motivation: 基于图像的 ECG 生物识别性能高度依赖波形渲染方式，但渲染本身的影响此前难以与生理样本差异分离。
Method: 提出确定性的 ECG-to-image 表示（改编自 ECGXtractor）：在每十个对齐心拍的块内取最接近块均值的五个心拍求平均，得到 400×L 矩阵，再渲染为常规走纸或心电时间×导联的密集热图；两种表示含相同生理样本，从而隔离渲染效应。在 PTB、ECG-ID、MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO 上做验证与闭集识别，从头训练五个紧凑模型（含 ZACH-ViT），并用六个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN/transformer 骨干考察模型规模与视觉迁移，另做导联消融。
Result: 热图在全部 15 组紧凑模型-数据集比较中改善两个 FNMR 工作点与两个识别 rank，EER 在 14 组中改善；匹配实验中 EER 平均下降 9.59 个百分点，Rank-1 平均上升 24.69 个百分点。ConvNeXt-Tiny 在 PTB 达 2.43% EER、ECG-ID 达 5.79%，DeiT-Base 在 MIMIC-DEMO 达 14.92%。ImageNet 初始化明显有利于两个多导联数据集但对 ECG-ID 效果不一，性能不随模型规模单调上升。
Conclusion: 代表形态热图是 ECG 验证与识别的有效图像表示，最佳热图系统在 PTB 与 ECG-ID 上接近最强信号域 EER，MIMIC-DEMO 上 DeiT-Base 为所评估的最强性能；有用的导联组合取决于队列与生物识别任务。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 提出确定性的 ECG-to-image 表示（改编自 ECGXtractor）：在每十个对齐心拍的块内取最接近块均值的五个心拍求平均，得到 400×L 矩阵，再渲染为常规走纸或心电时间×导联的密集热图；两种表示含相同生理样本，从而隔离渲染效应。在 PTB、ECG-ID、MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO 上做验证与闭集识别，从头训练五个紧凑模型（含 ZACH-ViT），并用六个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN/transformer 骨干考察模型规模与视觉迁移，另做导联消融。
summary_sections.result: 热图在全部 15 组紧凑模型-数据集比较中改善两个 FNMR 工作点与两个识别 rank，EER 在 14 组中改善；匹配实验中 EER 平均下降 9.59 个百分点，Rank-1 平均上升 24.69 个百分点。ConvNeXt-Tiny 在 PTB 达 2.43% EER、ECG-ID 达 5.79%，DeiT-Base 在 MIMIC-DEMO 达 14.92%。ImageNet 初始化明显有利于两个多导联数据集但对 ECG-ID 效果不一，性能不随模型规模单调上升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 代表形态热图是 ECG 验证与识别的有效图像表示，最佳热图系统在 PTB 与 ECG-ID 上接近最强信号域 EER，MIMIC-DEMO 上 DeiT-Base 为所评估的最强性能；有用的导联组合取决于队列与生物识别任务。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Probabilistic Safety Certification for AI-Based Grid-Edge Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Coordinating large population of flexible grid-edge devices can alleviate the need for time-consuming and capital-intensive network upgrades, and AI-based control methods such as multi-agent reinforcement learning or imitation learning are promising in their real-time decision scalability. However, system operators still need an independent and rigorous way to decide whether a given AI system is safe enough for deployment. This paper develops a finite-sample probabilistic safety certification framework for black-box AI decision models in closed-loop grid operation. The central idea is to reduce the complete input--AI--grid evaluator workflow to a binary unsafe outcome under an operator-defined safety specification, and then use exact binomial inference to certify the corresponding unsafe operation probability. Given a set of held-out calibration scenarios, the framework returns the tightest one-sided upper certificate and an accept/reject deployment criterion that controls the probability of false safety certification. Because the certification is for the calibration distribution that may deviate from the future operation, we further combine the nominal certificate with physically interpretable sample-space adversarial attacks, a concept widely used in AI to investigate the fragility of AI models. Case studies on grid-edge flexibility coordination with 1{,}000-agent AI models (independent parameters) verify the finite-sample safety guarantee and the value of integrating adversarial attacks into a rolling-window training-certification-deployment flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为电网边缘 AI 控制器提出有限样本概率安全认证框架：把完整的输入-AI-电网评估流程压缩成二值不安全结果，用精确二项推断给出不安全概率的最紧单侧上界证书，并配合运营方定义的接受/拒绝部署判据。证书只对校准分布成立，作者再叠加物理可解释的样本空间对抗攻击，并在 1,000 智能体模型上验证其在滚动窗口训练-认证-部署流程中的价值。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习与模仿学习能实时协调大规模柔性电网边缘设备、减少电网升级需求，但运营方缺少独立且严格的方法判定某个 AI 系统是否安全到可以部署。
Method: 把输入-AI-电网评估全流程归约为运营方安全规范下的二值不安全结果，用精确二项推断 (exact binomial inference) 在留出校准场景上构造最紧单侧上界证书与控制错误安全认证概率的接受/拒绝判据；再将名义证书与物理可解释的样本空间对抗攻击 (sample-space adversarial attacks) 结合，嵌入滚动窗口的训练-认证-部署流程。
Result: 在含 1,000 个智能体的电网边缘灵活性协调 AI 模型（独立参数）案例研究中，验证了有限样本安全保证，并验证了把对抗攻击纳入滚动窗口训练-认证-部署流程的价值。
Conclusion: 对黑盒 AI 电网控制，二值化加精确二项推断可给出可控错误率的有限样本安全证书，但因证书只覆盖校准分布，需用物理可解释的对抗攻击补上分布偏移风险。

papers.title: How Sensitive Are LLM Leaderboard Claims to Hidden Model Selection?
papers.abstract_en: LLM leaderboard gains can reflect selection among privately evaluated model variants, yet neither the number of variants nor their dependence is public. We ask how many hidden variants a published margin can support while retaining statistical evidence of a provider's advantage over a fixed comparator. For a fixed candidate family under a Gaussian margin model, we derive a sensitivity curve that reports this maximum count as a function of a lower bound on within-family correlation. The relevant correlation must match the score used for ranking and the sampling model: in a controlled family, pooled item correlation is 0.90, whereas composite-score correlation is 0.46 under item resampling and 0.92 when MMLU subjects are resampled. An item-based audit of 394 adjacent-rank claims on the Open LLM Leaderboard finds that 391 lack statistical support even before accounting for selection. Among claims that pass the uncorrected test, certification can depend on assumptions about the hidden family's correlation. The resulting curves make these assumptions explicit without estimating the unobserved search size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯边际模型下推导一条敏感性曲线，把 LLM 排行榜上一个已公布领先幅度所能支撑的隐藏变体最大数量，表示为族内相关系数下界的函数。用该曲线对 Open LLM Leaderboard 上 394 条相邻名次声明做基于题目的审计，发现 391 条在尚未计入选择效应之前就缺乏统计支撑。
Motivation: LLM 排行榜的领先幅度可能来自供应商在私有变体间的选择，而变体数量与依赖结构都不公开，导致已公布的边际无法判断是否真有统计证据支撑优势。
Method: 在固定候选族与高斯边际 (Gaussian margin) 模型下推导敏感性曲线，输出给定族内相关下界时可支撑的最大隐藏变体数；相关系数须与排序所用分数及采样模型一致，分别用题目重采样与 MMLU 学科重采样估计；再对 Open LLM Leaderboard 的相邻名次声明做 item-based audit。
Result: 受控族中 pooled item correlation 为 0.90，composite-score correlation 在题目重采样下为 0.46、在 MMLU 学科重采样下为 0.92；394 条相邻名次声明中 391 条在计入选择之前即缺乏统计支撑；通过未校正检验的声明，其认证与否取决于对隐藏族相关结构的假设。
Conclusion: 排行榜领先声明对隐藏模型选择高度敏感，敏感性曲线可在不估计未观测搜索规模的前提下把相关结构假设显式化。

papers.title: Confidence Falls Short: Asymmetric Certainty Gains from Optimization Hinder Multimodal Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning (MML) falls into the optimization dilemma due to the modality imbalance phenomenon, leading to suboptimal overall performance in practice. While many attempts primarily focus on balancing the optimization dynamics across modalities to address this issue, we identify a subtle yet critical flaw: optimization yields asymmetric gains in predictive certainty, with the strong modality more confident than the weak one, driving imbalanced modality contributions. In this paper, our analysis reveals that this flaw stems from unimodal characteristics rather than multimodal learning, and this confidence discrepancy can be corrected by positive cross-modal intervention. Based on this insight, we propose multimodal Max Confidence Regularization (MaxCR) to dynamically intervene in modality semantic confidence. Specifically, the semantic confidence of each modality is tracked using a nonlinear sparsity measure. We then design max suppression and max excitation based on this measure to regularize strong and weak modalities, respectively. They penalize and encourage the top-1 confidence, thereby constraining multimodal prediction. To this end, strong and weak modalities are expected to make calibrated confidence, thereby improving the overall performance. Empirical experiments on widely used datasets reveal the superiority of our method through comparison with various state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal learning baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态学习中优化带来的是各模态置信度的不对称增益：强模态比弱模态更自信，进而拉偏模态贡献。该置信度差异源自单模态特性而非多模态学习本身，可用正向跨模态干预纠正；据此提出 MaxCR，用非线性稀疏度量追踪各模态语义置信度，对强模态做 max suppression、弱模态做 max excitation，惩罚或鼓励 top-1 置信度以约束多模态预测，使两模态置信度校准并提升整体性能。
Motivation: 多模态学习受模态不平衡困扰，既有工作集中在平衡各模态的优化动态，但忽略了优化本身在预测置信度上产生不对称增益这一更细的缺陷，导致整体性能次优。
Method: 提出多模态 Max Confidence Regularization (MaxCR)：用非线性稀疏度量追踪每个模态的语义置信度，据此设计 max suppression 与 max excitation 分别正则强模态与弱模态，惩罚或鼓励 top-1 置信度，从而约束多模态预测并让强弱模态的置信度趋于校准。
Result: 在广泛使用的多模态数据集上与多种 SOTA 多模态学习基线比较，实验显示该方法具有优势；摘要未给出具体数据集名称或数值指标。
Conclusion: 模态不平衡的根源之一是优化造成的置信度不对称，而这一差异来自单模态特性，可通过正向跨模态干预加以校正，从而提升多模态整体性能。
