papers.title: Rank-One Signal Recovery in Sparse Wishart Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study the high-dimensional recovery of a signal vector $\mathbf{x}$ in the presence of sparse Wishart-like noise. We define an $N \times N$ matrix $A = J+(θ/N)\mathbf{xx}^{\top}$, where $\mathbf{xx}^{\top}$ is the rank-one deformation of the random noise matrix $J$. We consider a Wishart-like matrix $J={X}^{\top} X$, where $X$ is a sparse $M \times N$ random matrix with entries $X_{ij} = c_{ij}W_{ij}$, with $c_{ij}$ regulating the density of non-zero elements, and $W_{ij}$ the bond weights. Using the replica method, we compute analytically the top eigenpair statistics of $A$, and their dependence on the signal strength $θ$, the rectangularity ratio $α=\sqrt{M/N}$, and the average connectivity of the noise. The spectral observables are expressed in terms of a system of Recursive Distributional Equations, which are efficiently solved via a Population Dynamics algorithm. They allow us to compute the average largest eigenvalue $\langleλ_1\rangle_{A}$, the average top eigenvector component density, and the average overlap between the top eigenvector of $A$ and $\mathbf{x}$. We identify a critical threshold $θ_{\mathrm{crit}}$--depending on the average connectivity of the noise--that marks a BBP-like phase transition: below this value, $\langleλ_1\rangle_{A}$ is unaffected by the signal, and the overlap vanishes. Thus, the signal is not recoverable from the top eigenvector of $A$. For $θ>θ_{\mathrm{crit}}$, the signal-related outlier eigenvalue becomes $\langleλ_1\rangle_{A}$ and the overlap is nonzero, allowing for recovery of the signal. The results are in excellent agreement with numerical diagonalisation. We show that in the dense limit, the recovery threshold and eigen-statistics converge to the results predicted by the classical BBP transition for additive rank-one deformations of dense Wishart matrices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏 Wishart 噪声 J=XᵀX 上加秩一形变 A=J+(θ/N)xxᵀ，用 replica 方法加 Population Dynamics 求解 RDE，解析给出最大特征值、顶部特征向量分量密度与和信号 x 的重叠。存在依赖噪声平均连通度的临界阈值 θ_crit：θ<θ_crit 时 ⟨λ₁⟩ 不受信号影响且重叠为零、信号不可恢复，θ>θ_crit 时信号离群特征值成为 ⟨λ₁⟩ 且重叠非零、可从顶部特征向量恢复信号；稠密极限收敛到经典 BBP 阈值。
Motivation: 稀疏化会改变随机矩阵的谱与 BBP 相变位置，稠密 Wishart 的经典恢复阈值不再适用，需要在噪声连通度可调的稀疏体制下给出信号可否从顶部特征向量恢复的判定条件。
Method: 构造 A=J+(θ/N)xxᵀ，其中 J=XᵀX、X 为稀疏 M×N 矩阵（X_ij=c_ij W_ij，c_ij 控制非零密度）；用 replica method 解析计算 A 的顶部特征对统计量，谱观测量表达为一组 Recursive Distributional Equations (RDE)，用 Population Dynamics 算法高效求解，参数为信号强度 θ、长宽比 α=√(M/N) 与噪声平均连通度。
Result: 解析给出 ⟨λ₁⟩_A、顶部特征向量平均分量密度、以及顶部特征向量与 x 的平均重叠随 θ、α 和噪声连通度的变化；识别出依赖平均连通度的 θ_crit，θ<θ_crit 时 ⟨λ₁⟩ 不受信号影响且重叠为零，θ>θ_crit 时重叠非零；结果与数值对角化 (numerical diagonalisation) 吻合良好，稠密极限下阈值与谱统计收敛到稠密 Wishart 秩一形变的经典 BBP 结果。
Conclusion: 稀疏 Wishart 噪声中的信号恢复由一个随噪声连通度移动的 BBP 型相变阈值控制：只有 θ 超过 θ_crit 才能从顶部特征向量恢复信号，稠密情形是其特例。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning for 2D Representations with 3D Spatial Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Standard contrastive learning frameworks are mainly designed from a semantic perspective, yet learning 2D visual representations that preserve 3D spatial structure is also important for scene understanding. In this work, we propose Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL), a simple auxiliary objective that injects 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning. Our key idea is to use depth to convert local 3D proximity into contrastive similarity: pixels that are closer in 3D space are encouraged to have more similar representations than pixels that are farther apart. Instead of relying on absolute depth values, DGCL formulates supervision through relative 3D distance comparisons among randomly sampled pixels, making the objective invariant to depth scale, efficient to compute, and easy to integrate into existing contrastive frameworks. Experiments across different datasets and models show that DGCL consistently improves 2D representation learning and benefits semantic downstream tasks by stronger spatial and geometric understanding. The code is available on https://github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL)，用深度把局部 3D 邻近关系转成对比相似度：3D 中更近的像素对被拉近，更远的被推远。监督用随机采样像素间的相对 3D 距离比较而非绝对深度值，因此对深度尺度不变、计算便宜，可直接嵌入现有对比学习框架；跨数据集与模型的实验显示 2D 表征一致改善并提升语义下游任务。
Motivation: 标准对比学习只从语义视角设计正负对，学到的 2D 表征不保真 3D 空间结构，场景理解所需的几何与空间关系因此缺失。
Method: DGCL 作为辅助目标加到现有对比框架上：由深度图计算随机采样像素对的相对 3D 距离比较，把「更近」编码为相似度约束，替代绝对深度回归，使目标对深度尺度不变且开销低。
Result: 跨不同数据集与模型的实验中，DGCL 一致改善 2D 表征学习，并因更强的空间与几何理解使语义下游任务受益；代码发布于 github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL。
Conclusion: 把 3D 邻近关系以相对距离比较的形式注入对比目标，可以在不引入绝对深度尺度的前提下让 2D 表征获得 3D 空间感知。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A comparative assessment of global building and settlement datasets across geographic and settlement contexts
papers.abstract_en: Global building and settlement datasets increasingly support population mapping, exposure assessment, urban monitoring, and other analyses of the built environment, yet comparative evidence remains fragmented across products, geographic regions, reference datasets, spatial scales, and evaluation methods. We benchmark seven global or near-global products, including Overture Maps, Global Building Atlas, 3D-GloBFP, Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (OBT), Microsoft TEMPO, GHSL, and WSF Tracker, against harmonized reference footprints across 135 study areas. The evaluation combines complementary measures of detection, geometric agreement, and aggregate quantity accuracy, together with stratified analyses of settlement characteristics and diagnostic experiments on error size and temporal alignment. Overture achieved the highest median city-level vector F1 (0.786). Raster rankings were resolution-dependent: OBT achieved the highest median F1 at 10m (0.642), whereas WSF Tracker led at 100m (0.862). However, WSF Tracker substantially overestimated built-up area, emphasizing that when using raster products, it is important for the user to understand whether the raster identifies only buildings or includes additional impervious surfaces. Raster accuracy increased consistently with building density (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.58-0.75), while small candidate buildings were disproportionately associated with false positives in the vector products. Temporally aligning WSF Tracker with reference imagery increased mean F1 by 0.060 (median +0.037), indicating that the reported accuracies are conservative in rapidly growing areas. The study establishes a reproducible benchmark for comparing heterogeneous global urban and settlement layer datasets across geographic and settlement contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 7 个全球建筑与聚落数据集（Overture Maps、Global Building Atlas、3D-GloBFP、Google OBT、Microsoft TEMPO、GHSL、WSF Tracker）在 135 个研究区做统一基准：Overture 矢量城市级 F1 中位数最高 0.786，栅格排名随分辨率反转（10m 时 OBT 0.642 最高，100m 时 WSF Tracker 0.862 最高但显著高估建成区面积）。栅格精度随建筑密度单调上升（Spearman rho = 0.58–0.75），把 WSF Tracker 与参考影像做时间对齐后平均 F1 提升 0.060。
Motivation: 全球建筑与聚落产品在产品、地区、参考数据、空间尺度与评价方法上的对比证据零散，用户难以判断哪个产品适合人口制图、暴露评估与城市监测。
Method: 以统一参考足迹为基准，在 135 个研究区评测 7 个全球或近全球产品，组合检测、几何一致性与总量精度三类指标，并按聚落特征分层，另做误差尺寸与时间对齐的诊断实验。
Result: Overture 城市级矢量 F1 中位数 0.786 最高；栅格 10m 分辨率 OBT 中位 F1 0.642 最高，100m 时 WSF Tracker 0.862 最高但大幅高估建成区面积；栅格精度随建筑密度升高（Spearman rho = 0.58–0.75）；矢量产品中偏小的候选建筑与假阳性高度相关；WSF Tracker 与参考影像时间对齐后平均 F1 +0.060（中位 +0.037）。
Conclusion: 栅格产品排名取决于分辨率，且用户须先确认栅格只含建筑还是包含其他不透水面；快速增长区报告的精度偏保守，时间对齐会抬高分数。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: EvEMTBench: An Open Benchmark for Machine Learning in Power System Protection
papers.abstract_en: Studies of machine-learning-based power system protection are difficult to compare because task definitions, measurement access, data partitions, metrics, and generalization conditions often differ. EvEMTBench addresses this gap with an open, executable, and versioned benchmark that fixes these evaluation choices while leaving model design open. Across four grids spanning 20-345 kV, it defines 12 protection and event-analysis functions instantiated as 24 scored tasks and supports structured evaluation across observability conditions, predefined distribution shifts, and zero-shot and fine-tuned cross-grid transfer. Committed partitions, leakage controls, and reproducible reporting provide a common basis for comparing future methods. A reference evaluation spanning trivial, conventional, feature-based, and deep-learning baselines shows that wider observability is not uniformly beneficial, shifted conditions can reveal failures not apparent in-distribution, and cross-grid transfer is substantially stronger for fault detection than for fault localization. Protection-relevant diagnostics identify failure modes not apparent from primary metrics alone. EvEMTBench therefore makes generalization in machine-learning-based protection an explicit and reproducible evaluation problem.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary information included. Code: https://github.com/EvEMTBench/evemtbench-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvEMTBench 把电力系统保护的机器学习评测固定成开放、可执行、带版本的基准：4 个 20–345 kV 电网、12 个保护与事件分析功能拆成 24 个计分任务，覆盖可观测性条件、预定义分布偏移与零样本/微调跨电网迁移。参考评测显示更宽可观测性并非一律有益，分布偏移会暴露分布内看不出的失效，故障检测的跨电网迁移远强于故障定位。
Motivation: 现有 ML 保护研究在任务定义、量测接入、数据划分、指标和泛化条件上各不相同，结果无法横向比较。
Method: 发布开放可执行、带版本的基准，固定评测选择而开放模型设计；在 4 个 20–345 kV 电网上定义 12 个保护与事件分析功能、24 个计分任务，提供提交的数据划分、防泄漏控制与可复现报告，并支持跨可观测性、预定义分布偏移、零样本与微调跨电网迁移的结构化评测；参考评测覆盖 trivial、常规、特征工程与深度学习四类基线。
Result: 参考评测发现：更宽的可观测性并不普遍提升性能；预定义分布偏移下会暴露分布内评测看不出的失效；故障检测的跨电网迁移显著强于故障定位；保护相关诊断能识别仅看主指标看不出的失效模式。
Conclusion: ML 保护的泛化应当被当作显式、可复现的评测问题，用统一划分与诊断指标而非单一主指标来比较方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RL Starts before RL: On Policy Distillation for Better Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning, but its performance depends on the policy from which training begins. We study on-policy distillation (OPD) as a preparation stage for RL and ask whether its benefits extend beyond improvements in the distilled model's initial accuracy. Under shared RL settings, students initialized with OPD reach higher final performance than those trained with direct RL or supervised fine-tuning followed by RL. This advantage can emerge even when OPD produces little immediate improvement in accuracy. Pre-RL Pass@k does not fully explain the benefit: similar or even higher values do not necessarily lead to better performance after RL. Behavioral analyses point to alignment with the teacher's distribution beyond top-1 agreement as a possible explanation. Such alignment may favor higher-quality reasoning paths while retaining alternatives that RL can further refine using outcome feedback. We further examine how trajectory sources and divergence objectives affect the value of distillation for subsequent RL. Standard reverse-KL OPD performs better before RL, but forward-KL OPD overtakes it afterward; with teacher-generated distillation trajectories, reverse KL remains ahead at both stages. These findings suggest that the preferred distillation objective depends on both the trajectory source and the training that follows. Our results support evaluating OPD as preparation for RL and selecting distillation choices by the performance achieved after subsequent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 on-policy distillation (OPD) 当作 RL 的前置准备阶段，在共享 RL 设置下，OPD 初始化的学生最终性能高于直接 RL 与 SFT+RL；即使 OPD 几乎不提升初始准确率，优势仍会出现。前向 KL 与反向 KL 的优劣随阶段翻转：RL 前反向 KL 更好，RL 后前向 KL 反超，但改用 teacher 生成的蒸馏轨迹后反向 KL 两阶段都领先。作者主张按后续训练后的表现来挑选蒸馏目标与轨迹来源。
Motivation: RL 训练的最终表现取决于起始策略，但 on-policy distillation 的收益是否只体现在蒸馏模型的初始准确率上并不清楚，Pre-RL Pass@k 也解释不完全。
Method: 把 OPD 作为 RL 之前的准备阶段，与直接 RL、SFT 后接 RL 在共享 RL 设置下对比；比较 reverse-KL 与 forward-KL 两种散度目标，并考察蒸馏轨迹来源（含 teacher 生成轨迹）；辅以行为分析，考察与 teacher 分布的对齐是否超出 top-1 一致。
Result: OPD 初始化的学生最终性能高于直接 RL 和 SFT+RL，且该优势可在 OPD 几乎不提升准确率时出现；相似甚至更高的 Pre-RL Pass@k 并不必然带来 RL 后更好的表现。RL 前 reverse-KL OPD 更好、RL 后 forward-KL OPD 反超；用 teacher 生成的蒸馏轨迹时 reverse KL 在两阶段都领先。
Conclusion: OPD 的价值应按后续 RL 训练后的表现来评估，蒸馏目标的取舍取决于轨迹来源与后续训练方式，Pre-RL Pass@k 不足以预测 RL 后的结果。

papers.title: "We'll Fix It Later": Education, AI, and the Deferral of Privacy in EdTech
papers.abstract_en: Educational technology (EdTech) platforms collect highly sensitive student data, including behavioral logs, disability records, and academic histories. However, privacy considerations are often postponed rather than treated as a foundational design requirement. We present a mixed-methods study combining 12 semi-structured interviews with EdTech professionals and a privacy policy audit of 48 platforms coded across five dimensions, with strong inter-rater reliability (mean Cohen's Kappa = 0.781). Our interviews reveal a recurring organizational pattern in which privacy is recognized as important but deferred across the product lifecycle as organizations prioritize product functionality, growth, funding, and immediate educational outcomes. Responsibility is often delegated to cloud providers, policy documents, or downstream institutions, while limited privacy-related feedback gives organizations little pressure to change these practices. The policy analysis reflects these patterns: platforms describe what data they collect relatively well but provide substantially less information about how that data is subsequently governed. Thirty-three percent make no meaningful Artificial Intelligence (AI) disclosure despite visible AI features, and 73% provide only generic accountability and breach-response language. K-12 platforms perform better on children's consent where regulation creates explicit requirements, but this advantage does not extend to AI governance or accountability. These findings suggest that meaningful improvement requires enforceable institutional and regulatory mechanisms rather than voluntary privacy commitments alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 48 个 EdTech 平台的隐私政策审计加 12 位从业者访谈显示：平台写清收集什么数据，却几乎不写后续如何治理；33% 有可见 AI 功能却无任何有意义的 AI 披露，73% 只有泛化的问责与 breach-response 套话。作者主张隐私改进必须靠可执行的机构与监管机制，而非自愿承诺。
Motivation: EdTech 收集行为日志、残障记录、学业历史等敏感学生数据，但隐私被当作可推迟事项而非设计前提，责任被外包给云厂商、政策文本或下游学校。
Method: 混合方法研究：12 位 EdTech 从业者半结构化访谈，加上对 48 个平台隐私政策的审计，按五个维度编码，评分者一致性 mean Cohen's Kappa = 0.781。
Result: 48 个平台中 33% 在有可见 AI 功能的情况下没有任何有意义的 AI 披露，73% 仅提供通用的问责与 breach-response 表述；K-12 平台在儿童同意上因监管明文要求表现更好，但该优势不延伸到 AI 治理与问责。
Conclusion: 隐私被组织在产品生命周期中层层推迟，仅靠自愿隐私承诺无法改善，需要可执行的机构与监管机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NPBoost: Neural Processes with Gradient-Boosted Fixed Effects
papers.abstract_en: Neural Processes (NPs) are model-based meta-learners that implicitly learn a stochastic process and adapt to a new task from a small context set. Most extensions of NPs focus on improving the neural network architecture. We instead develop an extension motivated by the shared hierarchical interpretation of meta-learning and mixed-effects models. Specifically, we introduce Neural Process Boosting (NPBoost), which decomposes structured response variability into tree-boosted fixed effects shared across tasks and NP random effects that capture stochastic task-to-task variation. We propose to train the two components jointly using a boosting algorithm in which an NP learns residual task-specific structure and a tree ensemble estimates common patterns across tasks. Across synthetic and real-world tabular meta-learning problems, this decomposition improves over a standard NP when the shared structure contains discontinuities or other irregular patterns that boosted trees can represent effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NPBoost 把结构化响应变异拆成两部分：梯度提升树拟合跨任务共享的固定效应，Neural Process 拟合残余的任务随机效应，两者用 boosting 式算法联合训练。在合成与真实表格型 meta-learning 问题上，当共享结构含不连续等树模型擅长表示的不规则模式时，该分解优于标准 Neural Process。
Motivation: Neural Process 扩展多集中在改网络架构，而 meta-learning 与混合效应模型共享的层级解释尚未被利用；共享结构中的不连续、不规则模式是标准 NP 难以有效表示的缺口。
Method: 提出 Neural Process Boosting (NPBoost)：树集成 (tree ensemble) 用梯度提升估计跨任务共享的固定效应，NP 学习残余的任务特异随机结构，两组件按 boosting 算法联合训练。
Result: 在合成与真实世界的表格型 meta-learning 问题上，当共享结构含不连续或其他树提升可有效表示的不规则模式时，该分解优于标准 Neural Process。
Conclusion: 把 NP 的随机效应与树提升的固定效应按混合效应视角分解并联合训练，可在共享结构不规则时超过标准 NP。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Attention Head Analysis via Gradient-Based Attribution in Context-Aware Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We empirically show the alignment of our method with the effects of increasing the attention scores of token-to-token relations on three models and two language directions, ensuring the robustness of our method. Our analysis reveals the presence of the "general-purpose" attention heads that improve the model's performance when attending to different relations. We find that the average attention a head assigns to a relation does not necessarily relate to the model's performance, which suggests that the models developed redundancies during training in terms of the head functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于梯度的注意力头归因方法：把 Token-level Max-Margin loss 反传到 attention map 上，对 LLM 注意力头做大规模因果分析。在 Context-aware Machine Translation 的消歧任务上覆盖 50 个现象、4 个模型、4 个语向，归因结果与提高 token-to-token 注意力分数的效果在 3 个模型、2 个语向上一致；头对某关系的平均注意力与模型表现并不必然相关，说明训练中形成了冗余的头功能。
Motivation: 注意力头数量大、逐头干预成本高，缺少能扩展到 LLM 的因果归因手段来判断哪些头真正影响上下文相关机器翻译中的消歧表现。
Method: 将 Token-level Max-Margin loss 反向传播到 attention map，得到 token-to-token 关系的梯度归因分数，据此对注意力头做因果分析；在 Context-aware Machine Translation 消歧任务上评估，覆盖 50 个现象、4 个模型、4 个语向，并用提高注意力分数的干预验证归因一致性。
Result: 方法与提高 token-to-token 注意力分数的效应在 3 个模型、2 个语向上对齐；分析覆盖 50 个消歧现象、4 个模型、4 个语向；发现存在对不同关系都提升表现的 general-purpose attention heads，且头的平均注意力与模型表现无必然关联。
Conclusion: 梯度归因可作为 LLM 注意力头的大规模因果分析工具；头功能在训练中出现冗余，平均注意力不能作为头重要性的代理指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic and Geometry Aware Neural Surrogate of Scrape Off Layer Plasma Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Fast surrogates for tokamak boundary-plasma simulation are typically deterministic regressors mapping a global operating point to a flattened vector of cell values. Near the divertor detachment transition the steady state is not reliably single-valued. A point estimate must average over qualitatively different plasma states, and it arrives with no statement of confidence. Moreover, the flattened vector representation discards the geometric structure of the SOLPS-ITER mesh. This work addresses both problems. We unroll the curvilinear mesh into three fixed-size image tensors whose layout preserves cell adjacency and inverts exactly, letting a convolutional network act on the geometry without loss of information. A conditional flow matching model, well suited to highly sensitive systems, is then trained on this representation. The result is an efficient, scalable surrogate that captures multiple plausible outcomes even at sensitive operating points. Along a gas-puff scan, the predictive distribution splits into a hot and a cold mode across an early regime transition. A further check on synthetic data with an injected bifurcation of known size confirms the model recovers both branches rather than their average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对托卡马克边界等离子体 SOLPS-ITER 仿真代理，指出确定性回归器在偏滤器脱附转变附近会把多稳态平均成一个点估计且无置信度，同时展平向量丢失网格几何。做法是把曲线网格无损展开为三张固定尺寸图像张量（保持相邻关系且可精确逆变换），再在其上训练条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 模型。沿 gas-puff 扫描，预测分布在早期 regime 转变处裂成热、冷两个模态；在注入已知大小分岔的合成数据上，模型恢复两支而非其均值。
Motivation: 偏滤器脱附转变附近稳态不再单值，确定性点估计只能对性质不同的等离子体状态取平均且不给置信度；展平向量还丢掉 SOLPS-ITER 网格的几何结构。
Method: 把曲线网格展开成三张固定尺寸图像张量，布局保持单元邻接且可精确求逆，使卷积网络能无损处理几何；在此表示上训练面向高敏感系统的 conditional flow matching 模型，输出条件概率分布而非点估计。
Result: 沿 gas-puff 扫描，预测分布跨早期 regime 转变分裂为热、冷两个模态；在注入已知大小分岔的合成数据检验中，模型恢复两个分支而非两者的平均。
Conclusion: 几何保持的图像表示加条件生成式流，可在敏感运行点给出多模态、带置信度的边界等离子体代理，替代对多稳态取平均的确定性回归。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Field-of-View Extension in Dental Cone-Beam CT via Implicit Neural Representations and Diffusion Model-Based Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Dental cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) systems often employ detector configurations that provide a truncated field of view (FOV) that only captures a small part of the patient's anatomy. In this work, we aim to reconstruct an extended FOV using projections of truncated FOV scans. To this end, we propose a three-stage framework that consists of (1) an implicit neural representation (INR) for estimating missing parts of the truncated projection data, (2) an iterative reconstruction for generating a secondary volumetric image with improved anatomical consistency and (3) a fast diffusion model for image enhancement. The proposed approach combines the strengths of continuous representations, physics-based reconstruction and generative refinement within a unified pipeline for truncated CBCT imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively reduces truncation artifacts, improves the reconstruction of structures extending beyond the original FOV and produces images with enhanced quality. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/SusanneSchaub/CBCT-FOV-Extension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对牙科 CBCT 探测器视野截断，提出三阶段框架：用 implicit neural representation (INR) 补全截断投影数据，再做迭代重建得到解剖一致性更好的体积图，最后用快速 diffusion model 做图像增强，从而在截断扫描上重建扩展 FOV。实验显示该方法有效降低截断伪影、改善超出原 FOV 结构的重建并提升图像质量，代码已开源。
Motivation: 牙科 CBCT 常用截断 FOV 探测器配置，只覆盖患者解剖的一小部分，截断伪影限制了对超出原视野结构的重建。
Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) INR 估计截断投影数据的缺失部分；(2) 迭代重建生成解剖一致性更好的次级体积图像；(3) 快速 diffusion model 做图像增强，把连续表示、物理重建与生成式细化统一到截断 CBCT 流程中。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法有效减少截断伪影、改善超出原 FOV 结构的重建，并产出图像质量更优的结果；代码发布于 GitHub 仓库 CBCT-FOV-Extension。
Conclusion: 把 INR 补全投影、物理迭代重建与 diffusion 细化串成一条流水线，可以在不扩大探测器的前提下从截断 CBCT 扫描恢复扩展视野。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Advances in generative modeling have recently been extensively employed in robotics for policy learning. In particular, Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) trained with expert demonstrations has been shown to outperform existing methods on robot manipulation benchmarks. While prior work has mainly focused on single-task settings, we study the problem from a multi-task perspective, as training independent models for each task is computationally expensive. Multi-Task policy learning comes with its own set of challenges, as naively training on a concatenated dataset of demonstrations would either require increased model capacity to accommodate the added complexity or result in drops in performance. We propose to distill knowledge from single-task CFM experts into a shared multi-task policy by transferring their learned velocity fields. We combine this distillation signal with the original CFM objective to retain fidelity to the demonstrations. Experiments on RLBench show that our approach improves multi-task policy performance over naive training while maintaining a fixed model size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把单任务 Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) 专家学到的速度场蒸馏进一个共享的多任务策略，并与原始 CFM 目标结合以保持对演示数据的保真。在 RLBench 上，该方法在固定模型容量下比直接在拼接数据集上训练的多任务策略性能更好。
Motivation: 机器人操作策略学习中，为每个任务各训一个模型计算代价高，而把演示拼接后直接训练多任务策略要么需要更大模型容量、要么性能下降。
Method: 从单任务 CFM 专家蒸馏知识到共享多任务策略，迁移其学到的速度场作为蒸馏信号，并与原始 CFM 训练目标结合，从而在固定模型规模下保留对专家演示的保真度。
Result: 在 RLBench 多任务操作基准上，该蒸馏方法在固定模型大小的前提下，性能优于在拼接演示数据上直接训练的 naive 多任务基线。
Conclusion: 通过速度场蒸馏而非扩大模型容量，可以在单一共享策略中容纳多任务复杂度，避免独立单任务模型的重复训练开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fed-ReMasker: Federated Tabular Imputation under Feature-Level Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Multi-center clinical studies and biomedical research collaborations increasingly seek to utilize data across centers to build models that generalize beyond any single center. This creates two distinct challenges: data protection regulations may restrict the sharing of raw patient data across institutions, while centers may collect only partially overlapping sets of features under different protocols. Federated learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing raw data. However, existing federated imputation methods rarely evaluate feature-level missingness, in which entire features are unobserved at some centers. To address this setting, we adapt the ReMasker masked autoencoder to federated learning (Fed-ReMasker), enabling centers to impute features never observed locally by leveraging knowledge learned across collaborating centers. We evaluate Fed-ReMasker in a benchmark spanning synthetic datasets with linear and nonlinear relationships and real-world tabular datasets, including clinical data. The benchmark varies the number of centers, the missingness ratios, and client heterogeneity. Fed-ReMasker achieves the lowest imputation error in 93.2% of value-level and 96.7% of feature-level scenarios in the homogeneous benchmark. It also remains robust to client heterogeneity using simple federated averaging, outperforming all baselines in all 36 value-level scenarios and each baseline in at least 35 of 36 feature-level scenarios, and comes within 3.0% on average of a centralized model trained on the pooled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fed-ReMasker 把 ReMasker 掩码自编码器改造为联邦版本，让各中心在整列特征本地从未观测的情况下，靠跨中心协作知识补全该特征。在含合成与真实临床表格数据的基准上，它在同质设置中 93.2% 的值级缺失与 96.7% 的特征级缺失场景取得最低插补误差，且在客户端异质时用简单联邦平均仍全面领先基线，平均只比集中式训练差 3.0%。
Motivation: 多中心临床研究受数据保护法规限制不能共享原始患者数据，且各中心按不同协议只采集部分重叠的特征集；现有联邦插补方法很少评估整列特征在某些中心完全缺失的 feature-level missingness。
Method: 将 ReMasker 掩码自编码器适配到联邦学习框架（Fed-ReMasker），各中心不外发原始数据，通过跨中心协作学习补全本地从未观测的特征；评测基准涵盖线性与非线性关系的合成数据集及含临床数据的真实表格数据集，并变化中心数量、缺失率与客户端异质性。
Result: 同质基准中，Fed-ReMasker 在 93.2% 的值级场景与 96.7% 的特征级场景取得最低插补误差；面对客户端异质性，用简单联邦平均在全部 36 个值级场景胜过所有基线，在每个基线上至少赢下 36 个特征级场景中的 35 个；整体与在合并数据上训练的集中式模型平均只差 3.0%。
Conclusion: 在不共享原始数据的前提下，联邦化的掩码自编码器足以补全本地从未观测的整列特征，性能接近集中式训练，且对客户端异质性稳健。

papers.title: Visual Tripwires: Anticipating Failure in Deep Vision Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep vision systems remain vulnerable to corruption, occlusion, and distribution shift despite strong benchmark performance. Existing reliability methods typically evaluate uncertainty at individual time steps and do not explicitly model how a system progresses toward failure. We introduce Visual Tripwires, a predictive reliability framework that uses temporal instability in model behaviour to anticipate impending failure. Our central hypothesis is that predictive degradation develops progressively through measurable changes in latent representations, prediction trajectories, and attention structure. Visual Tripwires captures these changes using representation drift, prediction oscillation, trajectory curvature, and attention entropy. A lightweight tripwire predictor aggregates these signals over a temporal window to estimate the probability of failure within a future prediction horizon. Experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and progressive perturbation settings show that the proposed instability signals emerge before predictive degradation and provide earlier and more accurate failure warnings than conventional uncertainty estimation methods. These results demonstrate that temporal instability contains useful information about future model reliability and provides a practical basis for early warning in deep vision systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Visual Tripwires 用模型行为的时间不稳定性提前预警深度视觉系统的失效：以 representation drift、prediction oscillation、trajectory curvature、attention entropy 四类信号为特征，轻量预测器在时间窗上聚合后估计未来预测时域内失效概率。跨多个数据集、架构与渐进扰动设置的实验显示，这些不稳定信号先于预测性能退化出现，比常规不确定性估计方法给出更早、更准的失效预警。
Motivation: 深度视觉系统基准表现强但对 corruption、occlusion 与 distribution shift 仍脆弱；现有可靠性方法只在单时间步评估不确定性，不显式建模系统如何一步步走向失效。
Method: 从 latent representation、prediction trajectory 与 attention 结构中提取 representation drift、prediction oscillation、trajectory curvature、attention entropy 四种时间不稳定信号，由轻量 tripwire predictor 在时间窗上聚合成未来时域内失效概率。
Result: 在多个数据集、多种架构与 progressive perturbation 设置下，不稳定信号在预测退化之前出现，且比常规不确定性估计方法给出更早、更准确的失效预警。
Conclusion: 时间不稳定性包含关于未来模型可靠性的有用信息，可作为深度视觉系统早期预警的实用依据。

papers.title: MotionSpec: Spectral Trajectory Supervision for Motion-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity visual synthesis, yet realistic motion remains challenging. Generated videos may exhibit temporal discontinuities, inconsistent action progression, and structural distortions during complex movements. Even when individual frames appear realistic, the underlying motion may evolve in inconsistent or implausible ways. Standard generative objectives provide limited motion-specific supervision, leaving motion evolution insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we propose MotionSpec, a motion supervision framework centered on Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC). STC constructs dense anchor-relative motion trajectories and transforms them into motion spectral volumes via a temporal Fourier transform. By aligning the spectral amplitude and phase of predicted and target trajectories, STC constrains both motion strength across temporal frequencies and the temporal organization of motion. To complement this trajectory-level supervision, we introduce Local Flow Consistency (LFC), which aligns consecutive-frame optical flow between predicted and target videos to stabilize local motion transitions. Experiments demonstrate that MotionSpec consistently improves motion consistency, temporal coherence, and plausibility while preserving visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionSpec 用频谱轨迹一致性 (Spectral Trajectory Consistency, STC) 给文本到视频生成加运动监督：把锚点相对运动轨迹经时间 Fourier 变换转成运动谱体，对齐预测与目标轨迹的幅度和相位，同时约束各时间频率上的运动强度与运动的时间组织；再用局部光流一致性 (Local Flow Consistency, LFC) 对齐相邻帧光流以稳定局部运动过渡。实验显示该框架在保持视觉保真度的同时持续改善运动一致性、时间连贯性与运动合理性。
Motivation: 文本到视频生成中单帧虽真实，但运动演化可能不连贯或不合理：动作推进不一致、复杂运动出现结构畸变，而标准生成目标缺少针对运动的专门监督，运动演化约束不足。
Method: STC 模块构造密集的锚点相对运动轨迹，经时间 Fourier 变换转为运动谱体，对齐预测与目标轨迹的频谱幅度与相位；LFC 模块对齐预测视频与目标视频的相邻帧光流，稳定局部运动过渡；两者构成轨迹级加局部光流的运动监督框架。
Result: 实验表明 MotionSpec 在运动一致性、时间连贯性和运动合理性上持续改善，同时保持视觉保真度；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把频谱域的轨迹监督与局部光流对齐结合，可以在不牺牲画质的前提下约束文本到视频生成中的运动演化。

papers.title: Can LLMs Catch a Rigged Backtest? A Clean-Control Calibration Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0\% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8\% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5\% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8\% (95\% CI 11.7--34.3) to 0.0\% (0.0--7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文把回测审计重构为校准问题，构建 96 组配对样本：每个有缺陷的回测都配一个只改一处方法学细节、其余策略/日期/代码风格/标签/报告框架全同的 clean control。DeepSeek 审计器在 1440 次缓存审计中 closed 与 clean-aware 代码召回率达 100.0%，但开放 prompt 把 93.8% 的干净代码对照误报；加入 clean-aware 警告后代码误报率从 20.8%（95% CI 11.7–34.3）降到 0.0%（0.0–7.4）且召回不变。
Motivation: 回测审计里高缺陷召回率本身无意义：模型若把匹配的干净策略也大量误报，排名会失真。仅用报告召回率会把四个模型中的三个排成同一名次，无法区分校准质量。
Method: 构建 96 项配对基准，每条缺陷样本配一条固定策略、日期、代码风格、标签与报告框架、仅改一处方法学细节的 clean control；用确定性打分器分别统计缺陷召回、clean-control 误报、证据定位与修复相关性，在四个文本端点上累计 1440 次缓存审计。
Result: 主审计器 DeepSeek 达到 100.0% closed 与 clean-aware 代码召回；开放 prompt 对干净代码对照误报 93.8%，clean-aware all-three 特异度为 87.5%。clean-aware 警告使 DeepSeek 代码误报率从 20.8%（95% CI 11.7–34.3）降至 0.0%（0.0–7.4），召回不变；同一 prompt 下 budget anchor 仍误报 38/48 个干净对照。只报召回率会把四个模型中的三个并列，报出 clean-control 率则拉开 79 分差距。
Conclusion: 回测审计的评价必须同时报 clean-control 误报率，单看召回率会掩盖校准差异；加入 clean-aware 警告可在不损失召回的前提下把代码误报压到 0。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovery of fully efficient fault indicators along a data-based diagnosis process
papers.abstract_en: The integration of model-based and data-driven paradigms provides a powerful framework for fault diagnosis by combining the interpretability of analytical redundancy relations, i.e., input-output relations that are used as diagnosis indicators in model-based diagnosis, with the adaptability of learning techniques. DT4X is a recent diagnosis algorithm that uses symbolic regression to generate multivariate relations leveraging some properties of analytical redundancy relations and uses them as split functions in a decision tree. However, its symbolic regression procedure optimizes only the separation between two selected classes at each node, often fragmenting the remaining classes and degrading both interpretability and diagnosis performance. This paper introduces DT4X+, an enhanced version of DT4X that modifies the construction of training sets and the symbolic-regression loss so that expressions separate the target classes while preserving the coherence of non-target classes. The resulting relations become fully consistent with ARR properties and lead to more informative splits, improved robustness, and better performance on dynamic-system datasets. Experiments conducted on several benchmark systems demonstrate the benefits of this enhanced formulation.
papers.comment: Submission accepted to IFAC WC 2026 (waiting for publication)
papers.journal_ref: 23rd IFAC World Congress (IFAC World Congress 2026), Aug 2026, Busan, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DT4X+ 改造 DT4X 的符号回归训练集构造与损失，使生成的多元关系在分离目标类的同时保持非目标类的一致性，从而得到完全符合解析冗余关系 (ARR) 性质的分裂表达式。在多个动态系统基准上的实验表明该改进带来信息量更大的分裂、更强的鲁棒性和更好的诊断性能。
Motivation: DT4X 的符号回归在每个节点只优化两类分离，常把其余类别切碎，同时损害可解释性与诊断性能。
Method: DT4X+ 修改训练集构造与符号回归损失，使表达式在分离目标类时保持非目标类的一致性；生成的多元关系作为决策树分裂函数，兼具 ARR 的可解释性与学习方法的适应性。
Result: 在多个基准动态系统数据集上的实验展示了该改进公式的收益：分裂表达式完全符合 ARR 性质，分裂信息量更大、鲁棒性更强、诊断性能更好。
Conclusion: 把非目标类一致性写进符号回归目标，可以让数据驱动的诊断指示器同时保住 ARR 的可解释结构与诊断精度。

papers.title: LAYERSCOPE: A Layerwise Characterization of Video and Multimodal Learned Representations
papers.abstract_en: We propose LAYERSCOPE, a label-free, layerwise framework that aims to characterize a model's learned representations in video and multimodal settings. Evaluating downstream performance using representations from final or intermediate layers typically requires large amounts of labeled data, repeated task-specific evaluations, and substantial computation. To address these limitations, LAYERSCOPE uses local, global, distributional, and correspondence-based geometric metrics to compare layerwise representation structure within and across models without requiring task-specific labels. We evaluate seven architecturally diverse models across video and multimodal classification, clustering, and text-to-video retrieval tasks from MVEB/MVEB+. We find that intermediate-layer representations can outperform final-layer and model-default outputs. We also find that no single geometric metric consistently predicts downstream performance, but note that distinct layerwise geometric signatures emerge across model families. LID shows task-dependent relationships with performance, while RankMe provides the strongest measure for classification and clustering, but is not a universal layer selector. We also find that pairing-aware metrics explain retrieval better than distributional distances alone. LAYERSCOPE therefore offers a framework for comparing representations across models and layers, enabling a more systematic evaluation in video and multimodal settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAYERSCOPE 提出免标签、逐层的表征刻画框架，用局部、全局、分布与对应关系四类几何指标比较视频与多模态模型各层表征结构。在 MVEB/MVEB+ 的分类、聚类与文本到视频检索任务上评测七个架构各异的模型，发现中间层表征可胜过最终层与模型默认输出，RankMe 对分类聚类预测最强但并非通用选层器。
Motivation: 用下游性能评估最终层或中间层表征需要大量标注数据、反复的任务特定评测和可观算力，缺少免标签的跨模型逐层比较手段。
Method: LAYERSCOPE 以 local、global、distributional、correspondence-based 几何指标逐层刻画表征结构，无需任务标签；在 MVEB/MVEB+ 的视频与多模态分类、聚类、文本到视频检索任务上评测七个架构多样的模型。

papers.title: Curriculum Learning with GNN-based Reinforcement Learning for Job Shop Scheduling
authors: Jayakrishnan K. Vasudevan (Rosenheim University of Applied Sciences)
Jonathan Hoss (Rosenheim University of Applied Sciences)
Noah Klarmann (Rosenheim University of Applied Sciences)
papers.abstract_en: The job shop scheduling problem is a challenging combinatorial optimization problem, and recent reinforcement learning approaches using graph neural networks have shown promise for learning scheduling policies directly from problem instances. However, training on large instances remains computationally expensive, and generalization across instance sizes remains challenging. This paper studies curriculum learning for graph neural network-based reinforcement learning in the job shop scheduling problem by comparing it with single-size training across three target sizes: 20 x 20, 25 x 25, and 30 x 30. In the curriculum setting, the policy is first trained on smaller instances and then progressively adapted to larger target sizes, allowing scheduling behavior learned in earlier stages to support learning on larger instances. Models are evaluated on unseen instances from 8 x 8 to 30 x 30 using the optimality gap, considering both generalization across all evaluation sizes and specialization on the target size. Results show that curriculum learning consistently reduces wall-clock training time, with larger benefits as the target size increases. The strongest advantage is observed at 30 x 30, where curriculum learning reduces the mean optimality gap across all evaluation sizes by approximately 8.1 percentage points, reduces the target-size mean optimality gap by approximately 8.6 percentage points, and saves approximately 50 hours of training time.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE 10th International Conference on Computational Systems and Information Technology for Sustainable Solutions (CSITSS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在作业车间调度 (job shop scheduling) 中，用 GNN 策略先在小实例上训练再渐进适配到大实例的课程学习 (curriculum learning)，相比单尺寸训练一致缩短训练墙钟时间，且目标尺寸越大收益越大。在 30×30 目标上，全评测尺寸平均 optimality gap 降低约 8.1 个百分点、目标尺寸降低约 8.6 个百分点，并节省约 50 小时训练时间。
Motivation: GNN+RL 直接从实例学调度策略已有进展，但在大实例上训练开销高，且跨实例尺寸的泛化仍然困难。
Method: 比较课程学习与单尺寸训练，覆盖 20×20、25×25、30×30 三个目标尺寸：课程设置下先在较小实例上训练策略，再渐进适配到更大目标尺寸；模型在 8×8 到 30×30 的未见实例上用 optimality gap 评测，分别考察跨全部评测尺寸的泛化与目标尺寸上的特化。
Result: 课程学习一致降低训练墙钟时间，且目标尺寸越大收益越大；30×30 目标上全评测尺寸平均 optimality gap 降低约 8.1 个百分点，目标尺寸平均 optimality gap 降低约 8.6 个百分点，节省约 50 小时训练时间。
Conclusion: 课程学习能把小实例上学到的调度行为迁移到更大实例，从而同时改善跨尺寸泛化、目标尺寸特化并压缩训练时间，收益随目标尺寸增大。

papers.title: ZoomDiff: A High-Fidelity Diffusion Model for Dual-Camera Smooth Zooming
papers.abstract_en: Digital zoom transitions between dual cameras often exhibit conspicuous discontinuities in geometric structure and chromatic consistency, degrading the user experience. While recent dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ) methods attempt to mitigate this by fine-tuning frame interpolation (FI) models on DCSZ data, they struggle with the large cross-view disparities and complex geometric transformations. Considering that the generative prior of diffusion models is suitable for addressing this problem, we explore their application to DCSZ. However, naively applying existing diffusion-based FI models still yields low-fidelity transitions due to insufficient conditional guidance, high-frequency information loss during VAE encoding, as well as inadequate temporal consistency. To address this, we propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model that leverages dual-camera inputs in both latent and pixel spaces for photo-realistic transitions. Specifically, we first strengthen dual-image conditional guidance during the multi-step denoising process to improve geometric consistency. Then we inject flow-aligned multi-scale features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder to recover high-frequency details, where flow-guided temporal consistency supervision are introduced to produce more smooth transitions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ZoomDiff outperforms state-of-the-art methods quantitatively and qualitatively. Project page: https://jiayi-hit.github.io/ZoomDiff.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZoomDiff 把双摄平滑变焦 (DCSZ) 从帧插值微调路线改到扩散模型上，在 latent 与 pixel 两个空间同时利用双摄输入：多步去噪中强化双图条件引导以稳住几何，向 VAE decoder 注入光流对齐的多尺度 encoder 特征以找回高频细节，并用光流引导的时序一致性监督压住过渡抖动。合成与真实数据集上定量与定性均优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 双摄数字变焦过渡在几何结构与色彩一致性上出现明显跳变；现有基于帧插值 (FI) 微调的方法难以处理跨视图大视差与复杂几何变换，直接套用扩散式 FI 又因条件引导不足、VAE 编码丢失高频、时序一致性不够而保真度低。
Method: ZoomDiff 在 latent 与 pixel 空间同时使用双摄输入：去噪多步中加强双图条件引导以提升几何一致性；把 VAE encoder 的光流对齐多尺度特征注入 VAE decoder 以恢复高频细节；再引入光流引导的时序一致性监督使过渡更平滑。
Result: 在合成与真实两类数据集上，ZoomDiff 在定量与定性两方面均超过现有最先进 DCSZ 方法；摘要未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 扩散生成先验配合双空间条件引导与光流一致性监督，可产出照片级真实的双摄平滑变焦过渡，优于基于 FI 微调的路线。

papers.title: Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration for Learning-based Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Conventional image registration algorithms are robust to domain shifts and achieve low errors, but they are slow and computationally expensive. Deep-learning methods are efficient at inference-time, but face challenges in out-of-domain samples. We propose Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration (RUGI), an algorithm for iteratively refining deformation fields predicted by learning-based registration models. At each iteration, the registration model predicts an incremental deformation, and a gating map modulates the update. Refinements are hence concentrated in regions that remain difficult to register. We explore two gating strategies: a learned uncertainty-based approach and an image residual error approach. We evaluate RUGI on cardiac MRI and echocardiography datasets and show consistent improvements over single-step inference. Ablation experiments demonstrate that iterative refinement alone improves registration, but informative spatial gating provides a significant additional benefit. The error-gated variant of RUGI can also be applied directly to existing pretrained models; applied to VoxelMorph, TransMorph, and CycleMorph, it yields MSE reductions of 27-37% with no modification to the original training procedure. The improvements in registration performance are reflected in decreased errors in ejection fraction estimation relative to ground truths. These results demonstrate that spatially selective iterative refinement provides an effective strategy to improve registration accuracy at inference-time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RUGI 在推理阶段用门控图 (gating map) 迭代修正学习式配准模型输出的形变场，把更新集中到仍难配准的区域。误差门控变体直接套在 VoxelMorph、TransMorph、CycleMorph 上，MSE 下降 27–37%，且不改动原训练流程，射血分数估计误差也随之下降。
Motivation: 传统配准算法对域偏移鲁棒、误差低但慢且算力开销大；深度学习推理快却在域外样本上表现不佳，需要在不重训的前提下提升推理时配准精度。
Method: RUGI 每轮让配准模型预测一个增量形变，再用门控图调制更新，反复迭代；门控策略有两种——基于学习式不确定性，以及基于图像残差误差。在心脏 MRI 与超声心动图数据集上评测，并做消融区分迭代细化与空间门控各自的贡献。
Result: 在心脏 MRI 与超声心动图数据集上，RUGI 相对单步推理有一致改进；消融显示仅迭代细化即可改善配准，而带信息量的空间门控带来额外显著收益。误差门控变体套用到 VoxelMorph、TransMorph、CycleMorph 时 MSE 下降 27–37%，不修改原训练过程；射血分数 (ejection fraction) 估计相对真值的误差同步下降。
Conclusion: 空间选择性的迭代细化是在推理时提升配准精度的有效策略，且误差门控版可即插即用于已有预训练模型而无需重训。

papers.title: LiAM-SAM: Lifecycle-Aware Memory for Robust SAM2-Based MOT
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation-based multi-object tracking (MOT) with foundation video models such as SAM2 offers strong localization quality, yet remains fragile in crowded, real-world scenes. In detector-prompted SAM2 pipelines, failures typically arise at three stages of the object lifecycle: (i) erroneous or duplicate track initiation, (ii) memory drift during close interactions, and (iii) unreliable re-identification after long occlusions or re-entry. These errors corrupt object memory and accumulate over time, making long-horizon tracking unstable. In this paper, we reframe MOT as a lifecycle memory integrity problem. We present LiAM-SAM, a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM) framework with targeted mechanisms for each of the three failure modes. At track birth, to prevent faulty or duplicate initiations, we apply contrastive track initiation, which conditions each prompt on existing nearby tracked instances. To preserve memory integrity during strong interactions, we introduce motion- and geometry-grounded memory correction that resolves interaction confusions and suppresses drift. For reliable re-identification after disappearance, we maintain an adaptive context memory that promotes diverse and trustworthy references as long-term identity anchors. Finally, similarity aware spatial pruning optionally selects the memory tokens to retain at cross-attention time, improving efficiency with minimal accuracy loss. LiAM-SAM represents a modular, detector-agnostic, SAM2-based MOT system that achieves state-of-the-art HOTA and IDF1 on the evaluated benchmarks. In association-challenging environments, our ablations show that LiAM improves a detector+SAM2 baseline by +10.5 HOTA, +17.4 AssA, and reduces identity switches by 96%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于 SAM2 的分割式多目标跟踪 (MOT) 重构为对象生命周期记忆完整性问题，LiAM-SAM 针对轨迹出生、强交互、长遮挡后再识别三个失效阶段分别加机制。在关联困难场景的消融中，相对 detector+SAM2 基线提升 +10.5 HOTA、+17.4 AssA，身份切换 (ID switches) 减少 96%。
Motivation: SAM2 类基础视频模型定位质量高，但在拥挤真实场景中，错误/重复轨迹初始化、近距交互时的记忆漂移、长遮挡后的再识别不可靠会污染对象记忆并随时间累积，使长时程跟踪不稳定。
Method: LiAM-SAM 含四个针对性机制：轨迹出生时用对比式轨迹初始化 (contrastive track initiation)，让每个 prompt 受附近已跟踪实例约束以避免错误或重复启动；用运动与几何约束的记忆修正 (motion- and geometry-grounded memory correction) 解决交互混淆并抑制漂移；维护自适应上下文记忆 (adaptive context memory)，挑选多样且可信的参考作为长期身份锚点；可选的相似度感知空间剪枝 (similarity aware spatial pruning) 在 cross-attention 阶段选择保留的记忆 token 以提升效率。整体是模块化、detector-agnostic 的 SAM2-based MOT 系统。
Result: 在所评估的 benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 的 HOTA 与 IDF1；在关联困难环境的消融中，相对 detector+SAM2 基线 HOTA +10.5、AssA +17.4，身份切换减少 96%。
Conclusion: 把 MOT 的三类失效分别归因到生命周期的记忆完整性问题并逐段修复，可在拥挤场景中大幅改善关联稳定性，同时用记忆剪枝换取效率且精度损失极小。

papers.title: TEEP-RCNN: Texture-Enhanced Edge-aware Perception for Steel Surface Defect Detection via Improved Convolutional Block Attention in Faster R-CNN
papers.abstract_en: Steel surface defect detection is critical for automated industrial quality control but remains challenging due to subtle inter-class texture differences and pronounced class imbalance. We introduce TEEP-RCNN (Texture-Enhanced Edge-aware Perception Region-based CNN), a two-stage detector built on Faster R-CNN with a Feature Pyramid Network backbone and an improved Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Our CBAM adds dropout regularization in the channel attention MLP and batch normalization on the spatial attention branch, reducing co-adaptation and stabilizing gating logits. Training uses a differential learning rate protocol with cosine annealing warm-up, separating update rates for the pre-trained ResNet-101 backbone and the detection head. At inference, predictions are refined via Test-Time Augmentation fused with Weighted Box Fusion (WBF), improving localization stability on elongated and boundary-adjacent defects. On the NEU-DET benchmark across six defect categories, TEEP-RCNN achieves 73.3\% mAP@50 and 37.9\% mAP@50-95 in only 10 training epochs on a single GPU, competitive with YOLOv11m (76.2\% mAP@50, 100 epochs) while outperforming it on the rolled-in-scale category under the COCO metric. Per-class analysis shows the spatial attention branch is most effective on elongated texture defects such as patches and scratches, while crazing remains an open challenge across both paradigms due to its distributed non-local texture structure.

Motivation: 钢材表面缺陷检测中类间纹理差异细微且类别严重不平衡，注意力门控信号易不稳定，长条与边界贴邻缺陷的定位也不稳。
Method: 两阶段检测器：Faster R-CNN + FPN 骨干（ResNet-101）+ 改进 CBAM（通道 MLP 加 dropout、空间分支加 BatchNorm）；训练用差分学习率与 cosine annealing warm-up，区分骨干与检测头更新速率；推理用 Test-Time Augmentation 与 Weighted Box Fusion (WBF) 融合。
Result: NEU-DET 六类缺陷上，10 epochs、单 GPU 训练得 73.3% mAP@50、37.9% mAP@50-95；YOLOv11m 为 76.2% mAP@50（100 epochs），TEEP-RCNN 在 rolled-in-scale 类别上按 COCO 指标更优。逐类分析显示空间注意力对 patches、scratches 等长条纹理缺陷最有效，crazing 在两种范式下均未解决。
Conclusion: 改进 CBAM 加紧凑训练日程可在极少 epoch 内逼近 YOLOv11m 的整体 mAP 并在个别类别反超，但分布式非局部纹理的 crazing 仍是开放难题。

papers.title: SlackDrive: Reclaiming Runtime Slack for Adaptive Driving Inference
papers.abstract_en: Driving world-action models improve planning by coupling multimodal reasoning with future prediction, but their growing inference cost increasingly conflicts with the real-time latency requirements of vehicle control. Existing acceleration methods reduce tokens, layers, or sampling steps with policies selected prior to deployment, yet leave residual runtime variation largely unexploited after offline profiling and static scheduling on shared onboard compute. We observe that the largest admissible compute budget varies systematically with the residual runtime state, while recent realized latency provides a direct signal of the available compute slack. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{SlackDrive}, a pre-inference compute allocator that reuses realized latency to select the compute budget of each control step before model execution. SlackDrive profiles the latency and planning utility of a small discrete budget set once, estimates online compute state from completed forwards, and selects the highest-utility budget predicted to remain within the admissible latency envelope, complementing existing profiling and resource scheduling while preserving the driving backbone and its compute actuator. On NAVSIM v2 with DriveDreamer-Policy, SlackDrive improves latency-constrained EPDMS by $21.7\%$ over the strongest baseline under a stringent latency regime, while the full-budget model and preconfigured token-pruning baselines exceed the admissible latency envelope under runtime contention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlackDrive 把已实现延迟 (realized latency) 当作运行时计算余量信号，在每次控制步执行前为 driving world-action model 选择可容纳的最大计算预算，从而在不改骨干与计算执行器的前提下压住时延包络。在 NAVSIM v2 + DriveDreamer-Policy 的严苛时延条件下，延迟受限 EPDMS 比最强基线高 21.7%，而全预算模型与预配置 token 剪枝基线在运行时争用下超出可接受时延包络。
Motivation: 驾驶世界-动作模型的推理开销与车载控制的实时延迟要求冲突；现有 token/层/采样步加速策略在部署前离线选定，离线剖析与静态调度后残留的运行时波动基本未被利用。
Method: 提出预推理计算分配器 SlackDrive：一次性剖析一小离散预算集合的延迟与规划效用，从已完成前向估计在线计算状态，再选出预测仍留在可接受时延包络内的最高效用预算；保留原驾驶骨干与其计算执行器，与既有剖析和资源调度互补。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v2 上用 DriveDreamer-Policy，严苛时延条件下延迟受限 EPDMS 比最强基线提升 21.7%；同条件下全预算模型与预配置 token-pruning 基线在运行时争用中超出可接受时延包络。
Conclusion: 把已实现延迟作为每次控制步的计算余量信号做预算选择，可以在不改模型骨干的情况下同时守住时延包络并保住规划效用，优于部署前静态定预算的做法。

papers.title: AstraLOD3: Zero-shot multimodal agentic reconstruction of LOD3 building models
papers.abstract_en: Automated LOD3 building modeling typically relies on purpose-built geometric or learning-based pipelines, limiting flexibility across heterogeneous buildings and input evidence conditions. This study investigates whether Astra, a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, can address these limitations through zero-shot reconstruction of LOD3 building models within an agentic framework under bounded autonomy. AstraLOD3 combines multi-view images, calibrated cameras, and a filtered sparse SfM point cloud with a natural-language reconstruction specification, while the Astra agent dynamically selects and executes computational procedures using Python and Blender. Across 35 runs, including 24 benchmark buildings, AstraLOD3 achieved a mean FRDS of 0.9647 and geometric agreement comparable to that of previous purpose-built methods. Controlled ablations further revealed the effects of reconstruction guidance, evidence modalities, model configuration, and run-to-run variability. The results demonstrate that structured LOD3 reconstruction can be formulated as a constrained agentic process rather than as a fixed pipeline. Future work will investigate adaptive refinement, user-guided correction, task-specific specialization, and damage-aware reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AstraLOD3 把 LOD3 建筑重建从固定管线改写为受约束的 agentic 流程：通用多模态基础模型 Astra 在 bounded autonomy 下用 Python 与 Blender 动态选择并执行重建步骤，输入为多视角图像、标定相机、滤波稀疏 SfM 点云与自然语言重建规格。35 次运行（含 24 栋基准建筑）平均 FRDS 达 0.9647，几何一致性与既往专用方法相当。
Motivation: 现有 LOD3 自动建模依赖专用几何或学习管线，面对异构建筑与不同输入证据条件时灵活性受限。
Method: AstraLOD3 将多视角图像、标定相机、滤波稀疏 SfM 点云与自然语言重建规格一并交给 Astra 智能体，由其在 bounded autonomy 框架内动态选择并执行 Python 与 Blender 计算过程；辅以受控 ablation，考察重建引导、证据模态、模型配置与运行间变异的影响。
Result: 35 次运行（含 24 栋基准建筑）平均 FRDS 为 0.9647，几何一致性与既往专用方法相当；受控 ablation 揭示了重建引导、证据模态、模型配置与 run-to-run 变异的作用。
Conclusion: 结构化 LOD3 重建可以表述为受约束的 agentic 过程而非固定管线；作者后续方向为自适应细化、用户引导修正、任务专用化与损伤感知重建。

papers.title: Exact Quantile Balancing and Load-Error Injection for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with negligible communication, and Load-Error Injection (LEI), which injects local load errors directly into router-score gradients. On 7.5B-parameter MoEs trained for up to 500B tokens, EQB improves global balance and downstream performance over naive QB, while LEI improves local balance and outperforms the GShard loss at comparable quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MoE 训练中全局负载均衡与专家并行所需的局部均衡难以同时满足，提出 Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB) 用可忽略通信量计算精确全局 batch 的 BF16 分位数，并提出 Load-Error Injection (LEI) 把局部负载误差直接注入 router 分数梯度。在 7.5B 参数 MoE、最多 500B token 训练中，EQB 相对朴素 QB 改善全局均衡与下游表现，LEI 改善局部均衡且在可比质量下优于 GShard loss。
Motivation: 分布式 Quantile Balancing 依赖分片相关或近似的全局分位数，而与 token 无关的 expert bias 无法保证 microbatch 级别的均衡，全局与局部两层负载平衡同时受限。
Method: EQB 计算精确的全局 batch BF16 分位数且通信开销可忽略；LEI 将局部负载误差直接注入 router-score 梯度，与现有 QB 和 GShard loss 对照训练。
Result: 在 7.5B 参数 MoE、训练至多 500B token 的设置下，EQB 相对 naive QB 提升全局均衡度与下游表现；LEI 提升局部均衡，并在可比质量下优于 GShard loss。
Conclusion: 精确全局分位数与把局部负载误差注入 router 梯度可以分别解决 MoE 的全局和局部均衡问题，二者在该规模训练中同时有效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Prompt, Probe, Train, or Annotate? Single-camera sports video understanding in amateur settings
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding is usually benchmarked on curated, single-actor, or professionally filmed clips, and a strong score there is routinely read as evidence a model is robust enough for deployment. Amateur team sport is a useful, largely untested place to check that assumption: over eight million students played a school sport in the United States in 2024-25 alone, almost none of it filmed by more than a single fixed camera, with several candidate actors crowded into frame and no operator or second angle to fall back on. Using volleyball as a test case, we ask whether strong performance on general video and world-model benchmarks translates into reliable, per-player attribution once footage is this chaotic, turning footage into statistics through a chain of tasks from finding play boundaries to naming who did what. We evaluate four approaches (prompting and agentic reasoning over frontier vision-language models, classical computer vision with small trained specialists, self-supervised video world models, and manual annotation) at every stage, on 66 amateur matches with 46,648 human-labelled contacts, filmed under conditions no published benchmark uses. No single paradigm wins every stage, and static, single-frame computer vision is not competitive at any stage involving motion or identity. A prompted model segments matches well, yet a far smaller trained model beats it at spotting contacts for a fraction of the cost, and the sport's own rules recover rally outcomes the pixels cannot. Identity is where every automated approach struggles: a jersey number is a static fact temporal reasoning cannot recover if never visible, unlike sporting action, a repeated motor pattern a temporal model can exploit, which is why holistic reasoning improves event detection while identity stays unchanged. We close with where each approach earns its cost, and what transfers beyond volleyball to amateur sport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 66 场业余排球比赛、46,648 个人工标注触球上对比四条路线（提示前沿 VLM、训练小型 CV 专家、自监督视频世界模型、人工标注），发现没有单一范式赢下从找回合边界到记谁做了什么的全部阶段：提示模型切分比赛最好，而更小的训练模型以几分之一成本在触球检测上反超，回合结果靠项目规则从像素之外恢复；身份归属是所有自动方法的共同短板，因为球衣号若从未入镜，时序推理无法补回。
Motivation: 视频理解分数通常来自精选、单人或专业拍摄片段，高分被当作可部署的证据，但业余团队运动几乎全是单固定机位、多人拥挤、无第二角度，per-player attribution 在这种条件下未经检验。
Method: 以排球为测试案例，把录像转成统计量拆成一串任务（找比赛/回合边界、检测触球、识别谁做了什么、恢复回合结果），在四个阶段上分别评测四类方法：对前沿 vision-language model 的 prompting 与 agentic reasoning、带小型训练专家的经典计算机视觉、自监督视频世界模型、人工标注；数据为 66 场业余比赛、46,648 条人工标注触球，拍摄条件为已发表 benchmark 未覆盖的场景。
Result: 四类方法在各阶段互有胜负，无单一范式全胜；静态单帧计算机视觉在任何涉及运动或身份的阶段都不具竞争力；prompted model 在比赛切分上表现好，但更小的训练模型在触球检测上以几分之一的成本超过它；回合结果由项目规则从像素之外恢复；身份归属上所有自动方法都吃紧，holistic reasoning 改善事件检测而身份识别保持不变。
Conclusion: 作者按成本收益给出各方法在哪个阶段划算，并指出哪些结论可从排球推广到其他业余运动：事件类任务靠时序与规则可解，身份归属受限于球衣号是否曾入镜，换更强的时序推理也补不回来。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 以排球为测试案例，把录像转成统计量拆成一串任务（找比赛/回合边界、检测触球、识别谁做了什么、恢复回合结果），在四个阶段上分别评测四类方法：对前沿 vision-language model 的 prompting 与 agentic reasoning、带小型训练专家的经典计算机视觉、自监督视频世界模型、人工标注；数据为 66 场业余比赛、46,648 条人工标注触球，拍摄条件为已发表 benchmark 未覆盖的场景。
summary_sections.result: 四类方法在各阶段互有胜负，无单一范式全胜；静态单帧计算机视觉在任何涉及运动或身份的阶段都不具竞争力；prompted model 在比赛切分上表现好，但更小的训练模型在触球检测上以几分之一的成本超过它；回合结果由项目规则从像素之外恢复；身份归属上所有自动方法都吃紧，holistic reasoning 改善事件检测而身份识别保持不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者按成本收益给出各方法在哪个阶段划算，并指出哪些结论可从排球推广到其他业余运动：事件类任务靠时序与规则可解，身份归属受限于球衣号是否曾入镜，换更强的时序推理也补不回来。

papers.title: TEMPS: Temporal Sentence Embeddings for Temporal Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS), a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS- Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPS 为冻结的语义检索器外挂一个时间分支：把锚定时间表达解析成区间并做矩匹配得到高斯分布，用其排序监督 anchor-date 条件编码器，推理时与语义分数融合。在三个时间基准上它对每个语义 backbone 都提升 MRR，在 TS-Retriever 上把 R@1 从 19.92 提到 25.39，超过此前的时间检索 SOTA。
Motivation: 稠密检索器与 RAG 管线在主题匹配上好、在时间匹配上差，会返回主题对但时间错的文档，而临床、新闻、法律检索中事件发生时间直接决定相关性。
Method: 提出 Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS) 任务，衡量两段锚定文本在时间上对齐程度且独立于主题相似度；TEMPS 模块将锚定时间表达解析为区间并对每个区间做矩匹配 (moment-matching) 得到高斯，用该分布的排序监督一个 anchor-date 条件编码器，推理时把时间分数与语义分数融合，监督信号来自 grounding，无需人工标注时间数据。时间分数本身取自分布嵌入的 Gaussian-KL inclusion measure。
Result: 在三个时间基准上，TEMPS 对每个被测语义 backbone 都提升 MRR；在 TS-Retriever 上 R@1 从 19.92 提升到 25.39，超过此前的时间检索 state of the art。
Conclusion: 给冻结语义检索器加一条由 grounding 自监督的时间分支，就能在不改语义骨干、不用人工时间标注的前提下修正主题对但时间错的检索结果。

papers.title: Tensor Decomposition of Transformer Key-Value Caches: Spectral Structure and Format Comparison
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers can be viewed as a fourth-order tensor spanning attention heads, tokens, features, and grouped layers. We measure the singular-value spectra of all four mode unfoldings on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and LLaMA-2-13B and compare four standard tensor decompositions: Tucker, CP, tensor train, and t-SVD, at matched storage. The spectra partition the four axes into two classes. The token and feature modes carry low-rank structure, particularly for keys. The head and layer modes are nearly full-rank and resist compression at any practical error level. Among the four decompositions, Tucker achieves the lowest reconstruction error at every compression ratio from $2\times$ to $5\times$, because it can leave the full-rank modes untouched. Comparisons with two-dimensional unfolding baselines show that the preferred representation differs between keys and values: 2D methods achieve lower key error, while four-way Tucker achieves lower value error at matched storage. A mode-pinning theorem certifies the full-rank preservation from the measured spectra alone. Two further spectral properties affect the compressible modes without touching the full-rank ones: values reach a higher error floor than keys at every ratio, and post-RoPE keys lose $41\%$ - $64\%$ of their pre-RoPE compressibility on both models.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications (SIMAX)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 的 KV cache 视为（头×token×特征×层）四阶张量，在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 与 LLaMA-2-13B 上测四种 mode 展开的奇异值谱并比较 Tucker、CP、tensor train、t-SVD 四种分解。token 与 feature mode 低秩、head 与 layer mode 近满秩；Tucker 在 2×–5× 压缩比下误差最低，post-RoPE key 相对 pre-RoPE 损失 41%–64% 的可压缩性。
Motivation: KV cache 随序列与层数线性膨胀，是自回归推理的主要显存瓶颈；但四个轴的谱结构不同，统一的低秩压缩假设会失效。
Method: 把 KV cache 建模为四阶张量，测四种 mode 展开的奇异值谱，在匹配存储下比较 Tucker、CP、tensor train、t-SVD，并与二维展开基线对照；给出仅凭实测谱即可认证满秩 mode 不被破坏的 mode-pinning 定理。
Result: 在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 与 LLaMA-2-13B 上，token 与 feature mode 低秩（key 尤甚），head 与 layer mode 在任意实用误差水平下近满秩；Tucker 在 2× 到 5× 每个压缩比上重建误差最低。二维方法在 key 上误差更低，四向 Tucker 在 value 上误差更低；value 在每个压缩比下误差地板都高于 key；post-RoPE key 相对 pre-RoPE 在两个模型上损失 41%–64% 的可压缩性。
Conclusion: KV cache 压缩应按 mode 区别对待：保留满秩的 head/layer 轴、只压 token/feature 轴，Tucker 是匹配存储下的首选；RoPE 会显著削弱 key 的可压缩性。

papers.title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Narciss 反馈分类细化为七类反馈焦点 (feedback focus)，在三门大学写作课上标注教师与六个 LLM 在三种提示策略下生成的反馈，构成基准 FeedType。发现多数 LLM 能覆盖大部分焦点类型，但分布不匹配教师，且按草稿阶段与学生水平的自适应程度不一，没有一个匹配教师的自适应行为。
Motivation: 既有 LLM 写作反馈评估关注反馈特征、学习效果与对象，反馈焦点及其自适应性 (adaptivity) 基本被忽略，无法判断 LLM 是否像专家教师那样组织反馈。
Method: 采纳并细化 Narciss 的分类为七种反馈焦点类型，在三门大学写作课上标注教师反馈与 LLM 反馈；覆盖六个 LLM、三种提示策略，评估焦点类型的覆盖与分布，并检验 LLM 是否随草稿阶段和学生水平调整反馈。
Result: 多数 LLM 覆盖了大部分反馈焦点类型，但其分布未能反映教师反馈的分布；各模型自适应水平不一，没有任何一个匹配教师的自适应行为。评测对象为三门大学写作课、六个 LLM、三种提示策略，基准名为 FeedType。
Conclusion: LLM 写作反馈在焦点覆盖上接近教师，但在焦点分布与按草稿阶段、学生水平的自适应上仍未对齐专家教师；FeedType 用于支撑后续教学对齐 (pedagogical alignment) 研究。

papers.title: PISCES: Physics-Informed Solar-wind Convolutional autoEncoder for Space-weather Anomaly Detection and Early Warning
papers.abstract_en: Space weather early warning depends on detecting solar wind transients in in-situ measurements at the first Sun-Earth Lagrange point (L1), before they reach Earth. Fixed thresholds can miss combined magnetic and plasma structure, and many learning methods provide a single anomaly score. We present the Physics-Informed Solar-wind Convolutional autoEncoder for Space-weather (PISCES), a convolutional autoencoder trained without catalog labels on OMNI solar wind measurements under physics constraints. Its loss includes magnetic field consistency, an empirical relation between temperature and velocity, the Parker spiral angle, and penalties on changes between consecutive one-minute samples in derived quantities calculated from the reconstruction. At inference, PISCES separates the anomaly score into magnetic and plasma reconstruction errors, physics relations, and residual corrections, and reports the magnitude of each contribution. Attenuation of the skip connections, selected on validation data, improves average precision for the trained models, while the untrained scores remain nearly the same. The trained models also give a more consistent ordering of these physical contributions. After smoothing with a trailing median, the alarms can precede independently observed sudden commencements, including positive sudden impulses.
papers.comment: Poster presented at NASA 5th Eddy Cross-Disciplinary Symposium, May 2026. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/PISCES
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PISCES 是一个物理约束的卷积自编码器，在无标签的 OMNI 太阳风数据上训练，把异常分数拆成磁场、等离子体、物理关系与残差修正四部分并各自报告量级。削弱 skip connection（在验证集上选强度）能提升训练后模型的 average precision，而未训练分数几乎不变；经滑动中位数平滑后，报警可早于独立观测到的 sudden commencement（含正 sudden impulse）。
Motivation: L1 点太阳风瞬变的预警依赖固定阈值，但固定阈值会漏掉磁场与等离子体的联合结构，且多数学习方法只给单一异常分数，无法说明报警由哪部分物理量驱动。
Method: 卷积自编码器在 OMNI 太阳风测量上无目录标签训练，损失含磁场一致性、温度-速度经验关系、Parker spiral 角，以及由重建导出量在相邻 1 分钟样本间变化的惩罚；推理时把异常分数分解为磁场与等离子体重建误差、物理关系、残差修正并报告各自量级，skip connection 衰减强度在验证集上选择，报警前加 trailing median 平滑。
Result: 削弱 skip connection 提升训练模型的 average precision，而未训练分数几乎不变；训练后模型对各物理贡献的排序更一致；平滑后的报警可先于独立观测的 sudden commencement，包括正 sudden impulse。
Conclusion: 把物理关系直接写进损失并把异常分数按物理贡献分解，能在无标签太阳风数据上给出可解释、可提前到 L1 预警的报警，skip connection 的衰减是影响检测质量的关键设计选择。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Improving Ensemble Filters with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation estimates a dynamical state from partial and noisy observations. Classical ensemble filters are efficient but restrict analysis updates through finite sample covariance and affine Gaussian distribution. We introduce the Flow Ensemble Filter (FlowEF), which uses conditional flow matching to transport the forecast ensemble from a classical baseline filter to an analysis ensemble. FlowEF uses a localized Gaussian source during training, transports forecast ensemble members from a baseline filter at deployment, and conditions its velocity field on ensembles from that baseline filter and the observation. The proposed model therefore learns a nonlinear update while mapping each baseline ensemble independently. For sparsely observed dynamical systems, FlowEF improves both deterministic and probabilistic metrics over all four classical ensemble filters. It also achieves the best performance among the state-of-the-art generative data assimilation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Flow Ensemble Filter (FlowEF)，用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 把经典集合滤波器输出的预报集合直接输运成分析集合，从而突破有限样本协方差与仿射高斯假设的更新限制。在稀疏观测动力系统上，FlowEF 的确定性与概率性指标均优于四种经典集合滤波器，并在当前生成式数据同化模型中取得最佳表现。
Motivation: 经典集合滤波器效率高，但分析更新被有限样本协方差和仿射高斯分布形式束缚，难以表达非线性、非高斯的后验；稀疏观测下这一限制尤其突出。
Method: FlowEF 用条件流匹配训练一个速度场，条件同时取自基线滤波器的集合与观测；训练时以局部化高斯 (localized Gaussian source) 为源分布，部署时把基线滤波器的每个预报集合成员独立输运为分析成员，从而学到非线性更新。
Result: 在稀疏观测的 dynamical systems 上，FlowEF 在确定性与概率性两类指标上同时改进了全部四种经典集合滤波器，并在 state-of-the-art 生成式数据同化模型中取得最佳性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用流匹配替换集合滤波的分析步骤，可以在保留逐成员独立映射的同时学到非线性更新，从而在稀疏观测系统上同时改善确定性和概率性指标。
Relevance: 86

papers.title: SoLiD26: A First Principles Solid-Liquid Interface Dataset for Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for solid-liquid interfaces in advanced materials applications, e.g., electrochemistry, catalysis and corrosion, require training data that samples both liquid environments, the solid and the interface itself. We present SoLiD26, a curated solid-liquid interface dataset, containing 15.4 million first-principles atomic structures with up to 576 atoms and 15 chemical elements for training and evaluating MLIPs. The structures were compiled from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed in studies of solid-liquid interfaces, with most configurations originating from ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. Each record contains atomic species, positions, simulation cell, periodic boundary conditions, potential energy and atomic forces. SoLiD26 includes aqueous coinage metal interfaces, electrode-electrolyte systems, and selected bulk reference structures, calculated with VASP using the PBE functional and D3 dispersion corrections. We describe the data ingestion and preparation pipeline used to construct the dataset. The application of SoLiD26 for training and evaluating MLIPs is demonstrated with a suite of MACE models on a simple training, validation and test split. The dataset enables development and benchmarking of MLIPs for structurally and chemically heterogeneous solid-liquid interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoLiD26 是首个面向固液界面的机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 第一性原理数据集，含 1540 万个 DFT 结构、最多 576 原子、15 种元素，覆盖水溶液 coinage metal 界面、电极-电解液体系统与体相参考结构。用 VASP/PBE+D3 计算并以 MACE 模型在简单训练-验证-测试划分上演示训练与评估，为异质固液界面的 MLIP 开发与基准测试提供数据基础。
Motivation: MLIP 用于电化学、催化、腐蚀等固液界面时需同时采样液体、固体与界面本身，而现有训练数据难以覆盖这种结构与化学上的异质性。
Method: 从既往固液界面 DFT 研究（多为 AIMD）中汇编并整理数据，记录原子种类、位置、模拟盒、周期性边界、势能与原子力；用 VASP 的 PBE 泛函加 D3 色散校正计算，配套描述数据摄取与预处理管线，并以 MACE 模型族在简单训练/验证/测试划分上演示训练与评估。
Result: 数据集含 1540 万个第一性原理原子结构，最多 576 原子、15 种化学元素；覆盖 aqueous coinage metal 界面、电极-电解质体系与选定体相参考结构；以 MACE 模型在简单划分上完成训练与评估演示。
Conclusion: SoLiD26 可支撑结构与化学异质固液界面 MLIP 的开发与基准测试，其价值在于把液体、固体与界面三类环境统一进同一训练语料。

papers.title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Turkish Domain Documents Under Retrieval and Hardware Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Most Turkish-capable large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using general-purpose benchmarks rather than long, structurally complex domain documents. This paper evaluates five open-weight 7B-8B models for Turkish document question answering under a resource-constrained local deployment setting. The primary benchmark contains 100 systematically validated questions derived from a 109-page industrial R&D report, and the evaluation protocol is replicated using a second 112-page public-sector report and an independently constructed 100-question set. All models are evaluated locally on an NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop GPU with 6 GB VRAM using controlled prompting, decoding, and 4-bit quantisation. The principal methodological contribution is an evidence-annotated evaluation protocol that separates retrieval failure from downstream model reasoning failure without requiring additional model calls. On the primary benchmark, end-to-end accuracy ranges from 49% to 75%. Seven lexical, dense, and hybrid retrieval configurations are additionally compared using 95% Wilson intervals and exact paired McNemar tests; none significantly outperforms the character TF-IDF baseline on either document. Evidence recall saturates differently across the two reports, showing that retrieval and effective context capacity can be binding constraints for some documents but not others. These results demonstrate that model selection, retrieval behaviour, and hardware limits must be evaluated separately when deploying open-weight LLMs for Turkish domain documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 6GB VRAM 笔记本 GPU 上用 4-bit 量化评测 5 个 7B-8B 开源模型做土耳其语长文档问答，端到端准确率 49%–75%；七种检索配置（词法/稠密/混合）均未显著超过字符 TF-IDF 基线，说明检索失败与模型推理失败必须分开归因。
Motivation: 土耳其语 LLM 多用通用基准评测，缺少对长篇、结构复杂领域文档的检验；实际本地部署还同时受检索质量与硬件显存约束，三者混在一起无法定位失败原因。
Method: 提出带证据标注的评测协议 (evidence-annotated protocol)，无需额外模型调用即可区分检索失败与下游推理失败；主基准为 109 页工业研发报告衍生的 100 道验证问题，并在 112 页公共部门报告与独立构造的 100 题集上复现；模型在 RTX 3050 6GB 上以受控 prompt、解码与 4-bit 量化本地运行，检索用 95% Wilson 区间与配对 McNemar 精确检验比较七种配置。
Result: 主基准端到端准确率 49%–75%；七种词法、稠密、混合检索配置在两份文档上均无一显著优于字符 TF-IDF 基线；证据召回在两份报告上呈现不同饱和行为。
Conclusion: 部署土耳其语领域文档开源 LLM 时，模型选择、检索行为与硬件限制必须分开评估；检索与有效上下文容量只在部分文档上成为瓶颈。

papers.title: Shared Global KV with Layer-Specific Local History
papers.abstract_en: Decoder-only Transformer language models cache keys and values (KV) to reuse past computation during generation. Sharing KV across layers saves storage but reduces the diversity of representations available across depth. We study what local memory should retain alongside shared global KV, separating historical content from the input source used to form it. At 126M parameters and 2K context, an eight-seed study finds about 1.4% lower held-out test perplexity with local history than with a current-token local branch. Capacity, entry-count and training-compute controls support the value of historical content. In a two-seed comparison, this value persists when adjacent layers share local inputs while retaining independent projections; source sharing also shortens exact cache-construction dependencies. Against GQA and adjacent-layer KV sharing, equal bounded learning-rate searches and new-seed confirmation yield better same-source likelihood with larger caches and higher long-request latency. The ordering against adjacent-layer sharing persists after equal-token adaptation to 8K, with a short-context cost. The eight-seed external-book history effect remains uncertain, and downstream outcomes vary by task. We derive a sufficient suffix schedule that reduces upper-layer construction work while preserving the complete cache in exact arithmetic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 decoder-only Transformer 中把全局 KV 跨层共享、同时为每层保留一路基于历史内容的局部记忆，比保留基于当前 token 的局部支路更有效：126M 参数、2K 上下文的八种子实验中 held-out test perplexity 约低 1.4%。容量、条目数与训练算力对照支持这一收益来自历史内容本身；但相对 GQA 与相邻层共享的似然优势以更大缓存和更高长请求延迟为代价，且外部书籍语料上的效应仍不确定。
Motivation: 跨层共享 KV 能省缓存存储，却压缩了深度方向的表示多样性；共享之后局部记忆该保留什么（历史内容还是形成它的输入源）此前没有被分离检验。
Method: 在 126M 参数、2K 上下文的 decoder-only 模型上做八种子对照，比较历史内容局部记忆与当前 token 局部支路，并加入容量、条目数与训练算力控制；再用双种子比较相邻层共享局部输入但保留独立投影的变体，与 GQA、相邻层 KV 共享在等预算学习率搜索和新种子确认下对比，最后做等 token 的 8K 适配。
Result: 126M/2K 下历史局部记忆相对当前 token 支路 held-out test perplexity 约低 1.4%（八种子）；容量、条目数、训练算力控制支持历史内容的价值；双种子显示相邻层共享局部输入时该价值仍在；相对 GQA 与相邻层共享在等预算搜索与新种子确认下取得更好的 same-source likelihood，但缓存更大、长请求延迟更高；等 token 适配到 8K 后相对相邻层共享的排序保持，代价是短上下文性能下降；外部书籍语料上的八种子历史效应仍不确定，下游结果因任务而异。
Conclusion: 共享全局 KV 时应为每层保留基于历史内容的局部记忆，而非当前 token 支路；这一收益在精确算术下可用充分的 suffix 调度减少上层构建工作并保留完整缓存，但要接受缓存与延迟开销以及跨语料、跨任务的不确定性。

papers.title: Controlled Attribute-Specific Summarization of Interrogative Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Effective summarization of interrogative dialogues is a critical task in forensic and investigative settings, requiring high factual accuracy, coherence, and attribute-specific relevance. In this work, we introduce CASPER, a novel Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization framework that leverages structured prompting and iterative refinement to generate high-quality summaries of interrogator-witness interactions. We construct MINDSum, a dataset extending the MIND corpus, comprising 6,000 utterance pairs annotated with event details, factual statements, character descriptions, and fillers. CASPER employs RoleEval, a hierarchical evaluation mechanism where multiple roles (officer, inspector, senior inspector) iteratively assess summaries based on predefined criteria. By integrating entity extraction and structured feedback loops, CASPER significantly improves factual consistency and contextual completeness compared to existing baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard summarization models on both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) metrics, while human evaluation confirms its alignment with expert reasoning. Our findings underscore the potential of controlled summarization in high-stakes domains, paving the way for AI-driven forensic intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASPER 用 Chain-of-Thought 属性特定提示 (Attribute-Specific Prompting) 对审讯对话做受控摘要，配合 RoleEval 多角色层级迭代评审与实体抽取反馈环，在自建 MINDSum（6,000 对话语句，标注事件、事实、人物、填充语）上于 ROUGE 与 BERTScore 上均超过标准摘要模型，人工评估也确认其与专家推理一致。
Motivation: 法医与侦查场景要求摘要事实准确、连贯且按属性（事件/事实/人物）定向，通用摘要模型难以满足这种高风险领域的属性级可控性。
Method: 提出 CASPER：结构化 CoT 属性特定提示加迭代精炼；构建 MINDSum 数据集（扩展 MIND 语料，6,000 utterance pairs，四类属性标注）；用 RoleEval 让 officer、inspector、senior inspector 三个角色按预设准则逐轮评审，并接入实体抽取与结构化反馈环。
Result: 在 ROUGE（词面）与 BERTScore（语义）上均优于标准摘要模型与既有基线；人工评估确认摘要与专家推理对齐；数据集规模为 6,000 对话语句。
Conclusion: 受控的属性特定提示加多角色迭代评审能在高风险领域提升摘要的事实一致性与上下文完整性，作者据此主张其在法医情报中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Learning from Failures: Heterogeneous Graph Memory for Small Language Model Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Small and medium-sized language models offer cost-effective executors for tool-using agents, making them attractive for local and large-scale deployment. However, in long-horizon and stateful environments, they often make structural errors such as missing required observations, performing premature writes, repeating failed calls, and violating action preconditions. These errors can lead to incorrect state updates, policy violations, and costly or irreversible consequences, making reliable tool execution a critical deployment challenge. Existing fine-tuning approaches require substantial data and computation, while flat memory may retrieve failed actions without preserving their causal context or safety conditions. In this paper, we propose FRESH, a Failure-aware Retrieval framework over Experience-Structured Heterogeneous graphs, which transforms historical successes and failures into structured external experience for tool-using agents. By explicitly modeling the dependencies among tasks, actions, errors, repairs, and execution conditions, FRESH helps frozen language models reuse reliable strategies, avoid recurring failures, and make safer decisions in stateful tool interactions. Experiments on $τ$-Bench and AppWorld with multiple open-source models show that FRESH consistently improves task success and tool-use reliability over no-memory agents and representative memory-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRESH 把工具调用的历史成功与失败改写成异构图外部经验，显式建模任务、动作、错误、修复与执行条件之间的依赖，让冻结的小语言模型在有状态工具交互中复用可靠策略、避开重复失败。在 τ-Bench 与 AppWorld 上，多个开源模型的任务成功率与工具使用可靠性一致高于无记忆 agent 和代表性记忆基线。
Motivation: 中小模型在长时程有状态环境中反复犯结构性错误（漏观测、提前写入、重复失败调用、违反前置条件），而现有微调代价高、flat memory 检索失败动作时丢掉因果上下文与安全条件。
Method: 提出 FRESH（Failure-aware Retrieval over Experience-Structured Heterogeneous graphs）：把历史成功与失败转成异构图结构化外部经验，显式建模任务、动作、错误、修复与执行条件的依赖，检索后供冻结语言模型复用。
Result: 在 τ-Bench 与 AppWorld 上、覆盖多个开源模型，FRESH 相对无记忆 agent 与代表性记忆基线一致提升任务成功率和工具使用可靠性。
Conclusion: 结构化、失败感知的图记忆可以在不微调的前提下提升冻结小模型工具执行的可靠性与安全性。
Relevance: 0
