papers.title: Compliant with Local Controls, Collectively Discriminatory. A Governance Architecture for Multi-Agent AI in Regulated Finance
authors: Jose Manuel de la Chica Rodriguez
papers.abstract_en: Financial institutions are beginning to deploy agentic workflows in credit, fraud, collections, compliance, and operational control. Governance remains largely component-centric: each model or agent is specified, tested, authorized, and monitored locally. That is insufficient when institutional risk arises from the joint behavior of many locally acceptable components. We call this gap constitutional non-compositionality: local compliance checks need not compose into acceptable collective outcomes such as bounded disparate impact, market integrity, or traceable accountability. We propose ARIA as a finance-specific reference architecture and falsifiable research agenda for agent-population governance. It organizes six capabilities across normative-accountability, execution-control, and assurance-learning planes: policy specification, population-level observed-versus-expected behavior monitoring (M2), bounded authority, runtime containment, adaptive policy change, and preserved human oversight competence. Two simulations illustrate shared-signal thin-file exclusion under local controls and earlier warning from observed-versus-expected distributional monitoring in a constructed drift regime. The contribution maps these controls to fair-lending, EU AI Act, model-risk, and conduct-supervision evidence needs, and closes with a validation agenda rather than a production-effectiveness claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ARIA：面向受监管金融的多智能体治理参考架构，核心论断是各组件单独合规并不保证集体结果合规（constitutional non-compositionality）。它用六个能力分属规范-问责、执行控制、保证-学习三个平面，其中群体级 observed-versus-expected 行为监控 (M2) 能在构造的漂移场景下更早发出分布偏移预警。
Motivation: 金融机构的 agentic workflow 治理仍是 component-centric：每个模型或 agent 单独测试授权，但机构风险来自众多局部可接受组件的联合行为，局部合规检查不必然合成有界差异化影响、市场完整性与可追溯问责等可接受的集体结果。
Method: 提出 ARIA 参考架构与可证伪研究议程，组织六个能力于三个平面：policy specification、群体级 observed-versus-expected 行为监控 (M2)、bounded authority、runtime containment、adaptive policy change、preserved human oversight competence；用两个仿真作说明，并把这些控制映射到 fair-lending、EU AI Act、model-risk、conduct-supervision 的证据需求。
Result: 两个仿真分别演示：局部控制下共享信号导致 thin-file 群体被排除，以及在构造的漂移 (drift) 场景中 observed-versus-expected 分布监控给出更早预警。贡献以验证议程收尾，明确不作 production-effectiveness 主张。
Conclusion: 多智能体金融治理必须在群体层面而非组件层面设控制，ARIA 给出可证伪的架构与验证议程，其有效性主张有待后续验证而非已证的生产效果。

papers.title: Task-Induced Riemannian Metrics for Vision Transformer Feature Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Methods operating on Vision Transformer (ViT) feature spaces typically rely on Euclidean distance or cosine similarity. This assumes that every direction is equally meaningful, but there is no reason to believe the true task geometry has this property. The task-sensitive geometry of the feature space is given by the pullback metric $g(F) = J(F)^\top J(F)$, where $J$ is the Jacobian of the decoder's output fed to a task-specific distance, with respect to the features. Storing the full $g$ is infeasible at modern scales, and for dense outputs such as depth maps even forming $J$ is impractical. We show that whether a low-rank approximation of this metric can be learned depends on the model-decoder pair, and we characterize this with a matrix-free diagnostic $κ_{cap}(r)$ computable with a low number of Jacobian-vector products. For tractable pairs, we develop the Spectral Pullback Network (SPN), which learns a low-rank version of the metric from randomized power iteration, and we distill it into a $310$K-parameter importance head that predicts token importance directly from the features. When the Jacobian spectrum is too spread out for a low-rank approximation, passing the decoder's input features through a VAE bottleneck can restore tractability. Across DPT, DINOv2, CLIP, and VGGT backbones, $κ_{cap}(r)$ predicts which learned-metric architectures are viable. The importance head reaches Spearman $ρ= 0.998$ on DINOv2 CLS, and our geometric token pruning reduces the additional depth error of ToMe-based token selection by $25\%$ on DPT depth at prune ratio $0.5$, without fine-tuning the ViT. Project page: https://cyberiada.github.io/TaskInducedViTs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViT 特征空间的欧氏/余弦度量默认各向同性，与任务真实几何不符；本文用解码器输出对特征的 Jacobian 定义 pullback metric g(F)=J(F)ᵀJ(F)，并提出矩阵自由诊断 κ_cap(r) 判断该度量能否低秩近似。可解的模型-解码器对上用 Spectral Pullback Network (SPN) 经随机幂迭代学低秩度量，蒸馏成 310K 参数 importance head 直接预测 token 重要性；DINOv2 CLS 上 Spearman ρ=0.998，DPT 深度上剪枝比例 0.5 时相对 ToMe 额外深度误差降低 25%，无需微调 ViT。
Motivation: ViT 特征空间方法普遍依赖欧氏距离或余弦相似度，等于假设各方向同等有意义，但任务敏感的真实几何由 pullback metric 给出；完整存储 g(F) 在现代规模不可行，稠密输出（如深度图）连构造 Jacobian 都不现实。
Method: 以解码器输出经任务距离的 Jacobian 定义 g(F)=J(F)ᵀJ(F)，提出矩阵自由诊断 κ_cap(r)，用少量 Jacobian-vector products 判断低秩近似是否可行；可行对上用 Spectral Pullback Network (SPN) 经随机幂迭代学低秩度量，蒸馏为 310K 参数 importance head 直接从特征预测 token 重要性；Jacobian 谱过散时，把解码器输入特征过 VAE bottleneck 恢复可解性。
Result: 在 DPT、DINOv2、CLIP、VGGT 四种 backbone 上，κ_cap(r) 能预测哪些学得度量架构可行；importance head 在 DINOv2 CLS 上达到 Spearman ρ=0.998；在 DPT 深度任务、prune ratio 0.5 下，几何 token 剪枝把 ToMe token selection 的额外深度误差降低 25%，且不微调 ViT。
Conclusion: 任务诱导的 Riemannian 度量能否低秩近似取决于具体模型-解码器对，可用 κ_cap(r) 事先判定；对可解对，学得的低秩几何能在不微调的前提下改进 token 剪枝的深度误差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PCQC: Privileged Counterfactual Question Credit for Multi-Turn Medical Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress on medical question-answering, yet effective medical dialogue also requires learning to ask questions that uncover relevant patient information. To train such dialogue policies, a common pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning (RL) based on final diagnostic correctness. However, this outcome-based supervision does not directly distinguish the contributions of individual questions and provides no question-level feedback for unexecuted alternatives. To address this gap, we introduce PCQC (Privileged Counterfactual Question Credit), which uses privileged patient information during training to learn from questions never asked. During training, PCQC makes alternative questions directly comparable at the same dialogue state by using privileged patient facts to construct their answers. A frozen diagnostic scorer evaluates the diagnostic utility of each resulting question-answer pair by how strongly it supports the correct diagnosis. PCQC turns these comparisons into relative question credit that teaches the policy which questions to favor, directly supervising both executed and unexecuted questions alongside outcome-based RL without requiring complete rollouts for the unexecuted alternatives. Extensive experiments across four medical benchmarks demonstrate that PCQC achieves 63.10% mean diagnostic accuracy, outperforming GRPO and ATPO by 4.38 and 4.21 percentage points, respectively. These gains are achieved with 33.1% fewer inquiry turns than GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PCQC 在医疗多轮对话训练中用特权患者信息为“没问出口”的备选问题构造答案，再由冻结的诊断打分器给出问题级相对信用，与基于结果的 RL 一起监督策略。在四个医疗问答基准上平均诊断准确率 63.10%，比 GRPO 高 4.38 个百分点、比 ATPO 高 4.21 个百分点，且问询轮次少 33.1%。
Motivation: SFT 加基于最终诊断正确性的 RL 只给结果级监督，无法区分单个问题各自的贡献，也完全不给未执行问题任何反馈。
Method: 训练时用特权患者信息在同一对话状态上直接构造备选问题的答案，使不同问题可比；冻结的诊断打分器按支撑正确诊断的强度评估每个问答对，转成相对问题信用 (relative question credit)，同时监督已执行与未执行问题，无需为备选问题做完整 rollout，与结果型 RL 并用。
Result: 在四个医疗 benchmark 上平均诊断准确率 63.10%，较 GRPO 高 4.38 个百分点、较 ATPO 高 4.21 个百分点；问询轮次比 GRPO 少 33.1%。
Conclusion: 问题级反事实信用能在不增加 rollout 成本的前提下同时提升诊断准确率并减少问询轮次，优于仅靠结果奖励的 GRPO 与 ATPO。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Relative Discharge Stage (RDS) Classification: A Practical Indicator of Battery Discharge Progress
papers.abstract_en: Accurate remaining discharge time (RDT) prediction is challenging in real-world battery applications because future load profiles are unknown and highly dynamic. To address the uncertainty of continuous RDT regression, this paper introduces Relative Discharge Stage (RDS), a battery-management indicator that represents the remaining discharge condition using five interpretable classes: Normal, Good, Moderate, Low, and Recharge Required. Unlike state of charge (SOC), which reflects the current charge level, RDS characterizes the remaining discharge process without requiring future-current information during inference. A physics-informed RDS classification framework is proposed, combining SOC estimation with lightweight temporal learning. The SOC-estimation component includes second-order ECM state and terminal-voltage prediction, hysteresis and OCV temperature correction, core-temperature estimation, and AEKF state correction, supported by OCV evaluation, online STC-ECM parameter adaptation, and pretrained neural residual-voltage correction. The measured current, terminal voltage, surface temperature, and estimated SOC are arranged into a sliding observation window and processed by a lightweight temporal convolutional network. Experiments on two public lithium-ion battery datasets demonstrate robust RDS classification, with accuracy exceeding 80% under varying load and thermal conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出相对放电阶段 (RDS) 分类，把剩余放电时间回归转成 Normal、Good、Moderate、Low、Recharge Required 五个可解释类别，推理时不需要未来电流信息。物理信息框架用 AEKF 修正的 SOC 估计加轻量时序卷积网络处理滑动观测窗，在两个公开锂电数据集上、变负载与变温度条件下准确率超过 80%。
Motivation: 实际电池应用中未来负载未知且高度动态，连续剩余放电时间 (RDT) 回归受此不确定性影响而难以准确预测。
Method: 物理信息 RDS 分类框架：SOC 估计部分含二阶 ECM 状态与端电压预测、迟滞与 OCV 温度修正、核心温度估计、AEKF 状态修正，并有 OCV 评估、在线 STC-ECM 参数自适应与预训练神经残差电压修正；再把电流、端电压、表面温度与估计 SOC 排成滑动观测窗，送入轻量时序卷积网络 (TCN) 分类。
Result: 在两个公开锂离子电池数据集上，变负载与变温度条件下 RDS 分类准确率超过 80%。
Conclusion: RDS 作为电池管理指标可在不依赖未来电流信息的前提下刻画剩余放电过程，用 SOC 估计加轻量时序学习即可达到可用的分类精度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 物理信息 RDS 分类框架：SOC 估计部分含二阶 ECM 状态与端电压预测、迟滞与 OCV 温度修正、核心温度估计、AEKF 状态修正，并有 OCV 评估、在线 STC-ECM 参数自适应与预训练神经残差电压修正；再把电流、端电压、表面温度与估计 SOC 排成滑动观测窗，送入轻量时序卷积网络 (TCN) 分类。
summary_sections.result: 在两个公开锂离子电池数据集上，变负载与变温度条件下 RDS 分类准确率超过 80%。
summary_sections.conclusion: RDS 作为电池管理指标可在不依赖未来电流信息的前提下刻画剩余放电过程，用 SOC 估计加轻量时序学习即可达到可用的分类精度。

papers.title: Riemannian Structure and Optimization for a Class of Low-Parametric Orthogonal Matrices
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we are concerned with matrices formed by block-diagonal factors interleaved with fixed permutations -- a flexible family of structured matrices. This class has recently drawn interest in deep learning architectures for its balanced expressivity-efficiency trade-off, yet efficient computational strategies for working with it remain to be found. We approach this problem through Riemannian geometry and examine under what conditions this class admits a smooth manifold structure. For the practically important case of orthogonal two-factor matrices, we derive the essential Riemannian tools and propose efficient algorithms for their implementation. The algorithms leverage automatic differentiation, support parameter sharing within each factor, and avoid explicit dense matrix construction. We test them within the Riemannian optimization framework on the best matrix approximation problem and for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Beyond the two-factor setting, we study the geometric and matrix-theoretic properties of factorizations with a larger number of block-diagonal factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究块对角因子与固定置换交错构成的低参数正交矩阵类，从黎曼几何刻画其成为光滑流形的条件，并为正交两因子情形推导黎曼梯度、投影等工具，给出基于自动微分、支持因子内参数共享且不显式构造稠密矩阵的优化算法。算法在黎曼优化框架下用于最优矩阵逼近与大语言模型的参数高效微调。
Motivation: 块对角因子与置换交错的结构化矩阵在深度学习中表达力与效率较平衡，但缺少高效可用的计算策略，其流形结构与优化工具尚不明确。
Method: 用黎曼几何分析该矩阵类何时构成光滑流形；对正交两因子情形推导黎曼工具并设计算法，借助自动微分、支持因子内参数共享、避免显式稠密矩阵构造；在黎曼优化框架下测试最优矩阵逼近与 LLM 参数高效微调，并研究更多块对角因子分解的几何与矩阵论性质。
Result: 在最优矩阵逼近问题与大语言模型参数高效微调两类任务上测试所提黎曼优化算法；摘要给出 37 页、2 幅图的篇幅信息，未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 块对角-置换结构的正交两因子矩阵具备可操作的黎曼优化工具，可支撑参数高效微调等应用；更多因子的分解则以几何与矩阵论性质的形式研究。

papers.title: Risk-Controlled KV-Cache Eviction: From Memory Budgets to Risk Targets
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache eviction is typically evaluated through average quality-memory trade-offs, yet a small average loss can hide requests whose utility degrades materially. We reformulate eviction as a deployment risk-control problem: a material degradation occurs when eviction lowers task utility by more than a deployment-specified tolerance relative to full-KV inference on the same request, and deployment risk is the population frequency of such events. Given a reliability contract specifying a target risk level and confidence requirement, we use a compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure to select a retention policy from calibration data with a finite-sample guarantee, falling back to full KV when no compressed policy is certified. Across multiple eviction methods, Llama and Mistral models, and LongBench and RULER-32K, the same contract supports substantially different levels of eviction: on Llama, it certifies SnapKV at 75% retention on LongBench but no tested compressed policy on RULER-32K, triggering full-KV fallback. Policies with empirical degradation rates below the 5% target can still fail finite-sample certification; on Llama LongBench, empirical thresholding selects uncertified policies that retain 5-10 percentage points less cache across fixed-budget methods. The proposed framework converts a deployment-level reliability requirement into a KV-memory operating point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 KV-cache 驱逐从平均质量-内存权衡改写成部署风险控制：给定可靠性契约（目标风险水平与置信要求），用与压缩器无关的后验认证流程从校准数据中选出保留策略并给出有限样本保证，无策略通过则回退到 full KV。在 Llama 上同一契约在 LongBench 认证 SnapKV 保留 75%，在 RULER-32K 上不认证任何被测压缩策略而触发回退。
Motivation: 平均质量-内存权衡会掩盖少数请求效用大幅退化的情况；部署方需要的是针对单请求实质退化频率的风险保证，而非平均指标。
Method: 将实质退化定义为驱逐使任务效用相对同请求 full-KV 推理下降超过部署方给定容忍度，部署风险即该事件的人群频率；给定风险目标与置信要求，用压缩器无关的后验认证流程从校准数据中选择保留策略并给出有限样本保证，未通过则回退 full KV。
Result: 跨多种驱逐方法、Llama 与 Mistral、LongBench 与 RULER-32K：Llama 上同一契约在 LongBench 认证 SnapKV 75% 保留率，在 RULER-32K 不认证任何被测压缩策略并触发 full-KV 回退；经验退化率低于 5% 目标仍可能通不过有限样本认证；在 Llama LongBench 上经验阈值法选出的未认证策略比固定预算方法少保留 5-10 个百分点的 cache。
Conclusion: 部署级可靠性要求可以被转换成 KV 内存工作点，且经验退化率低于目标并不足以替代有限样本认证。

papers.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Generalizing from Limited Resources in the Open World workshop at International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Whisper 编码器做无标签剪枝：按 leave-one-layer-out 的 WER 变化给层排序，删掉影响最小的 6 层（占编码器 18.5%），得到的浅层模型无需任何自定义推理代码即可直接加速。再用无标签单语语音蒸馏恢复性能，四语平均 WER 从零样本剪枝后的 21.9% 降到 20.1%，相对 18.2% 的基线仍略有损失。
Motivation: 已有剪枝工作集中在解码器（turbo 32→4 层、Distill-Whisper 32→2 层），编码器压缩缺少被广泛采用的方案，原因在于多数方法需要定制推理实现才能真正拿到收益。
Method: 对编码器逐层做 leave-one-layer-out 消融，按引起的 WER 变化排序，删除变化最小的 6 层；随后用无标签单语语音数据做蒸馏，恢复零样本剪枝造成的退化。
Result: 删除 6 层，占编码器堆栈的 18.5%；四语平均 WER：基线 18.2%，零样本剪枝 21.9%，蒸馏后 20.1%。
Conclusion: 按 WER 敏感度排序的编码器剪枝可以做到零推理代码改动，配合无标签蒸馏能把 WER 从 21.9% 拉回 20.1%，但仍高于 18.2% 的原始基线。

papers.title: All modalities are equal, but video is more equal: Closing the Cross-Attention Gap in Joint Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video is a rich representation of a physical event, capturing appearance, geometry, motion, and temporal evolution. Other modalities, such as 3D body motion or audio, encode narrower aspects of the same event. We find that joint multimodal diffusion transformers exhibit a corresponding asymmetry in cross-modal correspondence: companion modalities develop strong correspondences to video, but the reciprocal correspondences through which they constrain video remain substantially weaker. We express both directions as comparable correspondence distributions over video tokens and define their disagreement as the reciprocal correspondence gap. We introduce RecCAR, standing for Reciprocal Cross-modal Attention Regularization, a KL regularizer that uses the well-established video-to-modality correspondence as a fixed reference and aligns the weaker modality-to-video correspondence toward it. Across joint video-motion and video-audio generation, RecCAR improves the Human Anatomy score from 0.69 to 0.75 and reduces audio-video desynchronization from 0.804 to 0.752, while improving overall generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联合多模态扩散 Transformer 中，伴随模态（3D 身体动作、音频）对视频的 cross-modal 对应强，而反向约束视频的对应明显更弱，作者把双向对应分布的分歧定义为 reciprocal correspondence gap。提出 RecCAR（Reciprocal Cross-modal Attention Regularization）：以已确立的 video-to-modality 对应为固定参考，用 KL 正则把较弱的 modality-to-video 对应对齐过去。在联合视频-动作与视频-音频生成上，Human Anatomy 分数从 0.69 提到 0.75，音画不同步从 0.804 降到 0.752。
Motivation: 联合多模态生成中双向跨模态约束不对称：伴随模态能被视频约束，但视频本身受伴随模态的约束弱，导致动作或音频对生成视频的引导不足。
Method: RecCAR 把双向对应都表示为 video token 上可比的对应分布，以较强的 video-to-modality 对应作固定参考，用 KL 正则对齐较弱的 modality-to-video 对应，作用于联合视频-动作与视频-音频两类扩散 Transformer。
Result: 在联合视频-动作与视频-音频生成上，Human Anatomy 分数由 0.69 提升至 0.75，音画不同步（audio-video desynchronization）由 0.804 降至 0.752，整体生成质量同时改善。
Conclusion: 跨模态注意力的双向不对称是可测量并可通过正则化弥合的；以强方向为参考校准弱方向，能在不牺牲整体质量的前提下提升解剖合理性与音画同步。

papers.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
papers.abstract_en: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational questions and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AI 生成教育问题上，Bloom 分类器从 IID 数据集迁移到 OOD 时性能下降：TF-IDF+POS 的 ML 模型 Macro F1 仅 0.48，BERT 0.55，LLM 0.79。文本拼接 (text splicing) 把 ML 与 BERT 提到 0.59 和 0.62，而模型重训练在所有模型与数据集上带来最大提升。
Motivation: AI 批量生成教育材料的速度已超过人工验证其教学法质量的能力，而现有 Bloom 分类器只在 IID 数据集上准确，迁移到 AI 生成的新问题时会退化。
Method: 在 Bloom 层级分类任务上对比传统 ML（TF-IDF+POS 特征）、Transformer（BERT）与 LLM 三类预训练模型，并测试三类稳定 OOD 的特征工程策略：加入 NLP 指标、把学习目标拼进输入、以及 text splicing。
Result: 基线 OOD Macro F1：TFPOS-IDF ML 0.48、BERT 0.55、LLM 0.79；text splicing 后 ML 与 BERT 分别升至 0.59 与 0.62；附加学习目标只在特定数据集上提升；模型重训练在所有模型与数据集上带来最大改进。
Conclusion: 预训练模型用于 AI 辅助生成的新教育问题时存在性能权衡，战略性特征增强（尤其是重训练与 text splicing）可缓解分布迁移造成的损失。

summary_sections.method: 在 Bloom 层级分类任务上对比传统 ML（TF-IDF+POS 特征）、Transformer（BERT）与 LLM 三类预训练模型，并测试三类稳定 OOD 的特征工程策略：加入 NLP 指标、把学习目标拼进输入、以及 text splicing。
summary_sections.result: 基线 OOD Macro F1：TFPOS-IDF ML 0.48、BERT 0.55、LLM 0.79；text splicing 后 ML 与 BERT 分别升至 0.59 与 0.62；附加学习目标只在特定数据集上提升；模型重训练在所有模型与数据集上带来最大改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 预训练模型用于 AI 辅助生成的新教育问题时存在性能权衡，战略性特征增强（尤其是重训练与 text splicing）可缓解分布迁移造成的损失。

papers.title: Less Language, More Latents: Annotation-Efficient VLAs for Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLA) promise human-steerable autonomous driving, but their training is bottlenecked by the scarcity of frames paired with natural-language instructions: while camera streams and expert trajectories are logged at scale, language annotations (e.g., turn left at the intersection) remain scarce and expensive to acquire. To address this challenge, we introduce Latent Action Driving Annotations (LADA), a three-stage pipeline that transforms abundant unlabelled observation-trajectory pairs into a substrate for language-conditioned control. First, we train a latent action model with a vector-quantised bottleneck, producing a compact codebook of high-level vehicle intents. Second, a small language-annotated subset is used to train a vision-language translator to map observations and language instructions into this codebook. Third, we train a driving VLA on observation-latent-action pairs over the full unlabelled corpus. Using fewer than 5% of language annotations and without leveraging any auxiliary chain-of-thought reasoning or visual question answering streams, LADA achieves a Driving Score of 87.98 and a Success Rate of 70.46% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark, matching or surpassing fully supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三阶段管线 LADA，用向量量化瓶颈把大量无标注的观测-轨迹对压成高层车辆意图码本，再用不足 5% 的语言标注训练视觉-语言翻译器把指令映射到该码本，最后在全量无标注语料上训练语言条件驾驶 VLA。在闭环 Bench2Drive 上 Driving Score 87.98、Success Rate 70.46%，匹配或超过全监督基线。
Motivation: VLA 自动驾驶的训练受限于「帧-自然语言指令」配对数据的稀缺：相机流与专家轨迹可大规模记录，而语言标注昂贵且难以获取。
Method: LADA 三阶段：先用向量量化瓶颈 (vector-quantised bottleneck) 训练 latent action model，得到高层车辆意图的紧凑 codebook；再用一小部分语言标注样本训练 vision-language translator，把观测与语言指令映射到该 codebook；最后在全量无标注语料的 observation-latent-action 对上训练驾驶 VLA，全程不使用 chain-of-thought 或视觉问答 (VQA) 数据流。

Conclusion: 语言标注并非 VLA 驾驶性能的必要条件：把无标注轨迹转成 latent action 再对齐语言，可以在极少标注下达到全监督水平。

papers.title: Categorical Internalisation of Environmental Groupoids for Generalisable POMDP Solving
papers.abstract_en: This paper advocates category theory as a practical framework for structuring and improving rein- forcement learning in high-dimensional, partially observable environments. We model symmetries between environmental states by partitioning the state space into equivalence classes induced by sym- metry orbits, and organise each such class as a groupoid with a designated canonical representative. This allows the agent to share what it learns across many similar environmental states simultaneously, rather than treating every orientation or position as an entirely new problem. Learning is thus carried out on a symmetry-reduced state space with each orbit represented once, preserving structure while eliminating redundancy and improving sample efficiency. We implement this framework within standard reinforcement learning pipelines and evaluate two different approaches on partially observable benchmarks, demonstrating that orbit-based partitioning yields consistent performance improvements in environments exhibiting latent symmetry. Beyond these empirical results, our approach illustrates how categorical structure provides a principled bridge between abstract reinforcement learning formulations and their computational application, thereby establishing a pathway toward more structured and scalable learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把范畴论用作强化学习的结构化框架：按对称轨道 (symmetry orbits) 将状态空间划分为等价类，每类组织成带规范代表元的 groupoid，在对称约化的状态空间上学习，使同一轨道内的相似状态共享经验。在含潜在对称的部分可观测基准上评估两种实现方式，轨道划分带来一致的性能提升并提高样本效率。
Motivation: 高维部分可观测环境中，每个朝向或位置都被当成全新问题，导致学习冗余、样本效率低，抽象 RL 公式与可计算实现之间也缺少结构化的衔接方式。
Method: 用对称性诱导的等价类划分状态空间，每类组织为带指定规范代表元的 groupoid；在对称约化空间上（每个轨道只表示一次）做学习，并将该框架嵌入标准 RL pipeline，评估两种不同实现方式。
Result: 在含潜在对称 (latent symmetry) 的部分可观测基准上，轨道划分 (orbit-based partitioning) 带来一致的性能提升，并因消除冗余而改善样本效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 范畴结构可以把抽象 RL 形式化与计算实现有原则地连接起来，对称约化是通向更结构化、更可扩展学习系统的路径。

papers.title: Limiting-Kernel Q($λ$): Bridging Short and Long Horizons
papers.abstract_en: In value-based reinforcement learning, improving the accuracy of policy evaluation has been shown to improve downstream policy optimization performance. The widely adopted family of approximations relying on $n$-step truncation yields computationally efficient value estimators but is inherently limited to a short evaluation horizon. In contrast, methods that exploit the global structure of the transition dynamics can accelerate policy evaluation, but their memory and computational requirements often limit scalability to large or continuous state spaces. To reconcile these limitations, we introduce Limiting-Kernel Q($λ$) (LKQL), an off-policy value estimator that combines $n$-step truncation with a long-horizon approximation based on the limiting kernel (LK). LKQL has the same order of complexity as $n$-step estimators and integrates directly into both on- and off-policy actor-critic algorithms. We prove that, under aperiodicity and in the near-on-policy regime, the operator underlying LKQL improves the policy evaluation convergence rate over its truncated counterpart for sufficiently large $n$, and that LKQL itself converges almost surely to the optimal values in finite Markov decision processes (MDPs) under a fixed behavior policy. On the MuJoCo continuous-control benchmark, we show that LKQL improves over $n$-step baselines in most settings, particularly on long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Limiting-Kernel Q(λ)（LKQL），把 n-step 截断与基于 limiting kernel 的长时程近似结合成 off-policy 价值估计器，在保持与 n-step 同阶复杂度的同时改善策略评估收敛速度。在 aperiodicity 与 near-on-policy 条件下，足够大的 n 时其算子收敛快于截断版本，且在有限 MDP、固定行为策略下几乎必然收敛到最优价值；MuJoCo 连续控制上多数设置优于 n-step 基线，长时程任务提升最明显。
Motivation: n-step 截断计算高效但评估时程受限，利用转移动力学全局结构的方法虽能加速却难以扩展到大规模或连续状态空间，价值评估精度不足会拖累下游策略优化。
Method: LKQL 将 n-step 截断与 limiting kernel（LK）长时程近似组合成 off-policy 价值估计器，复杂度与 n-step 同阶，可直接嵌入 on-policy 与 off-policy actor-critic 算法；理论部分在 aperiodicity 与 near-on-policy 区制下分析其算子收敛率，并在固定行为策略下证明有限 MDP 中的几乎必然收敛。
Result: 理论上证明：足够大的 n 时 LKQL 算子的策略评估收敛率优于对应截断估计器，且在有限 MDP、固定行为策略下几乎必然收敛到最优价值。实验上在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准中，多数设置优于 n-step 基线，在长时程任务上提升尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把 limiting kernel 的长时程结构并入 n-step 估计器，可以在不增加复杂度阶数的前提下同时拿到短时程效率与长时程收敛优势，长时程任务收益最大。

papers.title: MENO: Memory-Efficient Neural Operator
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Memory-Efficient Neural Operator (MENO) as a high-performance PDE neural solver based on the Manifold Function Encoder (MFE). MENO features three primary advantages: (1) MENO has a significantly smaller memory footprint and much faster training speed than other popular architectures, with the memory footprint being independent of the data resolution, and therefore holds the potential for scaling up to large-scale models. (2) MENO can accept PDE inputs of arbitrary form, including arbitrary geometric domains and arbitrary discretizations. In particular, it is capable of handling cross-geometry scenarios, i.e., where the input functions and the output solutions are defined on different manifolds. (3) MENO exhibits strong generalization capability, and achieves the best accuracy on most of the benchmarks we tested, compared with the results reported in the literature. The code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/jpzxshi/MENO, and all numerical examples in this paper can be run with a single command to reproduce the reported results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MENO 用 Manifold Function Encoder (MFE) 把 PDE 解算子编码到与数据分辨率无关的表示上，使显存占用不随离散分辨率增长、训练显著更快，并可接受任意几何域与任意离散的输入。它还支持输入函数与输出解定义在不同流形上的 cross-geometry 场景，在所测多数基准上取得与文献报告结果相比最好的精度。
Motivation: 主流 PDE 神经算子架构的显存随数据分辨率增长，训练慢、难以放大到大规模模型；同时对几何域与离散方式的适应性差，跨流形的输入输出场景难以处理。
Method: 以 Manifold Function Encoder (MFE) 为核心构建 MENO 这一 PDE 神经解算子，将输入函数编码为分辨率无关的表示，从而支持任意几何域、任意离散以及输入与输出位于不同流形的 cross-geometry 情形；代码在 GitHub 开源，数值算例可用单命令复现。
Result: 显存占用与数据分辨率无关，训练速度显著快于其他流行架构；在所测试的多数基准上取得与文献报告结果相比最好的精度。
Conclusion: 分辨率无关的流形函数编码可以让 PDE 神经解算子同时做到小显存、快训练、跨几何泛化，且精度不落后于已有方法。

papers.title: NS-ATTENTION: Newton-Schulz Transformations of Attention Outputs in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Newton-Schulz (NS) iteration has recently been used in the Muon optimizer to transform update matrices during the training of large language models. Motivated by its spectral effect, we investigate applying NS directly to Transformer attention representations. We introduce Newton-Schulz Attention (NS-Attn.), a parameter-free transformation applied to the output of each attention head. Each head output is arranged as a feature-by-token matrix and normalized by its Frobenius norm. We then apply a finite NS polynomial step and restore the original norm. The objective is to reduce spectral concentration and increase effective rank before standard head merging and output projection. Across ViT and Swin on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, NS-Attn. improves final-epoch accuracy in all 12 matched-seed comparisons, with mean gains of 0.25--0.83 percentage points. ViT ablations show higher mean accuracy with one iteration than with two. Spectral analysis further shows reduced leading-eigenvalue concentration and increased effective rank. These gains incur additional inference latency.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Muon 优化器里的 Newton-Schulz 迭代直接搬到 Vision Transformer 的注意力输出上：对每个 head 的特征×token 矩阵做 Frobenius 归一化、有限 NS 多项式一步、再还原范数，以降低谱集中、抬高有效秩。在 ViT 与 Swin 上 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 的 12 组同 seed 对比中最终 epoch 准确率全部提升，平均增益 0.25–0.83 个百分点，且一次迭代优于两次。
Motivation: 注意力输出的谱过度集中、有效秩偏低，会削弱 head merging 与输出投影前的表征容量；NS 迭代的谱效应此前只在 LLM 训练的 Muon 优化器中用于更新矩阵，未被直接用于注意力表征。
Method: 提出参数无关的 Newton-Schulz Attention (NS-Attn.)：把每个注意力头输出排成 feature-by-token 矩阵，用 Frobenius 范数归一化，施加一个有限 NS 多项式步 (finite NS polynomial step)，再恢复原范数，作用于标准 head merging 与输出投影之前；在 ViT 与 Swin 上做 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 训练，并做迭代次数消融与谱分析。
Result: ViT 与 Swin 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上全部 12 组 matched-seed 对比最终 epoch 准确率均提升，平均增益 0.25–0.83 个百分点；ViT 消融显示一次迭代的平均准确率高于两次；谱分析显示主特征值集中度下降、有效秩上升；代价是额外推理延迟。
Conclusion: 对注意力输出做一次 NS 谱整形即可在不引入参数的前提下小幅稳定提升 ViT/Swin 精度，迭代次数并非越多越好，但需为额外推理延迟买单。

summary_sections.result: ViT 与 Swin 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上全部 12 组 matched-seed 对比最终 epoch 准确率均提升，平均增益 0.25–0.83 个百分点；ViT 消融显示一次迭代的平均准确率高于两次；谱分析显示主特征值集中度下降、有效秩上升；代价是额外推理延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对注意力输出做一次 NS 谱整形即可在不引入参数的前提下小幅稳定提升 ViT/Swin 精度，迭代次数并非越多越好，但需为额外推理延迟买单。

papers.title: InfiNoVA: Infinite Novel View Augmentation for Viewpoint Invariant Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely strongly on the camera viewpoints seen during training, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed from unseen perspectives. Collecting demonstrations from sufficiently diverse physical viewpoints is expensive and still provides only sparse coverage of the viewpoint space. We introduce InfiNoVA, a data-augmentation framework that converts synchronized multi-camera demonstrations into a dense distribution of geometrically consistent training views. InfiNoVA reconstructs each manipulation trajectory as a time-varying 3D Gaussian representation and renders novel observations from sampled camera poses while preserving the original state-action correspondence. This explicit scene representation improves frame-level fidelity and temporal consistency while reducing task-critical hallucinations observed in generative novel-view synthesis. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained with InfiNoVA achieve 5.4x higher average success under unseen randomized viewpoints than both VISTA-based augmentation and the unaugmented policy. InfiNoVA further achieves 1.7x higher success than training directly on all five physical camera views. These results show that dense, geometrically grounded viewpoint augmentation provides a practical route toward camera-robust robot policies without modifying the underlying policy architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfiNoVA 把同步多相机演示重建为随时间变化的 3D Gaussian 场景表示，从采样相机位姿渲染几何一致的新视角并保持原状态-动作对应，从而密集扩充 VLA 策略的视角训练分布。在四个真实操作任务上，用 InfiNoVA 训练的策略在未见随机视角下平均成功率是 VISTA 增广与未增广策略的 5.4 倍，也比直接用全部五个物理相机视角训练高 1.7 倍。
Motivation: VLA 策略强烈依赖训练时见过的相机视角，换到未见视角性能大幅下降；而采集多视角演示昂贵且只能稀疏覆盖视角空间。
Method: 把每条操作轨迹重建为时变 3D Gaussian 表示，从采样相机位姿渲染新观测，同时保留原始状态-动作对应；用显式场景表示替代生成式新视角合成，以提升帧级保真与时间一致性、减少任务关键幻觉。
Result: 在四个真实操作任务上，InfiNoVA 增广训练的策略在未见随机视角下平均成功率相对 VISTA 增广和未增广策略提升 5.4 倍；相对直接使用全部五个物理相机视角训练提升 1.7 倍。
Conclusion: 密集且几何有据的视角增广能在不改动策略架构的前提下得到相机鲁棒的机器人策略，显式 3D 表示比生成式新视角合成更少产生任务关键幻觉。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AI-Driven Neural Surrogates for In Silico Design of Cognitive-Affective Neuromodulation Targets
papers.abstract_en: In neuropsychiatry, the primary goal is often not only to decode brain activity but to change it, for example to lessen a negative affective bias or an overly salient memory. Motivated by control theory, we develop an AI-driven neural-surrogate framework that proposes candidate representational changes and tests their predicted perceptual effects from snapshots of stimulus-evoked fMRI activity, without physical stimulation. The framework combines fMRI decoding, deep generative modeling, and constrained latent-space steering. Valence and memorability are used only as worked examples. Using more than 36,000 image-fMRI observations from four deeply sampled Natural Scenes Dataset participants, subject-specific models recovered coarse generative structure from visually responsive cortex (two-way identification, 0.79-0.88; chance, 0.5). Graded perturbations were reconstructed as images and evaluated with automated scorers and human ratings from 7,200 trials by 18 participants. In the primary VDVAE model, valence shifted from -0.61 to +1.03 SD and memorability from -1.34 to +1.45 SD; a later Versatile Diffusion refinement reduced or altered these effects. Across five perturbation levels, human valence ratings moved in the predicted direction under the linear time-correction model (mean slope, 0.038 SD per unit of alpha; 95 percent CI, 0.003-0.074; positive in 16 of 18 participants). Perceived memorability did not change reliably. Baseline agreement with the automated assessor was suggestive for valence (r = 0.30) and weak for memorability (r = 0.10). Extreme perturbations drifted from the original stimulus, so intended change must be weighed against loss of fidelity. These findings provide a falsifiable upstream method for designing and behaviorally testing candidate representational targets for future neuromodulation in psychiatry, while marking the limits of the present static approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由控制论启发的 AI 神经代理框架：从刺激诱发 fMRI 快照解码并做受约束的潜空间操控 (constrained latent-space steering)，在不施加物理刺激的情况下预测表征改变的感知效应。在 Natural Scenes Dataset 四名深度采样被试的 36,000+ 条 image-fMRI 观测上，VDVAE 模型把 valence 从 -0.61 推到 +1.03 SD、memorability 从 -1.34 推到 +1.45 SD；18 名被试 7,200 次试验中人类 valence 评分按预测方向移动（斜率 0.038 SD/单位 alpha，95% CI 0.003–0.074，16/18 被试为正），memorability 则无可靠变化。
Motivation: 神经精神科的目标常是改变而非仅解码脑活动（如削弱负性情绪偏向），但直接在人体上试错式寻找表征靶点代价高，需要先在体外 (in silico) 设计并检验候选改变。
Method: 框架结合 fMRI 解码、深度生成建模与受约束潜空间操控：用被试特异模型从视觉皮层活动重建图像，valence 与 memorability 作为示例目标，主模型为 VDVAE，另有 Versatile Diffusion 精化版本；扰动效应先用自动评分器评估，再由人类评分验证，采用线性 time-correction 模型拟合。
Result: 双向识别 (two-way identification) 0.79–0.88（chance 0.5）；VDVAE 下 valence -0.61 → +1.03 SD、memorability -1.34 → +1.45 SD，Versatile Diffusion 精化减弱或改变了这些效应；五个扰动水平下人类 valence 评分斜率 0.038 SD/单位 alpha（95% CI 0.003–0.074），18 人中 16 人为正；memorability 无可靠变化；与自动评分器的基线一致性 valence r = 0.30、memorability r = 0.10。
Conclusion: 该框架为未来精神科神经调控提供可证伪的上游靶点设计与行为检验方法，但极端扰动会使图像偏离原始刺激，预期改变量必须与保真度损失权衡，属静态近似。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuralSRNF: Neural Square Root Normal Fields for the Statistical Shape Analysis and Generation of Nonrigid 3D and 4D Objects
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NeuralSRNF, a novel framework for the statistical shape analysis and generation of genus-zero 3D and 4D objects that undergo nonrigid deformations. Traditional methods rely on complex and computationally expensive nonlinear elastic metrics that measure bending and stretching. Recent advances in elastic shape analysis achieve computational efficiency by mapping input 3D shapes to the space of Square Root Normal Fields (SRNFs) where the L2 metric approximates the partial elastic metric, significantly facilitating the process of computing geodesics and summary statistics. SRNFs, however, are not invertible, and the numerical algorithms used to map SRNFs back to the original space of surfaces remain computationally very expensive and often lead to approximate results. This paper addresses this fundamental SRNF inversion problem using a novel neural representation, termed NeuralSRNF. Unlike the commonly used numerical SRNF, NeuralSRNF is (1) continuous, and thus resolution-agnostic, enabling full functional shape analysis, (2) more accurate, and (3) computationally more efficient as it can compute inverse SRNF maps along a geodesic path in less than 3 s compared to over 10 min for the numerical SRNF. We demonstrate, using various datasets, the utility and efficiency of the proposed NeuralSRNF in multiple elastic 3D and 4D shape analysis tasks such as geodesic computation, deformation transfer, statistical summaries computation, and 3D shape generation. We show that it outperforms competing methods on most evaluated datasets and metrics by a wide margin in both accuracy and computational efficiency. The source code and additional results are available at https://awaisnizamani16.github.io/awais/NeuralSRNF/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuralSRNF 用连续的神经表示替代数值 Square Root Normal Fields，解决 SRNF 不可逆且反演昂贵的问题，可在 3 秒内沿测地线求逆映射（数值 SRNF 需 10 分钟以上），并支持分辨率无关的 3D/4D 形状分析与生成。
Motivation: SRNF 映射使 L2 度量近似部分弹性度量，但不可逆，数值反演算法计算昂贵且常只给近似结果，阻碍了完整的函数式形状分析。
Method: 提出 NeuralSRNF 神经表示，连续、分辨率无关，用于 genus-zero 非刚性 3D/4D 物体的测地线计算、变形迁移、统计摘要与 3D 形状生成。
Result: 沿测地线求逆 SRNF 映射耗时低于 3 秒，数值 SRNF 需超过 10 分钟；在多个数据集的多数评估指标上以较大差距优于竞争方法，兼得精度与效率。
Conclusion: 神经化 SRNF 反演可同时解决不可逆性、精度与效率问题，成为弹性形状分析中数值反演的可行替代。

papers.title: FFM-CP: Cross-Backbone Fusion of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Few-Shot Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Pathology vision-language foundation models vary in performance across diseases and tasks, with no single model consistently performing best. The high cost of expert pathology annotation can also limit the labeled data available for task-specific adaptation. Combining complementary pretrained representations is a potential approach to these limitations, yet learning an effective fusion from few labeled examples remains challenging. We introduce Few-shot Fusion Foundation Models of Computational Pathology (FFM-CP), which is a framework that combines multiple pathology vision-language models in the few-shot learning setting. The framework first aligns heterogeneous representations using a closed-form Orthogonal Procrustes transformation estimated from corresponding support images. This alignment preserves within-model feature geometry without training an additional alignment network. Within the aligned space, a unified graph enables information exchange across backbones by jointly refining support-image features and visual and textual class prototypes. These refined representations support complementary text-prototype and case-retrieval branches that capture semantic class knowledge and within-class visual variation, respectively. Each branch learns to combine predictions from all ordered backbone pairs, allowing queries encoded by one model to draw on evidence represented by another. We evaluate three backbone combinations on six histopathology datasets at 4, 8, and 16 shots per class. FFM-CP achieves higher mean macro-F1 than the strongest individually adapted member of each fused set in 50 of 54 comparisons. These findings suggest that combining complementary pretrained representations can improve histopathological classification when annotations are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FFM-CP 在少样本计算病理学设定下融合多个病理视觉-语言基础模型：先用支撑图像估计的闭式正交 Procrustes 变换对齐异构表征，再在统一图上联合精修支持图像特征与视觉/文本类原型，最后由文本原型分支与病例检索分支组合所有有序骨干对的预测。在六个组织病理数据集、每类 4/8/16 shot 下，54 组对比中有 50 组的 mean macro-F1 高于各融合集合中单独适配最强的成员。
Motivation: 病理视觉-语言基础模型在不同疾病和任务上各有胜负，没有单一模型稳定最优；而专家标注昂贵导致可用标注极少，从少量标注中学习有效的跨模型融合本身也很困难。
Method: FFM-CP 框架分三步：用对应支撑图像估计闭式正交 Procrustes 变换对齐异构骨干表征（不额外训练对齐网络，保留模型内特征几何）；在对齐空间中用统一图联合精修支撑图像特征与视觉、文本类原型；精修后的表征驱动互补的 text-prototype 分支与 case-retrieval 分支，每个分支学习组合所有有序骨干对的预测，使单一模型编码的查询可借用另一模型的证据。
Result: 在六个组织病理数据集、每类 4、8、16 shot 的设定下评测三种骨干组合，FFM-CP 在 54 组对比中的 50 组取得高于各融合集合中最强单独适配成员的 mean macro-F1。
Conclusion: 在标注受限时，组合互补的预训练表征可以提升组织病理分类效果，且对齐加图上原型精修的融合路径在少样本下有效。

papers.title: DAVIO: Dense Monocular-Inertial SLAM with Feed-Forward Initialization and Pose-Conditioned Mapping
papers.abstract_en: A camera and an IMU are the minimal sensor setup for metric localization and dense mapping, yet classical visual--inertial filters must wait for parallax before they start and then retain only sparse landmarks. Feed-forward geometry models, in contrast, predict dense structure from a few images but provide neither metric scale nor gravity. We present DAVIO, which uses a single multi-view depth model, Depth Anything~3, for both start-up and mapping. At start-up, a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements form a feature-free linear system. Its robust, conditioning-checked solution bootstraps a VIO filter through buffered replay. During tracking, the filter's metric poses condition the depth model. Residual scale is corrected only along viewing rays, which preserves the metric camera baselines, and a gravity-preserving submap graph with drift-gated revisits refines the map. On EuRoC, DAVIO starts markedly earlier, reduces the localization error, and maps more accurately than SOTA feed-forward mappers given identical poses. On building-scale ORI sequences, DAVIO is on bar or better than SOTA mappers on the same odometry, and degrades far less when GT poses are replaced by real odometry. We release the code of DAVIO, a real-time dense metric SLAM system, to the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAVIO 用单个前馈深度模型 Depth Anything 3 同时完成 VIO 启动与稠密建图：启动时用五帧窗口加预积分 IMU 构造无特征线性系统，鲁棒且经条件数检查的解通过缓冲回放引导滤波器；跟踪中用滤波器的度量位姿条件化深度模型，残差尺度只沿视线方向校正以保住度量基线，再用保重力子图与漂移门限回环精化地图。在 EuRoC 上比同位姿的 SOTA 前馈建图器启动更早、定位误差更小、建图更准；在建筑尺度 ORI 序列上持平或更好，且真值位姿换成真实里程计时退化远小于对比方法。
Motivation: 经典 VIO 滤波器要等视差才能启动且只留稀疏路标；前馈几何模型能从少量图像预测稠密结构，却没有度量尺度与重力方向，两者各自缺一半。
Method: 启动阶段取五帧图像窗口与预积分 IMU 构成无特征线性系统，求鲁棒并做条件数检查的解，经 buffered replay 引导 VIO 滤波器；跟踪阶段用滤波器输出的度量位姿去条件化 Depth Anything 3，残差尺度仅沿 viewing rays 校正，配合保重力子图 (gravity-preserving submap) 与漂移门限的 revisit 精化地图。
Result: 在 EuRoC 上，DAVIO 启动明显更早，定位误差下降，且在给定相同位姿时建图精度优于 SOTA 前馈建图器；在建筑尺度 ORI 序列上，同一里程计输入下与 SOTA 建图器持平或更好，当真值位姿被真实里程计替换时性能退化幅度远小于对比方法。
Conclusion: 前馈深度模型可以在被度量位姿与重力约束后直接充当 VIO 的启动器与建图器，得到可实时运行的稠密度量 SLAM，并开源代码。

papers.title: SynSeq: End-to-End SYNTAX Score Prediction from Coronary Angiography Videos
papers.abstract_en: The SYNTAX score is an established tool for assessing coronary artery disease and guiding revascularization treatment decisions. However, its manual estimation from coronary angiography videos by clinical experts is time-consuming and subject to inter-reader variability. While machine learning has shown promise in automating this process, prior work has primarily focused on lesion detection, characterization, or binary disease classification, leaving direct SYNTAX score prediction relatively unexplored. We propose SynSeq, a video-based method for direct SYNTAX score prediction. It combines targeted preprocessing with a tailored training strategy using a zero-inflation-aware loss and linear target scaling. Evaluated on the public CardioSyntax dataset, SynSeq significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, improving $R^2$ by 0.55, reducing prediction bias by 93.1% and achieving more consistent performance across annotations from three independent expert graders. In addition, SynSeq achieves a weighted $F_1$-score of 0.80 for revascularization treatment recommendations, slightly below inter-expert agreement. These results demonstrate the potential of SynSeq to provide consistent, automated SYNTAX score assessment and reliable decision support for coronary revascularization planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynSeq 直接从冠状动脉造影视频回归 SYNTAX 评分，用针对性预处理加零膨胀感知损失 (zero-inflation-aware loss) 与线性目标缩放的训练策略。在公开 CardioSyntax 数据集上较此前 SOTA 将 R² 提升 0.55、预测偏差降低 93.1%，血运重建建议的 weighted F1 达 0.80，略低于专家间一致性。
Motivation: SYNTAX 评分靠专家手工读片，耗时且存在 inter-reader variability；既有自动化工作集中在病灶检测与二分类，直接回归评分基本空白。
Method: 视频级端到端回归：针对性预处理 + 定制训练策略，损失采用 zero-inflation-aware 形式并配合 linear target scaling，以应对评分分布的零膨胀与量纲。
Result: 在公开 CardioSyntax 数据集上，较先前 SOTA 的 R² 提升 0.55，预测偏差降低 93.1%，且在三位独立专家标注上表现更一致；血运重建治疗建议 weighted F1-score 为 0.80，略低于 inter-expert agreement。
Conclusion: 直接回归 SYNTAX 评分可提供一致的自动化评估，作为冠脉血运重建规划的决策支持，其建议准确度已接近专家间一致性水平。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Gender Bias in Vision-Language In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables large vision-language models (LVLMs) to perform tasks by following patterns from in-context examples, yet its potential to amplify societal biases remains underexplored. We systematically investigate how ICL influences gender bias in LVLMs through VL-BICLE, an evaluation framework comprising six ICL settings, three tasks, and four datasets. Our experiments on six LVLMs reveal that gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force, shifting model bias toward the demonstrated gender through a cross-gender mechanism that disproportionately degrades performance on the opposite gender. This effect appears in image captioning and pronoun prediction but not in visual question answering, indicating that gendered ICL influences bias only when the task output involves gendered language. Similarity-based retrieval methods inherit the training pool's gender imbalance and offer no debiasing advantage, while standard quality metrics remain blind to these bias shifts. To mitigate this bias, we replace real in-context images with synthetic ones from stable diffusion models while keeping captions unchanged. This simple intervention reduces gender bias without degrading caption quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VL-BICLE 框架在六个 LVLM、三类任务、四个数据集上显示：带性别倾向的 in-context 示例会把模型偏见定向推向被示范的性别，并通过 cross-gender 机制显著拉低相反性别的表现；该效应出现在图像描述与代词预测中，但在视觉问答 (VQA) 中不出现，因为其输出不涉及性别化语言。用 Stable Diffusion 生成的合成图像替换真实 in-context 图像（caption 不变）可在不损失描述质量的前提下降低性别偏见。
Motivation: Vision-language 模型的 in-context learning (ICL) 会放大社会性偏见，但这一风险此前缺少系统评估，且现有质量指标对偏见漂移不敏感。
Method: 提出评估框架 VL-BICLE，覆盖六种 ICL 设置、三类任务、四个数据集，在六个 LVLM 上测量性别偏见方向性漂移；缓解手段是用 Stable Diffusion 合成图像替换真实 in-context 图像、caption 保持不变，并对比 similarity-based retrieval 基线。
Result: 性别化 ICL 示例使偏见朝被示范性别定向移动，交叉性别机制使相反性别表现不成比例地下降；该效应在 image captioning 与 pronoun prediction 中出现，在 VQA 中不出现。Similarity-based retrieval 继承训练池性别失衡、无去偏优势；标准质量指标对这些偏见漂移不敏感；合成图像干预降低性别偏见且不损害 caption 质量。
Conclusion: 性别化 ICL 只在输出含性别化语言的任务上推动偏见，替换为合成 in-context 图像是一种不牺牲质量的去偏手段。

papers.title: CasCVS-Net: A Staged Multi-Task Cascade for Critical View of Safety Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated assessment of the Critical View of Safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy requires both recognition of the three CVS criteria and anatomical grounding in small, rare, and often occluded hepatocystic structures. Learning-based methods differ in the anatomical information they use, from image-level classification to detection, segmentation, or graph-based reasoning, yet grounding the safety-critical anatomy remains the main bottleneck. We propose CasCVS-Net, a staged multi-task cascade that jointly performs object detection, semantic segmentation, and CVS assessment, trained on the Endoscapes dataset. The model couples the tasks through predicted anatomy: predicted boxes guide segmentation, and predicted masks provide region-level features for CVS classification, so CVS assessment at inference uses only model predictions rather than ground-truth annotations. To reduce optimisation instability in this coupled setting, training progresses from detection to detection-segmentation and then to the full three-task cascade, followed by task-wise fine-tuning. Evaluation on the public unseen test set shows that CasCVS-Net improves over matched single-task baselines on all three tasks, achieving 32.0 detection mAP, 46.8 semantic mIoU, 15.3 rare-anatomy mIoU, and 67.2 CVS mAP. It outperforms the state-of-the-art LG-CVS and SV2LSTG by 6.3% and 4.5% relative CVS mAP, respectively, corresponding to 4.0 and 2.9 mAP points. These results show that staged task coupling through predicted boxes and masks improves anatomical grounding for CVS assessment, particularly for rare hepatocystic structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CasCVS-Net 把腹腔镜胆囊切除术中 Critical View of Safety (CVS) 评估做成检测、分割、分类三任务的分阶段级联：预测框引导分割，预测掩膜再提供区域特征给 CVS 分类，推理时只用模型自身预测而不用真值标注。在 Endoscapes 公开未见测试集上取得 32.0 检测 mAP、46.8 语义 mIoU、15.3 稀有解剖 mIoU、67.2 CVS mAP，CVS mAP 相对 LG-CVS 与 SV2LSTG 分别高 6.3% 与 4.5%（4.0 与 2.9 个 mAP 点）。
Motivation: CVS 自动评估既要识别三条判据，又要在小、罕见、常被遮挡的肝胆三角结构上做解剖定位；现有方法从图像级分类到检测、分割、图推理不一，但安全关键解剖的 grounding 仍是主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 staged multi-task cascade：目标检测、语义分割与 CVS 评估三任务通过预测解剖耦合（预测框引导分割，预测掩膜提供区域级特征做 CVS 分类）；训练按检测 → 检测+分割 → 三任务全级联分阶段推进，再做逐任务微调，以缓解耦合带来的优化不稳定；在 Endoscapes 数据集上训练。
Result: 在公开未见测试集上，三项任务均优于匹配的单任务基线：检测 mAP 32.0，语义 mIoU 46.8，稀有解剖 mIoU 15.3，CVS mAP 67.2；相对 SOTA 的 LG-CVS 与 SV2LSTG，CVS mAP 分别高 6.3% 和 4.5%（即 4.0 与 2.9 个 mAP 点）。
Conclusion: 通过预测框与掩膜做分阶段任务耦合能改善 CVS 评估的解剖 grounding，对罕见肝胆三角结构尤其有效；CVS 判定在推理阶段可完全依赖模型自身预测。

papers.title: What Do Tabular Foundation Models Compute In Context? In-Situ Representation Refinement through Attention-Gated Updates
papers.abstract_en: What reusable computation should a tabular foundation model learn when every table defines a new supervised task? We develop in-situ representation refinement: support labels guide updates to the episode's representations, and these updates transfer to unlabeled queries without changing model parameters. A regularized leave-one-out objective yields a support correction and its query extension. The leading term separates attention-based reading from state-dependent scaling, motivating RefineICL: an attention-gated, FFN-free contextual stack with selected low-rank feature interaction and typed memory. RefineICL-L24 reaches 0.93836 OVR-AUC and 0.87173 accuracy on AMLB29. A benchmark-informed continuation reaches 1644.8 Elo on the 38-dataset TabArena snapshot, 31.4 Elo above TabPFN-3 under the same evaluation. It also improves all four reported metrics over TabPFN-v3 on both TabZilla views. In a matched 100K-update depth grid, an expanded FFN gives no consistent validation benefit and uses 60.2% more peak inference memory at L8. Internal interventions show that support representations are more than a static source of labels: removing one intermediate support update, while preserving the query output, increases final query cross-entropy in all 72 tested episodes. Together, the derivation and interventions explain how attention-gated updates can construct a task-specific predictor in context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格基础模型的上下文计算被重构为 in-situ representation refinement：支持集标签驱动对 episode 表示的更新并外推到无标签查询，且不改模型参数。由此导出的 RefineICL（attention-gated、无 FFN 的上下文栈）在 AMLB29 上达到 0.93836 OVR-AUC、0.87173 accuracy，TabArena 38 数据集快照 1644.8 Elo，比同评测下的 TabPFN-3 高 31.4 Elo。
Motivation: 每张表都是一个新的有监督任务，问题在于表格基础模型在上下文中究竟应学到什么可复用计算，以及支持集信息如何在不更新参数的情况下塑造查询预测。
Method: 用正则化 leave-one-out 目标导出 support correction 及其 query 扩展，其主项把 attention-based reading 与 state-dependent scaling 分离，据此设计 RefineICL：attention-gated、FFN-free 的上下文栈，含选定的低秩特征交互与 typed memory；另做 100K-update 深度网格与内部干预（移除一次中间 support 更新）。
Result: RefineICL-L24 在 AMLB29 上 0.93836 OVR-AUC、0.87173 accuracy；benchmark-informed continuation 在 TabArena 38 数据集快照上 1644.8 Elo，比同评测的 TabPFN-3 高 31.4 Elo；在 TabZilla 两个视图上均改进相对 TabPFN-v3 的全部四项指标；100K-update 深度网格中扩大 FFN 无一致验证收益，且 L8 峰值推理内存多用 60.2%；移除一次中间 support 更新（保持查询输出不变）使全部 72 个测试 episode 的最终查询 cross-entropy 上升。
Conclusion: 支持集表示不是静态标签来源：attention-gated 的中间更新在上下文中逐步构造任务特定预测器，而加深 FFN 在该设置下不带来一致收益却增加推理内存。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: RefineICL-L24 在 AMLB29 上 0.93836 OVR-AUC、0.87173 accuracy；benchmark-informed continuation 在 TabArena 38 数据集快照上 1644.8 Elo，比同评测的 TabPFN-3 高 31.4 Elo；在 TabZilla 两个视图上均改进相对 TabPFN-v3 的全部四项指标；100K-update 深度网格中扩大 FFN 无一致验证收益，且 L8 峰值推理内存多用 60.2%；移除一次中间 support 更新（保持查询输出不变）使全部 72 个测试 episode 的最终查询 cross-entropy 上升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 支持集表示不是静态标签来源：attention-gated 的中间更新在上下文中逐步构造任务特定预测器，而加深 FFN 在该设置下不带来一致收益却增加推理内存。

papers.title: RoadOcc Learns When to Persist, Transport, or Refresh Memory for Roadside Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Fixed roadside cameras repeatedly observe a stable scene overlaid by sparse moving traffic. Temporal memory can recover weak observations, but reusing moving evidence at stale locations can corrupt occupancy predictions. Motion compensation addresses displacement, while reliance on the resulting history remains a separate learning problem. We introduce RoadOcc, which learns soft routing among fixed-coordinate history (\emph{Persist}), velocity-addressed history (\emph{Transport}), and current evidence (\emph{Refresh}). Motion state and class-consistent historical support supervise these source choices. Dynamic-aware cross-attention (DCA) updates candidate locations, multi-scale voxel velocity estimation (VVE) constructs transport addresses from multi-scale current--history correspondence, and velocity-guided dynamic sparse fusion (VDSF) combines routed evidence under fixed sparse-token budgets. On InfraOcc, RoadOcc reaches 65.29 mIoU and 32.37 dynamic mIoU, gains of 4.44 and 4.71 over STCOcc. Controlled address experiments show that VVE raises dynamic mIoU by 0.87 over fixed-coordinate reading. Across three seeds, supervised P/T/R adds 1.40 dynamic points over motion-corrected retrieval, while removing Refresh costs 0.32 points. Results from two transfer models, Occ3D-nuScenes, and longer intervals provide additional support. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoadOcc 针对路侧固定相机的占据预测，学习在固定坐标历史 (Persist)、按速度寻址的历史 (Transport) 与当前证据 (Refresh) 之间做软路由，用运动状态与类别一致的历史支撑监督路由选择。在 InfraOcc 上达到 65.29 mIoU 与 32.37 动态 mIoU，较 STCOcc 分别高出 4.44 与 4.71；动态感知跨注意力、多尺度体素速度估计与速度引导动态稀疏融合共同构成其证据更新机制。
Motivation: 路侧相机场景稳定、运动目标稀疏，时序记忆能恢复弱观测，但把过期位置的运动证据复用会污染占据预测；运动补偿只解决位移，如何依赖补偿后的历史本身是独立的学习问题。
Method: RoadOcc 在 Persist、Transport、Refresh 三源间做软路由，由运动状态与类别一致的历史支撑监督；动态感知跨注意力 (DCA) 更新候选位置，多尺度体素速度估计 (VVE) 由多尺度当前-历史对应关系构造传输地址，速度引导动态稀疏融合 (VDSF) 在固定稀疏 token 预算下合并路由证据。
Result: 在 InfraOcc 上 RoadOcc 取得 65.29 mIoU 与 32.37 动态 mIoU，比 STCOcc 高 4.44 与 4.71；受控地址实验中 VVE 比固定坐标读取提高 0.87 动态 mIoU；三个随机种子上，有监督 P/T/R 比运动校正检索多 1.40 个动态点，去掉 Refresh 损失 0.32 点；两个迁移模型、Occ3D-nuScenes 与更长间隔的结果提供进一步支持。
Conclusion: 路侧占据预测中，何时保留、传输还是刷新记忆应作为可学习的路由问题，而非仅靠运动补偿解决；代码将开源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Track2Art: Motion-Centric Articulated Object Model Recovery from 2D Point Trackers
papers.abstract_en: Understanding articulated objects is fundamental for robotic interaction, requiring accurate rigid-part discovery and the recovery of their kinematic relations. Existing approaches often treat articulation as a by-product of reconstructed geometry or recover it through per-instance optimization. We instead build on the hypothesis that articulation is directly observable from persistent motion: points on the same rigid part move coherently, while relative motion between parts reveals their kinematic constraints. We present Track2Art, a motion-centric framework for recovering structured articulated objects from RGB-D interaction videos. Track2Art lifts tracked image points into persistent 3D trajectories and combines pretrained tracking features, visual descriptors, and explicit trajectory geometry. These representations are grouped into a variable number of rigid-part hypotheses and subsequently used to recover directed kinematic relations, joint types, and joint geometry through rotation-equivariant learned--analytic reasoning. On the aligned 20-object PartNet-Mobility suite, Track2Art achieves 0.695 Point IoU and 0.410 end-to-end J@20, while requiring neither ground-truth part counts nor test-time optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Track2Art 从 RGB-D 交互视频中的 2D 点轨迹直接恢复铰接物体的刚性部件与运动学关系：把跟踪点抬升为持久 3D 轨迹，聚类出可变数量的刚体假设，再用旋转等变的 learned-analytic 推理恢复关节类型与几何。在 PartNet-Mobility 20 物体上取得 0.695 Point IoU 与 0.410 end-to-end J@20，且不需要真值部件数与 test-time optimization。
Motivation: 现有方法把铰接当作几何重建的副产物，或依赖逐实例优化，既需要真值部件数又在测试时优化，难以从交互视频中直接、结构化地恢复刚性部件与运动学约束。
Method: Track2Art 将跟踪的图像点抬升为持久 3D 轨迹，融合预训练 tracking 特征、视觉描述子与显式轨迹几何；把这些表示聚类成可变数量的刚体部件假设，再通过 rotation-equivariant learned-analytic reasoning 恢复有向运动学关系、关节类型与关节几何。
Result: 在对齐的 20-object PartNet-Mobility suite 上，Point IoU 为 0.695，end-to-end J@20 为 0.410，同时不需要真值部件数，也不做 test-time optimization。
Conclusion: 铰接关系可直接从持续运动中观测得到：以点轨迹的运动一致性为主线索，就能在不依赖真值部件数与逐实例优化的条件下恢复结构化铰接物体模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SGDet3D++: Geometry-Grounded Semantics for 4D Radar and Camera 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: 4D radar complements dense image semantics with long-range geometry and radial motion, but existing radar--camera detectors largely solve \emph{where} to align the modalities while leaving \emph{whether} a piece of evidence supports an evolving object hypothesis implicit. An image token may describe an occluder, a nearby radar return may belong to another object, and a pose-aligned memory slot may carry incompatible motion. We formulate \emph{hypothesis-conditioned evidence grounding}, which separates candidate access from evidence use: semantic, geometric, or temporal evidence is filtered or conditioned by the evolving 3D state before updating the corresponding query. \sgdetpp{} instantiates this principle through Anchor-Grounded Semantic Retrieval (AGR), which conditions deformable image retrieval on pooled anchor-consistent radar support; Geometry-Consistent Anchor Refinement (GCR), which attentively aggregates individual associated returns; and Doppler-Verified Correspondence (DVC), which replaces history only when current radial motion contradicts it. \sgdetpp{} improves the strongest compared method by 3.82 mAP and 6.82 ODS on OmniHD-Scenes and by 6.82 mAP and 9.22 NDS on ManTruckScenes, while also leading the listed methods in the TJ4DRadSet test comparison. Mechanism-targeted evaluations show that AGR improves strict AP in every projected-occlusion bin, the yaw-aligned box gate raises target-return purity from 29.95\% to 58.87\%, and DVC preserves 96.11\% of motion-consistent history while retaining 75.90\% contradiction recall. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGDet3D++ 把 4D radar–camera 3D 检测中的证据使用显式化为「假设条件化的证据落地」：语义、几何、时间证据先被当前演化 3D 状态过滤再更新 query。在 OmniHD-Scenes 上比最强对比方法高 3.82 mAP 与 6.82 ODS，ManTruckScenes 上高 6.82 mAP 与 9.22 NDS，yaw 对齐框门把目标回波纯度从 29.95% 提到 58.87%。
Motivation: 现有 radar–camera 检测器只解决模态在哪对齐，不判断某条证据是否支持当前目标假设：图像 token 可能是遮挡物、邻近雷达回波可能属于他物、位姿对齐的记忆槽可能携带不相容运动。
Method: 三个模块实例化该原则：Anchor-Grounded Semantic Retrieval (AGR) 用池化的 anchor 一致雷达支持来条件化 deformable 图像检索；Geometry-Consistent Anchor Refinement (GCR) 注意力聚合单个关联回波；Doppler-Verified Correspondence (DVC) 仅在当前径向运动与历史矛盾时替换历史。
Result: OmniHD-Scenes 上较最强对比方法 +3.82 mAP、+6.82 ODS，ManTruckScenes 上 +6.82 mAP、+9.22 NDS，并在 TJ4DRadSet test 对比中领先所列方法；机制评测中 AGR 在每个投影遮挡分箱都提升 strict AP，yaw 对齐框门使目标回波纯度由 29.95% 升至 58.87%，DVC 保留 96.11% 运动一致历史同时保持 75.90% 矛盾召回。
Conclusion: 把「是否该用这条证据」与「在哪对齐模态」分开处理，可在 4D radar–camera 检测上同时提升检测指标与证据纯度；代码将开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 THESEUS 导航与可追溯性框架，把 KGQA 拆成逐跳图动作选择，用冻结的本地 SLM 作策略，同时度量终点答案 Hits@1 与路径保真度 Path Edit Distance (PED)。在 Kinship 与 MQuAKE-ST 上，同规模模型的答案准确率与路径保真度差异很大且两指标有时指向不同模型，单条示范轨迹对导航的改善或损害也随模型而变。作者主张图推理评测不能只看终点准确率。
Motivation: 端到端 KGQA 把图访问、搜索、导航、推理与答案生成耦合在一起，既无法判断 SLM 是否忠实执行了问题隐含的推理路径，也无法把失败归因到导航而非流水线其他环节。
Method: 采用 THESEUS 导航与可追溯性框架，将冻结的现成 SLM 作为本地动作策略：每跳环境给出合法出边图动作，模型只选一个可执行图动作并决定是否停止，不做任务相关参数更新、不用模型控制的 beam search、不生成自由文本答案。
Result: 在 Kinship 与 MQuAKE-ST 两个 KGQA 上，用 Hits@1 度量终点答案准确率、用 Path Edit Distance (PED) 度量路径保真度；同规模本地模型在两项指标上差异显著，且两指标有时偏好不同模型。单条示范轨迹对导航的效果依模型而定，可能提升也可能降低。
Conclusion: SLM 的图推理评测必须同时看路径保真度，只报终点准确率会掩盖导航层面的模型差异与提示敏感性。

papers.title: Robust Adversarial Reinforcement Learning with Risk Sensitivity and Critic Consistency Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) achieves strong performance in sequential decision-making but remains brittle under dynamic uncertainty and distributional shifts. Robust Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (RARL) improves robustness via worst-case perturbations, but existing approaches frequently suffer from unstable optimization and degraded value estimation. In particular, overly aggressive adversaries can drive the agent toward uninformative failure states, while adversarial perturbations amplify disagreement between double critics and introduce biased value targets. We propose a unified framework, RACER (Risk-sensitive robust Adversarial critic ConsistEncy-regularized Reinforcement learning), that revisits adversarial RL from a risk-sensitive perspective. First, we introduce a state-dependent adversarial objective that adaptively regulates perturbation strength, suppressing harmful disturbances while preserving informative exploration. Second, we propose critic consistency regularization to reduce disagreement between Q-value estimators and stabilize learning. Comprehensive experiments on challenging continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that RACER consistently improves performance, robustness, and training stability over strong robust RL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 RARL 中过强对抗扰动把智能体推向无信息失败状态、并放大双 critic 分歧的问题，提出 RACER：用状态相关的对抗目标自适应调节扰动强度，同时对 Q 值估计加 critic 一致性正则。在连续控制基准上，RACER 相对强鲁棒 RL 基线一致提升性能、鲁棒性与训练稳定性。
Motivation: RARL 用最坏情况扰动提升鲁棒性，但优化不稳、价值估计退化：过强的对手把智能体带进无信息失败状态，对抗扰动又放大双 critic 分歧并引入有偏价值目标。
Method: RACER（Risk-sensitive robust Adversarial critic ConsistEncy-regularized RL）从风险敏感视角重构对抗 RL：一是状态相关的对抗目标，自适应调节扰动强度，抑制有害扰动同时保留有信息的探索；二是 critic 一致性正则，减小 Q 值估计器之间的分歧以稳定学习。
Result: 在有挑战的连续控制基准上，RACER 相对强鲁棒 RL 基线在性能、鲁棒性和训练稳定性三方面均一致更好；摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: Evolutionary Stability Does Not Guarantee Learning Accessibility: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Perspective on Cooperation Emergence
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation emergence is a central problem in multi-agent systems because decentralized agents must coordinate while adapting to the changing behavior of others. Evolutionary game theory identifies strategically stable outcomes, but stability under a population adjustment dynamic need not imply that finite-sample learning agents can reach the same outcome through local reward feedback. We study this distinction in a transparent three-agent governance-motivated game involving a government, a platform firm, and users. We derive replicator dynamics for the fixed stage-game incentives, evaluate the cooperative evolutionary basin on a symmetric initial-condition grid, and compare it with learning-basin estimates for three decentralized value-based learners. The learning analysis uses independent Q-learning with $\varepsilon$-greedy action selection, scaled Boltzmann exploration, and SA--EA BQL under the same payoff environment and outcome criterion. The evolutionary basin has volume $V_E=1.00$ on the sampled grid. The empirical learning basin is $0.88$ for $\varepsilon$-IQL and $0.00$ for both scaled Boltzmann and SA--EA BQL. Diagnostic traces show that broader action diversity and nonzero value separation can coexist with failure to sustain the cooperative joint action in this fixed configuration. These results indicate that evolutionary stability and learning accessibility are distinct properties of a coupled game--learning system. The shared-bike setting is a motivating application; the broader contribution is a framework for comparing population-level stability with the finite-sample accessibility of cooperation under specified multi-agent learning dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在政府—平台—用户三方治理博弈中，演化稳定的合作盆地体积为 1.00，但有限样本学习者未必能到达：ε-IQL 的经验学习盆地仅 0.88，scaled Boltzmann 探索与 SA–EA BQL 均为 0.00。结论是演化稳定性与学习可达性是耦合博弈—学习系统的两个不同性质，评估合作涌现必须同时报告两者。
Motivation: 演化博弈给出的策略稳定结局不保证去中心化、靠局部奖励反馈的有限样本学习智能体能到达同一结局，而现有分析常把两者混为一谈。
Method: 在三方（政府、平台企业、用户）治理博弈中推导固定阶段博弈激励下的 replicator dynamics，在对称初始条件网格上评估合作演化盆地，并在同一收益与结局判据下比较三种去中心化 value-based 学习者：ε-greedy 的 independent Q-learning、scaled Boltzmann 探索、以及 SA–EA BQL。
Result: 演化盆地在采样网格上体积 V_E=1.00；经验学习盆地 ε-IQL 为 0.88，scaled Boltzmann 与 SA–EA BQL 均为 0.00。诊断轨迹显示更宽的动作多样性与非零价值分离可以与无法维持合作联合行动并存。
Conclusion: 演化稳定性不蕴含学习可达性；比较群体层面稳定性与有限样本可达性需在同一博弈—学习系统中按指定多智能体学习动力学分别度量。共享单车场景只是动机性应用，贡献是这套对比框架。

papers.title: Private Decentralized Optimization with Noise Reduction and Bias Correction
papers.abstract_en: Private decentralized learning is affected by sampling noise, privacy noise, and decentralized bias under heterogeneous data. We propose Private Recursive Decentralized Optimization (PRDO). PRDO uses recursive estimation with same-batch gradient differences to reduce estimation errors caused by sampling and privacy noise, while its Exact Diffusion component corrects decentralized bias arising from data heterogeneity. Our analysis establishes a nonconvex convergence bound without assuming uniformly bounded data heterogeneity across nodes. It further gives a sufficient condition under which recursive gradient differences yield strictly lower query sensitivity than private Exact Diffusion, together with an example that rigorously satisfies this condition. Experiments show improved accuracy over the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出私有递归去中心化优化 (PRDO)：用同批次梯度差的递归估计压低采样噪声与隐私噪声，用 Exact Diffusion 分量校正异构数据带来的去中心化偏差。在不假设各节点数据异构性一致有界的前提下给出非凸收敛界，并给出递归梯度差严格降低查询敏感度的充分条件；实验中准确率高于所评估基线。
Motivation: 异构数据下，私有去中心化学习同时受采样噪声、隐私噪声与去中心化偏差干扰，且现有分析通常要求各节点数据异构性一致有界。
Method: PRDO 以同批次梯度差做递归估计以削减采样与隐私噪声引起的估计误差，并用 Exact Diffusion 分量校正数据异构导致的去中心化偏差；分析给出不依赖节点间异构性一致有界假设的非凸收敛界，以及递归梯度差查询敏感度严格更低的充分条件与满足该条件的示例。
Result: 建立无需各节点数据异构性一致有界假设的非凸收敛界；给出递归梯度差查询敏感度严格低于私有 Exact Diffusion 的充分条件及一个严格满足该条件的示例；实验中准确率优于所评估基线。
Conclusion: 递归梯度差加 Exact Diffusion 可同时抑制噪声与去中心化偏差，并在更弱的异构性假设下给出可证明的私有性与收敛保证。

papers.title: FLEET: From Logits Entropy to Enhanced Trajectories in Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution. However, this memoryless approach is inherently suboptimal: because it lacks awareness of prior generations and their evaluations, it produces an increasing proportion of semantically duplicate answers as more samples are drawn, leading to diminishing returns. To address this limitation, we introduce FLEET, a novel method that integrates a memory mechanism into the generation process. FLEET represents each generation as a sparse trajectory through states whose entropy exceeds a predefined threshold and uses these trajectories to infer per-token utility scores that adjust the logits. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that FLEET achieves the same accuracy as the repeated sampling baseline, with a 3x speedup, and substantially improves accuracy on complex coding tasks (LiveCodeBench Pass@32 increases from 59.9% to 66.2%) under the same budget. Furthermore, in the greedy-decoding configuration evaluated here, the approach is deterministic and uses a single calibration pass to derive its principal hyperparameters, requiring only minimal modifications to existing LLM pipelines.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Algorithm source code and experiments: https://github.com/Alexiush/fleet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLEET 给 LLM 重复采样加记忆机制：把每次生成表示为熵超阈值的稀疏 token 轨迹，由轨迹推断 per-token utility 分数并修正 logits。同等预算下达到与重复采样相同的准确率而加速 3 倍，LiveCodeBench Pass@32 从 59.9% 提到 66.2%。
Motivation: 温度采样是无记忆的：不利用先前生成及其评价，采样越多语义重复答案占比越高，收益递减。
Method: FLEET 将每次生成表示为熵超过预设阈值的状态构成的稀疏轨迹，用这些轨迹推断 per-token utility 分数来调整 logits；贪心解码配置下流程确定，仅需一次校准 pass 得到主要超参数，对现有 LLM pipeline 改动极小。
Result: 与重复采样基线相比达到相同准确率并获得 3 倍加速；同等预算下复杂编码任务 LiveCodeBench Pass@32 从 59.9% 提升到 66.2%。
Conclusion: 在重复采样中引入基于轨迹的记忆与 logits 调整，可以在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降本，并在复杂编码任务上同预算提升 Pass@32。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Physical intelligence requires more than predicting how the world may evolve: predictions must remain actionable as the world continues to change. We introduce InternW0, the first instantiation of the InternW physical world model series from Shanghai AI Laboratory, built around omnimodal interfaces, asynchronous multi-frequency processing, and local physical modeling under partial observations and external influences. InternW0 jointly learns future visual dynamics and continuous robot control through an asymmetric video--action architecture with flow matching. A high-capacity video expert provides longer-horizon predictive context, while a lightweight action expert operates at a faster timescale. Instead of regenerating the future for every action update, InternW0 reuses layerwise K/V and adapts it to newly observed states through observation-conditioned context routing. Domain-specific interfaces and soft prompts support heterogeneous embodiments, while contact-aware post-training incorporates force and tactile signals for contact-rich manipulation. We train InternW0 on approximately 7,200 hours of heterogeneous robot and egocentric data, including EgoLab, a 275-hour real-laboratory egocentric dataset. Evaluation spans simulation benchmarks and real-world scientific tasks, including a 15-stage metal--organic framework synthesis workflow and 5-stage contact- and force-aware dexterous manipulation for general-purpose quantitative pipetting. These results advance scalable, asynchronous, and science-native physical world models for universal and efficient real-world interactions.
papers.comment: A technical report of world models, 24 pages, 8 figures, and 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InternW0 是上海 AI Lab 的物理世界模型首个实例，用非对称 video-action 架构与 flow matching 联合学习未来视觉动态和连续机器人控制：高容量 video expert 给长时程预测，轻量 action expert 跑更快时间尺度，并复用 layerwise K/V、经 observation-conditioned context routing 适配新观测，避免每次动作更新都重生成未来。在约 7,200 小时机器人与第一视角数据上训练，评测覆盖仿真基准与 MOF 合成、定量移液等真实科学任务。
Motivation: 物理智能不只要预测世界如何演化，还要让预测在世界持续变化时保持可执行；现有做法每次动作更新都重算未来，代价高且难以覆盖异构机体与部分观测下的外部影响。
Method: 非对称 video-action 架构配合 flow matching 联合建模未来视觉动态与连续控制：高容量 video expert 提供长时程预测上下文，轻量 action expert 以更快速率运行；复用 layerwise K/V 并通过 observation-conditioned context routing 按新观测状态适配；用领域接口与 soft prompts 支持异构 embodiment，contact-aware post-training 引入力与触觉信号。训练数据约 7,200 小时异构机器人与第一视角数据，含 275 小时真实实验室第一视角数据集 EgoLab。
Result: 评测覆盖仿真基准与真实科学任务，包括 15 阶段 metal-organic framework (MOF) 合成流程，以及面向通用定量移液的 5 阶段接触与力感知灵巧操作；训练集约 7,200 小时，其中 EgoLab 为 275 小时真实实验室第一视角数据。
Conclusion: 作者主张 InternW0 代表可扩展、异步且 science-native 的物理世界模型方向，能支撑通用而高效的真实世界交互。

papers.title: FedIncome: Federated Learning for Income Estimation in Digital Lending Under Data Sovereignty Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Verified income is often unavailable in digital loan applications, forcing lenders to rely on reported income and potentially leading to over-lending, overly conservative offers, or rejection of creditworthy applicants. Cross-institutional data-sharing constraints make this problem especially difficult for smaller lenders with limited training data. We introduce FedIncome, a federated learning framework for income estimation that enables institutions to train a shared model without pooling raw borrower records. Using more than one million LendingClub loans partitioned into $50$ state-level clients, we simulate a heterogeneous lending consortium. The best federated model achieves out-of-time $R^2=0.608$, compared with $0.619$ for a pooled centralised benchmark. Small-sample clients obtain an average out-of-time $R^2$ improvement of $3.8$ percentage points relative to the pooled centralised benchmark, while the fitted client-level relationship places the empirical crossover at approximately $4,790$ training observations in this setting. When pooling is infeasible and the relevant alternative is local-only training, federation improves out-of-time performance across all sample-size groups, with the largest gains for data-scarce clients. We also combine federated income estimates with state- and income-specific debt-to-income thresholds. In a retrospective decision analysis, replacing reported income with the federated estimate increases simulated approval rates with only modest changes in observed default rates. FedIncome supports collaborative learning under data-locality constraints with little aggregate loss relative to pooled training and larger gains relative to local-only estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedIncome 在数据不得跨机构汇总的约束下，用联邦学习训练共享收入估计模型：以超过 100 万笔 LendingClub 贷款按 50 个州级客户端划分模拟异构放贷联盟，最优联邦模型 out-of-time R² 达 0.608，仅比集中式 pooled 基线 0.619 低一点；小样本客户端反而比 pooled 基线平均高 3.8 个百分点，经验交叉点约 4,790 条训练样本。
Motivation: 数字信贷申请常缺验证收入，机构只能依赖自报收入，导致过度放贷、过度保守定价或拒掉合格申请人；跨机构数据共享受限使小机构尤其缺训练数据。
Method: 提出联邦学习收入估计框架 FedIncome：把 100 万+ LendingClub 贷款按州划成 50 个客户端做异构联盟模拟，各机构在本地数据上训练共享模型而不汇总原始记录；再把联邦收入估计与按州、按收入分层的 debt-to-income 阈值结合，做回顾性审批决策分析。

papers.title: Learning Local Heterogeneity and Cross-Region Context for Large-Scale Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic flow forecasting is essential to intelligent transportation systems. Large-scale traffic forecasting requires jointly modeling local spatial dependencies and cross-region context.Spatial dependencies between geographically neighboring nodes are heterogeneous due to differences in road identity and travel direction, while acquiring global information through allpairs node interactions incurs substantial computational costs. Therefore, capturing local heterogeneity while efficiently acquiring long-range context remains an important challenge in largescale traffic forecasting. To address these challenges, we propose LoReST, a Local-Region Spatial Temporal network that models spatial dependencies at two complementary granularities: node neighborhoods and road network regions. Specifically, relation-aware local aggregation captures heterogeneous dependencies within geographic neighborhoods through road and direction specific feature transformations. Cross-region interaction constructs region representations through mean pooling, exchanges long range context via inter-region attention, and broadcasts it back to nodes. By integrating local information aggregation with crossregion interaction, LoReST is able to effectively achieve spatial dependency learning in large-scale road networks. Experiments on four datasets of the LargeST benchmark show average relative reductions of 4.78%, 3.60%, and 5.75% in MAE, RMSE, and MAPE, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LoReST，用两个互补粒度建模大规模交通流：关系感知局部聚合按道路与方向做特异变换以刻画邻域异质性，跨区域交互经 mean pooling 生成区域表示、用 inter-region attention 交换长程上下文再广播回节点。在 LargeST 四个数据集上，MAE、RMSE、MAPE 平均相对下降 4.78%、3.60%、5.75%。
Motivation: 大规模交通预报中相邻节点的空间依赖因道路等级与行驶方向而异，而全节点两两交互获取全局信息的计算代价过高，局部异质性与长程上下文难以同时高效刻画。
Method: LoReST（Local-Region Spatial Temporal network）在节点邻域与路网区域两个粒度建模：relation-aware local aggregation 用道路与方向特定的特征变换捕捉邻域内异质依赖；cross-region interaction 对节点做 mean pooling 得到区域表示，经 inter-region attention 交换长程上下文并广播回节点，两者整合完成大规模路网空间依赖学习。
Result: 在 LargeST benchmark 的四个数据集上，MAE、RMSE、MAPE 分别取得平均相对下降 4.78%、3.60%、5.75%。
Conclusion: 把局部异质聚合与跨区域注意力上下文交换结合，可在大规模路网上同时实现异质邻域建模与高效长程上下文获取。

papers.title: Pheno-GS: Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput single-cell data is now collected across large patient cohorts. Understanding patient-level heterogeneity from cellular-level data motivates phenoscaping: embedding each single-cell distribution as a "datapoint," with distances given by optimal transport (OT). Computing geometry-aware OT at this scale, between all pairs of patient datasets, remains an open challenge, since existing methods either rely on Euclidean ground metrics that distort manifold structure or fail under sparse, unevenly sampled, or large-scale data. We present \textbf{Pheno-GS} (Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn), which computes accurate, scalable geodesic transport distances under noisy, unbalanced, large-scale settings via three components: ($1$) graph connectivity regularization for well-defined geodesics on sparse/disconnected manifolds; ($2$) an unbalanced OT formulation via KL marginal penalties; and ($3$) a batched matrix algorithm computing all pairwise distances in one heat diffusion (over $200 \times$ faster than Geodesic Sinkhorn for $500$ distributions). We validate Pheno-GS on synthetic benchmarks and a CyTOF perturbation dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pheno-GS 在单细胞队列尺度上计算几何感知的最优传输距离：用图连通性正则化处理稀疏/不连通流形上的测地线，用 KL 边缘罚做 unbalanced OT，并以一次热扩散批量算出所有成对距离。在 500 个分布上比 Geodesic Sinkhorn 快 200 倍以上，并在合成基准与 CyTOF 扰动数据集上验证。
Motivation: 队列级单细胞数据需要把每个患者的细胞分布当作一个点做 phenoscape 嵌入，但患者数据集两两之间的几何感知 OT 计算仍是开放难题：现有方法要么用扭曲流形结构的欧氏 ground metric，要么在稀疏、不均匀采样或大规模数据下失效。
Method: 三个组件：图连通性正则化 (graph connectivity regularization) 保证稀疏/不连通流形上测地线良定义；KL 边缘罚的 unbalanced OT 公式；批量矩阵算法用一次热扩散 (heat diffusion) 算出全部成对距离。
Result: 在 500 个分布上比 Geodesic Sinkhorn 快 200 倍以上；在合成基准与 CyTOF 扰动数据集上验证了方法。
Conclusion: 在噪声、unbalanced、大规模条件下，Pheno-GS 能给出准确且可扩展的测地传输距离，使患者级两两 phenoscape 距离计算变得可行。
