papers.title: Compliant AI Infrastructure for Regulated Finance: A tiered multi-agent framework with DLT audit trails for financial operations in DACH
papers.abstract_en: We present a compliance-first architecture for AI in regulated finance that treats regulation as an orientation layer rather than a deterministic ruleset. A matrix of regulatory intent and exposure provides a compact classification handle, which a governed policy compiler then maps into concrete prohibitions, obligations and runtime budgets. Prohibitions constrain feasibility and block externalisation, while obligations extend tasks with artefacts that must meet explicit admissibility criteria. Committee activation remains policy-driven and proportionate, preserving efficiency while ensuring supervisory oversight. Evidence, decisions and reason codes are bound to a permissioned DAG with deterministic timestamping, enabling replay, provenance checks and clear attribution of failure. Clause-level legal indexing with effective dates and capability-based agent routing ensure portability across DACH and the wider EU. The result is assurance by construction: compliance is embedded in execution and verifiable by auditors without sacrificing proportionality or transparency.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Published in Swissi AI Journal under CC BY 4.0
papers.journal_ref: Swissi AI Journal, Volume 2025, Article SAIJ-xz3bi3q7fwim (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 DACH 受监管金融的合规优先 AI 架构：把监管意图×风险敞口矩阵经治理型 policy compiler 编译为具体禁令、义务与运行时预算，禁令约束可行性并阻断外泄，义务为任务附加须满足可接纳性标准的产物，委员会激活按政策按比例触发。证据、决策与 reason code 绑定到带确定性时间戳的 permissioned DAG，支持 replay、provenance 与失败归因，实现可审计的 assurance by construction。
Motivation: 受监管金融中把法规当作确定性规则集难以覆盖监管意图与跨 DACH/EU 的条款差异，AI 执行过程缺少可归因、可重放的审计证据。
Method: 分层多 agent 框架：监管意图与敞口矩阵作为分类入口，governed policy compiler 映射为禁令、义务与运行时预算；委员会激活按政策按比例进行；证据与决策绑定 permissioned DAG 并确定性时间戳；配合条款级法律索引（含生效日期）与 capability-based agent 路由实现跨辖区可移植。
Result: 产出为 assurance by construction：合规内嵌于执行过程，审计员可验证，同时保持 proportionality 与 transparency；架构支持 replay、provenance 检查与失败的清晰归因。
Conclusion: 把监管当作定向层而非硬编码规则、并用 DAG 审计轨迹承载证据，可在受监管金融 AI 中同时获得可审计性与按比例的监督效率。

papers.title: SHRAV: State-Hypothesis-Reason-Action-Verify Framework for Physical Modeling and Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Physical modeling and inverse design require computation that can continue from reusable state. We introduce SHRAV, an architecture-independent computational framework organized around State, Hypothesis, Reason, Action, and Verify. Its central mechanism is a state-continuation core with declared reuse boundaries and explicit roles for learned evolution and numerical quantities. Forward configurations evolve predictive state and read out physical responses; inverse-design configurations additionally generate target-directed modifications and consume evaluator feedback. Electromagnetic world-model studies are mapped to forward configurations, with selected readout and reuse diagnostics reported here. Computational lithography demonstrates an inverse-design configuration: four fixed-weight design updates improve thresholded aerial-image intersection-over-union from 0.5313 to 0.8153 under independent scalar-pupil replay, with maximum absolute prediction-replay difference approximately 0.000824 between predictor estimates and independent replay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHRAV 是一个与架构无关的计算框架，把物理建模与逆设计统一为 State-Hypothesis-Reason-Action-Verify 五段循环，核心是带显式复用边界的状态延续核 (state-continuation core)，区分学习到的演化与数值量。前向配置演化预测状态并读出物理响应，逆设计配置额外产生目标导向修改并消费评估器反馈；在计算光刻中四次定权设计更新把阈值化 aerial-image IoU 从 0.5313 提到 0.8153。
Motivation: 物理建模与逆设计需要能从可复用状态继续的计算，而现有做法把前向预测与逆向设计割裂，状态无法跨步复用。
Method: 框架由 State、Hypothesis、Reason、Action、Verify 组成，中心机制是声明复用边界、并显式区分学习演化与数值量的状态延续核；前向配置演化预测状态并读出物理响应，逆设计配置生成目标导向修改并消费 evaluator 反馈；电磁 world-model 研究映射为前向配置，计算光刻作为逆设计配置。
Result: 计算光刻中四次固定权重设计更新使阈值化 aerial-image intersection-over-union 从 0.5313 升至 0.8153（independent scalar-pupil replay 下），预测器估计与独立 replay 的最大绝对差约 0.000824；另报告了电磁 world-model 前向配置的读出与复用诊断。
Conclusion: 以状态延续核加显式复用边界组织前向与逆向任务，可在计算光刻逆设计中用少量定权更新显著抬高 IoU，且预测与独立 replay 高度一致。

papers.title: InGuard: Towards Generalized Inner Guardrail for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models generate high-quality images from arbitrary user prompts, yet they can just as easily produce not-safe-for-work (NSFW) content. Conventional outer guardrails consist of two components: a prompt classifier that checks for risk before generation, and a post-hoc image classifier that checks the fully generated image. In this design, both classifiers operate outside the generation pipeline and do not use the model's own representations. This separation can limit prompt-screening accuracy, while the image-side check runs only after the full generation cost has been spent. Moreover, a flagged prompt can only be rejected, even when it could be adjusted to produce a safe image. In this work, we propose the Inner Guardrail (InGuard), a safety framework that works inside the pipeline on the model's own representations, leaving base-model parameters untouched. First, a risk classifier grades each prompt as unsafe, risky, or benign based on the text encoder's embeddings, with no external language model. Second, SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings) modifies the embeddings of risky prompts, aiming to return a safe image instead of a refusal. Third, a latent detector checks the one-step clean latent estimate midway through denoising, reaching nearly image-level performance and halting generation when risk is detected. We also construct the RevGen Safety Benchmark to evaluate T2I safety under realistic conditions: 10,000 prompts built through real-image reverse generation, with a rewriting step that supplies controlled intellectual-property (IP) characters, covering graded porn/gore risks, categorical IP risks, and benign negatives. Across five open-weight T2I models, InGuard reaches 97.9-98.8% safety rate, matching or exceeding the outer guardrail, with 57.5-73.5% less benign disturbance, ~3.7x fewer parameters, and 50-55.6% of denoising steps skipped.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InGuard 把 T2I 安全护栏移进生成管线内部，直接操作模型自身表征且不改动基座参数：基于 text encoder embedding 的风险分级器、对 risky prompt 改写嵌入的 SAGE、以及在去噪中途检查一步 clean latent 的 latent detector。在自建的 10,000 条 RevGen Safety Benchmark 上、跨五个开源 T2I 模型，安全率达 97.9-98.8%，与外置护栏持平或更高，良性干扰少 57.5-73.5%，参数少约 3.7 倍，并跳过 50-55.6% 的去噪步。
Motivation: 外置护栏的两个分类器都在生成管线之外、不用模型自身表征，导致 prompt 筛查精度受限、图像侧检查要等整段生成算完才触发，且被标记的 prompt 只能拒绝而无法改写成安全图像。
Method: 三段式 Inner Guardrail：风险分级器直接读 text encoder embedding 把 prompt 分为 unsafe/risky/benign，不依赖外部语言模型；SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings) 修改 risky prompt 的嵌入以返回安全图像而非拒答；latent detector 在去噪中途检查一步 clean latent 估计，检出风险即中止生成。基座模型参数保持不动。同时构建 RevGen Safety Benchmark：用真实图像反向生成构造 10,000 条 prompt，含改写步骤引入受控 IP 角色，覆盖分级的 porn/gore 风险、类别化 IP 风险与良性负例。
Result: 在五个开源 T2I 模型上，InGuard 安全率 97.9-98.8%，持平或超过外置护栏；良性干扰减少 57.5-73.5%；参数量少约 3.7 倍；跳过 50-55.6% 的去噪步。latent detector 的中途检查达到接近图像级的检出性能。
Conclusion: 安全检查可以放进生成管线内部、只动模型自身表征而不改基座参数，同时拿到外置护栏级别的安全率并省下生成成本；对 risky prompt 的处理应从拒绝改为改写嵌入以产出安全图像。

papers.title: BiCFlow-MER: Orchestrating Discriminative and Generative Multimodal Emotion Recognition via Conditional Transport
papers.abstract_en: In multimodal emotion recognition (MER), human affective states are inferred by integrating complementary cues from multiple modalities. In audio-text MER, affective cues are often entangled with speaker style and lexical content, while cross-modal disagreement further complicates how the evidence should be integrated. Under conventional discriminative fusion, multimodal evidence is compressed into a terminal prediction, with modality-specific cues and conflict information insufficiently preserved. In large generative affective models, by contrast, affective reasoning is typically embedded in language decoding, leaving emotion evidence implicit and difficult to verify in a structured space. To address these limitations, BiCFlow-MER (Bidirectional Conditional Flow for Multimodal Emotion Recognition) is proposed as a conditional-flow framework in which audio-text MER is formulated as generative evidence transport within a structured emotion space. Within BiCFlow-MER, emotion-oriented evidence is disentangled from speaker-style and lexical-content factors to construct a conflict-aware affective condition. Guided by this condition, each utterance is transported to an explicit emotion-space endpoint through a bidirectional rectified flow. Candidate emotions are jointly verified through adaptive prototype-cloud scoring of the transported endpoint and backward class-to-condition consistency with the original multimodal condition, enabling conflict-aware recognition. BiCFlow-MER is shown to outperform all compared methods across IEMOCAP, MELD, and the zero-shot CASE benchmark. By orchestrating discriminative recognition and generative evidence modeling through conditional transport, BiCFlow-MER defines a new MER paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiCFlow-MER 把 audio-text 多模态情感识别 (MER) 重写为结构化情感空间中的条件流证据传输：先将情感证据与说话人风格、词汇内容解耦得到冲突感知条件，再用双向 rectified flow 把话语运送到显式情感端点，最后以原型云打分与反向类到条件一致性联合判定。在 IEMOCAP、MELD 与零样本 CASE 上均超过全部对比方法。
Motivation: 判别式融合把多模态证据压成单一终预测，模态特异线索与冲突信息丢失；生成式情感模型又把推理埋进语言解码，情感证据隐式且难以在结构化空间核验。
Method: 提出 BiCFlow-MER（Bidirectional Conditional Flow for MER）：将 audio-text MER 形式化为结构化情感空间中的生成式证据传输；用冲突感知情感条件解耦情感证据与 speaker style、lexical content；在该条件引导下用 bidirectional rectified flow 把每条话语运送到显式情感端点；再以 adaptive prototype-cloud scoring 打分端点，并用 backward class-to-condition consistency 与原始多模态条件交叉核验候选情感。
Result: 在 IEMOCAP、MELD 以及零样本 CASE benchmark 上，BiCFlow-MER 均优于所有对比方法（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 判别识别与生成式证据建模可通过条件传输协同，冲突感知的显式情感空间传输构成新的 MER 范式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A generalizable structural brain MRI foundation model built through dual-priority federated pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models hold promise for generalizable analysis of structural brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) across development, aging and disease. However, existing models are typically built through centralized pretraining on pooled data, despite privacy and governance constraints. Such pooling optimization can overemphasize cohort size and overlook complementary information from smaller, specialized cohorts. Here we present BrainFedFM, a structural brain MRI foundation model federatively pretrained on 164,707 three-dimensional scans drawn from diverse real-world data distributions and organized across 42 federated sites. BrainFedFM uses dual-priority federated pretraining, coupling spatial-priority masking at each site with site-priority aggregation at the server to emphasize informative anatomical regions locally and prioritize site contributions globally. Across 20 downstream datasets spanning 17 classification, regression and segmentation tasks, BrainFedFM achieved the state-of-the-art performance (mean rank 1.68, 50\% gain) across seven models, including four centralized foundation models, while showing particularly consistent advantages in classification and regression and robustness across underrepresented populations. These findings demonstrate the generalizability of BrainFedFM and highlight federated pretraining as a practical strategy for developing neuroimaging foundation models from distributed data without pooling raw images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrainFedFM 是结构脑 MRI 基础模型，用双优先级联邦预训练：站点内做 spatial-priority masking 强调有信息的解剖区域，服务器端做 site-priority aggregation 优先小而专门的站点贡献。在 42 个联邦站点、164,707 例三维扫描上预训练后，于 20 个下游数据集的 17 类分类/回归/分割任务中取得 SOTA（mean rank 1.68，50% gain），跨七个模型比较，分类与回归优势最一致。
Motivation: 现有基础模型依赖集中式汇总数据预训练，但隐私与治理约束限制数据汇集；汇总优化又偏向大队列、忽略小而专门站点的互补信息。
Method: BrainFedFM 在 42 个联邦站点上对 164,707 例三维结构 MRI 做联邦预训练，耦合站点侧 spatial-priority masking 与服务器侧 site-priority aggregation，不汇集原始图像；随后在 20 个下游数据集的 17 个分类、回归与分割任务上评测。
Result: 在七个对比模型（含四个集中式基础模型）中达到 SOTA，mean rank 1.68、50% gain；分类与回归任务优势尤其一致，并在代表性不足人群中表现出稳健性。
Conclusion: 联邦预训练是在分布式数据上开发神经影像基础模型、无需汇集原始图像的可行策略，且能兼顾小站点贡献与跨人群泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Jev Judge Radiology Reports? Evaluating a System One Model for Clinical Factuality
papers.abstract_en: An AI-generated radiology report can resemble a physician's report while omitting an abnormality, adding an unsupported finding, or reversing its presence. Measuring these factual differences is essential for evaluating report generators. We study Jev, a System One decision model, as a simple, low-cost judge of agreement with physician-written reference reports. Our evaluator checks whether each statement is supported by the other report and combines these judgments in both directions to capture unsupported claims and omissions. A single-question configuration reaches Kendall correlations of 0.573 on RadEvalX and 0.398 on RadEvalExpert with expert error counts, outperforming an open natural language inference judge under matched decomposition and aggregation. One support question per statement retains similar expert agreement to seven while using 43-45% fewer judgment input tokens. At the documented API price, judgments cost under three cents per hundred report pairs, excluding local decomposition. In a separate controlled-error test, Jev detects false negation with an AUROC of 0.977. Local RadMatch achieves stronger agreement on clinically significant errors in both expert datasets and on total errors in the shared RadEvalExpert subset. Finding-count and error-scope analyses show that benchmark agreement reflects report size and error definitions as well as medical error detection. These results support Jev as a practical judgment component for measuring factual differences in generated radiology reports and identify where more elaborate evaluation remains valuable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 作为 System One 判别模型，用双向逐语句支持性判断度量 AI 放射报告与医生报告的事实差异：单问题配置在 RadEvalX 与 RadEvalExpert 上与专家错误计数的 Kendall 相关分别为 0.573 和 0.398，超过同分解聚合下的开源 NLI judge；每语句一个支持问题在保持相近专家一致性的同时少用 43-45% 判断输入 token，每百对报告判断成本低于 3 美分，假阴性检测 AUROC 0.977。
Motivation: AI 生成的放射报告可能漏掉异常、添加无依据发现或反转存在性，外观却与医生报告相似，需要低成本的方式度量这些事实差异。
Method: Jev 是 System One 判别模型，先对报告做本地分解得到语句，再逐语句检查另一份报告是否支持该语句，并把双向判断聚合起来，同时捕捉无依据主张与遗漏；对照开源 NLI judge 使用相同的分解与聚合。
Result: 单问题配置与专家错误计数的 Kendall 相关：RadEvalX 0.573、RadEvalExpert 0.398，优于匹配分解聚合下的开源 NLI judge；每语句一个支持问题与七个问题专家一致性相近，判断输入 token 少 43-45%；按文档 API 价格每百对报告判断成本低于 3 美分（不含本地分解）；受控错误测试中假阴性检测 AUROC 0.977；本地 RadMatch 在两个专家数据集的临床显著错误上、以及共享 RadEvalExpert 子集的总错误上一致性更强。
Conclusion: Jev 可作为度量生成放射报告事实差异的实用判断组件，但在临床显著错误上更精细的评估（如 RadMatch）仍有价值；基准一致性同时受报告长度与错误定义影响，不只是医学错误检测能力。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: State-Grounded Conditioning: Wrapping User-Facing LLM Agents Where Direction Depends on Live State
papers.abstract_en: We introduce State-Grounded Conditioning (SGC), a design principle for user-facing LLM agents that must condition on live user state (game state, session history, live inventory), and a distinct failure class we call direction drift: task-complete responses whose chosen direction misaligns with the current state. SGC externalises state-dependent control into rule kernels over structured inputs and three primary state slices, via Perception, Grounding, and Interaction wrappers with explicit conditioning dependencies. We evaluate SGC on a 200-session anonymised benchmark ($\approx$1,000 assistant model turns) from an in-game conversational coaching agent that guides players through consecutive competitive matches, reporting mean first-token latency and five human-annotated dialogue-quality metrics that jointly cover factual grounding and coach-like guidance progression. The Perception wrapper holds mean first-token latency at 1.5s (vs. 6.1s for PE-Agent inside a production tool-use harness); enabling all three wrappers lifts turn-level grounded accuracy from 61.1%/69.8% (Prompting / PE-Agent) to 96.7% and session-level grounded accuracy from 20.0%/26.5% to 83.5%; session-level grounding-failure incidents drop by $\approx$78% relative to the strongest baseline. A cumulative ablation shows complementary incremental gains as the wrappers are added. These results inform approximate state-slice orthogonality, without establishing independent per-wrapper effects.
papers.comment: 11 pages (6-page main body + Limitations, Ethics, References, Appendix); 4 figures; 3 tables. Preprint. Under review at EACL 2027 (Industry Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向用户态 LLM agent 的 State-Grounded Conditioning (SGC) 设计原则与 direction drift 失败类（回复任务完成但方向与实时状态不符），把状态依赖控制外置为结构化输入上的规则核，经 Perception、Grounding、Interaction 三个显式条件依赖的 wrapper 实现。在 200 场次、约 1000 次模型回合的游戏内对话教练基准上，三 wrapper 全开把回合级 grounded accuracy 从 61.1%/69.8% 提到 96.7%，场次级从 20.0%/26.5% 提到 83.5%，场次级 grounding 失败事件相对最强基线降约 78%，Perception wrapper 把平均首 token 延迟压在 1.5s（PE-Agent 为 6.1s）。
Motivation: 面向用户的 LLM agent 必须依赖实时用户状态（游戏状态、会话历史、实时库存）给出方向正确的回复，但存在 direction drift：回复看似完成任务、方向却与当前状态错位，现有 prompt 或 agent 框架缺少针对该失败类的控制机制。
Method: SGC 把状态依赖控制外置为结构化输入上的规则核，覆盖三个主要状态切片 (state slices)，并以 Perception、Grounding、Interaction 三个 wrapper 组织显式条件依赖；在游戏内对话教练 agent 的生产工具调用 harness 中评测，用累计消融逐个加入 wrapper。
Result: 在 200 场次匿名基准（约 1000 次 assistant model turns）上：Perception wrapper 平均首 token 延迟 1.5s，PE-Agent 为 6.1s；三 wrapper 全开回合级 grounded accuracy 由 Prompting/PE-Agent 的 61.1%/69.8% 升至 96.7%，场次级由 20.0%/26.5% 升至 83.5%；场次级 grounding 失败事件相对最强基线下降约 78%；累计消融显示逐个加入 wrapper 有互补的增量收益。
Conclusion: 把实时状态控制外置成规则核加显式条件 wrapper，可在生产 harness 中同时保住低延迟并大幅抬高 grounded accuracy；作者指出结果只支持状态切片近似正交，未确立各 wrapper 的独立效应。

summary_sections.motivation: 面向用户的 LLM agent 必须依赖实时用户状态（游戏状态、会话历史、实时库存）给出方向正确的回复，但存在 direction drift：回复看似完成任务、方向却与当前状态错位，现有 prompt 或 agent 框架缺少针对该失败类的控制机制。
summary_sections.method: SGC 把状态依赖控制外置为结构化输入上的规则核，覆盖三个主要状态切片 (state slices)，并以 Perception、Grounding、Interaction 三个 wrapper 组织显式条件依赖；在游戏内对话教练 agent 的生产工具调用 harness 中评测，用累计消融逐个加入 wrapper。
summary_sections.result: 在 200 场次匿名基准（约 1000 次 assistant model turns）上：Perception wrapper 平均首 token 延迟 1.5s，PE-Agent 为 6.1s；三 wrapper 全开回合级 grounded accuracy 由 Prompting/PE-Agent 的 61.1%/69.8% 升至 96.7%，场次级由 20.0%/26.5% 升至 83.5%；场次级 grounding 失败事件相对最强基线下降约 78%；累计消融显示逐个加入 wrapper 有互补的增量收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把实时状态控制外置成规则核加显式条件 wrapper，可在生产 harness 中同时保住低延迟并大幅抬高 grounded accuracy；作者指出结果只支持状态切片近似正交，未确立各 wrapper 的独立效应。

papers.title: When Context Misleads: In-context Learning with Jurisdiction in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a cornerstone of modern LLM deployment. However, existing ICL post-training methods have a critical blind spot: they excel at extracting patterns from demonstrations while often neglecting context authority, the ability to determine whether contextual information should govern the final answer. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FakeContextBench, which contains pseudoscientific claims across seven domains. Our evaluation of commercial and open-source models shows that large-scale pre-training alone is insufficient for reliable context-authority discrimination. Moreover, prevalent ICL fine-tuning methods can increase susceptibility to misleading context, reducing reality accuracy by up to 14.95 percentage points relative to the base model. To address this trade-off, we propose Jurisdiction In-Context Learning (J-ICL), a post-training framework that incorporates context validation into the training objective. Across four model backbones, J-ICL improves ICLEval by an average of 5.84 percentage points and reality accuracy by 9.20 points over the corresponding base models. It also raises the Reality Rate by an average of 18.09 points relative to MetaICL and Symbol Tuning. These results demonstrate that ICL capability and resistance to deceptive context can be improved together. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/peilin717/FakeContext-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FakeContextBench（七个领域的伪科学论断）评测 LLM 的上下文权威判断，并提出把上下文验证写进训练目标的 Jurisdiction In-Context Learning (J-ICL)。常见 ICL 微调会让模型更易被误导上下文带偏，现实准确率相对基线模型最多下降 14.95 个百分点；J-ICL 在四个骨干模型上平均提升 ICLEval 5.84 个百分点、现实准确率 9.20 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 ICL 后训练方法只擅长从示例中抽取模式，却不判断上下文信息是否有权决定最终答案，导致模型面对伪科学等误导性上下文时现实准确率下降。
Method: 构建 FakeContextBench，含七个领域的伪科学论断，评测商用与开源模型；提出 J-ICL 后训练框架，把 context validation 纳入训练目标，在四个模型骨干上训练。
Result: 大规模预训练本身不足以可靠区分上下文权威；主流 ICL 微调使现实准确率相对基线模型最多下降 14.95 个百分点；J-ICL 在四个骨干上平均提升 ICLEval 5.84 个百分点、现实准确率 9.20 个百分点，Reality Rate 相对 MetaICL 与 Symbol Tuning 平均高 18.09 个百分点。
Conclusion: ICL 能力与抵抗欺骗性上下文的能力可以同时提升，前提是把上下文验证显式写进后训练目标。

papers.title: Efficient Linear Bandits via Cluster-Aware Sketching
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of computational efficiency for linear bandits in high-dimensional settings with a finite arm set. In linear bandits, the increase in the dimension $d$ of the feature vectors leads to growing computational costs of $O(d^2)$ at each round of update. Traditional sketching-based methods such as SOFUL reduce computation via fixed-size matrix sketching, yet run the risk of incurring vacuous linear regret when the spectral tail of the data is heavy and the sketch size is inadequately selected. To guarantee regret convergence and effectively reduce computational costs, we introduce a clustering mechanism and propose the Cluster Sketch Linear Bandit (CS-LB) algorithm. Our method preserves the full covariance information in each cluster to guarantee robust sublinear regret without spectral-tail vulnerabilities, performs cluster switching by assigning a sentinel for each cluster, and reduces per-round update computation to $O(l^2d)$ via a tunable sketch size $l<d$. Experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method consistently maintains a favorable trade-off between efficiency and regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CS-LB 在有限臂集线性 bandit 中按聚类分别维护满协方差并配 sentinel 做簇切换，把每轮更新从 O(d^2) 降到 O(l^2 d)（l<d），同时避免 SOFUL 因谱尾重、sketch 尺寸选不当而出现的空洞线性遗憾；合成数据实验显示效率与遗憾保持良好折中。
Motivation: 高维线性 bandit 每轮更新代价随维度 d 增至 O(d^2)；固定尺寸 sketch 方法（如 SOFUL）在数据谱尾重且 sketch 尺寸选不当时可能退化为空洞的线性遗憾。
Method: 提出 Cluster Sketch Linear Bandit (CS-LB)：对臂做聚类，每簇保留完整协方差以保证次线性遗憾、消除谱尾脆弱性；每簇设一个 sentinel 负责簇切换；用可调 sketch 尺寸 l<d 做降维更新，把每轮计算压到 O(l^2 d)。
Result: 每轮更新计算量由 O(d^2) 降至 O(l^2 d)，其中 l<d；在合成数据集上的实验中，该方法在效率与 regret 之间持续保持有利折中。
Conclusion: 按簇保留满协方差加 sentinel 切换，可以在不牺牲遗憾收敛的前提下削掉线性 bandit 的高维每轮计算，并规避固定 sketch 的谱尾风险。

papers.title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure methods that operate via linear projection assume that features occupy separable subspaces. We show this assumption fails under dense superposition: when two features are forced into an antipodal pair sharing a single subspace, state-of-the-art linear erasure destroys both, not just the target. Networks trained with gradient descent instead solve this problem non-linearly, but not uniformly: they converge to one of two distinct circuit-level solutions depending on initialization, which we call mirror and shadow solutions. We map this bifurcation as a function of feature entanglement, show it reflects a stable attractor structure rather than an artifact of our setup, and use targeted causal interventions to demonstrate that both solutions leave a substantial, measurable trace of the erased feature's representation intact, recoverable through a single scalar patch rather than requiring any further training. This mirrors a failure mode recently observed empirically in LLM unlearning, where suppression rather than deletion allows forgotten knowledge to resurface; our results offer a mechanistic, causally-validated account of why that failure mode occurs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性投影式概念擦除中，若两个特征被压成共享单一子空间的对跖对，SOTA 线性擦除会连带摧毁两个特征而非只删目标；梯度下降训练的网络改用非线性解法，但随初始化分岔为 mirror 与 shadow 两种电路级解法。两种解法都只压制被擦特征、留下可测表征痕迹，一次标量 patch 无需再训练即可恢复，为 LLM unlearning 中遗忘知识复现的失败模式给出因果验证的机制解释。
Motivation: 线性擦除依赖特征占据可分子空间的假设，而稠密叠加 (dense superposition) 下该假设失效，导致擦除目标时误伤共存特征；这正对应 LLM unlearning 中知识被压制而非删除、随后复现的经验性失败。
Method: 构造两特征被强制为共享单一子空间的对跖对 (antipodal pair) 的设定，比较线性擦除与梯度下降训练所得网络；把解的分岔映射为特征纠缠度的函数，检验其为稳定吸引子结构而非设定假象，并用定向因果干预 (targeted causal interventions) 检验擦除后表征是否残留。
Result: 稠密叠加下 SOTA 线性擦除同时破坏两个特征而非仅目标；梯度下降收敛到 mirror 与 shadow 两种依赖初始化的电路级解法，分岔随特征纠缠度变化且呈稳定吸引子结构；两种解法都留下大量可测的被擦特征表征痕迹，可通过单个标量 patch 恢复而无需任何再训练。
Conclusion: 概念擦除与 LLM unlearning 中的遗忘是压制而非删除，残留表征可被单标量干预直接恢复；线性可分性假设在稠密叠加下不成立，擦除效果需按因果可恢复性而非投影后的不可见性来判定。

papers.title: The Capability Manifold and ML Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Existing machine learning (ML) scaling laws relate predictive loss to compute, model parameters, and data. However, as models are increasingly deployed through agentic harnesses, loss alone is insufficient to characterize downstream performance: models with similar loss can exhibit different capabilities in reasoning, retrieval, planning, and adaptation. Yet, no unified framework connects such capabilities to the coupled resources available across the ML lifecycle. We bridge this gap by introducing a capability manifold, a multidimensional framework mapping downstream capabilities to pre-training, post-training, and test-time resources through bounded scaling functions. Analytical Jacobians quantify capability sensitivity to resource changes and interactions. As an initial application, we embed Kaplan- and Chinchilla-type scaling laws and test-time compute within the framework, demonstrating how existing scaling relationships can be unified as trajectories on a common capability manifold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 capability manifold，把下游能力（推理、检索、规划、适应）映射到预训练、后训练与测试时资源上，用有界标度函数刻画，并以解析 Jacobian 量化各资源对能力的敏感度及资源间交互。作为初始应用，把 Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 型 scaling law 及 test-time compute 统一为同一能力流形上的轨迹。
Motivation: 现有 ML scaling law 只把 loss 与算力、参数量、数据关联，而 loss 相近的模型在推理、检索、规划与适应上可能差异很大；缺少把下游能力与 ML 全生命周期耦合资源统一起来的框架。
Method: 构建多维 capability manifold，用有界 scaling function 把下游能力映射到 pre-training、post-training、test-time 三类资源；推导解析 Jacobian 度量能力对资源变化的敏感度与交互；将 Kaplan 型与 Chinchilla 型 scaling law 及 test-time compute 嵌入该框架。
Result: 在框架内演示 Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 型 scaling law 及 test-time compute 可统一为共同 capability manifold 上的轨迹；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: loss 不足以刻画部署在 agentic harness 下的模型表现，能力应作为资源的有界函数在统一流形上刻画，现有 scaling 关系是该流形上的特例轨迹。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Does Step Law Transfer to Small-Scale Language Models? An Empirical Recalibration Below 59M Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Step Law gives power-law formulas for the optimal peak learning rate eta* and batch size B* when pre-training language models. It was calibrated on models between 59M and 1B parameters; the small-model regime N < 59M was never tested empirically by its authors. This regime matters for single-GPU training, interpretability research, educational experiments, and settings where larger models are infeasible on memory or cost grounds. We test whether Step Law transfers to small language models. We consider three outcomes: H1, the original coefficients work directly; H2, the power-law form holds but with different coefficients; and H3, a power law does not describe the optima in this regime. All experiments use a single nanoGPT/TinyStories pipeline with a 2048-token BPE vocabulary, AdamW, and a warmup-cosine schedule. The optimum for each (N, D) cell is extracted from the loss surface L(eta, B) via a local quadratic approximation in log-log coordinates over the smoothed training loss. The final dataset contains 29 unique (N, D) cells and 935 analysis-ready runs. The main refit uses 25 cells (815 runs) in the working range 4 <= D/N <= 600. On the pooled data we accept H2: the functional form is preserved, but the coefficients differ from the original. We obtain eta*(N, D) = 0.0985 N^(-0.508) D^(0.238) (R^2 = 0.834) and B*(D) = 3.6 x 10^(-4) D^(0.931) (R^2 = 0.950). Step Law's structural claim that B* is independent of N is reproduced (p = 0.87), but the growth of B* with D is nearly twice as steep as in the original work. Direct transfer of Step Law systematically overestimates the optimal learning rate: the median ratio eta_SL / eta* is approximately 4.0x, with a range of 2.4x to 6.6x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Step Law 在 59M 以下小模型上不直接成立：作者用 nanoGPT/TinyStories 单管线扫出 935 次训练，重拟合出 η*(N,D)=0.0985 N^(-0.508) D^(0.238)（R²=0.834）与 B*(D)=3.6×10⁻⁴ D^0.931（R²=0.950），接受 H2——幂律形式保留但系数改变。原 Step Law 系数会系统性高估最优学习率，中位比值约 4.0 倍（2.4–6.6 倍），因此小模型预训练须重新标定系数而非照搬。
Motivation: Step Law 的 η*、B* 幂律标定区间是 59M–1B 参数，N<59M 区间原作者从未实测；而单 GPU 训练、可解释性研究与教学实验恰恰落在这一区间。
Method: 统一用 nanoGPT/TinyStories 管线（2048-token BPE 词表、AdamW、warmup-cosine 调度）扫描 (N,D) 网格，对每个格点在 log-log 坐标下对平滑训练损失做局部二次逼近，从损失面 L(η,B) 提取最优点；再在 4≤D/N≤600 工作区间用 25 个格点重拟合幂律系数，并检验 B* 是否依赖 N。

papers.title: VCMM: Variance-Calibrated Momentum for Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal joint training often suffers from modality imbalance, where a dominant modality suppresses the optimization of others. Existing methods mainly balance modality learning by modulating gradient magnitudes or directions, modifying optimization objectives, or adjusting training strategies, with most interventions focusing on the current update. However, when combined with widely used momentum-based optimizers, the update also incorporates accumulated information from previous gradients, which is not explicitly addressed by current-step modulation alone. To address this issue, we propose Variance-Calibrated MomentuM (VCMM), which adapts gradient memory to modality-specific gradient dynamics. Specifically, VCMM estimates minibatch noise and temporal drift online and uses their relative strength to determine modality-specific momentum through a Kalman-inspired controller. We further center the control signal across modalities and apply exact bias correction for the time-varying first moment, enabling adaptive gradient memory without extra network passes or explicit learning-rate scaling. Experiments on four multimodal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements with modest training overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCMM 针对多模态联合训练中主导模态压制其他模态的问题，把动量（momentum）的梯度记忆按模态分别调节：在线估计 minibatch 噪声与时序漂移，用二者相对强弱经 Kalman-inspired controller 决定各模态动量，并对跨模态居中控制信号、对时变一阶矩做精确偏差校正。在四个多模态基准上带来一致改进，训练开销 modest，且不需额外网络前向或显式学习率缩放。
Motivation: 多模态联合训练常出现 modality imbalance，现有方法只调当前步的梯度幅度/方向或训练策略，但动量优化器的更新还累积了历史梯度信息，仅靠当前步调制无法处理。
Method: VCMM 在线估计 minibatch 噪声与时序漂移，以二者相对强度经 Kalman-inspired controller 确定 modality-specific momentum；控制信号在模态间居中，并对时变一阶矩做 exact bias correction，无需额外网络前向或显式学习率缩放。
Result: 在四个多模态基准 (multimodal benchmarks) 上取得一致改进 (consistent improvements)，训练开销 modest；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把梯度记忆本身按模态动态自适应调节，是缓解多模态主导模态压制的一条有效路径，且开销可控。

papers.title: DCRL: Decoupling and Coupling Reinforcement Learning via Policy-Reward Manifold Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing reward systems, such as rule-based and reward-model-based, often exhibit issues such as unstable optimization and reward hacking. In this work, we revisit the general reasoning of LLMs from a geometric perspective, conceptualizing it as a coupled manifold composed of three interdependent sub-manifolds: logical deduction, evaluation, and representation. Based on this perspective, response generation in RL can be interpreted as a decoupling process from the evaluation manifold, while reward estimation corresponds to a decoupling process from the logical deduction manifold. The limitations of rule-based and reward-model RL systems can be geometrically interpreted as the mismatch of policy-reward manifolds during RL process. To address the aforementioned misalignment, we propose Decoupling and Coupling Reinforcement Learning (DCRL) framework, which incorporates two key components: (1) a syllogistic logic-based prompt evolution mechanism that dynamically refines reward rubrics to enhance the expressiveness of the reward manifold; and (2) a policy-reward re-coupling mechanism that jointly updates the reward and policy models, ensuring consistent evaluation and mitigating manifold mismatch during training. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments across multiple reasoning domains demonstrate that DCRL consistently outperforms both rule-based and reward-model baselines. Notably, a Qwen3-4B model trained under DCRL surpasses a Qwen3-32B baseline and approaches the performance of a Qwen3-235B model, highlighting superior effectiveness and generalization in RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCRL 把 LLM 推理视为逻辑演绎、评估、表示三个耦合子流形，将规则奖励与奖励模型的不稳定优化和 reward hacking 归因为 policy-reward 流形错配。它用三段论逻辑驱动的 prompt 演化动态细化奖励 rubric，并联合更新奖励模型与策略模型以重新耦合两者。在多个推理域上稳定超过规则基线与奖励模型基线，Qwen3-4B 经 DCRL 训练后超过 Qwen3-32B 基线并接近 Qwen3-235B 的表现。
Motivation: 规则式与奖励模型式 RL 训练 LLM 时优化不稳、易被 reward hacking 钻空子，根因是策略与奖励两个流形在训练中错配。
Method: DCRL 框架含两部分：三段论逻辑 (syllogistic logic) 基于的 prompt 演化机制动态细化奖励 rubric，扩展奖励流形表达力；policy-reward 重耦合机制联合更新奖励模型与策略模型，训练中保持评估一致并抑制流形错配。附带理论分析。
Result: 在多个推理域的实验中，DCRL 持续优于规则式与奖励模型两类基线；Qwen3-4B 经 DCRL 训练后超过 Qwen3-32B 基线，并接近 Qwen3-235B 的性能。
Conclusion: 把 policy-reward 错配当作几何问题、用 rubric 演化加联合更新来重新耦合，能在小模型上取得大得多的基线模型级别的推理效果与泛化。

papers.title: FDE-Bench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Deployment Environment Configuration
papers.abstract_en: Deployment requires an agent to turn application code into a running system whose services connect, become ready, and remain observable. FDE-Bench evaluates this capability with 136 deployment-configuration tasks spanning Docker images, multi-service Compose stacks, and Kubernetes, in greenfield and diagnose-and-repair modes. Agents submit declarative artifacts that are collected, rebuilt, and redeployed in a pristine environment. Four gated binary check layers measure build, readiness, behavior, and conformance to the deployment specification, using programmatic checks without an LLM judge. A four-arm release gate requires a resolving reference solution and rejects tasks solved by do-nothing, specification-transcription, or generic-stub submissions. The released check annotations expose the link between 2,145 checks and their specifications, including seven documented gaps. Three additional adversarial strategies test shortcuts in the grading signals; none resolves any of the 135 tasks they cover, while a vacuous health probe passes readiness and exposes the need for downstream checks. On the 136-task evaluation grid, seven language models from four providers use the same four-tool scaffold and resolve 52.9-75.0 percent of tasks. The three zero-intelligence floors resolve none and reach a mean Deployment Score of at most 0.44. Readiness is the largest failure stage, accounting for 110 of 313 unresolved episodes. Mean resolution rate is 30.7 percentage points higher on the repair task group than on the disjoint greenfield group, with a positive gap for every model; ten tasks resist all seven. In a 25-task case study, one practicing engineer directing Claude-Sonnet-5 resolves 92 percent against 72 percent for the autonomous baseline. FDE-Bench links deployment success and failure to artifacts that can be inspected and replayed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FDE-Bench 用 136 个部署配置任务评测 LLM agent 把应用代码变成可运行系统的能力，覆盖 Docker、Compose 多服务栈与 Kubernetes，分 greenfield 与诊断修复两种模式。四家提供商的七个模型在同一四工具脚手架下解出 52.9–75.0% 的任务，修复组平均解出率比 greenfield 高 30.7 个百分点，readiness 是最大失败环节（313 个未解 episode 中占 110 个）。
Motivation: 部署配置要求 agent 让服务互联、就绪并可观测，但缺少能区分真实能力与空转、抄规格、通用桩等捷径的可复现评测环境。
Method: 任务产出声明式工件，在干净环境中收集、重建并重新部署；四层门控二元检查度量 build、readiness、behavior 与部署规格一致性，全部用程序化检查、不用 LLM judge；四臂发布门要求可解析的参考解，并用 do-nothing、规格转写、generic-stub 三种零智能下限拒绝取巧任务，另附三条对抗策略检验评分信号捷径。
Result: 136 任务上七个模型解出率 52.9–75.0%；三个零智能下限一个不解，平均 Deployment Score 至多 0.44；readiness 占 313 个未解 episode 中的 110 个；修复组比 disjoint greenfield 组平均高 30.7 个百分点且每个模型都为正，10 个任务七个模型全败；对抗策略覆盖的 135 任务无一被解出，而空洞 health probe 能通过 readiness；25 任务案例研究中，工程师指挥 Claude-Sonnet-5 解出 92%，自主基线 72%；发布 2,145 条检查与规格的对应关系，含 7 处已记录缺口。
Conclusion: 部署成功与失败可归因到可检查、可重放的工件上，readiness 是当前 LLM agent 的主要瓶颈，而人机协同指挥能显著抬高解出率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TNLearn: An Open Source Python Package for Task-based Neurons
papers.abstract_en: The brain does not rely on a single type of neuron to perform all kinds of tasks; instead, it designs different neurons for different tasks. The concept of task-based neurons represents a paradigm shift compared to task-based architectures. It argues that solving a specific problem requires customized neurons, as task-based neurons capture useful prior knowledge from task-related data. To facilitate the use of task-based neurons in scientific research and industrial applications, we introduce TNLearn, an open-source Python package that provides automated construction of task-based neurons and networks, enabling smooth training of task-based networks. Comprehensive documentation, including technical exposition, API reference, and representative examples, is available online. TNLearn is open-sourced at https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn and has become a PyTorch ecosystem project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TNLearn 是一个开源 Python 包，把「任务定制神经元 (task-based neurons)」这一范式工程化：自动构建面向特定任务的神经元与网络并支持顺畅训练，已作为 PyTorch ecosystem 项目发布。其主张是解决具体问题应定制神经元而非只换整体架构，因为任务定制神经元能从任务相关数据中捕获先验知识。
Motivation: 任务定制架构 (task-based architecture) 之外缺少一套可复用的构建与训练基础设施，使 task-based neurons 难以在科研与工业场景落地。
Method: 提供 task-based neurons 与网络的自动化构建流程，并配套训练管线；附带技术文档、API reference 与代表性示例，代码在 GitHub 开源并进入 PyTorch 生态。
Result: 产出为可复用软件工件：TNLearn 开源包、在线文档（技术说明、API reference、示例）与 PyTorch ecosystem 项目身份；摘要未给出任何基准或指标数字。
Conclusion: 定制神经元应作为可编程构件而非一次性设计，由统一框架自动生成并训练，方能在科研与工业中通用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Visual Quality Misleads: Intent Recognition under Rendered Avatar Distortions
papers.abstract_en: Avatar-streaming systems are commonly evaluated with image and video quality assessment (IQA/VQA) metrics, implicitly treating visual fidelity as a proxy for communicative success. We test this assumption through a controlled behavioral study of rendered 3D avatars across a pristine condition and fourteen geometric, photometric, temporal, and combined distortions. Fifty-nine participants contributed 2,688 judgments of perceived action, response confidence, and visual quality. We identify Misleading Quality in this dataset as distorted renderings that retain above-average perceived quality but yield below-average action-recognition accuracy. We also derive an Intent Quality Score (IQS) combining recognition correctness and confidence as the behavioral target for objective metrics. Among 126 distorted content--condition cells, 31 (24.6%) exhibited Misleading Quality; temporal and geometric distortions showed the highest rates, at 50.0% and 31.1%, respectively. The results reveal a quality--accuracy dissociation where distortion families affect appearance and communication differently. Across 24 direct-scoring IQA/VQA metrics and three supervised feature-regression baselines, alignment with IQS remained limited; at $λ=0.5$, the best leave-one-content-out baseline reached PLCC $=0.4435$. Under this controlled protocol, visual fidelity alone is insufficient for avatar communication, motivating intent-aware quality assessment and streaming objectives.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications. 6 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文用受控行为实验检验「视觉保真度可代理 avatar 流的沟通成功」这一假设：59 名参与者对 1 个原始条件与 14 种几何、光度、时间及其组合失真共 2,688 次判断，发现 126 个内容-条件格中 31 个（24.6%）出现「质量误导」（Misleading Quality，感知质量高于平均但动作识别准确率低于平均），其中时间类失真达 50.0%、几何类 31.1%。作者据此提出 Intent Quality Score (IQS) 作为客观指标应拟合的行为目标，并指出 24 个 IQA/VQA 指标与 3 个监督特征回归基线对 IQS 的对齐仍有限（λ=0.5 时最优 leave-one-content-out 基线 PLCC=0.4435）。
Motivation: avatar 流媒体系统普遍用 IQA/VQA 指标评估，隐含把视觉保真度当作沟通成功的代理，但这一假设从未被行为数据直接检验。
Method: 受控行为研究：渲染 3D avatar 的原始条件加 14 种几何、光度、时间及组合失真，59 名参与者给出 2,688 次关于感知动作、反应置信度与视觉质量的判断；据此定义 Misleading Quality，并导出结合识别正确性与置信度的 Intent Quality Score (IQS) 作为客观指标的行为目标；再用 24 个直接打分的 IQA/VQA 指标与 3 个监督特征回归基线在 leave-one-content-out 下对照 IQS。
Result: 126 个失真内容-条件格中 31 个（24.6%）呈 Misleading Quality；时间类失真率 50.0%，几何类 31.1%。24 个 IQA/VQA 指标与 3 个监督基线对 IQS 的对齐有限，在 λ=0.5 时最优 leave-one-content-out 基线 PLCC=0.4435。
Conclusion: 在该受控协议下，视觉保真度单独不足以刻画 avatar 沟通质量，质量-准确率解离要求以意图感知 (intent-aware) 的质量评估与流媒体目标取代纯保真度目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhyMo: A Physical-Field Modality for Multimodal AI4Physics
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning is emerging as a powerful paradigm for AI for Physics (AI4Physics), where predicting physical systems requires the joint interpretation of heterogeneous observations, measurements, and domain knowledge. However, existing approaches typically represent physical quantities and governing equations as generic numerical or textual tokens, overlooking the physical constraints that determine their spatiotemporal interactions. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textbf{physical-field modality} and propose \textbf{PhyMo}, a physics-grounded multimodal framework that organizes heterogeneous measurements through PDE-associated operators. PhyMo follows a three-stage learning procedure: the physical-field encoder is first pretrained through field reconstruction under PDE residual supervision, its representations are subsequently aligned with visual embeddings in a shared latent space, and the fused multimodal representations are finally processed by corresponding downstream prediction heads. Experiments on five datasets spanning diverse physical environments show that PhyMo achieves state-of-the-art performance, compared to the strongest baseline on each dataset, demonstrating the superiority of PhyMo on multimodal representation learning in AI4Physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhyMo 提出 physical-field modality，用 PDE-associated operators 组织异构物理观测，取代把物理量和方程当通用数值/文本 token 的做法。三阶段训练：物理场编码器先在 PDE residual 监督下做场重建预训练，再与视觉嵌入在共享隐空间对齐，最后由下游预测头输出。在覆盖不同物理环境的五个数据集上，相对各数据集最强基线达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 AI4Physics 多模态方法把物理量与控制方程当作通用数值或文本 token，丢掉了决定时空相互作用的物理约束，异构观测难以联合解释。
Method: 三阶段流程：物理场编码器以 PDE residual 为监督做场重建预训练；其表示与视觉嵌入在共享隐空间对齐；融合后的多模态表示送入对应下游预测头。整体框架通过 PDE-associated operators 组织异构测量。
Result: 在五个覆盖多样物理环境的数据集上，PhyMo 相对每个数据集的最强基线均取得 state-of-the-art 表现；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把物理约束显式编码为一种模态，而非通用 token，可在多模态 AI4Physics 表示学习上系统性超过各领域最强基线。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: EBRL: Asynchronous Embodied RL by Multi-Grained Resource Management
papers.abstract_en: Embodied reinforcement learning (RL) improves model capabilities with a pipeline of environment simulation, action generation, and model updates. These stages show heterogeneous CPU and GPU demands, making efficient resource utilization difficult. Recent systems overlap rollout (simulation and generation) with training for efficiency, but exclusive GPU allocation and synchronized barrier in rollout still leave substantial hardware resource waste. In this paper, we present EBRL, an asynchronous embodied RL training system with two core techniques. The asynchronous pipelined scheduler overlaps rollout and training, pipelines simulation and generation across environment groups, and carries out each environment independently, eliminating synchronization stalls. The fine-grained resource manager pools CPU cores and GPU streaming multiprocessors, and uses stage profiles and runtime feedback to adjust resource quotas and batch sizes to meet the shifting demands among stages. We implement EBRL on RLinf and evaluate it with four embodied policies and four simulation benchmarks across heterogeneous GPU testbeds. Experiments show that EBRL achieves 1.30-3.47 times the end-to-end rollout throughput and 2.5 times of training convergency compared to the SOTA embodied RL systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EBRL 把具身 RL 训练中 rollout 与训练的同步屏障拆掉：异步流水调度器让各环境组独立推进仿真与生成，细粒度资源管理器按阶段画像和运行时反馈动态调配 CPU 核与 GPU SM 配额及 batch size。在异构 GPU 测试床上以四个具身策略、四个仿真基准评测，端到端 rollout 吞吐达到 SOTA 具身 RL 系统的 1.30–3.47 倍，训练收敛速度 2.5 倍。
Motivation: 具身 RL 的环境仿真、动作生成、模型更新三阶段 CPU/GPU 需求异构，现有系统在 rollout 中独占 GPU 分配并用同步屏障，造成硬件资源大量闲置。
Method: 在 RLinf 上实现两个核心技术：异步流水调度器 (asynchronous pipelined scheduler) 重叠 rollout 与训练、跨环境组流水化仿真与生成并让每个环境独立执行以消除同步停顿；细粒度资源管理器 (fine-grained resource manager) 汇聚 CPU 核与 GPU streaming multiprocessor，依据阶段画像与运行时反馈调整资源配额和 batch size。
Result: 在异构 GPU 测试床上用四个具身策略与四个仿真基准评测：端到端 rollout 吞吐为 SOTA 具身 RL 系统的 1.30–3.47 倍，训练收敛 (training convergency) 达 2.5 倍。
Conclusion: 去掉 rollout 的同步屏障并按阶段动态调配 CPU/GPU 配额，可同时显著提升具身 RL 的 rollout 吞吐与训练收敛速度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robustness of Diffusion Models under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models are increasingly considered in settings where the underlying data distribution may differ from the training distribution, yet existing theoretical guarantees largely focus on the no-shift setting. In this work, we study robust score estimation under Wasserstein perturbations of a reference distribution. For the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion, we show that robust estimation decomposes into two fundamental components: the statistical cost of learning the reference distribution and the intrinsic cost of distribution shift. The latter scales quadratically with the Wasserstein radius, and this dependence is minimax optimal. We construct an explicit finite-sample estimator achieving the resulting robust minimax rate without knowing the shift radius. When the reference distribution lies on an unknown low-dimensional subspace, the statistical term adapts to the intrinsic dimension while the shift cost remains unchanged. Finally, we show that the same decomposition governs positive-time reverse sampling and obtain matching minimax guarantees in KL divergence. Together, these results characterize how finite data, intrinsic dimension, and distribution shift affect the robustness of score-based diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Wasserstein 扰动下研究 score-based diffusion 的鲁棒 score 估计：对 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 扩散，鲁棒性可分解为学习参考分布的统计代价与分布偏移的内禀代价，后者随 Wasserstein 半径二次增长且该依赖是 minimax 最优的。作者构造了无需知道偏移半径即达该鲁棒 minimax 率的有限样本估计器，并把同一分解推广到正时间反向采样，在 KL 散度下给出匹配的 minimax 保证。
Motivation: 现有 diffusion 理论保证基本只覆盖训练分布与真实分布一致的 no-shift 设定，而实际部署中数据分布常偏离训练分布，缺少刻画分布偏移代价的理论。
Method: 在参考分布的 Wasserstein 扰动下研究鲁棒 score 估计，针对 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 扩散把风险分解为统计项与偏移项；构造显式有限样本估计器，无需已知偏移半径；当参考分布落在未知低维子空间时讨论统计项对本征维数的自适应，并将分解推广到正时间反向采样。
Result: 偏移代价随 Wasserstein 半径二次标度且 minimax 最优；显式有限样本估计器在未知偏移半径下达到鲁棒 minimax 率；参考分布位于未知低维子空间时统计项随本征维数自适应而偏移项不变；正时间反向采样服从同一分解，并在 KL 散度下获得匹配的 minimax 保证。
Conclusion: 扩散模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性由有限数据、本征维数与偏移半径三者决定，且偏移代价的二次标度不可改进；低维结构只能降低统计代价，无法降低偏移代价。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Behaviora - A Conceptual Architecture for External and Internal Behavior of Robots and Agents
papers.abstract_en: Behaviora is a preliminary conceptual architecture for representing agent and robot behavior, external and internal alike, in an addressable form. A behaving robot or agent performs a Behavior Episode composed of episode components, which can be derived from behavior taxonomies (BTax) and assigned persistent identifiers. We denote these identifiers as IoB (Internet of Behaviors) Addresses. A Behavior Episode specifies what the system does, while a Style Profile (SP) specifies how this behavior is expressed. Style can communicate characteristics of the actor and qualities such as competence and cultural manners. An Experience Profile (EP) represents behaviorally relevant internal state that modulates the execution of an Episode. Finally, a Behavior Compiler maps these behavioral representations to platform-specific actions. We use a primitive touching arm model to show these components and their relations. External Behavior is a result of addressable movements and their styles. Internal Behavior is represented through the same episodic principle and can be rendered as inner speech. Sensing, perception and complex task contexts have not been included in the present implementation, although a conceptual place is reserved for them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Behaviora 提出一个把机器人与智能体的内外行为都写成可寻址形式的概念架构：行为片段 (Behavior Episode) 由带持久标识符 (IoB Addresses) 的片段组件构成，Style Profile 规定行为如何表达，Experience Profile 表示调制执行的内部状态，Behavior Compiler 再把这套表示映射为平台相关动作。作者用一个原始的触碰手臂模型演示各组件关系，并明确当前实现不含感知与复杂任务上下文。
Motivation: 机器人与智能体的行为缺乏统一的可寻址表示，外部动作与内部状态被分开处理，难以像数据一样被引用、复用和渲染。
Method: 架构包含四层：由行为分类体系 (BTax) 派生并赋 IoB Addresses 的 Behavior Episode、规定表达方式的 Style Profile、表示调制执行的内部状态的 Experience Profile，以及映射到平台动作的 Behavior Compiler；以 primitive touching arm model 展示组件与关系，内部行为沿用同一片段原则并可渲染为 inner speech。
Result: 给出一个初步概念架构及其组件关系的演示（primitive touching arm model）；外部行为被定义为可寻址动作及其 style 的结果，内部行为按同一片段原则表示并可呈现为 inner speech；当前实现不含 sensing、perception 与复杂任务上下文，仅预留概念位置。
Conclusion: 行为可以统一按片段加持久地址的方式表示，外部与内部共用同一 episodic 原则；但这是初步架构，感知与任务上下文尚未纳入实现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ICM: Intra-class Mixing for Domain Adaptation in Adverse Weather
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) for semantic segmentation remains challenging under adverse weather conditions because severe appearance changes enlarge the domain gap and degrade the reliability of pseudo labels in the target domain. To address this problem, we propose an Intra-Class Mixing Consistency (ICM) framework that enforces prediction consistency between an intra-class mixed image and its original counterpart. Unlike previous mixing-based consistency methods that combine regions across different images or domains and may introduce unrealistic semantic inconsistencies, ICM performs mixing within the same image and semantic class, preserving realistic semantic layout for consistency regularization. With ICM, we establish a new state-of-the-art performance for clear-to-adverse-weather unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in semantic segmentation. On the Cityscapes $\rightarrow$ ACDC benchmark, our method achieves 75.7\% mIoU, outperforming the previous state of the art by +1.9 pp, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating class confusion under challenging environmental conditions. The code is provided in the supplementary material.

Method: ICM 在同一图像的同一语义类内部混合，得到与原图语义布局一致的混合样本，再对混合图与其原始对应图施加预测一致性约束，用于无监督域适应 (UDA) 语义分割的伪标签正则化。

papers.title: ProCredit: From Outcome Rewards to Progress Credit in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agentic tasks require an agent to modify an environment through a sequence of tool calls, with success determined by the final state. The standard recipe assigns a single outcome reward at the end and compares trajectories sampled for the same task. As a result, a group with no successful trajectory yields no training signal, failed attempts cannot be told apart by how close they came to completion, and turns that advance the task receive the same credit as turns that only query the environment. Prior work refines the unit of comparison from the trajectory to the step, or trains a reward model to supply intermediate signal: the former still derives its signal from final success alone, and the latter estimates it with a model. We observe that the acceptance checks that decide success can also be run on intermediate states, so progress is as verifiable as the outcome. We propose ProCredit, which turns this verified progress into credit: it reruns the acceptance checks after each turn, rewards the turn by its change in progress, and uses these rewards to assign credit both across attempts at the same task and across the turns within a trajectory. Starting from Qwen3.5 base models at three scales on AppWorld, ProCredit outperforms outcome-reward baselines and progress-based baselines in task completion rate at every scale on both test sets, exceeding the strongest outcome-reward baseline by 4.1 percentage points at 4B, and results in a second environment show the same direction of improvement. Ablations show that adding the final progress to the trajectory score alone does not improve performance: the gain comes from crediting progress to the turn where it occurs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProCredit 把长程 agentic 任务中可复用的验收检查 (acceptance checks) 在每轮后重跑，用进度变化量作为奖励，同时在同任务的多次尝试之间和单条轨迹的各轮之间分配 credit。在 AppWorld 上从 Qwen3.5 base 的三个规模起步，任务完成率在两个测试集、每个规模都超过 outcome-reward 与 progress-based 基线，4B 规模比最强 outcome-reward 基线高 4.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程 agentic 任务只在末尾给一个 outcome reward：整组采样全失败时没有训练信号，失败尝试之间无法区分接近完成的程度，真正推进任务的轮次与只查询环境的轮次拿到相同 credit。
Method: ProCredit 在每轮之后重跑判定成功的 acceptance checks，按进度变化给该轮打分，再用这些奖励同时做跨尝试 (across attempts) 与跨轮次 (across turns) 的 credit 分配；训练起点为 Qwen3.5 base 的三个规模，任务环境为 AppWorld。
Result: 在 AppWorld 两个测试集上，三个规模的任务完成率均超过 outcome-reward 基线与 progress-based 基线，4B 规模比最强 outcome-reward 基线高 4.1 个百分点；第二个环境的结果方向一致。消融显示只把最终进度加进轨迹分数不带来提升，增益来自把进度 credit 记到发生该进度的轮次。
Conclusion: 进度和结果一样可验证，把可验证进度按发生轮次记账才是增益来源，单纯在轨迹分数上追加最终进度无效。

papers.title: M3D-Net: Hierarchical Coordination of Spatial Context, Feature Reuse, and Differential Attention for Mammography Classification
papers.abstract_en: Breast image classification requires local detail and global tissue context, yet these cues can weaken as representations deepen. We present M3D-Net, a mammography encoder that hierarchically coordinates multi-scale coordinate attention, bounded dynamic feature reuse, and differential attention through resolution-aware operator placement. Within-stage retrieval preserves access to earlier features, coordinate-aware aggregation integrates local and global context, and differential attention operates at coarse resolutions. We evaluate image-only classification on AISSLab mammography and an adapted image--clinical model on BrEaST ultrasound. Against EdgeNeXt, RepViT, and TransXNet, the proposed implementations achieve the highest recorded validation accuracy and late-training accuracy, with the lowest endpoint cross-entropy loss. Validation accuracies reach 97.78\% and 80.39\%, respectively. These results support further evaluation of hierarchical coordination across breast imaging settings; repeated-seed, component-controlled, and independent evaluations remain necessary.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027; 5 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M3D-Net 是一个乳腺影像编码器，通过分辨率感知的算子布置，把多尺度 coordinate attention、有界的动态特征复用 (bounded dynamic feature reuse) 与 differential attention 分层协同起来：within-stage retrieval 保留对早期特征的访问，coordinate-aware aggregation 融合局部与全局上下文，differential attention 只放在粗分辨率层。在 AISSLab 乳腺 X 线摄影与改造后的 BrEaST 超声图像-临床模型上，其验证准确率分别达到 97.78% 和 80.39%，相对 EdgeNeXt、RepViT、TransXNet 取得最高验证与后期训练准确率、最低终点交叉熵损失。
Motivation: 乳腺影像分类同时需要局部细节与全局组织上下文，而表征加深时这两类线索会同时减弱，通用骨干网络缺少针对这一矛盾的结构安排。
Method: M3D-Net 以分辨率感知的算子放置分层组织三个组件：multi-scale coordinate attention、有界动态特征复用、differential attention（仅置于粗分辨率）；within-stage retrieval 保留早期特征通路，coordinate-aware aggregation 融合局部与全局上下文。评测为纯图像分类（AISSLab 乳腺 X 线摄影）加改造的图像-临床模型（BrEaST 超声），对比 EdgeNeXt、RepViT、TransXNet。
Result: 在 AISSLab 乳腺 X 线摄影与 BrEaST 超声上验证准确率分别达 97.78% 与 80.39%；相对 EdgeNeXt、RepViT、TransXNet 取得最高记录的验证准确率与后期训练准确率，以及最低的终点交叉熵损失。
Conclusion: 分层协同空间上下文、特征复用与差分注意力能在乳腺影像设置中提升分类准确率并压低终点损失；作者主张进一步在更多乳腺影像场景评估，并指出仍需重复种子、组件消融与独立评测。

papers.title: Not What You Meant: Can LLMs Follow a Specified Negation Semantics?
papers.abstract_en: Negation does not carry a uniform interpretation across domains. In legal, regulatory, and medical reasoning, the intended interpretation depends on the reading in force -- open- versus closed-world, two- versus three-valued, and credulous versus skeptical. We study which reading of negation large language models adopt by default and whether they can override that preference when a different reading is explicitly specified. To this end, we introduce NAFBench, a procedural generator of solver-certified instances spanning four semantic viewpoints: SLDNF, well-founded semantics (WFS), and credulous and skeptical reasoning under stable-model semantics. The generator emits ground normal logic programs with controlled depth, width, and cycle structure. Each program is solved under all four viewpoints using SWI-Prolog, a well-founded semantics solver, and clingo, yielding up to four divergent labels. The programs are then verbalized into natural language under multiple framings and rule orderings that leave the answer invariant. The results expose a consistent gap. Across open-source models, following a specified negation semantics remains unsolved: the strongest models score 59--74% across the four semantic viewpoints, while the weakest score 31--67%. All models are order-sensitive on more than half of logically identical rule shufflings, while the two weaker models frequently overcommit on well-founded "undefined." Two frontier models reach 100% on the main fixed-complexity evaluation set, and a third, o4-mini, is near-perfect, falling only to 81% on well-founded "undefined." Delegating reasoning to a solver, fine-tuning on certified traces, or forcing an explicit three-valued verdict each partly closes the gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 NAFBench：用过程化生成器产出经求解器认证的逻辑程序实例，覆盖 SLDNF、WFS、稳定模型语义下的轻信与怀疑四种否定读法，再把程序在多种框架与规则顺序下语言化。结果显示开源模型按指定否定语义作答仍未解决：最强模型四种读法得分 59–74%，最弱 31–67%，且超过一半的逻辑等价规则重排会改变其答案。
Motivation: 法律、监管、医疗推理中否定的正确解读取决于生效读法（开放/封闭世界、二值/三值、轻信/怀疑），但 LLM 默认采纳哪种读法、能否被显式指定覆盖，此前缺少受控且答案可认证的评测。
Method: NAFBench 过程化生成受控深度、宽度与环结构的 ground normal logic programs，用 SWI-Prolog、WFS 求解器与 clingo 在四种视角下求解，最多得到四个分歧标签；再把程序按多种 framing 与规则顺序语言化，答案保持不变。
Result: 开源模型按指定否定语义得分：最强 59–74%，最弱 31–67%；全部模型在超过一半的逻辑等价规则重排上顺序敏感；两个较弱模型频繁在 well-founded 的 undefined 上过度断言。两个 frontier 模型在主固定复杂度评测集上达 100%，o4-mini 接近满分，仅在 well-founded undefined 上降到 81%。把推理交给求解器、在认证轨迹上微调、强制给出显式三值判定，三种做法各自部分缩小差距。
Conclusion: 按指定否定语义遵循规则对 LLM 仍是未解决问题，其默认读法可被规则顺序扰动；求解器委托、认证轨迹微调与显式三值判定是三条部分有效的缓解路径。

papers.title: NV-Reason-CT: 3D Visual Language Model for CT Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present NV-Reason-CT, a generative vision--language model for chest and abdominal CT combining native 3D visual encoding with radiologist-guided reasoning. The model couples a native 3D vision transformer with a language model, passing all visual tokens and their explicit 3D coordinates into language decoding without further spatial token merging. This retains volumetric spatial information within the vision encoder and through the language model's positional encoding during joint processing with text. We train on a curated corpus of approximately 550,000 multimodal instruction examples from 70,111 unique CT image inputs, combining standardized reports, abnormality-focused and anatomy-specific questions, multi-turn interactions, and radiologist-authored reasoning from recorded and transcribed expert CT interpretations. Expert annotations provide direct supervision and guide additional report-grounded synthetic reasoning. End-to-end supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), with verifiable rewards over chest and abdominal abnormality sets. The model supports abnormality classification, report generation, and interactive reasoning with reviewable observations, differential diagnoses, and uncertainty. Evaluation spans public CT benchmarks and a held-out NIH cohort. On CT-RATE, NV-Reason-CT achieves a macro-F1 of 0.614 and macro-AUROC of 0.871 without a task-specific classification head; generated reports achieve a report-derived macro-F1 of 0.592. In a preliminary study with expert radiologists, AI-assisted review received favorable confidence ratings and was associated with a 50% reduction in average reported interpretation and reporting time. We release the model and training code to support reproducible research on explainable AI for volumetric medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NV-Reason-CT 是面向胸腹部 CT 的生成式视觉-语言模型，用原生 3D vision transformer 直接把全部视觉 token 及其显式 3D 坐标送入语言模型解码，不做空间 token 合并。经约 55 万条多模态指令样本的 SFT 加 GRPO（对胸腹异常集合设可验证奖励）训练后，在 CT-RATE 上无任务专用分类头取得 macro-F1 0.614、macro-AUROC 0.871，生成报告的 report-derived macro-F1 为 0.592。
Motivation: CT 体积数据在 VLM 中常被压成二维切片或合并空间 token，丢失体素级定位；同时医学推理需要放射科医生可审查的观察、鉴别诊断与不确定性，而非黑箱输出。
Method: 原生 3D vision transformer 与语言模型耦合，视觉 token 连同 3D 坐标经位置编码进入语言解码；训练语料约 550,000 条多模态指令样本、来自 70,111 个唯一 CT 输入，含标准化报告、异常与解剖专项问答、多轮交互及放射科医生撰写的推理记录；流程为端到端 SFT 后接 GRPO，奖励基于胸腹异常集合的可验证校验。
Result: 在 CT-RATE 上 macro-F1 0.614、macro-AUROC 0.871（无任务专用分类头），生成报告的 report-derived macro-F1 0.592；评测覆盖公开 CT 基准与留出 NIH 队列。专家放射科医生初步研究中 AI 辅助阅片获得良好信心评分，平均解读与报告时间下降 50%。
Conclusion: 保留体积空间信息并配合放射科医生引导的可审查推理，可在不加分类头的情况下完成 CT 异常分类与报告生成，并显著缩短阅片报告时间；模型与训练代码开源以支持可解释医学影像复现研究。

summary_sections.method: 原生 3D vision transformer 与语言模型耦合，视觉 token 连同 3D 坐标经位置编码进入语言解码；训练语料约 550,000 条多模态指令样本、来自 70,111 个唯一 CT 输入，含标准化报告、异常与解剖专项问答、多轮交互及放射科医生撰写的推理记录；流程为端到端 SFT 后接 GRPO，奖励基于胸腹异常集合的可验证校验。
summary_sections.result: 在 CT-RATE 上 macro-F1 0.614、macro-AUROC 0.871（无任务专用分类头），生成报告的 report-derived macro-F1 0.592；评测覆盖公开 CT 基准与留出 NIH 队列。专家放射科医生初步研究中 AI 辅助阅片获得良好信心评分，平均解读与报告时间下降 50%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 保留体积空间信息并配合放射科医生引导的可审查推理，可在不加分类头的情况下完成 CT 异常分类与报告生成，并显著缩短阅片报告时间；模型与训练代码开源以支持可解释医学影像复现研究。

papers.title: Uncheatable Eval: Dynamic Compression-Based Evaluation of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models are pretrained on massive datasets, making it difficult to prevent benchmark data from entering their training sets and undermining the reliability of evaluation results. Reliable evaluation is particularly challenging for base models, whose limited instruction-following ability complicates task-based assessment. We introduce Uncheatable Eval, a dynamic benchmark that regularly collects newly published text to evaluate base language models and reduce the risk of data contamination. Drawing on the relationship between a model's predictive ability and its ability to compress data losslessly, we use compression rate to evaluate how well models predict new text. We evaluate 80 models across 14 text categories, study how compression changes with context length, and examine the correlation between compression rate and zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Our results yield three main findings: (1) compression performance follows a consistent scaling trend with model size; (2) attention-based, hybrid, and recurrent models differ in how their compression performance changes as more context becomes available; and (3) lower compression rates are strongly associated with higher zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Jellyfish042/uncheatable_eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Uncheatable Eval：定期采集新发布文本，用无损压缩率 (compression rate) 作为指标评估 base 语言模型，以规避基准数据污染。评测 80 个模型、14 类文本，发现压缩性能随模型规模呈一致 scaling 趋势，压缩率越低与 zero-shot MMLU 准确率越强正相关。
Motivation: 大模型预训练数据规模巨大，基准数据易混入训练集导致评测失真；base 模型指令遵循能力弱，基于任务的评测更难做。
Method: 动态基准定期收集新发表文本，借预测能力与无损压缩的等价关系，用压缩率衡量模型对新文本的预测好坏；考察压缩率随 context length 的变化，并与 zero-shot MMLU 准确率做相关性分析。
Result: 评测 80 个模型、14 类文本；三项发现：压缩性能随模型规模呈一致 scaling 趋势；attention、hybrid、recurrent 三类架构的压缩性能随可用上下文增加的变化方式不同；更低压缩率与更高 zero-shot MMLU 准确率强相关。
Conclusion: 以动态新文本加压缩率评测 base 模型可降低数据污染风险，压缩率可作为预测能力的代理指标并反映模型规模与下游准确率。

papers.title: Know-Your-Scene (KYS)-SLAM: Hierarchical Semantic-Motion Priors for Feature Matching in Stereo Visual SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Stereo visual SLAM systems built on local descriptors suffer from semantic ambiguity, instance-level confusion, and independently moving objects, each corrupting data association and accumulating as trajectory drift. Prevailing semantic and dynamic SLAM methods address this through binary feature rejection, sacrificing correspondence density for outlier suppression. We contend that contextual implausibility is better expressed as a graded quantity than an exclusion criterion. We present Know-Your-Scene (KYS)-SLAM, a modular extension of ORB-SLAM3 that supplants feature rejection with continuous correspondence modulation. The contribution is the reframing of contextual evidence as correspondence cost, applied within feature matching and leaving the geometric backend unmodified. Each keypoint is augmented with semantic, panoptic, and motion priors fused through a hierarchical compatibility formulation, in which semantic class and instance identity enforce structural plausibility while a zero-shot motion score down-weights features on independently moving objects. That score comes from a training-free module fitting a depth-aware ego-motion model to background optical flow and classifying panoptic segments via self-calibrating, coverage-aware thresholds, so only segments with sufficient motion evidence are penalized and static structure is left unpenalized. Penalizing correspondences rather than discarding them preserves the geometric support bundle adjustment depends on. Under one fixed configuration, no coefficient retuned per sequence or dataset, KYS-SLAM reduces per-sequence ATE RMSE by 17.4% on outdoor KITTI and 27.7% on indoor EuRoC across 21 stereo sequences with no regressions, and by 6.6% on dynamic subsets of KITTI Tracking and 17.8%, up to 31.2%, on Virtual KITTI 2 -- cross-domain transfer across outdoor driving, indoor flight, and synthetic imagery under one set of constants.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KYS-SLAM 把语义、panoptic 与运动先验融合成连续的匹配代价，替代 ORB-SLAM3 的二值特征剔除，在不改几何后端、单一固定配置下把 21 条立体序列的逐序列 ATE RMSE 在 KITTI 室外降低 17.4%、EuRoC 室内降低 27.7%，且无回退。
Motivation: 局部描述子的语义歧义、实例混淆与独立运动物体会破坏数据关联并累积成轨迹漂移；现有语义/动态 SLAM 用二值剔除抑制外点，代价是牺牲对应密度。
Method: 作为 ORB-SLAM3 的模块化扩展，在特征匹配阶段把上下文证据重写为对应代价，几何后端与 BA 保持不变；每个关键点附加语义类、实例身份与零样本运动分数三层先验，经层次兼容性公式融合，运动分数由免训练模块对背景光流拟合深度感知 ego-motion 模型并对 panoptic 分段用自校准、覆盖感知阈值分类得到，只惩罚有充分运动证据的分段。
Result: 在单一固定配置、无逐序列或逐数据集调参下，21 条立体序列的逐序列 ATE RMSE：KITTI 室外降 17.4%，EuRoC 室内降 27.7%（无回退）；KITTI Tracking 动态子集降 6.6%，Virtual KITTI 2 降 17.8%、最高达 31.2%。
Conclusion: 把上下文不合理性当作连续代价而非剔除判据，可在不改 BA 后端的前提下跨室外驾驶、室内飞行与合成图像三类域泛化，且用一组常数即可成立。

papers.title: Information Capacity of Generative Video Compression: Quantifying the Rate-Compute Exchange at Identical Quality
papers.abstract_en: Under the AI Flow framework, communication networks distribute intelligence across devices, edge servers, and clouds, and computation at the receiver becomes a resource that can substitute for transmitted bits. Generative video compression (GVC) embodies this exchange by sending compact tokens with ultra-low bitrate and letting a generative decoder synthesize the video, yet how much bandwidth savings a unit of decoder compute actually achieves has never been quantified. To fill this vacancy, we model reconstruction quality as a two-factor power law in data rate and decoder compute, which fits measured DISTS of two GVC decoders with a mean error below 3%, and define the information capacity (IC) as the negative logarithmic slope along an iso-quality contour, namely the fraction of rate saved per fractional increase in compute at identical quality. IC is dimensionless and unit-invariant, thus enabling an architecture-agnostic comparison. It forms a field over the operating plane, locating where additional denoising steps are worth their cost. Across five datasets, the 14B decoder trades more compute for fewer rate about ten times more efficiently than the 1.3B decoder. IC also varies significantly across datasets, indicating imbalanced performance on the rate-compute trade-off in GVC methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AI Flow 框架下把生成式视频压缩 (GVC) 的重建质量建模为码率与解码器算力的双因子幂律，据此定义信息容量 (IC) 为等质量轮廓上的负对数斜率，即单位算力增加换来的码率节省比例。该模型对两个 GVC 解码器实测 DISTS 的拟合平均误差低于 3%；跨五个数据集，14B 解码器以算力换码率的效率约为 1.3B 解码器的十倍，且 IC 随数据集显著变化。
Motivation: AI Flow 下接收端算力可替代传输比特，但 GVC 中一单位解码算力究竟能省多少带宽此前从未被量化，缺少跨架构可比的统一度量。
Method: 把重建质量写成码率与解码算力的双因子幂律并用两个 GVC 解码器的实测 DISTS 拟合；定义 IC 为等质量轮廓上的负对数斜率（无量纲、单位不变），使其成为覆盖操作平面的场，用于定位额外去噪步数是否值得其开销。
Result: 双因子幂律对两个 GVC 解码器实测 DISTS 的拟合平均误差低于 3%；跨五个数据集，14B 解码器以算力换码率的效率约为 1.3B 解码器的十倍；IC 在不同数据集间变化显著，说明现有 GVC 方法的率-算力折衷表现不均衡。
Conclusion: 率-算力折衷可由无量纲的 IC 场统一刻画并做架构无关比较，据此可在操作平面上判断追加去噪步数是否划算；同一方法在不同数据集上的折衷效率并不均衡。

papers.title: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents need reliable knowledge of how their experiments change outcomes. We introduce WhatWorkedBench to measure experimental understanding, the accuracy of predictions about component changes after budgeted experimentation. Agents inspect code, select measurements, and submit a response surface, a table predicting scores for every configuration of component settings. Exhaustive CPU execution supplies reference effects for changing each component while holding the others fixed. These effects capture combinations of changes across 36 tasks from 30 data sources and 8 workflow types, with 1248 configuration records. Core evaluation combines 4,206 numerical-control records across all eight families and 108 agent episodes across the original six. At eight new measurements, pair-effect ridge selects an optimum on 15 of 22 sources and limits every effect error to 10% of score range on three. Fitting a Gaussian process (GP) to the same agent observations raises effect recovery, accuracy relative to true effect magnitude, from 0.632 to 0.698 in the original Flash cohort and from 0.621 to 0.720 in an additional cohort. On six completed beat-detection and graph submissions, the same-observation GP raises family-macro recovery from 0.303 to 0.455. On six workflows with six binary options at 20 new measurements, encoding code equivalences, configurations with identical behavior, raises GP recovery from 0.248 to 0.462. WhatWorkedBench supports research on experimental agents, adaptive experimental design, numerical inference, and use of program structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WhatWorkedBench 用穷举 CPU 执行为 36 个任务、1248 条配置记录建立参考效应，衡量 AI agent 在预算内实验后对组件改动结果的预测准确性（experimental understanding）。在 8 次新测量下 pair-effect ridge 在 22 个数据源中 15 个选出最优配置；对同一观测拟合 GP 把效应恢复率从 0.632 提到 0.698（Flash cohort），编码代码等价性后 GP 恢复率从 0.248 升到 0.462。
Motivation: AI 研究 agent 缺少可靠知识来判断改动实验组件会如何改变结果，现有评测无法度量这种预算内实验后的预测准确性。
Method: Agent 检查代码、选择测量并提交 response surface（预测所有组件设置组合分数的表）；穷举 CPU 执行提供固定其他组件时改变单个组件的参考效应，覆盖 36 个任务、30 个数据源、8 种 workflow 类型、1248 条配置记录，核心评测含 4206 条 numerical-control 记录与 108 个 agent episodes。
Result: 8 次新测量下 pair-effect ridge 在 22 个源中 15 个选出最优，并在 3 个源上把每个效应误差限制在分数范围的 10% 以内；GP 拟合把 effect recovery 从 0.632 提到 0.698（原 Flash cohort）、从 0.621 提到 0.720（额外 cohort）；6 个 beat-detection 与 graph 提交上 family-macro recovery 从 0.303 升到 0.455；6 个 workflow、6 个二元选项、20 次新测量下编码代码等价性使 GP recovery 从 0.248 升到 0.462。
Conclusion: 对 agent 观测拟合 GP 并编码程序结构中的行为等价性，能显著提升从预算实验中恢复组件效应的准确性，该基准支持实验 agent、自适应实验设计与程序结构利用的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Passing: An Endless Journey through Reconstructed Spacetime with AI-Generated Sound
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Passing, an interactive audiovisual installation that generates an endless journey from a single continuous monorail-window recording by reconstructing it as a spatiotemporal volume. Rather than replaying the footage linearly, the work resamples its spatial and temporal structure along nonlinear trajectories, producing a continuously passing landscape whose depth, speed, and temporal order become unstable. A camera-based viewer-presence detection system estimates whether a viewer is present in the viewing zone and uses this presence state to influence transitions among rendered video sequences. The resulting video stream is fed into SpecMaskFoley, a real-time video-to-audio synthesis model that generates a synchronized soundscape for the reconfigured image. The model is not used to reconstruct an objectively correct soundtrack, but functions as a speculative listener, proposing a possible auditory interpretation of a world whose conventional spatial and temporal premises have been disrupted. Passing distributes creative agency across the artist, who defines the rules of spacetime reconstruction; the AI model, which interprets the emergent visual flow as sound; and the audience, whose embodied presence influences the audiovisual trajectory. Through this structure, the work investigates how authorship and listening may be negotiated among human intention, machine inference, and audience interpretation. Artwork page: https://ryufurusawa.com/passing
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Creative AI Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Passing 把单段连续单轨车窗录像重建为时空体，沿非线性轨迹重采样其空间与时间结构，使画面深度、速度与时间顺序持续失稳，再用观众在场检测状态驱动视频片段切换，并由 SpecMaskFoley 实时把重排后的画面合成为同步声景。作品把创作权分配给设定重建规则的艺术家、把视觉流解读为声音的 AI 模型、以及以身体在场影响音画轨迹的观众。
Motivation: 线性回放的录像无法让观众进入时空前提被打乱的持续运动体验，而现有视频到音频模型多追求客观正确的音轨重建，缺少在时空失稳画面下承担推测性听者角色的用法。
Method: 把单段单轨车窗录像重建为时空体积，沿非线性轨迹对其空间与时间结构重采样生成连续变换的景观；用基于相机的观众在场检测估计观看区是否有人，并以该在场状态影响渲染视频序列之间的转场；重排后的视频流输入实时视频到音频合成模型 SpecMaskFoley 生成同步声景，模型被定位为推测性听者而非客观音轨重建器。
Result: 产出一件交互式视听装置作品，包含时空体重建、非线性重采样、相机在场检测驱动的转场，以及 SpecMaskFoley 实时生成的同步声景；作品被 NeurIPS 2026 Creative AI Track 接收。
Conclusion: 创作权可在艺术家设定的重建规则、AI 对视觉流的声音解读、观众身体在场三者之间协商分配，听者与作者身份也随之被重新谈判。

papers.title: Learning Where to Look: A Shared Relative-Alignment Module for Time-Series Forecasting and PPG-to-Vital-Sign Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: PPG-to-vital-sign reconstruction turns a wrist-worn photoplethysmogram into clinical waveforms such as the ECG. Long-horizon multivariate time-series forecasting underpins planning in energy, weather, and traffic. Both generate a target sequence from a condition sequence, and current models hard-code where each target position reads it, as a same-position copy or seasonal recurrence, so neither transfers between tasks. We propose ROOSTER, one conditioning module that handles vital-sign reconstruction and time-series forecasting alike by learning this correspondence. Its core is a periodic-comb bias over the target-condition offset whose center, period, and sharpness are learned per head, so one module settles on the identity alignment or a seasonal lag and reports which it found. On vital-sign reconstruction from PPG, ROOSTER outperformed the published baselines on four heart-rate and respiratory-rate benchmarks. On multivariate time-series forecasting, it achieved the best horizon-averaged MSE on four benchmarks and outperformed the forecasting model it extends on 20 of 24 dataset-horizon settings under matched three-seed training. An ablation study indicated that the relative bias, not content matching, carried the alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ROOSTER：一个共享的相对对齐模块，用可学习的周期梳状偏置 (periodic-comb bias) 建模目标位置与条件位置的偏移，中心、周期、锐度逐头学习，从而在同一模块里自行落到恒等对齐或季节滞后并报告所选对齐。在 PPG 生命体征重建的 4 个心率/呼吸率基准上超过已发表基线；在多变量时间序列预报的 4 个基准上取得最佳 horizon 平均 MSE，并在匹配三种子训练下于 24 个 dataset-horizon 设置中的 20 个胜过其扩展的预报模型；消融显示起作用的是相对偏置而非内容匹配。
Motivation: 现有模型把「目标每个位置从条件的哪里读取」写死为同位复制或季节递推，导致生命体征重建与长时程多变量预报两个任务无法共用同一条件化机制。
Method: ROOSTER 是单一条件化模块：在目标-条件偏移上施加周期梳状偏置，其周期、中心、锐度按注意力头学习，使模型自行决定是恒等对齐还是季节滞后并输出所选对齐；同时用于 PPG→ECG 类临床波形重建与多变量时间序列预报，并做消融区分相对偏置与内容匹配的作用。
Result: PPG 生命体征重建上，在 4 个心率与呼吸率基准上超过已发表基线；多变量时间序列预报上，在 4 个基准上取得最佳 horizon 平均 MSE，并在匹配三种子训练下于 24 个 dataset-horizon 设置中的 20 个胜过其扩展的预报模型；消融表明承载对齐的是相对偏置而非内容匹配。
Conclusion: 把「从条件的哪里读取」作为可学习的相对对齐而非硬编码，可让一个模块同时服务生命体征重建与时间序列预报，且对齐来源可被消融归因到相对偏置。

papers.title: DeltaS: Reading the Gated Linear Attention State for KV Cache Eviction in Streaming Video
papers.abstract_en: Recent video-language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that interleave linear and full attention layers for efficient long-context processing. While the recurrent state of linear attention remains fixed in size, the KV cache of full attention continues to grow with the video stream, making eviction necessary under a bounded memory budget. The key challenge in streaming is that eviction must occur before the question arrives, so what to retain has to be decided without the question. Existing eviction methods derive token scores from the KV cache itself, using position, attention, or key-value representations, and attention-based scores further require proxy queries or extra computation. Hybrid backbones offer another source of signal. In gated-delta linear attention, the recurrent state is updated by the residual between each input and what can already be retrieved from the state, so its change over a chunk of frames reflects how much new information the chunk brings. We propose DeltaS, a query-agnostic, training-free method that retains video chunks inducing larger normalized state change, or state drift. In a controlled comparison with the budget and retention policy held fixed, state drift outperforms position-, attention-, and key-value-based signals. With a signal costing only 1.9% of the forward pass, DeltaS surpasses the strongest query-agnostic bounded-memory baseline by 2.1 points on average across six long-video benchmarks and by 5.6 points on the longest benchmark. These results suggest that the two memories of hybrid architectures can work cooperatively. Code is available at https://github.com/MaumAI-Company/DeltaS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaS 用 gated-delta 线性注意力循环状态在每个视频块上的归一化状态漂移 (state drift) 作为保留分数，在问题到达前做无查询的 KV cache 逐出。该信号只占前向计算的 1.9%，在六个长视频基准上平均比最强的无查询有界内存基线高 2.1 分，最长基准上高 5.6 分。
Motivation: 混合视频-语言模型里线性注意力状态大小固定而 full attention 的 KV cache 随视频流增长，必须在预算内逐出；但流式场景下逐出发生在问题到达之前，无法依据问题决定留什么，而现有打分方法只看 KV cache 本身或需要代理查询与额外计算。
Method: DeltaS 是 query-agnostic、training-free 的逐出方法：利用 gated-delta 线性注意力状态由「输入减去状态已能检索到的部分」的残差更新这一性质，把一个视频块引起的状态漂移（归一化状态变化）作为 token/块保留分数；受控比较中固定内存预算与保留策略，只替换打分信号。
Result: 在预算与保留策略固定的受控比较中，state drift 优于基于位置、注意力、key-value 的信号；打分信号开销仅占前向计算的 1.9%；在六个长视频基准上平均比最强的 query-agnostic 有界内存基线高 2.1 分，最长的那个基准上高 5.6 分。
Conclusion: 混合架构的两种记忆（线性注意力循环状态与 full attention KV cache）可以协同：状态漂移是比 cache 自身统计更有效的无查询逐出信号，且几乎不增加计算。

papers.title: CereVLA: Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Execution
papers.abstract_en: Action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve inference efficiency, but limited feedback within committed action chunks can lead to accumulated execution errors. Residual adaptation can correct such deviations without retraining the VLA; however, existing corrections are typically optimized for reference-action consistency without explicitly considering their downstream consequences. To address this limitation, we present Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance (CereVLA), a unified framework that integrates lightweight residual refinement and predictive consequence evaluation into frozen VLA execution. Corrective actions are first generated by flow-based residual refinement, and their short- and interval-horizon consequences are then evaluated by a recurrent state-space model and a history-aware classifier. Residual corrections predicted to be unfavorable are selectively suppressed by a lightweight governor. Comparisons with state-of-the-art methods on LIBERO-10 and LIBERO-GOAL demonstrate the effectiveness of CereVLA. On SO-101, CereVLA increases task success from 57.5% to 90.0% and reduces mean control steps by 19.6% among successful trials, relative to the frozen SmolVLA baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CereVLA 在冻结的 VLA 策略外挂一层小脑式残差治理：flow-based 残差精修先生成纠正动作，再用 recurrent state-space model 与 history-aware classifier 预测其短程与区间后果，被判不利的纠正由轻量 governor 选择性抑制。在 SO-101 上相对冻结 SmolVLA 基线任务成功率从 57.5% 升到 90.0%，成功试验的平均控制步数减少 19.6%。
Motivation: 动作分块 (action chunk) 内反馈有限导致执行误差累积；现有残差修正只追求与参考动作一致，不考虑纠正动作的下游后果。
Method: 在冻结 VLA 执行中并入两部分：flow-based residual refinement 生成纠正动作，recurrent state-space model 加 history-aware classifier 评估其 short- 与 interval-horizon 后果，轻量 governor 抑制预测不利的残差修正；在 LIBERO-10、LIBERO-GOAL 与 SO-101 上与 SOTA 方法比较。
Result: SO-101 上任务成功率 57.5% → 90.0%（相对冻结 SmolVLA 基线），成功试验的平均控制步数减少 19.6%；在 LIBERO-10 与 LIBERO-GOAL 上与 SOTA 方法的比较显示方法有效。
Conclusion: 把后果预测接进残差治理，可在不重训 VLA 的前提下大幅提高成功率并缩短成功轨迹的控制步数。
