papers.title: Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. Pairwise flow dependence between adjacent voxels supports conditional queries, and per-voxel predictive variances yield calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate. We evaluate Kairos on three real pedestrian environments: a robot-collected campus dataset, a shopping mall, and a station concourse recorded continuously for eleven months. Its learned state remains consistent under loop-closure corrections, and its forecasts are competitive with dedicated occupancy and flow models trained on the full detection stream, although Kairos learns from only the small fraction available to a patrolling robot. Finally, we validate the representation on a downstream encounter-probability planning task, where plans computed over the Kairos forecasts encounter more people than plans computed over any time-invariant map at an equal success rate. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kairos 把层级 3D scene graph 扩展为 4D scene graph，每个体素同时存方向混合分布与出现率，用 spectral predictor 对任意未来查询时刻给出人员出现概率和完整运动方向分布。在三个真实人流环境上，其预测与在完整检测流上训练的专用 occupancy/flow 模型相当，但只用巡逻机器人能拿到的一小部分数据学习；下游遭遇概率规划在同等成功率下比任何时不变地图遇到更多人。
Motivation: 机器人在有人环境中做长期自主需要预判尚未观测时刻的人员出现与运动方向，而现有行人表征要么只预报未来活动量（把地点压成标量速率），要么建模完整方向分布但时间上固定，两者不可兼得。
Method: Kairos 在重建几何的每个已观测体素上存方向混合 (directional mixture) 与 presence rate，用 spectral predictor 对任意未来查询时刻同时预报出现概率与方向分布；相邻体素间建 pairwise flow dependence 以支持条件查询，逐体素预测方差给出可信区间。
Result: 在三个真实人流环境评测：机器人采集的校园数据集、购物中心、连续录制十一个月的车站大厅；学习状态在 loop-closure 修正下保持一致，预测与在完整检测流上训练的专用 occupancy 和 flow 模型相当，而 Kairos 只用巡逻机器人可获得的一小部分数据学习；下游遭遇概率规划任务中，基于 Kairos 预测的规划在同等成功率下比基于任何时不变地图的规划遇到更多人。
Conclusion: 把出现率与方向分布一起放进随时间演化的 4D scene graph，可以在稀疏机器人观测下做到与全数据流训练模型相当的预测，并直接改善遭遇概率规划；代码已开源。
Relevance: 38

summary_sections.result: 在三个真实人流环境评测：机器人采集的校园数据集、购物中心、连续录制十一个月的车站大厅；学习状态在 loop-closure 修正下保持一致，预测与在完整检测流上训练的专用 occupancy 和 flow 模型相当，而 Kairos 只用巡逻机器人可获得的一小部分数据学习；下游遭遇概率规划任务中，基于 Kairos 预测的规划在同等成功率下比基于任何时不变地图的规划遇到更多人。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把出现率与方向分布一起放进随时间演化的 4D scene graph，可以在稀疏机器人观测下做到与全数据流训练模型相当的预测，并直接改善遭遇概率规划；代码已开源。

papers.title: Hybrid Gaussians for Robust Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Multi-View Object Association and Boundary Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D segmentation localizes objects from free-form text queries, but remains challenging in real image sequences: incomplete or noisy 2D supervision destabilizes multi-view identity assignment, while full-scene semantic learning weakens object-level discriminability. We introduce Hybrid Gaussians, a unified 3D representation jointly modeling object association and language-aligned semantics. Its Multi-View Object Association mechanism combines Observation Fusion and Semantic Contrastive Learning to improve identity consistency and semantic discrimination. Boundary Reconstruction Optimization further refines local boundary structure to improve contour quality. Experiments on LERF and 3D-OVS demonstrate strong quantitative and qualitative performance. Our method achieves 59.1\% mIoU on LERF, yielding a 13.4\% relative gain over the baseline. Project page: https://nora202.github.io/hybridgaussians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Hybrid Gaussians，把物体关联与语言对齐语义统一进同一 3D 表示，用 Multi-View Object Association（Observation Fusion + Semantic Contrastive Learning）稳定跨视角身份一致性，再用 Boundary Reconstruction Optimization 精修局部边界轮廓。在 LERF 上取得 59.1% mIoU，相对基线提升 13.4%。
Motivation: 真实图像序列中 2D 监督不完整或含噪，使多视角身份分配不稳定；全场景语义学习又削弱物体级判别力，开放词汇 3D 分割因此难以落地。
Method: 以 Hybrid Gaussians 统一建模物体关联与语言对齐语义；Multi-View Object Association 机制结合 Observation Fusion 与 Semantic Contrastive Learning 提升身份一致性与语义判别；Boundary Reconstruction Optimization 精修局部边界结构以改善轮廓质量。
Result: 在 LERF 上 mIoU 达 59.1%，相对基线提升 13.4%；同时在 LERF 与 3D-OVS 上给出定量与定性结果。
Conclusion: 把物体关联、语义判别与边界精修放进同一 3D 表示，可在开放词汇 3D 分割上取得强定量与定性表现。

papers.title: Invisible in Space, Visible in Time: Motion Vision CAPTCHA against GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Most existing visual CAPTCHAs remain spatially solvable: the required information is exposed by static appearance, local structure, and interface state. This assumption is weakened by advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents, which exhibit strong visual perception, reasoning, and browser interaction capabilities. We propose Motion Vision CAPTCHA (MVCAP), a hierarchical motion-based CAPTCHA framework in which target semantics are instantiated as motion-defined foreground structures and become recoverable only through temporal segregation from a dynamically evolving background. Built on this shared principle, MVCAP is instantiated in three perceptually progressive levels: coherent motion, structural motion, and biological motion. To evaluate this framework, we introduce MVCAP-Bench, a browser-based benchmark with 600 live CAPTCHA instances, together with a matched foreground-only control benchmark, MVCAP-Bench-FG. We evaluate humans, Browser Use agents, native computer use agents, and a supplementary offline VQA setting derived from the same instances. Results reveal a substantial human--agent gap: on the full MVCAP-Bench, human accuracy reaches 99.6%, whereas the best GUI agent achieves only 16.8%, close to the six-way chance level. The foreground-only control further shows that the key difficulty comes from dynamic background camouflage rather than answer format or browser interaction alone. These findings identify a measurable human--agent perception gap and position MVCAP-Bench as a benchmark for studying motion-defined perception in current agents.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出运动视觉验证码 MVCAP，把目标语义编码为运动定义的前景结构，只有把前景从动态演化背景中做时间分离才能还原，分连贯运动、结构运动、生物运动三级。在 600 个在线实例的 MVCAP-Bench 上人类准确率 99.6%，最强 GUI agent 仅 16.8%，接近六选一随机水平；前景-only 对照表明难点来自动态背景伪装。
Motivation: 现有视觉验证码可由静态外观、局部结构和界面状态在单帧内解开，而 MLLM 与 GUI agent 的视觉感知和浏览器交互能力正使这一假设失效，需要把验证信号移到时间维度。
Method: MVCAP 用分层运动框架把目标语义实例化为运动定义的前景，需与动态背景做时间分离才能恢复；构建浏览器端基准 MVCAP-Bench（600 个在线验证码实例）及配对的前景-only 对照 MVCAP-Bench-FG，评测人类、Browser Use agent、原生 computer use agent，并补充同实例的离线 VQA 设置。
Result: MVCAP-Bench 上人类准确率 99.6%，最强 GUI agent 16.8%，接近六选一机会水平；前景-only 对照显示主要困难来自动态背景伪装，而非答案格式或浏览器交互本身。
Conclusion: 当前 agent 在运动定义感知上与人类存在可测量的鸿沟，MVCAP-Bench 可作为研究这类运动定义感知的基准。

papers.title: Beyond Balanced Accuracy: A Resolution and Parity-Controlled Benchmark for Vision-Language and Vision-Only Defect Assessment in UAV Power-Line Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often reported to outperform task-specific vision backbones for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) power-line defect assessment. We test that claim on ElecVQA-Bench, a 56,972-item benchmark derived from the public InsPLAD dataset, across six evaluation choices: partition, evaluated item set, label space, replication, input resolution, and side information. On a matched partition, a Swin Transformer and the strongest adapted VLM differ by only 0.03 points at binary screening. At seven-way defect typing, increasing the vision backbones from 224 px to the measured pixel budget of the VLM preprocessor narrows the gap against InternVL3.5-8B from +20.53 to -0.57 points for ResNet-50 and from +23.67 to +4.70 points for Swin-T. A pixel-budget audit shifts Qwen3-VL-8B macro recall by 10.78 points, yet a source-pixel-matched InternVL control still leaves Qwen ahead by 7.43 to 13.61 points while using 56% fewer visual tokens, so neither source pixels nor token budget explains the difference between the two VLMs. A two-seed global replication changes Qwen binary accuracy and seven-way macro recall by 0.86 and 1.02 points. After split-specific retraining, Qwen does not lead at crop or image level, and a 14-tower, three-seed replication reverses the sign across seeds, giving mean common-six macro recall of 0.9085 for Qwen against 0.9509 for ResNet-50. No split regime yields a family-level advantage that survives multiple-comparison correction. The study supports a benchmark-audit contribution rather than a general claim of VLM superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ElecVQA-Bench（56,972 项，源自 InsPLAD）上系统审计六个评测选择，发现 VLM 相对任务专用视觉骨干的表面优势随分辨率、token 预算与划分方式而翻转：对齐像素预算后 ResNet-50 与 InternVL3.5-8B 的七分类差距从 +20.53 收窄到 -0.57 点，而 14 塔三种子复现中 Qwen 与 ResNet-50 的 common-six macro recall 均值为 0.9085 对 0.9509。结论是没有任何划分 regime 的家族级优势能通过多重比较校正，应把贡献定位为 benchmark 审计而非 VLM 普遍更优。
Motivation: 文献常报告 VLM 在无人机输电线路缺陷评估上优于任务专用视觉骨干，但评测划分、标签空间、分辨率与侧信息等选择本身足以翻转结论，需要可复现的审计框架来判定优势是否稳健。
Method: 构建分辨率与奇偶性受控的基准 ElecVQA-Bench（56,972 项，源自公开 InsPLAD），沿六个评测选择做对照：partition、评测条目集、标签空间、复现、输入分辨率、侧信息；比较 Swin Transformer、ResNet-50、Swin-T 与 InternVL3.5-8B、Qwen3-VL-8B，并做像素预算审计与源像素匹配控制，配合两种子全局复现和 14 塔三种子复现。
Result: 匹配划分下二分类 Swin 与最强适配 VLM 仅差 0.03 点；七分类把视觉骨干从 224 px 提到 VLM 预处理器实测像素预算后，ResNet-50 对 InternVL3.5-8B 的差距从 +20.53 变为 -0.57 点，Swin-T 从 +23.67 收窄到 +4.70 点；像素预算审计使 Qwen3-VL-8B macro recall 移动 10.78 点，但源像素匹配的 InternVL 控制仍让 Qwen 领先 7.43 至 13.61 点且少用 56% 视觉 token；两种子全局复现使 Qwen 二分类准确率与七分类 macro recall 变动 0.86 与 1.02 点；划分特定重训后 Qwen 在 crop 与 image 级均不领先，14 塔三种子复现跨种子翻转符号，common-six macro recall 均值 Qwen 0.9085 对 ResNet-50 0.9509；无任何划分 regime 的家族级优势通过多重比较校正。
Conclusion: VLM 相对专用视觉骨干的评估优势主要由分辨率、token 预算与划分选择驱动而非模型家族本身，该工作的贡献应是 benchmark 审计框架而非 VLM 普遍更优的论断。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Latent evolving World Action Model
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model action generation and environment dynamics and are mostly built on pretrained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs). In VDM-based WAMs, observations are first encoded by a VAE, and the resulting compressed latents are then processed by large video diffusion backbones to extract effective features for action generation. However, this paradigm ties WAM performance and training cost to large-scale video generation pretraining, limiting WAM efficiency and scalability. In this paper, we theoretically and empirically investigate how visual representations affect action generation in WAMs. Our results show that predictive embeddings from Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoders better support action generation than compressed VAE latents, with I-JEPA performing best in our encoder comparison. Based on these findings, we propose LeWAM, which conditions action generation on JEPA embeddings and models environment evolution by predicting future embeddings in the same space, without relying on a video diffusion backbone. We further find that imitation learning matches demonstrated actions but does not distinguish better actions from worse ones, even though small action deviations can greatly affect task success. To address this limitation without additional environment interaction or the human oversight required for resets and safety, we introduce Demonstration-Guided DPO (DemoDPO), an offline preference refinement stage that derives preference supervision directly from demonstrations.With only 0.4B trainable parameters, LeWAM achieves an average success rate of 92.28\% on RoboTwin 2.0, comparable to that of state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs, and maintains practical effectiveness on real-world manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeWAM 用 JEPA 预测式表征替代 VAE 压缩 latent 与视频扩散骨干来驱动生成动作，并在同一 embedding 空间预测未来表征以刻画环境演化；I-JEPA 在编码器对比中表现最好。再用从示范直接构造偏好对的 Demonstration-Guided DPO (DemoDPO) 做离线偏好精修，0.4B 可训练参数在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 92.28%，与 SOTA VLA/WAM 相当。
Motivation: 基于视频扩散模型 (VDM) 的 World Action Model 把动作生成与训练成本绑死在大规模视频生成预训练上，效率与可扩展性受限；模仿学习只复现示范动作，无法区分好坏动作，而微小动作偏差会显著改变任务成败。
Method: 先理论加实证比较不同视觉表征对动作生成的影响，选定 JEPA（其中 I-JEPA 最佳）embedding 作为条件，并在同一空间预测未来 embedding 来建模环境演化，去掉视频扩散骨干；随后引入 DemoDPO，一个无需额外环境交互与人工 reset 的离线偏好精修阶段，偏好监督直接从示范中导出。
Result: 编码器对比中 I-JEPA 对动作生成的支持优于压缩 VAE latent 及其他被比较编码器；仅 0.4B 可训练参数的 LeWAM 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 92.28%，与 SOTA VLA 和 WAM 相当，并在真实操作任务上保持实际有效性。
Conclusion: 动作生成更该由预测式 JEPA 表征而非 VAE latent 加视频扩散骨干驱动，且示范本身足以构造偏好信号做离线精修，从而摆脱对大规模视频生成预训练的依赖。

papers.title: Issuer-Sovereign Agentic Payments
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are beginning to make real payments. Current approaches let an agent pay by relying on a credential provider that, in the approaches deployed today, typically sits outside the cardholder's bank. The spending rules are then enforced by the card network or that provider, and not by the bank itself. This leaves the issuing bank, which carries the financial risk, with little direct control at the moment a payment happens. This paper describes Issuer-Sovereign Agentic Payments, a method that keeps that control with the issuer. The cardholder approves a spending rule once, and the bank's own authentication component records it. Later, when the agent pays a specific merchant, the bank checks the merchant against the approved rule and generates the card authentication value only if the merchant is allowed. The payment then travels the normal card rails and is validated by the issuer, with no extra dependency introduced at execution.

papers.title: BEE: Intervention-Adaptive Real-World Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models handle long-horizon manipulation, yet success hinges on a few precision-critical phases where millimeter-scale errors undo all prior progress. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize exactly these actions, but free exploration is far too costly on real robots, which makes human corrections indispensable. However, existing online RL methods for VLAs either cannot incorporate such corrections or fold them into undifferentiated supervision. Yet human corrections are not uniformly noisy but reliable along some action dimensions and variable along others. Building on this, we introduce BEE, an intervention-adaptive framework for real-world RL on a frozen VLA that lets the policy go BEyond Expert imitation. We formulate human corrections not as actions to reproduce but as evidence about a constraint: a Correction Model predicts how a human would correct a given VLA proposal and how consistent the correction is along each action dimension. This predicted consistency sets the per-dimension tightness of a constraint on policy optimization. Where corrections are consistent the policy stays close to the human, and where they vary, the constraint relaxes. We evaluate BEE on three real-world manipulation tasks and one LIBERO-Pro simulation task at a matched online-data budget. BEE attains the highest success rate on every task, 91.2% on average against 57.5% for RLT and 42.1% for DSRL, and the lowest human intervention rate on all real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEE 把人类纠正当作关于约束的证据而非要复现的动作：Correction Model 预测人会如何纠正 VLA 的动作提议、以及纠正在每个动作维度上的一致性，用该一致性设定策略优化约束的逐维紧度——一致处贴紧人类、不一致处放松约束。在匹配在线数据预算下，三个真实操作任务加一个 LIBERO-Pro 仿真任务上平均成功率 91.2%，对比 RLT 57.5%、DSRL 42.1%，且真实任务的人类干预率最低。
Motivation: VLA 的长程操作成败取决于少数毫米级精度阶段，真实机器人上自由探索代价过高必须依赖人类纠正，而现有在线 RL 方法要么无法吸收纠正、要么把纠正混成无差别监督，忽略了纠正在不同动作维度上可靠性不同。
Method: 在冻结的 VLA 上做干预自适应的真实世界在线 RL（框架名 BEE，Beyond Expert imitation）：训练 Correction Model 预测人类对给定 VLA 动作提议的纠正及其逐动作维度的一致性，把该一致性映射为策略优化约束的逐维紧度，一致维度贴近人类、变动维度放松约束；评测覆盖三个真实操作任务与一个 LIBERO-Pro 仿真任务，采用匹配的在线数据预算。
Result: 在匹配在线数据预算下，BEE 在全部四个任务上取得最高成功率，平均 91.2%，对比 RLT 57.5% 与 DSRL 42.1%；在所有真实世界任务上人类干预率最低。
Conclusion: 把人类纠正按维度分解为可靠性证据并据此调节约束紧度，能在冻结 VLA 上同时提高真实操作成功率并减少对人类干预的依赖。

papers.title: Quantum Reinforcement Learning for Cost and Delay Tradeoffs in Quantum Cloud Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Quantum cloud computing, delivered through the quantum-as-a-service (QaaS) model, provides access to quantum computing resources. However, applying uniform time-based pricing across fundamentally heterogeneous quantum resources significantly complicates task orchestration, particularly when addressing the tradeoff between execution costs and system performance. While heuristic methods rely on predefined scheduling rules, classical deep reinforcement learning (DRL) models may require more trainable parameters in this setting. Motivated by the potential of parameterised quantum circuits (PQCs) as compact function approximators, we propose QRLQ, a cost-delay-aware quantum cloud scheduling framework integrating PQCs with a dueling double deep Q-network (D3QN) to dynamically account for both cost and delay. Our simulation results show that QRLQ achieves lower mean cost and delay than the heuristic baselines, achieving a 5-11% lower mean cost relative to availability-based and rotation-based heuristics and reducing mean delay by 17% and 82% relative to the strongest and weakest heuristic baselines, respectively, while retaining execution fidelity within 2% of a fidelity-greedy policy. Compared with the classical DRL baseline, QRLQ achieves comparable scheduling performance while using 72% fewer trainable parameters. This work explores the feasibility of using QRL for task orchestration in quantum cloud environments and demonstrates its potential for cost-delay-aware quantum resource management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QRLQ 把参数化量子线路 (PQC) 作为紧凑函数近似器接入 dueling double DQN (D3QN)，用于量子云任务编排中的成本-时延权衡。仿真中相对 availability-based 与 rotation-based 启发式平均成本低 5–11%，平均时延相对最强与最弱启发式分别降低 17% 与 82%，执行保真度保持在 fidelity-greedy 策略的 2% 以内；相比经典 DRL 基线性能相当但可训练参数少 72%。
Motivation: 量子云 (QaaS) 对根本异质的量子资源按统一时间定价，使执行成本与系统性能的权衡难以编排；启发式依赖预设规则，而经典 DRL 在该设定下需要更多可训练参数。
Method: 提出 QRLQ：将 PQC 与 D3QN 结合的量子强化学习调度框架，动态同时计入成本与时延，在仿真环境中与启发式及经典 DRL 基线对比。
Result: 仿真结果：相对 availability-based 与 rotation-based 启发式平均成本低 5–11%；平均时延相对最强启发式降低 17%、相对最弱启发式降低 82%；执行保真度保持在 fidelity-greedy 策略的 2% 以内；相对经典 DRL 基线调度性能相当而可训练参数少 72%。
Conclusion: PQC 作为紧凑函数近似器可在量子云成本-时延感知调度中以大幅更少的参数达到与经典 DRL 相当的性能，并明显优于启发式规则。

papers.title: SatUnreal: A High-Precision Synthetic Dataset for Satellite Stereo Matching via Unreal Engine
papers.abstract_en: 3D reconstruction from satellite imagery is essential for large-scale topographic analysis, yet the lack of high-fidelity training datasets with accurate occlusion labels remains a primary bottleneck. Existing benchmarks, such as US3D and WHU-Stereo, face inherent challenges in spatio-temporal mismatch -- environmental changes and shadow displacements between multi-view acquisitions -- and provide ambiguous ground truth in occluded regions due to LiDAR sparsity. In this paper, we propose SatUnreal, a high-precision synthetic dataset designed to fundamentally overcome these limitations through an Unreal Engine-based simulation pipeline. SatUnreal provides 10,000 stereo pairs with high resolution (0.3m GSD) and is characterized by: (1) Physical Geometry Simulation, replicating realistic satellite orbits by systematically varying baselines and azimuths; (2) Spatio-temporal Consistency, eliminating temporal noise through fixed virtual environments; (3) Topographic Diversity, spanning dense urban canyons to low-texture natural terrains; and (4) Mathematical Label Integrity, utilizing a novel two-step linetrace algorithm to generate flawless occlusion masks. Experimental results using SOTA iterative models demonstrate that models trained exclusively on SatUnreal achieve superior zero-shot transfer performance on real-world benchmarks (US3D, WHU-Stereo) compared to those trained on real datasets. Our findings prove that physically accurate synthetic data provides a more effective supervisory signal for learning geometric features than complex real-world observations, establishing a new paradigm for Sim-to-Real transfer in Earth Observation. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jmp-Telepix/SatUnreal_A_High-Precision_Synthetic_Dataset_for_Satellite_Stereo_Matching_via_UnrealEngine
papers.comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshop on EarthVision (CVPRW 2026), pp. 7990-7999. Code and dataset: https://github.com/jmp-Telepix/SatUnreal_A_High-Precision_Synthetic_Dataset_for_Satellite_Stereo_Matching_via_UnrealEngine Supplementary material: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026W/EarthVision/supplemental/Kim_SatUnreal_A_High-Precision_CVPRW_2026_supplemental.pdf
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops, 2026, pp. 7990-7999
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SatUnreal 用 Unreal Engine 仿真管线生成 10,000 对 0.3m GSD 卫星立体像对，以两步 linetrace 算法产出无歧义的遮挡 mask，消除真实基准的时空错配与 LiDAR 稀疏导致的标签模糊。仅在 SatUnreal 上训练的 SOTA 迭代模型，在 US3D、WHU-Stereo 真实基准上的零样本迁移优于用真实数据训练的模型。
Motivation: 卫星立体匹配缺少带准确遮挡标签的高保真训练数据：US3D、WHU-Stereo 存在多视角采集间的环境变化与阴影位移等时空错配，且 LiDAR 稀疏使遮挡区域真值含糊。
Method: 基于 Unreal Engine 的仿真管线，系统改变基线与方位角复现真实卫星轨道，固定虚拟环境消除时间噪声，覆盖从密集城市峡谷到低纹理自然地形，并用两步 linetrace 算法生成精确遮挡 mask；用 SOTA 迭代模型做训练与迁移实验。
Result: 数据集含 10,000 对立体像对，分辨率 0.3m GSD；仅用 SatUnreal 训练的模型在真实基准 US3D 与 WHU-Stereo 上的零样本迁移性能优于用真实数据训练的模型。
Conclusion: 物理精确的合成数据比复杂真实观测更适合作为学习几何特征的监督信号，可为地球观测的 Sim-to-Real 迁移建立新范式。

papers.title: Stable Neural Decoding Across Sessions via Task-Conditioned Latent Alignment for Brain-Machine Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Achieving stable long-term neural decoding in invasive brain-machine interfaces (BMIs) remains challenging due to variations in recorded neural populations across sessions. Current latent alignment approaches may overlook task-dependent structure during cross-session adaptation. We propose Task-Conditioned Latent Alignment (TCLA), a framework that stabilizes neural decoding by learning a shared latent space. TCLA learns a low-dimensional source representation using neural reconstruction and continuous behavioral supervision. During target-session adaptation, the shared representation is fixed, while target neural activity is mapped into the source latent space by aligning source and target distributions separately for each task condition. We evaluated TCLA on seven nonhuman primate datasets spanning multiple tasks. In long-term cross-session evaluation, TCLA achieved a mean $R^2$ of $0.476\pm0.014$ with a negative $R^2$ failure rate of only 6.8\%. Across 1,356 within-subject session pairs, TCLA achieved a mean $R^2$ of $0.371\pm0.009$ with a failure rate of 6.8\%. Across 2,134 cross-subject session pairs, TCLA achieved a mean $R^2$ of $0.218\pm0.004$ with a failure rate of 12.9\%, substantially better than those of the comparison methods. These results demonstrate that by preserving behaviorally relevant and task-dependent latent structure, TCLA improves the robustness of neural decoding across recording sessions and subjects. The source code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/FAMD-CASIA/TCLA}{https://github.com/FAMD-CASIA/TCLA}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出任务条件化隐空间对齐 (TCLA)：用神经重构与连续行为监督学一个共享低维源隐空间，跨 session 适应时固定该空间，再按任务条件分别对齐源/目标分布，把目标神经活动映射进源隐空间。在 7 个非人灵长类数据集上，长期跨 session 平均 R² 为 0.476±0.014、负 R² 失败率 6.8%，跨个体 2,134 对 session 上 R² 0.218±0.004、失败率 12.9%，均明显优于对比方法。
Motivation: 侵入式 BMI 长期使用中记录到的神经元群体会跨 session 变化，导致解码漂移；现有隐空间对齐方法忽略任务相关的跨 session 结构。
Method: TCLA 先用神经重构损失加连续行为监督学习低维源表示；目标 session 适应时冻结共享表示，按每个任务条件分别做源/目标分布对齐，把目标神经活动映射到源隐空间。
Result: 在 7 个非人灵长类数据集、多任务上：长期跨 session 平均 R² 0.476±0.014，负 R² 失败率 6.8%；1,356 个被试内 session 对上平均 R² 0.371±0.009，失败率 6.8%；2,134 个跨被试 session 对上平均 R² 0.218±0.004，失败率 12.9%，显著优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 保留行为相关且任务依赖的隐结构能提升跨 session、跨被试神经解码的稳健性；跨被试难度更大（R² 0.218、失败率 12.9%）。源码已公开。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 保留行为相关且任务依赖的隐结构能提升跨 session、跨被试神经解码的稳健性；跨被试难度更大（R² 0.218、失败率 12.9%）。源码已公开。

papers.title: Overlapping Visual Grouping Without Semantic Priors
papers.abstract_en: Most computer-vision systems organize visual input toward a predefined interpretation, such as semantic categories, prompted regions, learned object-like representations, or a single spatial partition. This work considers an earlier stage of visual organization: the formation of candidate perceptual units directly from sensor measurements before their identity, meaning, or task relevance is known. We introduce Domain Parent Grouping (DPG), a sensor-grounded grouping method in which complementary measurement relationships are represented in separate processing domains. Spatially connected groups formed within these domains are related through cross-domain overlap, yielding a non-exclusive grouping representation rather than a single mutually exclusive segmentation. This representation retains broader and more localized groups, as well as alternative grouping boundaries over the same image locations, simultaneously available. DPG also includes a native mechanism for reprocessing selected group content, in which input-relative measurement ranges allow the observational resolution to change while preserving previously formed groups. DPG is implemented using three domains representing locally contextualized luminance, direct chromatic relationships, and contextual chromatic relationships. Experiments on the BSDS500 dataset demonstrate the benefit of combining the three domains. The results further show that DPG forms measurement-supported groups corresponding to low-level image structure, and that these groups exhibit measurable correspondence with human-annotated regions and boundaries. This demonstrates that structured visual organization can emerge directly from relationships among sensor measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Domain Parent Grouping (DPG)：在语义、提示区域与单一互斥分割之前，直接从传感器测量关系生成候选感知单元。三个域（局部上下文化亮度、直接色度关系、上下文化色度关系）内各自连通成组，再靠跨域重叠关联，得到同时保留多尺度与备选边界的非互斥分组；在 BSDS500 上验证三域组合的收益，且分组与人工标注的区域和边界有可测对应。
Motivation: 现有视觉系统一开始就朝预定义解释（语义类别、提示区域、学习到的类物体表示或单一空间划分）组织输入，缺少身份与任务先验之前的、由测量本身支撑的分组阶段。
Method: DPG 把互补的测量关系放进独立处理域：三个域分别编码局部上下文化亮度、直接色度关系、上下文化色度关系；域内做空间连通分组，再通过 cross-domain overlap 关联各域，形成非互斥分组表示，同时保留更宽与更局部的组及同一位置上的备选边界。另含原生的重处理机制，用 input-relative measurement ranges 改变观测分辨率并保留已形成的组。
Result: 在 BSDS500 上的实验显示组合三个域带来收益；结果还显示 DPG 形成的组对应低层图像结构，并与人工标注的区域和边界存在可测对应 (measurable correspondence)。
Conclusion: 结构化的视觉组织可以直接从传感器测量之间的关系中涌现，无需语义先验；分组应在身份与含义确定之前、以非互斥方式保留多尺度与备选边界。

papers.title: Counterfactual Constraint-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Multi-constraint instruction following requires a model to respond to a query under many simultaneously active constraints. Even strong instruction-tuned models still routinely violate some of them. Existing approaches either augment supervision with sequence- or token-level RL rewards from external verifiers or learned graders, or use on-policy distillation (OPD) against a single full-context teacher whose probability mass becomes diluted as more constraints become simultaneously active. We propose CC-OPD (Counterfactual Constraint-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation), which inverts the standard supervision-generation direction in distillation. Rather than enriching the teacher with information beyond what the student sees, CC-OPD ablates each constraint from the teacher's conditioning in turn, and constructs the per-constraint signal from the resulting per-token probability differentials. The resulting per-token leave-one-out log-likelihood shifts are summed, clipped, and added to the vanilla OPD reward as a token-level shaping term. All shaping terms are obtained from the frozen teacher, without an external verifier during distillation, and the reward equals vanilla OPD wherever the aggregate shift is zero. Across two Qwen model pairs and seven benchmarks, CC-OPD achieves the highest average among all evaluated student-training methods. A 1.5B student trained with CC-OPD surpasses its own 7B RL-trained teacher on the MulDimIF benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CC-OPD：对每个约束从教师条件中逐一消融，用逐 token 概率差构造 leave-one-out log-likelihood 偏移，求和裁剪后作为 shaping 项加进 vanilla OPD 奖励，全部信号来自冻结教师、无需外部 verifier。在两组 Qwen 师生对与七个基准上取得所有学生训练方法中的最高平均分，1.5B 学生在 MulDimIF 上超过其 7B RL 训练的教师。
Motivation: 多约束指令跟随中强指令微调模型仍常违反部分约束；现有方法要么依赖外部 verifier/learned grader 的序列或 token 级 RL 奖励，要么用单一 full-context 教师做 on-policy distillation，而同时激活的约束越多，教师概率质量越被稀释。
Method: CC-OPD 反转蒸馏的监督生成方向：不给教师补充学生看不到的信息，而是逐个从教师条件中消融某条约束，取该消融前后的逐 token 概率差作为该约束的信号；把各约束的 leave-one-out log-likelihood 偏移求和、裁剪，加到 vanilla OPD 奖励上作为 token 级 shaping 项。所有 shaping 项来自冻结教师，蒸馏期间不用外部 verifier，且当聚合偏移为零时奖励退化为 vanilla OPD。
Result: 在两组 Qwen 模型对和七个基准上，CC-OPD 取得所有被评估学生训练方法中的最高平均分；一个 1.5B 学生用 CC-OPD 训练后在 MulDimIF 基准上超过其自身 7B 的 RL 训练教师。
Conclusion: 把约束逐条消融得到的反事实逐 token 偏移作为奖励塑形，可以在不引入外部 verifier 的前提下提升多约束指令跟随，并让小学生超过大 RL 教师。

papers.title: Emergi-PersonaOS: A Persona Agent Operating System for Situational Adaptation and Controllable Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Symbiosis between humans and digital beings offers a vision for the future of human--machine interaction. In enduring human--machine relationships, personality provides a foundation for continuity of identity, individuality in interaction, and development through experience. We investigate this capacity through persona agents as computational implementations and introduce Emergi-PersonaOS, a psychology-grounded operating system for managing persona objects throughout their lifecycle. The system organizes dispositional traits, characteristic adaptations, and narrative identity into a three-layer persona representation, distinguishing relatively enduring persona beliefs from their activation in the current persona state. During situational adaptation, it integrates the current interlocutor, relationship, event, and retrieved memories to infer a persona state and generate actions and replies; during long-term development, it records experiences and outcomes, and develops and evaluates revision candidates through change attribution, meaning-making, and behavioral testing. Belief updates are managed through explicit review, traceable evidence and version records, and the ability to reject candidates, making persona evolution controllable. Using television-character dialogue as longitudinal material, we demonstrate long-horizon system operation and examine its principal mechanisms in a concrete implementation. This work provides a computational framework for persona agents to maintain individual continuity, produce situation-specific expression, and develop through experience over sustained interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Emergi-PersonaOS 是一个心理学取向的人格体操作系统，把人格对象按三层表征（特质、特征适应、叙事同一性）管理，并区分持久人格信念与当前情境下的人格状态。情境适应时结合对话者、关系、事件与检索记忆推断状态并生成回复；长期演化通过归因、意义建构与行为测试产生修订候选，经显式审查、可追溯证据与版本记录后才更新信念，使演化可控。以电视剧角色对话作纵向材料，展示了长时段系统运行。
Motivation: 人机长期关系中人格体需要身份连续性与随经验发展的能力，而现有实现缺少对人格对象全生命周期、信念更新可追溯与可控的系统化管理。
Method: 三层人格表征（dispositional traits、characteristic adaptations、narrative identity），分离持久信念与 persona state；情境适应整合对话者、关系、事件与检索记忆推断状态并生成动作与回复；长期演化记录经验与结果，用 change attribution、meaning-making、behavioral testing 生成并评估修订候选，信念更新走显式审查、证据与版本记录、可拒绝候选的流程。
Result: 以电视角色对话作为纵向材料，演示了长时段系统运行并在具体实现中检视其主要机制；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 人格体的连续性、情境化表达与经验驱动发展可以通过一个带可追溯、可拒绝更新流程的操作系统式框架在持续交互中维持。

papers.title: S2A:Semantic-to-Spatial Alignment for Alignment-Free RGB-T Salient Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Alignment-free RGB-T salient object detection (RGB-T SOD) aims to identify salient objects from unregistered RGB and thermal image pairs without costly pre-alignment. However, spatial misalignment breaks pixel-wise correspondence and causes feature contamination during cross-modal fusion. To address this issue, we propose S2A, a semantic-to-spatial alignment framework for alignment-free RGB-T SOD. Specifically, a global-guided hierarchical fusion module (GGHF) first exploits global semantic guidance to suppress background interference and refine hierarchical intra-modal features. Subsequently, the alignment-free cross-modal channel attention module (AFCA) globally exchanges complementary semantic information through channel-wise interaction, effectively overcoming the interference caused by local spatial misalignments. Finally, a spatial deformable cross-attention module (SDCA) predicts adaptive sampling offsets to recover local cross-modal spatial correspondence. Through this semantic-to-spatial paradigm, S2A first enables reliable cross-modal semantic interaction and subsequently performs local spatial calibration, effectively reducing misalignment-induced feature contamination. Without bells and whistles, S2A achieves highly competitive performance on multiple public alignment-free RGB-T benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in alleviating misalignment-induced feature contamination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对未配准 RGB-T 显著目标检测 (alignment-free RGB-T SOD) 中空间错位破坏像素对应、跨模态融合被污染的问题，提出 S2A 的语义到空间对齐范式：先用全局语义交互绕开局部错位，再用可变形采样偏移恢复局部空间对应。在多个公开 alignment-free RGB-T benchmark 上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: RGB 与热图像未预配准时，空间错位破坏逐像素对应，跨模态融合阶段出现特征污染；预对齐本身成本高。
Method: 三级流水线：全局引导分层融合模块 (GGHF) 用全局语义抑制背景干扰并细化模态内分层特征；对齐无关跨模态通道注意力 (AFCA) 通过通道维交互全局交换互补语义，绕开局部空间错位；可变形跨注意力 (SDCA) 预测自适应采样偏移，恢复局部跨模态空间对应。
Result: 在多个公开 alignment-free RGB-T 显著目标检测 benchmark 上取得 highly competitive performance，被作者用作减轻错位诱导特征污染有效性的证据。
Conclusion: 先做全局语义交互、再做局部空间校准的语义到空间顺序，能可靠缓解未配准 RGB-T 融合中的错位污染。

papers.title: When Labels Are Scarce: An Oscillatory State Space Model for Vibration Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Machine fault diagnosis from vibration requires learning from scarce labelled fault recordings while meeting the computational constraints of edge devices for local inference. We introduce DualRes, a compact oscillatory state-space model that combines two complementary spectral views of vibration, capturing rapid changes and fine frequency structure. Time-aligned views are processed by selective oscillatory memory, which learns how long to retain temporal patterns. The encoder contains 39,528 parameters. We evaluate supervised learning across six bearing datasets and a gearbox benchmark, with an additional gearbox pilot. Recording-level splits and explicit accounting of labelled duration distinguish data efficiency from repeated exposure to correlated samples. On the main gearbox benchmark, DualRes achieves state-of-the-art performance among the nine evaluated methods at six of seven label budgets. With about six labelled seconds per class, it improves macro-F1 by 16.1 percentage points over the next strongest comparator. On the same benchmark, DualRes achieves a 1.44-fold recording-level speedup and a 24.8-fold reduction in checkpoint storage relative to a selective state-space baseline under matched hardware and runtime conditions. Bearing results reveal task-dependent trade-offs. These findings support oscillatory memory as a compact approach to vibration diagnosis under limited labelled exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualRes 是面向振动故障诊断的紧凑振荡状态空间模型，用两个时间对齐的频谱视角加选择性振荡记忆 (selective oscillatory memory) 学习保留时序模式的长度，编码器仅 39,528 参数。在主齿轮箱基准的 7 个标注预算中 6 个达到九种方法里的最优；每类仅约 6 个标注秒时，macro-F1 比次优方法高 16.1 个百分点，相对选择性 SSM 基线录制级加速 1.44 倍、检查点存储减少 24.8 倍。
Motivation: 故障诊断缺少标注故障录制，同时边缘设备算力受限；相关样本的重复曝光会虚高数据效率，需要用录制级划分和标注时长核算来区分真实效率。
Method: DualRes 把振动的两个互补频谱视角按时间对齐后送入选择性振荡记忆，由记忆决定时序模式保留多久；评测为监督学习，覆盖六个轴承数据集与一个齿轮箱基准外加一个齿轮箱试点，采用 recording-level splits 并显式核算标注时长。
Result: 编码器 39,528 参数；主齿轮箱基准上在 7 个标注预算中的 6 个取得九种已评测方法中的 SOTA；每类约 6 个标注秒时 macro-F1 比次优比较器高 16.1 个百分点；同基准、同硬件与运行条件下相对选择性 SSM 基线录制级加速 1.44 倍、检查点存储减少 24.8 倍；轴承结果呈任务相关的取舍。
Conclusion: 在标注曝光受限时，振荡记忆是振动诊断的紧凑可行路线，其优势在齿轮箱基准上随标注预算变化，轴承任务上则存在任务依赖的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Active Learning for Biodiversity Monitoring: From Label Efficiency to Reliable Ecological Inference
papers.abstract_en: Limited expert annotation capacity is a pervasive constraint in biodiversity monitoring. Passive acoustic recorders and camera traps generate data faster than experts can analyse them. Machine learning (ML) models can process these data at scale, but their reliability depends on the quality, quantity, and coverage of labelled samples, so expert time remains a constraint. Active learning (AL) eases this bottleneck by selecting, under a fixed annotation budget, the samples expected to improve a model most, and published evidence shows it can reduce the labels needed to reach a target performance. Monitoring programmes, however, face a broader question: how should a limited expert budget be divided so that model training, validation, and the ecological estimates built on model outputs all remain reliable? Because AL selects samples non-randomly, its labels are unsuitable for validation, calibration, or threshold selection, a tension rarely acknowledged. We synthesise AL research across acoustic and image modalities and identify gaps and opportunities. Most studies evaluate query strategies on pre-labelled benchmarks with simulated annotators; deployments in real monitoring workflows are rare and concentrate on birds and cetaceans. Bats, insects, amphibians, and fish are underrepresented, and multimodal applications remain largely unexplored. Evaluation centres on headline reductions in annotation effort, often without random-sampling baselines, per-class results, or calibration analysis, and rarely accounts for the labels required for validation. We provide a tutorial treatment of the AL loop that makes these budget decisions explicit, and a roadmap towards AL methods that support label-efficient training, validation, and trustworthy downstream ecological inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述生物多样性监测中的主动学习 (active learning)，核心论断是：AL 按非随机准则选样本，其标签不能用于验证、校准或阈值选择，因此专家标注预算必须在训练、验证与下游生态推断之间显式分配，而不是全部投给训练集。已发表证据显示 AL 能减少达到目标性能所需标签，但多数研究只在预标注基准上用模拟标注者评测，且常缺随机采样基线、逐类结果与校准分析。
Motivation: 被动声学记录仪与相机陷阱产数速度远超专家分析能力，而 AL 只优化训练标签、忽略验证与校准所需标签，导致生态估计的可靠性无从保证。
Method: 综合声学与图像两类模态的 AL 研究，梳理查询策略、评测方式与预算分配；给出显式区分训练、验证、校准、阈值选择预算的 AL loop 教程式处理，并提出面向标签高效训练与可信生态推断的方法路线图。
Result: 已发表证据表明 AL 可减少达到目标性能所需标签量；综述发现现有评测集中于标注努力的头条式缩减，常不带随机采样基线、逐类结果与校准分析，也很少计入验证所需标签；真实监测流程中的部署稀少且集中于鸟类与鲸豚，蝙蝠、昆虫、两栖类、鱼类代表性不足，多模态应用基本空白。
Conclusion: AL 的价值不止于省训练标签：非随机采样使其标签天然不适合验证与校准，监测项目必须把专家预算显式分给训练、验证与生态估计三处，才能得到可信的下游推断。

papers.title: What Looks Like a Capability Limit in Vision-Language Models Is a Readout Limit
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for vision-language models offer their answer choices in some convention: a letter, a color name, a pixel coordinate. That convention is treated as neutral. We find it is not, and that the limits a benchmark reports can belong to the readout rather than to the model. On 200 COCO photographs, Qwen3-VL-4B picks the correct one of nine locations for a named object 68.5% of the time when the locations are given in English and 20.0% when the same locations are given as pixel coordinates. Chance is 11.1%. The cost arises when the answer options are coordinates; giving the model a coordinate in the question instead costs 3.5 points and is not significant. The gap holds on a 4x4 grid, under 8-bit rather than 4-bit quantization, and in every slice by object size, boundary distance and category. It also decides which model wins. Two models that tie under English names differ by 39 points in one coordinate system and by 54 in the other, in opposite directions. On the color task, three of the four open models capable of the task show the penalty; on photographs, two of three open models do, and so does Gemini, at 11.1 points on parseable answers (p = 1e-4). GPT-4o does not. To ask whether a model reads a coordinate at all, we attach the wrong name to each one and record which the model follows. Color options written as hue angles are followed below chance; a normalized pixel convention is followed at four times chance. This tells apart conventions a model can use from ones it cannot, though it did not predict accuracy on two untried conventions. Five models also name the same color wheel five different ways, so a fixed answer vocabulary is not neutral across models either. Five times during this work we measured a capable model as incapable because our scorer and the model disagreed about what an answer looks like. We report each case. They are the phenomenon in miniature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 基准里答案选项的书写约定（英文名 vs 像素坐标）本身就能制造出看似模型能力上限的差距。在 200 张 COCO 图上，Qwen3-VL-4B 用英文名选对九个候选位置的比例为 68.5%，换成像素坐标只剩 20.0%（随机 11.1%）；把坐标放进题干只损失 3.5 个百分点且不显著。该差距在 4×4 网格、8-bit 量化以及按物体大小/边界距离/类别的全部切片中都成立，并能反转模型排名。
Motivation: 基准把答案约定（字母、颜色名、像素坐标）当作中性载体，但读出方式的差异会被误读成模型能力上限，甚至决定哪个模型“赢”。
Method: 在 200 张 COCO 照片上让 Qwen3-VL-4B 从九个候选位置中选目标位置，对比英文名与像素坐标两种选项约定；再用“给每个坐标附错误名称、记录模型听谁的”探针区分模型能用与不能用的约定，并在 4×4 网格、4/8-bit 量化、按物体大小/边界距离/类别切片上检验稳健性。
Result: 英文名 68.5% vs 像素坐标 20.0%（chance 11.1%）；坐标放进题干只损失 3.5 点且不显著。两个在英文名下打平的模型在一种坐标系下差 39 点、另一种下差 54 点，方向相反。颜色任务四个开放模型中三个、照片任务三个开放模型中两个出现该惩罚，Gemini 在可解析答案上为 11.1 点（p = 1e-4），GPT-4o 没有。错误命名探针中，色相角选项低于随机，归一化像素约定被遵循的程度是随机的四倍；五个模型对同一色轮给出五种不同命名。
Conclusion: 基准报告的“能力上限”可能属于读出约定而非模型本身，评分器与模型对答案形态的分歧会把有能力的模型判成无能（作者记录了五次此类案例）；固定答案词汇表跨模型也不中性。

papers.title: Forget who you Forgot: Speaker Unlearning to Prevent Re-Identification in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Recent zero-shot text-to-speech (ZS-TTS) systems can reproduce a speaker's voice with high fidelity from only a few seconds of reference speech, raising concerns over unauthorized voice cloning and impersonation. Speaker identity unlearning has recently emerged as an approach to selectively suppress this capability for speakers who opt out while preserving synthesis capability for other speakers. Although existing approaches reduce speaker similarity, preventing re-identification often faces severe degradation of speech quality. Motivated by this observation, we propose GUARD, a lightweight speaker identity unlearning framework that combines a learned speaker gate with speaker-agnostic activation steering on a frozen TTS backbone. The steering vectors are optimized using group-relative reward optimization to shift outputs from forget speakers toward population-level impostor similarity while preserving intelligibility and speech naturalness. On CosyVoice2, GUARD reduces forget-speaker similarity from 0.541 to 0.103 and re-identification accuracy in a 150-speaker gallery from 73.5% to 0.5%, while preserving retain-speaker reproduction. The results demonstrate that similarity reduction alone may not fully characterize successful speaker identity unlearning and highlight re-identification as a complementary criterion for its evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUARD 在冻结的 zero-shot TTS 骨干上用可学习说话人门控加说话人无关激活导向 (speaker-agnostic activation steering)，以 group-relative reward optimization 优化导向向量，把遗忘说话人的输出推向群体级冒名相似度。在 CosyVoice2 上，遗忘说话人相似度从 0.541 降到 0.103，150 说话人库的重识别准确率从 73.5% 降到 0.5%，同时保留说话人复现能力。
Motivation: zero-shot TTS 只需几秒参考语音即可高保真复现人声，退出者的声音仍可被克隆；现有说话人身份遗忘方法虽降低相似度，但阻止重识别时往往严重损害语音质量。
Method: GUARD 是轻量说话人身份遗忘框架：在冻结 TTS 骨干上叠加可学习说话人门控与说话人无关激活导向，导向向量用 group-relative reward optimization 训练，目标是把遗忘说话人输出拉向群体级冒名相似度，同时保持可懂度与自然度。
Result: 在 CosyVoice2 上，遗忘说话人相似度 0.541 → 0.103；150 说话人 gallery 中重识别准确率 73.5% → 0.5%；保留说话人的复现能力得以维持。
Conclusion: 相似度下降不足以刻画成功的说话人身份遗忘，重识别准确率应作为互补评估准则；降低相似度与保住语音质量可以同时做到。

papers.title: Automotive mmWave Spinning Radar Place Recognition with Spatially Gated Feature-Correlation Representation
papers.abstract_en: Automotive spinning FMCW radar provides dense, $360^\circ$ sensing and remains reliable under poor illumination and adverse weather, making it well-suited to autonomous navigation. Place recognition uses these observations to identify previously visited locations for re-localization and long-term navigation. However, heading changes appear as circular shifts in the polar radar representation, and conventional global aggregation can lose relationships among radar responses that are important for distinguishing similar places. We propose SGCA-Net, a spinning radar place recognition framework that combines rotation-robust feature extraction with Spatially Gated Correlation Aggregation (SGCA). SGCA learns spatial weights to reduce the influence of unstable and ambiguous radar regions, while aggregating pairwise correlations among local responses to preserve informative feature relationships. Experiments on the MulRan dataset show that SGCA-Net consistently outperforms SOTA methods across urban, campus, and open-road environments, while remaining robust to substantial heading variation. Evaluation on the HeRCULES dataset further demonstrates that SGCA-Net generalizes to unseen environments and radar sensors without fine-tuning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications (DICTA 2026). 8 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGCA-Net 用旋转鲁棒特征提取加空间门控相关聚合 (SGCA) 做车载旋转 FMCW 雷达的地点识别：空间权重压低不稳定、含糊雷达区域的影响，同时聚合局部响应的成对相关以保留区分相似地点的特征关系。在 MulRan 的城市、校园与开放道路环境中一致优于 SOTA，并在 HeRCULES 上零微调泛化到未见过的环境与雷达传感器。
Motivation: 航向变化在极坐标雷达表征中表现为循环移位，而常规全局聚合会丢失区分相似地点所需的雷达响应间关系，使重定位与长期导航不可靠。
Method: 旋转鲁棒特征提取应对循环移位；Spatially Gated Correlation Aggregation 学习空间权重抑制不稳定含糊区域，并聚合局部响应的成对相关；在 MulRan 上实验，并在 HeRCULES 上做跨环境跨传感器评测。
Result: MulRan 数据集上在城市、 campus 与开放道路环境中一致优于 SOTA 方法，且在大幅航向变化下保持鲁棒；HeRCULES 数据集上无需微调即泛化到未见过的环境与雷达传感器。
Conclusion: 把空间门控与成对相关聚合结合，可以让旋转雷达地点识别在航向大幅变化和跨传感器场景下保持区分力与可迁移性。

papers.title: EvoAudio: Recursive Self-Improvement for Audio Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Audio language models understand what is said far better than how it sounds. Closing this gap takes more than data. Detailed acoustic annotation is costly, labels from stronger models inherit their errors and limits, and fixed data cannot adapt as the learner improves. We therefore propose EvoAudio, a recursive self-improvement system for audio understanding. To our knowledge, it is the first to evolve the model, waveforms, questions, and difficulty in one closed loop. EvoAudio uses the current model's performance to set the focus and difficulty of the next training data. A library of audio tools then constructs questions whose answers follow from how the audio was made, providing verifiable supervision without new human annotation. Reinforcement learning updates the model, and validation decides whether it enters the next evolution round. Across 13 rounds, EvoAudio improves five models with different audio encoders and language backbones on MMSU, MMAU-Pro, and MMAR. It achieves the highest average for every backbone, raising overall performance by up to 6.3 points. The improvement unfolds over successive rounds, with each stronger model starting the next round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoAudio 是面向音频理解的递归自我改进系统：用当前模型表现决定下一轮训练数据的重点与难度，由音频工具库构造答案可由音频生成过程核验的问题，再经强化学习更新模型、由验证集决定是否进入下一轮。跨 13 轮迭代在 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 上改进了五种不同音频编码器与语言骨干的模型，每个骨干都取得最高平均分，整体性能最多提升 6.3 分。
Motivation: 音频语言模型懂“说了什么”远胜于“听起来如何”，而细粒度声学标注昂贵、强模型标签会继承其错误、固定数据无法随学习者进步而调整。
Method: 闭环同时演化模型、波形、问题与难度：以当前模型表现设定下一轮数据的重点与难度，用音频工具库构造答案由音频生成方式决定的可核验问题（无需新的人工标注），以强化学习更新模型，并由验证集决定是否进入下一轮演化。
Result: 跨 13 轮演化，在 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 上改进五种不同音频编码器与语言骨干的模型；每个骨干均取得最高平均分，整体性能最多提升 6.3 分；改进在连续多轮中逐步展开，每轮更强的模型进入下一轮。
Conclusion: 让模型自己决定下一轮数据的焦点与难度、并用可核验监督替代人工标注，可以在多个骨干上持续多轮提升音频理解表现。

papers.title: Forecast Workflow Bench: Evaluating Language-Model Decisions with Budgeted Forecast Tools
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide forecasts for operational decisions, but accuracy alone does not determine their value. Evaluating agents that use these models requires measuring decision quality and forecast cost. FWBench evaluates this capability on 1,251 electricity and cycle-hire cases using fixed forecast tools and simulated capacity contracts. Agents select models, histories and horizons, then submit capacities to minimize a stated loss-cost objective. We evaluated two hosted and eight local configurations, including small language models, and tested local models with and without TSFMs. GPT-6 Astra bought inexpensive short-horizon forecasts selectively, using 2.5% of the budget, and outperformed fixed policies when the saved decisions were scored with three loss-cost weightings. FWBench enables reproducible evaluation of how language models select and use time-series forecasts to make decisions under cost constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FWBench 用固定时间序列预报工具与模拟容量合同，评测语言模型代理在预算约束下如何选择模型、历史长度与预报时效并提交容量决策。GPT-6 Astra 选择性购买便宜的短时预报，只用掉 2.5% 预算，在三种 loss-cost 加权打分下都胜过固定策略。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的精度不等于决策价值，现有评测无法衡量代理在预报成本约束下的决策质量与花费。
Method: 在 1,251 个电力与共享单车 (cycle-hire) 案例上，用固定预报工具和模拟容量合同构建 FWBench；代理选择模型、历史与预报时效后提交容量，最小化给定的 loss-cost 目标；评测两个托管与八个本地配置（含小语言模型），本地模型分带与不带 TSFM 两种条件。
Result: 共 1,251 个电力与 cycle-hire 案例，2 个托管 + 8 个本地配置；GPT-6 Astra 仅用 2.5% 预算选择性购买短时预报，在三种 loss-cost 权重打分下均优于固定策略。
Conclusion: 语言模型代理能在成本约束下自主取舍预报开销与决策损失，FWBench 提供该能力的可复现评测。

papers.title: Psychoacoustically Aligned Latent Smoothing for Adversarial Robustness of Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Dialogue Models
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end speech-to-speech dialogue models listen and speak simultaneously, so a continuously open acoustic channel is exposed to adversarial manipulation. We formalize imperceptible attacks on full-duplex agents as optimization over additive perturbations confined beneath the psychoacoustic masking threshold of the carrier speech, under three goals: targeted semantic hijacking, response suppression, and policy jailbreaking. Against an undefended Moshi-style agent, white-box attacks succeed in up to 91.7% of trials. We then introduce psychoacoustically aligned latent smoothing (PALS), which injects anisotropic Gaussian noise shaped by local codebook covariance at the residual-vector-quantized latent interface, with input noise shaped by the masking threshold constraining the attacker and trained by a Kullback--Leibler consistency objective. Deployed with no inference-time cost, PALS reduces hijack to 8.3%, mute to 11.2%, and jailbreak to 9.1% at clean quality within 2.3%. A Monte Carlo-smoothed variant certifies an ellipsoidal latent radius up to 0.616, a guaranteed floor that the empirical robustness far exceeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对全双工语音到语音对话模型持续开放的声学通道，把掩蔽阈值以下的不可感知加性扰动形式化为三类攻击（语义劫持、响应抑制、策略越狱），并提出 PALS：在 RVQ 潜变量接口注入由局部 codebook 协方差与掩蔽阈值塑形的各向异性高斯噪声，用 KL 一致性目标训练。对无防御 Moshi 式 agent，白盒攻击成功率最高 91.7%；部署后劫持降到 8.3%、静音 11.2%、越狱 9.1%，干净音质损失在 2.3% 以内，且无推理时开销。
Motivation: 端到端全双工对话模型边听边说，声学输入通道始终开放，可被掩蔽阈值以下的不可感知扰动操纵，而现有对话 agent 缺少针对这类攻击的防御。
Method: 先将不可感知攻击形式化为在载体语音掩蔽阈值以下的加性扰动优化，覆盖语义劫持、响应抑制、策略越狱三个目标；再提出 psychoacoustically aligned latent smoothing (PALS)，在残差矢量量化 (RVQ) 潜变量接口注入由局部 codebook 协方差塑形的各向异性高斯噪声，输入端噪声由掩蔽阈值塑形以约束攻击者，并以 Kullback--Leibler 一致性目标训练；另有一个 Monte Carlo 平滑变体给出认证半径。
Result: 对无防御 Moshi 式 agent，白盒攻击成功率最高 91.7%；PALS 部署后劫持降至 8.3%、响应抑制 11.2%、越狱 9.1%，干净音质保持在 2.3% 以内，无推理时开销；Monte Carlo 平滑变体认证椭球潜变量半径达 0.616，而实测鲁棒性远超该下界。
Conclusion: 在 RVQ 潜变量接口按掩蔽阈值与 codebook 协方差塑形噪声并用 KL 一致性训练，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下把全双工 agent 的三类白盒攻击成功率从 91.7% 压到约 8%–11%，同时保住干净音质。

papers.title: Planned Test-Time Scaling with Coordinated Reasoning Paths
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling with parallel branches is widely adopted to improve performance on challenging reasoning tasks. The predominant approach, repeated sampling, draws branches independently from a single policy, which can produce redundant attempts and thereby limit the gains from additional inference compute. To address this limitation, we propose Planned Test-Time Scaling (PTTS), which replaces independent sampling with a coordinated joint policy: a planner generates a solution outline for each branch, steering the branches toward distinct reasoning paths, and an executor produces a full solution conditioned on each outline. Formally, we show that PTTS strictly generalizes repeated sampling and, in a stylized setting, provably promotes coverage of complementary reasoning modes and yields better pass@k scaling. We instantiate PTTS on top of strong reasoning models, keeping them fixed as executors while replacing repeated sampling with PTTS inference to further enhance test-time scaling. Concretely, we develop two variants: PTTS-ZS prompts a model to jointly generate outlines for all branches in a single autoregressive pass, while PTTS-RL directly optimizes the planner against the pass@k reward using truncated execution rollouts for efficient training and a sharper reward signal. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B and 4B, PTTS-ZS improves pass@64 over repeated sampling by up to 6.7 points, while PTTS-RL further increases the gain to up to 13.4 points. Further analysis indicates that broader coverage of distinct reasoning paths contributes to these gains. Overall, PTTS provides a general framework for improving test-time scaling by coordinating reasoning branches, with zero-shot and trainable instantiations that yield substantial performance gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Planned Test-Time Scaling (PTTS)，用一个 planner 为每条并行分支先生成解题提纲、executor 再据此补全，把重复采样的独立分支换成协调的联合策略。在五个数学推理基准上，Qwen3-1.7B/4B 的 pass@64 相对重复采样最多提升 6.7 点 (PTTS-ZS)，用 pass@k 奖励训练 planner 的 PTTS-RL 最多提升 13.4 点。
Motivation: 重复采样从单一策略独立抽分支，分支之间冗余，追加推理算力的收益受限。
Method: PTTS 由 planner 一次自回归生成所有分支的提纲、executor 在各自提纲条件下产出完整解法；PTTS-ZS 为零样本提示版，PTTS-RL 用截断执行 rollout 直接以 pass@k 奖励优化 planner，executor 保持冻结。
Result: 五个数学推理基准、Qwen3-1.7B 与 4B 上，PTTS-ZS 的 pass@64 相对重复采样最多提高 6.7 点，PTTS-RL 最多提高 13.4 点；分析显示对不同推理路径的更广覆盖贡献了这些增益。
Conclusion: PTTS 严格推广重复采样，并在简化设定下可证明促进互补推理模式的覆盖、改善 pass@k scaling；协调分支而非独立采样是提升 test-time scaling 的通用手段。

papers.title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent language models repeatedly apply shared network blocks to refine latent representations, but standard inference recomputes global attention at every recurrent step. We study attention dynamics across recurrent depth and find that attention support and distributions stabilize substantially earlier than hidden states and attention outputs. This suggests a two-stage structure: early steps discover a sparse working set of relevant context, while later steps refine representations over largely the same routing support. Motivated by this structure, we introduce WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation), a training-free method that uses unrestricted global attention during early recurrence and later reuses directly discovered block-structured support while keeping recurrent depth and within-support attention computation dynamic. Controlled interventions show that recurrent discovery is important and that support-only reuse better preserves model behavior than more restrictive attention-reuse alternatives. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, WISE largely preserves full-attention performance, while context scaling reveals increasingly sparse working sets and greater efficiency gains. Quality is largely preserved through 2K context, with a measurable loss at 4K. An optimized sparse-attention implementation achieves up to a 1.76x attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K and a 1.36x speedup for the full 32-step attention trajectory. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 循环语言模型 (recurrent LM) 的注意力支撑集与分布在远早于隐状态和注意力输出时就已稳定，WISE 据此在早期循环步用全局注意力发现稀疏 working set，后续步只复用该 block 结构支撑集。多跳 QA 上 2K 上下文基本保持全注意力性能，4K 有可测损失；优化稀疏实现在 4K 相对原生 FlashAttention 最高 1.76× 注意力加速，完整 32 步注意力轨迹 1.36×。
Motivation: 标准推理在每个循环步都重算全局注意力，代价随上下文和循环深度增长，而注意力支撑其实很早就不再变化。
Method: WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation)：训练无关 (training-free)，早期循环用无约束全局注意力，后期复用直接发现的 block 结构支撑集，同时保持循环深度与支撑内注意力计算动态；用受控干预比较支撑复用与更严格的注意力复用方案。
Result: 多跳 QA 上 WISE 基本保持全注意力性能；上下文放大显示 working set 越来越稀疏、效率增益更大；质量在 2K 上下文内基本保持，4K 出现可测损失；优化稀疏实现在 4K 注意力加速最高 1.76×（对比原生 FlashAttention），完整 32 步注意力轨迹 1.36×。
Conclusion: 循环早期发现的稀疏支撑集足以承载后续细化，只复用支撑 (support-only reuse) 比更严格的注意力复用更能保持模型行为，且上下文越长效率收益越大。

summary_sections.conclusion: 循环早期发现的稀疏支撑集足以承载后续细化，只复用支撑 (support-only reuse) 比更严格的注意力复用更能保持模型行为，且上下文越长效率收益越大。

papers.title: Neither Silence nor Overlap Is Failure: Intent-Conditioned Evaluation of Turn-Taking in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for full-duplex spoken dialogue models score turn-taking with binary fixed-window rules that reward immediate response or silence by completeness of the prior turn. We argue that the appropriateness of a response offset, whether delayed silence or anticipatory overlap, is conditional on the speaker's latent intent, identifiable only from that speaker's behavior. We introduce TACT, a benchmark of 9,728 episodes and 73.2 hours from five dyadic corpora; each episode carries dialogue history, a per-speaker memory profile, and an annotator-derived posterior over six intent classes. Scoring replaces binary windows with a strictly proper threshold-weighted continuous ranked probability score whose weights are intent-conditioned timing kernels fitted to human floor-transfer-offset distributions, proving boundedness, consistency, and binary reduction. Across eleven systems the best model reaches 0.47 against a human topline of 0.86, is nearly invariant to speaker profiles, and TACT agrees with human judgments at Spearman 0.81 versus 0.46 for binary metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACT 用说话人意图条件化的连续评分取代全双工对话模型的二值固定窗轮替评测：9,728 个片段、73.2 小时、五套双人语料，每个片段带六类意图后验与记忆画像。评分用意图条件化时间核加权的严格 proper CRPS，11 个系统中最好模型得 0.47 而人类上界 0.86，与人类判断 Spearman 0.81（二值指标 0.46）。
Motivation: 全双工语音对话模型的轮替评测用二值固定窗规则，按上一轮完整度奖励立即应答或沉默，把延迟沉默与预期性重叠一律判为失败，而响应偏移是否合适其实取决于说话人潜在意图。
Method: 构建 TACT 基准：五个双人语料共 9,728 个片段、73.2 小时，每片段含对话历史、逐说话人记忆画像与标注者给出的六类意图后验。评分改为意图条件化时间核加权的严格 proper 阈值加权连续排序概率评分 (threshold-weighted CRPS)，时间核从人类 floor-transfer-offset 分布拟合，并证明其有界性、一致性与对二值规则的退化。
Result: 在 11 个系统上，最佳模型得分 0.47，人类 topline 0.86；最佳模型对说话人画像近乎不变；TACT 与人类判断的 Spearman 相关为 0.81，二值指标仅 0.46。
Conclusion: 轮替评测应按说话人潜在意图条件化打分，延迟沉默与预期性重叠都可能是恰当响应；意图条件化连续评分比二值窗规则更贴近人类判断，而当前系统距人类水平仍有 0.47 对 0.86 的差距。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ASAP: Visual Analytics for Identifying and Analyzing Image Patterns in AI-generated Images
papers.abstract_en: Generative image models can produce highly realistic images, raising concerns about potential misuse in creating deceptive content. Current deepfake approaches face several challenges, including limited generalizability, lack of interpretability, and poor actionability. To help address these, we present ASAP, an interactive visualization system designed to empower users in the analysis and summarization of deceptive patterns in AI-generated images. ASAP introduces a novel CLIP-adapted image encoder that generates interpretable representations, enabling the extraction of influential pixel regions via calculated masks. This approach facilitates the identification of key deceptive features through influence measurement techniques. These backend techniques are integrated into a visual analytics dashboard that allows users to quantify and analyze authenticity-indicative patterns in image collections containing both authentic and AI-generated images. This approach also supports the comparative analysis of various generative models, including GANs and diffusion models. We demonstrate ASAP's efficacy through a user study and two application scenarios using established fake image detection benchmarks, showcasing its ability to effectively extract and quantify deceptive patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASAP 是一套面向 AI 生成图像欺骗模式的交互式可视分析系统：用改造的 CLIP 图像编码器产出可解释表征，经影响度量算出像素掩码定位关键欺骗特征，再由仪表板对图像集合做真实性模式的量化与跨生成模型（GAN、diffusion）比较。作者通过一项用户研究和两个基于既有假图检测基准的应用场景展示其提取与量化欺骗模式的能力。
Motivation: 现有 deepfake 检测方法泛化能力有限、缺乏可解释性、也难转化为可操作结论，用户无法看清 AI 生成图像中的欺骗性模式到底在哪里。
Method: 核心是 CLIP-adapted image encoder，生成可解释表征并用影响度量 (influence measurement) 计算掩码，提取有影响力的像素区域；后端接入可视分析仪表板，支持对含真实与 AI 生成图像的集合做量化分析，并可比较 GAN 与 diffusion 等不同生成模型。
Result: 通过一项用户研究和两个应用场景进行演示，所用为已建立的假图检测基准 (fake image detection benchmarks)，展示系统能有效提取并量化欺骗模式；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把可解释的像素级影响掩码与可视分析界面结合，可以让用户量化并比较 AI 生成图像中的真实性指示模式，同时覆盖多种生成模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Conditioned Visual Place Recognition in Natural Environments
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in natural environments remains challenging due to repetitive vegetation, sparse distinctive landmarks, and substantial appearance and viewpoint variation across traversals. While visual observations of the same place can change considerably, their underlying spatial structure is often more persistent. We exploit this complementary geometric consistency through Depth-Aware Distillation (DAD), which conditions the token representations of a pretrained Vision Foundation Model (VFM) on geometry inferred by a Geometric Foundation Model (GFM), without any depth sensor. Rather than treating geometry as an additional input modality, DAD projects image-aligned depth into the VFM token space and selectively modulates visual representations through channel-wise geometric conditioning. A two-stage teacher-guided learning strategy first anchors the geometry-conditioned representation to the pretrained appearance space, before refining it for place discrimination. Evaluated on the WildCross benchmark, DAD improves average inter-sequence Recall@1 from 61.41% to 66.37% and Recall@5 from 65.86% to 72.49% over a matched appearance-only baseline, with the largest gains under reverse traversal and long-term appearance variation. These results show that GFM-derived geometry can provide a persistent structural prior for VPR when visual appearance becomes unreliable.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications (DICTA 2026). 8 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Depth-Aware Distillation (DAD)：用 Geometric Foundation Model 推断的深度去调制预训练 Vision Foundation Model 的 token 表示，把几何作为持续结构先验注入视觉地点识别 (VPR)，无需深度传感器。在 WildCross 基准上，平均跨序列 Recall@1 从 61.41% 提到 66.37%、Recall@5 从 65.86% 提到 72.49%，反向穿越与长期外观变化下增益最大。
Motivation: 自然环境中植被重复、地标稀少，同一地点跨次穿越的外观与视角变化大，纯外观的地点识别失效；而底层空间结构更持久，这一互补性此前未被利用。
Method: DAD 将 GFM 推断的图像对齐深度投影到 VFM token 空间，用逐通道几何条件化 (channel-wise geometric conditioning) 选择性调制视觉表示，而非把几何当作额外输入模态；训练采用两阶段教师引导策略，先把几何条件化表示锚定到预训练外观空间，再为地点判别做细化。
Result: 在 WildCross 基准上，相对匹配的纯外观基线，平均跨序列 Recall@1 由 61.41% 提升至 66.37%，Recall@5 由 65.86% 提升至 72.49%；增益在反向穿越 (reverse traversal) 与长期外观变化条件下最大。
Conclusion: 当视觉外观不可靠时，GFM 派生的几何可以作为持久结构先验支撑 VPR，且无需深度传感器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anomaly-Free Self-Optimization via AUC Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Anomalies are rare, and anomalous data are often unavailable during development, making it difficult to determine which anomaly detection models and configurations will generalize to unseen anomalies. Recent approaches address this challenge by generating pseudo-anomalies and using bounds on the achievable area under the ROC curve (AUC) to select the optimal configuration from a finite set of candidates. Instead, we use the AUC bound as a differentiable, anomaly-free objective for directly optimizing continuous parameters of anomaly detection systems. We demonstrate this framework by optimizing ensemble weights and introducing a learnable score-rescaling mechanism that adapts pseudo-anomaly scores, enabling optimization beyond a predefined candidate set. Experiments across multiple datasets and embedding models show that AUC-bound optimization achieves significant performance gains over conventional model selection and prior development-set-based parameter selection. The results further show that direct optimization is less sensitive to the choice of pseudo-anomaly construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AUC 上界从「在有限候选集中选配置」改成可微的、无需真实异常的目标函数，直接优化异常检测系统的连续参数。具体做法是优化 ensemble 权重，并引入可学习的 score-rescaling 机制调整伪异常分数，从而突破预定义候选集。在多个数据集与 embedding 模型上，该优化相对常规模型选择和基于开发集的参数选择取得显著性能提升，且对伪异常构造方式的选择更不敏感。
Motivation: 真实异常稀有且开发阶段常拿不到，导致无法判断哪个异常检测模型与配置能泛化到未见异常；现有做法靠生成伪异常加 AUC 上界在有限候选集里挑选，搜索空间被预定义候选集卡死。
Method: 把可达 AUC 上界当作可微、无需异常数据的目标函数，直接优化连续参数：一是优化 ensemble weights，二是引入可学习的 score-rescaling 机制来调整伪异常分数，使优化能超出预定义候选集。
Result: 在多个数据集与多个 embedding 模型上的实验显示，AUC-bound 优化相对常规模型选择以及此前基于开发集的参数选择取得显著性能提升；同时直接优化对伪异常构造方式的选择更不敏感。
Conclusion: AUC 上界更适合当作可微目标直接优化连续参数，而不是只用于候选集内选型；这样既扩大了可搜索的配置空间，也降低了对伪异常构造的敏感度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Mean Foils: Auditing Worst-Foil Specificity in Frozen CLIP Region Explanations
papers.abstract_en: A region can overlap a target object yet contribute more to another class. We test regions selected by Cluster-based Concept Importance (CCI) in frozen CLIP. Across COCO and VOC with two checkpoints, 41.08-64.78% of regions that pass overlap and mean-contrast checks fail against the strongest competing class. Removing competitors annotated in the image leaves 39.69-63.64% failing. We then test all eight candidate regions per image. An alternative passes the test for 6.25-7.84% of failures on COCO and 27.40-31.15% on VOC. Requiring it to preserve the original target-score drop within $ε= 0.02$ reduces these rates to 0.16-0.98%. Available regions and target-drop tolerance constrain repair; relaxing the tolerance increases repair opportunities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对冻结 CLIP 上基于 CCI 的区域解释做最差竞争类审计：通过重叠与均值对比检查的区域，仍有 41.08–64.78% 无法通过最强竞争类检验；即使放宽到保留原始目标分数下降 ε=0.02，可替代区域的修复率也降到 0.16–0.98%，说明可用区域与容差共同限制了解释修复。
Motivation: 区域与目标物体重叠并不保证它对目标类贡献最大；现有检查只做均值对比，会放过实际由竞争类驱动的区域，使冻结 CLIP 的区域解释审计失真。
Method: 在 COCO 与 VOC、两个 CLIP checkpoint 上，对 CCI 选出的区域依次施加重叠检查、均值对比检查与最强竞争类检验；对失败案例穷举每图全部八个候选区域，并要求替代区域保持原始目标分数下降在 ε=0.02 以内。
Result: COCO 与 VOC 上 41.08–64.78% 通过重叠与均值对比的区域未通过最强竞争类检验；剔除图中已标注的竞争类后仍有 39.69–63.64% 失败。穷举每图八个候选区域后，COCO 上 6.25–7.84% 的失败可被替代区域通过，VOC 为 27.40–31.15%；加上 ε=0.02 的目标分数下降容差后降至 0.16–0.98%。
Conclusion: 重叠与均值对比不足以保证区域解释的类特异性，最差竞争类检验会暴露大量失败；修复机会受可用区域数量与目标下降容差约束，放宽容差会增加可修复比例。

papers.title: Quantization-Robust Unlearning through the Lens of Retain-Forget Loss Landscapes Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning ensures LLM compliance by removing the influence of private or copyrighted training data. However, since LLM models typically undergo post-training compression, like quantization, in practical deployment, it has been observed that the unlearning effect can be substantially weakened, with the forgetting behavior degrading more severely than that of model utility. This paper proposes a quantization-robust unlearning framework that makes forgetting robust to quantization while maintaining overall model utility. We analyze this gap through the lens of loss landscape. Specifically, our analysis reveals a curvature-based criteria that pinpoints sensitive weights in the unlearned model that leads to both non-robust forgetting and reduced utility. We therefore propose sensitivity-guided noisy regularization, which is applied on the sensitive parameters to steer the model convergence towards a smoother minima of uniformly low forget and retain losses. Balancing unlearning and utility, we further propose forget-critical optimization, which updates only forget-critical layers, preserving most of the network to retain useful knowledge. Extensive experiments on the MUSE and TOFU benchmarks across multiple LLM unlearning algorithms show that our approach achieves substantially more quantization-resilient forgetting while maintaining utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量化鲁棒遗忘框架：用基于曲率的判据定位遗忘模型中对量化敏感的权重，对这些参数加敏感度引导的噪声正则 (sensitivity-guided noisy regularization)，把收敛导向 forget 与 retain 损失同时偏低的平滑极小点，再用 forget-critical optimization 只更新关键层。在 MUSE 与 TOFU 基准、多种 LLM 遗忘算法上，遗忘效果在量化后更稳健，同时保持模型效用。
Motivation: LLM 部署前通常要做量化等后训练压缩，而已有遗忘效果会被量化明显削弱，且遗忘行为比模型效用退化得更严重。
Method: 先从 loss landscape 视角分析，得到基于曲率的判据，定位导致遗忘不鲁棒且效用下降的敏感权重；随后在敏感参数上施加 sensitivity-guided noisy regularization 引导向平滑极小点收敛，并以 forget-critical optimization 只更新 forget-critical 层以保留大部分网络。
Result: 在 MUSE 和 TOFU 基准上、跨多种 LLM 遗忘算法的实验中，该方法取得明显更具量化鲁棒性的遗忘，同时保持模型效用。
Conclusion: 遗忘与效用的量化退化可归因于少数曲率敏感权重，针对这些参数做正则化并限制更新范围，能在压缩后同时守住遗忘与效用。

papers.title: Constraint-Driven Context Engineering: Designing Domain Interfaces for AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI systems are increasingly deployed to address domain problems. These systems operate under technical, regulatory, institutional, and normative constraints that define acceptable AI behaviour and outcomes within their domains. We observe a recurring pattern in our industry engagement: partners often arrive with a functioning but relatively generic AI solution. The challenge is no longer to build an AI system from scratch, but to improve the quality and domain appropriateness of an AI-generated solution. In these settings, the limiting factor is often the quality, scope, and structure of the context available to the system. Yet, existing context engineering approaches primarily focus on supplying domain knowledge through retrieval, memory, and tools, with limited support for systematically identifying and operationalising the constraints that govern AI systems in their operational environments. This paper proposes Constraint-Driven Context Engineering (CDCE), a design approach for engineering domain interfaces for AI systems. Drawing on software architecture design and Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CDCE treats domain constraints as first-class design drivers. It identifies and characterises constraints, determines the required context assets, and designs representations through which these assets are made available to AI systems. We conducted a comparative multiple-case study with industry and public-sector partners across educational assessment, healthcare decision support, and financial-distress prediction. Depending on their characteristics, constraints can guide AI behaviour, enforce permissible boundaries, or support verification of AI-generated outcomes. The cases demonstrate CDCE's applicability across contrasting domains and show how constraint characteristics shape the resulting domain interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出约束驱动的上下文工程 (CDCE)，把技术、监管、制度与规范约束当作一等设计驱动，借软件架构与领域驱动设计 (DDD) 识别约束、确定所需上下文资产并设计其呈现接口。在教育评估、医疗决策支持与财务困境预测的多案例对比中，约束按其特性分别引导 AI 行为、强制合规边界或支撑对生成结果的核验。
Motivation: 业界常见已有通用 AI 方案但领域适配不足，瓶颈转为上下文的质量、范围与结构；现有 context engineering 主要靠检索、记忆与工具补领域知识，缺少系统识别并落地运行环境中约束的手段。
Method: CDCE 借鉴软件架构设计与 Domain-Driven Design (DDD)，把领域约束作为一等设计驱动：先识别并刻画约束，再确定所需上下文资产，最后设计让 AI 系统获取这些资产的领域接口；以行业与公共部门伙伴的对比性多案例研究检验。
Result: 在教育评估、医疗决策支持、财务困境预测三个跨领域案例中，CDCE 展示跨不同领域的适用性，并显示约束特性如何塑造最终的领域接口：约束或引导 AI 行为、或强制可允许边界、或支撑对 AI 生成结果的核验。
Conclusion: 把领域约束显式建模为设计驱动并为其设计专门接口，是提升通用 AI 方案领域适配性的可行路径，且约束的角色取决于其自身特性。

papers.title: MolDesignBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agent for Scenario-grounded Molecular Design
papers.abstract_en: Real-world molecular design remains challenging for large language model (LLM)-based agents. It requires them to interpret design contexts, satisfy multiple constraints, identify infeasible specifications, and reason over multi-step tool outputs. Existing benchmarks do not capture this complexity, focusing instead on explicit and narrow constraints, only feasible problems, and single-path solutions. To address this gap, we propose MolDesignBench, a scenario-grounded benchmark that more closely reflects real-world molecular design for evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents. MolDesignBench comprises 2K generation and optimization instances that combine implicit requirements embedded in design narratives with explicit property and functional-group constraints, including infeasible cases, and require the effective use of 17 specialized chemistry tools. Experiments across diverse frontier LLMs reveal low success rates--with the best achieving only $\sim43$\%--and frequent failures in implicit-constraint reasoning, infeasibility detection, and tool reasoning. The corresponding fine-grained failure-mode analysis identifies implicit constraint interpretation and infeasibility detection as the primary bottlenecks, establishing MolDesignBench as a rigorous testbed to guide future research on chemical agents. The benchmark, tool interface, and evaluation code are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolDesignBench 是面向工具增强 LLM 智能体的场景化分子设计基准，含 2K 生成与优化实例，把设计叙事中的隐式需求与显式性质/官能团约束绑定，并刻意包含不可行案例，要求调用 17 个化学工具。在多个前沿 LLM 上最佳成功率仅约 43%，失败集中在隐式约束解读、不可行性检测与工具推理。
Motivation: 现有分子设计基准只测显式且狭窄的约束、只给可行问题和单路径解，无法反映真实设计中解读上下文、多约束满足、识别不可行规格与多步工具推理的复杂度。
Method: 构建场景化基准 MolDesignBench：2K 生成与优化实例，将设计叙事中的隐式需求与显式性质、官能团约束组合，含不可行案例，需使用 17 个专用化学工具；对多个前沿 LLM 做工具增强实验并做细粒度失败模式分析。
Result: 在多样前沿 LLM 上成功率普遍偏低，最佳仅约 43%；失败模式集中在隐式约束推理、不可行性检测与工具推理，细粒度分析把隐式约束解读和不可行性检测列为首要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 隐式约束解读与不可行性检测是当前化学智能体的主瓶颈，MolDesignBench 可作为该方向的严格测试床；基准、工具接口与评测代码已公开。

papers.title: Evolving Inspectable O-RAN Slicing xApps with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Open RAN (O-RAN) slicing xApps must adapt resource allocations to changing channel conditions and traffic demands while meeting service-level agreements (SLAs). Deep reinforcement learning can produce adaptive policies, but their allocation rules remain encoded in neural-network parameters. Our goal is to retain this adaptability while making the controller's decision logic directly inspectable and editable by operators. We use a large language model (LLM) to evolve slicing controllers as compact Python programs whose decision logic remains readable and editable after optimization. The LLM proposes and revises candidates offline, while a calibrated simulator scores them, and the selected decision module runs unchanged in the O-RAN control path. On the NSF POWDER 5G testbed, the evolved controller releases resources from a guaranteed slice whose throughput target becomes unattainable under a sustained channel fade, improving best-effort throughput from 158.2 to 228.6 Mbps, a 44.5% gain over the best static allocation. Since the controllers are readable source code, their behavior can be predicted from their equations, defects can be diagnosed by reading the code, and calibration errors can be corrected with one-line edits, reducing SLA misses from 79.9% to 2.2% in one case and more than doubling fitness in another. In a four-slice trace-driven simulation calibrated to the same testbed, evolutionary search achieves higher average evaluation scores than independent prompting at a matched proposal budget, with mean normalized gains on held-out traces of 16.3% for prompting alone, 32.1% for evolution from scratch, and 51.0% for evolution from a starting program.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 把 O-RAN 切片控制器进化成可读可改的紧凑 Python 程序，保留 DRL 的自适应性同时让运维能直接检查与编辑决策逻辑。在 NSF POWDER 5G 测试床上，持续信道衰落时控制器释放保证切片资源，best-effort 吞吐从 158.2 提到 228.6 Mbps，比最优静态分配高 44.5%；一处一行修改把 SLA 违约率从 79.9% 降到 2.2%。
Motivation: DRL 切片策略的分配规则锁在神经网络参数里，运维无法检查、诊断或修正；目标是既保留对信道与流量变化的自适应，又让决策逻辑对运维可读可编辑。
Method: LLM 离线提出并修订候选切片控制器（紧凑 Python 程序），由校准过的仿真器打分，选中的决策模块原样进入 O-RAN 控制路径；另在四切片 trace-driven 仿真（校准到同一测试床）上比较独立 prompting、从零进化、从初始程序进化三种搜索方式，提案预算对齐。
Result: NSF POWDER 5G 测试床上 best-effort 吞吐 158.2 → 228.6 Mbps，较最优静态分配提升 44.5%；SLA 违约率一例从 79.9% 降到 2.2%，另一例 fitness 翻倍以上。四切片仿真 held-out trace 上平均归一化增益：仅 prompting 16.3%、从零进化 32.1%、从初始程序进化 51.0%。
Conclusion: 把控制器当源码来进化，可以在保持自适应的同时获得可检查、可诊断、可一行修正的决策逻辑；从已有初始程序出发的进化比从零进化或独立 prompting 更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CART: Closed-Loop Adaptive Red Teaming for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Automated red teaming often replays a fixed set of prompts, which measures known risks but cannot learn from failures found during testing. We present CART (Closed-Loop Adaptive Red Teaming), a framework that uses each result to guide what it tests next. CART begins with broad risk coverage, follows weaknesses that emerge, keeps new probes diverse, and records the evidence and source of every finding. It separates the Challenger that creates tests, the Target being tested, which may be a text-only model or a bounded tool-using agent, and the Judge that evaluates the results, allowing these roles to be studied independently. Across three evaluation families (Frontier, JAH, and Agentic), CART discovers more failures and higher average risk than static seed replay for every Target with an available baseline. The gains extend to tool-mediated agent tests, suggesting that contextual adaptation can reveal weaknesses that direct prompt replay does not exercise. These results describe what the test policies discover, not how often failures occur in real deployments. We also find that Challenger-Judge choices affect the evidence uncovered, highlighting the need for role separation and independent review. Overall, CART turns red teaming from a one-time checklist into a continuous, adaptive, and auditable search for model and agent weaknesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CART 把大模型红队测试从固定提示词回放改成闭环自适应搜索：Challenger 依据上一轮 Judge 结果决定下一批探针，保持多样性并记录每条发现的证据与来源。在 Frontier、JAH、Agentic 三类评测上，对每个有基线的 Target 都比静态 seed replay 发现更多失败、平均风险更高，且增益延伸到工具调用 agent 测试。
Motivation: 自动红队长期回放固定提示词集合，只能度量已知风险，无法从测试中暴露的弱点继续追查。
Method: 框架分设 Challenger（生成测试）、Target（被测的纯文本模型或受限工具使用 agent）、Judge（评判结果）三个可独立研究的角色；测试策略先保证广覆盖，再跟随新出现的弱点，同时维持探针多样性并记录证据与来源。
Result: 在 Frontier、JAH、Agentic 三个评测族上，对每个有可用基线的 Target，CART 发现的失败数与平均风险均高于静态 seed replay；增益同样出现在工具中介的 agent 测试中。Challenger 与 Judge 的选型会影响所揭示的证据类型。
Conclusion: 上下文自适应的测试策略能挖出直接提示回放触不到的弱点，红队应做成持续、可审计的搜索而非一次性清单；结论描述的是测试策略的发现能力，不是真实部署中的失败发生率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Just-in-Time Memory: Learning to Curate Task-Adaptive Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory systems reuse past experience to improve future performance, yet most existing designs curate memory at write time: once a task is completed, its trajectory is distilled into a fixed artifact, such as a reflection, workflow, skill, or reasoning strategy, that is later retrieved by similarity. This forces the system to decide what is worth remembering before the future query is known, irreversibly discarding information and producing a query-independent summary that must serve many possible downstream tasks. Learning such a write-time curator is also difficult because the value of a storage decision may only become apparent when a relevant query arrives, potentially many tasks later, creating a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. We instead retain raw trajectories and defer curation until read time, when the current task is known. Given the retrieved traces and the new task, a memory curator synthesizes a compact, task-adaptive payload tailored to the immediate need. Because this payload is consumed on the same task, the curator can be trained directly from immediate task success, avoiding delayed utility signals and the need to artificially group related tasks. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and $τ^2$-bench, our Just-in-Time Memory (JitMem) consistently outperforms no-memory agents as well as heuristic and learned write-time memory methods, improving over the strongest baseline by 16.2, 16.3, and 3.9 absolute success-rate points, respectively. Notably, even an untrained curator is already competitive with or surpasses these baselines, showing that task-adaptive read-time curation itself is a major source of the gain; training the curator further compounds the improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JitMem 把记忆整理从写入时推迟到读取时：保留原始轨迹，等新任务已知再由 curator 现场合成任务自适应的紧凑 payload，从而用即时任务成功直接训练。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench 上相对最强基线分别提升 16.2、16.3、3.9 个绝对成功率点，且未经训练的 curator 已能持平或超过这些基线。
Motivation: 写入时整理必须在未知未来查询前决定记什么，不可逆丢信息且产生查询无关摘要；存储决策的价值要到很多任务之后才显现，形成 horizon 很长的 credit-assignment 问题。
Method: 保留原始轨迹，读取时给定检索到的 trace 与新任务，由 memory curator 合成即时任务专用的紧凑 payload；因 payload 在同一任务上被消费，curator 可直接用即时任务成功训练，无需延迟效用信号或人为把相关任务分组。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench 上，JitMem 相对最强基线的绝对成功率分别提升 16.2、16.3、3.9 个点，且一致优于无记忆 agent 以及启发式与学习式写入时记忆方法；未经训练的 curator 已与这些基线持平或更优。
Conclusion: 任务自适应的读取时整理本身就是增益的主要来源，训练 curator 可在此之上进一步叠加提升。
