papers.title: Alignment Inertia: Auditing the Durability of Training Data Influence Through Policy Override Resistance
papers.abstract_en: Platform operators increasingly rely on system prompts and fine-tuning to govern model behavior, yet it remains unclear how reliably these interventions override behavior inherited from prior training. We propose Override Success Rate (OSR) and alignment inertia to measure when operator interventions succeed or fail to change prior behavior. We evaluate zero-shot prompting and LoRA fine-tuning across Llama and Mistral in medical misinformation and hate speech. Alignment inertia persists across both models but varies by model, domain, and policy direction. Notably, in Mistral's restrictive hate-speech condition, LoRA increased inertia by 46.5 percentage points, showing that fine-tuning can reinforce rather than override prior behavior. We also use TRAK to test whether inertia is associated with weaker adaptation signals. TRAK achieves AUC of at least 0.85 in 7 of 8 conditions and outperforms model confidence, TF-IDF similarity, and embedding similarity as a predictor of inertia. These results provide an operator-facing audit of where prior training constrains downstream model governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Override Success Rate (OSR) 与 alignment inertia 两个指标，审计系统提示与微调能否真正覆盖模型从先前训练继承的行为。在 Llama 与 Mistral 的医疗虚假信息和仇恨言论条件下，惯性普遍存在且随模型、领域、策略方向变化；Mistral 限制性仇恨言论条件下 LoRA 使惯性上升 46.5 个百分点，即微调反而强化而非覆盖先前行为。
Motivation: 平台运营方依赖 system prompt 与微调治理模型行为，但这些干预能否可靠覆盖先前训练继承的行为尚不清楚，缺少面向运营方的审计度量。
Method: 定义 OSR 与 alignment inertia 度量干预成败；在 Llama、Mistral 上对医疗虚假信息与仇恨言论两类策略做 zero-shot prompting 与 LoRA 微调对照；再用 TRAK 检验惯性是否与更弱的 adaptation signal 相关，并与 model confidence、TF-IDF similarity、embedding similarity 比较预测能力。
Result: 惯性在两个模型上均持续存在，且随模型、领域、策略方向而变；Mistral 限制性仇恨言论条件下 LoRA 使惯性增加 46.5 个百分点；TRAK 在 8 个条件中的 7 个达到 AUC 至少 0.85，作为惯性预测因子优于 model confidence、TF-IDF similarity 与 embedding similarity。
Conclusion: 先前训练会约束下游模型治理，微调在某些策略方向上会强化而非覆盖旧行为；TRAK 的 adaptation signal 可作为运营方判断干预是否生效的审计信号。

papers.title: Stable Geometry with Divergent Task Evidence for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Compression
papers.abstract_en: Long horizon agents accumulate growing interaction histories that increase context and inference costs. We find that geometric redundancy alone is an insufficient criterion for safe compression. Although agent histories exhibit strong low dimensional structure, similar global geometry can preserve very different amounts of task evidence. At identical retained block counts, evidence aware selection raises next action Top 3 retention from 0.31 to 0.69, while centroid similarity remains 0.98. Controlled replacement further shows that action related information can be substantially altered while global geometric measures remain nearly unchanged. Motivated by this gap between geometry and evidence, we introduce Geometry Guided Evidence Preserving Memory (GEM), a training free compressor that protects task and execution evidence before using geometric residuals to complete coverage. GEM reduces mean combined token usage from 2.69M to 2.11M per task, a 21.4% reduction, while maintaining comparable task reward. Our results show that efficient agent history compression should optimize for preserved task evidence rather than geometric coverage alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长程 agent 历史压缩中，仅按几何冗余筛选是不安全的：相同保留块数下，证据感知选择把 next action Top 3 retention 从 0.31 提到 0.69，而 centroid similarity 仍为 0.98。作者据此提出免训练的 Geometry Guided Evidence Preserving Memory (GEM)，先保护任务与执行证据、再用几何残差补覆盖，把每任务平均 token 用量从 2.69M 降到 2.11M（降 21.4%）且任务 reward 相当。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的交互历史不断变长，上下文与推理成本上升；历史虽有强低维结构，但几何相似的块可能携带完全不同的任务证据，按几何冗余压缩会丢信息。
Method: 提出免训练 (training free) 的 GEM 压缩器：先按任务与执行证据做保护性选择，再用几何残差 (geometric residuals) 补齐覆盖；对照实验用证据感知选择与受控替换 (controlled replacement) 检验几何指标与证据的关系。
Result: 相同保留块数下，证据感知选择使 next action Top 3 retention 从 0.31 升至 0.69，同时 centroid similarity 保持 0.98；受控替换显示动作相关信息可被大幅改变而全局几何指标几乎不变；GEM 将每任务平均合计 token 用量从 2.69M 降至 2.11M（降 21.4%），任务 reward 保持相当。
Conclusion: 高效 agent 历史压缩应优化保留的任务证据而非几何覆盖，几何冗余本身不足以作为安全压缩准则。

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Analyze Human-Centered Video? Mapping Model Capabilities and Human-AI Collaborative Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Video provides a rich record of human behavior, interaction, and situated contexts, offering important evidence for understanding people and conducting human-centered research. As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable of analyzing video, they offer opportunities to automate this traditionally human-intensive process. Yet a central question remains: when can VLMs analyze human-centered video independently, and when does reliable analysis still require human involvement? To address this question, we first characterize video analysis practices in human-centered research. We systematically analyze all 1,702 CHI 2026 full papers and identify 125 that annotate videos. Through iterative coding, we derive a five-dimensional taxonomy spanning analytic purpose, viewpoint, phenomenon, reasoning requirement, and annotation authority. Grounded in recurring annotation tasks captured by this taxonomy, we construct a benchmark of 15 representative tasks from open datasets to map the capabilities and limitations of a general-purpose VLM. We examine the division of labor between humans and VLMs by comparing three annotation workflows: VLM alone, human alone, and human verification of VLM outputs. Across tasks, VLM-alone annotation approaches human accuracy on average (HNS = 97.0, where 100 denotes human-alone performance), demonstrating substantial potential to automate human-centered video analysis. Human verification achieves the highest accuracy (HNS = 121.5) while reducing human annotation time by 48.9% and monetary cost by 31.3%-44.5% relative to human-alone annotation. Our findings connect real-world human-centered video analysis tasks and current VLM capabilities, and clarify how human-AI collaboration can make VLM-assisted analysis reliable and efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 CHI 2026 全部 1,702 篇全文中 125 篇视频标注论文提炼五维分类法，并据此构建 15 项开放数据集任务的基准，测通用 VLM 在人类中心视频分析上的能力边界。VLM 单独标注平均接近人类水平（HNS=97.0，100 为人类单独水平），而人工核验 VLM 输出达到最高准确度（HNS=121.5），同时把人工标注时间减少 48.9%、费用降低 31.3%–44.5%。
Motivation: 人类中心研究中的视频标注传统上高度依赖人工，成本高且耗时；VLM 能力提升后，哪些任务可独立自动化、哪些仍需人工介入缺乏系统刻画。
Method: 先系统分析 CHI 2026 全部 1,702 篇 full papers 并筛出 125 篇视频标注论文，经迭代编码得到涵盖分析目的、视角、现象、推理需求、标注权限的五维分类法；再据此从开放数据集构造 15 项代表性任务的基准，比较三种标注工作流：VLM 单独、人工单独、人工核验 VLM 输出。
Result: VLM 单独标注跨任务平均 HNS=97.0（100 代表人工单独水平）；人工核验 VLM 输出 HNS=121.5 为三种工作流最高，相对人工单独标注节省时间 48.9%、费用 31.3%–44.5%。
Conclusion: VLM 单独标注已接近人类准确度，但人工核验 VLM 输出才是准确度最高且更省时省钱的组合，即人机协作使 VLM 辅助分析可靠且高效。

papers.title: A Hybrid Iterative Deep Ritz Method for Elliptic Interface Problems
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a hybrid iterative deep Ritz method (H-IDRM) for a class of interface problems for second-order elliptic operators. It is based on a new mixed formulation of the problem and involves solving a sequence of convex minimization problems. We employ a level-set neural network architecture, featuring a level-set representation of the interface, to accommodate the piecewise smoothness of the solution and the flux. The approach involves only volumetric representations instead of duality pairing on the interface and avoids explicit interface sampling that is inconvenient for complex interface geometries. Further, we present an analysis of the method, including the errors arising from the neural network approximation, Monte Carlo approximation, iterative scheme, and penalty parameters. Numerical experiments indicate that the H-IDRM outperforms existing neural solvers on problems with high-dimensional domains, intricate interface geometries, and lower subdomain regularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合迭代深度 Ritz 方法 (H-IDRM) 求解二阶椭圆界面问题：基于新的混合格式化为一串凸极小化问题，用 level-set 神经网络表示界面以容纳解与通量的分片光滑性，只用体积分表示而不在界面上做对偶配对。数值实验显示它在高维区域、复杂界面几何与低子域正则性问题上优于现有神经求解器。
Motivation: 椭圆界面问题中解与通量分片光滑，复杂界面几何下显式界面采样不便，需要一种只依赖体积分、能处理高维与低正则子域的神经求解路线。
Method: H-IDRM 采用新的混合 formulation，把问题化为一串凸极小化问题迭代求解；网络用 level-set 表示界面的架构逼近分片光滑的解与通量，避免界面上的对偶配对与显式界面采样；并给出误差分析，分解神经网络逼近、Monte Carlo 逼近、迭代格式与惩罚参数四类误差来源。
Result: 数值实验表明 H-IDRM 在高维区域、复杂界面几何与较低子域正则性的问题上优于现有神经求解器；分析给出神经网络逼近、Monte Carlo 逼近、迭代格式与惩罚参数各自的误差项。
Conclusion: 只用体积分表示加迭代凸极小化的混合深度 Ritz 路线，可在复杂界面与高维设定下胜过现有神经求解器，且无需显式界面采样。

papers.title: Verifiable Hidden Dynamics Play: Generating Agentic RL Environments from Solved Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks with evolving state, interdependent decisions, and delayed outcomes. Scaling their training requires diverse agentic environments, dependable outcome signals, and low extension cost. Existing generation pipelines commonly construct an environment before defining its outcome rule or annotating its trajectories, leaving dynamics and evaluation to be aligned post hoc. VHD-Play reverses this dependency by sampling and solving a mathematical model before a corpus-grounded setter renders its decision process as stateful tools. The executable dynamics and trajectory-scoring reference are inherited from the same solved model. The pipeline produces 3,300 diverse agentic environments at a cost of a few cents each. Training Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on three families raises its mean agentic score from 0.204 to 0.815 in a five-family diagnostic. Gains also appear on held-out instances from all three training families and eight unseen mechanism families, then extend beyond the generated substrate to external benchmarks for general function calling, travel planning, and 365-day e-commerce. On E-Commerce Bench, the trained checkpoint completes every run without bankruptcy and exceeds Qwen3.7-Max. We compare written-out problems with stateful versions that reveal or hide their parameters. The comparison shows that most of the learnable gap lies in stateful interaction rather than underlying problem solving. A frozen 35B setter realizes larger environments, and scale-matched training retains gains as mechanism size and horizon grow, indicating the potential for an evolving training substrate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VHD-Play 先采样并求解一个数学模型，再由语料驱动的 setter 把它渲染成带状态工具的 agentic 环境，使可执行动力学与轨迹打分参考同源继承。用该管线以每个几美分的成本产出 3,300 个环境，训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 后其五族诊断平均 agentic 分数从 0.204 升到 0.815，并迁移到函数调用、旅行规划与 365 天电商等外部基准；对照实验显示可学习的差距主要在状态化交互而非底层解题。
Motivation: 扩展 LM agent 训练需要多样环境、可靠的结局信号和低扩展成本，但现有生成管线先建环境再事后对齐动力学与评测，导致 dynamics 与 evaluation 脱节。
Method: VHD-Play 反转依赖顺序：先采样并求解一个数学模型，再由 corpus-grounded setter 将其决策过程渲染为有状态工具 (stateful tools)，可执行动力学与轨迹打分参考继承自同一已解模型；用冻结的 35B setter 生成更大环境，并做 written-out 与 stateful（显式/隐藏参数）版本对照。
Result: 产出 3,300 个 agentic 环境，单个成本几美分；训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在五族诊断上平均 agentic 分数 0.204 → 0.815；增益出现在三个训练族的 held-out 实例与八个未见机制族，并延伸到通用函数调用、旅行规划、365 天电商等外部基准；在 E-Commerce Bench 上训练后 checkpoint 每次运行均未破产并超过 Qwen3.7-Max；对照显示多数可学习差距位于状态化交互而非底层解题，scale-matched 训练在机制规模与时长增长时保持增益。
Conclusion: 先求解再渲染的生成顺序能把动力学与评测绑定在同一模型上，以低成本产出可扩展的训练基底；可学习能力主要来自状态化交互，且该基底可随机制规模与时长演进。

papers.title: Breaking Weather-Content Coupling: Type-Severity Guided Progressive Disentanglement for All-in-One Infrared Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Infrared (IR) imaging is crucial for autonomous driving, remote sensing, and other perception tasks. However, adverse weather may introduce fake structural responses that are entangled with real thermal structures. Existing IR restoration methods are typically designed for a single degradation type or directly reconstruct from degradation-entangled representations. Consequently, they struggle to distinguish intrinsic thermal structures from weather-induced fake responses and to accommodate spatially varying degradation severity, leading to artifacts or the over-suppression of weak but meaningful thermal responses. To address these issues, we propose TSGPD-IR, a type-severity guided progressive disentanglement network for all-in-one infrared restoration that factorizes restoration guidance into task-level weather semantics and region-level degradation severity. Specifically, a Weather and Semantic Co-Guided Multi-Level Prompt Generation Module combines global weather semantics with stage-wise local features to generate adaptive prompts that progressively suppress degradation-induced responses while preserving intrinsic thermal structures. To complement global weather semantics with spatial restoration control, a Proxy-Supervised Regional Degradation Estimator derives severity supervision without manual annotations and predicts spatially varying degradation priors. Guided by these cues, a Multi-Source Collaborative Expert Selection Strategy uses a shared branch to preserve weather-invariant thermal structures and hierarchical routing to select weather-specific expert pools and severity-compatible regional experts. This design progressively separates degradation interference from genuine thermal content and enables region-adaptive restoration, reducing both residual artifacts and over-suppression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSGPD-IR 把红外修复的引导拆成任务级天气语义与区域级退化严重度两级：Weather and Semantic Co-Guided Multi-Level Prompt Generation Module 生成自适应提示逐步压制天气伪响应，Proxy-Supervised Regional Degradation Estimator 无需人工标注即预测空间变化的严重度先验，再由 Multi-Source Collaborative Expert Selection Strategy 用共享分支保留热不变结构、分层路由选天气专家池与区域专家。该设计同时减少残余伪影与对弱热响应的过度抑制，实现区域自适应的 all-in-one 红外修复。
Motivation: 恶劣天气在红外图像中引入与真实热结构纠缠的伪结构响应，现有方法多针对单一退化类型或直接从纠缠表示重建，难以区分本征热结构与天气伪响应，也无法适应空间变化的退化严重度，导致伪影或对弱而有意义的热响应的过度抑制。
Method: TSGPD-IR 将修复引导分解为任务级天气语义与区域级退化严重度：Weather and Semantic Co-Guided Multi-Level Prompt Generation Module 融合全局天气语义与逐阶段局部特征生成自适应提示；Proxy-Supervised Regional Degradation Estimator 以代理监督方式在无人工标注下导出严重度监督并预测空间变化的退化先验；Multi-Source Collaborated Expert Selection Strategy 用共享分支保持天气不变热结构，通过分层路由选择天气特定专家池与严重度兼容的区域专家。
Result: 该设计逐步分离退化干扰与真实热内容，实现区域自适应修复，同时降低残余伪影与过度抑制；摘要未给出定量指标、数据集或基线对比数字。
Conclusion: 作者主张 all-in-one 红外修复需要把天气语义与区域严重度作为两级引导并配合分层专家路由，才能在压制天气伪响应的同时保住本征热结构。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Turning Safety into Competence: Minimally Exploitable Robot Policies via Safety-Filtered Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed for competitive tasks must outmaneuver their opponents without sacrificing safety. Existing approaches, including safe reinforcement learning (RL), train a single policy to achieve task success and avoid failures simultaneously. This coupling can complicate training and leave the learned policy exploitable by deliberate attacks. We propose Safety to Competence (S2C), a two-stage RL framework that separates safety synthesis from competitive task learning. We formulate competitive interactions as safety-critical Markov games and prove that perfect filtering preserves policy non-exploitability when all players commit to safe maneuvers. S2C learns a robust safety filter via adversarial RL, embeds it in the environment during task policy training, and retains the same filter at deployment. In simulated touchdown games, S2C outperforms eight safe RL baselines, achieving the highest win rate and Elo rating, and the lowest exploitability. Hardware stress tests against a human opponent confirm S2C's competence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S2C 把安全与竞技能力拆成两阶段：先用对抗 RL 学一个鲁棒安全过滤器，再把它嵌入环境训练任务策略，部署时沿用同一过滤器。在模拟 touchdown 对抗中，S2C 胜率与 Elo 最高、可利用性 (exploitability) 最低，超过八个 safe RL 基线，硬件压力测试对人类对手也确认其能力。
Motivation: safe RL 用单一策略同时兼顾任务成功与避障，训练复杂且学到的策略容易被蓄意对手利用。
Method: 将对抗交互形式化为安全关键马尔可夫博弈 (safety-critical Markov games)，证明在所有参与方都执行安全动作时完美过滤可保持策略不可利用；两阶段框架 S2C 先以对抗 RL 学鲁棒安全过滤器，训练任务策略时将其嵌入环境，部署时保留同一过滤器。
Result: 在模拟 touchdown 对抗游戏中，S2C 超过八个 safe RL 基线，取得最高胜率、最高 Elo rating 与最低 exploitability；硬件压力测试中对人类对手确认其竞技能力。
Conclusion: 把安全约束从任务学习中解耦成独立的过滤器，可以在不牺牲安全的前提下减少策略被对手利用的空间并保住竞技胜率。

papers.title: Multi-View Fusion for Encrypted C2 Detection: A Leakage-Controlled Measurement Study of Evaluation Pitfalls
papers.abstract_en: Command-and-control (C2) traffic increasingly hides within TLS, so defenders now apply machine learning to traffic metadata. Many studies assume that combining two metadata views, namely flow statistics and TLS handshake fingerprints, improves both accuracy and robustness. We tested this assumption on 17,577 TLS flows from 62 real Cobalt Strike captures. Our evaluation removes the data leakage that leads to overly optimistic reported scores. We report three findings that matter more than the fusion result itself. First, an incorrect preprocessing step increases the F1 score by 0.28. This step computes the frequency encoding across the entire dataset rather than within each cross-validation fold. The increase is about ten times larger than any real effect we measured. Second, both the labels and the behavioral features depend on the destination address. Because of this, the 17,577 flows form only 2,132 independent groups, and the positive rate of 55.1\%, which looks balanced, drops to 4.2\%. Therefore, class balance is just a result of how we analyze the data, specifically whether we count flows or endpoints, and not a real feature of the task. Third, 20 of the 62 captures (32\%) have no TLS flows to any known C2 address, so they contain only benign samples. We checked these captures directly and confirmed that this is a gap in the ground truth, not a labeling error. In this context, fusion beats the best single view by only 0.022 in F1. When an attacker forges both feature surfaces simultaneously, every model performs worse than a simple baseline that always predicts positive (F1 = 0.711). For encrypted C2 detection, the evaluation design is not a preliminary step. It \emph{is} the main result.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 ASIAN Conference on Communication and Networks (ASIANComNet 2026), Hanoi, Vietnam, October 11-14, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 17,577 条 TLS 流、62 份真实 Cobalt Strike 抓包上检验流量统计与 TLS 握手指纹双视图融合的常见假设，发现泄漏与分组问题主导分数：全数据集频率编码使 F1 虚高 0.28，而去除泄漏后融合仅比最佳单视图高 0.022。攻击者同时伪造两个特征面时所有模型都不如恒预测正类的基线（F1 = 0.711），因此加密 C2 检测的评测设计本身就是主要结论。
Motivation: 大量研究假设融合流量统计与 TLS 握手指纹能同时提升准确率与鲁棒性，但预处理泄漏、按流而非按端点计数、以及标注缺口会让报告分数过度乐观，掩盖真实效应大小。
Method: 在 62 份真实 Cobalt Strike 抓包的 17,577 条 TLS 流上做受控测量：对比频率编码在全数据集计算与在每个交叉验证折内计算两种预处理；按目的地地址把流归为独立分组（17,577 流 → 2,132 组）重算正类率；直接核查无已知 C2 地址 TLS 流的抓包以区分标注缺口与标注错误；并测试攻击者同时伪造两个特征面的情形。
Result: 错误预处理（全数据集频率编码）使 F1 提高 0.28，约为所测任何真实效应的十倍；按流计正类率 55.1%，按端点分组后降至 4.2%（17,571 流仅构成 2,132 个独立组）；62 份抓包中 20 份（32%）不含任何发往已知 C2 地址的 TLS 流，仅有良性样本；去除泄漏后融合仅比最佳单视图高 0.022 F1；两个特征面同时被伪造时所有模型都不如恒预测正类基线（F1 = 0.711）。
Conclusion: 对加密 C2 检测，评测设计不是前置步骤而是主要结果：泄漏与按流计数能制造远超真实效应的分数，类别平衡只是分析口径的产物而非任务本身属性。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 错误预处理（全数据集频率编码）使 F1 提高 0.28，约为所测任何真实效应的十倍；按流计正类率 55.1%，按端点分组后降至 4.2%（17,571 流仅构成 2,132 个独立组）；62 份抓包中 20 份（32%）不含任何发往已知 C2 地址的 TLS 流，仅有良性样本；去除泄漏后融合仅比最佳单视图高 0.022 F1；两个特征面同时被伪造时所有模型都不如恒预测正类基线（F1 = 0.711）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对加密 C2 检测，评测设计不是前置步骤而是主要结果：泄漏与按流计数能制造远超真实效应的分数，类别平衡只是分析口径的产物而非任务本身属性。

papers.title: FairTest: Search-Based Fairness Testing for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) trains a team of agents that share one environment and learn their policies together. Training maximizes the team return, and a high return does not imply that the rewards are shared fairly among the agents in every episode. Testing is an established way to discover the failures of deep reinforcement learning, yet few methods address the fairness of MARL. In this work, we propose FairTest, a search-based testing approach that seeks the unfair executions of a MARL policy. The design combines search guidance with test prioritization. The guidance scores each candidate with three fitness functions. One measures the fairness of the runs already performed, another predicts the fairness from abstract states and fairness features, and the third reads the decision uncertainty from the policy. Crossover and mutation derive further candidates from the observed executions. The prioritization ranks the candidates by the predicted fairness and the decision uncertainty, so that the runs reach the candidates where failures are expected. FairTest is evaluated on three environments and two MARL algorithms, and four baselines are given the same budget. It detects the most fairness failures compared to three baselines with statistical significance and large effect sizes. The failure count exceeds that of the strongest baseline by 221% on average and coverage improves by an average of 23%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairTest 用搜索式测试在 MARL 策略中找不公平执行：三个适应度函数（已执行回合的公平性、由抽象状态与公平特征预测的公平性、策略决策不确定性）引导候选生成，再按预测公平性与决策不确定性做测试优先级排序，配合交叉与变异产生新候选。在三个环境、两种 MARL 算法、与四个同预算基线的对比中，检出的公平性失败数平均比最强基线多 221%，覆盖率平均提升 23%，且具统计显著性与大效应量。
Motivation: MARL 训练只最大化团队回报，高回报并不保证每个回合中回报在智能体间公平分配；现有深度强化学习测试方法很少针对 MARL 的公平性。
Method: 搜索式测试框架：三个适应度函数分别为已执行回合的公平性度量、从抽象状态与公平特征预测的公平性、从策略读出的决策不确定性；用交叉与变异从已观测执行派生候选，并按预测公平性与决策不确定性对候选排序以优先运行预期失败的用例。
Result: 在三个环境、两种 MARL 算法上与四个同预算基线对比，检出公平性失败最多且具统计显著性与大效应量；失败数平均比最强基线高 221%，覆盖率平均提升 23%。
Conclusion: 把公平性预测与决策不确定性同时用作搜索引导和优先级排序，能在固定预算下更高效地暴露 MARL 策略中的不公平执行。

papers.title: Learn How to Act from Your Own Interactions: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents enable the fulfillment of complex user instructions through multi-turn interactions with software environments, requiring step-wise reasoning and long-horizon memory to guide actions and retain task-relevant information, respectively. Recent on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) methods have achieved strong performance on GUI grounding, a foundational subtask for GUI agents, owing to dense token-level supervision from privilege-conditioned self-teachers. However, extending existing OPSD methods to multi-turn GUI agents is hindered by self-teachers' limited privilege-following ability and insufficient privileged guidance. In this paper, we introduce GUI-SD-v2, the next version of GUI-SD, which extends OPSD from GUI grounding to multi-turn GUI interaction and addresses key limitations through a two-stage training framework. Specifically, GUI-SD-v2 first strengthens privilege following by jointly optimizing rollouts with and without privileged guidance from the same GUI states. Furthermore, it selectively distills step-specific reasoning and memory guidance through a privilege-conditioned self-teacher, supporting action decisions and the retention of task-relevant information for subsequent interactions. Extensive experiments on two representative GUI agent benchmarks, AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, show that GUI-SD-v2 compares favorably with existing OPSD baselines while consistently outperforming the evaluated state-of-the-art methods in both Pass@1 and Pass@3 success rates. Code and training data will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI-SD-v2 把 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 从 GUI grounding 扩展到多轮 GUI 交互，用两阶段训练先联合优化带/不带特权引导的 rollout 来强化 privilege following，再经特权条件自教师选择性蒸馏分步推理与记忆引导。在 AndroidWorld 与 MobileWorld 上，Pass@1 与 Pass@3 成功率持续优于所评估的 SOTA 方法，并与现有 OPSD 基线相当。
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 依赖特权条件自教师的稠密 token 级监督，在 GUI grounding 上表现强，但推广到多轮 GUI agent 时受自教师 privilege-following 能力不足与特权引导不充分所阻。
Method: 两阶段训练框架：第一阶段对同一 GUI 状态下带特权引导与不带特权引导的 rollout 联合优化，强化 privilege following；第二阶段经特权条件自教师选择性蒸馏分步推理与记忆引导，支撑动作决策与后续交互的任务相关信息保留。
Result: 在 AndroidWorld 与 MobileWorld 两个 GUI agent 基准上，GUI-SD-v2 的 Pass@1 与 Pass@3 成功率持续优于所评估的 state-of-the-art 方法，并与现有 OPSD 基线相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把 OPSD 扩到多轮交互的关键是先让自教师可靠地跟随特权信息，再选择性蒸馏推理与记忆；代码与训练数据将公开。

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Models via Evolving Variational Autoregressive Networks
papers.abstract_en: Conventional score-based diffusion models learn scores without representing normalized densities, whereas tractable normalized models support both sampling and direct likelihood evaluation. A recent tensor-network approach provides such a representation but is largely restricted to low-dimensional lattices. Here we introduce a discrete diffusion model that parameterizes normalized probability distributions using variational autoregressive networks. Explicit Markov jump operators govern the forward noising and reverse denoising dynamics, extending discrete diffusion models with normalized distributions to spin systems on higher-dimensional lattices. We apply this framework to the two- and three-dimensional Ising models across ordered, critical, and disordered regimes, accurately computing thermodynamic quantities including free energy, energy, and magnetization. We further integrate the framework with Monte Carlo sampling, using adaptive diffusion steps to maintain high acceptance rates even at low temperatures while enhancing sample diversity. These results establish a neural-network framework for the discrete diffusion model with normalized probability distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用变分自回归网络 (variational autoregressive networks) 参数化归一化离散概率分布，配合显式 Markov 跳跃算子定义前向加噪与反向去噪，把带归一化的离散扩散模型从低维格点推广到更高维自旋系统。在二维与三维 Ising 模型的有序、临界、无序三个 regime 上可准确计算自由能、能量与磁化等热力学量。
Motivation: 常规 score-based 扩散模型学 score 但不表示归一化密度，无法直接算似然；已有的张量网络表示基本局限于低维格点，难以覆盖更高维自旋系统。
Method: 以变分自回归网络参数化归一化分布，用显式 Markov jump 管理前向加噪与反向去噪动力学；再与 Monte Carlo 采样结合，用自适应扩散步数 (adaptive diffusion steps) 在低温下维持高接受率。
Result: 在二维与三维 Ising 模型的有序、临界、无序 regime 上准确计算了自由能、能量与磁化；与 Monte Carlo 结合后在低温下仍保持高接受率并提升样本多样性。
Conclusion: 归一化分布的离散扩散模型可以用神经网络框架扩展到更高维格点自旋系统，同时支持采样与直接似然评估，并可作为低温 Monte Carlo 采样的补充。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Live Assistant: Learning Whether, When, and Whom to Assist in Real-World Live Social Streams
papers.abstract_en: Livestreams are long-lasting interactive environments where audiovisual content, viewer activity, host behavior, and platform signals evolve together, creating assistance needs that emerge from the stream itself. We introduce \liveassistant, a framework for mixed-initiative, role-conditioned assistance that formulates livestream interaction as four coupled decisions: \textbf{whether to act, when to act, whom to address, and what to communicate}. At each 10-second interval, one autoregressive policy consumes native audio and video with synchronized comments, gifts, viewer dynamics, and room metadata, then selects \textsc{OBS}, \textsc{MEM}, or \textsc{ANS}. \textsc{OBS} remains silent, \textsc{MEM} records a private semantic update, and \textsc{ANS} specifies a recipient, task, and grounded message. To support this task, we build a trajectory engine that reconstructs real livestream sessions into structured causal supervision, yielding over 320 hours of optimization trajectories and a human-reviewed benchmark of 275 clips and 13,812 decision intervals. We train the policy with Marker-Aware Multiturn Supervised Fine-Tuning (MA-MSFT), which strengthens sparse structured decisions, followed by Streaming Multiturn GSPO (SM-GSPO), which optimizes self-generated trajectories with turn- and trajectory-level credit. On the held-out benchmark, \liveassistant reaches 71.14 state accuracy, 72.67 recipient accuracy, and 58.41 task accuracy, with consistent gains over representative streaming and general multimodal baselines. Together, the formulation, benchmark, and training framework establish livestream assistance as selective participation in a shared social stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Live Assistant 把直播互动建模为四个耦合决策（是否行动、何时行动、对谁说话、说什么），单一自回归策略每 10 秒消费音视频与同步评论、礼物、观众动态，输出 OBS（沉默）、MEM（私有语义更新）或 ANS（指定接收者与 grounded 消息）。在 275 段、13,812 决策区间的人工审核基准上，状态准确率 71.14、接收者准确率 72.67、任务准确率 58.41，一致优于代表性直播与通用多模态基线。
Motivation: 直播是长时交互环境，音视频、观众行为、主播动作与平台信号同步演化，辅助需求从流本身涌现；现有方法缺少把是否、何时、对谁、说什么统一起来的选择性参与形式化与监督数据。
Method: 构建轨迹引擎把真实直播会话重建为结构化因果监督，产出超过 320 小时优化轨迹与人工审核基准（275 段、13,812 决策区间）；先用 Marker-Aware Multiturn SFT（MA-MSFT）强化稀疏结构化决策，再用 Streaming Multiturn GSPO（SM-GSPO）在自生成轨迹上做轮级与轨迹级 credit 优化。
Result: 在留出基准上状态准确率 71.14、接收者准确率 72.67、任务准确率 58.41，相对代表性直播与通用多模态基线有一致增益；数据规模为 320+ 小时轨迹、275 段、13,812 决策区间。
Conclusion: 直播辅助应被形式化为共享社会流中的选择性参与（selective participation），配合结构化因果轨迹与 marker 感知的多轮微调即可学到何时沉默、何时回应。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond the Illusion of Power: Calibrating Quasi-Experiments in Observational IS
papers.abstract_en: Information systems (IS) researchers increasingly use quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences (DiD) and instrumental variables (IV) to recover causal effects from observational panel data. Power calculations that justify these designs assume i.i.d. errors, but the deeper problem is what even a cluster-robust calculator cannot see. We report a Monte Carlo study over 9837 parameter conditions (approx 9.8 million datasets) and decompose the planned-versus-achieved power gap. The serial-correlation component is recoverable by an AR(1)-aware calculator when rho is known, and partially when rho must be estimated from short pre-periods, but panel attrition, staggered-adoption bias, and parallel-trends pretesting are captured by no closed-form formula; exogenous attrition alone costs approx 8 to 11 percentage points at the few-hundred-to-thousand sample sizes IS studies use. Treatment-correlated, outcome-dependent attrition instead induces bias, not just power loss. For IV, holding first-stage F fixed, larger N neither raises power nor curbs exclusion bias, though with a fixed instrument more data does sharpen the first stage, so identification rests on instrument strength, not sample size.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用 Monte Carlo 报告信息系统 (IS) 观察性面板中 DiD/IV 准实验的功效计算失真：在 9837 个参数条件、约 980 万份数据集上分解计划功效与实际功效的差距，发现外生 panel attrition 在 IS 常用的几百到几千样本量下就损失约 8 到 11 个百分点，而处理相关、结果依赖的 attrition 直接引入偏差而非仅功效下降；IV 在固定一阶段 F 下加大 N 既不提升功效也不抑制排除性偏差。
Motivation: IS 研究者用 DiD、IV 从观察性面板恢复因果效应，但支撑设计的功效计算假设 i.i.d. 误差，cluster-robust 计算器也看不到 attrition、staggered-adoption bias 与 parallel-trends 预检验带来的失真。
Method: 在 9837 个参数条件、约 980 万份数据集上做 Monte Carlo 研究，把计划功效与实际功效的差距分解为 serial correlation、panel attrition、staggered-adoption bias、parallel-trends 预检验等成分，并对照 AR(1)-aware 功效计算器（rho 已知或需从短前段估计）与 IV 设定（固定一阶段 F、改变 N）。
Result: serial-correlation 成分在 rho 已知时可由 AR(1)-aware 计算器恢复，rho 需从短前段估计时只能部分恢复；外生 attrition 在几百到几千样本量下损失约 8 到 11 个百分点功效，且无闭式公式覆盖 attrition、staggered-adoption bias 与预检验；处理相关、结果依赖的 attrition 诱导偏差；IV 固定一阶段 F 时增大 N 不提升功效也不降低排除性偏差，固定工具变量下更多数据只让第一阶段更准。

papers.title: StateComp: Learning When to Compress History in Long Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continuously accumulate interaction history during task execution, yet the importance of past interactions changes as the agent state evolves. Existing context management methods largely compress history based on fixed windows, periodic schedules, or current relevance, overlooking a more fundamental question: when has a past interaction become safe to replace? Premature compression may remove information still needed for future actions, while overly conservative retention leads to substantial context overhead. To address this, we propose State Conditioned Compression (StateComp), a framework that determines when historical interactions can be safely compressed according to the current agent state. StateComp constructs KEEP and READY supervision through a two-stage annotation procedure and trains an imbalance-aware router on hidden representations from a frozen language model. A bounded state representation further reduces the cost of evaluating long histories, while adjacent READY interactions are grouped into continuous spans and replaced with compact summaries during execution. Experiments on WorkBuddyBench show that StateComp reduces total agent and summarization tokens by 52.27% while maintaining task performance, and achieves a 12.67-fold speedup in representation extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateComp 用当前 agent 状态判断历史交互何时可安全压缩：两阶段标注构造 KEEP/READY 监督，在冻结语言模型隐表示上训练 imbalance-aware router，相邻 READY 交互合并成连续片段并替换为紧凑摘要。在 WorkBuddyBench 上，agent 与摘要总 token 减少 52.27% 而任务性能保持，表示提取加速 12.67 倍。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的历史重要性随状态演化，固定窗口、周期调度或仅按当前相关性的压缩要么过早丢掉后续仍需的信息，要么过度保留导致上下文开销大。
Method: 提出 State Conditioned Compression (StateComp)：两阶段标注程序生成 KEEP 与 READY 监督，在冻结语言模型的隐表示上训练 imbalance-aware router；用有界状态表示 (bounded state representation) 降低长历史评估成本，执行时把相邻 READY 交互分组为连续片段并替换为紧凑摘要。
Result: 在 WorkBuddyBench 上，agent 与 summarization 总 token 减少 52.27% 且任务性能保持不变；表示提取获得 12.67 倍加速。
Conclusion: 历史压缩的时机应由当前 agent 状态决定，而非固定窗口或当前相关性；按状态门控的压缩可在保持任务表现的同时大幅削减上下文开销。

papers.title: Large Knowledge Model: From Papers to a Scientific Reasoning Landscape
papers.abstract_en: Accumulated scientific knowledge advances inquiry when prior findings help researchers choose new questions, design investigations, and interpret results. Realizing this value at scale requires access to the reasoning that connects research problems, scientific procedures, conclusions, and evidence. We introduce the Large Knowledge Model (LKM), a scientific knowledge infrastructure that transforms the literature into a shared, computationally accessible reasoning resource. LKM represents papers as source-grounded reasoning graphs, couples structural traversal with semantic retrieval over the same objects, and aligns related questions, claims, and reasoning chains across papers. This representation forms a Scientific Reasoning Landscape with three connected views: a Question Landscape that organizes research problems and open directions, a Workflow Landscape that exposes reusable scientific procedures, and an Evidence Landscape that connects conclusions to their support, disagreement, and conditions. The unified substrate supports reasoning-aware scientific search, evidence-grounded question answering, comparative evidence analysis, and research planning. Researchers and agents can retrieve relevant work through its scientific intent, synthesize answers with inspectable supporting arguments, and develop research plans informed by established workflows and unresolved evidence. We describe a corpus-scale system and evaluate scientific retrieval and knowledge-intensive question answering. With the answering model fixed, LKM retrieval improves accuracy by 9.30%, 4.20%, and 14.69% on ChemBench, PubMedQA, and SciBench, respectively. By connecting knowledge access to scientific reasoning and action, LKM provides a common foundation for discovering relevant research, reusing scientific knowledge, and coordinating cumulative inquiry across researchers, agents, and research cycles.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures; under review at ICLR 2027. Website: https://lkm.bohrium.com/web/en
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LKM 把文献转成以来源为据的推理图 (source-grounded reasoning graphs)，在同一对象上同时做结构遍历与语义检索，构成 Question、Workflow、Evidence 三个视图的 Scientific Reasoning Landscape。固定答题模型后，LKM 检索使 ChemBench、PubMedQA、SciBench 上的准确率分别提升 9.30%、4.20%、14.69%。
Motivation: 既有文献检索只返回相关论文，不暴露连接研究问题、科学流程、结论与证据的推理过程，研究者和 agent 难以复用已有工作来选题、设计实验与解释结果。
Method: 将每篇论文表示为 source-grounded reasoning graph，在同一图对象上耦合结构遍历与语义检索，并跨论文对齐相关问题、主张与推理链；在此统一底座上支持 reasoning-aware 检索、证据支撑的问答、比较证据分析与研究规划，评测时固定答题模型只换检索。
Result: 在答题模型固定的条件下，LKM 检索将准确率提升 9.30%（ChemBench）、4.20%（PubMedQA）、14.69%（SciBench）；系统在 corpus 规模上构建并评测了科学检索与知识密集型问答。
Conclusion: 把文献组织成可计算的推理资源，能让检索按科学意图命中工作并给出可检查的支撑论证，从而在研究者、agent 与研究周期之间复用科学知识。

papers.title: Teach-to-Crash: A Closed-Loop Student-Teacher LLM Framework for Collision-Inducing Test Scenario Generation
papers.abstract_en: Validating Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) in simulation requires testing architectures that can discover rare, safety-critical failures while generating scenarios that are executable, diverse, and useful for downstream failure analysis. We introduce Teach-to-Crash, a closed-loop testing framework that combines a constrained ego-centric scenario representation, stagnation-aware search control, and a dual-LLM architecture for adaptive failure discovery. A high-reasoning Teacher LLM acts as an adaptive search controller, while a low-reasoning Student LLM emits simulator-executable scenarios in a strict JSON schema. The Teacher intervenes only when rolling collision rate and time-to-collision metrics stagnate, providing strategic guidance to redirect the search. In a CARLA case study with two experimental setups that vary the ego vehicle's speed policy, Teach-to-Crash achieves the highest Collision Hit Rate (90.79%), the shortest mean Time-to-Collision (18.31 s), and a competitive Collision Discovery Rate (136.21). PAFOT attains a higher mean CDR (179.44), but with substantially larger variance. Teach-to-Crash also yields the highest diversity (0.547) and, averaged across both setups on the CARLA Traffic Manager controller, the highest avoidability-based usefulness proxy (60.04%) among the compared methods. These results, within the evaluated CARLA scope, provide evidence that closed-loop dual-LLM reasoning can steer adversarial simulation-based testing over a constrained executable program space, generating failures that are frequent, structurally diverse, and assessed as more frequently avoidable.
papers.comment: 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE) AgenticDev (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Teach-to-Crash 用双 LLM 闭环做自动驾驶系统 (ADS) 碰撞测试场景生成：高推理 Teacher 只在滚动碰撞率与 TTC 指标停滞时介入指导，低推理 Student 按严格 JSON schema 输出 CARLA 可执行场景。在 CARLA 两种自车速度策略设置下，其 Collision Hit Rate 达 90.79%、平均 TTC 最短 18.31 s、多样性 0.547、可避性代理 60.04%，均为对比方法最高。
Motivation: 仿真验证 ADS 需要能发现罕见安全关键失效、且场景可执行、多样、便于后续失效分析的测试架构，而现有对抗搜索容易停滞或产出不可执行场景。
Method: 框架含受约束的自车中心场景表示、停滞感知搜索控制与双 LLM 架构：高推理 Teacher LLM 作为自适应搜索控制器，低推理 Student LLM 在严格 JSON schema 下生成仿真器可执行场景；Teacher 仅在滚动碰撞率与 time-to-collision 指标停滞时给出战略指导以重定向搜索。评估在 CARLA 上进行，含两种改变自车速度策略的实验设置，并在 CARLA Traffic Manager 控制器上比较多个方法。
Result: CARLA 案例研究中 Teach-to-Crash 取得最高 Collision Hit Rate 90.79%、最短平均 Time-to-Collision 18.31 s、Collision Discovery Rate 136.21、最高多样性 0.547；在 CARLA Traffic Manager 控制器上跨两种设置平均的基于可避性的 usefulness 代理为 60.04%，同为对比方法最高。PAFOT 的平均 CDR 更高（179.44），但方差显著更大。
Conclusion: 在所评估的 CARLA 范围内，闭环双 LLM 推理能在受约束的可执行程序空间上引导对抗仿真测试，产出频繁、结构多样且更常被判定为可避的失效。

papers.title: KITE: KV-Invariant Transformer Expansion for Efficient Agentic LLM Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling a language model is not only a question of final quality: the architectural choice determines how much computation is spent during training, prompt processing, and autoregressive decoding to achieve certain model quality. An ideal model architecture should lower all above computation costs to facilitate scaling to a larger model, while ensure the larger model indeed outperforms smaller baselines. We introduce KV-Invariant Transformer Expansion (KITE), a scaling paradigm that achieves this goal. It trains the model from a smaller size to a larger size (i.e., saving training costs via upcycling), while places newly added parameters in regions that do not affect attention KV. Consequently, during inference, prefilling KV only relies on the smaller part of the model, so the inference costs are saved. As a concrete instantiation, we present Step Scale Transformer (SST), a two-tower decoder in which one tower produces KV and the other reads them. At comparable cumulative training compute, SST, a 67B MoE model with 2.15B active body parameters per decode token, achieves lower training loss than 47B and 63B MoE Transformers with 1.48B and 2.02B active body parameters, respectively, while reducing estimated inference cost by 6.7% and 31.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KITE 提出 KV 不变的模型扩展范式：从小模型 upcycling 到大模型，把新增参数放在不影响 attention KV 的位置，使推理 prefill 只走较小的那部分。实例化为双塔解码器 Step Scale Transformer (SST)，一个塔产 KV、另一个塔读 KV；在可比累计训练算力下，67B MoE（每 token 激活 2.15B）训练损失低于 47B 与 63B MoE（激活 1.48B、2.02B），估计推理成本分别降 6.7% 与 31.6%。
Motivation: 架构选择决定训练、prompt 处理与自回归解码的算力开销；理想架构要在扩大模型时同时压低这三类成本，并保证大模型确实胜过小基线。
Method: KITE 范式：从小规模训练到大规模（upcycling 省训练成本），新增参数置于不影响 attention KV 的区域，推理时 prefill KV 只依赖模型较小部分；具体实现为双塔解码器 SST，一塔生成 KV、另一塔读取。
Result: 在可比累计训练算力下，SST（67B MoE，每 decode token 激活 2.15B body 参数）取得低于 47B MoE（激活 1.48B）与 63B MoE（激活 2.02B）的训练损失，同时估计推理成本分别降低 6.7% 与 31.6%。
Conclusion: 把新增参数放到 KV 不变的区域，可以在 upcycling 扩展的同时降低训练与推理算力，且更大模型仍胜过更小的 MoE 基线。

papers.title: NGN: Learning Neural Network Size as a Differentiable Count
papers.abstract_en: Neural network size is usually chosen before training, separating architecture selection from weight optimization. We introduce the Neurogenesis Network (NGN), a differentiable parameterization for learning how many ordered structural components a model should use. For each ordered component group, one learnable boundary selects an active prefix while the model parameters are trained. The boundary can grow from a compact initialization and can be deployed by discarding components beyond the learned boundary. Controlled experiments examine convergence of the learned boundary, the performance of deployed prefixes, and comparisons with fixed-size models and alternative approaches to learning capacity. We then apply the same mechanism to MLPs, convolutional and graph networks, Transformers, state-space models, LoRA, and adapters. Across these settings, deploying only the learned prefix usually changes performance little, and the selected architectures perform similarly to fixed models trained at the same size. These results show that structural capacity can be optimized directly as a count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NGN 把网络规模变成可微的计数来学：对每个有序结构组件组设一个可学习边界，边界选出激活前缀，权重与边界同时训练，边界可从紧凑初始化增长，部署时丢弃边界之外的组件。跨 MLP、卷积与图网络、Transformer、状态空间模型、LoRA 与 adapter，只部署学到的前缀通常几乎不改变性能，选出的架构与同规模固定模型表现相当。
Motivation: 网络规模通常在训练前人工选定，架构选择与权重优化被割裂，容量需要靠离散搜索而非梯度来定。
Method: 提出 Neurogenesis Network (NGN)：为每个有序组件组引入一个可学习边界，边界在参数训练过程中选择激活前缀，可从紧凑初始化增长；部署时丢弃边界之后的组件。在受控实验中考察边界的收敛、部署前缀的性能，并与固定规模模型及其它学习容量的方法比较，再把同一机制迁移到 MLP、卷积与图网络、Transformer、状态空间模型、LoRA 和 adapter。
Result: 受控实验考察学到边界的收敛、部署前缀的性能，并与固定规模模型和替代容量学习方法对比；跨上述各架构设置，只部署学到的前缀通常只带来很小的性能变化，被选出的架构与在相同规模下训练的固定模型表现相近。
Conclusion: 结构容量可以直接作为一个可微的计数来优化，学到的前缀可替代同规模的固定架构，无需在训练前离散地选定网络大小。

papers.title: Sparse-Observation Atmospheric Thermal Forecasting with Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Climate-Aware Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Short-horizon forecasts of atmospheric temperature are needed to support climate-aware digital-twin systems, but such forecasts must be produced where thermal observations are incomplete. This study evaluates a physics-informed neural network for potential-temperature forecasting, constrained by a pressure-coordinate thermodynamic advection-source equation and a diabatic-source closure fit from the preceding 12-hour period and frozen before future-time training. Using hourly ERA5 reanalysis at three pressure levels, the model is evaluated as a conditional hindcast at lead times of one, two and three hours against persistence, local-trend, and two matched neural-network baselines, one of which receives the same future meteorological forcing as the PINN, helping distinguish the physical constraint from access to future forcing. In an Oklahoma development case, mean RMSE improvement over the strongest baseline grew from 8.1\% at one hour to 23.8\% at three hours; under an observation-density sweep down to 5\% of candidate locations, this 3-hour advantage remained 14.6--16.9\%, with no evidence that lower density improves performance. Under a fixed protocol transferred to an Alabama heat event with three virtual-observation layouts, three-hour improvement ranged 19.7-24.4\% with consistent origin-level wins. A parallel Montana stress test, in which fixed pressure levels intersected complex terrain, produced a three-hour degradation of roughly 17.5\%, identifying a terrain-related applicability limit of the formulation. Together, these results indicate that the physics constraint's benefit grows with forecast horizon, persists under severe observation sparsity, and transfers across regions, but is bounded by the validity of a fixed vertical-coordinate representation over complex terrain, evidence relevant to physics-constrained components of climate-aware forecasting and digital-twin systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在热观测稀疏处做位温短临预报时，用压力坐标热力学平流-源方程约束的 PINN 加上由前 12 小时拟合并冻结的非绝热源闭合，物理约束的收益随时效增长：俄克拉荷马案例中相对最强基线的平均 RMSE 改善从 1 小时 8.1% 升到 3 小时 23.8%，观测密度降到候选位置的 5% 时 3 小时优势仍为 14.6–16.9%。但固定气压面在复杂地形上失效，蒙大拿压力测试 3 小时退化约 17.5%。
Motivation: 气候感知数字孪生需要在热观测不完整处做短时大气温度预报，而纯数据模型在观测稀疏、跨区域迁移时缺少物理约束，且固定垂直坐标在复杂地形上的适用边界不明。
Method: 以压力坐标热力学平流-源方程约束位温预报的 physics-informed neural network，非绝热源闭合用前 12 小时数据拟合后在预报时刻前冻结；用三个气压层的逐小时 ERA5 做 1、2、3 小时条件性回报 (conditional hindcast)，对照 persistence、local-trend 及两个匹配神经网络基线，其中一个获得与 PINN 相同的未来气象强迫，以区分物理约束与未来强迫信息的贡献。
Result: 俄克拉荷马开发案例中相对最强基线的平均 RMSE 改善 1 小时 8.1%、3 小时 23.8%；观测密度扫描到候选位置的 5% 时 3 小时优势仍为 14.6–16.9%，且没有证据显示更低密度会提升性能。固定协议迁移到阿拉巴马一次高温事件的三种虚拟观测布局，3 小时改善为 19.7–24.4%，各起始层均取胜；蒙大拿压力测试中固定气压面与复杂地形相交，3 小时退化约 17.5%。
Conclusion: 物理约束的收益随时效增长、在严重观测稀疏下仍保持并可跨区域迁移，但其适用性受限于固定垂直坐标表示在复杂地形上的有效性。
Relevance: 47

papers.title: Ruby-ASR: Evidence-Preserving Supervision for Joint Orthographic and Lexical-Reading Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Conventional Japanese automatic speech recognition (ASR) is supervised by an orthographic transcript, although the same written form can correspond to different lexical readings realized in speech. Such utterances receive an identical target, so their reading distinction is absent from the supervision interface and cannot be recovered reliably by post-hoc text-only grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. We present Ruby-ASR, which refines the conventional target into a span-bound orthographic--lexical-reading sequence. Unlike separate full-sentence orthographic and phonological outputs, the ruby representation locally binds each written span to its realized reading and permits deterministic recovery of both views. We instantiate the target under subtitle-style and verbatim-style transcription conventions using a Qwen3-ASR backbone; a mora-level CTC objective provides auxiliary monotonic reading supervision. The experimental results across five Japanese benchmarks show that refining the recognition target can improve lexical-reading recovery without sacrificing readable orthographic transcription. We release the checkpoints and inference code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ruby-ASR 把日语 ASR 的监督目标从纯字面转写改为 span 绑定的字面-词读序列 (orthographic--lexical-reading)，使同一书面形式对应的不同读音在监督接口中可区分，并可用确定性方式还原两种视图。在五个日语基准上，细化目标提升了词读恢复且不牺牲可读的字面转写。
Motivation: 日语同一书面形式可对应不同词读，传统字面转写监督给出相同目标，读音区分在监督接口中缺失，事后纯文本 G2P 无法可靠恢复。
Method: 以 Qwen3-ASR 为骨干，将目标细化为 span 绑定的字面-词读序列，分别在字幕式与逐字式转写约定下实例化；辅以 mora 级 CTC 目标提供单调读音监督。
Result: 在五个日语基准上，细化识别目标提升了词读恢复，同时不牺牲可读的字面转写；发布 checkpoints 与推理代码。
Conclusion: 在监督目标层面绑定书面 span 与其实际读音，可在不损失字面转写可读性的前提下恢复词读信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PotARCin: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Skill Acquisition in Abstract Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) has become a prominent benchmark for evaluating general abstract reasoning and fluid intelligence in AI models. Yet standard ARC evaluation considers only a single capability: producing the correct output grid for a test input. We argue that this narrow format fails to evaluate the diversity of abilities that genuine abstract skill acquisition should enable. We introduce PotARCin, a benchmark that extends ARC by assessing understanding of a task's underlying abstract rule across five dimensions: Definition, Classification, Constrained Generation, Editing, and Inversion. PotARCin employs programmatic methods to generate new task instances and transform given inputs for a given ARC task, enabling dynamic generative sampling beyond fixed input-output pairs. Across five state-of-the-art models evaluated on the ARC-AGI-1 training set, we observe a 25-52 percentage-point performance gap between standard ARC evaluation and evaluation on PotARCin, and find that multi-dimensional evaluation reorders models that standard accuracy ranks alike. We further investigate effects of generative sampling, difficulty of corruption types, and questions of self-consistency, showing that models frequently contradict their own formalized rule even where they have stated it correctly. We also introduce P-ARC, a held-out hand-crafted test set, on which models achieve 1-8% accuracy across all five dimensions, underscoring the importance of more holistic evaluations of abstract reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PotARCin 把 ARC 扩展为五维抽象规则评测（Definition、Classification、Constrained Generation、Editing、Inversion），用程序化方法动态生成任务实例与变换输入。在 ARC-AGI-1 训练集上评测五个前沿模型，标准 ARC 与五维评测之间出现 25–52 个百分点的性能落差，且多维评测会重排标准准确率打成平手的模型；在手工留出的 P-ARC 上五个维度准确率仅 1–8%。
Motivation: 标准 ARC 只看能否为测试输入产出正确输出网格，单一格式无法覆盖真正抽象技能习得应有的能力多样性，模型排名也失真。
Method: 以程序化方法为给定 ARC 任务生成新实例并变换输入，突破固定输入输出对；在五个维度上出题，评测五个前沿模型于 ARC-AGI-1 训练集，并另建手工留出测试集 P-ARC；同时考察生成式采样、腐化类型难度与自洽性（模型是否与自己已正确陈述的形式化规则矛盾）。
Result: 五个前沿模型在 ARC-AGI-1 训练集上，标准 ARC 评测与 PotARCin 评测之间存在 25–52 个百分点的性能差距；多维评测重排了标准准确率原本并列的模型；模型常与自己已正确陈述的规则自相矛盾；P-ARC 上五个维度的准确率全模型仅 1–8%。
Conclusion: 只用单一输出网格评分会高估抽象推理能力，多维评测会改变模型排序，抽象规则的陈述与运用之间存在明显断裂，需要更整体的评测方式。

papers.title: SR-Fraud: An Outcome-Supervised Reflective LLM Agent Framework for Non-Stationary Payment Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: Real-time payment fraud detection is a non-stationary streaming prediction problem: adversaries adapt before supervised labels mature, and localized burst attacks can cause losses before retraining. Production systems typically rely on tabular classifiers and rules, which can struggle to capture these emerging sequential patterns before periodic retraining occurs. We present SR-Fraud, an outcome-supervised reflective LLM framework that decouples request-time decisions from offline adaptation. A frozen, stateless agent scores each transaction from a Hybrid Episodic Window to track behavioral shifts, while an offline reflection agent proposes boundary hypotheses from matured errors. A deterministic verifier then admits only supported hypotheses into an executable knowledge state. On a production payment-fraud benchmark, SR-Fraud improves all detection metrics over its frozen decision agent, obtains higher point estimates than static and periodically retrained CatBoost, and detects an emerging fraud burst.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR-Fraud 把支付欺诈检测的请求时决策与离线适应解耦：冻结无状态 agent 用 Hybrid Episodic Window 打分每笔交易，离线反思 agent 从已成熟错误提出边界假设，确定性 verifier 只放行有证据支持的假设进入可执行知识状态。在生产支付欺诈基准上，它在全部检测指标上优于自身的冻结决策 agent，点估计高于静态与周期重训的 CatBoost，并检出一次正在涌现的欺诈突发。
Motivation: 支付欺诈是非平稳流式预测：对抗方在监督标签成熟前就已改变策略，局部突发攻击在重训周期到来前已造成损失，而生产系统依赖的表格分类器加规则难以在周期重训之间捕捉新出现的时序模式。
Method: 框架分三层：冻结无状态 agent 在请求时用 Hybrid Episodic Window 追踪行为漂移并给每笔交易打分；离线反思 agent 从成熟错误中提出边界假设；确定性 verifier 只把有证据支持的假设写入可执行知识状态，从而把请求时决策与离线适应分离。
Result: 在生产支付欺诈基准上，SR-Fraud 在全部检测指标上超过其自身的冻结决策 agent，点估计高于静态 CatBoost 与周期重训 CatBoost，并成功检出一次正在涌现的欺诈突发 (emerging fraud burst)。
Conclusion: 把请求时打分冻结、把适应放到离线反思加确定性验证这条路径，能在标签未成熟、攻击突发时仍提升欺诈检测并抓住突发事件。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在生产支付欺诈基准上，SR-Fraud 在全部检测指标上超过其自身的冻结决策 agent，点估计高于静态 CatBoost 与周期重训 CatBoost，并成功检出一次正在涌现的欺诈突发 (emerging fraud burst)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把请求时打分冻结、把适应放到离线反思加确定性验证这条路径，能在标签未成熟、攻击突发时仍提升欺诈检测并抓住突发事件。

papers.title: Memory Control Signals Emerge Before Action in Long Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long horizon language model agents continuously accumulate interaction history, increasing computational cost while making relevant information harder to preserve and reuse. Existing context management methods mainly focus on how to compress or retrieve history, but largely leave open whether the model itself already represents the need for these memory operations before they occur. We study the hidden state immediately before each agent action and find that compression and recall needs are already encoded in the model's internal representations. These signals cannot be explained by simple context length or interaction progress, and they exhibit distinct formation patterns across model depth. We further show that most memory decision information is preserved in a compact recent context, while selectively restored historical evidence complements the long range dependencies that recent context misses. Based on these findings, we propose Preaction Memory with Evidence Retrieval (PaMER), which combines state guided compression with external evidence retrieval. PaMER+ further introduces step level evidence selection to recover only the historical information required by the current task. Experiments on WorkBuddyBench, across multiple context management baselines and model backbones, show that our framework substantially reduces context consumption while maintaining competitive task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaMER 把长程 agent 的记忆操作提前到动作发生前：探针显示压缩与召回需求已编码在动作前的 hidden state 中，且不能由上下文长度或交互进度解释。据此用状态引导压缩加外部证据检索，PaMER+ 再加 step 级证据选择，在 WorkBuddyBench 上大幅降低上下文消耗同时保持有竞争力的任务表现。
Motivation: 长程语言模型 agent 持续累积交互历史，计算成本上升且相关信息难以保留复用；现有上下文管理只做压缩或检索，不关心模型是否在记忆操作发生前就已表征出这种需求。
Method: 分析 agent 每次动作前的 hidden state，检验压缩/召回需求的可解码性及其随模型深度的形成模式；据此提出 PaMER，结合状态引导压缩与外部证据检索，PaMER+ 进一步加入 step 级证据选择，只恢复当前任务所需的历史信息。
Result: 动作前表征中可解码出压缩与召回需求，且不能由上下文长度或交互进度解释，随模型深度呈不同形成模式；多数记忆决策信息保留在紧凑的近期上下文中，选择性恢复的历史证据补足近期上下文缺失的长程依赖。在 WorkBuddyBench 上跨多个上下文管理基线与模型 backbone，框架大幅降低上下文消耗并保持有竞争力的任务表现。
Conclusion: 记忆操作的需求在动作前就已由模型内部表征，可据此提前触发压缩与检索；状态引导压缩加证据选择能在压上下文的同时不明显掉任务表现。

papers.title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present Hunyuan-A13B, an open-source large language model based on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It contains 80 billion total parameters but activates only 13 billion during inference, balancing model capability, computational efficiency, and deployment cost. The model is pretrained on a rigorously filtered 20T-token corpus with enhanced STEM data curation, improving factual reliability and reasoning ability. High-quality supervised fine-tuning and large-scale reinforcement learning further enhance its overall performance. Hunyuan-A13B also introduces a dual-mode Chain-of-Thought framework that adapts reasoning depth to task complexity: fast thinking for routine queries and slow thinking for complex, multi-step problems. Evaluations show competitive performance across mathematics, science, programming, general language understanding, and agent tasks, often approaching that of much larger models. Its high inference throughput makes it suitable for latency-sensitive applications. We release Hunyuan-A13B to support open research and practical LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hunyuan-A13B 是一个 MoE 架构的开源 LLM：800 亿总参数、推理时仅激活 130 亿，在 20T token 过滤语料（强化 STEM 数据）上预训练，再经 SFT 与大规模强化学习，并引入按任务复杂度切换快思考/慢思考的双模式 Chain-of-Thought。评测覆盖数学、科学、编程、通用语言理解与 agent 任务，表现接近更大模型，高吞吐适合延迟敏感场景。
Motivation: 在 MoE 的能力与部署成本之间做权衡：既要接近大模型的推理与 STEM 表现，又要控制激活参数量以支撑低延迟应用。
Method: MoE 架构，80B 总参数、13B 激活；预训练用严格过滤的 20T token 语料并加强 STEM 数据筛选，随后高质量 SFT 与大规模强化学习；推理侧用双模式 Chain-of-Thought，按任务复杂度在 fast thinking 与 slow thinking 之间切换。
Result: 在数学、科学、编程、通用语言理解和 agent 任务上评测，表现有竞争力、常接近远大于它的模型；推理吞吐高，适合延迟敏感应用。摘要未给出具体分数或基线数值。
Conclusion: 以 13B 激活参数的 MoE 加双模式 CoT，可以在保持高吞吐的同时逼近更大模型的能力，作者据此开源该模型以支持研究与部署。

papers.title: Multitask Regression with Pairwise Fusion
papers.abstract_en: We study multitask regression when coefficient sharing can differ by predictor. For a given predictor, many tasks may have the same coefficient while a few differ, and the exceptional tasks need not be the same for another predictor. We describe this structure by two quantities: the number of active predictors and the total number of task coefficients that differ from the most common value for their predictor. We estimate the coefficient matrix by penalizing all pairwise coefficient differences across tasks, with an additional group penalty when predictor selection is needed. The resulting upper and lower bounds have the same dependence on these two quantities. We also consider the stronger setting in which a large set of tasks shares one entire coefficient vector. Under explicit sample-size conditions, the same pairwise estimator pools those tasks exactly, while allowing the remaining tasks to differ. Simulations and household energy data illustrate the transition between broad sharing and task-specific coefficients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多任务回归中系数共享按预测变量逐列发生：同一预测变量上多数任务共享同一系数、少数任务例外，且例外任务随预测变量变化。方法对所有任务对的系数差加惩罚（需要选变量时再加 group penalty），上下界只依赖活跃预测变量数与偏离众数的系数总数；在显式样本量条件下，当一大组任务共享整条系数向量时，该成对估计量能精确地把这组任务池化、同时允许其余任务不同。
Motivation: 多任务回归常假设系数要么全共享、要么全独立，无法刻画按预测变量逐列、且例外任务随列变化的部分共享结构，导致池化与估计误差权衡失准。
Method: 用两个量刻画结构：活跃预测变量个数，以及偏离各预测变量众数值的任务系数总数；对系数矩阵施加所有任务对系数差的惩罚，需要预测变量选择时附加 group penalty；另考虑一大组任务共享整条系数向量的更强设定，并给出显式样本量条件。
Result: 所得上界与下界对上述两个量的依赖形式一致；在显式样本量条件下，同一成对估计量精确池化共享整条系数向量的任务集合，同时允许其余任务取不同系数；用模拟与家庭能耗数据说明从广泛共享到任务特异系数的过渡。
Conclusion: 按预测变量逐列的成对差惩罚能在统一框架内同时处理部分共享与整向量共享，其理论速率由活跃预测变量数与偏离众数的系数总数共同决定。

papers.title: EnSIMem: Entity-Structured Indexing for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: An agent that interacts with users over long periods must recall facts, preferences, events, and changes from a continuously growing interaction history. Existing memory systems often compress interactions into generic summaries or retrieve anonymous text chunks, making it difficult for an agent to identify the correct entity, property, and supporting evidence. We present EnSIMem, an entity-structured long-term memory architecture for an agent. During offline construction, the system organizes interactions into theme-coherent episodes and builds dialogue-grounded index entries of the form [entity][entity type][property:value]. Each entry preserves its source turns, temporal information, and available multimodal fields. During online interaction, the agent's request is decomposed into evidence requirements whose properties are aligned with the memory index. Entity-property lookup and adaptive retrieval then collect the evidence needed for point, temporal, compositional, and aggregation reasoning. The agent generates its response from the preserved source evidence rather than from lossy memory summaries. On long-term agent-memory benchmarks, EnSIMem achieves high answer accuracy while maintaining compact contexts and favorable online efficiency. These results show that entity-structured indexing and episode-level provenance provide a reliable foundation for long-term memory in agents. The code of our model is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnSIMem 把智能体的长期交互历史离线组织为主题连贯的 episode，并建成 [entity][entity type][property:value] 形式的索引条目，保留来源对话轮次、时间信息与多模态字段。在线阶段把请求拆解为证据需求并与索引做属性对齐，经实体-属性查找与自适应检索收集 point、temporal、compositional、aggregation 四类推理所需证据，最终从保留的原始证据而非有损摘要生成回答。在长期智能体记忆基准上取得高回答准确率，同时保持紧凑上下文与良好的在线效率。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统把交互压成通用摘要或检索匿名文本块，智能体难以定位正确的实体、属性及其支撑证据，长程交互中的事实、偏好与变化因此不可靠召回。
Method: 离线构建阶段将交互划分为主题连贯 episode，生成 [entity][entity type][property:value] 索引条目并保留来源轮次、时间与多模态字段；在线阶段把用户请求分解为证据需求，与索引做属性对齐，再通过实体-属性查找和自适应检索收集点式、时序、组合与聚合推理的证据，回答只依据保留的原始证据生成。
Result: 在长期智能体记忆基准 (long-term agent-memory benchmarks) 上取得高回答准确率，同时保持紧凑上下文与有利的在线效率；代码已发布于 github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem。
Conclusion: 实体结构化索引加 episode 级来源追溯 (provenance) 可作为智能体长期记忆的可靠基础，让回答建立在可回溯的原始证据而非有损摘要之上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Learning with Spectral Connectivity Priors for Scarce Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning a sparse graph from scarce data is practically important but challenging. Motivated by the desirable combination of local sparsity and strong global connectivity exhibited by expander-like graphs, we propose spectral connectivity-regularized graph learning (SCoGL), a framework that incorporates a family of Laplacian spectral priors to explicitly promote global connectivity. Specifically, SCoGL augments a combinatorial-Laplacian-constrained graphical lasso (GLASSO) objective over a target adjacency matrix $\mathbf{W}$ with a general connectivity prior computed from Laplacian eigenvalues. We derive gradients for several representative connectivity priors and develop a projected gradient descent (PGD) algorithm with Armijo backtracking to efficiently optimize $\mathbf{W}$. Experiments show that the proposed SCoGL variants improve graph recovery and enhance downstream tasks such as graph signal denoising when signal observations are scarce.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀缺数据下学稀疏图时，SCoGL 在组合 Laplacian 约束的 GLASSO 目标上加一族由 Laplacian 特征值计算的谱连通性先验，显式提升全局连通性。用带 Armijo 回溯的投影梯度下降 (PGD) 优化邻接矩阵 W，实验显示各 SCoGL 变体在信号观测稀缺时改善图恢复，并提升图信号去噪等下游任务。
Motivation: 从稀缺数据学稀疏图既实用又困难：单纯稀疏目标容易牺牲全局连通性，而 expander-like 图正是局部稀疏与强全局连通的组合。
Method: SCoGL 在组合 Laplacian 约束的 graphical lasso (GLASSO) 目标上，叠加一个由 Laplacian 特征值算出的通用连通性先验；对若干代表性先验推导梯度，并用带 Armijo 回溯的投影梯度下降 (PGD) 高效优化目标邻接矩阵 W。
Result: 实验显示 SCoGL 各变体在信号观测稀缺时改善图恢复，并提升图信号去噪 (graph signal denoising) 等下游任务表现。
Conclusion: 把 Laplacian 谱连通性先验嵌入 GLASSO，可在数据稀缺时同时保住局部稀疏与全局连通，从而改善图恢复与下游图信号处理。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 Laplacian 谱连通性先验嵌入 GLASSO，可在数据稀缺时同时保住局部稀疏与全局连通，从而改善图恢复与下游图信号处理。

papers.title: TimeEvo: Failure-Driven Self-Evolution of a Time Series Agent
papers.abstract_en: Time series agents answer analytical questions by calling external tools, and which tools they carry is decided by people before the agent runs. However, we identify two failures in this setup. Human-Agent Tool Misalignment: a library of 21 expert-curated tools helps on some tasks and hurts on others, dropping anomaly accuracy under every backbone we test. Silent Harm: one round of generic self-revision changes 147 answers and breaks 56 of them, while the final score moves by less than a point. Both follow from the same gap: whether a tool helps is decided question by question at runtime, while tools are supplied in advance and judged by a single average. To address this, we propose TimeEvo, which clusters an agent's diagnosed failures into capability gaps, plans a measurement for each, synthesizes evidence-only tools that fill them, and admits the candidate library only through a paired admission gate. Experiments on ten time series QA tasks and three backbones show that TimeEvo, starting from an empty library, improves accuracy on every task and every backbone, and that a library grown on a cheap model still gains when it is installed into stronger ones. Code is available at https://github.com/Muyiiiii/TimeEvo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeEvo 让时序 agent 按运行时失败自演化工具库：把诊断出的失败聚成能力缺口、为每个缺口规划度量、合成只含证据的候选工具，再用配对准入门 (paired admission gate) 决定是否入库。它同时诊断出两个既有失败——21 个人工精选工具在所有 backbone 上都拉低异常检测准确率，一轮通用自修订改动 147 个答案并弄坏 56 个而总分变化不足 1 分。从空库起步，TimeEvo 在十个时序 QA 任务、三个 backbone 上逐任务逐模型提升准确率，且在便宜模型上长出的库装到更强模型上仍有增益。
Motivation: 工具是否有益是逐题在运行时决定的，但工具是事先人工供给、只按单一平均分评价：21 个专家工具在部分任务上有帮助、在另一些上有害，异常检测准确率在所有 backbone 上都下降；一轮通用自修订改动 147 个答案、破坏 56 个，而总分变化不足 1 分 (Silent Harm)。
Method: TimeEvo 把 agent 已诊断的失败聚类成能力缺口 (capability gaps)，为每个缺口规划一个度量方案，据此合成只含证据 (evidence-only) 的候选工具，最后通过配对准入门 (paired admission gate) 决定候选库是否整体入库，取代事先固定的人工工具库。
Result: 在十个时序 QA 任务、三个 backbone 上，TimeEvo 从空工具库出发，在每个任务、每个 backbone 上都提升准确率；在便宜模型上增长出的库安装到更强模型后仍有增益。对照诊断：21 个人工精选工具使异常检测准确率在所有被测 backbone 上下降；一轮通用自修订改动 147 个答案、破坏其中 56 个，而最终分数变化不足 1 分。
Conclusion: 工具的取舍应逐题在运行时按证据决定，而不是事先按单一平均分一次性供给；按失败驱动、经配对准入生长的工具库能跨任务、跨 backbone 稳定增益，并可跨模型强度迁移。

papers.title: DRSR: Learning Set-Level Deletion Risk for Efficient Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate reasoning traces, tool exchanges, and observations whose relevance changes with the current decision. Existing compression strategies often score historical units independently, but the safety of deleting several units is generally not determined by their singleton scores: redundant evidence, accumulated small effects, and the information that remains after deletion all matter. We introduce Direct Relational Set-Risk Pruning (DRSR), which formulates agent-history compression as risk-constrained selection over deletion sets. Offline, DRSR constructs exact counterfactual supervision by jointly deleting protocol-valid history Blocks and measuring the change in teacher-forced likelihood of the same recorded next output. A lightweight scorer then predicts set-level harm from online-visible relations between candidate history and the current pre-action state, together with deleted-retained and pairwise set structure. At deployment, DRSR evaluates a small set of structurally valid deletion candidates with the lightweight scorer and removes the largest feasible set under recency, protocol, budget, and learned-risk constraints, abstaining when no set is sufficiently safe. On WorkBuddyBench Full260, DRSR increases mean reward from 0.699 to 0.802 while reducing total model tokens by 20.820%. On the fixed Eval40 comparison, it obtains 0.794 reward at 1.211M tokens per task, using 35.850% fewer tokens than the uncompressed agent. Mechanistic analyses and ablations further show that decision-conditioned relations, retained-context information, pair interactions, and abstention each contribute to reliable pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRSR 把长程 agent 历史压缩建模为删除集合上的风险约束选择：离线用联合删除历史 Block 后同一记录输出的 teacher-forced likelihood 变化构造精确反事实监督，训练轻量打分器预测集合级危害，部署时在 recency、protocol、预算与学习风险约束下删除最大可行集，无足够安全集合则弃权。在 WorkBuddyBench Full260 上平均 reward 从 0.699 升到 0.802，同时总 token 减少 20.820%；固定 Eval40 上以每任务 1.211M token 取得 0.794 reward，比未压缩 agent 少用 35.850% token。
Motivation: 现有 agent 历史压缩多按单条历史单元独立打分，但删除多个单元的安全性不由单条分数决定：冗余证据、累积小效应与删除后残留信息都会改变结果，独立打分容易误删。
Method: DRSR (Direct Relational Set-Risk Pruning) 离线按协议合法的 Block 联合删除，测量同一记录 next output 的 teacher-forced likelihood 变化作为精确反事实监督；轻量打分器从候选历史与当前 pre-action 状态的在线可见关系、deleted-retained 关系与 pairwise 集合结构预测集合级危害；部署时对少量结构合法删除候选打分，在 recency、protocol、budget 与 learned-risk 约束下删除最大可行集，必要时弃权。
Result: WorkBuddyBench Full260 上平均 reward 0.699 → 0.802，总 model token 减少 20.820%；固定 Eval40 上每任务 1.211M token 取得 0.794 reward，比未压缩 agent 少 35.850% token。消融显示 decision-conditioned relations、retained-context information、pair interactions 与 abstention 各自对可靠剪枝有贡献。
Conclusion: 把历史压缩当作带约束的集合级风险选择而非逐条打分，可以在降低 token 成本的同时提高 agent 平均 reward；当没有集合足够安全时弃权是可靠剪枝的必要组成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High Dynamic Range Video Reconstruction from Single-Exposure Raw Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Due to the limited dynamic range of conventional image sensors, captured low dynamic range (LDR) video often suffers from highlight clipping and shadow detail loss, making high-quality high dynamic range (HDR) reconstruction from single-exposure sequences highly challenging without alternating exposures or extra hardware. Alternating-exposure HDR methods sacrifice frame rate and struggle with motion alignment, making them impractical for real-world capture. To address this, we propose RawHDRV, an end-to-end framework for single-exposure Raw video HDR reconstruction, that fundamentally exploits the linear response and channel-specific characteristics of Bayer data. Specifically, it features a channel-decomposition temporal alignment and fusion strategy that processes Bayer channels separately to exploit their distinct exposure characteristics, together with exposure-aware weighted fusion. It further incorporates an exposure complementarity mask-guided restoration module that leverages inter-frame exposure redundancy to adaptively fuse reliable information and suppress saturation artifacts, and introduces a mask-guided color loss that combines normalized error constraints with gradient smoothing to enhance highlight recovery. Furthermore, we construct a large-scale mobile Raw-HDR video dataset with per-frame HDR annotations. Experiments show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art results in all metrics, demonstrating superior spatial quality and temporal stability under extreme exposure conditions. The code is available at https://github.com/supeixian/RawHDRV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RawHDRV 是单曝光 Raw 视频 HDR 重建的端到端框架：按 Bayer 通道分别做时序对齐与曝光感知加权融合，再用曝光互补掩码引导的恢复模块抑制饱和伪影，并以掩码引导色度损失（归一化误差约束加梯度平滑）增强高光恢复。作者另建了带逐帧 HDR 标注的大规模手机 Raw-HDR 视频数据集，实验在全部指标上达到 SOTA，极端曝光条件下空间质量与时间稳定性更优。
Motivation: 常规传感器动态范围有限，LDR 视频高光截断、暗部细节丢失；交替曝光 HDR 方法牺牲帧率且在运动下难以对齐，不适用于真实拍摄。
Method: RawHDRV 直接利用 Bayer 数据的线性响应与通道特性：通道分解的时序对齐与融合策略分通道处理以利用各自曝光特性，配合曝光感知加权融合；曝光互补掩码引导的恢复模块利用帧间曝光冗余自适应融合可靠信息并抑制饱和伪影；掩码引导色度损失把归一化误差约束与梯度平滑结合以增强高光恢复。
Result: 构建了带逐帧 HDR 标注的大规模移动 Raw-HDR 视频数据集；实验在全部指标上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，极端曝光条件下空间质量与时间稳定性更优。
Conclusion: 单曝光 Raw 序列足以重建高质量 HDR 视频，前提是按通道利用 Bayer 曝光特性并用帧间曝光冗余补回高光，无需交替曝光或额外硬件。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CAVEAT: Towards Robust Computer-Use Agents in Incentive-Misaligned Environments
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act on behalf of users online. What happens when the environments they operate in have incentives that do not align with the user's? In online marketplaces, for example, platforms may favor some products over others, potentially steering agents away from the user's objective. Existing CUA benchmarks cover cooperative settings or explicit attacks, but do not test whether agents preserve user objectives when the environment itself has a stake in the outcome. We introduce CAVEAT, a controlled benchmark spanning nine marketplace environments and a taxonomy of eight common steering mechanisms. Across five model families, agents purchase the user-optimal product in 78.6% of matched-control episodes but only 17.3% when steering mechanisms are enabled. Larger models and increased reasoning improve robustness, but substantial failures persist. Our trajectory analysis and targeted ablations identify three points where steering enters the decision process: (1) agents distort the user's priorities, (2) prematurely narrow the set of alternatives they consider, and (3) commit before resolving decision-relevant evidence. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CAVEAT-Harness, which directly targets these failure modes and raises user-optimal purchasing by 55.0%. Targeted post-training further improves a smaller open model. These results establish incentive robustness as a distinct challenge for delegated agents, diagnose how it fails, and show that targeted interventions can substantially improve it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAVEAT 是一个受控基准，覆盖 9 个线上市场环境与 8 类诱导机制 (steering mechanisms)，测试 computer-use agent 在环境激励与用户目标不一致时是否仍买对商品。五个模型族在对照组 78.6% 买到用户最优商品，开启诱导后骤降到 17.3%；针对诊断出的三个失效点做的 CAVEAT-Harness 把最优购买率提升 55.0%。
Motivation: 现有 CUA 基准只测协作场景或显式攻击，没有测试当环境本身对结果有利益、会暗中引导 agent 偏离用户目标时，agent 是否还能守住用户目标。
Method: 构建受控基准 CAVEAT：9 个 marketplace 环境 × 8 类 steering 机制分类法，跨 5 个模型族评测；用轨迹分析与定向 ablation 定位诱导进入决策的三个环节，再据此提出 CAVEAT-Harness，并对一个较小开源模型做定向 post-training。
Result: 对照条件下 agent 购买用户最优商品的 episode 占比 78.6%，开启诱导机制后仅 17.3%；模型更大、推理更多可提升鲁棒性但仍有大量失败。CAVEAT-Harness 使用户最优购买率提升 55.0%，定向 post-training 进一步改善一个较小的开源模型。
Conclusion: 激励鲁棒性 (incentive robustness) 是委派型 agent 的一类独立挑战，其失效可定位到扭曲用户偏好、过早收窄候选、未解决关键证据就下单这三个环节，且针对性干预能大幅改善。

papers.title: GaussPDE: Graph-Based Partial Differential Equation-Driven Rendering for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present GaussPDE, a framework that injects physically structured partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics into pretrained 3D Gaussian scenes without mesh extraction, voxelization, or retraining. Our key observation is that PDE rendering requires not only accurate appearance, but also a reliable discrete computational domain. We therefore first introduce camera-aware regularization during 3DGS reconstruction to suppress camera-near floaters and oversized primitives that would create unstable graph topology. We then construct an active Gaussian graph using covariance-aware distances and opacity, appearance, and boundary-aware conductance, enabling mass-weighted graph Laplacian PDE evolution directly over Gaussian primitives. The evolving scalar PDE state is coupled back to rendering by modifying the direct-current spherical harmonic color coefficients while preserving geometry, opacity, and view-dependent rendering behavior. Experiments on real and synthetic scenes show that GaussPDE produces stable, controllable, and spatially coherent dynamic visualizations, with reduced cross-boundary leakage compared with baselines.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 把 PDE 演化直接架在 Gaussian primitive 构成的图上、并以渲染状态而非几何承载动力学，可在不重训练的前提下给静态 3DGS 场景加上可控动态效果。

papers.title: Functional Causal Discovery via Conditional Covariance Ordering
papers.abstract_en: We study causal discovery where each node is a random function. Previous studies on this topic rely on structural assumptions, e.g., linearity or non-linearity, and distributional assumptions, e.g., Gaussianity or non-Gaussianity. In contrast, we make use of covariance operators to avoid these assumptions. Under functional additive noise models, we propose a new sufficient condition to identify a valid topological ordering based on comparing norms of conditional covariance operators. Taking advantage of this identifiability condition, we develop a new mixed regression model that subsumes linear and non-linear models. Together with variable selection, our procedure yields an estimation of the causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) for functional variables. In theory, we develop the least-squares-type theory of this regression model, and derive asymptotic consistency of order determination, sparse regression, as well as identifying the DAG. Computational algorithms based on discrete observations are provided. Applied to simulated data, our approach performs satisfactorily among existing approaches. A real data example of brain effective connectivity is also presented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在函数型加性噪声模型 (functional additive noise model) 下，用条件协方差算子范数比较给出可识别拓扑序的充分条件，从而避开线性/非线性与高斯/非高斯结构假设；配套提出同时涵盖线性与非线性的混合回归模型加变量选择来估计函数型变量的因果 DAG。模拟数据上表现满意，并给出脑有效连接实例。
Motivation: 函数型节点的因果发现此前依赖线性或非线性、高斯或非高斯等结构与分布假设，限制了方法适用范围。
Method: 以协方差算子替代分布假设，在函数加性噪声模型下提出基于比较条件协方差算子范数的可识别充分条件；据此构建涵盖线性与非线性的混合回归模型，配合变量选择估计因果 DAG，并给出基于离散观测的计算算法与最小二乘型理论。
Result: 推导出序确定、稀疏回归与 DAG 识别的渐近一致性；在模拟数据上相对既有方法表现满意，并给出脑有效连接的真实数据示例。
Conclusion: 条件协方差算子范数排序足以在不加线性/高斯假设的情况下识别函数型因果 DAG，且配套回归具有渐近一致性。

papers.title: What Converges in the Platonic Representation Hypothesis? Structure over Geometry
papers.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that increasingly capable models converge toward shared representations. Recent work narrows this claim to shared local neighborhood relationships, finding that capacity-dependent trends in several global similarity measures largely disappear after calibration. We challenge this interpretation by showing that prior local-global comparisons confound structural scale (local versus global) with what is compared: relational structure, defined by which samples are related, versus metric geometry, characterized by quantitative relations such as distances, similarities, or correlations. To disentangle these factors, we construct a controlled $2\times2$ framework that evaluates both relational structure and metric geometry at local and global scales. We introduce $H_0$ skeleton overlap as a global counterpart to mutual $k$-nearest neighbors, together with matched distance-aware variants. Across vision-language models, relational structure exhibits robust representational convergence at both scales after calibration, whereas increasingly stringent distance agreement substantially weakens alignment and progressively flattens the capacity-dependent trend. We further extend the analysis beyond ambient Euclidean geometry by evaluating distance agreement under a Riemannian metric approximation and recover the same structure-geometry pattern. The pattern is also reproduced in video-text representations. Together, these results show that relational convergence extends beyond local neighborhoods to global spanning structure, whereas metric geometry exhibits substantially weaker convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用受控 2×2 框架把「局部/全局尺度」与「关系结构 vs 度量几何」两个混淆因素拆开，检验 Platonic Representation Hypothesis 到底收敛了什么。校准后关系结构在局部与全局尺度都表现出稳健的表征收敛（含 H0 skeleton overlap 这一全局指标），而距离一致性要求越严，对齐越弱、容量依赖趋势越被压平；该模式在视觉-语言模型、Riemannian 度量近似与视频-文本表征中一致复现。
Motivation: 近期工作把 PRH 收窄为仅共享局部邻域关系，称全局相似度的容量趋势在校准后消失；作者认为这类局部-全局比较把尺度与比较对象（关系结构 vs 度量几何）混在一起，导致结论被误导。
Method: 构建受控 2×2 框架，在局部与全局尺度上分别评估关系结构与度量几何；提出 H0 skeleton overlap 作为 mutual k-nearest neighbors 的全局对应物，并配对引入距离感知变体；在视觉-语言模型上校准后比较，并扩展到 Riemannian 度量近似下的距离一致性分析。
Result: 校准后关系结构在局部与全局尺度均显示稳健收敛；距离一致性要求越严格，对齐越弱且容量依赖趋势被逐步压平；用 Riemannian 度量近似评估距离一致性仍复现同一 structure-geometry 模式，该模式也在视频-文本表征中复现。
Conclusion: PRH 的收敛主要发生在关系结构上，且延伸到全局张成结构，而非度量几何；度量几何的收敛显著更弱，仅靠局部/全局尺度不足以解释既有分歧。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Risk-Sensitive Schrödinger Bridge: Is Not a KL Projection
papers.abstract_en: The Schrödinger bridge owes its computational power to a single structural fact: by Girsanov's theorem the controlled problem is a Kullback--Leibler (KL) projection onto a fixed reference measure, solvable by alternating projections. This letter shows that the fact does not survive risk sensitivity. When the expected path cost is replaced by the entropic risk measure and both endpoint marginals are kept as hard constraints, the resulting fixed-point bridge value $J_θ$ (the soft-problem value at the multiplier that enforces the terminal constraint) admits no representation as a constrained KL minimum against any fixed path-space reference with a regular endpoint law (a class strictly larger than the uniformly elliptic diffusion references: no Markov property is required), even allowing an additive normalisation depending on the initial marginal. Moreover, no single reference generates the one-parameter family in the risk parameter. The obstruction is computed in closed form: the Gaussian bridge value violates, by exactly $θ/2$, a heat equation that any Gaussian smoothing of a fixed endpoint density must obey. In place of the projection, the theory rests on a terminal-multiplier fixed point and an asymmetric factorisation penalising the score energy of the backward factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明风险敏感 Schrödinger bridge 不再是 KL 投影：把期望路径代价换成熵风险测度 (entropic risk measure) 并保留两端边缘分布为硬约束后，固定点桥值 J_θ 无法表示为对任意固定路径空间参考测度的受约束 KL 极小，且风险参数 θ 的单参数族无法由单一参考生成。闭式障碍为高斯桥值恰好违反 θ/2 的热方程。
Motivation: Schrödinger bridge 的可解性依赖 Girsanov 意义下的 KL 投影结构与交替投影算法，但风险敏感化后该结构是否成立此前未被厘清。
Method: 在熵风险测度替换期望代价、两端边缘为硬约束的设定下，证明 J_θ（强制终端约束的乘子处软问题值）不存在针对任意固定路径参考（仅需正则端点律，无需一致椭圆扩散或 Markov 性）的受约束 KL 表示，即使允许依赖初始边缘的加性归一化；并给出闭式高斯反例与替代框架：终端乘子固定点加惩罚 backward factor score 能量的非对称分解。
Result: 高斯桥值恰好违反 θ/2 的热方程，而任何固定端点密度的高斯平滑都必须满足该方程；风险参数单参数族不存在单一参考测度；障碍类严格大于一致椭圆扩散参考。
Conclusion: 风险敏感化破坏 KL 投影结构，理论须改由终端乘子固定点与非对称因子分解支撑，而非交替投影。
Relevance: 1
