papers.title: Repurposing Pre-trained LLMs as High Fidelity Continuous Text Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Next-token prediction has enabled highly fluent autoregressive language models, but it represents global structure only indirectly through sequential factorization. In contrast, high-fidelity autoencoders have become a standard primitive in image generation, enabling generative models to operate over continuous latent spaces; text lacks a comparably faithful continuous representation. We propose LLMAE, a method for repurposing a pretrained decoder-only language model as a continuous text autoencoder by exposing an intermediate fixed-length latent bottleneck within its internal activations. Instantiated with a parameter-efficient 270M Gemma 3 model, LLMAE uses structured attention masks, LoRA adaptation, and KL regularization to learn an autoencoding interface that leverages the generative prior of the original LLM. We train LLMAE to reconstruct text sequences up to 1024 tokens, significantly improving on this task to achieve near-perfect reconstruction. Furthermore, we demonstrate the downstream utility of this representation by training a latent text diffusion model for detailed image captioning using the learned LLMAE autoencoder. By mapping text into a fixed-length continuous latent space, our approach provides an effective substrate for downstream adaptation while benefiting from the fluency of the original LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLMAE 把预训练 decoder-only LLM 改造成连续文本自编码器：在中间激活上开固定长度 latent bottleneck，用结构化 attention mask、LoRA 与 KL 正则学出自编码接口。在 270M Gemma 3 上把最长 1024 token 的文本重建提升到接近完美，并用学到的 latent 训练文本扩散模型做细粒度图像描述。
Motivation: next-token prediction 只通过序列分解间接表达全局结构，图像生成已有高保真自编码器这一标准部件，文本却缺少同样忠实的连续表示，导致无法在连续 latent 空间上直接做生成建模。
Method: 在预训练 decoder-only LLM 的内部激活中暴露固定长度 latent bottleneck，配合结构化 attention mask、LoRA 参数高效适配与 KL 正则，训练自编码接口以复用原 LLM 的生成先验；实例为 270M Gemma 3。
Result: 在最长 1024 token 的文本序列重建任务上训练并显著改进，达到接近完美的重建；在此 latent 表示上训练的文本扩散模型被用于细粒度图像描述 (detailed image captioning)。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 中间激活变成固定长度连续 latent，可以同时保住原模型的语言流畅度并为下游适配提供有效底座，图像描述是其验证场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Listening and Mirroring: The Effects of Verbal Attunement and Behavioral Mimicry on Social and Empathic Perceptions of Embodied AI Agents in VR
papers.abstract_en: As embodied agents take on increasingly social and relational roles in VR, visual realism and embodiment alone may be insufficient; users must also perceive these agents as emotionally attuned, supportive, and humanlike. Prior work suggests that verbal attunement and nonverbal mimicry can each improve users' social evaluations of embodied agents. However, behavioral mimicry has largely been studied outside of real-time, conversational AI interactions, leaving limited understanding of how users respond when an agent simultaneously generates contextually responsive dialogue and adapts its nonverbal behavior during an immersive conversation. To address this gap, we developed an embodied AI counselor that combines conversational AI with real-time facial-expression and posture mimicry, while producing either verbally attuned or neutral responses. We evaluated the system in a 2 X 2 within-subjects study with 20 participants, manipulating verbal attunement and behavioral mimicry. Results showed that verbal attunement was the most reliable driver of perceived empathy. Behavioral mimicry showed a marginal relationship with perceived humanness, while greater mimicry exposure showed preliminary, exploratory positive associations with empathy, positivity, and humanness, particularly among female participants. Together, these findings show that multimodal synchrony is not a simple additive strategy for designing empathic conversational agents in VR and underscore the need to consider how verbal and nonverbal behaviors are combined during real-time interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 VR 中构建具身 AI 咨询师，同时操纵言语调谐 (verbal attunement) 与实时表情/姿态模仿 (behavioral mimicry)，2×2 被试内实验显示言语调谐是感知共情最稳定的驱动因素，而模仿对感知人性只有边缘关系，多模态同步并非简单叠加策略。
Motivation: 既有研究分别证明言语调谐和非言语模仿能改善对具身智能体的社会评价，但模仿多在非实时对话场景下研究，智能体同时生成情境化对话并实时调整非言语行为时用户如何反应尚不清楚。
Method: 开发具身 AI 咨询师，将对话 AI 与实时面部表情和姿态模仿结合，并输出调谐或中性两种言语回应；采用 2×2 被试内设计，操纵言语调谐与行为模仿两个因素，共 20 名参与者。
Result: 言语调谐是感知共情 (perceived empathy) 最稳定的驱动因素；行为模仿与感知人性 (perceived humanness) 呈边缘关系；更大模仿暴露与共情、正向情绪、人性呈初步探索性正相关，在女性参与者中尤其明显。
Conclusion: 多模态同步不是设计 VR 共情对话智能体的简单相加策略，设计时必须考虑言语与非言语行为在实时交互中如何组合。

papers.title: Full-Covariance Smoothing of Bayesian Neural Networks for Online Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: A neural network's layers can be treated as time steps of a state-space model, turning Bayesian training into a smoothing problem: a forward pass propagates Gaussian moments through the network, and a backward Rauch--Tung--Striebel pass updates the weight posteriors in closed form. Such methods learn from each observation in a single pass, in an uncertainty-aware manner, and without gradient-based iterations or replay, which makes them well suited for online adaptation and data-efficient learning. Existing smoothing-based methods, however, are restricted to diagonal covariances across activations, discarding correlations between neurons. We overcome this limitation via a cross-covariance identity that enables full-covariance propagation through a network's nonlinear activations. We derive a one-step-per-layer smoother that approximates as Gaussian only each layer's affine output, and that applies both to deterministic systems with noisy observations and to stochastic systems described by output statistics. We demonstrate this method in non-stationary classification, online dynamics learning, and policy adaptation of a vision-language-action model, and find that it is generally more accurate than other smoothing-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把网络各层视作状态空间模型的时间步，用跨协方差恒等式 (cross-covariance identity) 实现全协方差传播，得到逐层只对仿射输出做高斯近似的一步平滑器，权重后验由 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 反向 pass 闭式更新。在非平稳分类、在线动力学学习与视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略适应上，该方法总体比其他基于平滑的方法更准确。
Motivation: 现有基于平滑的贝叶斯神经网络训练只支持激活上的对角协方差，丢弃神经元间相关性，限制了单次前向/反向传播的在线适应精度。
Method: 将网络层视作状态空间模型时间步：前向 pass 传播高斯矩，反向 Rauch–Tung–Striebel pass 闭式更新权重后验；用跨协方差恒等式实现非线性激活处的全协方差传播，每层仅对仿射输出做高斯近似，同时适用于含噪观测的确定性系统与由输出统计描述的随机系统；无需基于梯度的迭代或经验回放。
Result: 在非平稳分类、在线动力学学习以及视觉-语言-动作模型的策略适应三类任务上演示，结果表明该方法一般比其他基于平滑的方法更准确。
Conclusion: 全协方差平滑可在单次逐观测 pass 中做不确定性感知的在线适应，比对角协方差平滑方法精度更高，且适用于确定性与随机两类系统。

papers.title: Combining LLMs and Genetic Search for ARC-AGI-2
papers.abstract_en: LLMs can generate programs for ARC-AGI-2 tasks, but the provided compute only allows a small number of attempts to generate, debug and validate solutions. Genetic algorithms can search and test many more programs, but random search rarely starts in a useful neighborhood of the solution space. We combine the two methods through a compact domain specific language (DSL). First, a quantized Qwen3.5-4B LLM generates an initial set of programs for each ARCAGI-2 task. Then, we use those programs to seed an initial population of starting programs, and use genetic algorithms to evolve these programs towards a solution to the given task. The DSL is designed such that every mutated program remains valid and can be executed. The initial programs proposed by the LLM solve 2 (3.3%) of the first 60 tasks of the ARC-2 public evaluation set. The genetic algorithm solves an additional 4, giving 6 correct test outputs in total (10.0%). If we try using evolving solutions without this LLM seeding, we do not arrive at any solutions at all. The results show that genetic search can improve programs generated by LLMs and produce additional correct solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把量化 Qwen3.5-4B 生成的程序作为遗传算法初始种群，经一个保证变异后仍可执行的紧凑 DSL 演化，求解 ARC-AGI-2 任务。LLM 播种单独解出前 60 题中的 2 题（3.3%），遗传搜索再增 4 题，合计 6 题（10.0%）；去掉 LLM 播种的纯演化一个也解不出。
Motivation: ARC-AGI-2 上可用算力只允许少量生成、调试与验证尝试，LLM 难以穷举；遗传算法能试更多程序，但随机搜索几乎从不落在解的邻域内。
Method: 用一个紧凑的领域专用语言 (DSL) 串联两法：量化 Qwen3.5-4B 先为每个任务生成初始程序集，作为遗传算法的初始种群种子再演化；DSL 经设计保证任何变异后的程序都合法且可执行。
Result: 在 ARC-2 公开评测集前 60 题上，LLM 初始程序解出 2 题（3.3%），遗传算法额外解出 4 题，共 6 个正确测试输出（10.0%）；不带 LLM 播种的演化过程一个解也得不到。
Conclusion: 遗传搜索能在 LLM 生成程序的基础上继续改进并产出额外正确解，而 LLM 播种是该演化过程能启动的前提。

papers.title: On the Sample Complexity of Active Learning with Membership Queries
papers.abstract_en: This work revisits a fundamental question in active learning: how powerful is the ability to synthesize arbitrary queries? Compared to pool-based active learning, where the learner only selects queries from a given unlabeled pool, we find that this seemingly mild change in query ability may dramatically alter the difficulty of statistical learning. In particular, some hypothesis classes that are inherently slow to learn in the pool-based setting, achieving only polynomial error decay in the number of samples, become exponentially learnable once synthesized queries are allowed. This striking gap suggests that membership query synthesis induces a fundamentally different mode of learning, one that is not adequately captured by existing active learning theory and calls for new analytical tools to characterize its complexity. Motivated by this phenomenon, we develop several sufficient conditions, present intriguing examples, and propose a conjectural perspective toward understanding which hypothesis classes admit efficient learning through synthesized queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对比 pool-based 主动学习与可合成任意查询的 membership query 主动学习，发现查询能力这一看似温和的改变会根本性改变统计学习难度：某些在 pool-based 下只能取得样本数多项式误差衰减的假设类，一旦允许合成查询就变成指数可学习。作者据此提出若干充分条件、构造示例，并给出一个猜想性视角，刻画哪些假设类能通过合成查询被高效学习。
Motivation: 现有主动学习理论无法刻画 membership query 合成所诱导的这种本质上不同的学习模式，需要新的分析工具来刻画其复杂度。
Method: 以 pool-based 与 membership query 两种查询模型的对比为出发点，推导若干保证合成查询下高效学习的充分条件，辅以示例，并提出一个猜想性框架来判定哪些假设类可经合成查询高效学习。
Result: 核心发现是复杂度上的分离：某些假设类在 pool-based 设定下误差仅随样本数多项式衰减，允许合成查询后变为指数可学习。
Conclusion: 合成任意查询的能力会把主动学习推入与现有理论不符的新模式，其复杂度需由新的充分条件与猜想性刻画来判定。

papers.title: Strip Convolution and Direction-Aware Exclusion Loss for Oriented Ship Detection
papers.abstract_en: Oriented ship detection in very high resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery remains challenging due to elongated hull geometry and dense target distributions in complex port scenes. Existing methods typically address geometric representation and duplicate suppression separately. To jointly tackle these issues, we propose an oriented ship detector with two complementary components. The C3k2_Strip module employs orthogonal strip convolutions to better capture elongated hull structures, while the Class-Aware Direction-Aware Exclusion Loss (CA-DAEL) suppresses redundant predictions using class, direction, and confidence cues. Experiments on HRSC2016 and DIOR-R achieve 78.45% and 53.71% mAP50:95, respectively, with only 2.91M parameters. On HRSC2016, the proposed method improves mAP50:95 by 6.32 percentage points over the YOLOv11-OBB baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness for accurate oriented ship detection.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Discover, Falsify, Revise: Auditing Input-Use Claims from Source Code to Predictive Contribution in Agent-Discovered Cell Models
papers.abstract_en: AI virtual cells aim to predict cellular responses to specified interventions, yet held-out predictive performance alone does not establish use of the supplied perturbation information. This prediction-claim gap matters in agentic model discovery, where language-model agents generate and revise predictors using score-based feedback. We introduce CELLAUDIT, which audits input-use claims by asking whether an input can enter the cited computation, whether fitted predictions depend on it, and whether that dependence improves prediction of observed response. On a paired morphology-transcriptomics perturbation benchmark (BBBC047), an agent-selected predictor attains a mean held-out Global Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.3153 but remains invariant to compound replacement; a control-profile-only predictor reaches 0.3142. Source inspection identifies a compound-query pathway blocked by singleton key-value attention, and the invariance persists after refitting with disjoint control wells. In a stratified audit of 48 candidates across two linked tasks, 47 change predictions under compound replacement on both held-out folds, but only 20 show target-loss gains with intervals above zero on both folds. On BBBC047, falsification-guided revisions recover positive mean compound contributions while retaining gains over the control-profile-only baseline. In matched sci-Plex searches, audit-enriched feedback yields higher held-out performance and larger mean compound and dose contributions across five trajectories, although paired intervals span zero. Refitting fixed designs on an independently acquired cohort shows predictive generalization need not imply generalization of input-use claims: dose contribution persists, whereas support for compound identity does not. CELLAUDIT adds a falsification layer to agentic model discovery, moving from generate-score-revise toward discover-falsify-revise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CELLAUDIT 给 agentic 细胞模型发现加一层可证伪审计，依次追问输入能否进入被引用的计算路径、拟合预测是否依赖该输入、这种依赖是否真的改善对观测响应的预测。在 BBBC047 上，agent 选出的预测器 held-out Global PCC 达 0.3153 却对化合物替换完全不变（仅用 control profile 的基线为 0.3142）；48 个候选中 47 个在两个 fold 上都随化合物替换改变预测，但只有 20 个在两个 fold 上 target-loss 增益区间高于零。
Motivation: held-out 预测性能好并不等于模型真的用了所提供的扰动信息；在用分数反馈生成与改写预测器的 agent 流程里，这个 prediction-claim gap 会让看似有效的模型掩盖输入被旁路的事实。
Method: CELLAUDIT 的三层审计：源码级检查输入能否进入被引用的计算（如 singleton key-value attention 阻断 compound-query 路径）、拟合后做化合物替换不变性检验、再用 target-loss 增益及其区间判断依赖是否改善对观测响应的预测；在 BBBC047 形态-转录组配对扰动基准与匹配的 sci-Plex 搜索（五条轨迹）上做分层审计，并在独立获取的队列上重拟合固定设计。
Result: BBBC047 上 agent 选出的预测器 held-out Global PCC 0.3153，对化合物替换不变，control-profile-only 基线 0.3142；换用不相交 control wells 重拟合后不变性依旧。48 个候选中 47 个在两个 held-out fold 上都随化合物替换改变预测，仅 20 个在两个 fold 上 target-loss 增益区间高于零。证伪引导的修订在 BBBC047 恢复正的平均化合物贡献并保持对 control-profile-only 基线的增益；sci-Plex 中 audit-enriched 反馈在五条轨迹上给出更高的 held-out 性能与更大的平均化合物和剂量贡献，但配对区间跨零。独立队列重拟合显示剂量贡献仍在，化合物身份的支持不再成立。
Conclusion: 预测泛化不蕴含 input-use 主张的泛化：CELLAUDIT 把 agentic 模型发现从 generate-score-revise 推进到 discover-falsify-revise，用可证伪层筛掉那些分数好看但绕过输入的预测器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Scaling Study for fMRI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws have guided large-model development in computer vision and natural language processing, but the relationships among data, model size, and compute remain unclear for functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) foundation models. Here, we conduct a controlled empirical study using pretraining data from more than 200 source datasets and over 10,000 GPU-hours of experiments. Holding the pretraining framework and downstream protocol fixed, we vary pretraining data size, model size, and training duration. Downstream performance generally improves with compute, yet models using similar compute can perform substantially differently. Additional pretraining data bring larger gains at larger model sizes, suggesting that data and model size should be scaled together. At matched compute, increasing pretraining data benefits more tasks than increasing model size, although the pattern varies across tasks. We then use in-distribution (ID) downstream performance to select the combination of pretraining data size, model size, and training duration at two fixed compute budgets. The resulting models are locked before out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation. They achieve the highest average performance across the evaluated OOD tasks among the compared fMRI foundation models while using less pretraining compute. Overall, our results show that compute alone does not characterize fMRI scaling: performance depends on how pretraining data, model size, and training duration are combined.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定预训练框架与下游协议下系统扫描 fMRI 基础模型的数据量、模型规模与训练时长，发现同等算力下不同组合性能差异显著，且数据增益随模型变大而放大。按 ID 下游表现在两个固定算力预算下选型后锁定模型再做 OOD 评测，所得模型以更少预训练算力取得所比较 fMRI 基础模型中最高的 OOD 平均性能。
Motivation: CV 与 NLP 已有成熟 scaling law，但 fMRI 基础模型中数据、模型规模与算力三者的关系不清，无法指导算力预算下的配置选择。
Method: 受控实证研究：预训练数据来自 200 多个 source datasets，累计超过 10,000 GPU-hours；固定预训练框架与下游协议，分别改变预训练数据量、模型规模与训练时长，再用 in-distribution (ID) 下游表现在两个固定算力预算下选定组合并锁定模型，随后做 out-of-distribution (OOD) 评测。
Result: 下游性能总体随算力提升，但相近算力的模型性能可相差很大；同等算力下增加预训练数据比扩大模型规模惠及更多任务（因任务而异），且数据增益在更大模型上更明显；锁定后的模型在所评测 OOD 任务上取得所比较 fMRI 基础模型中的最高平均性能，同时预训练算力更少。
Conclusion: 算力本身不足以刻画 fMRI 的 scaling：性能取决于预训练数据、模型规模与时长的组合方式，数据与模型规模应同步放大，选型应以 ID 表现在固定算力预算下进行。

papers.title: Surgical Kinematics from Monocular Video with Learned Articulated Motion Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Objective assessment of robotic surgery uses instrument kinematics, which must be reconstructed when only video is available. We introduce a kinematic reconstruction network for estimating instrument position, orientation and jaw angle from monocular video. Our visual representation combines global attention pooling of frozen DINOv3 features with local pooling at instrument landmarks from fine-tuned SAM 3.1 masks. Our shared Transformer encoder and temporal convolutional heads integrate this representation with mask geometry, monocular depth and visual state estimates from arm-specific multilayer regression networks. Our position branch predicts displacement magnitude and direction separately to preserve traveled distance. We fit trajectories to predicted state observations and motion increments by differentiable weighted least squares, expressing quaternion observations relative to cumulative predicted rotations to obtain a quadratic orientation objective. We evaluate reconstruction across 2,802 Open-H episodes. Compared with LiveMAE on the main Open-H benchmark, our method reduces path-length mean absolute error from 0.45 to 0.34\,cm and increases temporal mean average precision for motion segmentation from 44.54\% to 54.44\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从单目视频重建手术器械运动学 (kinematic reconstruction) 的网络，用 DINOv3 全局注意力池化加 SAM 3.1 关键点局部池化构成视觉表示，再以可微加权最小二乘拟合轨迹。在 2,802 个 Open-H episodes 上，相对 LiveMAE 把路径长度平均绝对误差从 0.45 cm 降到 0.34 cm，运动分割的 temporal mAP 从 44.54% 提到 54.44%。
Motivation: 机器人手术的客观评估依赖器械运动学，但只有视频可用时必须从中重建位置、朝向与钳口开合。
Method: 视觉表示融合冻结 DINOv3 特征的全局注意力池化与微调 SAM 3.1 mask 关键点上的局部池化；共享 Transformer 编码器与时序卷积头再整合 mask 几何、单目深度，以及臂专属多层回归网络给出的视觉状态估计。位置分支分开预测位移大小与方向以保留行程；轨迹对状态观测与运动增量用可微加权最小二乘拟合，四元数观测相对累积预测旋转表达，得到二次型朝向目标。
Result: 在 2,802 个 Open-H episodes 上评测：相对 LiveMAE（主 Open-H 基准），路径长度平均绝对误差 0.45 → 0.34 cm，运动分割 temporal mean average precision 44.54% → 54.44%。
Conclusion: 把冻结基础视觉特征、mask 关键点几何与可微最小二乘轨迹拟合结合起来，可以在仅有单目视频时更准地重建手术器械运动学。

papers.title: Meet, Compare, or Abstain: LatWeave for Deterministic Multi-Hop Question Answering on Knowledge Lattices
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic question-answering systems -- whether large language models (LLMs) themselves, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or trained multi-hop retrievers -- conflate "what is known" and "how to reason" into a single probabilistic computation: hallucination cannot be eradicated, evidence chains cannot be audited, and the system answers even when it does not know. We present LatWeave, which organizes knowledge into a multidimensional knowledge lattice and compiles multi-hop QA into three deterministic operators -- meet (constraint intersection), compare (lattice-order comparison), and abstain (structural abstention); LLMs appear only on the construction side (one-shot extraction) and the query-planning side, while the answer-generation path is zero-LLM, zero-task-training, and auditable end to end -- so that question answering over Web-published knowledge becomes reproducible item by item. Rather than claiming across-the-board SOTA, we characterize the operating envelope of this paradigm on six public benchmarks: when knowledge is complete (MetaQA, 39,093 questions) meet chains are near-lossless over three hops (any-hit 0.9975, on par with fully supervised KBQA); on templated multi-hop home ground (2WikiMultihopQA held-out n=1,258) EM 0.865, well above published structure-augmented RAG reproductions; on open-text deep composition (MuSiQue) and extraction-coverage gaps (HotpotQA) we report degradation honestly and attribute it to causes outside the lattice-algebra layer; and when information is incomplete (IIRC) we achieve structural abstention with abstain accuracy 0.971 and leak rate 0.029. Within the operating envelope, deterministic execution pays no performance penalty, and every step on the answer path can be recomputed -- precisely the source of end-to-end auditability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatWeave 把知识组织成多维 knowledge lattice，将多跳问答编译为 meet、compare、abstain 三个确定性算子，答案路径零 LLM、零任务训练且可逐步复算。在六个公开基准上刻画其适用边界：知识完备时 MetaQA（39,093 题）三跳 meet 链 any-hit 0.9975，接近全监督 KBQA；模板化多跳 2WikiMultihopQA（held-out n=1,258）EM 0.865；信息不完备的 IIRC 上结构化弃答准确率 0.971、泄漏率 0.029。
Motivation: LLM、RAG 与训练式多跳检索器把“知道什么”和“如何推理”混进同一个概率计算，导致幻觉无法根除、证据链不可审计，系统在不知道时仍然作答。
Method: 构建侧用 one-shot 抽取把 Web 知识编入多维 knowledge lattice，查询侧由 LLM 做规划，随后三个确定性算子执行：meet 做约束求交、compare 做格序比较、abstain 做结构化弃答；答案生成路径零 LLM、零任务训练，逐步可复算。
Result: 六个公开基准：MetaQA 39,093 题上三跳 meet 链 any-hit 0.9975，与全监督 KBQA 相当；2WikiMultihopQA held-out n=1,258 上 EM 0.865，高于已发表的 structure-augmented RAG 复现；MuSiQue（开放文本深组合）与 HotpotQA（抽取覆盖缺口）出现性能退化，作者归因于格代数层之外；IIRC 信息不完备时弃答准确率 0.971、泄漏率 0.029。
Conclusion: 在适用边界内确定性执行不付性能代价且答案路径可逐步重算，这正是端到端可审计性的来源；边界之外（开放文本深组合、抽取覆盖不足）需靠格代数层以外的手段补。

papers.title: Physiologically Informed Digital Auscultation for Pneumonia Detection in Long-term Care Residents
papers.abstract_en: Pneumonia is difficult to diagnose in older long-term care residents; multimorbidity and atypical presentations obscure signs, motivating operationally efficient objective testing. We analyzed multi-channel digital stethoscope recordings from 185 Japanese residents (73 pneumonia, 112 symptomatic without), using radiologist-confirmed chest X-rays and clinician diagnoses as supervisory signals that train convolutional neural networks, multimodal fusion, and channel-based variants with time-domain Grad-CAM interpretability. Models were evaluated with repeated patient-level cross-validation showing models with X-ray supervision outperformed clinician supervision (F1 0.729, accuracy 0.783 vs. F1 0.637, accuracy 0.711). Additionally, a three-channel selection protocol maintained performance (F1 0.736; accuracy 0.803), with two mid-thoracic sites ranking highest and Grad-CAM attention overlapping adventitious sounds. These findings indicate automated multi-channel lung-sound analysis can aid long-term care pneumonia diagnosis, with X-ray supervision being more reliable than clinical, and fewer channels preserving performance while lowering acquisition times.
papers.comment: Manuscript has been submitted to NPJ Digital Medicine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用多通道数字听诊录音训练 CNN 与多模态融合模型，以放射科确认的胸片作为监督信号比临床诊断监督更可靠：F1 0.729/准确率 0.783 对 F1 0.637/准确率 0.711。三通道选择协议进一步把性能维持在 F1 0.736、准确率 0.803，两个中胸部位最重要，可在缩短采集时间的同时保留诊断能力。
Motivation: 长期照护机构的高龄居民多病共存、症状不典型，肺炎体征被掩盖，临床诊断困难，需要操作上高效且客观的检测手段。
Method: 分析 185 名日本长期照护居民（73 例肺炎、112 例有症状但非肺炎）的多通道数字听诊录音，以放射科确认胸片和临床医生诊断作为两种监督信号，训练卷积神经网络、多模态融合及其通道变体，并用时间域 Grad-CAM 做可解释性；评估采用重复的患者级交叉验证。
Result: 胸片监督模型 F1 0.729、准确率 0.783，优于临床监督的 F1 0.637、准确率 0.711；三通道选择协议维持 F1 0.736、准确率 0.803，两个中胸部位排序最高，Grad-CAM 注意力与异常呼吸音 (adventitious sounds) 位置重叠。
Conclusion: 自动多通道肺音分析可辅助长期照护机构的肺炎诊断，胸片监督比临床诊断监督更可靠，减少通道数在降低采集时间的同时保留性能。

papers.title: Tail-Aware Geometry Learning for Conformal Ellipsoids
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies multivariate conformal prediction (CP), a distribution-free uncertainty quantification framework with finite-sample coverage guarantees. The efficiency of multivariate prediction sets hinges critically on the residual geometry encoded by the nonconformity score, while existing minimum-volume methods rely on quantile thresholds that ignore tail residual severity and implicitly bind geometry learning to coverage level. We propose a tail-aware geometry learning framework for conformal ellipsoids that decouples tail sensitivity in geometry learning from the final coverage guarantee. Using a two-split design, we learn the metric matrix via volume minimization under a CVaR constraint on an estimation split, then apply standard conformal calibration on a held-out calibration split. The resulting problem is convex and admits a bounded-reweighting interpretation that prioritizes high-residual samples. Moreover, we theoretically characterize the trade-off between ellipsoidal volume and tail severity. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多元保形预测 (multivariate conformal prediction) 中最小体积方法的分位数阈值忽略尾部残差严重度、并把几何学习与覆盖水平绑死的问题，提出尾部感知的保形椭球几何学习框架：在估计划分上用 CVaR 约束下的体积最小化学习度量矩阵，再在留出的校准划分上做标准保形校准，从而把几何学习的尾部敏感性与最终覆盖保证解耦。该问题为凸问题，可作有界重加权 (bounded-reweighting) 解读，优先处理高残差样本。
Motivation: 多元预测集的效率取决于非一致性分数编码的残差几何，而现有最小体积方法用分位数阈值，既忽略尾部残差严重度，又把几何学习隐式绑定到覆盖水平。
Method: 两分割 (two-split) 设计：在估计划分上施加 CVaR 约束做体积最小化以学习度量矩阵 (metric matrix)，在留出的校准划分上执行标准保形校准；所得优化问题为凸，等价于对高残差样本的有界重加权，并给出椭球体积与尾部严重度之间的权衡刻画。
Result: 实验结果表明所提方法有效；摘要未给出具体数据集、基线或数值指标。
Conclusion: 把尾部敏感性从覆盖保证中解耦，可在保持有限样本覆盖的同时改善保形椭球的体积与尾部严重度权衡。

papers.title: Learning Spectral Allocation: A Fractional Diffusion Framework for Adaptive Volumetric Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: We address adaptive computation in 3D medical image segmentation: instead of designing another backbone, we ask how much spectral mixing each network stage needs and let optimization answer. We derive FHEAT, a two-parameter operator family, from the discrete cosine transform (DCT) solution of a fractional heat equation. A fractional order alpha and a diffusion strength D govern the operator, and at D=0 it is exactly the identity. Reparametrized by the semigroup time tau = D*alpha, same-resolution instances compose exactly, so any distribution of diffusion across same-resolution stages amounts to a single Sobolev-type regularizer of learned strength. This identity limit lets the optimizer of each layer, not the designer, decide whether global mixing is needed and how sharp it should be. We instantiate FHEAT in a lightweight U-shaped architecture (Light-UNETR) paired with a Kolmogorov-Arnold mixer (KAN3D) with adaptive rational activations, yielding FHEAT-Seg. At 5% to 20% label rates on three public benchmarks, training produces gradient-driven spectral sparsification: seven of the eight stage-level operators drive D to zero, and the survivor saturates at the sharpest low-pass (alpha ~ 0.9) in the decoder layer feeding the semi-supervised attention map. The retired layers become exact identity shortcuts at inference, cutting FLOPs from 4.29G to 0.90G (a 79% drop) at 0.975M parameters. Under a standard semi-supervised protocol, FHEAT-Seg reaches Dice scores of 90.47% (left atrium), 78.79% (Pancreas-CT), and 81.90% (BraTS 2019), ahead of five semi-supervised methods and the Light-UNETR baseline. The large variant also surpasses Light-UNETR-L under full supervision (Dice 93.09%, 85.11%, and 87.19%) with 2.851M parameters and 55.75G FLOPs. These results suggest that the allocation of spectral computation is a learnable property of optimization dynamics, not a manual design commitment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FHEAT：由分数阶热方程的 DCT 解导出的双参数（分数阶 alpha、扩散强度 D）算子族，D=0 时精确退化为恒等，按半群时间 tau = D*alpha 重参数化后同分辨率层可精确复合。在 5%–20% 标签率的三个公开分割基准上训练出现梯度驱动的谱稀疏化：八个阶段算子中七个把 D 压到 0，仅存者饱和在 alpha≈0.9 的最锐低通，退役层在推理期成为恒等捷径，FLOPs 从 4.29G 降到 0.90G（降 79%），Dice 达 90.47%/78.79%/81.90%。
Motivation: 3D 医疗图像分割里每个网络阶段需要多少全局谱混合是人工拍定的，半监督低标签率下这种固定分配既浪费算力又未必合适。
Method: 从分数阶热方程的 DCT 解导出 FHEAT 双参数算子族，以 tau = D*alpha 重参数化使同分辨率实例精确复合、等价为一个可学习强度的 Sobolev 型正则；将 FHEAT 装入轻量 U 形架构 Light-UNETR 并配 Kolmogorov-Arnold mixer（KAN3D，自适应有理激活），得到 FHEAT-Seg，按标准半监督协议在三个公开基准、5%–20% 标签率下训练。
Result: 三个公开基准（left atrium、Pancreas-CT、BraTS 2019）5%–20% 标签率下 Dice 分别为 90.47%、78.79%、81.90%，领先五个半监督方法与 Light-UNETR 基线；八个阶段算子中七个 D 被压到 0，幸存者饱和于 alpha≈0.9，推理期 FLOPs 由 4.29G 降至 0.90G（降 79%），参数 0.975M。全监督下大变体以 2.851M 参数、55.75G FLOPs 超过 Light-UNETR-L，Dice 为 93.09%、85.11%、87.19%。
Conclusion: 谱计算的分配是优化动力学的可学习性质，而非人工设计承诺：让每层优化器决定是否需要全局混合，退役层即可化为精确恒等捷径，在半监督与全监督下同时省算力并保持或提升 Dice。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: KATOsuper: Surrogate-accelerated neural topology optimization with sensitivity-consistent Fourier neural operators
papers.abstract_en: Topology optimization (TO) remains computationally intensive due to repeated finite element analysis (FEA) evaluations required at each iteration. While neural network-based surrogates offer potential acceleration, existing approaches often suffer from gradient inconsistency between predicted objectives and sensitivities, leading to optimization instability. This work presents KATOsuper, an objective-agnostic framework that couples neural-reparameterized topology optimization with a Sensitivity-Consistent Fourier Neural Operator (SC-FNO). The framework employs the forward_split architecture, which derives deployed sensitivities via automatic differentiation through the predicted objective field and thereby preserves consistency between the predicted objective and the gradient used for optimization. The case studies include three 2D benchmark problems and three 3D structures considering compliance or stress minimization. A physics-informed multi-channel input encoding with Fourier position embedding enables resolution-invariant learning, supporting zero-shot extrapolation beyond the training resolution, with useful performance at moderate scaling factors and topology-preserving exploration at up to 64x without retraining. The framework extends to 3D through KATO3D, featuring novel KANConv3D blocks with learnable B-spline activations. KATOsuper demonstrates 15--110x deployment-time speedup over MATLAB baselines while maintaining competitive optimality, with the clearest gains observed in complex 3D and stress-optimization cases. The insight that sensitivity direction matters more than magnitude enables robust optimization even with approximate physics evaluation, extensible to other differentiable physics-driven design objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KATOsuper 把神经重参数化拓扑优化与灵敏度一致的 Fourier 神经算子 (SC-FNO) 耦合，用 forward_split 架构对预测目标场做自动微分得到部署灵敏度，使目标预测与优化梯度保持一致。在 3 个 2D 基准与 3 个 3D 结构的柔度/应力最小化案例上，相对 MATLAB 基线获得 15–110 倍部署加速，且在最高 64x 缩放因子下无需重训仍保持拓扑保持的探索。
Motivation: 拓扑优化每步都要重复有限元分析，计算代价高；现有神经代理模型的目标预测与灵敏度梯度不一致，导致优化不稳定。
Method: 框架以 forward_split 架构对预测目标场自动微分导出部署灵敏度，保证目标与梯度一致；用物理信息多通道输入编码加 Fourier 位置嵌入实现分辨率不变学习，并扩展出含 KANConv3D（可学习 B-spline 激活）的 KATO3D。
Result: 在 3 个 2D 基准与 3 个 3D 结构（柔度或应力最小化）上，相对 MATLAB 基线取得 15–110 倍部署时间加速，同时保持有竞争力的最优性，复杂 3D 与应力优化案例收益最明显；中等缩放因子下可零样本外推到训练分辨率之外，最高 64x 缩放无需重训仍保持拓扑探索。
Conclusion: 灵敏度方向比幅值更重要，因此即使物理评估是近似的也能稳健优化；该思路可推广到其他可微物理驱动的设计目标。

papers.title: Scalable Subgraph Sampling via Resistance Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Subgraph sampling reduces the training cost of large-scale graph neural networks, but sampling criteria may overlook the geometric roles of edges. We propose a resistance-curvature-guided sampling framework built on ERC-LG, a curvature approximation method for large-scale graphs. ERC-LG combines Johnson-Lindenstrauss projections with regularized multi-GPU batched conjugate gradient solvers, avoiding explicit Laplacian pseudoinverse computation and full embedding storage. The resulting curvature informs node- and edge-sampling probabilities for constructing GNN training subgraphs. Experiments show numerical agreement with pseudoinverse-based curvature and reduced runtime compared with CG-only computation. ERC-LG-based sampling variants achieve the highest mean accuracy on six of seven real-world datasets in downstream node classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以电阻曲率 (resistance curvature) 引导的子图采样框架，用大规模曲率近似方法 ERC-LG 为节点和边生成采样概率来构建 GNN 训练子图。ERC-LG 用 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 投影加正则化多 GPU 批处理共轭梯度求解器，避开显式 Laplacian 伪逆与全量嵌入存储；在下游节点分类中，基于 ERC-LG 的采样变体在七个真实数据集中的六个上取得最高平均准确率。
Motivation: 大规模图神经网络的子图采样能降低训练成本，但现有采样准则忽略边的几何角色，且曲率计算通常依赖显式伪逆或全量嵌入，难以扩展到大图。
Method: ERC-LG 以 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 投影压缩表示，配合正则化多 GPU 批处理共轭梯度 (batched conjugate gradient) 求解器近似曲率，不计算 Laplacian 伪逆也不存全量嵌入；得到的曲率再转成节点与边的采样概率，用于构造 GNN 训练子图。
Result: 曲率结果与基于伪逆的曲率数值一致，运行时间低于仅用 CG 的计算；ERC-LG 采样变体在七个真实数据集中的六个上取得下游节点分类最高平均准确率。
Conclusion: 把边的几何角色（电阻曲率）纳入采样概率，可以在保持曲率精度的同时降低大规模图上的计算开销，并在多数真实数据集上提升节点分类表现。

papers.title: Benchmarking Active Spot Selection for Cost-Efficient Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression in tissue context, but dense capture grids can be costly and may repeatedly sample morphologically similar regions. Most active learning strategies were developed for categorical labels and independent samples. We conduct a retrospective pool-based benchmark of active learning versus uniform Random sampling for ST, where expression vectors are high-dimensional and continuous and candidates are spatially correlated. Using two fully profiled public ST cohorts, we mask candidate expression vectors and simulate multi-round selection with uncertainty-based Monte Carlo dropout (MC-dropout) and temporal output discrepancy (TOD), and diversity-based CoreSet and TypiClust-inspired selection. We compare 160 completed configurations at 5%, 10%, 30%, and 50% of the fold-wide training spot pool under patient-level cross-validation, with a separate full-label reference. Within each budget, strategies share the selection schedule, morphology-to-expression predictor, and optimization protocol. We assess mean per-gene within-slide Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC), expression-cluster agreement, and Moran's I fidelity. On HER2-positive breast cancer, pooled mean PCC differences from Random across the four active strategies were -0.0176, -0.0117, +0.0056, and +0.0057 at 5%, 10%, 30%, and 50%, respectively. On cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), three strategies were below Random at 5%, and all four were below Random at 10%. On HER2-positive breast cancer, CoreSet and MC-dropout had lower PCC but higher expression-cluster agreement than Random at the two smallest budgets; this pattern did not reproduce on cSCC. Under the reported fixed training horizons, the evaluated active strategies do not consistently improve on Random at small budgets, and rankings depend on the evaluation measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个已全量测序的公共空间转录组 (ST) 队列上做回顾性 pool-based 基准，比较 4 种主动选点策略与均匀 Random：小预算 (5%、10%) 下主动策略的平均逐基因 PCC 差值为负或不占优，且策略排名随评价指标（PCC vs 表达簇一致性）改变。结论是在该固定训练时长设定下，主动选点在小预算时并不稳定优于 Random。
Motivation: ST 致密捕获网格成本高且反复采样形态相似区域；现有主动学习多为分类标签与独立样本设计，而 ST 的表达向量高维连续、候选点空间相关，其收益未经系统检验。
Method: 回顾性 pool-based 基准：用两个全量公共 ST 队列（HER2+ 乳腺癌、皮肤鳞癌 cSCC）遮蔽候选表达向量，模拟多轮选择；比较不确定性类 MC-dropout 与 temporal output discrepancy (TOD)，以及多样性类 CoreSet 与 TypiClust-inspired 策略；在患者级交叉验证下统一选择日程、形态到表达预测器与优化协议，预算取 5%、10%、30%、50%。
Result: 共 160 个完成配置，另有独立全标签参考；评价指标为逐基因 slide 内 Pearson 相关 (PCC)、表达簇一致性、Moran's I 保真度。HER2+ 乳腺癌上 4 种主动策略相对 Random 的合并平均 PCC 差在 5%/10%/30%/50% 预算下分别为 -0.0176、-0.0117、+0.0056、+0.0057；cSCC 上 5% 时 3 种策略低于 Random，10% 时 4 种全部低于 Random。最小两个预算下 CoreSet 与 MC-dropout 在 HER2+ 上 PCC 更低但表达簇一致性更高，该模式在 cSCC 上不复现。
Conclusion: 在所报告的固定训练时长下，被评估的主动选点策略在小预算时并不一致优于 Random，且排名依赖所用评价指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prediction with Expert Advice: Anytime Regret with Many Experts Matches the Fixed-Time Constant
papers.abstract_en: Prediction with expert advice is a fundamental problem in online learning. When the time horizon $T$ is known in advance, the minimax cumulative regret over $n$ experts is asymptotically $\sqrt{\frac{T \ln n}{2}}$. This is achieved by the Multiplicative Weights Update algorithm with a learning rate tuned to $T$, and is known to be tight. If instead the regret bound is required to hold simultaneously at every time $t$, the best known guarantee has been $\sqrt{t \ln n}$---a factor of $\sqrt{2}$ worse---and it has remained unknown whether this factor of $\sqrt{2}$ is necessary. We show that it is not. We give an algorithm, requiring no knowledge of the horizon, whose cumulative regret satisfies $R_t \le \bigl(1 + O(\sqrt{\ln \ln n / \ln n})\bigr)\sqrt{t \ln n / 2}$ simultaneously for every $t \ge 1$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线学习的 prediction with expert advice 中，已知时限 T 时最小最大遗憾为 sqrt(T ln n /2)，而要求对每个时刻 t 同时成立的 anytime 保证此前只能到 sqrt(t ln n)，差 sqrt(2) 倍。作者给出一个无需知道时限的算法，使 R_t ≤ (1+O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n))) sqrt(t ln n /2) 对所有 t≥1 同时成立，说明该 sqrt(2) 因子并非必需。
Motivation: 固定时限的 minimax 遗憾常数 sqrt(ln n /2) 已知紧，但 anytime 版本的最优常数长期未知，最好保证差一个 sqrt(2) 因子，无法判断这是本质差距还是技术产物。
Method: 构造一个不依赖时限 T 的在线算法，其累积遗憾在每个时刻 t 同时受 (1+O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n))) sqrt(t ln n /2) 约束，逼近固定时限的 minimax 常数。
Result: 固定时限 minimax 累积遗憾渐近为 sqrt(T ln n /2)（Multiplicative Weights Update 达到且已知紧）；此前 anytime 最好保证为 sqrt(t ln n)，差 sqrt(2) 倍；本文得到对所有 t≥1 同时成立的 R_t ≤ (1+O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n))) sqrt(t ln n /2)，额外因子随 n 增大趋于 1。
Conclusion: anytime 遗憾与固定时限常数之间的 sqrt(2) 差距不是必需的，未知时限下也能渐近匹配 sqrt(t ln n /2)，残余开销仅为 1+O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n))。

papers.title: Phonemizing User-Generated Text: A Benchmark, Taxonomy, and Compositional Approach
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-speech systems increasingly process user-generated text (UGT) such as ppl and imo, whose pronunciation must be inferred from the canonical rather than surface form. We introduce UGTPhon, the first grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) benchmark for UGT in English, Vietnamese, and Korean, together with an inference-grounded taxonomy for fine-grained diagnosis. Existing G2P models and frontier LLMs exhibit a systematic canonical-to-non-canonical performance gap, reaching up to 66.8 PER points. As a benchmark baseline, we propose a simple compositional G2P approach that incorporates canonical-form evidence through exact-match lookup and staged decoding. Across matched ByT5 and Qwen2.5-0.5B backbones, explicit canonical-form modeling consistently reduces non-canonical G2P errors. The 0.5B variant also performs competitively with much larger few-shot frontier LLMs, highlighting the benefit of explicitly modeling canonical-form inference for UGT phonemization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UGTPhon——首个面向用户生成文本 (UGT) 的英文、越南语、韩语 G2P 基准与推理导向诊断分类法，并给出组合式基线：用精确匹配查找引入规范形式证据、配合分阶段解码。现有 G2P 模型与前沿 LLM 在规范到非规范形式上存在最高达 66.8 PER 点的性能差距；在 ByT5 与 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上显式建模规范形式均一致降低非规范 G2P 错误，0.5B 变体与大得多的少样本前沿 LLM 竞争力相当。
Motivation: TTS 系统越来越多地处理 ppl、imo 这类 UGT，其发音须从规范形式而非表面形式推断；现有 G2P 模型与前沿 LLM 在规范与非规范形式之间存在系统性性能差距，缺少针对该场景的基准与细粒度诊断手段。
Method: 发布 UGTPhon 基准，覆盖英语、越南语、韩语三种语言，并附一套推理导向 (inference-grounded) 的分类法用于细粒度诊断；基线方法为组合式 G2P：通过精确匹配查找 (exact-match lookup) 引入规范形式证据，再配合分阶段解码 (staged decoding)，在 ByT5 与 Qwen2.5-0.5B 两种匹配骨干上实现。
Result: 现有 G2P 模型与前沿 LLM 的规范到非规范性能差距最高达 66.8 PER 点；在匹配的 ByT5 与 Qwen2.5-0.5B 骨干上，显式规范形式建模一致降低非规范 G2P 错误；0.5B 变体与大得多的少样本 (few-shot) 前沿 LLM 表现相当。
Conclusion: 对 UGT 音素化而言，显式推断规范形式是关键：把它做成精确匹配加分阶段解码的组合模块，0.5B 小模型即可逼近少样本大 LLM。

papers.title: XLOG: A CUDA-Native Engine for Neurosymbolic Integration
papers.abstract_en: xlog is a CUDA-native logic programming engine integrating neural perception with deterministic Datalog, probabilistic inference, and epistemic world views through a typed frontend and provider-owned CUDA runtime. Its reasoning modes share device data planes, but their execution boundaries differ: ordinary Datalog and exact inference are host-orchestrated, while certified resident recursive and Monte Carlo sampled cores record zero tracked host-device transfers before a bounded terminal receipt. The probabilistic path supports end-to-end gradients through GPU knowledge compilation from provenance to CNF to Decision-DNNF, exact weighted model counting, and backward gradients. A final smoothed circuit is certified against its source formula before caching or evaluation. Circuit caching yields a 2.74x MNIST-addition training speedup; a worst-case-optimal join subsystem yields a 27.96x geometric-mean gain over xlog's binary-join baseline. MNIST-addition accuracy matches Scallop's (0.9561 versus 0.9468), but no per-epoch speed claim is made because baseline epoch time varies with CPU quota. In five hub-skewed triangle-counting cases, the Souffle-to-fused-xlog execution-time ratio rises from 0.88x at 150k edges, where Souffle is faster, to 5.54x at 1.2M; fused peak device allocations are 85-1,033 MB versus 3,287-44,979 MB for the materializing arm. Exact inference is correctness-equivalent to but slower than ProbLog2. On a public video benchmark, a proximity predicate trained only through symbolic credit replaces hand-set geometry at unchanged held-out accuracy; within Event-Calculus rule search it fails ten-fold cross-validation and does not transfer on a leak-free split. On a maritime corpus, weighted clauses beat crisp selection by 0.065 F1, with the result reproduced by one chronological training pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XLOG 是 CUDA 原生逻辑编程引擎，把神经感知与确定性 Datalog、概率推断、认知世界视图统一到 typed frontend 和 provider-owned CUDA runtime 上，端到端梯度经 provenance→CNF→Decision-DNNF 的 GPU knowledge compilation 与精确 weighted model counting 反传。电路缓存带来 2.74x 的 MNIST-addition 训练加速，worst-case-optimal join 相对二元 join 基线几何平均提升 27.96x；精度与 Scallop 持平（0.9561 对 0.9468）。
Motivation: 神经符号系统里逻辑推理与 GPU 计算割裂：概率推断走主机、梯度难端到端传，Datalog 执行又受主机编排与物化内存限制，训练与查询都慢。
Method: 推理模式共享 device data plane：普通 Datalog 与精确推断由 host 编排，certified resident 递归核与 Monte Carlo 采样核在有界终止回执前记录零主机-设备传输；概率路径用 GPU knowledge compilation（provenance→CNF→Decision-DNNF）+ 精确 weighted model counting + backward gradients，平滑后电路在缓存/求值前对源公式做认证；另含 worst-case-optimal join 子系统。
Result: 电路缓存使 MNIST-addition 训练加速 2.74x；worst-case-optimal join 相对二元 join 基线几何平均提升 27.96x；MNIST-addition 精度 0.9561 对 Scallop 0.9468（摘要声明不作 per-epoch 速度声明）。五个 hub-skewed 三角计数案例中 Souffle/fused-xlog 执行时间比从 150k 边的 0.88x 升到 1.2M 边的 5.54x，fused 峰值设备分配 85–1,033 MB 对物化方案 3,287–44,979 MB。精确推断与 ProbLog2 正确性等价但更慢；公开视频基准上由符号信用训练的 proximity 谓词在 held-out 精度不变下替代手工几何，但在 Event-Calculus 规则搜索中十折交叉验证失败、无泄漏划分下不迁移；海事语料上加权子句比 crisp 选择高 0.065 F1。
Conclusion: 把概率推理与梯度放进 CUDA 常驻数据面能同时拿到训练加速与内存优势，且精度不掉；但符号信用学到的谓词在规则搜索与跨划分迁移上不可靠，精确推断速度仍不及 ProbLog2。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reliable Federated TinyML Deployment for IoT Security
papers.abstract_en: The growing deployment of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has increased the need for privacy-preserving intrusion detection systems that operate directly on resource-constrained hardware. Federated Learning enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, but conventional federated models are often too large and unstable for deployment on microcontroller-class devices. TinyML techniques enable compact neural networks but are typically designed for inference-only workloads. This work investigates combining Federated Learning with TinyML-based model compression for intrusion detection in IoT environments. We evaluate compression strategies including knowledge distillation, structured pruning, and quantization within a federated training pipeline. Preliminary results show that training stability plays a critical role in federated TinyML systems. In particular, server-coordinated cosine learning-rate scheduling improves Attack Recall from 46.7% to 93.85% while enabling substantial model compression and efficient edge deployment. These findings provide insights for designing lightweight and privacy preserving intrusion detection systems for IoT devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向资源受限 IoT 设备的入侵检测，把 Federated Learning 与 TinyML 压缩（知识蒸馏、结构化剪枝、量化）放进同一条联邦训练管线，并指出训练稳定性是关键瓶颈。服务器端协调的 cosine 学习率调度把 Attack Recall 从 46.7% 提到 93.85%，同时保持大幅压缩与边缘部署可行性。
Motivation: 常规联邦模型对微控制器级设备过大且训练不稳，而现有 TinyML 网络多为推理专用，二者直接结合难以在不共享原始数据的前提下做 IoT 入侵检测。
Method: 在联邦训练管线内评估三种压缩策略：知识蒸馏、结构化剪枝、量化；训练调度上采用服务器协调的 cosine 学习率调度来稳定联邦 TinyML 训练。
Result: 服务器协调 cosine 学习率调度使 Attack Recall 从 46.7% 提升至 93.85%，并同时实现 substantial model compression 与高效边缘部署。
Conclusion: 训练稳定性而非单纯压缩率决定联邦 TinyML 入侵检测的可用性；由服务器统一调度学习率是让压缩后的模型在联邦场景下收敛到可用召回率的关键设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Explainable Methods for Temporal Attribution in Sequential Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Sequential RecSys are central to modern personalization, exploiting user's historical interaction sequences to drive next-step decisions. Deep learning models, particularly CNN and Transformer-based architectures, have proven highly effective at capturing temporal dependencies in these histories. For transparency and trust, understanding which past interactions drive a given recommendation is increasingly important --- both for developers auditing model behavior and for users seeking a rationale. However, the non-linearities that give these models their predictive power also render them black boxes, making it difficult to attribute decisions to specific interactions. While gradient-based, perturbation-based, and attention-based explainability methods exist, a systematic benchmark of their faithfulness for sequential recommendation is missing. We address this gap by introducing a dual-model masking metric in which one model supplies per-timestep attribution scores and a separately trained, masking-robust probe measures the resulting change in predicted probability. Using this metric, we benchmark ten XAI methods across CNN, Transformer, SASRec, and BERT4Rec backbones on KuaiRand and MovieLens, complemented by analyses of temporal attribution patterns, item popularity confounding, and robustness to input corruption. Our key findings are: (1) gradient-based methods, particularly GradientSHAP and Integrated Gradients, yield the most faithful and robust attributions; (2) raw attention weights are unreliable, but gradient-weighted attention restores faithfulness on shorter sequences, with degradation on longer horizons as softmax attention probabilities converge toward uniform importance scores, diminishing the method's ability to identify informative interactions; and (3) temporal attribution patterns in faithful methods reflect genuine task structure rather than recency or popularity bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为序列推荐的时序归因提出双模型掩码评测指标：一个模型给逐时间步归因分数，另一个单独训练、对掩码鲁棒的 probe 测预测概率变化。在 KuaiRand 与 MovieLens 上、CNN/Transformer/SASRec/BERT4Rec 四种骨干上评测十个 XAI 方法，发现 GradientSHAP 与 Integrated Gradients 最忠实稳健，原始 attention 权重不可靠，梯度加权 attention 在短序列恢复忠实性、长时程上随 softmax 趋于均匀而退化。
Motivation: CNN 与 Transformer 序列推荐模型的非线性使其成为黑箱，已有梯度、扰动、attention 三类解释方法，但缺少对其忠实度 (faithfulness) 的系统 benchmark。
Method: 提出双模型掩码指标：归因模型输出逐时间步分数，另一个独立训练且对掩码鲁棒的 probe 测量被掩码后预测概率的变化；用该指标在 CNN、Transformer、SASRec、BERT4Rec 骨干上评测十个 XAI 方法，并做时序归因模式、item 流行度混淆与输入扰动鲁棒性分析。
Result: 在 KuaiRand 与 MovieLens 上：梯度类方法（尤其 GradientSHAP 与 Integrated Gradients）给出最忠实、最稳健的归因；原始 attention 权重不可靠，梯度加权 attention 在较短序列上恢复忠实性，但在更长时程上退化，因 softmax 注意力概率趋近均匀重要性分数；忠实方法的时序归因模式反映真实任务结构，而非近因或流行度偏置。
Conclusion: 序列推荐的可解释性评测应以掩码探针式忠实度指标为准：梯度类归因可信，attention 权重需梯度加权且在长序列上失效。

papers.title: ZO-COSMO: Index-Free One-Hop Mixing for Decentralized Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Sparse communication in decentralized zeroth-order learning requires compatible peer-state coordinates. We characterize this one-hop condition and develop \textsf{ZO-COSMO}, coupling two-query estimation with average-preserving masked consensus using $q$ values per active link. Global supports serve all-neighbor mixing; matching updates require agreement only within each pair. We derive a sharp contraction-per-scalar bound within the matching class and convergence guarantees for the core and sparse-momentum updates. At fixed matching, exact moment identities characterize how shared directions preserve gradient-heterogeneity cancellation and redistribute estimation error and disagreement. Mechanism experiments cover unequal curvatures, noise, and sparse momentum. Further tests span $64$ synthetic agents and eight logical Qwen LoRA workers. At matched payload budgets, Qwen2-7B QNLI gains $3.65$ accuracy points over explicit-index Rand-$k$; edge-local updates gain $3.42$ and $2.53$ points over all-neighbor mixing on eight-worker complete and ring graphs. A matched-first-step ablation gives a $3.92$-point momentum benefit. Seed-aware and same-matching controls distinguish encoding, scheduling, and query correlation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZO-COSMO 把去中心化零阶优化的稀疏通信对齐到 one-hop 坐标兼容条件：两查询梯度估计加保均值的 masked consensus，全局支撑走全邻域混合、matching 更新只需成对一致。在等 payload 预算下 Qwen2-7B QNLI 比显式索引 Rand-k 高 3.65 个准确点，八 worker 全连接与环图上 edge-local 更新比全邻域混合分别高 3.42 与 2.53 点。
Motivation: 去中心化零阶学习中稀疏通信要求各 peer 状态坐标兼容，否则无法直接混合；此前缺少对这一 one-hop 条件的刻画与相应收敛保证。
Method: 刻画 one-hop 兼容条件，提出 ZO-COSMO：两查询 (two-query) 零阶梯度估计耦合保均值 masked consensus，每条活跃链路用 q 个值；全局支撑用全邻域混合，matching 更新只需成对一致，并给出 matching 类内 sharp contraction-per-scalar 界与 core、sparse-momentum 两种更新的收敛保证，辅以 moment 恒等式分析梯度异质性抵消与估计误差/分歧的再分配。
Result: 在匹配 payload 预算下，Qwen2-7B QNLI 上比显式索引 Rand-k 高 3.65 个准确点；八 logical Qwen LoRA worker 上 edge-local 更新在全连接图与环图上分别比全邻域混合高 3.42 与 2.53 点；matched-first-step 消融给出 3.92 点的 momentum 收益。机制实验覆盖不等曲率、噪声与 sparse momentum，另有 64 个 synthetic agents 测试。
Conclusion: 只要把稀疏混合限制在 one-hop 坐标兼容的 matching 类内并保均值，去中心化零阶优化就能在等通信预算下同时拿到收敛保证与更高的下游准确率，且 momentum 收益在对齐首步后依然成立。

papers.title: Enhancing Small Language Models for Power Outage Report Generation via Minimum Risk Training
papers.abstract_en: Minimum Risk Training (MRT) enables neural machine translation models to directly optimize sequence-level evaluation metrics instead of relying only on token- level maximum-likelihood objectives Shen et al. [2016]. Although introduced a decade ago, recent work shows renewed potential for risk-based optimization in modern language models Yang et al. [2024], Jinnai et al. [2025]. We apply MRT to power outage report generation for the Outage Data Initiative Nationwide (ODIN), transforming heterogeneous reports into standardized XML compliant with CIM IEC 61968-3. Our MRT approach improves Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct overall accuracy from 16.20% to 68.95%, demonstrating the effectiveness of sequence- level optimization for domain-specific structured generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把最小风险训练 (Minimum Risk Training, MRT) 用于停电报告生成：对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 直接优化序列级指标，将 ODIN 异构报告转成符合 CIM IEC 61968-3 的标准化 XML，整体准确率从 16.20% 升到 68.95%。
Motivation: 领域结构化生成只靠 token 级最大似然，与序列级评测指标不对齐，导致停电报告转 XML 的准确率低。
Method: 把 MRT（Shen et al. 2016）这一序列级风险优化目标应用到 ODIN 报告到 XML 的结构化生成任务，基座模型为 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，输出需符合 CIM IEC 61968-3 标准。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 整体准确率从 16.20% 提升到 68.95%。
Conclusion: 序列级优化对领域特定结构化生成有效，MRT 在现代语言模型上仍有潜力。

papers.title: Diverse by Design: Architectural Constraints for Prototype-Based Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Prototype-based neural networks provide inherent interpretability through case-based reasoning, yet suffer from critical limitations: prototypes converge to redundant features, fail to capture diverse semantic parts, and lack quantitative interpretability assessment. We propose Diversity-Aware Prototype Learning (DAPL), which enforces prototype diversity through architectural constraints rather than explicit regularization. Our approach leverages multi-head self-attention with strict one-to-one attention-to-prototype mapping, ensuring each prototype specializes in distinct visual features. We further introduce foreground-aware training to focus prototypes on semantically meaningful regions and develop comprehensive evaluation metrics (Coverage and Diversity) for quantitative interpretability assessment. Experiments on CUB-200-2011 demonstrate substantial improvements: DAPL with foreground-aware training achieves 81.69\% accuracy with 0.596 Coverage and 0.427 Diversity, providing the best overall balance across all evaluated prototype-based methods. Code is available at https://github.com/xinmiaolin/DAPL.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Trustworthy, Robust, Uncertainty-Aware, and Explainable Visual Intelligence and Beyond (TRUE-V) Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAPL 用架构约束而非显式正则强制原型多样性：多头自注意力与原型严格一一对应，使每个原型专精不同视觉特征，配合前景感知训练聚焦语义区域。在 CUB-200-2011 上，带前景感知训练的 DAPL 达到 81.69% 准确率、0.596 Coverage 与 0.427 Diversity，在所评估的原型方法中取得最佳整体平衡。
Motivation: 基于原型的网络虽有内在可解释性，但原型收敛到冗余特征、无法覆盖多样语义部件，且缺少可解释性的定量评估手段。
Method: 提出 Diversity-Aware Prototype Learning (DAPL)：用多头自注意力并施加注意力到原型的严格一一映射这一架构约束来保证原型多样性；加入 foreground-aware training 让原型聚焦语义有意义的区域；并设计 Coverage 与 Diversity 两个指标做定量可解释性评估。
Result: 在 CUB-200-2011 上，DAPL 配合前景感知训练取得 81.69% 准确率、0.596 Coverage、0.427 Diversity，在全部被评估的基于原型的方法中给出最佳的整体平衡。
Conclusion: 原型多样性可以靠架构约束而非显式正则来保证，且前景感知训练能在保持准确率的同时提升原型的语义覆盖与多样性。

papers.title: Data-driven discrete-time deep recurrent neural network-based modeling for dissipative systems
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI has gained increasing attention for its role in developing AI systems that better understand, predict, and control real-world dynamics. Achieving this requires AI models that not only achieve high prediction accuracy but also preserve fundamental physical properties of dynamical systems. In this paper, we propose a deep discrete-time dissipative recurrent neural network (DissipNet) that explicitly enforces dissipativity, a key property related to stability and energy dissipation, through structural weight constraints and a dedicated training algorithm. By construction, the proposed network is capable of learning dissipative dynamics while preserving their inherent stability, which is formally analyzed using Lyapunov theory. In contrast to Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), which incorporate governing equations into the training loss but do not guarantee preservation of internal analytical properties such as dissipativity or passivity, our approach provides explicit guarantees on stability at the model level. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method through several modeling applications, and compare its performance with a naive recurrent neural network (RNN) and a PINN-based model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DissipNet：在离散时间深度循环网络上用结构性权重约束加专用训练算法显式强制耗散性 (dissipativity)，由 Lyapunov 理论形式化保证模型层面的稳定性。与把控制方程写进损失、却不保证耗散性/无源性等内部解析性质的 PINN 相比，该结构直接给出稳定性保证，并在若干建模应用上与朴素 RNN 和 PINN 模型对比。
Motivation: Physical AI 需要模型既预测准又保持动力系统的基本物理性质；PINN 只把控制方程放进损失，不保证耗散性、无源性这类内部解析性质，稳定性在模型层面缺失。
Method: 提出离散时间深度耗散循环神经网络 DissipNet：通过结构性权重约束与专门的训练算法显式施加耗散性，使网络按构造学到耗散动力学并保持其内在稳定性，稳定性用 Lyapunov 理论做形式化分析；对比对象为朴素 RNN 与基于 PINN 的模型。
Result: 在若干建模应用上展示方法有效性，并与朴素 RNN 和 PINN 模型比较性能；摘要给出的是模型层面稳定性的显式保证这一性质结论，未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把耗散性写进网络结构而非损失项，可以在模型层面给出稳定性保证，这是 PINN 路线所不具备的；适用对象是耗散动力系统的建模。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Artificial intelligence surrogates for treatment effect estimation with before-and-after data
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the causal effects of medical treatments is difficult when clinically important outcomes are costly to measure or require long follow-up. Short-term or inexpensive surrogate outcomes offer a potential alternative, but surrogate biomarkers may be unavailable or difficult to identify. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled increasingly accurate prediction of clinical outcomes from inexpensive, high-dimensional measurements, which creates an opportunity to use AI predictions themselves as surrogates. To this end, we develop a framework for estimating treatment effects from paired measurements obtained before and after treatment for each treated individual. A pretrained AI model is applied to the before and after measurements, and our estimator compares the resulting outcome predictions. We characterize the technical assumptions under which this within-person contrast identifies the average treatment effect on the treated, even when clinical outcomes are never observed for treated individuals. When these assumptions cannot be justified, we use prediction-powered inference to correct bias using a small number of observed clinical outcomes and obtain valid inference. Synthetic and real-world cardio-oncology experiments demonstrate the validity and accuracy of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用预训练 AI 模型对每位受试者治疗前后的高维测量分别预测临床结局，再以个体内预测差作为替代结局来估计平均处理效应 (ATT)，即使受试者的真实临床结局从未被观测也能识别。当识别假设不成立时，用少量实测临床结局做 prediction-powered inference 校正偏差并给出有效推断；在合成数据与真实 cardio-oncology 实验中验证了方法的有效性与准确性。
Motivation: 医学处理效应估计依赖的临床结局测量昂贵或需长期随访，而替代生物标志物往往难以获得或识别，导致处理效应难以估计。
Method: 框架对每位受处理个体的治疗前后配对测量分别跑同一个预训练 AI 模型得到结局预测，比较个体内预测差以识别 ATT；当识别假设不可辩护时，用少量观测到的真实临床结局做 prediction-powered inference 校正偏差并保证推断有效。
Result: 在合成实验与真实 cardio-oncology 实验中展示了该方法的有效性与准确性；摘要给出的是定性结论，未列具体数值。

papers.title: Change detection with conformal martingales: new optimal constructions, and suboptimality of existing methods
papers.abstract_en: We study distribution-free sequential changepoint detection for independent observations with unknown and unrestricted pre- and post-change laws. We build on the conformal test martingales and associated e-detectors of Vovk(2021), which control the probability of false alarm (PFA) and the average run length (ARL) respectively. The majority of these works focus on validity, with statistical efficiency usually left for simulations. We develop a comprehensive theory of how conformal p-values behave under non-exchangeable data with a changepoint at an unknown time $T$. We use this to analyze the post-change growth and resulting detection delay of conformal martingale methods, and prove that the standard existing methods are suboptimal for PFA and ARL control, and can lead to delays that are $Ω(T)$ and $Ω(\sqrt{\text{ARL}})$ respectively. We propose different conformal e-processes and e-detectors that are provably minimax optimal, with delays $Θ(\log T)$ and $Θ(\log \text{ARL})$ respectively, and have much shorter delays in simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对独立观测、变点前后分布未知且无限制的分布无关序贯变点检测，本文建立 conformal p-value 在含未知变点时刻 T 的非交换数据下的理论，证明现有 conformal martingale / e-detector 方法在 PFA 与 ARL 控制上次优，检测延迟可达 Ω(T) 与 Ω(√ARL)；随后构造新的 conformal e-process 与 e-detector，延迟达到 minimax 最优的 Θ(log T) 与 Θ(log ARL)，仿真中延迟显著更短。
Motivation: 现有 conformal test martingale 与 e-detector 文献多只保证有效性（控制 PFA 与 ARL），统计效率通常留给仿真，缺少对非交换数据下检测延迟的理论刻画，无法判断现有方法是否最优。
Method: 在 Vovk (2021) 的 conformal test martingale 与 e-detector 框架上，推导含未知变点时刻 T 的非交换数据中 conformal p-value 的行为理论；据此分析变点后 conformal martingale 的增长与检测延迟，证明现有方法的次优性，并提出新的 conformal e-process 与 e-detector 构造。
Result: 证明现有方法对 PFA 与 ARL 控制次优，延迟下界分别为 Ω(T) 与 Ω(√ARL)；新构造达到 minimax 最优延迟 Θ(log T)（对应 PFA）与 Θ(log ARL)（对应 ARL），且仿真中延迟明显更短。
Conclusion: 现有 conformal 变点检测方法在延迟上并非最优，可被改进到 minimax 最优的对数级延迟；有效性控制与检测效率需同时在理论中处理。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Multimedia Verification through Memory Consolidation of Contestation Experiences
papers.abstract_en: Multimedia verification requires not only accurate decisions but also traceable evidence, reliable human correction, and safe reuse of prior experience. Existing systems often lack explicit mechanisms for revising intermediate reasoning or preventing harmful knowledge transfer. We present SEMV (Self-Evolving Multimedia Verification), a self-evolving multi-agent framework that treats provenance-bearing arguments as the interface between evidence, reasoning, human contestation, and memory. SEMV combines arena-based quantitative bipolar argumentation (A-QBAF), causal and scoped revision, and verification-gated memory consolidation with explicit conflict retention. On COSMOS benchmark, SEMV achieves 91.88% accuracy versus 89.10% for the strongest comparable baseline. Verified memory reduces negative transfer from 5.7% to 0.2%. On CTR benchmark, constructed from reviewer contestations, scoped causal revision corrects 96.7% of initial errors while saving 52.8% compute. MV2026 Grand Challenge dataset further supports evidence-grounded, temporally consistent reporting. These results show that SEMV can evolve through verified experience while keeping accumulated knowledge and subsequent decisions traceable, revisable, and contestable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自演化多智能体多媒体验证框架 SEMV，用带溯源的论证把证据、推理、人类异议与记忆连起来，靠验证门控的记忆固化阻止有害经验迁移。在 COSMOS 上准确率 91.88%（最强可比基线 89.10%），验证后记忆把负迁移从 5.7% 压到 0.2%；在 CTR 上作用域因果修订纠正 96.7% 的初始错误并省 52.8% 算力。
Motivation: 现有多媒体验证系统缺少修订中间推理的显式机制，也挡不住有害知识迁移，导致证据链不可追溯、人类纠正难以安全复用。
Method: SEMV 组合 arena-based quantitative bipolar argumentation (A-QBAF)、因果且带作用域的修订 (causal and scoped revision)，以及带显式冲突保留的验证门控记忆固化 (verification-gated memory consolidation)，以带溯源的论证作为证据、推理、人类异议与记忆之间的接口。
Result: COSMOS benchmark 上准确率 91.88%，对比最强可比基线 89.10%；验证记忆把负迁移由 5.7% 降至 0.2%。在由审稿人异议构建的 CTR benchmark 上，作用域因果修订纠正 96.7% 的初始错误并节省 52.8% 算力；MV2026 Grand Challenge 数据集用于支撑证据充分、时间一致的报告。
Conclusion: 经过验证的经验可以让系统在保持知识与决策可追溯、可修订、可异议的同时持续演化，验证门控是抑制负迁移的关键。

papers.title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
papers.abstract_en: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Includes references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Jev 作为科学工作流中的语义决策组件来评测：在确定性计算前先判断观测关系（是否同一文化、处理、参照标准），再把算术交给代码执行。在十个科学案例的二十个 source-grounded Choices 上比较十二个模型配置、每个重复五次，Jev 在语义选择完全正确这一档与其他五个配置并列，且在成功响应中观测到最低的中位延迟。
Motivation: 科学工作流在做计数或比较前必须先选对观测之间的关系，选错会改变结果的科学含义，而这类语义选择环节此前缺少独立评测。
Method: 构建一个遵循 Jev 文档指引、并把算术分配给代码的评测 harness；在十个科学案例上设计二十个 source-grounded Choices，比较十二个模型配置，每个重复五次，分别度量语义选择、下游输出与最终 claim 标签三层结果。
Result: 十二个模型配置、二十个 Choices、十个科学案例、每项重复五次；Jev 与另外五个配置在语义完全正确上持平，并在成功响应中取得最低观测中位延迟；在三个对比模型上，一道文化史问题的七次错误选择改变了下游计数，却仍保持正确的最终 claim 标签。
Conclusion: Jev 适合承担预备性的科学语义决策任务，而评测这类角色必须同时检查工作流将复用的关系与量，只看最终标签会掩盖中间选择错误。

papers.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.
papers.comment: Project Page: https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/large-model-team/blog/uranus/ Inference Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-OSS Inference Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/D-Robotics/Uranus-Demo-Data SDK Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-SDK Model Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/D-Robotics/uranus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Uranus 是一个以关节轨迹为条件的自回归扩散机器人模拟器，可在线接收未来关节位置轨迹、逐步自回归生成一个 latent 帧（对应 4 个 RGB 帧），实现无固定时域的流式开放 rollout。推理优化后达到 24 FPS 的低延迟，并以统一接口支持不同机器人本体与相机配置的同步多视角生成。
Motivation: 真实世界交互成本高，而传统模拟器需要大量人工搭建，机器人数据生成、策略训练与安全迭代因此受限于可扩展的仿真能力。
Method: 核心是 joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model：以未来关节位置轨迹为条件，自回归地每步生成一个 latent 帧并展开为 4 个 RGB 帧；推理侧做优化以压低延迟，并提供统一接口做同步多视角生成，覆盖多种机器人本体与相机配置。
Result: 推理优化后达到 24 FPS；每步自回归生成 1 个 latent 帧对应 4 个 RGB 帧；在 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 数据上做了定量与定性评估，并开源代码与模型权重。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的轨迹条件扩散模拟器可以提供无固定时域的流式机器人 rollout 与低延迟多视角生成，作者同时明确指出了当前局限，并以开源代码和权重交付社区。

papers.title: ActiveArena: Benchmarking and Understanding Active Perception in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Active perception and manipulation are crucial for robots to interact with complex scenes. Existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate how robots effectively acquire and maintain information in memory in an active manner. To this end, we introduce ActiveArena-Sim, an active-perception simulator with controllable viewpoints and large-scale workspaces as the foundation. Built on this, we propose ActiveArena-Bench, which comprises 35 tasks across 5 fine-grained categories, covering visual exploration and interactive information acquisition. Each task is difficult to solve from passive observations alone, requiring multi-round evidence acquisition and memory-based reasoning. The benchmark provides rich memory annotations, standardized training data, and ID/OOD protocols featuring disjoint scenes, unseen distractor configurations, and novel backgrounds. Moreover, we present ActiveArena-VLA, a modular suite of 13 vision-language-action configurations for controlled studies of memory writing, memory capacity, proprioceptive state, subtask supervision, and high-level planning in active perception. Benchmark results reveal a substantial ID-OOD gap: uniform memory sampling, increased memory capacity under reliable write policies, proprioceptive inputs, and subtask supervision improve OOD generalization, while planner-guided memory management and decision-making achieve performance close to the best-performing configuration using only sparse memory. ActiveArena thus provides a unified testbed to develop and diagnose models for active perception and manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActiveArena 提出主动感知仿真器 ActiveArena-Sim 与基准 ActiveArena-Bench（35 个任务、5 个类别），配套 13 种 vision-language-action 配置的 ActiveArena-VLA 套件做受控消融。结果显示 ID-OOD 差距显著：均匀记忆采样、可靠写入策略下的更大记忆容量、本体感觉输入与子任务监督都提升 OOD 泛化，而 planner 引导的记忆管理仅用稀疏记忆即可接近最佳配置性能。
Motivation: 现有机器人基准难以评估机器人如何以主动方式获取并维持记忆中的信息，且任务常可从被动观测直接解决。
Method: 先建 ActiveArena-Sim 主动感知仿真器（可控视角、大规模工作区），在其上构建 ActiveArena-Bench：35 个任务、5 个细分类别，覆盖视觉探索与交互式信息获取，每题仅靠被动观测难以解决，需多轮取证与基于记忆的推理；提供记忆标注、标准化训练数据与 ID/OOD 协议（场景不相交、未见干扰物配置、新背景）。再用 ActiveArena-VLA 的 13 个 VLA 配置，对记忆写入、记忆容量、本体感觉状态、子任务监督与高层规划做受控研究。
Result: 基准结果显示显著的 ID-OOD 差距；均匀记忆采样、在可靠写入策略下增大记忆容量、加入本体感觉输入、子任务监督均提升 OOD 泛化；planner 引导的记忆管理与决策在仅用稀疏记忆时达到接近最佳配置的性能。

papers.title: SyzHarness: Patch-Based Kernel Bug Reproduction with LLM-Synthesized Fuzzing Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Automated kernel vulnerability reproduction is essential for bug triage, patch validation, and regression testing, but still lacks an effective and efficient solution. The core challenge is twofold: a reproducer must first recover the trigger scaffold needed to reach the vulnerable state and determine the precise concrete values that actually trigger the bug. Existing directed fuzzing approaches are ineffective at recovering the necessary trigger scaffold, while LLM-only generation is brittle because it struggles with concrete-value discovery and runtime nondeterminism. We design SyzHarness, a framework that combines LLM reasoning with coverage-guided fuzzing for patch-based Linux kernel vulnerability reproduction. Given a patch, SyzHarness uses an LLM agent grounded by code navigation tools to synthesize a parameterized fuzzing harness that fixes the prerequisite setup logic while exposing only uncertain, bug-critical input parameters to be mutated by Syzkaller. SyzHarness then translates this harness into a Syzkaller compatible interface and iteratively refines it using hierarchical reachability feedback. We evaluate SyzHarness on multiple datasets of triggerable real-world Linux kernel vulnerabilities. On 100 KernelCTF cases, SyzHarness achieves a 78% bug reproduction success rate. On the SyzDirect benchmark, SyzHarness achieves a 73% bug reproduction success rate, substantially outperforming prior directed greybox fuzzing. On 50 recent, known-triggerable syzbot bugs fixed after March 2026, SyzHarness reproduces 40/50 (80%) using only the fix commits as input.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyzHarness 把 LLM 代码导航与覆盖引导 fuzzing 结合，从补丁自动生成参数化 harness：固定前置 setup 逻辑，只把不确定且与 bug 相关的输入参数交给 Syzkaller 变异，并用分层可达性反馈迭代修正接口。在 100 个 KernelCTF 案例上复现成功率 78%，SyzDirect benchmark 上 73%，2026 年 3 月后修复的 50 个已知可触发 syzbot bug 上仅用 fix commit 即复现 40/50（80%）。
Motivation: 内核漏洞复现需要同时恢复触发脚手架并找到具体触发值，定向 fuzzing 恢复不了脚手架，纯 LLM 生成又在具体值发现和运行时非确定性上很脆。
Method: 给定补丁，用带代码导航工具的 LLM agent 合成参数化 fuzzing harness，固定前置 setup、只暴露 bug 关键的不确定参数给 Syzkaller 变异；再把 harness 翻译成 Syzkaller 兼容接口，并用分层可达性反馈 (hierarchical reachability feedback) 迭代精化。
Result: 在 100 个 KernelCTF 案例上复现成功率 78%；在 SyzDirect benchmark 上 73%，大幅超过此前的定向 greybox fuzzing；在 2026 年 3 月之后修复的 50 个已知可触发 syzbot bug 上复现 40/50（80%），输入仅为 fix commit。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的脚手架推理与 Syzkaller 的具体值搜索分工，可以在只给补丁的条件下高效复现真实内核漏洞，覆盖多个真实漏洞数据集。

papers.title: WorkWorlds: An Infrastructure for Evaluating AI Agents on Workplace Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Many knowledge-work benchmarks are constructed around individual tasks, with the context needed for each task selected together with or after the task has been specified. This design measures performance on workplace-like tasks in an environment assembled for the task. When task specification guides which context is selected, the evaluation can encode task information into the environment and pre-complete part of the information-localization work that workplace performance normally requires. We introduce WorkWorlds, an evaluation infrastructure that separates organizational state from task specification. A world first fixes a revision, date, and employee seat and materializes the organizational state that employee can access; tasks are introduced only afterward. We implement WorkWorlds in a primary synthetic pharmaceutical company with 8 measured tasks across 6 employee seats, and construct additional organizational worlds. Across 192 matched evaluations, task-level curation increased evidence access by 17.6 percentage points, from 72.8% to 90.4%, and criterion pass by 8.7 points, from 68.0% to 76.7%, while pass conditional on evidence access remained nearly unchanged; most of the measured difference occurred before the agent reached sufficient evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorkWorlds 把组织状态与任务描述解耦来评测职场 AI agent：先固定修订版本、日期与员工席位并物化该员工可访问的组织状态，之后才投放任务。192 次配对评测显示，按任务挑选上下文使证据可及率从 72.8% 升到 90.4%（+17.6 个百分点）、通过率从 68.0% 升到 76.7%（+8.7 个百分点），而给定证据可及后的条件通过率几乎不变，说明差异主要发生在 agent 拿到足够证据之前。
Motivation: 多数知识工作基准在任务确定后再挑选上下文，等于把任务信息编码进环境、预先替 agent 完成本应由它完成的信息定位工作，从而高估职场表现。
Method: 提出评测基础设施 WorkWorlds：world 先固定 revision、日期与 employee seat 并物化该员工可访问的组织状态，任务后置注入；在一家合成制药公司中实现 6 个员工席位、8 个被测任务，并构建额外组织世界，做 192 次配对评测。
Result: 任务级上下文挑选 (task-level curation) 使证据可及率提高 17.6 个百分点（72.8% → 90.4%），criterion pass 提高 8.7 个百分点（68.0% → 76.7%）；给定证据可及的条件通过率几乎不变，多数差异出现在 agent 尚未获得足够证据之前。
Conclusion: 按任务挑选上下文会把信息定位的功劳提前计入评测，职场 agent 基准应先固定组织世界再投放任务，否则测到的是环境预完成的证据定位而非 agent 能力。

papers.title: RSPDBench: Benchmarking Vision Foundation Models on Earth Observation Tasks Under Physically Grounded Remote-Sensing Product Degradations
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models targeting Earth observation (EO) tasks are commonly evaluated on clean downstream benchmarks, but operational EO products can already contain spatial, radiometric, alignment, noise, and harmonization defects before reaching the model. Existing robustness evaluations often use generic image corruptions or broad domain shifts, which do not isolate these product-level failure modes. We introduce \textbf{RSPDBench}, a physically grounded \textbf{r}emote-\textbf{s}ensing-\textbf{p}roduct \textbf{d}egradation \textbf{b}enchmark for vision foundation models. RSPDBench evaluates five EO datasets, seven foundation-model entries, and two supervised baselines under audited primitive degradations and compound product chains. Each model is evaluated under its clean-selected native protocol, with robustness measured as the drop from its own clean baseline. Our analysis reveals that degradation sensitivity is strongly structured: resolution-conditioned and channel-grouped encoders protect different failure axes, and the same physical defect can hurt one model while helping another. Compound chains expose failures that isolated degradations do not predict, with model-dependent amplification, saturation, or component dominance, and excess drops up to $38$ percentage points beyond the strongest component. These results show that EO robustness cannot be characterized by clean accuracy or generic perturbation tests alone; it must also be measured against the structured defects that remote-sensing products carry into deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSPDBench 用物理可解释的遥感产品退化（空间、辐射、配准、噪声、一致性）替代通用图像腐蚀，评测 5 个 EO 数据集、7 个视觉基础模型和 2 个监督基线，鲁棒性按各模型自身 clean 基线的跌幅计。复合退化链暴露出孤立退化预测不到的失效，超出最强单个分量的额外跌幅最高达 38 个百分点。结论是 EO 鲁棒性不能只靠 clean 精度或通用扰动测试刻画。
Motivation: 现有 EO 鲁棒性评测用通用图像腐蚀或宽泛域偏移，无法隔离遥感产品在到达模型前就已带有的产品级缺陷，而 clean 基准评测掩盖了这些部署期失效。
Method: 构建物理接地的遥感产品退化基准 RSPDBench：审计过的原始退化 (audited primitive degradations) 与复合产品链 (compound product chains) 两类扰动，覆盖 5 个 EO 数据集、7 个视觉基础模型条目与 2 个监督基线；每个模型按其 clean 选定的原生协议评测，鲁棒性定义为相对自身 clean 基线的跌幅。
Result: 退化敏感性结构化：分辨率条件化与通道分组编码器保护的失效轴不同，同一物理缺陷可能伤害一个模型而帮助另一个。复合链出现放大、饱和或分量主导等模型依赖行为，超出最强单个分量的额外跌幅最高达 38 个百分点。
Conclusion: EO 鲁棒性必须针对遥感产品带入部署的结构化缺陷来度量，clean 精度与通用扰动测试不足以刻画。

papers.title: OmniEcho: Audio-Visual Spatial Understanding for Omni-Modal Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Humans can effortlessly localize the direction of a sound source and integrate it with visual cues for reasoning, yet this remains challenging for embodied agents. In particular, it is still unclear how to effectively evaluate and model spatial audio understanding in embodied settings. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{OmniEchoBench}, a unified benchmark for spatial audio-visual perception and audio-vision-language navigation. OmniEchoBench comprises six tasks over 197 real-world spatial audio-visual scenes, 2,972 question-answer pairs, and 900 navigation samples with first-order ambisonics (FOA) audio collected from 30 real-world environments. To enable scalable training supervision, we develop a controllable rendering pipeline for spatial audio. It preserves geometric consistency among sound sources, visual observations, and agent trajectories. Building on this, we propose \textbf{OmniEcho}, a spatially aware omni-modal model. It introduces an FOA spatial encoder alongside a pretrained semantic audio pathway. Extensive experiments show that OmniEcho achieves state-of-the-art performance on spatial audio-visual perception. For our sound-guided navigation, OmniEcho reaches a performance level close to that of traditional vision-language navigation. These results demonstrate that spatial audio can serve as a valuable signal for embodied scene reasoning and navigation, while also highlighting fine-grained spatial localization and distance estimation as important open challenges. Our code and data will be available in https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/OmniEcho/tree/main
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniEcho 提出空间音频-视觉基准 OmniEchoBench（6 项任务、197 个真实场景、2972 个问答、900 条 FOA 导航样本）与配套可控空间音频渲染管线，并在其上构建带 FOA 空间编码器的全模态模型 OmniEcho。在空间音频-视觉感知上达到 SOTA，声音引导导航性能接近传统视觉-语言导航；细粒度定位与距离估计仍是开放难题。
Motivation: 具身智能体难以像人一样定位声源方向并与视觉线索联合推理，且如何在具身场景中评测与建模空间音频理解一直缺少统一基准。
Method: 构建 OmniEchoBench：6 项任务、197 个真实空间音视场景、2972 个 QA、900 条来自 30 个真实环境的一阶 ambisonics (FOA) 导航样本；开发保持声源-视觉观测-轨迹几何一致的可控空间音频渲染管线；提出 OmniEcho 模型，含 FOA 空间编码器与预训练语义音频通路。
Result: OmniEcho 在空间音频-视觉感知上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；在声音引导导航上达到接近传统视觉-语言导航的水平。基准规模为 6 任务、197 场景、2972 QA、900 导航样本、30 个真实环境。
Conclusion: 空间音频可作为具身场景推理与导航的有效信号，但细粒度空间定位与距离估计仍是重要开放挑战。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Leaky-integrator reconstruction: taming error accumulation in recursive differenced time-series forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Recursive differenced forecasting, the standard remedy for non-stationarity, predicts one-step changes and integrates them by cumulative summation. We show that this reconstruction is a discrete integrator with a pole on the unit circle, so the biased increment errors of a learned nonlinear model are summed without bound and the rollout diverges: at 336 steps its normalised MAE reaches 1.6-3.8 for every neural architecture tested, against 0.80 for a stable linear recursion. We then introduce leaky-integrator reconstruction, a training-free fix that moves the pole inside the unit circle with H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1), gamma < 1, bounding the accumulation of the model's own increment errors. Applied post hoc with a single fixed gamma=0.9 (no retraining, a two-line change to any deployed one-step or foundation-model forecaster), it beats the traditional recursive integrator at every horizon, with the mean gain over seven diverging architectures and twenty datasets growing from ~3% at H=24 to 23% at H=96, 37% at H=192 and 51% at H=336 (43-75% across those architectures; 78% with an oracle pole), bringing all of them to 0.87-0.97. Based on these extensive empirical experiments, adding a leaky integrator thus improves recursive differenced time-series forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 递归差分预测把一步增量做累加求和，等价于单位圆上极点的离散积分器，学到的有偏增量误差被无界累加导致 rollout 发散：336 步时所有测试神经架构的归一化 MAE 达 1.6-3.8，而稳定线性递归仅 0.80。作者提出训练无关的 leaky-integrator reconstruction，把极点移到 H(z)=1/(1-γz⁻¹)、γ<1，事后固定 γ=0.9 即可，在每个时效上都胜过传统递归积分器。
Motivation: 递归差分是处理非平稳时间序列的标准手段，但其累加重构让有偏增量误差无界累积，任何神经架构在长时效 rollout 上都会发散。
Method: leaky-integrator reconstruction：把累加积分器换成 H(z)=1/(1-γz⁻¹)、γ<1 的漏积分器，从而约束模型自身增量误差的累积；作为事后 (post hoc) 修复，单一固定 γ=0.9、无需重训练，可对任何已部署的一步或 foundation-model 预报器做两行改动。
Result: 传统递归积分在 336 步时归一化 MAE 为 1.6-3.8（所有测试神经架构），稳定线性递归为 0.80；漏积分器在七个发散架构、二十个数据集上每个时效均更优，平均增益从 H=24 的约 3% 增至 H=96 的 23%、H=192 的 37%、H=336 的 51%（跨架构 43-75%，oracle 极点 78%），并把全部架构拉回 0.87-0.97。
Conclusion: 给递归差分时间序列预报加一个漏积分器即可系统性改善长时效 rollout，且是无需重训练的事后修复。
Relevance: 35
