papers.title: PhenoBench: Mapping What a Deeply Phenotyped Human Cohort Can Tell Us
papers.abstract_en: Deeply phenotyped cohorts combine clinical, imaging, molecular, and wearable observations across timescales from seconds to years, but heterogeneous analyses are not directly comparable. We present PhenoBench, an executable benchmark that turns deep-phenotyping measurements into explicit questions and controlled comparisons of information sources and predictive models. It is built around the Human Phenotype Project, with more than 13,000 participants at the initial visit. Each question fixes the target, population, timing, and allowed information; its evaluation contract specifies the split, metric, baseline, and claim boundary. PhenoBench defines 90 clinically grounded tasks across 15 domains and 26 input modalities. Across 160 matched regression comparisons spanning 52 tasks, six pretrained tabular models ranked above the evaluated task-specific baselines, including XGBoost and CatBoost, under a fixed single-estimator protocol with bounded tuning. Giving each task equal weight, their mean advantage over ridge was 0.0103 $R^2$ (95% task-bootstrap interval, 0.0071-0.0136). We also evaluated 14 language models, collectively covering 40 tasks spanning phenotype recovery, classification, follow-up forecasting, and participant ordering. Without cohort-specific fitting, language models made informative predictions on some tasks but showed task-specific capability gaps, shared failures of scale, and rarely surpassed task-specific ridge or logistic regression models fitted on the same input fields. PhenoBench provides a versioned, auditable evaluation system where new questions, measurements, and models can be added without redefining existing comparisons.
papers.comment: 35 pages; 4 main figures, 5 supplementary figures, and 1 extended-data figure. Expanded model comparisons; corrected paired summaries; clarified evaluation protocols and limitations. Project website: https://galsapir.github.io/phenobench-benchmark/ . Code and benchmark materials: https://github.com/galsapir/phenobench-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhenoBench 把 Human Phenotype Project（初访逾 13,000 名参与者）的深度表型数据转成可执行基准，每个问题固定目标、人群、时机与允许信息，并规定 split、指标、基线和 claim 边界。在 160 组匹配回归比较（覆盖 52 个任务）中，六个预训练表格模型（含 XGBoost、CatBoost）在固定单估计器协议下平均仅比 ridge 高 0.0103 R²（95% task-bootstrap 区间 0.0071–0.0136）；14 个语言模型覆盖 40 个任务，不做队列特异拟合时很少超过同输入的 ridge 或 logistic 回归。
Motivation: 深度表型队列横跨临床、影像、分子与可穿戴多尺度观测，但各研究分析异构、结果不可直接比较，缺少统一的问题定义与受控比较框架。
Method: 以 Human Phenotype Project 为底座，定义 90 个临床任务、15 个领域、26 种输入模态；每个问题固定 target、population、timing、allowed information，evaluation contract 规定 split、metric、baseline 与 claim boundary。回归侧在固定单估计器、有限调参协议下做 160 组匹配比较；另评 14 个语言模型在 phenotype recovery、classification、follow-up forecasting、participant ordering 上的零队列拟合表现。
Result: 160 组匹配回归比较覆盖 52 个任务，六个预训练表格模型（含 XGBoost、CatBoost）排名高于所评任务特异基线；等权平均相对 ridge 的优势为 0.0103 R²（95% task-bootstrap 区间 0.0071–0.0136）。14 个语言模型合计覆盖 40 个任务，不做队列特异拟合时在部分任务上有信息量，但存在任务特异能力缺口与共同的规模失效，很少超过同输入字段上的 ridge 或 logistic 回归。
Conclusion: 深度表型预测中预训练表格模型的增益很小（约 0.01 R²），语言模型零拟合时基本不敌简单线性基线；版本化、可审计的 evaluation contract 让新问题与新模型可加入而不重定义既有比较。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Task-Aware QUBO Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-precision quantization requires discrete allocation of weight and activation bit-widths, followed by recovery of the selected network. We develop a task-aware quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) surrogate with separate weight and activation profiles, a bit-operation (BOP) cost, and selected structural priors. QUBO provides a network-wide allocation that can be refined through direct validation-based PROTES search. On a compact NAFBlock-based denoiser, the refined route achieves 37.192 dB after LSQ+ at 4.035\% routed-layer BOPs, versus 37.092 dB at 4.101\% for a HAWQ-style baseline. The repeated-search primary experiment shows that LSQ+ largely closes the quality gap between QUBO allocation and expensive direct refinement. An additional restoration architecture retains a larger recovered gain, indicating that refinement's value depends on architecture and recovery. We evaluate quality, achieved cost, routing stability and optimization expense together. Deployment measurements characterize a fake-quantized floating-point implementation; BOP reductions describe analytical allocation savings.
papers.comment: Substantially revised version with expanded experiments, additional architectures and baselines, robustness analysis, and updated presentation. Corrected the title metadata
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出任务感知的 QUBO 混合精度量化分配方法：用二次无约束二值优化同时分配权重与激活位宽，含 BOP 成本与结构先验，再用基于验证的 PROTES 搜索精修。在 NAFBlock 去噪器上，精修路线以 4.035% 路由层 BOP 达到 37.192 dB，优于 HAWQ 风格基线的 37.092 dB @ 4.101%；但 LSQ+ 恢复基本抹平 QUBO 分配与昂贵直接精修的差距，精修价值取决于架构与恢复方式。
Motivation: 混合精度量化需要先离散分配权重与激活位宽再恢复网络，直接搜索昂贵，而网络级分配与恢复阶段的耦合使成本-质量权衡难以兼顾。
Method: 构建任务感知 QUBO surrogate，含独立的权重/激活位宽 profile、bit-operation (BOP) 成本项与选定结构先验，给出网络级分配；再用基于直接验证的 PROTES 搜索精修，配合 LSQ+ 量化恢复，在 NAFBlock 去噪器及另一恢复架构上评估质量、实际成本、路由稳定性与优化开销。
Result: NAFBlock 去噪器上精修路线经 LSQ+ 后达 37.192 dB，路由层 BOP 占 4.035%；HAWQ 风格基线为 37.092 dB @ 4.101% BOP。重复搜索主实验显示 LSQ+ 基本抹平 QUBO 分配与昂贵直接精修的质量差距；另一恢复架构保留更大的恢复增益。部署测量对应 fake-quantized 浮点实现，BOP 降低为分析性分配节省。
Conclusion: QUBO 分配加 LSQ+ 恢复已能逼近昂贵精修，精修的额外收益取决于架构与恢复方式；评估需把质量、BOP 成本、路由稳定性与优化开销放在一起看。

papers.title: Conditioning Degenerate Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Current conditioned generative models heavily rely on score functions for guidance during training. When the generative model is a diffusion process with a singular diffusion coefficient and the underlying (conditional) densities either do not exist or are not smooth, we use causal optimal transport to define \emph{approximate} loss functions that identify a minimum-entropy control for guidance under minimal assumptions. Our approach relies on causal optimal transport and its characterization through the predictable representation property of (conditioned) diffusion processes whose associated martingale problem is well posed, à la Üstünel.
papers.comment: v2: Fixed typos in the affiliation and citations, and added a new definition in appendix to clarify the terminology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散系数奇异、条件密度不存在或不光滑的退化扩散生成模型，用因果最优传输 (causal optimal transport) 定义近似损失函数，在最小假设下识别用于引导的最小熵控制。该刻画依赖条件扩散过程可预测表示性质 (predictable representation property)，且要求其关联的 martingale problem 适定（à la Üstünel）。
Motivation: 现有条件生成模型的引导高度依赖 score function，但当扩散过程系数奇异、条件密度不存在或不光滑时 score 无法定义，训练引导失效。
Method: 以因果最优传输构造近似损失函数替代 score 引导；刻画依据条件扩散过程的可预测表示性质，前提是其关联 martingale problem 适定（à la Üstünel），并在最小假设下求解最小熵控制。
Result: 在最小假设下给出可识别最小熵引导控制的近似损失函数构造及其可预测表示刻画；摘要未给出实验或数值结果。
Conclusion: 奇异扩散下的条件引导可绕开 score function，改由因果最优传输与 martingale problem 适定性给出最小熵控制的定义。

papers.title: Learning Informative Prior with Infinite-Dimensional Continuous Normalizing Flow for Bayesian Inverse Problem
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses infinite-dimensional Bayesian inference for inverse problem of partial differential equations with model parameters in infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. To effectively incorporate prior information, we propose a novel continuous normalizing flows based infinite-dimensional model. Specifically, by introducing a well-defined neural ordinary differential equation in infinite-dimensional space, a simple reference measure can be transformed into a more complex measure which encodes the prior information. A corresponding theoretical framework is established to ensure the well-posedness of our proposed Bayesian prior in infinite-dimensional space. We also provide training methods of the prior for two distinct data settings, along with two sampling algorithms for the resulting Bayesian posterior. The proposed framework is applied to three representative inverse problems: the simple smooth inverse problem, inverse scattering problem, and the inverse heat conduction problem. Numerical experiments support the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于无限维连续 normalizing flow (CNF) 的贝叶斯先验学习框架：在无限维 Hilbert 空间中用定义良好的 neural ODE 把简单参考测度变换为编码先验信息的复杂测度，并建立理论框架保证该贝叶斯先验的适定性 (well-posedness)。针对两种数据设置给出先验训练方法与两种后验采样算法，在光滑逆问题、逆散射、逆热传导三类反问题上数值实验支持理论分析并展示算法效率。
Motivation: PDE 反问题的模型参数位于无限维 Hilbert 空间，如何在该空间中有效引入先验信息并保证贝叶斯先验适定，是无限维贝叶斯推断的核心困难。
Method: 用无限维空间中定义良好的 neural ODE 构建 continuous normalizing flow，把简单参考测度变换为编码先验信息的复杂测度；建立保证无限维先验适定性的理论框架；针对两种不同数据设置提供先验训练方法，并给出两种贝叶斯后验采样算法。

papers.title: RideSkill: A Hierarchical Algorithm for Generalized Ride Sharing with LLM-Driven Automatic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Ride-sharing, which allows multiple passengers with different origin-destination (OD) pairs to share a single vehicle, is a challenging operational problem, as it requires orders with different OD pairs to be efficiently bundled and assigned to vehicles under uncertain and varying scenarios. Although multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) solutions have achieved promising performance, they suffer from limited generalization (adapting to different environmental scenarios), low transferability (adapting to different platform objectives), and training difficulties in large-scale systems, such as the curse of dimensionality. Recently, motivated by the scaling of large language models (LLMs), several works have incorporated LLMs into ride-hailing systems, either by employing LLMs directly as decision-making agents or using them for automatic algorithm design. However, none of these approaches support vehicle sharing, which complicates the problem by expanding both the state and action spaces exponentially. Moreover, most of them require frequent LLM calls at inference time, making them infeasible for real-time deployment. To address these issues, we propose RideSkill, a hierarchical method for ride-sharing that leverages LLM-assisted automatic algorithmic design. RideSkill consists of a combiner that assigns appropriate skills to each vehicle from a learned skill repository, enabling adaptive dispatch under varying scenarios and objectives, and a repositioner that sequentially relocates idle vehicles to emerging regions, avoiding conflicts among vehicles. Crucially, the skill repository, combiner, and repositioner are all trained by an LLM-based automatic evolutionary method, eliminating the need for LLM calls during deployment and thus ensuring high real-time performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RideSkill 用 LLM 辅助的自动进化把拼车（ride-sharing）策略压成一个可复用的技能库：combiner 从库中为每辆车挑技能实现自适应派单，repositioner 顺序迁移空车避免冲突，三者全部由 LLM 进化得到，部署时不再调用 LLM。作者称该设计同时缓解 MARL 的泛化差、迁移差与大规模训练难，并保证实时性。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习在拼车派单上泛化与迁移都受限，大规模下还有维数灾难；已有 LLM 接入打车系统的工作不支持多人共乘，且推理期频繁调用 LLM 无法实时部署。
Method: 分层结构：combiner 从学习得到的 skill repository 中为每辆车分配技能以适配不同场景与平台目标，repositioner 依次把空车迁往新出现的需求区域并避免车辆间冲突；skill repository、combiner、repositioner 三者均由基于 LLM 的自动进化方法训练。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性主张：支持不同 OD 对的多人共乘，状态与动作空间因共乘指数级扩大；部署期无需 LLM 调用，因而具备高实时性能。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 用在离线算法设计而非在线决策，可以在保留自适应派单与跨目标迁移的同时满足实时部署约束。

papers.title: HANIA: Planner-Guided Multimodal Graph Evidence Selection for Grounded Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal question answering remains sensitive to noisy, incomplete, and weakly grounded evidence. Long unstructured contexts can introduce redundancy and encourage unsupported generation, while flat retrieval may overlook relations needed for multi-step reasoning. We present HANIA, a planner-guided multimodal graph framework for evidence-grounded question answering. HANIA processes the supplied image and text using a frozen vision-language model to extract concise question-relevant visual evidence with explicit abstention. It then constructs an input-grounded multimodal graph and applies a two-group finite-state planner to coordinate descriptive and relational evidence. Coverage-aware pruning retains a compact evidence set based on relevance, graph confidence, concept coverage, and modality diversity. The selected passages, visual statements, and graph triples are provided to a frozen instruction-tuned decoder. We evaluate HANIA on ScienceQA using answer accuracy, evidence-filtering quality, evidence-budget sensitivity, and efficiency. The results show that structured evidence planning and compact graph-guided retrieval can support competitive multimodal question answering without target-dataset fine-tuning or iterative retrieval. The code is available at https://github.com/Zafar-southeast/HANIA.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at Graph-enhanced LLMs for trustwOrthy Web data management (GLOW), ISWC 2026 Workshops, Bari, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HANIA 用冻结的视觉-语言模型抽取问题相关的视觉证据并显式弃权，构建输入接地的多模态图，再用两组有限状态规划器协调描述性与关系性证据，经覆盖感知剪枝保留紧凑证据集交给冻结指令微调解码器。在 ScienceQA 上以答案准确率、证据过滤质量、证据预算敏感性和效率评测，无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索即可达到有竞争力的多模态问答表现。
Motivation: 多模态问答对噪声、不完整和弱接地证据敏感：长上下文带来冗余并诱发无依据生成，扁平检索又漏掉多步推理所需的关系。
Method: 冻结 VLM 从图像与文本抽取简洁的问题相关视觉证据并显式弃权；构建输入接地的多模态图，用两组有限-state 规划器 (two-group finite-state planner) 协调描述性与关系性证据；按相关性、图置信度、概念覆盖与模态多样性做覆盖感知剪枝，把选中的段落、视觉陈述与图三元组交给冻结的指令微调解码器。
Result: 在 ScienceQA 上评测答案准确率、证据过滤质量、证据预算敏感性与效率，结果显示结构化证据规划与紧凑图引导检索可支持有竞争力的多模态问答，且无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索。
Conclusion: 在不微调目标数据集、不做迭代检索的条件下，图结构的证据规划加紧凑剪枝足以支撑有竞争力的 ScienceQA 多模态问答。

papers.title: How Far Can 5,500 Hours of Driving Take You? A Scaling Law Analysis of Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Video generation for autonomous driving cannot follow the web-scale route: driving data is expensive to collect, bound by privacy requirements, and cannot be scraped at will, so models must make the most of a fixed corpus. We present a systematic scaling-law study of video diffusion models trained from scratch on driving data: a family of models from 1M to 9B parameters, trained at different exposures on up to 5,500 hours of driving. Validation loss follows consistent power laws in both model size and training exposure, answering the questions that shape a training budget: whether compute is better spent on longer training or on a larger model, and whether more data is needed. Loss improves much faster with training exposure than with model size, making longer training the most effective way to improve a fixed model under limited compute. However, larger models continue to achieve lower asymptotic loss, so compute-optimal scaling still favors increasing model size when sufficient compute and data are available. Guided by these laws, we train a 9B-parameter model, to our knowledge the largest video diffusion model trained from scratch on driving data: it sets a new open-source state of the art for driving video generation, as measured on nuScenes. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/valeoai/VATIX. NATIX is separately releasing the underlying driving data in stages.
papers.journal_ref: [Archival Track] ECCV 2026 DriveX - 6th Workshop on Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定 5,500 小时驾驶数据上从零训练视频扩散模型族（1M–9B 参数），验证损失对模型规模与训练曝光量都服从稳定幂律，且损失随训练曝光量下降远快于随模型规模下降。结论是算力受限时优先延长训练，算力与数据充足时仍应加大模型以获得更低渐近损失；据此训练的 9B 模型在 nuScenes 上取得驾驶视频生成的开源新 SOTA。
Motivation: 驾驶数据昂贵、受隐私约束、无法随意爬取，视频生成无法走 web-scale 路线，训练预算必须在“训更久”与“建更大”之间做取舍，缺少可依据的定量规律。
Method: 从零训练一族视频扩散模型，参数量 1M 到 9B，在最多 5,500 小时驾驶数据上取不同训练曝光量，拟合验证损失对模型规模与曝光量的幂律；再按所得规律指导训练 9B 模型，代码与预训练模型开源（github.com/valeoai/VATIX）。
Result: 验证损失在模型规模与训练曝光量两个维度上均呈一致幂律；损失随训练曝光量的改善远快于随模型规模的改善，故固定模型在有限算力下延长训练最有效；但更大模型持续达到更低渐近损失，算力充足时 compute-optimal scaling 仍偏向加大模型。9B 模型（据作者所知为从零训练的最大驾驶视频扩散模型）在 nuScenes 上取得驾驶视频生成的开源 SOTA。
Conclusion: 算力受限时把预算花在更长训练上回报更高，算力与数据充足时则应扩大模型规模；在 5,500 小时这一固定语料上，按幂律分配预算可训出开源最优的驾驶视频生成模型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Conditional Visual Evidence Utility: State-Dependent Rank Reversals in Frozen Vision-Language Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Static importance scores compress visual evidence into a single ranking, but the value of remaining evidence can change after one cue has been observed. We study this possibility in controlled compositional visual search, where color, shape, and texture evidence can be independently exposed and their conditional marginal utility measured across acquisition states. In a held-out confirmation on 800 scenes, frozen OpenCLIP and SigLIP exhibit robust state-dependent rank reversals that concentrate in candidate-overlap regimes designed to induce ordering changes, persist across two evidence-accumulation constructions and ten equivalent query wordings, and collapse to near-chance-scale behavior under query-scene derangement. A subsequent role-balanced follow-up on 1,200 scenes rotates the abstract roles of initially strong, redundancy-inducing, and comparator attributes; the positive-minus-negative reversal contrast remains positive across all 24 role-permutation, backbone, and evidence-mode cells, although residual attribute-identity effects remain. We further distinguish measured replanning opportunity from prospective predictability. Matched-first-action utility analyses show substantial opportunity to rerank remaining evidence, but lightweight predictors using posterior-based or acquired-embedding state representations do not establish a robust incremental advantage of acquired-state information over legal static controls on the role-balanced benchmark. Together, these results show that conditional visual evidence utility is reliably state dependent in this controlled setting, while separating the existence of changing utility from the stronger claim that those changes are prospectively predictable by a learned selector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控组合视觉搜索中，颜色、形状、纹理证据可独立暴露并逐状态测量条件边际效用；在 800 个留出场景上，冻结的 OpenCLIP 与 SigLIP 出现稳健的状态依赖排序反转，且集中在候选重叠 (candidate-overlap) 区制。1,200 场景的角色轮换复验中，正减负反转对比在全部 24 个角色排列×骨干×证据模式组合上保持为正，但轻量预测器无法在合法静态对照之上确立已获状态信息的稳健增量优势。
Motivation: 静态重要性分数把视觉证据压成单一排序，但观测到某个线索后剩余证据的价值可能改变；需要区分效用确实会变与这些变化能否被学习到的 selector 前瞻性预测。
Method: 在受控组合视觉搜索中独立暴露 color、shape、texture 证据并跨获取状态测量条件边际效用；用冻结 OpenCLIP 与 SigLIP 做 800 场景留出确认，再做 1,200 场景的角色平衡轮换（旋转初始强属性、冗余诱导属性、比较属性的抽象角色），并用基于后验或已获 embedding 状态表示的轻量预测器对比合法静态对照。
Result: 800 场景留出确认中，OpenCLIP 与 SigLIP 呈稳健状态依赖排序反转，集中于为诱发排序改变而设计的候选重叠区制，跨两种证据累积构造与十种等价查询措辞均持续，query-scene derangement 后坍缩到近随机水平；1,200 场景角色平衡复验中，正减负反转对比在全部 24 个角色排列、骨干与证据模式组合上保持为正，但仍有残余属性身份效应；matched-first-action utility 分析显示大量重排剩余证据的机会，而轻量预测器未确立已获状态信息相对合法静态对照的稳健增量优势。
Conclusion: 在该受控设定下条件视觉证据效用可靠地依赖状态，但效用会变这一事实与这些变化可被学习 selector 前瞻预测的更强主张必须分开。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 在受控组合视觉搜索中独立暴露 color、shape、texture 证据并跨获取状态测量条件边际效用；用冻结 OpenCLIP 与 SigLIP 做 800 场景留出确认，再做 1,200 场景的角色平衡轮换（旋转初始强属性、冗余诱导属性、比较属性的抽象角色），并用基于后验或已获 embedding 状态表示的轻量预测器对比合法静态对照。
summary_sections.result: 800 场景留出确认中，OpenCLIP 与 SigLIP 呈稳健状态依赖排序反转，集中于为诱发排序改变而设计的候选重叠区制，跨两种证据累积构造与十种等价查询措辞均持续，query-scene derangement 后坍缩到近随机水平；1,200 场景角色平衡复验中，正减负反转对比在全部 24 个角色排列、骨干与证据模式组合上保持为正，但仍有残余属性身份效应；matched-first-action utility 分析显示大量重排剩余证据的机会，而轻量预测器未确立已获状态信息相对合法静态对照的稳健增量优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在该受控设定下条件视觉证据效用可靠地依赖状态，但效用会变这一事实与这些变化可被学习 selector 前瞻预测的更强主张必须分开。

papers.title: Memory Is Not Always Needed: Characterizing Conditional Memory in Scientific Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Scientific reasoning requires language models to retrieve specialized knowledge and incorporate it reliably into multi-step computation. Conditional memory provides an explicit lookup pathway that complements dense neural representations, but its usefulness is inherently input- and computation-dependent: retrieved information may repair missing scientific associations, yet it may also introduce distracting shortcuts or interfere with reasoning that the base model can already perform correctly. In this work, we systematically investigate when, where, and to what extent conditional memory should participate in scientific reasoning. We characterize the scientific knowledge boundary and controlled interventions on memory-enabled knowledge-circuit nodes. Based on these analyses, we propose a Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router that uses task-specific input proxies available before generation to determine whether memory is activated, which layer-stage nodes receive memory signals, and how strongly these signals contribute. Experiments on biological and chemical reasoning benchmarks, covering two backbone families and six task types, show that memory effects vary substantially across inputs, tasks, and injection locations. Compared with static and activation-rate-matched random routing, our approach more consistently preserves beneficial memory contributions while suppressing memory-induced regressions, establishing selective memory allocation as an important principle for reliable scientific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出知识边界感知路由器 (Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router)，用生成前可得的任务输入代理决定是否启用条件记忆、在哪一层阶段节点注入以及注入强度。在生物与化学推理基准、两个骨干家族、六类任务上，记忆效应随输入、任务和注入位置大幅变化，该路由比静态路由与激活率匹配的随机路由更能保留有益记忆贡献并抑制记忆引发的回退。
Motivation: 条件记忆的检索结果既可能补上模型缺失的科学关联，也可能引入干扰捷径、干扰模型本已能做对的推理，静态启用记忆无法区分这两种情形。
Method: 先刻画科学知识边界，并对记忆使能的知识电路节点做受控干预；据此构建 Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router，用生成前的任务输入代理决定记忆是否激活、哪些 layer-stage 节点接收记忆信号以及信号贡献强度。
Result: 在生物与化学推理基准上、覆盖两个骨干家族与六类任务类型，记忆效应随输入、任务和注入位置显著变化；与静态路由及激活率匹配的随机路由相比，该方法更一致地保留有益记忆贡献并抑制记忆导致的回退。
Conclusion: 选择性记忆分配 (selective memory allocation) 是可靠科学推理的一条原则：记忆该不该参与、参与多深应按输入与任务逐例决定，而非全局开关。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Anchoring Instruction Outside Mask: Exact Reference Caching for Efficient In-Context Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal generation is central to a wide range of content creation and editing applications. In-context conditioning is essential to this paradigm. It allows diffusion transformers to process text instructions and visual references in a shared attention sequence. However, each reference image introduces thousands of tokens. Computation therefore grows rapidly with the number of references. Existing methods reduce computation through structured sparse attention, which limits interactions between reference and target tokens. This structure also makes the reference K and V independent of the denoising target, allowing them to be computed once and reused across steps. However, it blocks visual references from attending to the text instruction. This substantially degrades instruction following and reference fidelity in multi-reference editing. To resolve this conflict, we jointly redesign the token sequence and attention mask. Our beyond-mask design uses static text anchors to connect the instruction to the reference branch. It preserves exact K and V reuse without adding parameters. However, this direct architectural conversion degrades generation quality. We recover the lost performance through teacher-forced velocity distillation, followed by a short on-policy stage in which the teacher supervises student-visited states. To our knowledge, this is the first use of on-policy distillation for architectural recovery in diffusion models. Across three image-editing benchmarks, our method matches full-attention generation quality. With five reference images, it accelerates the complete 40-step denoising process by 3.92x, while static text anchors introduce negligible runtime overhead; the speedup reaches 5.47x at ten references in our scaling study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多参考图像编辑的 diffusion transformer 中，用静态 text anchor 把文本指令接到 reference 分支的 attention mask 之外，使 reference 的 K/V 仍可跨去噪步复用；直接改架构会掉画质，再用 teacher-forced velocity distillation 加一段 on-policy 蒸馏把质量补回。三个图像编辑基准上达到 full-attention 的生成质量，5 张参考图时 40 步去噪整体加速 3.92x，10 张参考图时达 5.47x。
Motivation: in-context 条件化中每张参考图引入数千 token，计算随参考数激增；已有结构化稀疏注意力虽让 K/V 可复用，却阻断了参考 token 对文本指令的注意力，多参考编辑时指令跟随与参考保真度明显下降。
Method: 重新设计 token 序列与 attention mask 的 beyond-mask 方案，用静态 text anchor 连接指令与 reference 分支，不引入新参数且保留 K/V 精确复用；架构改动造成的画质损失用 teacher-forced velocity distillation 恢复，随后接一段短的 on-policy 阶段，由 teacher 监督 student 访问过的状态。
Result: 在三个图像编辑基准上匹配 full-attention 的生成质量；5 张参考图时整个 40 步去噪加速 3.92x，静态 text anchor 的运行时开销可忽略，scaling study 中 10 张参考图时加速达 5.47x。
Conclusion: 指令与参考分支的注意力连通性和 K/V 复用可以同时保住，代价由蒸馏而非参数补偿；作者称这是 diffusion 模型中首次用 on-policy 蒸馏做架构改动后的画质恢复。

papers.title: Intervention, Not Shared Latents: Blocking Visual Shortcuts in Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio--video (AV) generators are trained on data in which \emph{what an event looks like} and \emph{what it sounds like} are spuriously correlated. We present a \emph{controlled causal study} of the resulting failure mode. In an AV structural causal model where the audio is, by construction, independent of the video's nuisance appearance, models that let audio read video directly---through cross-attention or a shared latent---learn a \emph{visual shortcut}: they predict sound from appearance rather than the causal event and, when the appearance--event correlation is broken at test time, synthesize the wrong event's sound. Crucially, the popular remedy of routing both modalities through a \emph{shared common-cause latent} does \emph{not} fix this---a bottleneck, an unsupervised shared/private factorization, and a faithful shared-prior model all grab the appearance proxy and fail like the direct model. Blocking the shortcut instead requires an \emph{intervention on the nuisance}: under the stated assumptions we prove that counterfactual invariance is necessary and sufficient to identify the causal predictor, and we verify the mechanism from feature-vector SCMs to procedural pixel video, real images with spectrogram audio, moving real digits, and a conditional generator. On a \emph{real, pretrained} V2A generator (MMAudio), an input-intervention test shows the model is far from invariant to sound-irrelevant edits, though a generic-noise control reveals it is broadly input-brittle rather than specifically colour-shortcutting---clean isolation of the shortcut needs the controlled confounds our synthetic studies provide. We characterize \emph{when} the shortcut occurs, compare the objective against supervised counterfactual augmentation, and isolate the \emph{unknown-nuisance} regime---where the intervention cannot be applied---as the central open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 音视频联合生成中，让音频直接读视频（cross-attention 或共享隐变量）会学到视觉捷径：从外观而非因果事件预测声音，测试时外观-事件相关被打破就合成错误事件的声音。共享 common-cause 瓶颈、无监督 shared/private 分解、shared-prior 模型都照样抓外观代理而失败；只有对 nuisance 做干预、满足 counterfactual invariance 才能在给定假设下识别因果预测子。
Motivation: 音视频训练数据中事件的外观与声音存在伪相关，导致生成器从外观而非事件本身推断声音；流行的共享隐变量正则并不能消除这一捷径。
Method: 构建音视频结构因果模型（SCM，其中音频对视频 nuisance 外观按构造独立），证明 counterfactual invariance 对识别因果预测子既必要又充分；在特征向量 SCM、程序化像素视频、真实图像+频谱图音频、移动真实数字与条件生成器上验证机制，并与有监督 counterfactual augmentation 对比目标函数。
Result: 在真实预训练 V2A 生成器 MMAudio 上的输入干预测试显示模型对与声音无关的编辑远非不变；但 generic-noise 对照表明它整体上对输入脆弱，而非特异地走颜色捷径。
Conclusion: 阻断视觉捷径需要对 nuisance 的干预而非共享隐变量；nuisance 未知、无法施加干预的 regime 是核心开放问题，干净隔离捷径需要受控混淆的合成研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Parameter-Free Few-Shot Evaluation for Elephant Vocalisation Classification
papers.abstract_en: We present a parameter-free episodic evaluation of nearest-centroid classification of elephant vocalisations on fixed pretrained embeddings, for the Elephant Voices (EV) and Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC) datasets. We ask not which embedding yields the best classifier trained on all labelled data, but how the simplest classifier performs as the number of exemplars per class varies. There are no learnable parameters, because each class is modelled as the mean of its support embeddings and each query is assigned to the nearest centroid under squared Euclidean distance. Evaluation covers the fixed Perch (ver. 1), Perch (ver. 2) and HuBERT (base, layer 2) embeddings, alongside mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) features, $N$-way $k$-shot, under the same stratified $K$-fold cross-validation protocol as the trained classifiers. None of these embedding models was trained to distinguish elephant call types. On the smaller EV dataset the centroid classifier is markedly data-efficient. Using Perch (ver. 1) or Perch (ver. 2) embeddings it overtakes in mean average precision (mAP) the fully-trained logistic regression (LR) baseline from one or two exemplars and the recurrent baseline from two. Over the reduced set of call types on which the strongly-supervised end-to-end baseline was trained, the centroid classifier using Perch (ver. 2) embeddings overtakes that baseline in mAP as well, from two exemplars. On the larger LDC dataset the recurrent baselines retain their advantage for all considered values of $k$. Only LR is overtaken, and only in mAP. Nearest-centroid classification is therefore preferable precisely when exemplars are few and the fixed embedding already separates the call types.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Camera-ready version accepted at SATNAC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对大象叫声分类提出无参数的 episodic 评估：在固定预训练 embedding（Perch v1/v2、HuBERT base layer 2、MFCC）上按类均值做最近质心分类，用 N-way k-shot 与分层 K 折交叉验证扫描每类样本数。在 EV 数据集上 Perch embedding 的质心分类器从 1–2 个样本起 mAP 就超过全量训练的 LR 基线、从 2 个起超过循环基线；在更大的 LDC 上循环基线在所有 k 值保持优势，仅 LR 在 mAP 上被超过。
Motivation: 现有评估只问哪个 embedding 配全量标签训练出的分类器最好，而没有回答在极少标注样本下最简单的分类器能到什么水平；同时这些 embedding 都不是为区分大象叫声类型而训练的。
Method: 每个类建模为 support embedding 的均值，query 按平方欧氏距离分配到最近质心，无可学习参数；在固定 Perch (ver. 1)、Perch (ver. 2)、HuBERT (base, layer 2) embedding 与 MFCC 特征上做 N-way k-shot 评估，采用与已训练分类器相同的分层 K 折交叉验证协议，数据集为 Elephant Voices (EV) 与 LDC。
Result: 在 EV 上，用 Perch v1 或 v2 embedding 的质心分类器从 1 或 2 个样本起 mAP 超过全量训练的 logistic regression 基线，从 2 个起超过循环基线；在强监督端到端基线所训练的那组缩减呼叫类型上，Perch v2 质心分类器也从 2 个样本起在 mAP 上超过该基线。在更大的 LDC 数据集上，循环基线在所有考虑的 k 值保持优势，只有 LR 被超过且仅在 mAP 指标上。
Conclusion: 最近质心分类恰好在样本极少且固定 embedding 已能分开呼叫类型时才是首选；样本量增大后（LDC）训练过的循环基线仍占优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
papers.abstract_en: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data dependency. To demonstrate the advantages (high generalizability and low data dependency) of this framework, we first built a dataset of 30K tool-use trajectories and action demonstrations, which is much smaller than those used by baseline methods. We then designed a training regimen for long-trajectory tool-use reasoning in challenging environments. Experiments show that ART achieves a 20% higher success rate than mainstream baselines on simulation and real-world tasks, such as pick-and-place in the dark at novel viewpoints. Empirical results highlight the benefits of an agent-based approach: modular tool utilization enables more efficient training, lightweight deployment, and scalable integration of new tools. This design fosters robustness, adaptability, and extensibility, paving the way for the practical deployment of VLA systems in complex real-world scenarios.

papers.title: Unifying Physical Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: Physical computing systems exploit device dynamics for computation, but their gradient-based optimization is challenging: backpropagation through a digital twin suffers from a model-reality gap. On-device gradient computation could resolve this issue, and a handful of theoretical and experimental studies have proposed ways to achieve it. Yet a unifying theory identifying when a physical system can compute the gradient of its own performance has been missing. Here we develop such a unification based on the adjoint method: we identify sufficient conditions under which the adjoint field required for formally exact gradients can be generated on the same hardware that performs the computation. Linear and nonlinear systems obey fundamentally different conditions: for linear systems, damping or gain is admissible provided reciprocity is preserved. For nonlinear trajectory systems, the sufficient conditions are reciprocity of the linearized system and the existence of a time-reversal mirror. Algorithmically, the nonlinear case requires infinitesimal nudging, whereas linear systems admit a finite-amplitude experiment. We recover (quantum) Equilibrium Propagation, Hamiltonian echo backpropagation, fully forward mode training and in situ gradient methods in integrated-photonic and free-space-optical systems. Finally, we show that reciprocity is a special case of more general intertwining conditions. For linear systems, these permit exact on-device gradients in a class of non-Hermitian, non-reciprocal systems. For nonlinear trajectories, they combine with generalized time-reversal mirrors to cover, e.g., PT-symmetric equations. The framework also includes time-dependent parameters and Onsager-reciprocal dynamics, providing a unified basis for formally exact physical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于伴随法 (adjoint method) 给出物理系统能否在自身硬件上算出精确梯度的统一充分条件：线性系统只要保持互易 (reciprocity)，允许阻尼或增益；非线性轨迹系统要求线性化系统互易且存在时间反演镜 (time-reversal mirror)，算法上需无穷小 nudging。该框架统一了 Equilibrium Propagation、Hamiltonian echo backpropagation、全前向模式训练与集成光子/自由空间光学中的原位梯度方法，并推广到非厄米非互易系统与 PT 对称方程。
Motivation: 物理计算靠器件动力学做计算，但梯度优化依赖数字孪生反向传播，存在 model-reality gap；此前缺少统一理论判定物理系统何时能计算自身性能的梯度。
Method: 以伴随法为基础推导充分条件，区分线性与非线性轨迹系统：线性情形允许阻尼/增益但须保互易，可做有限幅度实验；非线性情形要求线性化互易加时间反演镜，需无穷小 nudging。再把互易推广为更一般的 intertwining 条件，纳入时变参数与 Onsager 互易动力学。
Result: 证明线性系统在保持互易时阻尼或增益不妨碍精确原位梯度；非线性轨迹系统的充分条件是线性化系统互易加时间反演镜存在。框架恢复 (quantum) Equilibrium Propagation、Hamiltonian echo backpropagation、全前向模式训练与集成光子/自由空间光学系统中的原位梯度方法；intertwining 条件使一类非厄米非互易线性系统也能得到精确原位梯度，并经广义时间反演镜覆盖 PT 对称方程。
Conclusion: 物理学习的精确原位梯度可由互易与 intertwining 这两类条件统一判定，互易只是更一般条件的特例；线性与非线性系统服从本质上不同的条件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: How a shared state is described determines whether AI agents synchronize
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly act in populations, where the outcome that matters is collective: whether they align, split or fail to coordinate. Each acts not on the world but on a text description of it, a choice usually fixed in software. Using synchronization, the canonical probe of how interaction rules produce collective order, we show that this choice can decide the outcome. Agents on a circle chose to advance, stay or move back after reading the others' relative positions, in 507,112 valid responses across matched populations, controlled inputs and three model families. In GPT, numerical summaries aligned every matched population at both positive couplings, whereas histograms aligned none; Claude showed the reverse at the stronger coupling. Re-describing identical states shifted action probabilities in all three families, even between histograms carrying the same information. No single directional coefficient explained the outcome: state descriptions are part of the interaction rule that turns individual responses into collective order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在圆环同步 (Kuramoto-like synchronization) 探针中，AI agent 只读到对共享状态的文本描述，而描述方式本身决定群体结局：GPT 在两个正耦合强度下用数值摘要使全部配对群体同步、直方图一个都不同步，Claude 在较强耦合下恰好相反。重述信息等价的状态也会移动三个模型家族的动作概率，说明状态描述是把个体反应变成集体秩序的交互规则的一部分。
Motivation: 语言模型 agent 在群体中行动时，决定集体结局的不是世界本身而是对它的文本描述，而这一描述通常在软件里被固定下来；此前不清楚这一选择能否决定同步与否。
Method: 以同步作为交互规则产生集体秩序的标准探针，让 agent 站在圆环上、读取其他 agent 的相对位置后选择前进、停留或后退；在配对群体、受控输入和三个模型家族上采集 507,112 条有效回答，比较数值摘要与直方图等不同状态描述。
Result: 共 507,112 条有效回答；GPT 在两个正耦合下数值摘要使每个配对群体都同步而直方图全部不同步，Claude 在较强耦合下结果反转；三个模型家族中，重述相同状态（包括信息相同的两个直方图）都会移动动作概率；没有任何单一方向性系数能解释结局。
Conclusion: 状态描述不是中性的表示选择，而是交互规则的组成部分，必须与耦合强度和模型家族一起才能解释群体同步与否。

papers.title: TACT: Taxonomy-Aligned Post-Training for Pedagogically Adaptive English Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide conversational practice for English-as-a-second-language (ESL) learners. Effective ESL tutoring, however, requires more than fluent response generation: a tutor must select an appropriate pedagogical action based on learner behavior and dialogue context. Human-tutoring research offers principles for adaptive support, but they are often task-specific and remain insufficiently integrated into LLM-based ESL tutor training and evaluation. We present TACT (Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor), a human-grounded framework for post-training and evaluating pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors. Drawing on established literature, we develop two complementary taxonomies: the Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy with 13 tutor response strategies and the Student-Move Taxonomy characterizing learner behavior by move type and status. Using these taxonomies, we construct TACTCorpus, which enriches 260 authentic teacher-student conversations with 32,379 annotations and quality-controlled augmented training data. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through supervised fine-tuning followed by taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization, producing TACTutor and optimizing it for scaffolding quality rather than reference imitation alone. On TACTBench, a strategy-balanced diagnostic benchmark comprising 78 authentic tutoring contexts, TACTutor improves over its backbone by 20.30% and outperforms all evaluated proprietary baselines under the same protocol, while maintaining backbone performance on established external educational benchmarks; in a blinded study with 50 learners, it also receives the highest overall mean rating among the evaluated tutors. We release the data, benchmark, and model weights, providing an open foundation for developing pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACT 用 Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy（13 种导师策略）与 Student-Move Taxonomy 两个分类体系，对 Qwen3.5-4B 做 SFT 加 taxonomy-aligned GRPO 后训练，产出按脚手架质量优化的 ESL 导师 TACTutor。在 78 个真实教学情境的 TACTBench 上，TACTutor 比原 backbone 提升 20.30%，同协议下超过全部受评闭源基线，且在 50 名学习者的盲测中获最高总体均分。
Motivation: LLM 英语辅导只生成流畅回复不够，导师需按学习者行为与对话上下文选择合适教学动作；人类导师研究的自适应原则多为任务特定，未充分融入 LLM 导师的训练与评测。
Method: 构建两个互补分类体系（13 种导师回应策略的 Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy、按 move type 与 status 刻画学习者的 Student-Move Taxonomy），据此构造 TACTCorpus：260 段真实师生对话、32,379 条标注及质量受控的增强训练数据；对 Qwen3.5-4B 先做监督微调，再用 taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization 后训练。
Result: 在 TACTBench（78 个真实辅导情境、策略均衡的诊断基准）上，TACTutor 较其 backbone 提升 20.30%，同协议下优于所有受评闭源基线，并在既有外部教育基准上保持 backbone 水平；50 名学习者的盲测中它获得所有受评导师的最高总体均分。
Conclusion: 把人类导师教学分类体系对齐到后训练目标（SFT + GRPO），能在不牺牲通用教育基准表现的前提下提升 ESL 导师的教学动作质量；数据、基准与模型权重全部开源。

papers.title: Test Time Adaptation Methods for Point Cloud Registration in Laparoscopic Surgery
papers.abstract_en: 3D point cloud registration in laparoscopic surgery estimates the transformation between an intraoperative organ reconstructed from video and its preoperative mesh. Because ground-truth transformations are unavailable for real data, supervised networks are trained on synthetic organ pairs. At test time, real reconstructions differ from synthetic data and are noisy, sparse, and occluded, which degrades correspondence estimation. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can reduce this domain shift, but existing methods mainly rely on logits, entropy, class prototypes, or cache memories unavailable in registration. Registration also involves paired inputs with an asymmetric shift that primarily affects the intraoperative cloud. We analyse and modify state-of-the-art TTA methods from three families to 3D registration: model, normalization, and input adaptation. We analyze four representative approaches based on auxiliary-task model updates, backpropagation-free token purging, feature alignment, and layer-normalization calibration. We modify them to handle asymmetric shifts between preoperative and intraoperative point clouds and replace classification-based entropy objectives. Using a correspondence-based model trained on clean synthetic source data, we evaluate adaptation to corrupted synthetic and real target data on P2P and P2ILReg. For synthetic targets, we apply eight corruptions, including uniform noise and global density reduction, at five severity levels. All methods improve registration on P2P, whereas on P2ILReg only input adaptation reduces the error, while normalization adaptation degrades it. Considering the computational overhead of backpropagation-based adaptation, input adaptation is the most promising option for laparoscopic surgery, providing low inference latency and consistent error reductions across datasets. Code: https://github.com/ninaa-git/survey_pc_registration_tta
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把三类测试时自适应 (TTA) 方法改造后用于腹腔镜手术点云配准，处理术前/术中点云的非对称域偏移：在 P2P 上所有方法都降低配准误差，在 P2ILReg 上只有 input adaptation 降低误差、normalization adaptation 反而使误差变差。考虑反向传播开销，作者判定 input adaptation 是腹腔镜手术中最有前景的方案，推理延迟低且跨数据集误差下降一致。
Motivation: 真实术中重建与合成训练数据存在域偏移且含噪、稀疏、遮挡，而真实数据没有 ground-truth 变换，监督网络只能在合成器官对上训练；现有 TTA 方法依赖 logits、熵、类别原型或缓存记忆，这些在配准任务中不可用。
Method: 分析并改造 model、normalization、input 三族 SOTA TTA 方法到 3D 配准，覆盖基于辅助任务模型更新、免反向传播的 token purging、特征对齐、layer-normalization 校准四种代表方法；使其处理术前与术中点云间的非对称偏移，并替换基于分类的熵目标。用在干净合成源数据上训练的基于对应关系 (correspondence-based) 模型，在 P2P 与 P2ILReg 上评测对含腐化合成目标与真实目标的自适应。
Result: 合成目标上施加 8 种腐化（含均匀噪声、全局密度下降）× 5 个严重度等级。P2P 上所有方法都改善配准；P2ILReg 上仅 input adaptation 降低误差，normalization adaptation 使误差变差。
Conclusion: 在反向传播类自适应的计算开销约束下，input adaptation 是腹腔镜手术点云配准最有前景的 TTA 选项，推理延迟低且跨数据集误差下降一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OptR：面向输出的 INT2 KV-cache 旋转量化方法，直接最小化经注意力读出与输出投影 W_O 之后的注意力输出误差，而非缓存统计量或代理误差。在三个模型、五个推理与编码基准上一致改进 QuaRot 与 OSCAR，并增强长上下文检索，同时保持 paged KV-cache 格式、推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV-cache 是内存与带宽瓶颈，现有基于旋转的 INT2 方法在完整注意力读出之前优化缓存统计量或代理误差，与模型实际受 W_O 之后误差影响这一事实不匹配。
Method: OptR 将 post-W_O 注意力输出误差分解为 key 诱导项与 value 诱导项，通过完整 INT2 量化与注意力路径学习 per-head 正交修正；另用注意力等价的 key 重参数化压低大通道偏移且不改变 softmax 分布。
Result: 在三个模型与五个推理、编码基准上，OptR 一致改进 QuaRot 与 OSCAR 两种旋转基线，并增强长上下文检索，推理开销可忽略且保留 paged KV-cache 格式。
Conclusion: 把旋转优化目标对齐到 post-W_O 的真实输出误差，可在不牺牲推理效率的前提下提升 INT2 KV-cache 量化质量并兼容现有分页缓存。

papers.title: Predicting Activities in Aqueous Electrolyte Solutions with Hybrid Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Activities in aqueous electrolyte solutions, usually described by ionic activity and osmotic coefficients, are important properties for modeling many processes in industry and nature. Established activity models, such as those of Pitzer or Bromley, require fitting to experimental data for each electrolyte of interest and thus cannot predict properties for unstudied systems. While some predictive approaches exist, they are typically limited in scope and rely on additional ion-specific descriptors. In this work, we introduce a new hybrid model that combines the physics-based Bromley model with a matrix completion method (MCM) from machine learning. The MCM is employed to predict the electrolyte-specific parameters of the Bromley model, exploiting the fact that these parameters can be arranged in a matrix with cations and anions as rows and columns, respectively. Due to the lack of experimental data for many electrolytes, the initial parameter matrix is sparsely populated, making the prediction of the Bromley parameters for unstudied electrolytes a matrix completion problem. The hybrid model, Bromley-MCM, was trained end-to-end on experimental data for mean ionic activity coefficients and osmotic coefficients of aqueous solutions of 478 electrolytes at 298 K from the Dortmund Data Bank. As output, we obtain a completed matrix of Bromley parameters for 83 cations and 112 anions, enabling consistent prediction of concentration-dependent activities in aqueous solutions of 9,296 electrolytes at 298~K. This substantially extends the applicability of the Bromley model while maintaining high predictive accuracy, as demonstrated through evaluations on electrolytes excluded from model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把物理型 Bromley 活度模型与机器学习矩阵补全 (matrix completion, MCM) 结合：用 MCM 预测 Bromley 中需逐电解质拟合的参数，把参数排成阳离子×阴离子矩阵后做稀疏补全。模型在 298 K 下 478 个电解质的平均离子活度系数与渗透系数实验数据上端到端训练，得到 83 阳离子×112 阴离子的完整参数矩阵，可一致预测 9,296 个电解质的浓度依赖活度，并在留出电解质上保持高预测精度。
Motivation: Pitzer、Bromley 等经典活度模型必须对每种电解质用实验数据拟合参数，无法预测未研究体系；已有预测方法范围有限且依赖离子专属描述符。
Method: 提出 Bromley-MCM 混合模型：以物理型 Bromley 模型为骨架，将其电解质专属参数排列成以阳离子为行、阴离子为列的矩阵，用矩阵补全方法 (MCM) 预测缺失参数；在 Dortmund Data Bank 中 478 个电解质、298 K 下的平均离子活度系数与渗透系数实验数据上端到端训练，初始参数矩阵因数据缺失而稀疏。
Result: 输出 83 个阳离子与 112 个阴离子对应的完整 Bromley 参数矩阵，可预测 9,296 个电解质在 298 K 下的浓度依赖活度；在未参与训练的电解质上评测，保持高预测精度（摘要未给出具体误差数值）。
Conclusion: 把需逐体系拟合的物理模型参数转成矩阵补全问题，可在不牺牲精度的前提下把 Bromley 模型推广到未研究的电解质体系。

papers.title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong language-conditioned manipulation knowledge, but they remain largely vision-driven and can struggle once manipulation enters contact states where the scene is occluded, depth is ambiguous, or small force errors push execution off the offline demonstration distribution. We present LIFT (Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training), a force-aware post-training framework that adds contact reactivity to a pretrained VLA policy while preserving its general manipulation knowledge. LIFT grafts a reactive action expert beside the original action expert, initializes it from pretrained action weights, and injects recent 6D end-effector force through causal force memory and zero-initialized cross attention, enabling actions to be refreshed during execution. To address the policy-dependent distribution shift of contact feedback, LIFT further couples reactive force injection with an online DAgger loop that trains on a mixture of offline task-alignment data and human-corrected online rollouts. Across towel folding, book insertion, and Hanoi ring placement, LIFT learns faster and reaches higher performance than vision-only post-training, while ablations show that reactive force memory and online corrective data are both important for robust contact-rich manipulation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/y-wng/lift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIFT 在预训练 VLA 策略旁嫁接一个反应式动作专家，把近期 6D 末端力经因果力记忆与零初始化 cross attention 注入，使接触状态下的动作可在执行中刷新，并与在线 DAgger 循环耦合。在毛巾折叠、书本插入与汉诺塔环放置任务上，LIFT 比纯视觉后训练学得更快、达到更高性能，消融显示力记忆与在线纠正数据对接触丰富操作都不可少。
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 策略以视觉为主，在遮挡、深度歧义或小的力误差把执行推离离线演示分布的接触状态下容易失效，且直接后训练会损害其通用操作知识。
Method: LIFT（Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training）在原动作专家旁嫁接反应式动作专家，用预训练动作权重初始化；通过因果力记忆 (causal force memory) 注入近期 6D 末端执行器力，并用零初始化 cross attention 实现执行中动作刷新；再耦合在线 DAgger 循环，用离线任务对齐数据与人工纠正的在线 rollout 混合训练。
Result: 在 towel folding、book insertion、Hanoi ring placement 三个任务上，LIFT 比纯视觉后训练 (vision-only post-training) 学得更快且达到更高性能；消融表明反应式力记忆与在线纠正数据对接触丰富操作的鲁棒性都重要。
Conclusion: 给 VLA 后训练注入反应式力反馈并配合在线纠正数据，可以在保留预训练操作知识的同时补上接触状态下的反应性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Omni-Decision: Evidence-Ledger Planning for Omni-Modal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal agents must seek evidence across video, audio, web pages, and computation to answer questions. Their main bottleneck is planning: noisy multimodal observations accumulate in conversation history and disrupt later decisions, while multimodal models have limited capacity for multi-step planning. Controlled backend replacements support this diagnosis: replacing the planner causes a much larger performance loss than replacing the perception backend. We present Omni-Decision, an omni-modal agent built on evidence-ledger planning: it replaces the growing dialogue history with an explicit evidence ledger that records what evidence is still missing, what has been confirmed, and where records conflict. A critic reads each noisy observation and passes only the usable content to the ledger, discarding the rest, so the planner works from a compact context throughout the task. Each run records the state, action, and verdict at every step, and supervised fine-tuning and decision-level reinforcement learning on these trajectories further improve the planner. Omni-Decision achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 81.4% on OmniGAIA at approximately 43% of Gemini-3.1-Pro's cost per question, and 65.0% on WorldSense long-video understanding, level with the strongest end-to-end model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-Decision 用证据台账 (evidence-ledger) 替代不断增长的对话历史：critic 逐条筛掉噪声观测、只把可用内容写入台账，记录缺失证据、已确认事实与冲突记录，planner 始终在紧凑上下文上决策。在 OmniGAIA 上达到 81.4% 的 SOTA 准确率，成本约为 Gemini-3.1-Pro 每题的 43%；WorldSense 长视频理解 65.0%，与最强端到端模型持平。
Motivation: 多模态 agent 的瓶颈在规划：视频、音频、网页与计算产生的噪声观测在对话历史中累积，扰乱后续决策，而多模态模型的多步规划能力有限。受控后端替换诊断显示，替换 planner 造成的性能损失远大于替换感知后端。
Method: 提出 evidence-ledger planning：显式台账记录仍缺失的证据、已确认内容与冲突记录；critic 读取每条噪声观测，只把可用部分传入台账，丢弃其余。每步记录 state、action、verdict 轨迹，并在这些轨迹上做监督微调与决策级强化学习 (decision-level RL) 来改进 planner。
Result: OmniGAIA 准确率 81.4%（SOTA），每题成本约为 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 43%；WorldSense 长视频理解 65.0%，与最强端到端模型持平。受控后端替换中，替换 planner 的性能损失远大于替换感知后端。
Conclusion: 把对话历史换成结构化证据台账，能让 omni-modal agent 在更紧凑的上下文上规划，以约四成成本取得 SOTA 准确率；规划而非感知是这类 agent 的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: Same Stories, Different Journeys: Exploring Persona-Grounded Conversational Agents for Supporting Career Exploration with Peers' Posts
papers.abstract_en: Young job seekers frequently explore their career possibilities by browsing peers' posts that share job-seeking experiences. However, static browsing requires them to reconstruct fragmented cases and privately judge what others' experiences mean for themselves, sometimes intensifying anxiety through upward social comparison. In this paper, we examine how transforming these posts into persona-grounded conversations reshapes this sensemaking process. We developed JobMate, a prototype featuring agents that have personas built upon peers' posts and follow the self-determination theory to converse with users. In a between-subjects comparative study with 24 participants, RedNote browsing exposed diverse trajectories but left reconstruction and comparison largely to users, whereas JobMate supported case selection and continued questioning. The conversations further prompted users to articulate previously implicit constraints and accept, challenge, or revise the agent's interpretations. We discuss design implications for combining authentic peer experiences with generative AI in career exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JobMate 把小红书 (RedNote) 上的同伴求职帖转成带 persona 的对话式智能体，按自我决定理论 (self-determination theory) 引导求职者追问，从而把原本要用户自己完成的案例重构与向上社会比较接管过来。24 人被试间对比研究显示，纯浏览让用户自行重建碎片案例，而 JobMate 支持案例筛选与持续追问，并促使用户说出隐含约束、接受或反驳智能体的解读。
Motivation: 求职者静态浏览同伴帖子需自行重构碎片化案例并私下判断他人经验对自身的含义，向上社会比较有时还会加剧焦虑。
Method: 开发原型 JobMate：以同伴帖子为基础构建 persona 的对话智能体，按自我决定理论组织对话；采用 24 名参与者的被试间对比设计，对照 RedNote 浏览与 JobMate 使用。
Result: 24 人被试间研究中，RedNote 浏览呈现多样职业轨迹但把重构与比较留给用户；JobMate 支持案例筛选与持续追问，对话促使用户表达此前隐含的约束，并接受、质疑或修正智能体的解读。
Conclusion: 把真实同伴经历与生成式 AI 结合的 persona 对话，可以改变职业探索中的意义建构方式，作者据此讨论设计启示。

papers.title: tidyHEBO: Robust General-Purpose Bayesian Optimization with Model-Consistent Warping and Pareto Search
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box problems, yet practical performance depends not only on high-level algorithmic choices but also on how surrogate model training, input and output warping transformations, acquisition functions, and candidate search are implemented. We present tidyHEBO, a BoTorch-native single-objective optimizer designed for robust general-purpose optimization. tidyHEBO jointly fits Yeo-Johnson output warping with the Gaussian-process surrogate, evaluates acquisition functions on the original objective scale using deterministic quadrature or MC-samples, and performs constrained cumulative Pareto search over multiple acquisition criteria. Without any Olympus-specific hyperparameter tuning - using only default optimizer configurations - tidyHEBO ranked first among the evaluated methods on the Olympus benchmark. It achieved the best average ranks for typical performance (average rank 1.53), worst-tail performance (1.21), and run-to-run variability (2.00), measured by median nAUC, CVaR_nAUC, and IQR_nAUC, respectively. Using the same default configuration, tidyHEBO also performed strongly on synthetic and Needle-in-a-Haystack problems and closely matched HEBO on Bayesmark (92.64 versus 93.34) while exceeding GP with logarithmic expected improvement and random search. Adaptive batching reduced feedback rounds while revealing a controllable trade-off between parallelization and optimization quality as the batch cap increased. These results characterize tidyHEBO as a robust, reproducible general-purpose optimizer for a broad range of practical optimization problems, including scientific applications and hyperparameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: tidyHEBO 是 BoTorch 原生的单目标贝叶斯优化器，把 Yeo-Johnson 输出 warping 与 GP 代理联合拟合，在原始目标尺度上用确定性求积或 MC 采样评估采集函数，并对多个采集准则做约束累积 Pareto 搜索。仅用默认配置、不做 Olympus 专属调参即在 Olympus 基准上排名第一，典型性能、最差尾部与运行间波动的平均排名分别为 1.53、1.21、2.00。
Motivation: BO 的实际表现取决于代理训练、输入输出 warping、采集函数与候选搜索的具体实现，而非只有高层算法选择；缺少不依赖任务专属调参的稳健默认实现。
Method: tidyHEBO 联合拟合 Yeo-Johnson 输出 warping 与 GP 代理，用确定性求积或 MC 采样在原始目标尺度上计算采集函数，并在多个采集准则上做约束累积 Pareto 搜索；全部实验只用默认优化器配置，不含 Olympus 专属调参，另含自适应 batching 控制并行度。
Result: Olympus 基准上排名第一：典型性能（median nAUC）平均排名 1.53、最差尾部（CVaR_nAUC）1.21、运行间波动（IQR_nAUC）2.00；Bayesmark 上 92.64 对 HEBO 的 93.33（93.34），并超过带对数 expected improvement 的 GP 与 random search；在合成与 Needle-in-a-Haystack 问题上同样以默认配置表现强劲；自适应 batching 随 batch 上限增大呈现并行度与优化质量的可控权衡并减少反馈轮次。
Conclusion: 不靠任务专属调参、仅凭模型一致的 warping 与 Pareto 采集搜索，就能得到跨问题稳健可复现的通用 BO 优化器，适用于科学应用与超参数调优。

papers.title: Energy-guided Recursive Model
papers.abstract_en: Recursive models show promise on reasoning and language tasks, yet their test-time scaling lacks a principled criterion for selecting trajectories or determining recurrent depth. We introduce \textbf{Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)}, which uses Hopfield-type memories of valid local and global structures to assign intrinsic energies to candidate trajectories. These energies guide candidate selection and suggest an effective range of recurrent depths, implying that deeper recurrence does not necessarily improve reasoning accuracy. They also enable sampling methods such as parallel tempering to improve exploration. For reasoning tasks, ERM achieves optimal solutions on Sudoku ($98.97\%$), Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench, $88.04\%$) and Maze ($99.30\%$), reaching the best accuracy in recursive modeling. On language modeling, ERM reduces RedPajama-V2 perplexity by $1.74\%$ with marginal inference overhead. The results support energy guidance as a practical framework for improving test-time scaling in recursive models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)，用 Hopfield 型记忆存储合法的局部与全局结构，给候选轨迹赋内在能量，由能量决定轨迹选择与递归深度范围，并可接入 parallel tempering 改善探索。在 Sudoku 上达到 98.97%、PPBench 88.04%、Maze 99.30% 的最优解精度，RedPajama-V2 困惑度下降 1.74%，推理开销仅轻微增加；更深递归并不必然提高推理精度。
Motivation: 递归模型在推理与语言任务上有效，但其 test-time scaling 缺少选择轨迹与确定递归深度的原则性判据，只能靠试错加深。
Method: ERM 用 Hopfield 型记忆编码合法的局部与全局结构，为候选轨迹计算内在能量，以能量指导候选筛选并给出有效递归深度区间；能量还支持 parallel tempering 等采样方法增强探索。
Result: 推理任务上 Sudoku 最优解 98.97%、Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench) 88.04%、Maze 99.30%，为递归建模中的最佳精度；语言建模上 RedPajama-V2 困惑度降低 1.74%，推理开销仅有边际增加。
Conclusion: 能量引导可作为改进递归模型 test-time scaling 的实用框架，且递归深度存在有效区间，更深不等于更准。

papers.title: IB-Flow: Information Bottleneck-Guided CFG Distillation for Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale text-to-image generative models have achieved unprecedented visual performance, their inherent reliance on multi-step iterative solvers incurs severe inference latency. Few-step distillation targeting the Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) trajectory has emerged as the prevalent dual-dimensional compression paradigm. However, existing frameworks remain subjugated by a coarse-grained blind injection paradigm that perpetually enforces a globally static guidance strength while indiscriminately sampling the supervisor timestep. This state-agnostic design completely disregards the intrinsic nature of image generation as a dynamic evolutionary process characterized by progressive entropy reduction, which not only restricts the performance boundary of few-step compression but also precipitates severe CFG over-conditioning artifacts. To transcend these limitations, we re-examine the distillation procedure through the theoretical lens of Information Theory, formally modeling it as a dynamic mutual information game constrained by the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Specifically, we dismantle traditional blind assumptions via a dual-track adaptive framework. To determine the injection target, we propose an instance-aware selection mechanism that transmutes the intractable KL divergence constraint into a zero-overhead closed-form solution predicated on the local vector field norm. To regulate the injection strength, we introduce an entropy-aware schedule that dynamically decays alongside the SNR, applying maximal thrust for initial structural anchoring before smoothly reverting to the natural manifold to refine micro-details. Extensive empirical evaluations corroborate that our framework fundamentally eradicates over-conditioning artifacts, shattering the performance ceiling to achieve SOTA generative fidelity under extremely stringent 2-step configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IB-Flow 把 CFG 轨迹上的少步蒸馏重写为信息瓶颈约束下的动态互信息博弈，用实例感知的教师步选择与随 SNR 衰减的熵感知注入强度替代全局静态引导。摘要称该框架消除了过条件化伪影，并在极严格的 2 步配置下达到 SOTA 生成保真度。
Motivation: 面向 CFG 轨迹的少步蒸馏普遍采用盲注入：引导强度全局恒定、教师步无差别采样，忽略生成过程的逐步熵减，既限制压缩上限又造成 CFG 过条件化伪影。
Method: 以 Information Bottleneck (IB) 原则把蒸馏建模为动态互信息博弈，构成双轨自适应框架：注入目标由实例感知选择机制决定，把 KL 约束化为基于局部向量场范数的零开销闭式解；注入强度由熵感知 schedule 控制，随 SNR 动态衰减，前期最大推力锚定结构，随后回落到自然流形细化微细节。
Result: 在极严格的 2 步生成配置下达到 SOTA 生成保真度，并称从根本上消除过条件化伪影；摘要以“extensive empirical evaluations”表述，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 少步 CFG 蒸馏应按生成阶段自适应选择注入目标与强度，而非维持全局静态引导强度。

papers.title: When do prophets profit in prediction markets?
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed beliefs into prices that act as probabilistic forecasts of uncertain events. Classical theory establishes how a better-than-market forecast can yield positive trading profit. However, it hinges crucially on the specific automated market maker (AMM) design, and is not applicable to popular exchanges today which are based on central limit order books. This paper fills that gap. For any prediction market and any proper scoring rule $S$, we exhibit a ``proper'' betting strategy that depends only on the forecaster's prediction $\mathbf{p}$ and the market price $\mathbf{q}$, and earns positive expected profit \emph{whenever} $\mathbf{p}$ outperforms $\mathbf{q}$ under $S$ and the market has sufficient liquidity. Moreover, this proper betting is essentially the only strategy with such robust profitability guarantee. Our proof rests on a decomposition of expected profit that strictly generalizes the classical AMM guarantee and also explains how strategies can profit even without an accuracy edge. Empirically, across thousands of forecasts by AI models, proper betting is the only strategy that reliably converts accuracy into profit, and we further identify systematic forecasting personas and show how the optimal proper strategy varies across them. For feasibility demonstration, we run a monthlong live pilot test on Kalshi; the encouraging preliminary results show that proper betting can survive real-world spreads, fees, discrete fills, and limited liquidity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在中心限价订单簿类预测市场中，给出只依赖预测 p 与市场价 q 的「proper betting」策略：只要预测在 proper scoring rule S 下优于市场价格且流动性充足，就保证正的期望收益，并证明这是唯一具备该稳健获利保证的策略。在数千条 AI 模型预测上它是唯一能稳定把准确率转化为利润的策略，并在 Kalshi 一个月实盘试点中经受住点差、费用、离散成交与有限流动性的检验。
Motivation: 经典预测市场获利理论依赖特定自动做市商 (AMM) 设计，无法适用于当今主流的中心限价订单簿交易所，准确率优势与交易利润之间缺少通用联结。
Method: 对任意预测市场与任意 proper scoring rule S，构造只依赖预测 p 与市场价 q 的 proper betting 策略；证明基于期望收益的分解，严格推广经典 AMM 保证，并论证该策略是唯一具备此类稳健获利保证的策略；再用 AI 模型的数千条预测做实证，并在 Kalshi 上跑一个月实盘试点。
Result: 在数千条 AI 模型预测上，proper betting 是唯一可靠地把准确率转化为利润的策略；识别出系统性的 forecasting personas，且最优 proper 策略随 persona 而变；Kalshi 一个月实盘试点的初步结果显示该策略能在真实点差、费用、离散成交与有限流动性下存活。
Conclusion: 只要预测在 S 下跑赢市场价且流动性足够，proper betting 就能稳健获利，且这种稳健性本质上是唯一的；获利不必依赖准确率优势，收益分解也解释了这一点。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A rubric-based controlled comparison of frontier language models on expert-authored clinical reasoning tasks
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice medical benchmarks are increasingly saturated, and recent rubric-based evaluations such as HealthBench have shown that open-ended clinical performance is far from solved - its "Hard" subset top score remains 32%. We present a small, deliberately difficult evaluation dataset of five clinician-authored clinical scenarios spanning four specialties (anaesthesia, internal/family medicine, emergency medicine, and obstetrics), each accompanied by an atomic, weighted, MECE rubric (25-62 criteria per task; 184 criteria total) authored from a clinician-drafted golden answer. We evaluate three frontier models: GPT 5.4, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Mean rubric pass rates were 0.47 (Claude), 0.38 (GPT), and 0.37 (Gemini). The central finding is an inversion of clinical priority: the highest-weighted (weight-5, critical) criteria passed at only 32.4-41.7%, while low-stakes weight-1 criteria passed at 80-90%. 55 of 108 critical (weight-5) criteria (51%) were satisfied by no model. Three LLM autoraters reproduced expert met/not-met labels on 92.8-94.6% of 552 graded criteria. We position this as a methods-and-preliminary-findings contribution: the five tasks demonstrate a scalable, defensible pipeline ready to develop into a large-scale benchmark.

papers.title: Exploiting Overlapping Fields of View for Redundancy-Aware Uplink Transmission in Vehicular 6G
papers.abstract_en: Emerging uplink-dominant 6G use cases, such as cooperative vehicular streaming, require efficient transmission of high-volume visual data over limited wireless resources. While semantic communications can reduce traffic by prioritizing task-relevant content, most existing approaches treat users independently and therefore overlook spatial redundancy among nearby devices' observations. This paper proposes a semantic-aware multiple access scheme that exploits overlapping fields of view among vehicular users to reduce redundant uplink transmissions. We formulate a joint perception and transmission control problem in which users decide which image patches to transmit, when to transmit them, and over which channel, subject to communication constraints. To address the resulting complexity, we introduce a practical two-phase approach. First, nearby vehicles share selected observation patches over Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) links to calculate inter-user spatial redundancy. Second, users transmit only semantically important, non-redundant patches to the base station, where observations can be reconstructed using the received patches and complementary views from neighboring vehicles. Simulation results in a dense urban vehicular scenario demonstrate that our approach improves the proportion of users who achieve high-fidelity reconstruction, highlighting the potential of semantic-aware multiple access for sustainable and resource-efficient 6G uplink systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向上行主导的车载 6G 视觉传输，提出语义感知多址接入：利用邻车间重叠视场，先经 V2V 交换观测 patch 计算空间冗余，再只向基站发送语义重要且非冗余的 patch，由互补视角重建图像。密集城市场景仿真中，高保真重建的用户比例得到提升。
Motivation: 协同车载流等 6G 上行场景要传大量视觉数据而无线资源有限；语义通信虽能减流量，但现有方案把用户当独立个体，忽略了邻近设备观测之间的空间冗余。
Method: 把感知与传输联合建模为控制问题：每个用户决定传哪些 image patch、何时传、走哪条信道，受通信约束。两阶段求解：先通过 Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) 链路共享选定 patch 计算 inter-user spatial redundancy，再只上传语义重要且非冗余的 patch，基站结合邻车互补视角重建观测。
Result: 在密集城市场景的仿真中，该方案提高了达成高保真重建的用户比例。
Conclusion: 把重叠视场的跨用户空间冗余纳入多址接入决策，可在通信约束下减少冗余上行传输，支撑资源高效、可持续的 6G 上行系统。

papers.title: Warranted Attention: Learning What to Pass from Attention to Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Relevance of information read by attention does not guarantee that its contribution benefits the current prediction. We propose Warrant, which learns how strongly attention-derived item contributions should be transmitted under the current query. Warrant applies learned item-wise permission before aggregation without renormalization, jointly controlling relative allocation and total transmission mass. Across backbones, we construct interfaces connecting these con- tributions to prediction scores or states and compare against ungated models on the same paths. On three CyGNet datasets, ungated paths reduce MRR, whereas learned permission partially or almost fully recovers the losses. In a 5-seed HotpotQA/RoBERTa experiment, distractors receive lower permission than gold support, while mean Support MRR rises from .9111 to .9141 and the unsupported selection rate falls from .2271 to .2215. Performance comparisons and contribution- level interventions across five task families reveal both the effects and limits of selective control. The results support learning the strength of contributions transmitted to prediction separately from attention relevance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Warrant：在聚合前对 attention 得到的逐项贡献施加可学习的 item-wise permission，不做事后重归一化，从而同时控制相对分配与总传输量。在 CyGNet 三个数据集上，去掉门控的通路会拉低 MRR，而学习到的 permission 能部分乃至几乎完全补回损失；在 5-seed HotpotQA/RoBERTa 上，干扰项获得的 permission 低于 gold support，Support MRR 从 .9111 升到 .9141，unsupported 选择率从 .2271 降到 .2215。
Motivation: attention 读到的信息相关，不等于它对当前预测有正贡献；直接把 attention 贡献传给预测分数或状态会把无用甚至有害的项一并传过去。
Method: Warrant 在聚合前对每个 attention-derived item 贡献乘上一个学习得到的 permission 门，不重归一化，联合控制相对分配与总传输质量；作者在多个 backbone 上构造把贡献接到预测分数或状态的接口，并与同通路上的 ungated 模型对比，另做 contribution-level 干预实验。
Result: CyGNet 三个数据集上 ungated 通路降低 MRR，学习的 permission 部分或几乎完全恢复损失；5-seed HotpotQA/RoBERTa 上干扰项 permission 低于 gold support，Support MRR .9111 → .9141，unsupported 选择率 .2271 → .2215；跨五个任务族的性能对比与贡献级干预显示了选择性控制的效果与边界。
Conclusion: 把「传多少贡献给预测」与「attention 相关性」分开学习是有效的，选择性控制在五个任务族上既有效果也有其极限。

papers.title: Algorithmic Unverifiability of Safety for Fixed and Recursively Self-Improving Systems
papers.abstract_en: We establish mathematical limits of algorithmic safety verification for Turing-complete self-modifying systems, the class in which recursive self-improvement takes place, both for a fixed system and across its own modification. Statically, no verifier is sound, complete and tractable: over unbounded domains by Rice's and Gödel's theorems, over all finite configurations by Trakhtenbrot's theorem, and over succinctly described finite environments because verifying a policy against an adversary is coNP-complete and synthesising one is PSPACE-complete. Dynamically, we model one step of self-modification as a computable transformation of code and ask whether a safety property survives it. If the transformation depends only on behaviour, this is Rice's theorem one level up; if it reads the code, as self-modification does, the question is no longer semantic, yet the same s-m-n reduction works inside a class of behaviourally identical programs and inherits the halting degree. One step is never harder than the property; persistence along the whole trajectory can be $Π^0_2$-complete. Certification by a total algorithm is possible only for transformations of restricted expressivity, not merely for systems that stop changing. No tower of supervisors helps, and every total supervisor errs on an undecidable set of systems. For effectively pointwise properties, every faithful bounded scheme that certifies on finite behavioural evidence admits evolution traces certified at every stage while the property is violated. What survives is exact: a monitor that raises an alarm on violation semidecides it, and comparison against a frozen reference keeps the full theory.
papers.comment: v3: revised & retitled. Part II covers behavioral/code-reading self-modification, framing safety-generality via restricted expressivity (not stasis); supervisory regress drops Turing-complete assumption. Resource face: coNP-complete verification, PSPACE-complete synthesis over succinct arenas. Part III assumes effectively pointwise properties. 30 pp. Companion: arXiv:2609.11326
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明图灵完备自修改系统的安全性不存在既可靠又完备且可判定的验证器：静态上无界域由 Rice/Gödel、有限构型由 Trakhtenbrot、简洁描述的有限环境因策略对 adversary 验证为 coNP-complete、合成为 PSPACE-complete 而失败；动态上单步自修改的性质保持至多与性质本身同难，整条轨迹的持续性可达 Π⁰₂-complete。结论是只有受限表达力的变换才能被全算法认证，任何全监控器必在某个不可判定集合上出错，可行的只剩对违规半可判定的报警监控器与冻结参照比对。
Motivation: 递归自我改进 (recursive self-improvement) 落在图灵完备自修改系统中，而现有安全论证缺少对“能否验证跨自身修改的安全性”这一问题的严格判定性边界。
Method: 静态侧用 Rice、Gödel、Trakhtenbrot 定理加上简洁竞技场 (succinct arenas) 上 coNP-complete 验证与 PSPACE-complete 合成的归约；动态侧把一步自修改建模为代码的可计算变换，用 s-m-n 归约在行为等价程序类内继承停机度，并对有效逐点性质 (effectively pointwise properties) 分析有界认证方案。
Result: 静态不可判定性由 Rice/Gödel（无界域）、Trakhtenbrot（全部有限构型）、coNP-complete 验证与 PSPACE-complete 合成（简洁有限环境）给出；单步性质保持不难于性质本身，整条轨迹的持续性可达 Π⁰₂-complete；监督塔无效，每个全监控器都在某个不可判定系统集合上出错；对有效逐点性质，任何基于有限行为证据的忠实有界认证方案都存在每阶段被认证但性质已违规的演化轨迹。
Conclusion: 安全认证只有在变换表达力受限（而非系统停止改变）时才可能由全算法完成；保留下来的精确结论是报警监控器对违规半可判定，与冻结参照比较可保留完整理论。

papers.title: TOPS: First-Principles Visual Token Pruning via Constructing Token Optimal Preservation Sets for Efficient MLLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their efficiency is limited by the large number of visual tokens, which introduces substantial computational overhead. Visual token pruning offers a natural solution, yet existing methods are imperfect: attention-based criteria tend to retain redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria are often agnostic to user instructions. Even methods that combine multiple criteria still lack a principled formulation of the intrinsic objective of token pruning. In this paper, we revisit visual token pruning from a first-principles perspective and formulate it as constructing Token Optimal Preservation Sets. Through a top-down information-theoretic analysis, we identify three fundamental principles for effective token selection: Task Relevance, Information Coverage, and Semantic Diversity. Based on these principles, we propose TOPS, a training-free and model-agnostic pruning module that can be applied to various MLLMs. Extensive experiments on 7 MLLM backbones and 14 benchmarks demonstrate that TOPS outperforms prior methods under diverse pruning settings. Notably, on LLaVA-NeXT, TOPS removes 77.8% of visual tokens while preserving 100.0% and 100.6% performance on its 7B and 13B models, respectively, suggesting that pruning redundant visual tokens can sometimes mitigate hallucination and inspire future lightweight MLLM design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TOPS 把视觉 token 剪枝形式化为构造 Token Optimal Preservation Sets，用自顶向下的信息论分析导出任务相关性、信息覆盖、语义多样性三条准则，做成免训练、模型无关的剪枝模块。在 LLaVA-NeXT 上剪掉 77.8% 视觉 token，7B 与 13B 性能保持 100.0% 与 100.6%，说明冗余 token 有时反而助长幻觉。
Motivation: MLLM 推理被大量视觉 token 拖累，现有剪枝方法要么基于 attention 准则保留冗余 token，要么基于多样性的准则不考虑用户指令，多准则组合也缺少对剪枝内在目标的原则性刻画。
Method: 从第一性原理把视觉 token 剪枝表述为构造 Token Optimal Preservation Sets，经自顶向下的信息论分析得到 Task Relevance、Information Coverage、Semantic Diversity 三条选择准则，据此实现免训练、模型无关的 TOPS 剪枝模块，可接入多种 MLLM。
Result: 在 7 个 MLLM backbone、14 个 benchmark 上的多种剪枝设置中，TOPS 超越先前方法；LLaVA-NeXT 上剪掉 77.8% 视觉 token，7B 与 13B 模型分别保持 100.0% 与 100.6% 的性能。
Conclusion: 按三条原则构造的 token 保留集可以在大幅剪枝下不掉点，且剪掉冗余视觉 token 有时还能缓解幻觉，为轻量 MLLM 设计提供方向。

summary_sections.method: 从第一性原理把视觉 token 剪枝表述为构造 Token Optimal Preservation Sets，经自顶向下的信息论分析得到 Task Relevance、Information Coverage、Semantic Diversity 三条选择准则，据此实现免训练、模型无关的 TOPS 剪枝模块，可接入多种 MLLM。
summary_sections.result: 在 7 个 MLLM backbone、14 个 benchmark 上的多种剪枝设置中，TOPS 超越先前方法；LLaVA-NeXT 上剪掉 77.8% 视觉 token，7B 与 13B 模型分别保持 100.0% 与 100.6% 的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按三条原则构造的 token 保留集可以在大幅剪枝下不掉点，且剪掉冗余视觉 token 有时还能缓解幻觉，为轻量 MLLM 设计提供方向。

papers.title: The Chandra-Gaia Catalog of Counterparts: Resolving ambiguous Gaia matches to X-ray sources in the Chandra Source Catalog using Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework to cross-match sources from the Chandra Source Catalog (CSC v2.1) with optical sources from Gaia Data Release 3. Unlike purely spatial approaches, we use source properties such as magnitudes, colors, and distances to identify true counterparts, detect chance coincidences, and resolve ambiguities when multiple plausible candidates exist. We define a training set of high-confidence matches using NWAY, a Bayesian cross-matching framework that accounts for positional errors and source densities. We train a gradient-boosted classifier (LightGBM) on a variety of features from both catalogs. Of the ~$254$k unique X-ray sources, we find counterparts for ~$113$k sources, of which plausible multiple counterparts are found for ~$7$k. We find no counterparts for ~$20$k sources for which separation-based cross-matching does find a match, and attribute half of these to chance coincidences. We validate the pipeline on the Chandra Orion Ultradeep Project (COUP), where the machine-learning matches reproduce 95% of NWAY cross-matches without using any positional information. We release a catalog of the ~$113$k Chandra-Gaia counterparts, together with ~$7$k alternative matches and ~$20$k ambiguous NWAY associations, supporting future population studies of sources detectable by both Chandra and Gaia. We discuss limitations and provide a generalization of the framework that is applicable in other cross-matching scenarios.
papers.comment: Published in The Astrophysical Journal. Website: https://www.samuelperezdi.com/chandragaia/
papers.journal_ref: V. Samuel Pérez-Díaz et al 2026 ApJ 1009 115
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LightGBM 梯度提升分类器在星等、颜色、距离等非位置特征上做 Chandra CSC v2.1 与 Gaia DR3 的交叉证认，训练集由考虑位置误差与源密度的贝叶斯框架 NWAY 生成。约 254k 个 X 射线源中找到约 113k 个对应体，COUP 验证中完全不用位置信息即复现 NWAY 交叉匹配的 95%。

papers.title: Starter-Iterator Neural Operator: A Unified Architecture for High-Fidelity Forward and Inverse PDE Problems
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning is an emerging field at the intersection of machine learning and scientific computing. By learning mappings between function spaces, neural operators provide data-driven surrogate models for families of partial differential equations (PDEs). Once trained, these models can evaluate solution operators efficiently, making them suitable for many-query applications such as real-time prediction and parameter sweeps. However, maintaining high approximation accuracy and stable long-term predictions remains challenging for complex forward and inverse problems. To address these challenges, we propose the Starter-Iterator Neural Operator (SINO), which incorporates the initialization and residual-correction structures of classical iterative solvers into neural operator learning. The frequency-domain Starter captures dominant global spectral features and provides an informed initial approximation, while the latent-space Iterator applies successive residual-based corrections to refine local and multiscale solution structures. Experiments on representative time-dependent PDEs, including the Navier-Stokes and acoustic wave equations, together with applications to image super-resolution and weather forecasting, show that SINO achieves competitive accuracy and stable performance across the benchmarks considered in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Starter-Iterator Neural Operator (SINO)，把经典迭代解法器的初始化与残差校正结构搬进神经算子：频域 Starter 抓全局谱特征给出初值，隐空间 Iterator 做逐次残差校正细化局部与多尺度结构。在 Navier-Stokes、声波方程等含时 PDE 上，并用于图像超分辨率与天气预报应用，SINO 在所考察基准上取得有竞争力的精度与稳定表现。
Motivation: 神经算子作为 PDE 代理模型在多查询场景高效，但在复杂正问题与反问题上同时保持高逼近精度和长期预测稳定性仍然困难。
Method: SINO 借用经典迭代解法器的两段结构：频域 Starter 输出带信息量的初始近似以捕获主导全局谱特征，隐空间 Iterator 施加基于残差的连续校正以细化局部与多尺度解结构；训练对象是含时 PDE 的解算子。
Result: 在代表性含时 PDE（Navier-Stokes 方程与声波方程）上的实验，以及图像超分辨率和天气预报应用中，SINO 在本文所考察的各基准上取得有竞争力的精度与稳定表现。
Conclusion: 把迭代求解器的初值加残差校正骨架引入神经算子，可同时服务正问题与反问题，并在长期预测上保持稳定。

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation with Curriculum Turn-level Guidance for Multi-turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn agents that plan, invoke tools, and interact with environments offer a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks, yet their capabilities typically rely on very large models whose inference cost is prohibitive in practice. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a natural recipe for transferring such capabilities to smaller students, but we find that it suffers a characteristic failure mode in this setting: small student errors compound across turns and push the trajectory out of the teacher's familiar state distribution, so the teacher's supervision becomes least reliable precisely where the student needs it most. We propose Guided On-Policy Distillation (Guided-OPD), a simple yet effective algorithm that mixes teacher- and student-generated turns within each rollout and schedules the teacher's intervention probability along a curriculum that decays to zero. Strong guidance keeps early trajectories close to the teacher distribution and is then gradually withdrawn to recover the purely on-policy regime used at inference. On ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, distilling Qwen3 students from a Qwen3-30B-A3B teacher, Guided-OPD yields average relative gains of 21.1\% in Score and 25.5\% in Success Rate over vanilla OPD, with larger gains on smaller students.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮 agent 的 On-Policy Distillation 中，小模型逐轮误差累积会把轨迹推出教师熟悉的分布，使教师监督在学生最需要处最不可靠。Guided-OPD 在每条 rollout 内混合教师与学生生成的轮次，并让教师介入概率沿课程衰减到零；在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上从 Qwen3-30B-A3B 蒸馏 Qwen3 学生，相对 vanilla OPD 平均 Score 提升 21.1%、Success Rate 提升 25.5%，学生越小增益越大。
Motivation: 多轮 agent 依赖超大模型，推理成本不可接受；直接做 on-policy 蒸馏时学生误差跨轮累积、偏离教师状态分布，教师监督恰好在最需要处失效。
Method: Guided-OPD：每条 rollout 内按概率混合教师生成轮次与学生生成轮次，教师介入概率沿课程逐步衰减到零，前期把轨迹拉回教师分布、后期恢复纯 on-policy；教师为 Qwen3-30B-A3B，学生为 Qwen3。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，相对 vanilla OPD 平均相对增益为 Score 21.1%、Success Rate 25.5%，且学生模型越小增益越大。
Conclusion: 用可衰减的教师介入课程能修复多轮 on-policy 蒸馏的分布偏移失效，最终仍回到推理时使用的纯 on-policy 状态。
