papers.title: Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees for Stratified Classification
papers.abstract_en: In the era of Explainable Artificial Intelligence, there is a renewed focus on single trees for their ease of interpretation. This paper introduces Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees, a probabilistic machine learning framework for classification trees in the presence of a stratification factor such as a temporal, spatial, or demographic variable, acting as a control variable or potential confounder. Standard tree growth procedures are not designed to optimize a conditional split rule. A model-based split rule is proposed in which child nodes are interpreted as latent components of a simultaneous mixture model, such as the Simultaneous Latent Budget Model and its constrained versions, fitted to the parent node. Mixing parameters drive the observations, differently for each group, to the child nodes whereas latent budgets parameters update the response classes profile of each level of the control variable. Parameters are estimated by least squares considering a neural network perspective of the model. An informative tree structure can be interactively visualized with interpretation aids on the node and the paths, including visual pruning and decision tree selection procedure. Suitable measures are proposed to handle an unbalanced response class distribution. The proposed methodology is applied to investigate gender-related differences in disease progression of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. The SLBT library with the various tree-based algorithms is available in the linked GitHub repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees (SLBT)：在含分层因子（时间、空间或人口统计变量）的分类树中，把子节点当作父节点 simultaneous mixture model 的潜成分，用模型驱动的分裂规则优化条件分裂而非标准树生长准则。混合参数按组把观测分配到子节点，latent budget 参数更新各控制变量水平的响应类别分布，参数用最小二乘从神经网络视角估计，并配套不平衡类别度量与交互式可视化剪枝。方法应用于 ALS 疾病进展中性别相关差异的分析。
Motivation: 标准分类树的分裂准则不针对条件分裂设计，遇到时间、空间、人口统计这类分层因子或潜在混杂变量时，无法在控制该变量的同时优化分裂，可解释单树在 XAI 场景下的这一缺口需要新的分裂规则。
Method: 模型驱动分裂规则：父节点拟合 Simultaneous Latent Budget Model 及其约束版本作为同时混合模型，子节点解释为潜成分；混合参数按组驱动观测进入子节点，latent budget 参数更新控制变量各水平的响应类别剖面。参数用最小二乘估计（神经网络视角），并提出针对响应类别不平衡的度量，配以节点/路径解释辅助、可视化剪枝与决策树选择流程，实现为 SLBT 库。
Result: 方法应用于 Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) 疾病进展数据，考察性别相关差异；提出处理响应类别不平衡分布的度量，并给出可交互可视化的树结构与剪枝、决策树选择流程。
Conclusion: 把子节点当作同时混合模型的潜成分，可以在含分层/混杂控制变量的分类树上直接优化条件分裂规则，同时保留单树的可解释性并支持交互式剪枝选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Routing-Aware Expert Calibration for Machine Unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is increasingly important for large language models, yet unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures remains underexplored. Unlike dense models, MoE architectures employ a router at each layer to assign each token to a sparse subset of experts. In this work, we observe that forget data often activates a small subset of experts disproportionately, while these experts may receive much weaker activation from retain data. This forget--retain routing mismatch can leave forget-critical experts under-regularized during unlearning. To address this, we propose \textbf{TRACE}, Targeted Routing-Aware Calibration of Experts, for MoE unlearning. TRACE first detects forget-critical experts from offline activation statistics, and then calibrates retain regularization by reweighting token-level retain losses so that each selected expert's retain-side activation frequency better matches its forget-side counterpart. Experiments on WMDP and MUSE-BOOKS across multiple MoE LLMs show that TRACE consistently improves the forget-utility trade-off, yielding a 9\% relative utility improvement over the strongest baseline under comparable forgetting quality and the best performance on three out of four MUSE-BOOKS metrics.
papers.comment: There's minor error in per-expert gradient decomposition Eq.(4)-(6)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoE 语言模型的机器遗忘中，遗忘数据会不成比例地激活少数专家，而这些专家在保留数据上激活弱得多，导致遗忘关键专家在遗忘训练时正则不足。TRACE 先用离线激活统计找出 forget-critical experts，再按 token 级重加权保留侧损失，使每个被选专家的保留侧激活频率对齐其遗忘侧。在 WMDP 与 MUSE-BOOKS 上，TRACE 在可比遗忘质量下相对最强基线提升 9% 效用，并在 MUSE-BOOKS 四项指标中的三项取得最佳。
Motivation: MoE 架构的机器遗忘研究不足：router 每层只把 token 分给稀疏专家子集，遗忘与保留数据的路由不匹配会让 forget-critical experts 在遗忘过程中欠正则，遗忘-效用权衡受损。
Method: TRACE (Targeted Routing-Aware Calibration of Experts)：先从离线激活统计中检测 forget-critical experts，再对 token 级保留损失重加权，校准保留正则，使每个被选专家的保留侧激活频率与其遗忘侧对应值匹配。
Result: 在 WMDP 和 MUSE-BOOKS 上、跨多个 MoE LLM，TRACE 在可比遗忘质量下相对最强基线取得 9% 的相对效用提升，并在 MUSE-BOOKS 四项指标中的三项取得最佳表现。
Conclusion: 遗忘-保留路由失配是 MoE 遗忘欠正则的根源，按专家对齐保留侧激活频率即可改善遗忘-效用权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Gravity-guided Contact Dynamics Estimation from 3D Human Motions
papers.abstract_en: Ground contact forces acting on the human body, are crucial for biomechanics studies or sport performance analysis. Prior methods rely on force plates or pressure mats to collect ground contact dynamics, limiting their applicability to carefully controlled settings. A more scalable solution is to estimate the dynamics directly from motion capture data. Recent approaches only roughly estimate the ground contact dynamics from the vertical distance between the body and the ground plane, which cannot capture the complex pressure distribution of all contact points. To this end, we propose GraCE -- Gravity-guided Contact Dynamics Estimation, a novel full-body contact dynamics model for human motions using a realistic influence of body mass distribution and gravity. We use the human's center of gravity to estimate the ground contacts based on its relative distance to the human body. The applied force on each contact is estimated via the product of predicted contact probabilities and the total exterior force computed from the center of mass trajectory. We outperform related work on the GroundLink dataset for ground reaction force estimation, and on the MOYO dataset for detailed contact pressure prediction. The code is published at https://github.com/cuongle1206/GraCE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GraCE：用人体重心与地面的相对距离预测各接触点概率，再乘以由质心轨迹算出的总外力，得到逐接触点的地面反作用力与压力分布。在 GroundLink 地面反作用力估计与 MOYO 接触压力预测上均超过相关工作。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖测力台或压力垫，只能在受控环境采集；从动作捕捉估计接触动力学的做法只用身体到地平面的垂直距离粗估，抓不住多接触点的复杂压力分布。
Method: GraCE 是全身接触动力学模型：以重心 (center of gravity) 相对人体的位置估计地面接触概率，各接触点受力取预测接触概率与由质心 (center of mass) 轨迹计算的总外力之积，纳入身体质量分布与重力的影响。
Result: 在 GroundLink 数据集的地面反作用力 (ground reaction force) 估计上优于相关工作，在 MOYO 数据集的细粒度接触压力预测上同样超过相关工作；代码已发布。
Conclusion: 用地形无关的重心—质心动力学替代测力台与垂直距离启发式，可以从动作捕捉直接得到逐接触点的力与压力分布。

papers.title: MLSkip: Data Skipping for ML Filters via Lightweight Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Database vendors recently released AI functions that can be used in filter predicates. As such functions often rely on costly, black-box ML models, they unveil new data management challenges. Concretely, traditional data skipping techniques for integer and string data fail to be applicable to the new filter type. Indeed, there is no known mechanism for pruning non-qualifying row groups, e.g., when reading files from blob storage. In this work, we initiate the study of data skipping techniques for ML filters. We make the case that Parquet's default min-max metadata is enough to enable pruning. To this end, we draw connections to two lines of research: (i) the recently proposed query language for ML models and (ii) neural network verification. Our preliminary results on ReLU architectures show that on tables from TPC-H and TPC-DS, the average pruning effectiveness for filters of selectivity below 0.1% amounts to 27.4%. Finally, inspired by research on spatial joins, we propose an enhanced metadata structure: a size-bounded 2D convex hull that verification tools can make better use of, increasing the pruning effectiveness to 38.31%, while occupying at most 45 bytes per row group and column pair. We observe an end-to-end speedup of 1.07$\times$ over PyTorch in DuckDB.
papers.comment: 7th International Workshop on Applied AI for Database Systems and Applications (AIDB 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLSkip 针对数据库中由昂贵黑盒 ML 模型构成的过滤谓词，论证 Parquet 默认 min-max 元数据即可实现 row group 剪枝，并借助 ML 查询语言与神经网络验证的联系给出剪枝机制。在 TPC-H 与 TPC-DS 表上、选择率低于 0.1% 的过滤器平均剪枝有效性为 27.4%；改用 size-bounded 2D convex hull 元数据后提升到 38.31%，每 row group 与列对至多占 45 字节，DuckDB 中相对 PyTorch 端到端加速 1.07×。
Motivation: 数据库厂商已把 AI 函数放进过滤谓词，但这些谓词依赖昂贵的黑盒 ML 模型，面向整数与字符串的传统 data skipping 技术无法适用，读取 blob storage 文件时没有已知机制剪掉不合格 row group。
Method: 论证 Parquet 默认 min-max 元数据足以支持剪枝，并连接两条研究线：面向 ML 模型的查询语言与神经网络验证（针对 ReLU 架构）；再借鉴 spatial join 思路提出 size-bounded 2D convex hull 增强元数据结构，供验证工具利用。
Result: 在 TPC-H 与 TPC-DS 表上，选择率低于 0.1% 的 ML 过滤器平均剪枝有效性为 27.4%；用 2D convex hull 元数据提升到 38.31%，每 row group 与列对至多 45 字节；DuckDB 中相对 PyTorch 端到端加速 1.07×。
Conclusion: ML 过滤器的 row group 剪枝可以只靠轻量元数据（min-max 或 size-bounded 2D convex hull）配合神经网络验证实现，凸包元数据在几乎不占空间的前提下把剪枝有效性从 27.4% 抬到 38.31%。

papers.title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
papers.abstract_en: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobileGym 是浏览器托管、完全可控的移动 GUI agent 仿真环境，用结构化 JSON 状态做确定性判定，同时给出可验证评测信号与低成本并行在线 RL。单服务器可跑数百个并行实例，每实例约 400 MB 内存、约 3 秒冷启动；GRPO 训练 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 在 256 任务测试集上提升 12.8 个百分点，真机 59 任务子集保留了仿真侧训练增益的 95.1%。
Motivation: 日常移动 app 缺少可复现的仿真环境：专有后端难以复制，评测依赖自由文本匹配易失败，在线 RL 又受限于并行 rollout 成本。
Method: 以浏览器托管的轻量可控环境捕获、配置、fork 并比对完整状态为结构化 JSON；分层状态模型加声明式任务定义框架支撑规模化任务创建，单一程序化 judging 机制同时产出确定性判定与稠密 RL 奖励；配套 MobileGym-Bench 用 AnswerSheet 协议替代自由文本匹配，训练算法为 GRPO，模型为 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct。
Result: 单服务器可托管数百个并行实例，每实例约 400 MB 内存、约 3 秒冷启动；MobileGym-Bench 含 416 个参数化任务模板（256 测试、160 训练）、覆盖 28 个 app；Sim-to-Real 案例中 GRPO 使 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 在 256 任务测试集上提升 12.8 个百分点，在 59 任务真机信号子集上保留仿真侧训练增益的 95.1%。
Conclusion: 把状态做成可 fork 的结构化 JSON 并用单一 judging 机制同时驱动评测与奖励，可以让移动 GUI agent 的在线 RL 在低成本并行下获得可验证、可迁移到真机的训练增益。

papers.title: A lift for input-convex neural net training
papers.abstract_en: Input-convex neural nets parametrize the convex potentials of density models and transport maps, and their convexity requires the inter-layer weights to be non-negative. Projected gradient descent enforces this by projecting after each step, and due to mini-batch noise the boundary is re-crossed indefinitely, which leads to an active set the projection never identifies. The differentiable alternative, direct softplus, optimizes a free latent weight through a softplus positivity map whose derivative attenuates the gradient exponentially where the weight is negative---the shoulder---so a coordinate that reaches it stays for an exponentially long time. To keep this unconstrained parametrization without its slow escape, we propose the lift, which replaces the free latent weight by a learnable slack plus an unconstrained network---the body---that takes a permutation-invariant summary of the training batch as input. The latent weight thus varies with the batch before the positivity map, and couples to the gradient formed on it. We show that this coupling enters the variance of the update to the latent weight at first order in the fluctuation, and that the slack, the batch dependence and the shared batch are each needed for it to act. Where the coupling aligns positively with the loss curvature, that variance is larger under the lift than under direct softplus, and a coordinate leaves the shoulder sooner. We compare the lift with the two existing methods on several applications. Where a constrained weight of direct softplus reaches the shoulder and does not leave, the lift fits the target more closely and reaches the same reconstruction about three times sooner. Where almost none reaches it, the methods agree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 input-convex neural net (ICNN) 中 softplus 正性映射在负权重处梯度指数衰减导致坐标滞留 shoulder 的问题，提出 lift：用可学习 slack 加一个以训练 batch 置换不变摘要为输入的无约束网络 (body) 替代自由隐变量，使隐权重在过正性映射前随 batch 变化并与该处梯度耦合。该耦合一阶进入隐权重更新的方差，使坐标更快离开 shoulder；在受约束权重陷入 shoulder 的应用上，lift 拟合目标更接近、约三倍时间达到相同重建。
Motivation: ICNN 的凸性要求层间权重非负：投影梯度下降因 mini-batch 噪声反复穿越边界、永远识别不出 active set；direct softplus 则在权重为负处梯度被指数衰减（shoulder），坐标一旦到达便停留指数长的时间。
Method: lift 用可学习 slack 加无约束网络 (body) 替代 softplus 的自由隐变量，body 以训练 batch 的置换不变摘要为输入，使隐权重在正性映射前依赖 batch 并与该处梯度耦合；理论上证明该耦合一阶进入隐权重更新方差，且 slack、batch 依赖与共享 batch 三者缺一不可。
Result: 在若干应用上与投影梯度下降和 direct softplus 两种现有方法比较：当 direct softplus 的受约束权重进入 shoulder 并滞留时，lift 拟合目标更接近，约三倍快 (about three times sooner) 达到相同重建；当几乎没有权重进入 shoulder 时，各方法结果一致。
Conclusion: 让隐权重在正性映射前随 batch 变化可把梯度耦合转化为更快逃离 shoulder 的更新方差，从而在不放弃无约束参数化的情况下缓解 softplus 的指数级滞留；收益仅在权重确实进入 shoulder 的情形出现。

papers.title: STAMBRIDGE: Spectral-Temporal Amplitude-aware Mid-Feature Bridge for EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) visual decoding remains challenging due to the modality gap between low-SNR neural signals and highly structured vision--language spaces, making direct cross-modal alignment unstable. To address this, we propose STAMBRIDGE, a versatile two-stage framework that sequentially tackles feature conditioning and cross-modal alignment. First, we introduce a Spectral-Temporal Amplitude-aware Modulation (STAM) to extract well-conditioned EEG representations. By replacing hard frequency masking with amplitude-derived soft channel weighting and multi-scale temporal convolutions, STAM explicitly preserves frequency-aware transients while reducing the risk of time-domain ringing artifacts. Building upon these robust neural features, we further introduce a model-agnostic Mid-Feature Semantic Bridge (MFSB) that constructs a regularized intermediate space through directed cross-modal interactions, enabling staged distillation and more stable semantic alignment. Experiments on the THINGS-EEG benchmark show competitive 200-way zero-shot retrieval performance, with 34.50\% Top-1 and 65.95\% Top-5 accuracy. In addition, embeddings learned by STAMBRIDGE produce semantically coherent image reconstructions with a diffusion model, demonstrating robust EEG-to-vision semantic alignment. The code is available at: https://github.com/thabeatmjh/STAMBRIDGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAMBRIDGE 用两阶段框架做 EEG 视觉解码：先以幅度感知调制 (STAM) 以幅度导出的软通道加权替代硬频率掩蔽并配合多尺度时间卷积，得到条件良好的 EEG 表征，再用 Mid-Feature Semantic Bridge (MFSB) 构造正则化中间空间做分阶段蒸馏与跨模态对齐。在 THINGS-EEG 上 200-way zero-shot 检索 Top-1 达 34.50%、Top-5 达 65.95%，其嵌入经扩散模型可重建语义一致的图像。
Motivation: 低信噪比 EEG 与高度结构化的视觉-语言空间之间存在模态鸿沟，直接跨模态对齐不稳定；硬频率掩蔽还易引入时域振铃伪影。
Method: 两阶段框架：STAM 用幅度导出的软通道加权 (amplitude-derived soft channel weighting) 取代硬频率掩蔽，加多尺度时间卷积以保留频率感知瞬态；MFSB 是模型无关的中间特征语义桥，通过有向跨模态交互构造正则化中间空间，实现分阶段蒸馏与语义对齐。
Result: THINGS-EEG 基准上 200-way zero-shot 检索 Top-1 34.50%、Top-5 65.95%；学到的嵌入经扩散模型生成语义一致的图像重建。
Conclusion: 先做条件良好的频谱-时间 EEG 表征、再做正则化中间空间对齐，可实现稳健的 EEG-to-vision 语义对齐与零样本检索。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReAlign: Generalizable Image Forgery Detection via Reasoning-Aligned Representation
papers.abstract_en: The rise of AI-generated images (AIGIs) poses growing challenges for digital authenticity, prompting the need for efficient, generalizable image forgery detection systems. Existing methods, whether non-LLM-based or LLM-based, exhibit distinct advantages and limitations. While non-LLM-based models offer efficient low-level artifact detection, they often lack semantic understanding. Conversely, LLM-based methods provide strong semantic reasoning and explainability but are computationally intensive and less sensitive to subtle visual artifacts. Moreover, the true contribution of explanatory reasoning texts to forgery detection performance remains unclear. In this work, we investigate the intrinsic value and potential of LLM-generated reasoning texts, considering it a source of generalization and semantic-error sensitivity. Based on these findings, we propose ReAlign, a novel framework that distills high-quality reasoning texts generated by a GRPO-optimized LLM into a lightweight AIGI detector via contrastive learning. ReAlign effectively inherits the generalization ability and semantic sensitivity capability of reasoning textual representations, while remaining efficient and lightweight for deployment. Moreover, ReAlign adopts a tailored joint optimization strategy that integrates contrastive loss for image-text alignment and classification loss for accurate forgery discrimination. Experimental results on AIGCDetectBenchmark, AIGI-Holmes, and our newly constructed UltraSynth-10k demonstrate that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art detectors in both accuracy and generalization, particularly when facing complex, high-fidelity forgeries from modern generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReAlign 把 GRPO 优化过的 LLM 所生成的高质量推理文本，经对比学习蒸馏进轻量 AIGI 检测器，并用图像-文本对齐损失与分类损失联合优化。在 AIGCDetectBenchmark、AIGI-Holmes 与自建 UltraSynth-10k 上，其准确率与泛化性一致超过现有 SOTA 检测器，尤其面对现代生成模型的高保真伪造时。
Motivation: 非 LLM 方法长于低层伪影但缺语义理解，LLM 方法语义推理强却算力开销大、对细微伪影不敏感，且解释性推理文本对检测性能的真实贡献尚不清楚。
Method: 先考察 LLM 生成的推理文本作为泛化与语义错误敏感性来源的价值，再用对比学习把 GRPO 优化 LLM 产出的推理文本蒸馏进轻量 AIGI 检测器；训练采用联合优化，即图像-文本对齐的对比损失加伪造判别的分类损失。
Result: 在 AIGCDetectBenchmark、AIGI-Holmes 与新构建的 UltraSynth-10k 上，ReAlign 在准确率与泛化性两方面一致优于现有 SOTA 检测器，优势在面对现代生成模型的复杂高保真伪造时尤为明显。
Conclusion: 推理文本的表征可被蒸馏进轻量检测器，从而在保持部署效率的同时继承 LLM 的泛化与语义敏感能力，说明解释性推理对伪造检测确有可迁移的价值。

papers.title: Judge Circuits Explain Format-Induced Inconsistency in LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant paradigm for grading model outputs at scale, yet the same model assigns systematically different scores when its output format changes (e.g., a 1-5 rating vs. a True/False label). Existing diagnoses of these format-induced inconsistencies stop at the input-output level. Using Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP), we causally investigate the internal mechanism in five open-weight instruction-tuned models (Gemma-3, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1) across five judgment tasks. We find that judgments across structured understanding and open-ended preference tasks share a sparse Latent Evaluator sub-graph in the mid-to-late layers; zero-ablating it collapses judgment while damaging knowledge probes substantially less than a random ablation of equal size in architecturally modular models. By structurally decoupling abstract judging from output formatting, we provide a mechanistic account of format-induced inconsistency on the open-weight models we study: a continuous judgment signal computed in the shared trunk is mapped through fragile, format-specific terminal branches. The judgment itself can therefore be read out independently of the requested output format. Our findings imply that benchmark comparisons of judge reliability across formats partly measure the fragile formatting stage, and can understate the quality of the underlying evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP) 在五个开源指令微调模型、五类评判任务上做因果干预，定位到中后层共享的稀疏 Latent Evaluator 子图：抽象打分与输出格式被结构性解耦，连续判断信号在共享主干算出，再经脆弱、格式专属的末端分支映射成 1–5 评分或 True/False 标签。零消融该子图会使判断崩溃，而同等规模随机消融对知识探针损伤更大，说明格式诱导的不一致主要来自末端格式分支，跨格式的 judge 可靠性基准比较会低估底层评估质量。
Motivation: 同一 LLM-as-a-judge 在输出格式改变（1–5 评分 vs. True/False）时给出系统性不同的分数，而现有诊断只停留在输入-输出层面，无法解释内部机制。
Method: 提出 Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP)，在 Gemma-3、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1 等五个开源指令微调模型上、跨五类判断任务做因果干预，定位共享评判子图并做零消融 (zero-ablating) 与等规模随机消融对照，同时用知识探针检测副作用。
Result: 结构化理解与开放偏好任务共享中后层一个稀疏 Latent Evaluator 子图；零消融该子图使判断崩溃，而对知识探针的损伤显著小于等规模随机消融（在架构模块化模型中）；判断信号可在共享主干独立读出，不受所请求输出格式影响。
Conclusion: 格式诱导的不一致源于共享主干产出的连续判断经脆弱的格式专属末端分支映射，因此跨格式的 judge 可靠性基准比较部分测的是格式阶段，会低估底层评估质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learn2Splat: Extending the Horizon of Learned 3DGS Optimization
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization is most commonly performed using general-purpose first-order optimizers such as Adam or SGD. Although robust across scenes, they update each parameter independently without exploiting the structural and spatial relationships among Gaussians, which slows convergence. Recent works introduced learned optimizers that predict correlated updates informed by inter-parameter and inter-Gaussian dependencies. However, those are trained for a fixed number of optimization iterations and rely on manually scheduled learning rates to avoid degradation. In this paper, we introduce Learn2Splat, a learned optimizer for 3DGS that avoids degradation over extended optimization horizons without auxiliary mechanisms. To enable this, we propose a meta-learning scheme that extends the optimization horizon via a checkpoint buffer and an optimizer rollout strategy, combined with an architecture that encodes gradient scale information in its latent states. Results show higher novel view synthesis quality at equal wall-clock time, while remaining stable over long horizons, with zero-shot generalization to unseen datasets and settings. To support our findings, we build a unified framework to train and evaluate learned and standard optimizers across sparse and dense view settings. Code and models will be released publicly. Our project page is available at https://autonomousvision.github.io/learn2splat .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Learn2Splat 是面向 3D Gaussian Splatting 的学习型优化器，用带 checkpoint buffer 的元学习方案延长优化时程，并在隐状态中编码梯度尺度信息，从而在不依赖手动学习率调度的情况下避免长时程退化。在相同 wall-clock 时间下获得更高的 novel view synthesis 质量，并对未见数据集与稀疏/稠密视角设定零样本泛化。
Motivation: Adam/SGD 等一阶优化器逐参数独立更新，无法利用高斯之间的结构与空间关系，收敛慢；已有学习型优化器绑定固定迭代数并需手动调度学习率，长时程会退化。
Method: 提出学习型优化器 Learn2Splat：元学习方案通过 checkpoint buffer 与 optimizer rollout 策略延长优化时程，架构在隐状态中编码梯度尺度信息；并构建统一框架在稀疏与稠密视角设定下训练与评估学习型与标准优化器。
Result: 在相同 wall-clock 时间下 novel view synthesis 质量更高，且在长时程上保持稳定，对未见数据集与设定零样本泛化；代码与模型将公开发布。
Conclusion: 把优化时程通过元学习与梯度尺度编码一起拉长，可以让学习型优化器在 3DGS 上无需辅助机制（如手动学习率调度）也不退化，并跨数据集零样本工作。

papers.title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often brittle in fine-grained manipulation, where minor action errors during the critical phases can rapidly escalate into irrecoverable failures. Since existing VLA models rely predominantly on successful demonstrations for training, they lack an explicit awareness of failure during these critical phases. To address this, we propose DreamAvoid, a critical-phase test-time dreaming framework that enables VLA models to anticipate and avoid failures. We also introduce an autonomous boundary learning paradigm to refine the system's understanding of the subtle boundary between success and failure. Specifically, we (1) utilize a Dream Trigger to determine whether the execution has entered a critical phase, (2) sample multiple candidate action chunks from the VLA via an Action Proposer, and (3) employ a Dream Evaluator, jointly trained on mixed data (success, failure, and boundary cases), to "dream" the short-horizon futures corresponding to the candidate actions, evaluate their values, and select the optimal action. We conduct extensive evaluations on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks. The results demonstrate that DreamAvoid can effectively avoid failures, thereby improving the overall task success rate. Across four real-world tasks, DreamAvoid achieves 72.5% success, compared with 48.8% for the base policy and 54.4% for GPC-RANK. Our code is available at https://github.com/XianzheFan/DreamAvoid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamAvoid 在 VLA 操作进入关键阶段 (critical phase) 时触发测试时「做梦」：由 Action Proposer 采样多个候选动作块，Dream Evaluator 推演短时未来并选最优动作，从而避开不可逆失败。四个真实操作任务上成功率 72.5%，对比基策略 48.8% 与 GPC-RANK 54.4%。
Motivation: VLA 策略在细粒度操作的关键阶段对微小动作误差极敏感，会迅速升级为不可逆失败；而训练主要依赖成功演示，模型对失败缺乏显式感知。
Method: 三个组件：Dream Trigger 判断是否进入关键阶段；Action Proposer 从 VLA 采样多个候选动作块；Dream Evaluator 在成功、失败与边界混合数据上联合训练，推演各候选的短时未来并评价值后选动作。另引入自主边界学习范式 (autonomous boundary learning) 细化成败边界。
Result: 在四个真实世界操作任务上 DreamAvoid 成功率 72.5%，基策略 48.8%，GPC-RANK 54.4%；另在仿真基准上做了评估，摘要称可有效避免失败并提升整体任务成功率。
Conclusion: 在关键阶段用测试时未来推演筛选候选动作，能显著抬高 VLA 操作成功率，成败边界样本的联合训练是其判断失败的依据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SMT-Based Active Learning of Weighted Automata
papers.abstract_en: We present an SMT-based active learning algorithm for nondeterministic weighted automata (WFAs) as a practical and robust alternative to Hankel/L*-style methods. Our algorithm is parametric in a given semiring and, if it terminates, guaranteed to produce minimal WFAs. We prove partial correctness and provide a sufficient termination condition, which in particular implies termination for all finite semirings. Our extensive experimental evaluation shows that our algorithm is capable of learning numerous minimal WFAs over both finite and infinite semirings, vastly outperforms a naive baseline, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art algorithm while producing significantly smaller automata and requiring less interaction with the teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 SMT 求解器的加权自动机 (WFA) 主动学习算法，作为 Hankel/L* 类方法的实用替代：对给定半环参数化，若终止则保证输出最小 WFA，并证明部分正确性与一个充分终止条件（该条件蕴含所有有限半环上必然终止）。实验中该算法能学习大量有限与无限半环上的最小 WFA，显著优于朴素基线，并在产出更小自动机、与教师交互更少的前提下与最先进算法竞争。
Motivation: Hankel/L* 风格的加权自动机主动学习在实践中的稳健性与交互开销存在问题，需要一个对半环参数化、可保证最小性与终止性的替代方案。
Method: 用 SMT 求解器驱动的主动学习算法学习非确定性加权自动机 (nondeterministic WFAs)，对任意给定半环参数化；证明部分正确性（若终止则输出最小 WFA）并给出充分终止条件，其中蕴含所有有限半环上的终止；实验覆盖有限与无限半环。
Result: 实验学习了众多有限与无限半环上的最小 WFA；相对朴素基线 (naive baseline) 大幅胜出；与最先进算法 (state-of-the-art) 相比具有竞争力，同时产出的自动机显著更小、与教师的交互次数更少。
Conclusion: SMT 驱动的主动学习可作为 Hankel/L* 类方法的实用且稳健的 WFA 学习路径，在有限半环上保证终止，并在自动机规模与查询开销上占优。

papers.title: ProteinJEPA: Latent prediction improves protein language model pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models are trained primarily with masked language modeling (MLM), which predicts masked amino-acid identities. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) instead predict latent representations, but have not been applied to proteins. ProteinJEPA supplements MLM with a cosine loss for predicting the half-depth hidden states of a teacher given the unmasked sequence. On 19 tasks, with ESM2 at 35M and 150M parameters and three pretraining seeds, MLM+JEPA outperforms compute-matched and step-matched MLM-only continued training in 78 and 76 of 114 comparisons (14 losses, 22 ties). The median compute-matched gain is $+0.0106$ on structure- and homology-sensitive tasks versus $+0.0041$ elsewhere, led by SCOPe-40 retrieval and remote homology with improvements of 6.1 percentage points in Recall@1 and 2.7 points in accuracy, respectively. Gains on these tasks increase with model size from 8M to 150M. Against the off-the-shelf checkpoint, MLM+JEPA wins 81 of 114 comparisons (median $+0.0068$) without improving MLM loss. In random initialization the gain is smaller and replicates inconsistently across seeds ($p{=}0.059$). The same recipe improves the causal ProGen3 model, beating a compute-matched next-token-prediction control on 12 of 16 tasks. Ablations show that cosine loss beats mean squared error, while adding shallower targets removes most of the task gain. JEPA-only training collapses downstream performance: latent prediction complements MLM rather than replacing it. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/protJepa-FF24
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProteinJEPA 在 ESM2（35M/150M）的 MLM 预训练上叠加一个余弦损失，用未掩码序列预测 teacher 半深度隐状态，在 19 个任务、3 个种子的 114 组对比中以 78 胜（compute-matched）领先纯 MLM 续训，结构与同源敏感任务中位增益 +0.0106，SCOPe-40 检索 Recall@1 提升 6.1 个百分点。纯 JEPA 训练会使下游性能崩溃，结论是隐预测只能补充 MLM 而非取代。
Motivation: 蛋白语言模型几乎只用 MLM 预测被掩氨基酸身份，而 JEPA 的隐空间预测此前未被用于蛋白；结构与远程同源这类任务对 MLM 而言增益有限。
Method: 在 MLM 目标之外加入余弦损失：以未掩码序列为输入，预测 teacher 网络半深度隐状态；在 ESM2 35M 与 150M、三个预训练种子上与 compute-matched 和 step-matched 的纯 MLM 续训对比，覆盖 19 个任务、14 类损失；另做随机初始化、ProGen3 因果模型迁移与消融（余弦 vs MSE、浅层目标、JEPA-only）。
Result: MLM+JEPA 在 114 组对比中胜 78（compute-matched）与 76（step-matched），22 组持平；compute-matched 下结构/同源敏感任务中位增益 +0.0106，其余任务 +0.0041，SCOPe-40 检索 Recall@1 +6.1 个百分点、远程同源 accuracy +2.7 个百分点，增益随模型从 8M 增至 150M 而扩大；对原厂 checkpoint 胜 81/114（中位 +0.0068）且 MLM loss 不降；随机初始化下增益更小且跨种子不稳（p=0.059）；ProGen3 上 16 个任务胜 12；消融显示余弦损失优于 MSE，加入更浅目标会抹去大部分任务增益。
Conclusion: 隐预测是 MLM 的补充而非替代：JEPA-only 训练使下游性能崩溃，而续训阶段叠加余弦隐预测能稳定抬高结构与同源检索类任务。

papers.title: EA-WM: Event-Aware Generative World Model with Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained video diffusion models provide powerful spatiotemporal generative priors, making them a natural foundation for robotic world models. While recent world-action models jointly optimize future videos and actions, they predominantly treat video generation as an auxiliary representation for policy learning. Consequently, they insufficiently explore the inverse problem: leveraging action signals to guide video synthesis, thereby often failing to preserve precise robot spatial geometry and fine-grained robot-object interaction dynamics in the generated rollouts. To bridge this gap, we present EA-WM, an Event-Aware Generative World Model that effectively closes the loop between kinematic control and visual perception. Rather than injecting joint or end-effector actions as abstract, low-dimensional tokens, EA-WM projects actions and kinematic states directly into the target camera view as Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields. To fully exploit this geometrically grounded representation, we introduce event-aware bidirectional fusion blocks that modulate cross-branch attention, capturing object state changes and interaction dynamics. Evaluated on the comprehensive WorldArena benchmark, EA-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing baselines by a significant margin.
papers.comment: Preprint. 31 pages, 15 figures. Added controlled analyses of KVAF representations, evaluation protocol and baseline reproduction details, computational overhead analysis, downstream functional evaluation, preliminary real-world evaluation, and counterfactual condition-following results. Code: https://github.com/Shownx-c/EA-WM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EA-WM 把机器人关节与末端执行器动作直接投影到目标相机视角，形成结构化运动到视觉动作场 (Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields, KVAF)，再用事件感知双向融合块调制跨分支注意力，让动作信号反向引导视频合成。在 WorldArena 基准上达到 SOTA，显著超越现有基线，生成 rollout 中保持了机器人空间几何与细粒度物体交互动力学。
Motivation: 现有 world-action 模型把视频生成当作策略学习的辅助表示，动作只作为低维 token 注入，反向问题——用动作信号引导视频合成——探索不足，导致生成 rollout 中机器人空间几何与物体交互动力学失真。
Method: 以预训练视频扩散模型为时空生成先验，将动作与运动学状态投影到目标相机视角得到 KVAF，替代低维 token 注入；引入事件感知双向融合块 (event-aware bidirectional fusion blocks) 调制跨分支注意力，捕捉物体状态变化与交互动力学，并联合优化未来视频与动作。
Result: 在 WorldArena 基准上取得 SOTA，显著超越现有基线；arXiv comment 另列出对 KVAF 表示的受控分析、基线复现、计算开销分析、下游功能评测、初步真实世界评测与反事实条件跟随结果。
Conclusion: 把动作几何地投到相机视角并让视频分支受事件感知调制，能闭合运动控制与视觉感知的回路，从而在生成 rollout 中保住精确空间几何与交互细节。

papers.title: CRISP: Compositional Relations as Invariant Structural Priors for Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization requires identifying stable representations that support reliable classification across domains. Domains may differ in low-level attributes, such as color, texture, or visual style, while preserving the same structural relationships among their underlying components. Existing methods primarily address these differences by improving the training process or aligning features across domains. However, since they leave this shared compositional structure implicit, they may overlook a more reliable source of invariance and consequently generalize less effectively to unseen domains. We propose Compositional Relational Invariance from Spatial Primitives (CRISP), an image classification framework that factors visual recognition into visual primitives and their relational composition. We represent these compositions using soft unary, binary, and ternary predicates over primitive locations and appearance, yielding differentiable measures of spatial and visual alignment that can be learned end-to-end. To learn primitives and relational structure jointly, we design an end-to-end architecture with three components: (1) a visual backbone that extracts generalized features, (2) a concept bottleneck layer that maps these features to primitive heatmaps with differentiable spatial coordinates, and (3) a structural scoring layer that evaluates candidate spatial relations among the detected primitives. Finally, we compute class probability from the joint evidence of its class-specific relational compositions and localized primitive appearance. We evaluate \method{} on five real-world image-classification datasets from the widely used DomainBed suite, covering shifts in depiction style, dataset provenance, and camera-trap location and achieving the new state-of-the-art on both benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRISP 把图像分类拆成视觉基元与基元间的组合关系，用可微的 unary/binary/ternary 谓词刻画空间与外观对齐，端到端学习后由类特定关系组合与基元外观的联合证据算出类别概率。在 DomainBed 五个真实图像分类数据集上覆盖描绘风格、数据来源与相机陷阱位置三类偏移，取得两个 benchmark 的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 域泛化现有方法只改进训练过程或做跨域特征对齐，把共享的组合结构留作隐式，因而可能错过更可靠的不变性来源，在未见域上泛化不足。
Method: 三段式端到端架构：视觉 backbone 提取泛化特征；concept bottleneck layer 把特征映射为基元热图与可微空间坐标；structural scoring layer 用 soft unary、binary、ternary 谓词对基元位置与外观打分，给出可微的空间/视觉对齐度量，最后由类特定关系组合与局部基元外观的联合证据计算类别概率。
Result: 在 DomainBed 套件的五个真实世界图像分类数据集上评测，覆盖描绘风格、数据集来源与相机陷阱位置偏移，在两个 benchmark 上均达到新的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把组合关系显式编码为不变结构先验，比只改训练或对齐特征更能支撑跨域分类，域泛化应显式建模基元间关系而非依赖隐式共享结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QuadraSHAP: Stable and Scalable Shapley Values for Product Games via Gauss-Legendre Quadrature
papers.abstract_en: We study the efficient computation of Shapley values for \emph{product games} -- cooperative games in which the coalition value factorizes as a product of per-player terms. Such games arise in machine learning explainability whenever the value function inherits a multiplicative structure from the underlying model, as in kernel methods with product kernels and tree-based models. Our key result is that the Shapley value of each player in a product game admits an exact one-dimensional integral representation: the weighted sum over exponentially many feature coalitions collapses to the integral of a degree-$(d-1)$ polynomial over $[0,1]$, where $d$ is the total number of features. This yields a Gauss--Legendre quadrature scheme that is \emph{provably exact} whenever the number of nodes satisfies $m_q \geq \lceil d/2 \rceil$, and otherwise provides a \emph{near-exact} approximation with error provably decaying geometrically in $m_q$. In practice, a few hundred nodes can achieve highly precise estimates even with thousands of features. Building on this formulation, we derive a numerically stable implementation via log-space evaluation, together with an efficient parallel implementation based on associative scan primitives that achieves $O(d\,m_q)$ total work and $O(\log d)$ parallel time. Experiments show that \textsc{QuadraSHAP} is the fastest numerically stable method across all tested configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuadraSHAP 把乘积博弈 (product games) 的 Shapley 值化为 [0,1] 上一个 d-1 次多项式的一维积分，用 Gauss-Legendre 求积在节点数 m_q ≥ ⌈d/2⌉ 时精确、否则误差随 m_q 几何衰减，配合 log 空间求值与 associative scan 并行实现，总工作量 O(d·m_q)、并行时间 O(log d)，实验中是所有测试配置下最快的数值稳定方法。
Motivation: 乘积博弈的 Shapley 值需要对指数多的特征联盟求加权和，直接计算在特征数上千时不可行，且现有方法在数值稳定性与速度上难以兼得。
Method: 先证明每个玩家的 Shapley 值等于 [0,1] 上 d-1 次多项式的加权积分，再用 Gauss-Legendre 求积离散；实现上用 log-space 求值保证数值稳定，并用 associative scan 原语做并行化，得到 O(d·m_q) 总工作量与 O(log d) 并行时间。
Result: 求积节点数 m_q ≥ ⌈d/2⌉ 时结果 provably exact，否则误差随 m_q 几何衰减；实践中数千特征只需几百个节点即可达到高精度；实验显示 QuadraSHAP 在所有测试配置中是最快的数值稳定方法。
Conclusion: 乘积结构使 Shapley 值的指数级联盟求和可塌缩为一维精确积分，从而同时拿到可证明的精度、数值稳定性和对数级并行深度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 求积节点数 m_q ≥ ⌈d/2⌉ 时结果 provably exact，否则误差随 m_q 几何衰减；实践中数千特征只需几百个节点即可达到高精度；实验显示 QuadraSHAP 在所有测试配置中是最快的数值稳定方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 乘积结构使 Shapley 值的指数级联盟求和可塌缩为一维精确积分，从而同时拿到可证明的精度、数值稳定性和对数级并行深度。

papers.title: Safeguarding LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Threats via Shadow Memory
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM)-powered agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex, real-world tasks, they face a growing class of attacks that exploit extended user-agent-environment interactions to pursue malicious objectives improbable in single-turn settings. Such long-horizon threats pose significant risks to the safe deployment of LLM agents in critical domains. In this paper, we present ShadowMem, a novel defensive framework designed to counter a wide range of long-horizon threats. Inspired by the "shadow stack" abstraction in systems security, ShadowMem maintains a dedicated, safety-focused agentic memory that distills and retains safety-critical context across the agent's full execution trajectory, leveraging this shadow memory to proactively assess the risk of pending actions prior to their execution. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that ShadowMem substantially outperforms existing defenses across diverse long-horizon threats in detection accuracy, achieves early-stage detection for the majority of attacks, and introduces only negligible overhead to agent utility. To our best knowledge, ShadowMem represents the first framework to detect and mitigate long-horizon threats using an agentic memory approach, establishing a new paradigm for this critical challenge and opening promising directions for future research. The artifacts are available at https://github.com/ZJUWYH/ShadowMem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ShadowMem：为 LLM agent 维护一条独立于主记忆的安全专用 agentic memory，从完整执行轨迹中蒸馏并保留安全关键上下文，在每个待执行动作落地前先做风险评估。在多种长程威胁上，其检测准确率显著优于现有防御，多数攻击可在早期阶段被检出，且对 agent 效用的开销可忽略。
Motivation: LLM agent 在多轮用户-agent-环境交互中会被利用来推进单轮场景下难以达成的恶意目标，这类长程威胁在关键领域风险高，而现有防御难以覆盖跨整条执行轨迹累积的攻击。
Method: 受系统安全中 shadow stack 抽象启发，ShadowMem 维护一条专职安全的 agentic memory，跨 agent 完整执行轨迹蒸馏并保留安全关键上下文，并在动作执行前用该 shadow memory 主动评估待执行动作的风险。
Result: 在多样化的长程威胁上，检测准确率显著优于现有防御；对多数攻击实现早期阶段检测；对 agent 效用仅引入可忽略的开销。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用 agentic memory 做长程威胁的检测与缓解是可行的新范式，据作者所知是首个用该思路处理长程威胁的框架；工件已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: ANO: Robust Policy Optimization via Bounded, Redescending Gain Fields
papers.abstract_en: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) dominates reinforcement learning and LLM alignment, yet its hard-clipping mechanism and unconstrained alternatives (e.g., SPO) sit at two extremes of a stability-efficiency dilemma. We argue that this dilemma is best understood dynamically: a surrogate objective is a feedback law on the probability ratio, and its clipping/penalty shape defines a gain field that drives the update dynamics. PPO's clip induces a dead zone (zero feedback outside the trust region), leaving the policy to drift open-loop under momentum; SPO's quadratic penalty induces an unbounded, linearly growing gain that stiffens the dynamics and destabilizes under aggressive step sizes. Guided by this view, we derive Anchored Neighborhood Optimization (ANO), which designs the gain field directly: a $C^\infty$ shaping kernel that anchors the identity map at $r{=}1$, peaks exactly at a prescribed trust-region boundary $1{+}ε$, bounds the push on severely off-policy samples by a tunable $κ_{+}$, and exerts a bounded, redescending pull of tunable depth $κ_{-}$ on extreme outliers. The three hyperparameters have decoupled roles, and all internal constants are solved in closed form. Empirically, ANO ranks first on both Atari (40 games) and MuJoCo in IQM and Median of normalized scores. While the runner-up differs across domains (PAPO on Atari, SPO on MuJoCo), ANO is the only method consistently at the top. Under a learning-rate stress test ($3\times10^{-4}\!\to\!10^{-3}$), ANO degrades by only $0.9\%$ whereas PPO collapses by $54.5\%$, and the stressed ANO still outperforms PPO and PAPO at their best-tuned learning rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANO 把 PPO 的代理目标重写为概率比上的反馈律并直接设计增益场：C∞ 整形核在 r=1 锚定恒等映射、在 1+ε 处取峰，用 κ+ 限制严重离策略样本的推力、用 κ- 对极端离群点施加有界回拉。在 Atari 40 游戏与 MuJoCo 上 IQM 和 Median 归一化得分均排第一；学习率从 3×10^-4 提到 10^-3 时 ANO 仅退化 0.9%，PPO 崩溃 54.5%。
Motivation: PPO 的硬裁剪在信任域外反馈为零，策略靠动量开环漂移；SPO 的二次惩罚增益无界线性增长，步长大时动力学变刚并失稳，两者构成稳定性-效率两难。
Method: 以反馈律视角推导 Anchored Neighborhood Optimization (ANO)：C∞ 整形核在 r=1 锚定恒等映射、峰值落在信任域边界 1+ε，κ+ 有界抑制严重离策略样本、κ- 对极端离群点做有界 redescending 拉回；三个超参角色解耦，内部常数全部闭式求解。
Result: ANO 在 Atari（40 游戏）与 MuJoCo 的 IQM 和 Median 归一化得分上均排第一，亚军在两域不同（Atari 为 PAPO、MuJoCo 为 SPO），ANO 是唯一始终居首的方法；学习率压力测试 3×10^-4→10^-3 下 ANO 仅退化 0.9%，PPO 崩溃 54.5%，且受压的 ANO 仍优于各自调到最佳学习率的 PPO 与 PAPO。
Conclusion: 把裁剪形状当作可设计的增益场，用有界且 redescending 的增益即可同时保住 PPO 的效率与大步长下的稳定性，三个解耦超参足以覆盖死区与无界增益两个极端。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anon: Extrapolating Adaptivity Beyond SGD and Adam
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive optimizers such as Adam and non-adaptive methods like SGD exhibit distinct generalization capabilities across different architectures. Prior tunable optimizers attempt to bridge this gap by strictly interpolating between SGD and Adam, effectively confining adaptivity within the 0-to-1 bound. However, this restricted interpolation is fundamentally insufficient: we reveal that optimal adaptivity often requires extrapolation, such as negative adaptivity for classical CNNs and adaptivity of at least one ($γ\geq 1$) for Transformers. Extrapolating adaptivity theoretically violates the strict non-decreasing pre-conditioner assumption, often leading to divergence in existing methods. To break this barrier, we propose Anon, an optimizer that achieves fully continuous adaptivity extrapolation across the entire real-number spectrum. To guarantee provable stability in these out-of-bound regimes, we introduce Incremental Delay Update (IDU), a novel mechanism that bypasses hard max-tracking strategies. We theoretically establish Anon's convergence in both convex and non-convex settings. Empirically, by exploring previously unreachable adaptivity landscapes, Anon demonstrates highly competitive and scalable performance among state-of-the-art element-wise optimizers on representative image classification, diffusion, and large language modeling tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anon 打破可调优化器把自适应度限制在 SGD 与 Adam 之间 0–1 区间的做法，允许在整个实数域上连续外推自适应度：经典 CNN 最优自适应度可为负，Transformer 则需 γ≥1。为在越界区间保证稳定，提出绕开硬 max-tracking 的 Incremental Delay Update (IDU)，并给出凸与非凸设定下的收敛性证明。
Motivation: 严格在 SGD 与 Adam 之间插值的可调优化器把自适应度锁死在 0–1，而最优自适应度常需外推（CNN 取负、Transformer 取 γ≥1）；外推又违反非递减 pre-conditioner 假设，导致现有方法发散。
Method: 提出优化器 Anon，实现整个实数谱上的连续自适应度外推；引入 Incremental Delay Update (IDU) 机制替代硬 max-tracking，以在越界区间保证可证稳定；理论上建立凸与非凸设定下的收敛性。
Result: 在图像分类、扩散模型与大语言模型任务上，Anon 在代表性 element-wise 优化器中表现出高度竞争力且可扩展的性能；理论结果为凸与非凸设定下的收敛性。
Conclusion: 自适应度应允许外推到 0–1 之外（CNN 可为负、Transformer 至少为 1），配合 IDU 这类绕开 max-tracking 的机制即可在越界区间保持可证稳定。

papers.title: Automated Palynological Analysis System: Integrating Deep Metric Learning, Detection and Classification in Bright Field Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Traditional melissopalynology is a time-consuming and subjective process, often taking 4-6 hours per sample. We present an automated, high-throughput microscopy system that integrates H_\infty robust mechanical control with advanced deep learning pipelines for the precise counting, classification, and morphological analysis of pollen grains from Bio Bio region in south central territory in Chile. Our system employs U^2-Net for salient object detection and a DINOv2 Vision Transformer backbone trained via Deep Metric Learning for classification. By integrating Gradient-Weighted Attention, the model provides human-interpretable texture and diagnostic feature annotations. The system achieves a 95.8% classification recall and at least 6x processing speedup compared to manual expert analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 H_∞ 鲁棒机械控制与深度学习拼成一套高通量显微镜系统，用 U^2-Net 做花粉粒显著性检测、DINOv2 ViT 经深度度量学习 (Deep Metric Learning) 做分类，再叠加 Gradient-Weighted Attention 给出可解释的纹理与诊断特征标注。对智利中南部 Bio Bio 地区花粉样本，分类 recall 达 95.8%，处理速度至少比人工专家分析快 6 倍，而传统 melissopalynology 每样本需 4–6 小时。
Motivation: 传统 melissopalynology（蜂蜜花粉分析）靠人工镜检计数与鉴定，每样本耗时 4–6 小时且主观性强，难以高通量处理。
Method: 系统集成 H_∞ 鲁棒机械控制与显微成像；检测用 U^2-Net 显著性目标检测，分类用 DINOv2 Vision Transformer 主干配合深度度量学习训练，并引入 Gradient-Weighted Attention 生成人类可解读的纹理与诊断特征标注。
Result: 分类 recall 95.8%，相对人工专家分析至少 6 倍处理加速；处理对象为 Bio Bio 地区花粉粒的计数、分类与形态分析，人工基线为每样本 4–6 小时。
Conclusion: 深度度量学习加可解释注意力的显微镜流水线可把花粉鉴定从数小时人工流程压缩到高通量自动流程，同时保留专家可核查的特征标注。

papers.title: Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts
papers.abstract_en: Deliberative multi-agent systems allow agents to exchange messages and revise beliefs over time. While this interaction is meant to improve performance, it can also create dangerous conformity effects: agreement, confidence, prestige, or majority size may be treated as if they were evidence, producing high-confidence convergence to false conclusions. To address this, we introduce PBRC (Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts), a protocol-level mechanism that strictly separates open communication from admissible epistemic change. A PBRC contract publicly fixes first-order evidence triggers, admissible revision operators, a priority rule, and a fallback policy. A non-fallback step is accepted only when it cites a preregistered trigger and provides a nonempty witness set of externally validated evidence tokens. This ensures that every substantive belief change is both enforceable by a router and auditable after the fact. In this paper, (a) we prove that under evidential contracts with conservative fallback, social-only rounds cannot increase confidence and cannot generate purely conformity-driven wrong-but-sure cascades. (b) We show that auditable trigger protocols admit evidential PBRC normal forms that preserve belief trajectories and canonicalized audit traces. (c) We demonstrate that sound enforcement yields epistemic accountability: any change of top hypothesis is attributable to a concrete validated witness set. For token-invariant contracts, (d) we prove that enforced trajectories depend only on token-exposure traces; under flooding dissemination, these traces are characterized exactly by truncated reachability, giving tight diameter bounds for universal evidence closure. Finally, we introduce a companion contractual dynamic doxastic logic to specify trace invariants, and provide simulations illustrating cascade suppression, auditability, and robustness-liveness trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PBRC 把多智能体审议中的开放交流与可接受的信念修正严格分开：契约公开固定证据触发条件、修正算子、优先级与回退策略，非回退步骤必须引用预注册触发并给出非空的外部验证证据 token 见证集。在保守回退的证据契约下，纯社会性回合不能提高置信度，也不会产生由从众驱动的“错但确信”级联；洪泛传播下轨迹由截断可达性刻画并给出紧的直径界。
Motivation: 审议式多智能体系统中，一致度、置信度、声望或多数规模可能被当作证据，导致对错误结论的高置信收敛，且信念变化事后无法归因。
Method: 提出协议级机制 PBRC：契约公开固定一阶证据触发、可容许修正算子、优先级规则与回退策略；非回退步骤须引用预注册触发并附非空的外部验证证据 token 见证集，由 router 强制执行并留下可审计轨迹。配套给出契约动态信念逻辑 (contractual dynamic doxastic logic) 描述轨迹不变式，并给出模拟。
Result: 证明在证据契约加保守回退下，纯社会回合不能提高置信度、不能产生纯从众的 wrong-but-sure 级联；证明可审计触发协议存在保持信念轨迹与规范化审计轨迹的 evidential PBRC 范式；token 不变契约下强制轨迹只依赖 token 暴露轨迹，洪泛传播下由截断可达性精确刻画并给出普适证据闭包的紧直径界；模拟展示级联抑制、可审计性与 robustness-liveness 权衡。
Conclusion: 把信念修正写成可强制、可审计的契约，就能把每一次顶层假设变更归因到具体已验证见证集，同时在保守回退下排除纯从众的高置信错误收敛。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: PBRC 把多智能体审议中的开放交流与可接受的信念修正严格分开：契约公开固定证据触发条件、修正算子、优先级与回退策略，非回退步骤必须引用预注册触发并给出非空的外部验证证据 token 见证集。在保守回退的证据契约下，纯社会性回合不能提高置信度，也不会产生由从众驱动的“错但确信”级联；洪泛传播下轨迹由截断可达性刻画并给出紧的直径界。
summary_sections.motivation: 审议式多智能体系统中，一致度、置信度、声望或多数规模可能被当作证据，导致对错误结论的高置信收敛，且信念变化事后无法归因。

papers.title: Vision-Based Safe Human-Robot Collaboration with Uncertainty Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Safe human-robot collaboration (HRC) requires accurate human pose estimation and motion prediction to prevent critical collisions. Existing certifiable safe HRC approaches are highly conservative or rely on marker-based motion tracking, while vision-based pose estimators lack the statistical guarantees required for certification in accordance with ISO 13849-1. Hence, we propose a pipeline that predicts 3D human motion and strong probabilistic bounds on the prediction error using conformal prediction. A gradient-based monitor detects out-of-distribution input poses and replaces them with poses from past predicted motions to maintain smooth operation. The resulting conformal prediction sets directly integrate into the provably safe HRC approach SARA shield. In experiments on the Human3.6M dataset and a real-world HRC setting, our conformal prediction sets have a 7.6 times smaller volume than model-based predictions, and we bound the probability of a dangerous failure per hour by 9.5E-7 with 99.999 % confidence under our test distribution, which is necessary but not sufficient for performance level d. All code and models are available at https://jakob-thumm.com/conformal_human_motion_prediction/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 ISO 13849-1 认证的人机协作安全，用 conformal prediction 给 3D 人体运动预测加上强概率误差界，并把分布外 (OOD) 输入姿态由梯度监测器替换为历史预测姿态以保持平滑运行。预测集可直接接入可证明安全的 SARA shield：在 Human3.6M 与真实 HRC 场景中，预测集体积比基于模型的预测小 7.6 倍，测试分布下每小时危险失效概率以 99.999% 置信度被界为 9.5E-7。
Motivation: 现有可认证的安全 HRC 方案要么极度保守、要么依赖标记点动作捕捉，而纯视觉姿态估计器缺少 ISO 13849-1 认证所需的统计保证，无法直接用于防碰撞。
Method: 流水线预测 3D 人体运动并用 conformal prediction 给出预测误差的概率界；梯度式监测器检测 OOD 输入姿态并用过去预测姿态替换；所得 conformal 预测集直接接入可证明安全的 HRC 方法 SARA shield。
Result: 在 Human3.6M 数据集与真实 HRC 场景实验中，conformal 预测集体积比基于模型的预测小 7.6 倍；在测试分布下每小时危险失效概率以 99.999% 置信度被界为 9.5E-7，作者指出这对 performance level d 是必要而非充分条件。
Conclusion: conformal 误差界加 OOD 监测能把视觉人体运动预测接入可证明安全的 HRC 防护层，但按 ISO 13849-1 该失效概率界只构成达到 performance level d 的必要条件。

papers.title: PipeLive: Efficient Live In-place Pipeline Parallelism Reconfiguration for Dynamic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism (PP) is widely used to partition layers of large language models (LLMs) across GPUs, enabling scalable inference for large models. However, existing systems rely on static PP configurations that fail to adapt to dynamic settings, such as serverless platforms and heterogeneous GPU environments. Reconfiguring PP by stopping and redeploying service incurs prohibitive downtime, so reconfiguration must instead proceed live and in place, without interrupting inference. However, live in-place PP reconfiguration is fundamentally challenging. GPUs are already saturated with model weights and KV cache, leaving little room for new layer placements and necessitating KV cache resizing, at odds with systems like vLLM that preallocate for throughput. Moreover, maintaining KV consistency during execution is difficult: stop-and-copy introduces large pauses, while background synchronization risks inconsistency as states evolve. We present PipeLive, which enables live in-place PP reconfiguration with minimal disruption. PipeLive introduces a redesigned KV cache layout together with a co-designed extension to PageAttention, forming a unified mechanism for live KV resizing. It further adopts an incremental KV patching mechanism, inspired by live virtual machine migration, to synchronize KV states between source and target configurations and identify a safe switch point. PipeLive achieves a 2.5X reduction in time-to-first-token (TTFT) without KV cache overflow compared to disabling KV resizing. Furthermore, compared to a variant without KV patching, it reduces reconfiguration overhead from seconds to under 10ms, and improves TTFT and time-per-output-token (TPOT) by up to 54.7% and 14.7%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PipeLive 让 LLM 流水线并行 (pipeline parallelism) 配置在推理不停机的情况下在线原地重配：重设计 KV cache 布局并扩展 PagedAttention 以支持在线 KV 缩容，再用受虚拟机热迁移启发的增量 KV patching 同步新旧配置状态并定位安全切换点。相比关闭 KV 缩容，TTFT 降低 2.5 倍且无 KV cache 溢出；相比去掉 KV patching 的变体，重配开销从秒级降到 10ms 以下，TTFT 与 TPOT 分别最多改善 54.7% 与 14.7%。
Motivation: 现有系统用静态 PP 配置，无法适配 serverless 与异构 GPU 环境；停机重部署代价过高，而 GPU 显存已被权重和 KV cache 占满，vLLM 式预分配又与在线缩容冲突，stop-and-copy 会造成长暂停、后台同步则有一致性风险。
Method: 重设计 KV cache 布局并与 PagedAttention 协同扩展，形成统一的在线 KV 缩容机制；再引入受 live VM migration 启发的增量 KV patching，在源配置与目标配置之间同步 KV 状态并识别安全切换点 (safe switch point)。
Result: 相比禁用 KV 缩容，TTFT 降低 2.5 倍且无 KV cache 溢出；相比无 KV patching 的变体，重配开销从秒级降到 10ms 以下，TTFT 最多改善 54.7%，TPOT 最多改善 14.7%。
Conclusion: 在线 KV 缩容与增量 patching 合起来可以让 PP 重配在不中断推理的前提下完成，把重配代价压到 10ms 以内。

papers.title: Joint Interference Detection and Identification via Adversarial Multi-task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Precise interference detection and identification are crucial for enhancing the survivability of communication systems in non-cooperative wireless environments. While deep learning (DL) has advanced this field, existing single-task learning (STL) approaches neglect inherent task correlations. Furthermore, emerging multi-task learning (MTL) methods often lack a theoretical foundation for quantifying and modeling task relationships. To bridge this gap, we establish a theoretically grounded MTL framework for joint interference detection, modulation identification, and interference identification. First, we derive an upper bound for the weighted expected loss in MTL frameworks. This bound explicitly connects MTL performance to task similarity, quantified by the Wasserstein distance and learnable task relation coefficients. Guided by this theory, we present the adversarial multi-task interference detection and identification network (AMTIDIN), which integrates adversarial training to minimize distributional discrepancies across tasks and uses adaptive coefficients to model task correlations dynamically. Crucially, we conducted a quantitative analysis of task similarity to reveal intrinsic task relationships, specifically that modulation identification and interference identification share a substantial feature overlap distinct from interference detection. Experiments demonstrate that AMTIDIN outperforms its independently trained single-task counterparts and MTL baselines under the evaluated conditions of limited training data, short signal lengths, and low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AMTIDIN：用对抗训练压低三个任务间的分布差异，并以可学习的任务关系系数动态建模相关性，联合做干扰检测、调制识别与干扰识别。理论上给出 MTL 加权期望损失上界，把性能与 Wasserstein 距离度量的任务相似度挂钩；定量分析显示调制识别与干扰识别特征重叠显著、且与干扰检测不同。在训练数据有限、信号短、低 SNR 条件下优于独立训练的单任务模型与 MTL 基线。
Motivation: 非合作无线环境中干扰检测与识别的单任务学习忽略任务间内在相关性，而现有 MTL 方法缺少量化、建模任务关系的理论依据。
Method: 先推导 MTL 加权期望损失上界，将性能与 Wasserstein 距离和可学习任务关系系数关联；据此构建 AMTIDIN，用对抗训练最小化跨任务分布差异，用自适应系数动态建模任务相关性，联合执行干扰检测、调制识别与干扰识别三个任务。
Result: 定量任务相似度分析显示调制识别与干扰识别共享大量特征、且与干扰检测明显不同；在训练数据有限、信号长度短、SNR 低的评估条件下，AMTIDIN 优于各自独立训练的单任务模型与 MTL 基线。
Conclusion: 以理论给出的任务相似度来驱动对抗式多任务学习，可在受限数据与低 SNR 条件下同时改善干扰检测与识别的联合性能。

papers.title: TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Study Selection in Systematic Reviews
papers.abstract_en: Server-based screening tools impose subscription costs, while open-source alternatives require coding skills, and full-text screening has remained outside the scope of no-code open-source tools. We developed TiAb Review Plugin, an open-source Chrome browser extension that provides no-code, serverless artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted study selection covering both title and abstract (T&A) screening and full-text screening. It uses Google Sheets as a shared database and Google Drive as a PDF store, and users supply their own large language model (LLM) API key. For T&A screening, it offers manual review, LLM batch screening, and machine learning (ML) active learning. For full-text screening, it retrieves open-access PDFs from PubMed Central, Europe PMC, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and publisher pages, supports blinded dual review with structured exclusion reasons and adjudication, optionally obtains an LLM judgment with page-anchored evidence, and computes PRISMA 2020 flow counts. We re-implemented the default ASReview algorithm (TF-IDF with Naive Bayes) in TypeScript and compared it with the Python original using 10-fold cross-validation on six datasets. For LLM T&A screening, we compared 16 parameter configurations on a benchmark dataset, validated the best (Gemini 3.0 Flash, low thinking budget, TopP 0.95) on five public datasets (1,038 to 5,628 records; 0.5% to 2.0% prevalence), and benchmarked nine further models from four developers. The TypeScript classifier produced top-100 rankings identical to ASReview on all six datasets. LLM T&A screening achieved recall of 94% to 100% with precision of 2% to 15%, and work saved over sampling at 95% recall (WSS@95) of 46.3% to 89.3%. No additional model exceeded the 96.1% recall of the reference configuration; the most recent models traded recall for precision. The classification accuracy of the full-text stage has not yet been evaluated.
papers.comment: v2: extends v1 (title and abstract screening only) to the full-text screening stage and adds a benchmark of nine further LLMs. 18 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/youkiti/tiab-review-plugin
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TiAb Review Plugin 是免代码、无服务器的 Chrome 扩展，把 AI 辅助的系统综述筛选覆盖到题录摘要与全文两个阶段，用 Google Sheets/Drive 当数据库与 PDF 库、用户自带 LLM API key。TypeScript 版 ASReview 默认算法 (TF-IDF + Naive Bayes) 在六个数据集上 top-100 排序与 Python 原版完全一致；LLM 题录筛选在五个公开数据集上 recall 94%–100%、precision 2%–15%、WSS@95 46.3%–89.3%，最佳配置为 Gemini 3.0 Flash (low thinking budget, TopP 0.95)。
Motivation: 服务器端筛选工具要订阅费，开源工具要写代码，全文筛选一直落在免代码开源工具之外。
Method: Chrome 扩展以 Google Sheets 为共享数据库、Google Drive 存 PDF，用户自备 LLM key；题录阶段提供人工、LLM 批量筛选与 ML 主动学习（TypeScript 重实现 ASReview 的 TF-IDF + Naive Bayes），全文阶段从 PubMed Central、Europe PMC、Unpaywall、OpenAlex 与出版商页面取开放获取 PDF，支持盲法双人筛选、结构化排除理由与仲裁、带页码锚点的 LLM 判读，并计算 PRISMA 2020 流程计数。
Result: TypeScript 分类器在六个数据集 10 折交叉验证下 top-100 排序与 ASReview Python 原版全部一致；在基准数据集上比较 16 种参数配置后选出 Gemini 3.0 Flash (low thinking budget, TopP 0.95)，在五个公开数据集（1,038–5,628 条记录，流行率 0.5%–2.0%）上 recall 94%–100%、precision 2%–15%、WSS@95 46.3%–89.3%；另测四家开发者的九个模型，无一超过参考配置的 96.1% recall，最新模型以 recall 换 precision。
Conclusion: 免代码、无服务器的浏览器扩展可以同时覆盖题录与全文筛选并复现 ASReview 排序；LLM 题录筛选在高 recall 下显著省力，但全文阶段的分类准确率尚未评估。

papers.title: Value Mirror Descent for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Value iteration-type methods have been extensively studied for computing a nearly optimal value function in reinforcement learning (RL). Under a generative sampling model, these methods can achieve sharper sample complexity than policy optimization approaches, particularly in their dependence on the discount factor. In practice, they are often employed for offline training. In this paper, we consider discounted Markov decision processes with state space S, action space A, discount factor $γ\in(0,1)$ and costs in $[0,1]$. We introduce a novel value optimization method, termed value mirror descent (VMD), which integrates mirror descent from convex optimization into the classical value iteration framework. In the deterministic setting with known transition kernels, we show that VMD converges linearly. For the stochastic setting with a generative model, we develop a stochastic variant, SVMD, which incorporates variance reduction commonly used in stochastic value iteration-type methods. For RL problems with general convex regularizers, SVMD attains a near-optimal sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2})$. Moreover, we establish that the Bregman divergence between the generated and optimal policies remains bounded throughout the iterations, even under the presence of model misspecification. This property is absent in existing stochastic value iteration-type methods but is important for enabling effective online (continual) learning following offline training. Under a strongly convex regularizer, SVMD achieves sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-5}ε^{-1})$, improving performance in the high-accuracy regime. Furthermore, we prove convergence of the generated policy to the optimal policy. Overall, the proposed method, its analysis, and the resulting guarantees, constitute new contributions to the RL and optimization literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 mirror descent 引入 value iteration 提出 value mirror descent (VMD/SVMD)：在 generative model 下一般凸正则的样本复杂度为 Õ(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2})，强凸正则下为 Õ(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-5}ε^{-1})，高精度区间更优；且迭代全程生成策略与最优策略的 Bregman divergence 有界，模型误设下也成立，便于离线训练后接在线学习。
Motivation: value iteration 类方法在 generative sampling model 下样本复杂度对折扣因子依赖更优，但缺少策略层面的可控性保证，离线训练后难以衔接在线持续学习。
Method: 在折扣 MDP（状态 S、动作 A、γ∈(0,1)、代价∈[0,1]）中把凸优化的 mirror descent 嵌入 value iteration：确定性已知转移核时为 VMD，随机 generative model 下加方差缩减得 SVMD，并支持一般凸正则与强凸正则两种分析。
Result: 确定性已知转移核下 VMD 线性收敛；一般凸正则 SVMD 样本复杂度 Õ(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2})，接近最优；强凸正则下 Õ(|S||A|(1-γ)^{-5}ε^{-1})，高精度区间更优；生成策略与最优策略的 Bregman divergence 全程有界（含模型误设），并证明策略收敛到最优策略。
Conclusion: value iteration 与 mirror descent 结合可同时拿到对 (1-γ) 与 ε 的更优样本复杂度和策略级 Bregman 有界性，后者是既有随机 value iteration 类方法不具备、支撑离线转在线学习的关键性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe learning-based control via function-based uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification is essential when deploying learning-based control methods in safety-critical systems. This is commonly realized by constructing uncertainty tubes that enclose the unknown function of interest, e.g., the reward and constraint functions or the underlying dynamics model, with high probability. However, existing approaches for uncertainty quantification typically rely on restrictive assumptions that encode smoothness properties of the unknown function, such as a known norm in a function space. Moreover, these methods usually struggle with discontinuities. In this paper, we model the unknown function as a random function from which independent and identically distributed realizations can be generated. We then construct uncertainty tubes via the scenario approach that hold with high probability. Our uncertainty tubes rely solely on sampled realizations and can therefore accommodate discontinuities represented by the sampling model. We integrate these uncertainty tubes into a safe Bayesian optimization algorithm with which we safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把未知函数当作可采样的随机函数，用 scenario approach 从独立同分布样本直接构造高概率不确定性管道 (uncertainty tube)，再嵌入安全贝叶斯优化来调控制器参数。管道只依赖采样实现，因此能容纳采样模型中的不连续性，避开已知函数空间范数等光滑性假设，并在真实 Furuta 摆上完成安全调参。
Motivation: 安全关键系统里基于学习的控制需要包住奖励、约束或动力学未知函数的不确定性管道，但现有方法依赖已知函数空间范数这类限制性光滑性假设，且难以处理不连续函数。
Method: 将未知函数建模为可生成独立同分布实现的随机函数，用 scenario approach 基于样本实现构造高概率不确定性管道；再把该管道接入安全贝叶斯优化算法，在真实 Furuta 摆上安全调节控制参数。
Result: 不确定性管道仅依赖采样实现，可容纳采样模型所表示的不连续性，无需已知函数空间范数等光滑性假设；管道以高概率成立，并被集成进安全贝叶斯优化在真实 Furuta 摆上进行控制参数调优。
Conclusion: 基于采样的 scenario approach 可以替代依赖光滑性假设的不确定性量化路线，为不连续未知函数提供高概率管道并支撑安全关键系统中的学习式控制调参。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Helping Customers in Distress: An LLM-powered Agent that Converses, Probes, and Routes
papers.abstract_en: Banks receive millions of reports of fraud, scams, and disputed transactions every year, making it challenging to accurately direct customers to the appropriate specialist teams for assistance. The existing manual process driven by humans is slow and stressful for both customers and staff. To address this, we develop a customer-facing AI powered triaging agent that leverages large language models (LLMs) to conduct multi-turn conversations, ask relevant questions, and classify cases for accurate, policy-guided routing, making it embedded in the customer journey. To evaluate and continuously improve the agent, synthetic digital twins of real customers were simulated, generating realistic, labelled dialogues based on historical data to test a wide range of real-world scenarios. This work details the triage agent's modelling approach, integration with policy, safety guardrails and reasoning frameworks, the use of the synthetic agent for scalable evaluation, and findings on the AI system's accuracy, robustness, and compliance. Results show that the agent successfully improves triaging of historical cases, achieving a 30.6% increase in classification accuracy, with high satisfaction levels reported by our subject-matter experts, highlighting how targeted probing can lead to more effective triage in banking operations at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向银行欺诈与争议交易的客服分流，用 LLM 智能体做多轮对话、针对性追问并按政策把案件路由到正确的专业团队；在基于历史数据合成的客户数字孪生上评测，分类准确率提升 30.6%，领域专家满意度高。
Motivation: 银行每年收到数百万起欺诈、诈骗与争议交易报告，人工分流慢且对客户和员工都有压力，难以准确地把案件导向对应专业团队。
Method: 构建面向客户的 LLM 分流智能体：多轮对话提问、按政策做路由分类，结合安全护栏与推理框架，并把政策嵌入流程；用基于历史数据模拟的合成客户数字孪生生成带标签对话，做可扩展的评测与持续改进。
Result: 历史案件分流的分类准确率提升 30.6%；领域专家 (subject-matter experts) 报告满意度高；摘要给出的发现覆盖系统的准确率、鲁棒性与合规性。
Conclusion: 把针对性追问 (targeted probing) 嵌入客户旅程并用合成数字孪生做评测，可以在银行业规模化地提升分流准确率，同时保持政策合规与专家认可。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Softmax gradient policy for variance minimization and risk-averse multi armed bandits
papers.abstract_en: Algorithms for the Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) problem play a central role in sequential decision-making and have been extensively explored both theoretically and numerically. While most classical approaches aim to identify the arm with the highest expected reward, we focus on a risk-aware setting where the goal is to select the arm with the lowest variance, favoring stability over potentially high but uncertain returns. To model the decision process, we consider a softmax parameterization of the policy; we propose a new algorithm to select the minimal variance (or minimal risk) arm and prove its convergence under natural conditions. The algorithm constructs an unbiased estimate of the objective by using two independent draws from the selected arm's distribution. We provide numerical experiments that illustrate the practical behavior of these algorithms and offer guidance on implementation choices. The setting also covers general risk-aware problems where there is a trade-off between maximizing the average reward and minimizing its variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多臂老虎机 (MAB) 中改以最小方差（最小风险）臂为目标，用 softmax 策略参数化提出新算法：从所选臂分布取两次独立抽样构造目标的无偏估计，并在自然条件下证明收敛。数值实验展示算法行为并给出实现选择指导，设置同时覆盖均值-方差权衡的一般风险感知问题。
Motivation: 经典 MAB 算法以期望奖励最大的臂为目标，而风险感知场景更看重回报稳定、偏好低方差而非高但不确定的收益，这一目标缺少带收敛保证的算法。
Method: 对策略做 softmax 参数化，提出选择最小方差（最小风险）臂的新算法；用所选臂分布的两次独立抽样构造目标的无偏估计，并在自然条件下证明收敛。
Result: 给出收敛性证明；数值实验展示算法的实际行为并提供实现选择方面的指导，覆盖均值最大化与方差最小化的权衡问题。
Conclusion: 以方差为优化目标的 softmax 策略可以在自然条件下收敛到最小风险臂，该框架适用于均值与方差之间存在权衡的一般风险感知决策问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FSCE: A Target-Aware Frequency-Spatial Collaborative Enhancement Framework for Noise-Resilient SAR ATR
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition (SAR ATR) is severely challenged by coherent speckle noise, whose interference can be progressively amplified by hierarchical nonlinear transformations and eventually damage high-level semantic representations. To address this issue, we propose a Target-Aware Frequency-Spatial Collaborative Enhancement (FSCE) framework for noise-resilient SAR ATR, which integrates frequency-spatial modeling for early feature stabilization with semantic regularization. Specifically, we design a Frequency-Spatial Early-stage Adaptive Enhancement (FS-EAE) module at the network entrance to suppress noise propagation and preserve target structures through collaborative spatial-frequency modeling. Building upon stabilized shallow representation, we further introduce an Adaptive Policy-driven Semantic Alignment (APSA) mechanism, which uses an online teacher policy to impose top-down semantic constraints on the student and feeds semantic guidance back to the enhanced early features during training. Experiments on MSTAR, OpenSARShip, and FUSARShip demonstrate the effectiveness of this synergy. Moreover, the competitive performance of our lightweight impletation $\text{FSCE-Net}_μ$ with only 0.17M parameters suggests that the proposed framework is applicable to both high-capacity and lightweight architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FSCE 框架在网络入口用频率-空间早期自适应增强模块 (FS-EAE) 抑制相干斑噪声沿层级非线性变换传播，再用自适应策略驱动的语义对齐机制 (APSA) 以在线 teacher 策略自上而下约束 student 并把语义引导回灌早期特征。在 MSTAR、OpenSARShip、FUSARShip 上验证有效，轻量版 FSCE-Net_μ 仅 0.17M 参数仍有竞争力表现，说明该框架可同时用于高容量与轻量架构。
Motivation: SAR ATR 中相干斑噪声会被层级非线性变换逐步放大，最终破坏高层语义表示，需要在网络早期就稳定特征。
Method: FSCE 框架含两部分：网络入口的 FS-EAE 模块通过空间-频率协同建模抑制噪声传播并保持目标结构；在其稳定的浅层表示之上，APSA 机制用在线 teacher 策略对 student 施加自上而下语义约束，并在训练中把语义引导反馈到增强后的早期特征。
Result: 在 MSTAR、OpenSARShip、FUSARShip 三个数据集上实验验证了频率-空间建模与语义正则协同的有效性；轻量实现 FSCE-Net_μ 仅 0.17M 参数即取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 早期频率-空间去噪与语义对齐的协同对噪声鲁棒 SAR ATR 有效，且该框架可同时适配高容量与轻量架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Remember: Attentive Reinforcement Learning for Edge Serverless Autoscaling
papers.abstract_en: In edge computing, the stochastic and bursty nature of serverless workloads challenges autonomous resource orchestration. Traditional reactive controllers, such as the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA), suffer from reaction latency, leading to Service Level Objective (SLO) violations during traffic spikes and resource flapping during ramp-downs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a pathway toward proactive management, standard agents suffer from \textit{temporal blindness}, an inability to exploit the recent temporal context in non-Markovian edge environments. To bridge this gap, we propose a stability-aware autoscaling framework unifying short-horizon temporal context and control via an Attention-Enhanced Double-Stacked LSTM architecture integrated within a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent. Unlike shallow recurrent models, our approach employs a learned attention mechanism that weights recent historical states non-uniformly, suppressing high-frequency jitter while preserving the trend that precedes demand shifts. We validate the framework on two independent Kubernetes clusters using real-world Azure Functions traces. Against the single-layer LSTM ablation and the static HPA baseline, our approach reduces P90 latency by $\approx$67\%, and holds average latency within the 50ms hard SLO for 98.8\% of the run against 49.6\% and 43.5\% respectively. Against Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling (KEDA), it matches latency performance at 75\% fewer replica-steps and 59\% less churn, with P90 hard-SLO violation bursts of at most 5 consecutive intervals against up to 24 for KEDA. These results indicate that mitigating temporal blindness through deep attentive memory improves the reliability and stability of Kubernetes autoscaling under bursty edge workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向边缘 serverless 弹性伸缩，提出以 Attention-Enhanced Double-Stacked LSTM 增强的 PPO 智能体，用可学习注意力对近期历史状态非均匀加权，抑制高频抖动并保留需求转折前的趋势。在两个 Kubernetes 集群上用 Azure Functions 真实轨迹验证，P90 延迟较单层 LSTM 消融与静态 HPA 基线降低约 67%，50ms 硬 SLO 内平均延迟达标时间占 98.8%（对照 49.6% 与 43.5%）。
Motivation: 边缘 serverless 负载随机且突发，HPA 这类反应式控制器存在响应延迟，流量尖峰时违反 SLO、缩容时资源抖动；标准 DRL 智能体在非马尔可夫边缘环境中存在 temporal blindness，无法利用近期时序上下文。
Method: 提出稳定性感知的伸缩框架：Attention-Enhanced Double-Stacked LSTM 嵌入 PPO 智能体，用学习到的注意力机制对近期历史状态非均匀加权，抑制高频抖动并保留需求变化前的趋势；在两个独立 Kubernetes 集群上以 Azure Functions 真实轨迹验证，并与单层 LSTM 消融、静态 HPA、KEDA 对比。
Result: 相对单层 LSTM 消融与静态 HPA，P90 延迟降低约 67%；平均延迟保持在 50ms 硬 SLO 内的运行时间占 98.8%，对照分别为 49.6% 与 43.5%。相对 KEDA，延迟性能相当但 replica-steps 少 75%、churn 少 59%，P90 硬 SLO 违规突发最多连续 5 个区间，KEDA 最多达 24 个。
Conclusion: 用深度注意力记忆缓解 temporal blindness，可在突发边缘负载下同时提升 Kubernetes 伸缩的可靠性与稳定性，并以更少副本步数和更低抖动达到与 KEDA 相当的延迟。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Binary Classification from Coupled Pairwise Labels
papers.abstract_en: Even when it is difficult to assign absolute class labels to individual instances, relational information may still be available, such as whether two instances belong to the same class or which instance is more likely to belong to the positive class. In this study, we refer to these two types of information as Similarity/Dissimilarity (SD) labels and Pairwise Comparison (Pcomp) labels, respectively, and consider binary classification that uses both types of relational information from the same instance pairs. SD learning uses the distinction between similar and dissimilar pairs but does not use the ordering within each pair, whereas Pcomp learning uses the ordering within each pair but does not distinguish between similar and dissimilar pairs. We therefore propose SD-Pcomp learning, whose objective function simultaneously preserves the structures of both SD learning and Pcomp learning. The proposed objective function admits two decompositions: one consists of an SD estimator plus a term that represents ordering information from Pcomp labels, and the other consists of a Pcomp estimator plus a term that represents pair-type information from SD labels. These decompositions clarify how the complementary information provided by SD and Pcomp labels is integrated into the proposed objective function. Experiments on eight datasets compare the proposed method with SD learning, Pcomp learning, and a method that takes a convex combination of their objective functions. We evaluate the effect of using both types of relational information on classification performance in terms of classification accuracy and AUC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SD-Pcomp learning：对同一批实例对同时利用 Similarity/Dissimilarity 标签与 Pairwise Comparison 标签，目标函数同时保持两种关系结构，并给出两种分解（SD 估计器加排序项，或 Pcomp 估计器加对型项）以说明互补信息如何合并。在八个数据集上以分类准确率和 AUC 与 SD learning、Pcomp learning 及二者目标函数的凸组合比较。
Motivation: 许多场景难以给单个实例打绝对类别标签，但成对关系仍可得：SD 标签只区分类别异同不用序，Pcomp 标签只用序不区分异同，单独用任一种都会丢掉另一半信息。
Method: 提出 SD-Pcomp 目标函数，同时保持 SD 学习与 Pcomp 学习的结构；该目标可分解为「SD 估计器 + 来自 Pcomp 标签的排序项」或「Pcomp 估计器 + 来自 SD 标签的对型项」两种形式，从而显式刻画两类标签的互补信息如何进入同一目标。
Result: 在八个数据集上比较所提方法与 SD learning、Pcomp learning、以及两者目标函数凸组合的方法，用分类准确率 (classification accuracy) 与 AUC 度量两类关系信息同时使用对分类性能的影响。
Conclusion: SD 与 Pcomp 标签携带互补结构，可在同一目标函数中同时整合，其两种分解给出互补信息进入目标的两条等价路径。

papers.title: An Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for Fluid Flow in Dual-Network Porous Media
papers.abstract_en: Porous materials -- natural or engineered -- often exhibit dual pore-network structures that govern processes such as mineral exploration and hydrocarbon recovery from tight shales. Double porosity/permeability (DPP) mathematical models describe incompressible fluid flow through two interacting pore networks with inter-network mass exchange. Despite significant advances in numerical methods, there remains a need for computational frameworks that enable rapid forecasting, data assimilation, and reliable inverse analysis. To address this, we present a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for forward and inverse modeling of DPP systems. The proposed approach encodes the governing equations in mixed form, along with boundary conditions, directly into the loss function, with adaptive weighting strategies to balance their contributions. Key features of the framework include adaptive weight tuning, dynamic collocation point selection, and the use of shared trunk neural architectures to efficiently capture the coupled behavior of the dual pore networks. It is inherently mesh-free, making it well-suited for complex geometries typical of porous media. It accurately captures discontinuities in solution fields across layered domains without introducing spurious oscillations commonly observed in classical finite element formulations. Importantly, the framework is well-suited for inverse analysis, enabling robust parameter identification in scenarios where key physical quantities -- such as the mass transfer coefficient in DPP models -- are difficult to measure directly. In addition, a systematic convergence analysis is provided to rigorously assess the stability, accuracy, and reliability of the method. The effectiveness and computational advantages of the approach are demonstrated through a series of representative numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对双孔隙/双渗透 (DPP) 多孔介质不可压流动，提出一个把混合形式控制方程与边界条件直接写进损失函数的 PINN 框架，配自适应权重调节、动态配点选择和共享 trunk 网络，同时做正演与反演。方法无网格、能捕捉分层域解的间断而不产生经典有限元常见的伪振荡，并给出系统收敛性分析与数值实验。
Motivation: DPP 模型数值方法虽有进展，但仍缺少能快速预报、做数据同化与可靠反演的计算框架，且质量传递系数等关键物理量难以直接测量。
Method: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN)：把混合形式的 DPP 控制方程与边界条件编码进损失函数，用自适应权重调节平衡各项贡献，配合动态配点选择与共享 trunk 神经架构捕捉双孔隙网络耦合行为；无网格，适用于复杂几何，并附系统收敛性分析。
Result: 在代表性数值实验中展示方法有效性与计算优势；分层域解场间断被准确捕捉且无数值振荡；框架支持对质量传递系数等难测参数的鲁棒辨识，并提供稳定性、精度与可靠性的收敛性分析。
Conclusion: 把 DPP 方程以混合形式嵌入带自适应权重的 PINN，可同时胜任正演、反演参数辨识与快速预报，且在分层间断问题上比经典有限元更干净。

papers.title: Measuring and Exploiting Contextual Bias in LLM-Assisted Security Code Review
papers.abstract_en: Automated Code Review (ACR) systems integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software development workflows, ranging from interactive assistants to autonomous agents in CI/CD pipelines. In this paper, we study how LLM-based vulnerability detection in ACR is affected by the framing effect: the tendency to let the presentation of information override its semantic content in forming judgments. We examine whether adversaries can exploit this through contextual-bias injection (crafting PR metadata to bias ACR security judgments) as a supply-chain attack vector against real-world ACR pipelines. To this end, we first conduct a large-scale exploratory study across 6 LLMs under five framing conditions, establishing the framing effect as a systematic and widespread phenomenon in LLM-based vulnerability detection. We then design a realistic and controlled experimental environment, evaluating 33 CVEs across 20 real-world projects and two popular ACR pipelines (Claude Code and CodeRabbit), to assess the susceptibility of real-world ACR pipelines to vulnerability re-introduction attacks. We employ two attack strategies: a template-based attack inspired by prior related work, and a novel LLM-assisted refinement attack. We find that template-based attacks are ineffective and may even backfire, as direct biasing attempts raise suspicions. Our refinement attack, on the other hand, is successful in 32/33 (97%) cases, exploiting a fundamental asymmetry: attackers can iteratively refine attacks against a local clone of the review pipeline, while defenders have only one chance to detect them. Overall, our findings highlight the dangers of over-relying on ACR and stress the importance of human oversight and contributor trust in the development process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 自动代码审查 (ACR) 的漏洞判定会被 PR 元数据的表述框架 (framing effect) 系统性带偏，攻击者可借此做上下文偏置注入 (contextual-bias injection) 作为供应链攻击。基于模板的直接诱导无效甚至适得其反，而 LLM 辅助迭代精修的攻击在 33 个 CVE 中成功 32 个 (97%)，因为攻击者可对本地审查流水线反复试错，防守方只有一次检测机会。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的 ACR 已进入 CI/CD 流水线，但其漏洞判定可能被 PR 元数据的呈现方式而非语义内容左右，从而成为可被利用的供应链攻击面。
Method: 先在 6 个 LLM、五种框架条件下做大规模探索性研究确立 framing effect；再在 20 个真实项目、33 个 CVE 上搭建受控环境，接入 Claude Code 与 CodeRabbit 两条 ACR 流水线，比较模板式攻击与新提出的 LLM 辅助精修攻击两类策略。
Result: 6 个 LLM、五种框架条件下 framing effect 被证实为系统性且普遍的现象；模板式攻击无效甚至因直接诱导引起怀疑而适得其反；LLM 辅助精修攻击在 33 个 CVE 中成功 32 个 (97%)，触发漏洞重新引入。
Conclusion: ACR 的安全判定可被 PR 元数据层面的上下文偏置注入操纵，攻防存在迭代试错与单次检测的根本不对称，因此不能过度依赖 ACR，需保留人工监督与贡献者信任机制。
