papers.title: The Truncation Blind Spot: How Decoding Strategies Systematically Exclude Human-Like Token Choices
papers.abstract_en: Why does machine-generated text remain detectable? We investigate a mechanistic explanation at the decoding stage: standard strategies such as top-$k$ and nucleus sampling restrict generation to high-probability tokens, while human writers routinely choose contextually appropriate words from deeper in the model's probability distribution. Truncation makes a measurable share of these choices unreachable; we call this the \emph{truncation blind spot}. Across five open models and three domains, 8--18\% of human-selected tokens fall outside common truncation boundaries. Linguistic analysis further reveals disproportionate exclusion of content-word tokens. In a benchmark comprising 1.8 million machine generations, classifiers using only predictability and lexical diversity achieve mean AUC-ROC near 0.97, with substantial variation across decoding settings and strong transfer across generators. Probability-floor samplers substantially narrow the blind spot, demonstrating that the choice of truncation criterion matters for retaining human-used tokens. Together, these findings characterize a source of human--machine distributional mismatch and motivate decoding methods that preserve contextually appropriate low-probability choices while maintaining generation quality. Code and data are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/human_vs_machine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: top-k 与 nucleus 采样把生成截断在高概率 token 上，导致人类作者常用的低概率词不可达，即“截断盲区” (truncation blind spot)。在 5 个开放模型、3 个领域上，8–18% 的人类选词落在常见截断边界之外，且内容词被不成比例地排除；180 万条机器生成文本上，仅用可预测性与词汇多样性的分类器 mean AUC-ROC 约 0.97。
Motivation: 机器生成文本持续可被检测，作者提出机制性解释：解码阶段的截断策略造成人机 token 分布错配，使人类常用词在生成时不可达。
Method: 在 5 个开放模型、3 个领域上比较标准截断策略 (top-k、nucleus) 与 probability-floor 采样，统计人类选词落在截断边界外的比例并做语言学分析；另构建 180 万条机器生成文本的 benchmark，用仅含可预测性与词汇多样性的分类器检测。
Result: 8–18% 的人类选词落在常见截断边界之外，内容词 token 被不成比例排除；180 万条机器生成上分类器 mean AUC-ROC 接近 0.97，随解码设置显著变化且跨生成器强迁移；probability-floor 采样明显缩小盲区。
Conclusion: 截断判据的选择决定人类使用 token 的保留程度，解码方法应在保持生成质量的同时保留语境合适的低概率选择。

papers.title: Toward Measuring Structural Drift in LLM Communication Loops
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly run in stateful pipelines that assemble each prompt from retrieval, memory, tools, and other agents. Such pipelines drift: information that should shape the next response is dropped, compressed, or misrouted while every component still reports success. Existing diagnostics miss this because they evaluate isolated prompts, responses, or task scores, whereas what decouples is the relation between a prompt and the response it draws. Here we show that treating the prompt to response to next prompt chain as the fundamental unit of analysis makes these relations measurable. We introduce structural communication coherence, quantified by two metrics: communication closure, which asks if what the pipeline returns at one turn matches what it faces next, and normalized conditional action contribution, which measures how much a sent message resolves the subsequent reply. Across 2,171 human to human, 58 human to LLM, and 8 LLM to LLM dialogues, these metrics reveal directional interaction structures; crucially, the measured contribution drops by 87 to 92% when a response is swapped for one from another turn, leaving surrounding prompts untouched. Because this approach requires no labels, healthy reference data, or predefined rules only the raw prompts and responses drift can be defined and measured directly from operational traffic, rather than inferred from eventual task failure. Establishing prospective detection performance is the next step.

papers.title: MessyKitchens: Contact-rich object-level 3D scene reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D scene reconstruction has recently seen significant progress. Powered by the modern neural architectures and large-scale data, recent methods achieve high performance in depth estimation from a single image. Meanwhile, reconstructing and decomposing common scenes into individual 3D objects remains a hard challenge due to the large variety of objects, frequent occlusions and complex object relations. Notably, beyond shape and pose estimation of individual objects, applications in robotics and animation require physically-plausible scene reconstruction where objects obey physical principles of non-penetration and realistic contacts. In this work we advance object-level scene reconstruction along two directions. First, we introduceMessyKitchens, a new dataset with real-world scenes featuring cluttered environments and providing high-fidelity object-level ground truth in terms of 3D object shapes, poses and accurate object contacts. Second, we build on the recent SAM 3D approach for single-object reconstruction and extend it with Multi-Object Decoder (MOD) for joint object-level scene reconstruction. To validate our contributions, we demonstrate MessyKitchens to significantly improve previous datasets in registration accuracy and inter-object penetration. We also compare our multi-object reconstruction approach on three datasets and demonstrate consistent and significant improvements of MOD over the state of the art. Our new benchmark, code and pre-trained models will become publicly available on our project website: https://messykitchens.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MessyKitchens 数据集与 Multi-Object Decoder (MOD)：在 SAM 3D 单物体重建基础上做联合多物体解码，输出满足非穿透与真实接触的物体级 3D 形状、位姿与接触。在三个数据集上 MOD 相对现有方法一致且显著提升，MessyKitchens 在配准精度与物体间穿透上显著优于此前数据集。
Motivation: 单图深度估计已进步，但把杂乱场景分解成独立 3D 物体仍困难，且机器人与动画需要满足非穿透和真实接触的物理合理重建，现有数据集缺少物体级接触真值。
Method: 发布 MessyKitchens：真实杂乱场景，提供物体级 3D 形状、位姿与精确接触的高保真真值；在 SAM 3D 单物体重建之上扩展 Multi-Object Decoder (MOD) 做联合物体级场景重建，并以配准精度与物体间穿透验证。
Result: MessyKitchens 在配准精度与物体间穿透上显著优于此前数据集；MOD 在三个数据集上相对 state of the art 一致且显著提升。
Conclusion: 物体级联合解码加带接触真值的杂乱场景数据集，是把重建推向物理合理场景的可行路径；基准、代码与预训练模型将在项目网站公开。

papers.title: InterPol: De-anonymizing LM Arena via Interpolated Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Strict anonymity of model responses is a key for the reliability of voting-based leaderboards, such as LM Arena. While prior studies have attempted to compromise this assumption using simple statistical features like TF-IDF or bag-ofwords, these methods often lack the discriminative power to distinguish between stylistically similar or within-family models. To overcome these limitations and expose the severity of vulnerability, we introduce INTERPOL, a model-driven identification framework that learns to distinguish target models from others using interpolated preference data. Specifically, INTERPOL captures deep stylistic patterns that superficial statistical features miss by synthesizing hard negative samples through model interpolation and employing an adaptive curriculum learning strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that INTERPOL significantly outperforms existing baselines in identification accuracy. Furthermore, we quantify the real-world threat of our findings through ranking manipulation simulations on Arena battle data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INTERPOL 用插值偏好数据训练模型驱动的识别框架，通过模型插值合成难负样本并配合自适应课程学习，捕捉 TF-IDF、词袋等浅层统计特征抓不到的深层文风模式，从而破解 LM Arena 等投票榜单的响应匿名性。在识别准确率上显著超过既有基线，并在 Arena battle 数据上用排名操纵仿真量化了真实威胁。
Motivation: 投票式榜单依赖模型响应严格匿名，但既有攻击只用 TF-IDF、词袋等简单统计特征，难以区分文风相近或同家族模型，匿名假设的脆弱性被低估。
Method: INTERPOL 是模型驱动的识别框架：用插值偏好数据 (interpolated preference data) 学习区分目标模型与其他模型，通过模型插值合成难负样本 (hard negatives)，并采用自适应课程学习策略 (adaptive curriculum learning) 逐步提升判别难度。
Result: 识别准确率显著优于既有基线；并在 Arena battle 数据上通过排名操纵仿真 (ranking manipulation simulations) 量化了该漏洞的真实世界威胁。
Conclusion: 基于浅层统计特征的匿名攻击低估了漏洞：深层文风模式可被学习到，投票榜单的匿名性假设在模型驱动识别面前不成立，且威胁可直接转化为排名操纵。

papers.title: Look Where It Matters: High-Resolution Crops Retrieval for Efficient VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) typically process images at a native high-resolution, forcing a trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency: high-resolution inputs capture fine details but incur significant computational costs, while low-resolution inputs advocate for efficiency, they potentially miss critical visual information, like small text. We present AwaRes, a spatial-on-demand framework that resolves this accuracy-efficiency trade-off by operating on a low-resolution global view and using tool-calling to retrieve only high-resolution segments needed for a given query. We construct supervised data automatically: a judge compares low- vs.\ high-resolution answers to label whether cropping is needed, and an oracle grounding model localizes the evidence for the correct answer, which we map to a discrete crop set to form multi-turn tool-use trajectories. We train our framework with cold-start SFT followed by multi-turn GRPO with a composite reward that combines semantic answer correctness with explicit crop-cost penalties. Project page: https://nimrodshabtay.github.io/AwaRes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AwaRes 让 VLM 先看低分辨率全局图，再用 tool-calling 只检索当前问题真正需要的高分辨率切片，从而同时保住细节精度与算力效率。监督数据由 judge 自动构造：对比低/高分辨率答案判定是否需要裁剪，oracle grounding 模型定位证据并映射为离散 crop 集合，形成多轮工具使用轨迹；训练用 cold-start SFT 接 multi-turn GRPO，奖励把语义正确性与显式 crop 代价惩罚合成。
Motivation: VLM 在原生高分辨率输入下精度与计算成本必须二选一：高分辨率算得贵，低分辨率会丢掉小字等关键细节。
Method: 低分辨率全局视图 + 按需检索高分辨率切片的 spatial-on-demand 框架；自动构造监督数据（judge 判定是否需要裁剪，oracle grounding 定位证据并离散化为 crop 集合，产出多轮 tool-use 轨迹），先 cold-start SFT 再 multi-turn GRPO，奖励为语义正确性加显式 crop-cost 惩罚的复合形式。
Result: 摘要给出的是流程与训练配方本身：自动 judge/oracle 数据管线、多轮工具轨迹、SFT+GRPO 复合奖励（含 crop 代价项），未列出数据集上的具体精度或成本数字。
Conclusion: 把高分辨率需求变成按查询触发的检索动作并把裁剪成本写进奖励，是化解 VLM 精度-效率权衡的一条可行路径。

papers.title: Med-V1: Small Language Models for Zero-shot and Scalable Biomedical Evidence Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Assessing whether an article supports an assertion is essential for hallucination detection and claim verification. While large language models (LLMs) have the potential to automate this task, achieving strong performance requires frontier models such as GPT-5 that are prohibitively expensive to deploy at scale. To efficiently perform biomedical evidence attribution, we present Med-V1, a family of small language models with only three billion parameters. Trained on high-quality synthetic data newly developed in this study, Med-V1 substantially outperforms (+27.0% to +71.3%) its base models on five biomedical benchmarks unified into a verification format. Despite its smaller size, Med-V1 performs comparably to frontier LLMs such as GPT-5, along with high-quality explanations for its predictions. We use Med-V1 to conduct a first-of-its-kind use case study that quantifies hallucinations in LLM-generated answers under different citation instructions. Results show that the format instruction strongly affects citation validity and hallucination, with GPT-5 generating more claims but exhibiting hallucination rates similar to GPT-4o. Additionally, we present a second use case showing that Med-V1 can automatically identify high-stakes evidence misattributions in clinical practice guidelines, revealing potentially negative public health impacts that are otherwise challenging to identify at scale. Overall, Med-V1 provides an efficient and accurate lightweight alternative to frontier LLMs for practical, real-world biomedical evidence attribution. Med-V1 is available at https://github.com/NLM-DIR/Med-V1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Med-V1 是一个 30 亿参数的生物医学证据归因小模型族，用新构建的高质量合成数据训练，在五个统一为验证格式的生物医学基准上比其 base model 提升 +27.0% 到 +71.3%，性能与 GPT-5 相当并给出解释。用它做幻觉量化发现引用格式指令会强烈影响引用有效性与幻觉率，GPT-5 产出更多 claim 但幻觉率与 GPT-4o 相近；还能在临床实践指南中自动识别高风险证据误归因。
Motivation: 判断文章是否支持某断言是幻觉检测与 claim 验证的核心，但依赖 GPT-5 等前沿模型成本过高，无法大规模部署。
Method: 构建 30 亿参数的小语言模型族 Med-V1，用本研究新开发的高质量合成数据训练，把五个生物医学基准统一成验证格式做评测；再以 Med-V1 作为判别器开展两项用例研究：不同引用指令下 LLM 生成答案的幻觉量化，以及临床实践指南中的证据误归因识别。
Result: 在五个统一为验证格式的生物医学基准上，Med-V1 比其 base model 提升 +27.0% 到 +71.3%，体量更小却与 GPT-5 等前沿 LLM 表现相当并附带高质量解释。用例研究显示格式指令强烈影响引用有效性与幻觉，GPT-5 生成更多 claim 但幻觉率与 GPT-4o 相近；第二项用例在临床实践指南中识别出高风险证据误归因，揭示难以大规模发现的潜在负面公共卫生影响。
Conclusion: 轻量模型加高质量合成数据足以在生物医学证据归因上替代前沿 LLM 做大规模部署，同时可作为审计工具量化幻觉与误归因。

papers.title: Regular Fourier Features for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract_en: Simulating a Gaussian process requires sampling from a high-dimensional Gaussian distribution, which scales cubically with the number of sample locations. Spectral methods address this challenge by exploiting the Fourier representation and treating the spectral density as a probability distribution suitable for Monte Carlo approximation. Although this probabilistic interpretation is valid for stationary processes, it is overly restrictive for the nonstationary case, where spectral densities are generally not probability measures. To avoid this limitation, we propose regular Fourier features for harmonizable processes with one-dimensional inputs. Our method discretizes the spectral representation directly, preserving the correlation structure among spectral weights without requiring probability assumptions. Assuming finite spectral support, this yields an efficient low-rank approximation that is positive semi-definite by construction and consistent under mild regularity conditions. When the spectral density is unknown, the framework also extends to kernel learning from data, which we explore as a proof of concept. We demonstrate the approximation on locally stationary and harmonizable mixture kernels, the latter with a complex-valued spectral density. As a feasibility study, we then apply the kernel-learning extension to real and synthetic data, where it matches competitive baselines.

papers.title: A Very Big Video Reasoning Suite
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in video models has largely focused on visual quality, leaving their reasoning capabilities underexplored. Video reasoning grounds intelligence in spatiotemporally consistent visual environments that go beyond what text can naturally capture, enabling intuitive reasoning over spatiotemporal structure such as continuity, interaction, and causality. However, systematically studying video reasoning and its scaling behavior is hindered by the lack of large-scale training data. To address this gap, we introduce the Very Big Video Reasoning (VBVR) Dataset, an unprecedentedly large-scale resource spanning 200 curated reasoning tasks following a principled taxonomy and over one million video clips, approximately three orders of magnitude larger than existing datasets. We further present VBVR-Bench, a verifiable evaluation framework that moves beyond model-based judging by incorporating rule-based, human-aligned scorers, enabling reproducible and interpretable diagnosis of video reasoning capabilities. Leveraging the VBVR suite, we conduct one of the first large-scale scaling studies of video reasoning and observe early signs of emergent generalization to unseen reasoning tasks. Together, VBVR lays a foundation for the next stage of research in generalizable video reasoning. The data, benchmark toolkit, and models are publicly available at https://video-reason.com/?v=vbvr .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VBVR 套件：含 200 个按分类学整理的推理任务、逾一百万视频片段的 VBVR 数据集，以及用规则化、对齐人类打分的 VBVR-Bench 评测框架。借助该套件做大规模 scaling 研究，观察到模型对未见推理任务出现早期涌现泛化迹象。
Motivation: 视频模型进展集中于画质，推理能力研究不足；而系统研究视频推理及其 scaling 行为受制于缺少大规模训练数据。
Method: 构建 VBVR Dataset：按原则性分类学整理的 200 个推理任务、逾 100 万视频片段，规模约为现有数据集的三个数量级；配套 VBVR-Bench，用规则化、与人类对齐的 scorer 取代基于模型的评判，提供可复现、可解释的诊断。
Result: 数据集覆盖 200 个推理任务与逾 100 万视频片段，约为现有数据集的三个数量级；基于 VBVR 套件完成首批大规模 video reasoning scaling 研究之一，观察到对未见推理任务的早期涌现泛化迹象。
Conclusion: 大规模、任务分类学化的视频推理数据加上规则化可验证评测，是研究 video reasoning scaling 与泛化的基础；数据、评测工具与模型已公开。

papers.title: LORA-CRAFT: Cross-layer Rank Adaptation via Frozen Tucker Decomposition of Pre-trained Attention Weights
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LoRA-CRAFT (\textbf{C}ross-layer \textbf{R}ank \textbf{A}daptation via \textbf{F}rozen \textbf{T}ucker), abbreviated CRAFT throughout, an extremely parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that applies Tucker tensor decomposition to pre-trained attention weight matrices stacked across transformer layers and trains only small square adaptation matrices on the resulting frozen Tucker factors. Existing tensor-based PEFT methods decompose \textit{gradient updates}: LoTR applies Tucker decomposition with shared factor matrices, while SuperLoRA groups and reshapes $ΔW$ across layers before applying Tucker decomposition. Separately, methods such as PiSSA apply SVD to \textit{pre-trained weights} but operate independently per layer. CRAFT bridges these two lines of work: it performs full Tucker decomposition via Higher-Order SVD (HOSVD) directly on \textit{pre-trained weights} organized as cross-layer 3D tensors, freezes all resulting factors, and adapts the model through lightweight trainable transformations applied to each factor matrix. Experiments on the GLUE benchmark using RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large, as well as commonsense reasoning benchmarks using LLaMA2-7B and LLaMA3-8B, demonstrate that CRAFT achieves competitive performance with existing methods while requiring only \rev{\textbf{extremely low Tucker adaptation parameters}}. \fixw{On LLaMA3-8B, CRAFT} \rev{exceeds the average accuracy of LoRA} \textbf{using hundreds of times fewer parameters}\fixw{; on LLaMA2-7B the same holds at a $0.252$M budget}. Our results suggest that CRAFT's efficiency advantage grows with model scale, as the frozen Tucker factors better capture the richer cross-layer structure of larger pre-trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoRA-CRAFT 把跨层堆叠的预训练注意力权重组织成 3D 张量，用 HOSVD 做完整 Tucker 分解并冻结全部因子，只训练各因子矩阵上的小型方阵适配器。在 GLUE（RoBERTa-base/large）与常识推理基准（LLaMA2-7B、LLaMA3-8B）上性能与现有 PEFT 方法相当，参数量低数百倍；LLaMA2-7B 在 0.252M 预算下同样超过 LoRA 平均精度，且优势随模型规模增大。
Motivation: 现有张量 PEFT 只分解梯度更新（LoTR 共享因子、SuperLoRA 跨层重塑 ΔW），而对预训练权重做 SVD 的 PiSSA 逐层独立操作，跨层结构未被利用。
Method: CRAFT 将预训练注意力权重按层堆成 3D 张量，用 Higher-Order SVD (HOSVD) 做完整 Tucker 分解，冻结全部因子矩阵，仅在每个因子上训练轻量方阵变换；与分解梯度更新的 LoTR、SuperLoRA 及逐层 SVD 的 PiSSA 对比。
Result: 在 GLUE（RoBERTa-base、RoBERTa-large）与常识推理基准（LLaMA2-7B、LLaMA3-8B）上，CRAFT 以极低 Tucker 适配参数取得与现有方法相当的性能；LLaMA3-8B 上平均精度超过 LoRA 而参数少数百倍，LLaMA2-7B 在 0.252M 参数预算下同样成立。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CRAFT 的效率优势随模型规模增长，因为冻结的 Tucker 因子能更好捕捉更大预训练模型中更丰富的跨层结构。

papers.title: Learning to Approximate Uniform Facility Location via Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks, particularly message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), are increasingly used as heuristics for hard combinatorial optimization problems. Yet many learning-based methods rely on supervision, reinforcement learning, or gradient estimators, causing high computational cost, unstable training, or limited guarantees. Classical approximation algorithms provide worst-case guarantees but are non-differentiable and cannot adapt to structure in natural input distributions. We study this tradeoff through Uniform Facility Location (UniFL), a problem with applications in clustering, summarization, logistics, and supply chains. We propose a fully differentiable MPNN that incorporates approximation-algorithmic principles without solver supervision or discrete relaxations. The model has provable approximation guarantees and empirically improves on standard approximation algorithms, narrowing the gap to integer linear programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对均匀设施选址 (Uniform Facility Location, UniFL)，提出一个完全可微的 MPNN，把近似算法的设计原则直接嵌入网络结构，无需求解器监督、强化学习或离散松弛。模型带有可证明的近似保证，实验上优于标准近似算法并缩小了与整数线性规划 (ILP) 的差距。
Motivation: 基于学习的组合优化启发式依赖监督、RL 或梯度估计，带来高计算成本、训练不稳定和有限保证；经典近似算法有最坏情况保证但不可微、无法利用真实输入分布的结构。
Method: 提出融合近似算法原则的全可微 message-passing neural network (MPNN)，不使用求解器监督、不依赖离散松弛，直接对 UniFL 输出选址解。
Result: 模型具有可证明的近似保证；实验中优于标准近似算法，并缩小了与整数线性规划 (ILP) 的解差距（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把近似算法原理嵌入可微架构，可以在保留理论保证的同时获得经验性能提升，缓解学习方法与经典保证之间的取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inverse Problems Conditioned on Observation Ensembles: Applications and Methods
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new multivariate statistical problem that we refer to as the Ensemble-conditioned Inverse Problem (EIP). The aim of EIP is to invert for an ensemble that is distributed according to the pushforward of a prior under a forward process. In high energy physics (HEP), this is related to a widely known problem called unfolding, which aims to reconstruct the true physics distribution from observations that are distorted by detector effects. The EIP also arises in full waveform inversion (FWI) and inverse imaging with unknown priors. We propose non-iterative inference-time methods that construct posterior samplers based on a new class of conditional generative models, which we call ensemble inverse generative models. For the posterior modeling, these models additionally use the ensemble information contained in the observation set on top of single observations. Unlike existing methods, our proposed methods avoid explicit and iterative use of the forward model at inference time via training across several sets of truth-observation pairs that are consistent with the same forward model, but originate from a wide range of priors. We empirically demonstrate that this training procedure can implicitly encode the likelihood model, enabling direct posterior inference for unseen priors to some degree. We benchmark the proposed method on several synthetic and real datasets in inverse imaging, HEP, and FWI. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhengyanHuan/EIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ensemble-conditioned Inverse Problem (EIP)：在观测集合条件下反演服从先验经前向过程推前分布的集合，用一类条件生成模型（ensemble inverse generative models）在推理时非迭代地构造后验采样器。训练用多组与同一前向模型一致、但来自不同先验的真值-观测对，隐式编码似然，从而对未见先验可直接做后验推断。
Motivation: HEP unfolding、全波形反演 (FWI) 与未知先验的反演成像都需要在观测集合条件下反演真值分布，而已有方法在推理时需显式、迭代地调用前向模型，代价高且依赖先验已知。
Method: 提出 EIP 这一新多变量统计问题，并设计一类条件生成模型 ensemble inverse generative models：除单个观测外还利用观测集合中的集合信息建模后验；训练跨多组与同一前向模型一致、来自广泛不同先验的真值-观测对，使似然被隐式编码，推理时非迭代、不显式调用前向模型。
Result: 在反演成像、HEP 与 FWI 的多个合成与真实数据集上做了实证检验，表明该训练过程可隐式编码似然模型，并在一定程度上对未见先验直接做后验推断；代码发布于 github.com/ZhengyanHuan/EIP。
Conclusion: 跨先验训练的条件生成模型可以把前向模型的似然吸收进权重，使集合条件反演在推理时免于迭代前向求解，并对未见先验保持一定程度的直接后验推断能力。

papers.title: Advances in Diffusion-Based Generative Compression
papers.abstract_en: Popularized by their strong image generation performance, diffusion and related methods for generative modeling have found widespread success in visual media applications. In particular, diffusion methods have enabled new approaches to data compression, where realistic reconstructions can be generated at extremely low bit-rates. This article provides a unifying review of recent diffusion-based methods for generative lossy compression, with a focus on image compression. These methods generally encode the source into an embedding and use a diffusion model to iteratively refine it during decoding, so that the reconstruction approximately follows the true data distribution. The embedding can take various forms and is typically transmitted via an auxiliary entropy model, and recent methods also explore the use of diffusion models themselves for information transmission via channel simulation. We review representative approaches through the lens of rate-distortion-perception theory, highlighting the role of common randomness and connections to inverse problems, and identify open challenges.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in IEEE BITS the Information Theory Magazine. v2: revised text, corrected equations, and expanded references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述扩散式生成有损图像压缩的统一范式：编码端把源压成 embedding，解码端用扩散模型迭代精修，使重建近似服从真实数据分布，并从率-失真-感知 (rate-distortion-perception) 理论视角梳理代表性方法。文章指出 embedding 通常经辅助熵模型传输，近期工作改用扩散模型本身经信道模拟 (channel simulation) 传信息，并强调 common randomness 的作用与和逆问题的联系。
Motivation: 扩散模型让极低码率下的逼真重建成为可能，但该领域方法分散在生成建模、熵编码与逆问题多个视角下，缺少统一的理论框架来解释 embedding、随机性与码率之间的关系。
Method: 作为综述性文章，统一归纳近期扩散式生成有损压缩方法（以图像压缩为主）：编码为 embedding、解码用扩散模型迭代精修，embedding 经辅助熵模型或经扩散模型的信道模拟传输；并以率-失真-感知理论、common randomness 与逆问题联系作为组织透镜。
Result: 给出扩散式生成压缩在极低码率下可生成逼真重建的定性结论，并通过率-失真-感知视角识别出开放挑战；文中含 1 篇幅 1 图，无实验数值对比。
Conclusion: 扩散式生成压缩应放在率-失真-感知理论下理解，common randomness 与逆问题视角是解释现有方法并定位开放问题的关键线索。

papers.title: Self-Improvement as Coherence Optimization: A Theoretical Account
papers.abstract_en: Can language models improve their accuracy without external supervision? Methods such as debate, bootstrap, and internal coherence maximization achieve this surprising feat, even matching golden finetuning performance. Yet why they work remains theoretically unclear. We show that they can all be understood as coherence optimization, the search for a context-to-behavior mapping that is most compressible and jointly predictable, with debate an exact instance and bootstrap and internal coherence maximization closely related to it. We prove that coherence optimization is equivalent to description-length regularization, and that among all such regularization schemes, coherence regularization with a prior derived from a pretrained model optimizes a lower bound of worst-case accuracy for semi-supervised learning. Our theory, supported by preliminary experiments, explains why feedback-free self-improvement works and predicts when it should succeed or fail.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 debate、bootstrap、内部一致性最大化等无外部监督的自提升方法统一为一致性优化 (coherence optimization)：搜索最可压缩且可联合预测的 context-to-behavior 映射，其中 debate 是其精确实例。证明一致性优化等价于描述长度正则，且由预训练模型导出先验的一致性正则在半监督学习中优化最坏情况准确率的下界。

Result: debate 被证明是一致性优化的精确实例，bootstrap 与内部一致性最大化与之紧密相关；一致性优化等价于描述长度正则；在所有此类正则方案中，带预训练模型先验的一致性正则优化半监督学习最坏情况准确率的下界；结论由初步实验 (preliminary experiments) 支持。

papers.title: GlyRAG: Context-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate blood glucose forecasting using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data can support the early prediction of dysglycemic risk. However, current neural-network-based forecasting models treat CGM data as a purely numerical sequence without integrating the contextual information contained in CGM signal morphology. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for time-series forecasting, yet their role as agentic context extractors in diabetes care remains largely unexplored. In this study, we bridge glucose forecasting and LLM-based contextualization by developing GlyRAG, a context-aware, retrieval-augmented forecasting framework that uses an LLM as a contextualization agent to summarize glucose morphology directly from a timed CGM window. The generated CGM-only narrative is embedded and fused with patch-based glucose representations, while a retrieval module incorporates similar historical training episodes through cross-attention. We evaluate GlyRAG on the OhioT1DM and AZT1D datasets for 5-, 30-, and 60-minute forecasting horizons. Compared with strong CGM-only baselines, GPT-4 GlyRAG significantly improves long-horizon root mean square error (RMSE) over PatchTST on both datasets. For example, RMSE decreases from 13.8 to 10.6 at 30 minutes and from 23.1 to 20.2 at 60 minutes on OhioT1DM. LLaMA 3.1 produces smaller but significant long-horizon gains, suggesting that the contextualization pipeline is not limited to GPT-4. Clinical error-grid analyses further show that approximately 85 percent of predictions fall within the clinically acceptable Clarke Error Grid Zones A and B. These results suggest that CGM-derived linguistic context and case-based retrieval can improve long-horizon glucose forecasting without requiring additional sensing modalities.
papers.comment: Accepted IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (IEEE JBHI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlyRAG 把 LLM 当作上下文代理，从带时间戳的 CGM 窗口直接生成血糖形态叙述，嵌入后与 patch 化葡萄糖表征融合，再用检索模块经 cross-attention 引入相似历史训练片段。在 OhioT1DM 与 AZT1D 上评测 5/30/60 分钟预报：GPT-4 版 GlyRAG 相对 PatchTST 显著降低长时效 RMSE，OhioT1DM 上 30 分钟从 13.8 降到 10.6、60 分钟从 23.1 降到 20.2，约 85% 预测落在 Clarke Error Grid A、B 区。
Motivation: 现有神经网络把 CGM 当纯数值序列，丢掉了信号形态里的情境信息；LLM 作为 agentic 上下文提取器在糖尿病照护中的作用基本未被探索，长时效血糖预报误差偏大。
Method: GlyRAG 用 LLM 从定时 CGM 窗口生成仅基于 CGM 的形态叙述，将叙述 embedding 后与 patch-based 葡萄糖表征融合；检索模块通过 cross-attention 引入相似历史训练 episodes。在 OhioT1DM 与 AZT1D 上评测 5、30、60 分钟三种预报时效，对照强 CGM-only 基线（PatchTST），并分别用 GPT-4 与 LLaMA 3.1 作上下文化代理，辅以临床误差网格分析。
Result: GPT-4 GlyRAG 在两个数据集上均显著改善长时效 RMSE（相对 PatchTST）：OhioT1DM 30 分钟 RMSE 13.8 → 10.6，60 分钟 23.1 → 20.2。LLaMA 3.1 带来幅度较小但显著的长时效增益。临床误差网格分析显示约 85% 的预测落在 Clarke Error Grid A 区与 B 区。
Conclusion: CGM 派生的语言学上下文加基于案例的检索，无需额外传感模态即可改善长时效血糖预报，且上下文化管线不依赖 GPT-4 这一特定模型。

papers.title: VLM2GeoVec: Toward Universal Multimodal Embeddings for Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Satellite imagery differs from natural images in viewpoint, resolution, scale variation, and the prevalence of small objects -- demanding both region-level spatial reasoning and holistic scene understanding. Existing remote-sensing approaches are fragmented: dual-encoder retrieval models scale well but cannot interleave modalities, whereas generative assistants support grounding, yet are inefficient for retrieval. Benchmarks mirror this split: interleaved evaluations mainly target generative assistants, while cross-modal retrieval benchmarks target dual encoders. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RSMEB}, a unified remote sensing benchmark that evaluates cross-modal and interleaved retrieval across 21 tasks under a single ranking protocol, enabling comprehensive comparison of retrieval models on region- and geo-aware capabilities as well as conventional retrieval. As a strong reference baseline, we present \textbf{VLM2GeoVec}, an instruction-conditioned, single-encoder interleaving formulation tailored to remote sensing that packs image, text, bounding-box, and geo-coordinate tokens into one sequence and learns a unified embedding via contrastive training. Across RSMEB, VLM2GeoVec achieves $\textbf{26.6\%}$ P@1 in region-caption retrieval ($\textbf{+25}$ percentage points), $\textbf{32.5\%}$ in referring-expression retrieval ($\textbf{+19}$), and $\textbf{17.8\%}$ in semantic geo-aware retrieval ($\textbf{>3}$$\times$ prior best), while remaining competitive in conventional scene classification and text--image retrieval in zero-shot settings. Together, the proposed suite and reference baseline standardize evaluation and deliver a unified embedder for scalable retrieval and region-/geo-aware grounding. The code, the model checkpoints, and the data are available at https://github.com/emasa/VLM2GeoVec.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop - TerraBytes II, 38 pages, 10 figures

TL;DR: 提出统一遥感检索基准 RSMEB，在单一排序协议下覆盖 21 项跨模态与交错检索任务，并给出单编码器参考模型 VLM2GeoVec：把图像、文本、bounding box 与地理坐标 token 拼成一条序列，用对比学习训练出统一 embedding。在 RSMEB 上其 region-caption 检索 P@1 达 26.6%（+25 个百分点），指代表达检索 32.5%（+19），语义地理感知检索 17.8%（超过先前最优 3 倍以上），常规场景分类与图文检索在 zero-shot 下仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 遥感检索现状割裂：双编码器可扩展却无法交错模态，生成式助手支持 grounding 却不适合检索；评测也随之分裂，交错评测偏向生成式、跨模态检索基准偏向双编码器，region 与 geo-aware 能力缺少统一比较口径。
Method: RSMEB 用单一排序协议统一评测跨模态与交错检索共 21 项任务，覆盖 region、geo-aware 与常规检索；参考基线 VLM2GeoVec 为 instruction-conditioned 单编码器交错方案，将图像、文本、bounding box、地理坐标 token 打包进同一序列，经对比学习得到统一 embedding。
Result: 在 RSMEB 上，VLM2GeoVec 的 region-caption 检索 P@1 为 26.6%（提升 25 个百分点），指代表达检索 32.5%（提升 19 个百分点），语义地理感知检索 17.8%（超过先前最优 3 倍以上）；常规场景分类与图文检索在 zero-shot 设定下保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把 region 与 geo-aware 检索纳入同一基准、并用单编码器交错建模统一 embedding，可在可扩展检索与 region/geo-aware grounding 之间不再二选一；代码、模型 checkpoint 与数据已开源。

papers.title: BOCO: Bayesian Online Contextual Optimization for Decision-Focused Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) trains predictive models to optimize downstream decisions rather than prediction accuracy alone. While recent studies have extended this paradigm to online settings with streaming data, existing online DFL methods generally maintain a point estimate, while their gradient-based updates require either a differentiable optimization layer or a problem-specific surrogate loss. Consequently, they can be unstable under limited data and difficult to apply across heterogeneous optimization problems. We introduce Bayesian Online Contextual Optimization (\texttt{BOCO}), a framework that maintains a decision-focused posterior over model parameters. \texttt{BOCO} aggregates the resulting predictions when prescribing decisions, thereby accounting for parameter uncertainty. To track this posterior in evolving environments, we develop two particle-based inference algorithms: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler for nondifferentiable problems and a function-space Stein variational gradient descent algorithm for differentiable problems. Across both real-world tasks, \texttt{BOCO} reduces running mean regret and temporal regret variability relative to two frequentist online DFL baselines. At the full horizon, relative to the best frequentist baseline, BOCO reduces running mean regret and temporal regret variability by 6.9\% and 6.3\% on knapsack and by 49.3\% and 38.1\% on energy scheduling, respectively. The gains are larger early in the data stream, a pattern consistent with a benefit from accounting for parameter uncertainty when data are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BOCO 在在线决策聚焦学习 (decision-focused learning) 中维护参数的决策聚焦后验而非点估计，用序贯蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 处理不可微问题、用函数空间 Stein 变分梯度下降 (SVGD) 处理可微问题，并对预测做聚合以纳入参数不确定性。相对最优频域基线，knapsack 上 running mean regret 与时间 regret 变异性分别降 6.9% 与 6.3%，energy scheduling 上降 49.3% 与 38.1%，且数据流早期增益更大。
Motivation: 现有在线 DFL 方法只维护点估计，梯度更新需要可微优化层或问题特定代理损失，导致数据有限时不稳、且难以跨异构优化问题复用。
Method: BOCO 维护模型参数的决策聚焦后验，决策时聚合后验预测；用粒子推断跟踪演化环境：面向不可微问题的 sequential Monte Carlo 采样器，以及面向可微问题的 function-space Stein variational gradient descent。
Result: 在两个真实任务上相对最优频域在线 DFL 基线：knapsack 的 running mean regret 降 6.9%、时间 regret 变异性降 6.3%；energy scheduling 分别降 49.3% 与 38.1%。增益在数据流早期更大，与数据有限时参数不确定性建模的收益一致。
Conclusion: 在线 DFL 中用后验而非点估计并聚合预测，可在数据有限阶段更稳地降低 regret，且 SMC 与函数空间 SVGD 使其能覆盖不可微与可微两类优化问题。

papers.title: Parameter Importance-Driven Continual Learning for Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific post-training often causes catastrophic forgetting, making foundation models lose their general reasoning ability and limiting their adaptability to dynamic real-world environments. Preserving general capabilities while acquiring downstream domain knowledge is a central challenge for large language and multimodal models. Traditional continual learning methods, such as regularization, replay and architectural isolation, suffer from poor downstream performance, reliance on inaccessible historical data, or additional parameter overhead. While recent parameter-efficient tuning (PET) methods can alleviate forgetting, their effectiveness strongly depends on the choice of parameters and update strategies. In this paper, we introduce PIECE, a Parameter Importance Estimation-based Continual Enhancement method that preserves general ability while efficiently learning domain knowledge without accessing prior training data or increasing model parameters. PIECE selectively updates only 0.1% of core parameters most relevant to new tasks, guided by two importance estimators: PIECE-F based on Fisher Information, and PIECE-S based on a second-order normalization that combines gradient and curvature information. Experiments across three language models and two multimodal models show that PIECE maintains general capabilities and achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance across diverse downstream tasks. Our results highlight a practical path to scalable, domain-adaptive foundation models without catastrophic forgetting.

papers.title: Offline A/B Testing of Slate Recommendation Systems with LLMs: Reducing the Dependency on Pre-Collected User Interaction Data
papers.abstract_en: Slate recommender systems (RecSys) present users with ordered sets of interacting items (e.g., playlists). We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can articulate pairwise preferences between slates for synthetic A/B testing of slate RecSys. We introduce a validation protocol measuring the alignment of synthetic preferences with classical RecSys metrics and their compliance with preference axioms, and use it to characterise how LLM pre-training and configuration affect slate preference articulation. Combined with the generalized Rao-Kupper model, synthetic LLM-based A/B testing recovers rankings that remain stable across utility weightings, whereas off-policy estimators are reliable only when the target utility matches the logged behavior. We position it as a screening stage between off-policy evaluation and live experiments: not a replacement for A/B testing, but a way to reserve its cost for the most promising candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 为 slate 推荐系统生成成对偏好，做离线合成 A/B 测试，以减少对预采集用户交互数据的依赖。结合 generalized Rao-Kupper 模型后，合成偏好恢复的候选排序在不同 utility 加权下保持稳定，而 off-policy 估计器只有在目标 utility 与日志行为一致时才可靠。作者将其定位为 off-policy 评估与线上实验之间的筛选环节，而非替代线上 A/B 测试。
Motivation: Slate 推荐的离线评估依赖预采集的用户交互日志，off-policy 估计在目标 utility 与日志策略不一致时失真，线上 A/B 测试成本又高。
Method: 让 LLM 对 slate（有序 item 集合，如播放列表）表达成对偏好，提出验证协议度量合成偏好与经典 RecSys 指标的一致性及其对偏好公理的满足度，并刻画 LLM 预训练与配置对偏好表达的影响；再与 generalized Rao-Kupper 模型结合生成 A/B 排序。
Result: 合成 LLM A/B 测试恢复的排序在不同 utility 加权下保持稳定；off-policy 估计器仅在目标 utility 与日志行为匹配时可靠。
Conclusion: LLM 合成偏好可作为 off-policy 评估与线上实验之间的筛选阶段，把线上 A/B 测试的开销留给最有希望的候选，而不是取代线上实验。

papers.title: UniShield: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Framework for Unified Forgery Image Detection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancements in image generation, synthetic images have become increasingly realistic, posing significant societal risks, such as misinformation and fraud. Forgery Image Detection and Localization (FIDL) thus emerges as essential for maintaining information integrity and societal security. Despite impressive performances by existing domain-specific detection methods, their practical applicability remains limited, primarily due to their narrow specialization, poor cross-domain generalization, and the absence of an integrated adaptive framework. To address these issues, we propose UniShield, the novel multi-agent-based unified system capable of detecting and localizing image forgeries across diverse domains, including image manipulation, document manipulation, DeepFake, and AI-generated images. UniShield innovatively integrates a perception agent with a detection agent. The perception agent intelligently analyzes image features to dynamically select suitable detection models, while the detection agent consolidates various expert detectors into a unified framework and generates interpretable reports. Extensive experiments show that UniShield achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing both existing unified approaches and domain-specific detectors, highlighting its superior practicality, adaptiveness, and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniShield 用感知 agent 分析图像特征并动态选择检测模型，检测 agent 把多个专家检测器整合成统一框架并输出可解释报告，跨图像篡改、文档篡改、DeepFake 与 AI 生成图四类伪造做检测与定位。实验称其达到 state-of-the-art，同时超过已有统一方法与各领域专用检测器。
Motivation: 现有伪造图像检测方法各自为政、跨域泛化差，缺少一个能覆盖多类伪造的自适应统一框架，实际可用性受限。
Method: 提出基于多 agent 的统一系统 UniShield：感知 agent 分析图像特征并动态选择合适的检测模型，检测 agent 将多种专家检测器 (expert detectors) 整合进统一框架并生成可解释报告，覆盖图像篡改、文档篡改、DeepFake、AI 生成图像四个域。
Result: 大量实验显示 UniShield 取得 state-of-the-art 结果，同时超越已有统一方法与各领域专用检测器；摘要未给出具体数据集名称或指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张多 agent 的感知—检测分工加专家检测器整合，能同时换来跨域实用性、自适应性与可扩展性。

papers.title: WAInjectBench: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detections for Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multiple prompt injection attacks have been proposed against web agents. At the same time, various methods have been developed to detect general prompt injection attacks, but none have been systematically evaluated for web agents. In this work, we bridge this gap by presenting the first comprehensive benchmark study on detecting prompt injection attacks targeting web agents. We begin by introducing a fine-grained categorization of such attacks based on the threat model. We then construct datasets containing both malicious and benign samples: malicious text segments generated by different attacks, benign text segments from four categories, malicious images produced by attacks, and benign images from two categories. Next, we systematize both text-based and image-based detection methods. Finally, we evaluate their performance across multiple scenarios. Our key findings show that while some detectors can identify attacks that rely on explicit textual instructions or visible image perturbations with moderate to high accuracy, they largely fail against attacks that omit explicit instructions or employ imperceptible perturbations. Our datasets and code are released at: https://github.com/Norrrrrrr-lyn/WAInjectBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAInjectBench 是首个系统评测 web agent 提示注入检测方法的基准：按威胁模型细分类攻击，构造恶意/良性文本与图像样本集，系统化文本与图像检测方法并在多场景评测。发现依赖显式文本指令或可见图像扰动的攻击可被中高准确率识别，而省略显式指令或使用不可察觉扰动的攻击基本检测失败。
Motivation: 已有多种针对 web agent 的提示注入攻击与通用检测方法，但没有任何检测方法被针对 web agent 系统评测过，检测能力边界不明。
Method: 按威胁模型对攻击做细粒度分类；构造数据集，含不同攻击生成的恶意文本段、四类良性文本段、攻击生成的恶意图像与两类良性图像；系统化文本与图像两类检测方法并在多场景评测。
Result: 对依赖显式文本指令或可见图像扰动的攻击，部分检测器达到中到高准确率；对省略显式指令或采用不可察觉 (imperceptible) 扰动的攻击，检测器基本失败。数据集与代码发布于 GitHub。
Conclusion: 现有提示注入检测对 web agent 的强隐匿攻击不成立，检测能力取决于攻击是否留下显式指令或可见扰动痕迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimization without Future Compromises? Decentralized Coordination via Collective and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Efficient resource allocation in multi-agent systems requires autonomous agents to coordinate their decisions while balancing system-wide objectives with individual costs. This becomes increasingly challenging over long time horizons, where decisions that improve the current allocation may compromise future resource allocation, while decentralized agents have limited observations of the overall system. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) can learn such long-term dependencies via local observations, but directly applying it to large-scale coordination leads to rapidly growing decision spaces and inefficient training. To this end, we propose Hierarchical Reinforcement and Collective Learning (HRCL), a hierarchical framework that uses MARL to guide, rather than replace, decentralized multi-agent coordination. At the high level, MARL learns strategies that restrict the alternatives considered during coordination and guide agents in balancing system-wide and individual objectives. At the low level, agents perform efficient decentralized coordination under this strategic guidance. This separation reduces the learning space and allows short-term coordination trade-offs to be evaluated according to their long-term effects. Experiments on a synthetic benchmark show that HRCL converges substantially faster than standalone MARL and reduces system-wide and individual costs by 35.53% and 27.05%, respectively. Evaluations on energy self-management and drone swarm sensing further show improved resource allocation, power-peak regulation, and sensing efficiency. These results show that learning strategic guidance for an existing coordination process can retain scalable decentralized coordination without letting short-term decisions compromise future resource allocation.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层框架 HRCL：用多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 在高层学策略来收窄底层去中心化协调的候选集，使短期协调按长期效果评估。合成基准上比单独 MARL 收敛显著更快，系统级与个体成本分别下降 35.53% 和 27.05%，能源自管理与无人机集群感知上也改善了资源分配、功率峰值调节与感知效率。
Motivation: 长时域下改善当前分配的决策可能损害未来资源分配，而去中心化智能体只能局部观测；直接把 MARL 用于大规模协调会导致决策空间爆炸、训练低效。
Method: HRCL 分两层：高层用 MARL 学习策略，限制协调期间考虑的候选并引导智能体权衡系统级与个体目标；底层智能体在该策略引导下执行高效的去中心化协调，从而缩小学习空间并让短期权衡按长期效果评估。
Result: 合成基准上 HRCL 比单独 MARL 收敛显著更快，系统级成本降低 35.53%、个体成本降低 27.05%；在能源自管理与无人机集群感知 (drone swarm sensing) 评测中改善了资源分配、功率峰值调节与感知效率。
Conclusion: 为既有协调过程学习策略引导，可以在不让短期决策牺牲未来资源分配的前提下保留可扩展的去中心化协调。

papers.title: A Discrepancy-Based Perspective on Dataset Condensation
papers.abstract_en: Given a dataset of finitely many elements $\mathcal{T} = \{\mathbf{x}_i\}_{i = 1}^N$, the goal of dataset condensation (DC) is to construct a synthetic dataset $\mathcal{S} = \{\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j\}_{j = 1}^M$ which is significantly smaller ($M \ll N$) such that a model trained from scratch on $\mathcal{S}$ achieves comparable or even superior generalization performance to a model trained on $\mathcal{T}$. Recent advances in DC reveal a close connection to the problem of approximating the data distribution represented by $\mathcal{T}$ with a reduced set of points. In this work, we present a unified framework that encompasses existing DC methods and extend the task-specific notion of DC to a more general and formal definition using notions of discrepancy, which quantify the distance between probability distribution in different regimes. Our framework broadens the objective of DC beyond generalization, accommodating additional objectives such as robustness, privacy, and other desirable properties.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. Accepted at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数据集凝缩 (dataset condensation, DC) 统一到 discrepancy 框架下：用度量概率分布距离的 discrepancy 重述 DC 目标，把「用 M≪N 个合成点逼近原数据分布」形式化为可扩展的通用定义。该框架把 DC 目标从泛化扩展到鲁棒性、隐私等附加目标，并涵盖现有 DC 方法。
Motivation: 现有 DC 方法各自为政，目标被窄化为泛化性能，缺少一个能统一解释「缩减点集逼近数据分布」并容纳鲁棒性、隐私等目标的形式化定义。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，用不同 regime 下量化概率分布距离的 discrepancy 概念，把任务特定的 DC 定义推广为更一般的形式化定义，并据此涵盖已有 DC 方法。
Result: 给出统一的形式化框架与更一般的 DC 定义，将目标从泛化扩展到鲁棒性、隐私等附加属性；论文为 42 页、5 张表、3 幅图，已被 TMLR 接收。
Conclusion: DC 应被理解为按 discrepancy 逼近数据分布的问题，据此目标可系统地从泛化扩展到鲁棒性、隐私等更多期望性质。

summary_sections.method: 提出一个统一框架，用不同 regime 下量化概率分布距离的 discrepancy 概念，把任务特定的 DC 定义推广为更一般的形式化定义，并据此涵盖已有 DC 方法。
summary_sections.result: 给出统一的形式化框架与更一般的 DC 定义，将目标从泛化扩展到鲁棒性、隐私等附加属性；论文为 42 页、5 张表、3 幅图，已被 TMLR 接收。

papers.title: VMMU: A Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VMMU, a Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark designed to evaluate how vision-language models (VLMs) interpret and reason over visual and textual information beyond English. VMMU consists of 2.5k multimodal questions across 7 tasks, covering a diverse range of problem contexts, including STEM problem solving, data interpretation, rule-governed visual reasoning, and abstract visual reasoning. All questions require genuine multimodal integration, rather than reliance on text-only cues or OCR-based shortcuts. We evaluate a diverse set of state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source VLMs on VMMU. Despite strong Vietnamese OCR performance, proprietary models achieve only 66% mean accuracy. Further analysis shows that the primary source of failure is not OCR, but instead multimodal grounding and reasoning over text and visual evidence. Code and data are available at https://vmmu-bench.github.io/

papers.title: Honest and Reliable Evaluation and Expert Equivalence Testing of Automated Neonatal Seizure Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of machine learning models for neonatal seizure detection is critical for clinical adoption. Current practices often rely on inconsistent and biased metrics, hindering model comparability and interpretability. Expert-level claims about AI performance are frequently made without rigorous validation, raising concerns about their reliability. This study aims to systematically evaluate common performance metrics and propose best practices tailored to the specific challenges of neonatal seizure detection. Using real and synthetic seizure annotations, we assessed standard performance metrics, consensus strategies, and human-expert level equivalence tests under varying class imbalance, inter-rater agreement, and number of raters. Matthews and Pearson's correlation coefficients outperformed the area under the curve in reflecting performance under class imbalance. Consensus types are sensitive to the number of raters and agreement level among them. Among human-expert level equivalence tests, the multi-rater Turing test using Fleiss k best captured expert-level AI performance. We recommend reporting: (1) at least one balanced metric, (2) Sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV, (3) Multi-rater Turing test results using Fleiss k, and (4) All the above on held-out validation set. This proposed framework provides an important prerequisite to clinical validation by enabling a thorough and honest appraisal of AI methods for neonatal seizure detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对新生儿癫痫发作检测 AI 的评估不一致与专家等效宣称缺乏严格验证，系统比较标准性能指标、共识策略与人类专家等效检验。在真实与合成发作标注、不同类别不平衡/评分者一致性/评分者数量条件下，Matthews 与 Pearson 相关系数比 AUC 更能反映类别不平衡下的性能，多评分者 Turing 检验（Fleiss k）最能刻画专家级 AI 性能。作者建议至少报告一个平衡指标、Sensitivity/Specificity/PPV/NPV、Fleiss k 的多评分者 Turing 结果，且全部在 held-out 验证集上给出。
Motivation: 新生儿发作检测的模型评估指标不一致且有偏，模型间难以比较；AI 的专家级宣称常缺严格验证，阻碍临床采纳。
Method: 用真实与合成发作标注，评估标准性能指标、共识策略 (consensus strategies) 与人类专家等效检验，变化的条件包括类别不平衡程度、评分者间一致性 (inter-rater agreement) 与评分者数量。
Result: Matthews 与 Pearson 相关系数在反映类别不平衡下的性能方面优于 AUC；共识结果对评分者数量与其间一致性敏感；在专家级等效检验中，基于 Fleiss k 的多评分者 Turing 检验最能捕捉专家级 AI 性能。
Conclusion: 临床验证的前提是诚实的评估框架：报告至少一个平衡指标、Sensitivity/Specificity/PPV/NPV、Fleiss k 多评分者 Turing 结果，且全部在 held-out 验证集上完成。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: InsurTech innovation using natural language processing
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid rise of InsurTech, traditional insurance companies are increasingly exploring alternative data sources and advanced technologies to sustain their competitive edge. This paper provides both a conceptual overview and practical case studies of natural language processing (NLP) and its emerging applications within insurance operations, focusing on transforming raw, unstructured text into structured data suitable for actuarial analysis and decision-making. Leveraging real-world alternative data provided by an InsurTech industry partner that enriches traditional insurance data sources, we apply various NLP techniques to demonstrate feature de-biasing, feature compression, and industry classification in the commercial insurance context. These enriched, text-derived insights not only add to and refine traditional rating factors for commercial insurance pricing but also offer novel perspectives for assessing underlying risk by introducing novel industry classification techniques. Through these demonstrations, we show that NLP is not merely a supplementary tool but a foundational element of modern, data-driven insurance analytics.
papers.journal_ref: Dong, P., Quan, Z. (2026). InsurTech innovation using natural language processing. North American Actuarial Journal, 1-34
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 NLP 作为商业保险分析的基础组件：用行业伙伴提供的替代文本数据，演示特征去偏、特征压缩与行业分类三类技术，把非结构化文本转成可用于精算分析与定价的结构化特征。文本衍生信息既补充并细化商业保险定价的传统费率因子，也为风险评估提供新的行业分类视角。
Motivation: InsurTech 崛起下，传统保险公司依赖的结构化数据不足以支撑差异化定价与风险评估，而大量非结构化文本未被转成精算可用的特征。
Method: 结合概念综述与实践案例：以 InsurTech 行业伙伴提供的真实替代数据为输入，应用多种 NLP 技术完成特征去偏 (feature de-biasing)、特征压缩 (feature compression) 与商业保险语境下的行业分类，并将结果对接精算分析与决策流程。
Result: 给出三类 NLP 应用的定性演示结果：文本衍生特征可补充并细化商业保险定价的传统费率因子，新型行业分类技术为评估底层风险提供新视角；摘要未给出数值指标。
Conclusion: NLP 在保险业不是补充性工具，而是现代数据驱动保险分析的基础要素，其价值在于把原始非结构化文本转成精算可用结构化数据。

papers.title: OD3: Optimization-free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Training large neural networks on large-scale datasets requires substantial computational resources, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as object detection. Although dataset distillation (DD) has been proposed to alleviate these demands by synthesizing compact datasets from larger ones, most existing work focuses solely on image classification, leaving the more complex detection setting largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce OD3, a novel optimization-free data distillation framework specifically designed for object detection. Our approach involves two stages: first, a candidate selection process in which object instances are iteratively placed in synthesized images based on their suitable locations, and second, a candidate screening process using a pre-trained observer model to remove low-confidence objects. We perform our data synthesis framework on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC, two popular detection datasets, with compression ratios ranging from 0.25% to 5%. Compared to the prior solely existing dataset distillation method on detection and conventional core set selection methods, OD3 delivers superior accuracy, establishes new state-of-the-art results, surpassing prior best method by more than 14% on COCO mAP50 at a compression ratio of 1.0%. Code is available at: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/OD3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OD3 是面向目标检测的免优化 (optimization-free) 数据集蒸馏框架，两阶段完成合成：先按合适位置迭代摆放物体实例，再用预训练 observer 模型筛掉低置信度物体。在 MS COCO 与 PASCAL VOC 上以 0.25%–5% 压缩率合成数据，1.0% 压缩率下 COCO mAP50 超过此前唯一的目标检测蒸馏方法 14% 以上。
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏 (DD) 多数只做图像分类，稠密预测类的目标检测场景基本未被覆盖；检测训练又依赖大规模数据与高算力。
Method: 两阶段免优化合成：候选选择阶段把物体实例按合适位置迭代放入合成图像，候选筛除阶段用预训练 observer 模型剔除低置信度物体；在 MS COCO 与 PASCAL VOC 上执行，压缩率 0.25%–5%。
Result: 与此前唯一的目标检测数据蒸馏方法及常规 core set selection 方法相比，OD3 精度更高并确立新 state-of-the-art：压缩率 1.0% 时 COCO mAP50 超过此前最佳方法 14% 以上。
Conclusion: 目标检测的数据集蒸馏可以不依赖逐样本优化，靠位置摆放加预训练模型筛除即可在极低压缩率下超过既有检测蒸馏与 core set 基线。

papers.title: AdaDim: Dimensionality Adaptation for SSL Representational Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: A key factor in effective Self-Supervised learning (SSL) is preventing dimensional collapse, where higher-dimensional representation spaces ($R$) span a lower-dimensional subspace. Therefore, SSL optimization strategies involve guiding a model to produce $R$ with a higher dimensionality ($H(R)$) through objectives that encourage decorrelation of features or sample uniformity in $R$. A higher $H(R)$ indicates that $R$ has greater feature diversity which is useful for generalization to downstream tasks. Alongside dimensionality optimization, SSL algorithms also utilize a projection head that maps $R$ into an embedding space $Z$. Recent work has characterized the projection head as a filter of noisy or irrelevant features from the SSL objective by reducing the mutual information $I(R;Z)$. Therefore, the current literature's view is that a good SSL representation space should have a high $H(R)$ and a low $I(R;Z)$. However, this view of SSL is lacking in terms of an understanding of the underlying training dynamics that influences the relationship between both terms. Our analysis shows that the best performing SSL models do not have the highest $H(R)$ nor the lowest $I(R;Z)$, but effectively arrive at a balance between both. To take advantage of this analysis, we introduce AdaDim, a training strategy that leverages SSL training dynamics by adaptively balancing between increasing $H(R)$ through feature decorrelation and sample uniformity as well as gradual regularization of $I(R;Z)$ as training progresses. We show performance improvements of up to 3% over common SSL baselines despite our method not utilizing expensive techniques such as queues, clustering, predictor networks, or student-teacher architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaDim 用训练动态自适应地在提升表示维度 H(R)（特征去相关与样本均匀化）和逐步正则化投影头互信息 I(R;Z) 之间取得平衡，而非一味追求高 H(R)、低 I(R;Z)。分析显示性能最好的 SSL 模型并不具备最高 H(R) 或最低 I(R;Z)，而是落在两者平衡点；据此训练在常见 SSL 基线上最高带来 3% 性能提升，且不使用 queue、聚类、predictor 网络或 student-teacher 架构。
Motivation: 现有 SSL 文献把好表示归结为高 H(R) 与低 I(R;Z)，但缺少对同时决定这两项的训练动态的理解，导致优化目标与实际最优性能脱节。
Method: AdaDim 是一种 SSL 训练策略：随训练进程在特征去相关与样本均匀化提升 H(R)、以及对投影头互信息 I(R;Z) 的渐进正则化之间自适应调度；不引入 queue、聚类、predictor 网络或 student-teacher 架构。
Result: 相比常见 SSL 基线，性能提升最高达 3%；分析发现表现最好的 SSL 模型既不具最高 H(R) 也不具最低 I(R;Z)，而是两者之间的平衡。
Conclusion: SSL 表示质量取决于 H(R) 与 I(R;Z) 的动态平衡而非各自极值，训练策略应随训练进程自适应调节这一平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChronoSteer: Bridging Large Language Model and Time Series Foundation Model via Synthetic Cross-Modal Alignment Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Conventional forecasting methods are trained end-to-end on unimodal time series, which limits their ability to exploit textual information and undermines their generalization in data-scarce scenarios. Recently, large language models (LLMs) and time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated powerful capabilities in complex textual reasoning and zero-shot temporal modeling, respectively. Integrating these strengths to construct a multimodal time series foundation model that jointly leverages temporal and textual information for zero-shot future inference has emerged as a promising research direction. However, the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality multimodal datasets remains a fundamental obstacle. To address this challenge, we propose ChronoSteer, a decoupled agentic framework that learns cross-modal alignment from synthetic paired supervision. Specifically, a pretrained LLM first converts textual events into revision instructions that steer the initial unimodal prediction produced by a frozen TSFM. These revision instructions form an intermediate instruction space that bridges the semantic gap between text and time series while fully leveraging pretrained knowledge. Technically, the instructions are discretized into a compact codebook of instruction anchors, effectively mitigating semantic divergence while reducing the cost of dataset construction. Finally, we adopt a two-stage training strategy to recover the fine-grained magnitude information lost during discretization. Furthermore, we release a leakage-controlled multimodal benchmark constructed with temporal separation and textual context available before the prediction window. When paired with an LLM and trained on synthetic cross-modal alignment data, ChronoSteer achieves a 25.8% improvement in zero-shot prediction accuracy over its unimodal backbone, and outperforms prior state-of-the-art unimodal and multimodal ...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoSteer 用解耦 agentic 框架把 LLM 的文本事件转成修订指令，去修正冻结 TSFM 的单模态初始预测，指令离散化为 instruction codebook 并用两阶段训练恢复幅度信息。在带泄漏控制的多模态 benchmark 上，配合 LLM 并用合成跨模态对齐数据训练后，零样本预测精度比其单模态 backbone 提升 25.8%。
Motivation: 单模态端到端训练的时间序列模型无法利用文本事件信息，数据稀缺场景下泛化差；而大规模高质量多模态时序数据稀缺是构建此类模型的根本障碍。
Method: 提出解耦 agentic 框架：预训练 LLM 将文本事件转为修订指令 (revision instructions) 来引导冻结 TSFM 的初始单模态预测，形成中间指令空间；指令再离散化为紧凑的 instruction anchors codebook 以降低数据构建成本并缓解语义分歧，最后用两阶段训练恢复离散化丢失的细粒度幅度信息。同时发布用时间分离、仅用预测窗口前文本上下文构建的泄漏受控多模态 benchmark。
Result: 在该泄漏受控 benchmark 上，配合 LLM 并以合成跨模态对齐数据训练的 ChronoSteer，零样本预测精度较其单模态 backbone 提升 25.8%，并超过此前最优的单模态与多模态方法。
Conclusion: 合成跨模态对齐数据加中间指令空间，可让 LLM 的文本推理能力在不微调 TSFM 的前提下转化为零样本时序预测精度提升。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Role of scrambling and noise in temporal information processing with quantum systems
papers.abstract_en: Scrambling quantum systems have attracted attention as effective substrates for temporal information processing. Here we consider a quantum reservoir processing framework that captures a broad range of physical computing models with quantum systems. We examine the scalability and memory retention of the model with scrambling reservoirs modelled by high-order unitary designs in both noiseless and noisy settings. In the former regime, we show that measurement readouts become exponentially concentrated with increasing reservoir size, yet strikingly do not worsen with the reservoir iterations. Thus, while repeatedly reusing a small scrambling reservoir with quantum data might be viable, scaling up the problem size deteriorates generalization unless one can afford an exponential shot overhead. In contrast, the memory of early inputs and initial states decays exponentially in both reservoir size and reservoir iterations. In the noisy regime, we also prove that memory decays exponentially in time for local noisy channels. These results required us to introduce new proof techniques for bounding concentration in temporal quantum models. Beyond this extreme scrambling regime, we numerically demonstrate that exponential concentration can still exist even with a physical reservoir such as an Ising model whenever the reservoir operates in a quantum-chaotic phase. In contrast, physical reservoirs in a many-body localized phase and at the edge of chaos appear to not suffer from such phenomena
papers.comment: v3: Extensively revised, notably with new results for widely used physical reservoirs, connecting phases of matter to the emergence of exponential concentration. 23 + 52 pages, 9 + 12 figures, 2 + 1 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在量子储层处理 (quantum reservoir processing) 框架下证明：高阶酉设计 (high-order unitary designs) 描述的 scrambling 储层会使测量读出随储层规模指数集中，但不随迭代次数恶化；而对早期输入与初态的记忆在储层规模和迭代次数两个方向都指数衰减，含噪局域信道下记忆还随时间指数衰减。数值上，处于量子混沌相的 Ising 物理储层同样出现指数集中，而多体局域 (MBL) 相与混沌边缘的储层则似乎不受此现象影响。
Motivation: scrambling 量子系统被广泛当作时间信息处理的基底，但其可扩展性与记忆保持能力缺少严格刻画：规模扩大时读出是否集中、记忆能撑多久，直接决定这类量子 reservoir 能否实用。
Method: 以统一的 quantum reservoir processing 框架覆盖多类量子系统计算模型，在无噪与含噪两种设定下用高阶酉设计建模 scrambling 储层，针对时间量子模型的集中性引入新的证明技术；再对 Ising 等物理储层做数值实验，比较量子混沌相、多体局域相与混沌边缘。
Result: 无噪时测量读出随储层规模指数集中、但不随储储层迭代次数恶化，扩大问题规模会损害泛化，除非承担指数级 shot 开销；对早期输入和初态的记忆随储层规模与迭代次数均指数衰减；含噪局域信道下记忆随时间指数衰减；数值上量子混沌相的 Ising 储层仍呈指数集中，而 MBL 相与混沌边缘的物理储层似乎没有该现象。
Conclusion: scrambling/量子混沌储层在规模方向上存在指数集中与指数记忆衰减的双重瓶颈，反复复用小储层或许可行，扩规模则需指数 shot 代价；换到 MBL 或混沌边缘的物理储层可避开这一集中现象。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Localized Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are state-of-the-art tools for various generative tasks. Yet training these models involves estimating high-dimensional score functions, a task that in principle suffers from the curse of dimensionality. It is therefore important to understand how low-dimensional structure in the target distribution can be exploited in these models. Here we consider locality structure, which describes certain sparse conditional dependencies among the target random variables. Given some locality structure, the score function is effectively low-dimensional, so that it can be estimated by a localized neural network with significantly reduced sample complexity. This observation motivates the localized diffusion model, where a localized score matching loss is used to train the score function within a localized hypothesis space. We prove that such localization enables diffusion models to circumvent the curse of dimensionality with dimension-independent error bounds, at the price of additional localization error. Under realistic sample size scaling, we then show both theoretically and numerically that a moderate localization radius can balance the statistical and localization errors, yielding better overall performance. Locality structure also facilitates parallel training, making localized diffusion models potentially more efficient for large-scale applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当目标分布具有 locality structure（稀疏条件依赖）时，score 函数实质上是低维的，可用局部化神经网络与局部化 score matching 损失在局部假设空间中训练。理论上证明这种局部化使扩散模型以维数无关的误差界绕过维数灾难，代价是额外的 localization error；在现实样本量标度下，中等的局部化半径能平衡统计误差与定位误差，从而取得更好的整体表现。
Motivation: 扩散模型训练需估计高维 score 函数，原则上受维数灾难制约；需要弄清如何利用目标分布的低维结构降低样本复杂度。
Method: 给定目标随机变量间的 locality structure，在局部假设空间中用 localized score matching 损失训练 score 函数，使 score 由局部化神经网络估计；结合理论分析与数值实验考察局部化半径的作用。
Result: 证明局部化带来维数无关的误差界（dimension-independent error bounds），可绕过维数灾难，代价是额外的 localization error；在现实样本量标度下，理论与数值结果均显示中等局部化半径可平衡统计误差与定位误差，取得更好的整体表现。
Conclusion: 利用 locality structure 的局部化扩散模型能以可控的定位误差换取维数无关的样本效率，并因局部化而支持并行训练，对大规模应用更具效率潜力。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: SMDDFNet: State-space Modeling and Dynamic Dual Fusion Network for Traffic Sign Detection
papers.abstract_en: Traffic sign detection is a challenging visual signal processing task for advanced driver assistance, where small objects, scale variation, and occlusion limit conventional detectors with fixed receptive fields. This paper proposes State-space Modeling and Dynamic Dual Fusion Network (SMDDFNet), a deep learning detector for traffic sign images. SMDDFNet integrates a Dynamic Dual Fusion (DDF) module and a state-space modeling backbone to enhance multi-scale feature representation. DDF combines efficient multi-scale attention with content-aware dynamic filtering in the frequency domain, while the backbone captures long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. A multi-scale feature fusion neck further aggregates pyramid features for robust localization of small signs. Experiments on TT100K, GTSDB, PASCAL VOC, and the Roboflow~100 \emph{vehicle} subset show that SMDDFNet achieves competitive accuracy against recent detectors while retaining real-time throughput. The source code is available at https://github.com/rainbowyuyu/SMDDFNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出交通标志检测器 SMDDFNet：Dynamic Dual Fusion 模块在频域结合高效多尺度注意力与内容感知动态滤波，配线性复杂度的状态空间骨干和多尺度特征融合 neck，专门应对小目标、尺度变化与遮挡。在 TT100K、GTSDB、PASCAL VOC 与 Roboflow100 vehicle 子集上取得与近期检测器相当的精度并保持实时吞吐。
Motivation: 高级驾驶辅助中的交通标志检测受小目标、尺度变化和遮挡限制，固定感受野的传统检测器难以兼顾精度与实时性。
Method: SMDDFNet 由三部分组成：Dynamic Dual Fusion (DDF) 模块在频域融合高效多尺度注意力与内容感知动态滤波；状态空间建模 (state-space modeling) 骨干以线性计算复杂度捕获长程依赖；多尺度特征融合 neck 聚合金字塔特征以定位小标志。
Result: 在 TT100K、GTSDB、PASCAL VOC 和 Roboflow100 vehicle 子集上，SMDDFNet 相对近期检测器达到有竞争力的精度，同时保持实时吞吐；源码发布于 github.com/rainbowyuyu/SMDDFNet。
Conclusion: 频域动态融合加状态空间骨干可以在交通标志检测上同时兼顾小目标定位精度与实时推理速度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Enhancing the Non-Functional Quality Compliance of LLM-Generated Code through Quality-Aware Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in commercial code completion engines, significantly enhancing coding efficiency and productivity. However, even functionally correct LLM-generated code may exhibit non-functional quality issues that violate coding standards and best practices, such as poor style and limited maintainability. To address this, we propose a framework for quality-aware preference learning that guides LLMs toward generating criteria-compliant code. Our approach consists of three phases. First, we construct a dataset of paired criteria-violating and criteria-compliant samples, where each pair contains code exhibiting a specific non-functional quality issue and its repaired version that resolves the issue. Second, we design an adaptive token weighting mechanism to emphasize quality-sensitive code regions. Third, we introduce a hybrid optimization objective that combines ranking loss with language modeling loss and KL divergence to enable effective comparative optimization. Extensive experiments on DeepSeek-Coder and Qwen2.5-Coder show that our method substantially improves compliance with the targeted non-functional quality criteria while maintaining functional correctness, achieving a 75.7% relative increase in Quality Reciprocal Score (QRS) on MBPP-sanitized for Qwen2.5-Coder. Fine-tuning a 7B model requires less than three hours, indicating strong practical viability. Ablation studies and a user study further support the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向非功能质量的偏好学习框架，用成对的违规/合规代码样本、自适应 token 加权和混合优化目标，引导 LLM 生成符合编码规范的代码。在 DeepSeek-Coder 与 Qwen2.5-Coder 上，Qwen2.5-Coder 在 MBPP-sanitized 的 Quality Reciprocal Score (QRS) 相对提升 75.7%，同时保持功能正确性。
Motivation: LLM 生成的代码即使功能正确，也可能存在风格差、可维护性低等非功能质量问题，违反编码标准，而现有代码补全引擎主要优化功能正确性。
Method: 三阶段框架：构建违规/修复成对代码样本数据集；设计自适应 token 加权机制突出质量敏感代码区域；引入结合 ranking loss、language modeling loss 与 KL 散度的混合优化目标做比较优化，在 DeepSeek-Coder 和 Qwen2.5-Coder 上微调。
Result: Qwen2.5-Coder 在 MBPP-sanitized 上 QRS 相对提升 75.7%，并保持功能正确性；微调 7B 模型耗时不到三小时；另含消融研究与用户研究支持框架有效性。
Conclusion: 质量感知偏好学习能在保持功能正确性的同时显著提升非功能质量合规，且 7B 模型三小时内可微调，具备实际可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Path Regularization: A Near-Complete and Optimal Nonasymptotic Generalization Theory for Multilayer Neural Networks and Double Descent Phenomenon
papers.abstract_en: Path regularization has shown to be a very effective regularization to train neural networks, leading to a better generalization property than common regularizations i.e. weight decay, etc. We propose a first near-complete (as will be made explicit in the main text) nonasymptotic generalization theory for multilayer neural networks with path regularizations for general learning problems. In particular, it does not require the boundedness of the loss function, as is commonly assumed in the literature. Our theory goes beyond the bias-variance tradeoff and aligns with phenomena typically encountered in deep learning. It is therefore sharply different from other existing nonasymptotic generalization error bounds. More explicitly, we propose an explicit generalization error upper bound for multilayer neural networks with $σ(0)=0$ and sufficiently broad Lipschitz loss functions, without requiring the width, depth, or other hyperparameters of the neural network to approach infinity, a specific neural network architecture (e.g., sparsity), or boundedness of the loss function, while also taking approximation error into consideration. In particular, we solve an open problem proposed by Weinan E et. al. in 2020 regarding the approximation rates in generalized Barron spaces. Furthermore, we show the near-minimax optimality of our theory for regression problems with ReLU activations. Notably, our upper bound exhibits the famous double descent phenomenon for such networks, which is the most distinguished characteristic compared with other existing results. Our subsequent work will prove the matching lower bounds in the minimax sense, meaning that it is highly possible that our theory reveals the true underlying mechanism of the double descent phenomenon. We can also explain scaling law from this theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 path regularization 下多层神经网络的近完备非渐近泛化误差上界，不要损失函数有界、不要宽度深度趋于无穷或特定稀疏架构，并计入逼近误差。ReLU 回归下证明近 minimax 最优，上界本身呈现 double descent，还解决 Weinan E 等 2020 年关于广义 Barron 空间逼近速率的公开问题，并可解释 scaling law。
Motivation: 现有非渐近泛化界多依赖损失有界、宽度深度趋于无穷或特定架构等强假设，且受 bias-variance tradeoff 框架束缚，难以解释深度学习中 double descent 与 scaling law 这类现象。
Method: 对带 path regularization 的多层网络（σ(0)=0、足够宽的 Lipschitz 损失）推导显式泛化误差上界，纳入逼近误差；在 ReLU 回归设定下论证近 minimax 最优性，并求解广义 Barron 空间的逼近速率问题。
Result: 上界呈现 double descent 现象，被作者称为区别于既有结果的最显著特征；ReLU 回归下证明近 minimax 最优；解决 Weinan E 等 2020 年提出的广义 Barron 空间逼近速率公开问题；配套 matching lower bound 留待后续工作。
Conclusion: path regularization 的这套非渐近理论可能揭示 double descent 的真实机制，并能从同一框架解释 scaling law；matching lower bound 尚待后续工作完成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Copy-Move Forgery Detection and Question Answering for Remote Sensing Image
papers.abstract_en: Driven by practical demands in land resource monitoring and national defense security, this paper introduces the Remote Sensing Copy-Move Question Answering (RSCMQA) task. Unlike traditional Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (RSVQA), RSCMQA focuses on interpreting complex tampering scenarios and inferring relationships between objects. We present a suite of global RSCMQA datasets, comprising images from 29 different regions across 14 countries. Specifically, we propose five distinct datasets, including the basic dataset RS-CMQA, the category-balanced dataset RS-CMQA-B, the high-authenticity dataset Real-RSCM, the extended dataset RS-TQA, and the extended category-balanced dataset RS-TQA-B. These datasets fill a critical gap in the field while ensuring comprehensiveness, balance, and challenging scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce a region-discrimination-guided multimodal copy-move forgery perception framework (CMFPF), which enhances the accuracy of answering questions about tampered images by leveraging prompts about the differences and connections between the source and tampered regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method establishes a stronger benchmark for RSCMQA compared to general VQA and RSVQA models. Our datasets and code are publicly available at https://github.com/shenyedepisa/RSCMQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出遥感复制-移动篡改问答 (RSCMQA) 新任务与五个数据集（RS-CMQA、RS-CMQA-B、Real-RSCM、RS-TQA、RS-TQA-B，覆盖 14 国 29 个地区），并给出区域判别引导的多模态篡改感知框架 CMFPF，用源区域与篡改区域差异/关联的 prompt 提升篡改图像问答准确率，在对比实验中相对通用 VQA 与 RSVQA 模型建立更强基准。
Motivation: 遥感篡改场景需要解释复杂伪造并推断物体间关系，传统 RSVQA 只做通用问答，缺少面向复制-移动篡改的全球问答数据与专用模型。
Method: 构建五个 RSCMQA 数据集（基础、类别均衡、高真实性 Real-RSCM、扩展 RS-TQA 及其均衡版），提出 CMFPF 框架，利用源区域与篡改区域差异和关联的 prompt 引导多模态复制-移动篡改感知，输出对篡改图像的问答结果。
Result: 数据集含 14 个国家 29 个地区的图像；实验显示 CMFPF 在 RSCMQA 上相对通用 VQA 与 RSVQA 模型建立更强基准；论文含 17 图 14 表。
Conclusion: 面向篡改区域关系的区域判别 prompt 加上专用、均衡的遥感篡改问答数据，是把复制-移动检测转成可解释问答的有效路径，数据与代码已公开。

papers.title: Statistical Properties of Deep Neural Networks with Dependent Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops theory for deep neural network (DNN) estimators under dependent data. To provide theory applicable to a variety of DNN-based estimators, I first establish nonasymptotic probability bounds on the theoretical and empirical $\mathcal{L}^{2}$-errors of nonparametric sieve estimators for a general class of estimation problems under possibly nonstationary $β$-mixing data taking values in unbounded sets. I then apply the theory to fully connected and convolutional DNN estimators without bounds or sparsity restrictions on the DNN weights. For both DNN classes, I derive general results when the function to be estimated is Hölder smooth and the data are nonstationary, subgaussian, and $β$-mixing with either exponential or polynomial decay. I then specialize these to nonparametric regression, logistic regression, and quantile regression settings. Under exponential $β$-mixing, the resulting estimators attain the nonparametric minimax rate of Stone (1982) up to logarithmic factors.
papers.comment: 100 pages, 3 figures. V4 changes: Removed former Theorem 1 and associated alpha-mixing results; extended nonasymptotic beta-mixing bounds to nonstationary data; corrected measurability results and proofs. Added results for fixed-width architectures, convolutional architectures, polynomial mixing rates, and quantile regression. Partially linear model remains in arXiv:2410.22574
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为相依数据下的深度神经网络估计量建立非渐近理论：在非平稳、subgaussian、β-mixing（指数或多项式衰减）数据上给出 sieve 估计量理论与经验 L2 误差的概率界，并应用到无权重界/稀疏约束的全连接与卷积 DNN。在指数 β-mixing 下，Hölder 光滑函数的估计量达到 Stone (1982) 的非参数 minimax 速率（差一个对数因子）。
Motivation: DNN 估计量的现有理论多假设独立同分布数据，而时间或空间相依、非平稳且取值无界的观测下缺少可直接套用的非渐近误差界。
Method: 先对一般估计问题类的非参数 sieve 估计量，在非平稳 β-mixing、无界取值下推导理论与经验 L2 误差的非渐近概率界；再应用到无权重界或稀疏约束的全连接 DNN 与卷积 DNN，设定待估函数 Hölder 光滑、数据 subgaussian 且 β-mixing 指数或多项式衰减，特化到非参数回归、logistic 回归与分位数回归。
Result: 在指数 β-mixing 下，所得估计量达到 Stone (1982) 非参数 minimax 速率，仅差对数因子；V4 将原 Theorem 1 及 α-mixing 结果删除，把非渐近 β-mixing 界推广到非平稳数据，并新增固定宽度架构、卷积架构、多项式混合速率与分位数回归的结果。
Conclusion: β-mixing 相依（含非平稳）数据下，足够灵活的全连接与卷积 DNN 在 Hölder 光滑设定中仍可达到经典非参数 minimax 速率，理论可覆盖一大类基于 DNN 的估计量。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Tackling fluffy clouds: robust agricultural field boundary delineation from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite image time series
papers.abstract_en: Accurate delineation of agricultural field boundaries is essential for effective crop monitoring and resource management. However, competing methodologies often face significant challenges, particularly in their reliance on extensive manual efforts for cloud-free data curation and limited adaptability to diverse global conditions. In this paper, we introduce PTAViT3D, a deep learning architecture specifically designed for processing three-dimensional time series of satellite imagery from either Sentinel-1 (S1) or Sentinel-2 (S2). Additionally, we present PTAViT3D-CA, an extension of the PTAViT3D model incorporating cross-attention mechanisms to fuse S1 and S2 datasets, enhancing robustness in cloud-contaminated scenarios. The proposed methods leverage spatio-temporal correlations through a memory-efficient 3D Vision Transformer architecture, facilitating accurate boundary delineation directly from preprocessed, cloud-affected imagery. We comprehensively validate our models through extensive testing on various datasets, including Australia's ePaddocks - CSIRO's national, continental-scale agricultural field boundary product covering Australia's cropping regions - alongside public benchmarks Fields-of-the-World, PASTIS, and AI4SmallFarms. Our results consistently demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, highlighting excellent global transferability and robustness. Crucially, our approach significantly simplifies data preparation workflows by reliably processing cloud-affected imagery, thereby offering strong adaptability across diverse agricultural environments. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/feevos/tfcl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PTAViT3D 及其跨注意力变体 PTAViT3D-CA，用记忆高效的 3D Vision Transformer 直接吃含云的 Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 影像时序做农田边界勾画，无需先人工筛出无云影像。在 ePaddocks、Fields-of-the-World、PASTIS、AI4SmallFarms 上达到 state-of-the-art，并展示出全球可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有农田边界方法依赖大量人工整理无云数据，且对全球多样环境适应性差，含云影像通常被直接丢弃。
Method: PTAViT3D 用记忆高效的 3D Vision Transformer 建模 S1 或 S2 影像时序的时空相关性，直接从预处理后的含云影像勾画边界；PTAViT3D-CA 加入 cross-attention 融合 S1 与 S2，提升云污染场景下的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 Australia 的 ePaddocks（CSIRO 全国/大陆尺度农田边界产品）及公开基准 Fields-of-the-World、PASTIS、AI4SmallFarms 上测试，结果一致达到 state-of-the-art，并展示出良好的全球迁移性与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 直接对含云影像建模可以省去无云数据筛选流程，同时在多种农业环境下保持可用的边界勾画精度与跨区域适应性。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Variance Reduction for Independent Metropolis
papers.abstract_en: Assume that we would like to estimate the expected value of a function $F$ with respect to an intractable density $π$, which is specified up to some unknown normalising constant. We prove that if $π$ is close enough under KL divergence to another density $q$, an independent Metropolis sampler estimator that obtains samples from $π$ with proposal density $q$, enriched with a variance reduction computational strategy based on control variates, achieves smaller asymptotic variance than i.i.d. sampling from $π$. The control variates construction requires no extra computational effort but assumes that the expected value of $F$ under $q$ is analytically available. We illustrate this result by calculating the marginal likelihood in a linear regression model with prior-likelihood conflict and a non-conjugate prior. Furthermore, we propose an adaptive independent Metropolis algorithm that adapts the proposal density such that its KL divergence with the target is being reduced. We demonstrate its applicability in a Bayesian logistic and Gaussian process regression problems and we rigorously justify our asymptotic arguments under easily verifiable and essentially minimal conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在独立 Metropolis 采样器中加入基于控制变量 (control variates) 的方差缩减：只要提议分布 q 与目标 π 的 KL 散度足够小，估计量的渐近方差就严格小于直接从 π 做 i.i.d. 抽样，且控制变量构造不增加额外计算量（前提是 F 在 q 下的期望可解析得到）。作者进一步提出自适应独立 Metropolis，通过压低 q 与 π 的 KL 散度来逼近该条件，并在贝叶斯 logistic 回归与高斯过程回归上演示。
Motivation: 用独立 Metropolis 从只知未归一化常数的 π 抽样估计 Eπ[F] 时，方差可能高于直接 i.i.d. 抽样；缺少一个可判定的条件说明何时提议分布 q 足够好、以及如何系统性地改进 q。
Method: 在独立 Metropolis 估计量上叠加控制变量（利用 E_q[F] 解析已知），证明当 KL(q‖π) 足够小时渐近方差下降；再提出自适应独立 Metropolis，迭代调整 q 以减小其与目标的 KL 散度，并在可验证的极弱条件下给出渐近论证。
Result: 证明了 KL 足够小时控制变量版独立 Metropolis 估计量的渐近方差小于 i.i.d. 抽样；示例为带 prior-likelihood conflict 与非共轭先验的线性回归边际似然计算；自适应算法在贝叶斯 logistic 回归与高斯过程回归问题上演示适用性。
Conclusion: 只要提议分布与目标的 KL 散度足够小，独立 Metropolis 加控制变量就是无额外开销的方差缩减手段，而自适应地缩小该 KL 散度是让条件成立的可行路径。
Relevance: 18
