papers.title: Radiomics and artificial Intelligence for thyroid cancer diagnosis: Concepts, challenges, and solutions
papers.abstract_en: Thyroid cancer is an increasing global health concern that requires advanced diagnostic methods. The application of AI and radiomics to thyroid cancer diagnosis is examined in this review. A review of multiple databases was conducted in compliance with PRISMA guidelines until October 2024. A combination of keywords led to the discovery of an English academic publication on thyroid cancer and related subjects. 368 papers were returned from the original search after 112 duplicates were removed. Relevant studies were selected according to predetermined criteria after 176 articles were eliminated based on an examination of their abstract and title. After the comprehensive analysis, an additional six studies were excluded. Among the 42 included studies, radiomics analysis, which incorporates ultrasound (US) images, demonstrated its effectiveness in diagnosing thyroid cancer. Various results were noted, some of the studies presenting new strategies that outperformed the status quo. The literature has emphasized various challenges faced by AI models, including interpretability issues, dataset constraints, and operator dependence. The synthesized findings of the 42 included studies mentioned the need for standardization efforts and prospective multicenter studies to address these concerns. Furthermore, approaches to overcome these obstacles were identified, such as advances in explainable AI technology and personalized medicine techniques. The review focuses on how AI and radiomics could transform the diagnosis and treatment of thyroid cancer. Despite challenges, future research on multidisciplinary cooperation, clinical applicability validation, and algorithm improvement holds the potential to improve patient outcomes and diagnostic precision in the treatment of thyroid cancer.

papers.title: Optimizing watermarks for large language models
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of large language models (LLMs) and concerns about potential misuse, watermarks for generative LLMs have recently attracted much attention. An important aspect of such watermarks is the trade-off between their identifiability and their impact on the quality of the generated text. This paper introduces a systematic approach to this trade-off in terms of a multi-objective optimization problem. For a large class of robust, efficient watermarks, the associated Pareto optimal solutions are identified and shown to outperform the currently default watermark.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 235:53251-53269, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 水印的可识别性与文本质量权衡写成多目标优化问题，对一大类鲁棒且高效的水印求出 Pareto 最优解，这些解在该权衡上优于当前默认水印。
Motivation: LLM 水印的核心矛盾是可识别性与生成文本质量此消彼长，此前缺少对这一权衡的系统刻画，只能沿用默认方案。
Method: 将可识别性与质量的权衡形式化为多目标优化问题，针对一大类鲁棒、高效的水印求解 Pareto 最优解，并与当前默认水印对比。
Result: 识别出的一类鲁棒高效水印的 Pareto 最优解在权衡表现上优于当前默认水印；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 默认水印并非该权衡上的最优选择，改用 Pareto 最优水印可在同等质量下获得更好的可识别性（或反之）。

papers.title: A Scalable Multi-Robot Framework for Decentralized and Asynchronous Perception-Action-Communication Loops
papers.abstract_en: We develop a decentralized Perception-Action-Communication (PAC) system for multi-robot teams that enables them to collaborate in large scale, outdoor environments. Our system natively supports deployments at any scale by leveraging a graph neural network (GNN) to diffuse information hop-by-hop across the fleet's network. This achieves global collaboration from individual robots limited to local sensing and communication. Fully asynchronous, the core modules of PAC: perception, inter-robot communication, message aggregation and action are clocked at different frequencies with information flowing between them through buffers. We implement the PAC system as a series of highly extensible ROS2 nodes to serve as the foundational infrastructure for deployable swarm systems. PAC is validated in the real world with outdoor experiments with up to N=20 quadrotor robots and in simulations based on real-world data with up to N=100. These validations show that our system upholds crucial properties for field-deployable robot collectives: scalability, resiliency and repeatability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出去中心化、全异步的感知-动作-通信 (PAC) 多机器人系统，用图神经网络 (GNN) 在机队网络中逐跳扩散信息，使仅有局部感知与通信的单机实现全局协作。真实户外实验最多 20 架四旋翼、基于真实数据的仿真最多 100 架均验证了系统的可扩展性、抗毁性与可重复性。
Motivation: 大规模户外多机器人协作中，单机感知与通信范围有限，集中式方案难以随机队规模扩展，且各模块时钟不同步会阻碍现场部署。
Method: PAC 系统由感知、机间通信、消息聚合、动作四个以不同频率运行的核心模块组成，模块间经缓冲区传递信息实现全异步；用 GNN 沿机队网络逐跳扩散信息，整体实现为一系列可扩展的 ROS2 节点。
Result: 在真实户外实验中验证至 N=20 架四旋翼机器人，在基于真实世界数据的仿真中验证至 N=100，结果显示系统保持可扩展性、抗毁性 (resiliency) 与可重复性。
Conclusion: 逐跳 GNN 扩散加异步模块化时钟的 PAC 架构可作为可部署机器人集群的基础基础设施，随规模任意扩展而不牺牲现场部署所需的关键性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Random Polytope Descriptors
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a class of random polytopes which simultaneously generalizes several known constructions. While being fairly general, these polytopes are also computationally exceptionally benign. We indicate how these properties can be exploited for classification and clustering tasks in data analysis. Crucially, our construction lets users smoothly trade off between a tighter description of the data and faster computation.
papers.comment: 19 pages (v3); major rewrite (new title, more stochastic geometry, less machine learning); experiments reworked from scratch; code and data available on zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22913313
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一类同时推广多种已知构造的随机多面体描述子 (random polytope descriptors)，其计算代价极低，并可在数据描述的紧致性与计算速度之间平滑权衡，用于分类与聚类任务。
Motivation: 数据的多面体描述通常在刻画紧致性与计算开销之间难以兼顾，需要一种既能较紧地描述数据、又能快速计算的通用表示。
Method: 构造一类推广多种已知随机多面体的通用描述子，将其用于分类与聚类任务，并提供可调参数在描述紧致度与计算速度间平滑权衡；代码与数据发布于 zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22913313)。
Result: 论文给出随机多面体描述子的构造及其计算友好性质，并说明其可应用于分类与聚类；v3 版本重写了实验，摘要中未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 这类随机多面体是计算上异常温和的通用数据描述子，用户可按需在描述精度与计算速度之间连续调节。

papers.title: Median Temporal Ensembling: Training-Free Robust Aggregation for Action-Chunked Visuomotor Policies
papers.abstract_en: Action-chunked visuomotor policies predict overlapping trajectories, so every executed action is covered by several predictions. Temporal ensembling smooths execution by combining these predictions with an exponentially weighted mean. One corrupted prediction can move the aggregate without bound: its breakdown point is 0. We use adversarial corruption to stress this deployed aggregator and to compare two kinds of guarantee. A metric guarantee bounds the response to a perturbation of a given size. A combinatorial guarantee instead bounds the damage when at most q of the M candidates covering a timestep are corrupted, whatever their size. Encoder adversarial fine-tuning recovers 44% of the loss under the published patch attack, but only 7.3% after the attacker's step size is increased. By contrast, the coordinate-wise median of the same candidate set keeps its recovered fraction flat as attack optimisation increases. Median temporal ensembling costs one line and requires no retraining. Across 25 (configuration, corruption-level) combinations it is never worse than the mean and is significantly better in 15. It also transfers to a second policy class, and it recovers performance under a failure with no attacker in the loop at all: camera frames that arrive blank. Its effect on clean data is configuration-dependent, from -0.04 to +0.07. We also give the boundary: corruption that shifts every covering prediction by the same amount is invisible to this whole family of statistics, and no equivariant aggregator can remove it.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/MedianTE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 动作分块 (action-chunked) 视觉运动策略的时序集成用指数加权均值合并重叠轨迹，breakdown point 为 0，单个被污染的预测即可无界拉动聚合结果。改用逐坐标中位数 (coordinate-wise median) 后，恢复比例随攻击步长增大保持平坦，无需重训练；在 25 个（配置, 污染等级）组合中从不劣于均值、15 个显著更好，代价是干净数据上效果依配置在 -0.04 到 +0.07 之间。
Motivation: 部署中的时序集成对对抗污染极其脆弱：均值型聚合的 breakdown point 为 0，一个损坏预测就能无界移动聚合结果，而现有对抗微调的保证随攻击步长增大迅速失效。
Method: 对比两类保证——度量保证 (metric guarantee) 限制给定大小扰动的响应，组合保证 (combinatorial guarantee) 限制 M 个候选中至多 q 个被污染时的损害；用对抗污染对已部署聚合器做压力测试，并将 encoder 对抗微调与同一候选集的逐坐标中位数对比，中位数版本只需一行改动、不需重训练。
Result: encoder 对抗微调在已发表的 patch attack 下挽回 44% 的损失，但攻击步长增大后仅挽回 7.3%；逐坐标中位数的恢复比例随攻击优化加深保持平坦。在 25 个（配置, 污染等级）组合中中位数从不劣于均值，15 个显著更好，并可迁移到第二类策略，还能应对无攻击者参与的相机空帧故障；其在干净数据上的影响依配置介于 -0.04 与 +0.07。
Conclusion: 中位数时序集成以一行代码、零重训练换来对任意大小污染的组合保证，优于均值的度量型保证；但所有平移等变聚合器都无法消除把每个覆盖预测同量平移的污染。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling of Capability and Efficiency at Inference Time in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Capability and efficiency are two key dimensions of reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Capability refers to the ability to solve a given problem correctly, whereas efficiency refers to the ability to do so with limited resources. When LLMs use Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve problems of controlled hardness, both the number of problems solved correctly and the number of tokens required to reach a correct answer depend on problem hardness and model size. However, how these factors jointly shape capability and efficiency remains poorly understood. Here, we use hierarchical Bayesian models to evaluate the capability and efficiency of LLMs from the DeepSeek-R1-Distill model family across four classes of arithmetic and algorithmic reasoning problems. At a fixed model size, the probability of correctly solving an instance decays approximately exponentially with instance size, our proxy for problem hardness. The decay scale grows sublinearly with model size, indicating that larger models are more capable, but that capability gains diminish with scale. Output length grows as a power law with instance size, which serves as a proxy for difficulty. However, the parameters of this power law do not vary systematically with model size, suggesting that larger models do not become more efficient. Together, these findings reveal potential limitations of naive scaling as a strategy for developing more capable AI systems: capability improves with diminishing returns, while efficiency shows little to no improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用层次贝叶斯模型测 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 系列在四类算术与算法推理题上的能力与效率标度：固定模型规模时，单题正确率随实例规模近似指数衰减，衰减尺度随模型规模次线性增长；输出长度随实例规模呈幂律，且幂律参数不随模型规模系统变化。结论是朴素扩展 (naive scaling) 收益递减——能力提升递减、效率几乎不改善。
Motivation: CoT 推理下正确题数与答对所需 token 数同时受问题难度和模型规模影响，但两者如何共同塑造能力与效率尚不清楚，扩展策略的收益边界缺乏定量刻画。
Method: 对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 模型族在四类算术与算法推理问题上建立层次贝叶斯模型 (hierarchical Bayesian models)，以实例规模 (instance size) 作为难度代理，分别拟合答对概率随实例规模的衰减规律与输出长度随实例规模的幂律。
Result: 固定模型规模下，单实例答对概率随实例规模近似指数衰减，衰减尺度随模型规模次线性增长；输出长度随实例规模呈幂律，但幂律参数不随模型规模系统变化。
Conclusion: 更大模型更擅长解题但能力增益递减，而推理效率（答对所需输出长度）基本不随规模改善，因此单纯扩大规模不是提升 AI 系统能力的有效策略。

papers.title: Count Evidence, Not Sentences: Tempered Evidence Fusion of LLM Judgments for Long-Text Value Measurement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to measure public value orientations from long social media posts, yet such posts often mix background, quotations, concessions, and only a few stance-bearing sentences. Existing approaches either ask the model to predict a document-level label directly, which can be overconfident, or aggregate sentence-level predictions by majority or soft voting, which treat uncertain and decisive sentences as equally informative. We formulate long-text value measurement as a decision-fusion problem and propose Tempered Evidence Fusion (TEF), a training-free rule that weights each sentence's log-odds by its normalized information gain, as derived from a generalized Bayesian posterior. This makes the fused score nearly vanish for uncertain sentences while preserving the Bayes-optimal weight of decisive evidence. We further introduce Multi-event Insight Network Dimensions (MIND), a benchmark of 8,358 Chinese and English posts spanning five years of public events and six value dimensions. On MIND, TEF outperforms the strongest baseline among Direct, Majority Vote, and Soft Vote by an average of 4.5 accuracy points and 4.6 macro-F1 points across five LLMs and two languages. MIND dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Kzczc/ICASSP2027-TEF.
papers.comment: Yuhe Wu, Rui Qian, and Guangyu Wang contributed equally. Corresponding author: Guang Zhang. See also: https://github.com/Kzczc/ICASSP2027-TEF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把长文本价值观测量改写成决策融合问题：TEF 用广义贝叶斯后验导出的归一化信息增益给每句 log-odds 加权，使不确定句的权重近乎归零、决定性证据保留 Bayes 最优权重。在自建的中英文基准 MIND（8,358 条帖子、五个年份公共事件、六个价值维度）上，跨 5 个 LLM 与两种语言，TEF 相对 Direct、Majority Vote、Soft Vote 中最强基线平均高出 4.5 个准确率点与 4.6 个 macro-F1 点。
Motivation: 长社交媒体帖混杂背景、引语、让步，只有少数句子真正承载立场：直接让模型给文档级标签会过度自信，句子级多数投票或软投票又把不确定句与决定性句同等对待。
Method: TEF 是免训练规则：按广义贝叶斯后验推导每句的归一化信息增益，用它加权该句 log-odds 后融合；配套发布 MIND 基准（8,358 条中英文帖子、五年公共事件、六个价值维度）与代码。
Result: 在 MIND 上，相对 Direct、Majority Vote、Soft Vote 中最强基线，TEF 跨 5 个 LLM 和两种语言平均提升 4.5 个准确率点、4.6 个 macro-F1 点。
Conclusion: 长文本价值测量应按证据的信息增益而非句子计数来融合判断，且该规则无需训练即可跨模型与语言成立。

papers.title: The Linear Representation Hypothesis Needs a Group Action
papers.abstract_en: To make claims about representations that generalize beyond a particular trained model, we need to specify when two representations should count as equivalent. The Linear Representation Hypothesis is often discussed without making this equivalence explicit. Different notions of equivalence preserve different structures, so metrics, probes, and interventions that appear to study the same representation may in fact correspond to different hypotheses. We therefore argue that the Linear Representation Hypothesis is not one hypothesis but a family of claims distinguished by representation equivalence. We formalize this idea using group actions, specifying the representation object, the procedure that produces it, and the property ultimately asserted, while accounting for equivalences imposed by the model architecture. This framework clarifies how assumptions can change across metrics, reading points, and analysis stages, and we use it to audit common representation quantities and recent interpretability analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张线性表征假设 (Linear Representation Hypothesis) 不是单一假设，而是一族由表征等价关系区分的论断；用 group action 形式化，把表征对象、产生它的过程、最终断言的性质以及模型架构强加的等价性分开指定。据此审计常见表征度量与近期可解释性分析，指出看似研究同一表征的 metrics、probes、interventions 实际对应不同假设。
Motivation: 线性表征假设的讨论通常不显式说明何时两个表征算等价；不同等价关系保留不同结构，导致表面上研究同一表征的度量、探针和干预其实对应不同假设，跨模型的泛化论断因此缺乏明确前提。
Method: 用 group action 形式化表征等价：明确表征对象、产生表征的流程、最终断言的性质，并计入模型架构所强加的等价；再用该框架审计常见表征量与近期可解释性分析，考察假设在不同 metrics、reading points、analysis stages 之间如何变化。
Result: 给出一个概念性与形式化框架：线性表征假设被重述为一族按表征等价区分的论断，并用它审计常见表征量与近期可解释性分析，说明不同度量、读取点与分析阶段所依赖的假设会改变；论文为 16 页、含 1 张表。
Conclusion: 关于表征的论断要能跨模型泛化，必须先显式指定等价关系，否则不同 metrics、probes、interventions 得出的结论可能根本不在检验同一个假设。

papers.title: Giving Credit Where It's Due: Redundancy-Aware Learning for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models can produce correct yet unnecessarily long reasoning traces. Existing methods improve reasoning efficiency with trajectory-level objectives or local token- and step-level signals, but rarely model inter-step semantic dependencies. This limits their ability to distinguish redundant steps from those that support later deductions, making it harder to shorten reasoning without sacrificing accuracy. We introduce RECAP (REdundancy-aware Credit Assignment via Propagation), which addresses this limitation by assigning credit where it is due based on both a step's downstream role in the reasoning structure and its contribution to solving the problem correctly. We define structural responsibility to capture the step's downstream role by measuring how strongly later reasoning depends on it, using credit propagated backward from the final-answer node through an outcome-independent, LLM-annotated semantic dependency graph. However, a step can have high structural responsibility yet steer the reasoning away from the correct solution. RECAP therefore introduces step efficacy to measure answer-directed progress through changes in gold-answer log-likelihood as each step is added. Together, these signals reshape rollout-level GRPO advantages into step-specific updates. RECAP requires neither a separately trained process reward model nor preconstructed concise trajectories. Across two 7B models and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, RECAP improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B, it improves pass@1 by 2.0-3.7 percentage points while reducing reasoning tokens by 8%-31% relative to GRPO across all four benchmarks. Analysis suggests these savings reflect fewer reasoning operations and less dead-end reasoning, rather than more compact expression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECAP（REdundancy-aware Credit Assignment via Propagation）用语义依赖图反向传播的结构责任与 gold-answer log-likelihood 变化的 step efficacy 两个信号，把 GRPO 的 rollout 级优势改写为逐步更新，从而裁掉冗余推理步而非压缩表达。在两个 7B 模型、四个数学推理基准上，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 相对 GRPO 的 pass@1 提升 2.0–3.7 个百分点，同时推理 token 减少 8%–31%。
Motivation: 现有推理效率方法用轨迹级目标或局部 token/步级信号，很少建模步间语义依赖，难以区分冗余步与支撑后续推导的关键步，缩短推理时容易掉精度。
Method: 先由 LLM 标注得到与结果无关的语义依赖图，从最终答案节点反向传播 credit 得到 structural responsibility；再用逐步加入时 gold-answer log-likelihood 的变化定义 step efficacy；两者共同重塑 GRPO 优势为 step-specific 更新，无需单独训练的 PRM，也无需预构造简洁轨迹。
Result: 在两个 7B 模型与四个数学推理基准上改善精度-效率权衡；Qwen2.5-Math-7B 相对 GRPO 在全部四个基准上 pass@1 提升 2.0–3.7 个百分点，推理 token 减少 8%–31%。分析显示节省来自更少的推理操作与更少的 dead-end 推理，而非更紧凑的表达。
Conclusion: 按下游结构角色与答对贡献分配 credit，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下缩短长推理；收益来自砍掉冗余与死路步骤，而不是把话说短。

papers.title: The Like Trap: Multi-Stage Poisoning against Agents in Similarity-based Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: With recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, these agents are becoming increasingly autonomous and gaining broader access to act on users' behalf on the internet. However, the vulnerability of automated agents deployed on social media platforms (e.g., for managing a user's personal account) remains underexplored. Existing studies on agent poisoning typically assume that the adversary can expose poisoned content to the agent. Although such an attack is direct and effective, it is more easily detected and mitigated. In the context of social media platforms, this leaves open whether the recommendation system itself would surface such content to the agent in a more subtle manner. Through theoretical analysis, we show that the like-score mechanism used in OASIS can be exploited, and we characterize the conditions under which a multi-stage chain of poisoned posts can steer the agent's feed. Based on these insights, we further develop an algorithm that crafts realistic poisoned posts. Experiments support our theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Notably, by exploiting the like-score feedback loop, the attack causes the recommendation system to select poisoned posts even when their user-post similarity falls below the retrieval threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对社交媒体上 LLM 代理被投毒的问题，本文证明 OASIS 推荐系统的 like-score 机制可被多阶段投毒链利用：即使投毒帖与用户的相似度低于检索阈值，反馈回路仍会让推荐系统选中它们。理论分析给出多阶段投毒链操控代理信息流的条件，并据此设计生成逼真投毒帖的算法，实验支持理论结论。
Motivation: 部署在社交平台上代管用户账号的 LLM 代理日益自主，其安全漏洞研究不足；现有代理投毒研究都假设攻击者能直接把投毒内容暴露给代理，容易被检测和缓解，而推荐系统是否会以更隐蔽的方式主动推送这类内容仍是开放问题。
Method: 通过理论分析刻画 OASIS 中 like-score 机制被利用的条件，以及多阶段投毒帖链条 (multi-stage chain of poisoned posts) 操控代理信息流所需的条件；再基于这些结论设计生成逼真投毒帖的算法，并用实验检验理论发现。
Result: 实验支持理论发现并证明所提算法有效；核心发现是利用 like-score 反馈回路，攻击可使推荐系统在投毒帖的用户-帖子相似度低于检索阈值时仍将其选出。
Conclusion: 相似度阈值不足以阻挡投毒内容：like-score 反馈回路本身构成一条绕过检索门槛的投毒通道，评估社交平台代理安全性时须把推荐机制本身纳入攻击面。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Do We Need Complex Topology Control? Distinct-Peer Random Routing Improves Cost-Efficiency in Sparse Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving the reasoning accuracy of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer interaction. Communication topology plays a central role in this process, motivating increasingly sophisticated mechanisms that learn, adapt, or dynamically reconfigure agent interactions to improve accuracy or reasoning reliability. Meanwhile, prior studies suggest that much simpler sparse communication can already achieve competitive performance at substantially lower cost. In this work, we take a closer look at sparse MAD and ask whether complex topology control is actually necessary to improve collective reasoning. We find that a simple random-without-replacement routing policy, which lets each agent debate with two distinct and newly sampled peers at every round, provides a surprisingly strong baseline and consistently improves the accuracy-cost trade-off of sparse MAD. Building on this observation, we further study deliberation stopping and show that lightweight stopping can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive accuracy. Our results suggest that sophisticated topology control such as learned topology adaption should be evaluated against strong simple routing and stopping baselines before its additional complexity is justified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏多智能体辩论 (MAD) 中，每轮让每个 agent 与两个新抽样且互不重复的同伴辩论的 random-without-replacement 路由，就已稳定改善稀疏 MAD 的精度-成本权衡，无需复杂拓扑控制；配合轻量 deliberation stopping 可在保持竞争力精度的同时大幅降低推理成本。作者主张 learned topology adaption 等复杂机制须先与这类强简单基线对比，其额外复杂度才谈得上合理。
Motivation: MAD 研究趋向学习、自适应或动态重构通信拓扑以提升精度与可靠性，但已有工作表明更简单的稀疏通信即可达到竞争力表现且成本低得多，复杂拓扑控制的必要性存疑。
Method: 研究稀疏 MAD 的通信路由策略：核心是 random-without-replacement 路由，每轮为每个 agent 随机采样两个互异的新同伴；在此基础上加入轻量级 deliberation stopping 控制停止轮数以削减推理开销，并将复杂拓扑机制与该简单路由+停止基线对比。
Result: random-without-replacement 路由被证明是意外强的基线，一致改善稀疏 MAD 的精度-成本权衡；轻量 stopping 可大幅降低推理成本同时保持竞争力精度。
Conclusion: 复杂拓扑控制（如 learned topology adaption）在被证明优于强简单路由与停止基线之前，其额外复杂度不足以自证合理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在稀疏多智能体辩论 (MAD) 中，每轮让每个 agent 与两个新抽样且互不重复的同伴辩论的 random-without-replacement 路由，就已稳定改善稀疏 MAD 的精度-成本权衡，无需复杂拓扑控制；配合轻量 deliberation stopping 可在保持竞争力精度的同时大幅降低推理成本。作者主张 learned topology adaption 等复杂机制须先与这类强简单基线对比，其额外复杂度才谈得上合理。
summary_sections.motivation: MAD 研究趋向学习、自适应或动态重构通信拓扑以提升精度与可靠性，但已有工作表明更简单的稀疏通信即可达到竞争力表现且成本低得多，复杂拓扑控制的必要性存疑。
summary_sections.method: 研究稀疏 MAD 的通信路由策略：核心是 random-without-replacement 路由，每轮为每个 agent 随机采样两个互异的新同伴；在此基础上加入轻量级 deliberation stopping 控制停止轮数以削减推理开销，并将复杂拓扑机制与该简单路由+停止基线对比。
summary_sections.result: random-without-replacement 路由被证明是意外强的基线，一致改善稀疏 MAD 的精度-成本权衡；轻量 stopping 可大幅降低推理成本同时保持竞争力精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 复杂拓扑控制（如 learned topology adaption）在被证明优于强简单路由与停止基线之前，其额外复杂度不足以自证合理。

papers.title: Temporally Ordered Region-Token Mamba with Logit-Space Diffusion for Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing change detection requires both global reasoning across bitemporal images and precise localization of changed regions. However, dense attention is computationally expensive for high-resolution imagery, while conventional feature fusion and coarse decoding may inadequately separate genuine changes from appearance variations or preserve object boundaries. We present Bitemporal Mamba-Diffusion for Change Detection (BMD-CD), which combines temporally structured state-space modeling with logit-space diffusion refinement. BMD-CD converts deep bitemporal features into region tokens and arranges them in explicit temporal partitions before bidirectional state-space propagation. Its Bitemporal Ordered Mamba Operator enables long-range cross-temporal interaction with linear sequence complexity, while Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement forms a change-oriented output and a complementary rotated output using learned pairwise rotations and unchanged-region consistency. Multiscale decoding then produces coarse change logits, which are refined through a five-step Conditional Diffusion Decoder operating directly in logit space. Experiments on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, DSIFN-CD, CDD, and S2Looking demonstrate strong performance across diverse change-detection settings. BMD-CD achieves F1 scores of 93.7%, 96.0%, 97.8%, and 99.0% on the four standard benchmarks and improves 3-pixel Boundary-F1 to 87.7% and 91.4% on LEVIR-CD and WHU-CD, respectively. The full model requires 32.09 GFLOPs and 47 ms per 256 x 256 image pair, while also showing zero-shot transfer to ValaisCD and B-FLAIR-test. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aparup2139/Public_WACV/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BMD-CD 把双时相深度特征切成按时间显式分区的 region token，用双向状态空间传播做线性复杂度的跨时序交互，再在 logit 空间用五步条件扩散精修边界。在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、DSIFN-CD、CDD 上 F1 分别为 93.7%、96.0%、97.8%、99.0%，3-pixel Boundary-F1 在 LEVIR-CD 与 WHU-CD 上达 87.7% 与 91.4%，单对 256×256 图像 47 ms、32.09 GFLOPs。
Motivation: 高分辨率双时相影像上稠密 attention 代价过高，而常规特征融合与粗解码难以把真实变化与外观差异分开、也保不住目标边界。
Method: BMD-CD 将双时相深度特征转为 region token 并按显式时间分区排列，经 Bitemporal Ordered Mamba Operator 做线性序列复杂度的双向状态空间传播；Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement 用学习到的成对旋转与未变区域一致性构造面向变化的输出和互补旋转输出；多尺度解码得到粗 change logit，再由在 logit 空间直接操作的五步 Conditional Diffusion Decoder 精修。
Result: F1：LEVIR-CD 93.7%、WHU-CD 96.0%、DSIFN-CD 97.8%、CDD 99.0%；3-pixel Boundary-F1 在 LEVIR-CD 87.7%、WHU-CD 91.4%；完整模型 32.09 GFLOPs、每对 256×256 图像 47 ms；并在 ValaisCD 与 B-FLAIR-test 上展示零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 按时间有序的 region token 状态空间建模加 logit 空间扩散精修，可在可控算力下同时拿到强变化检测精度与更锐的边界，并具备跨数据集零样本迁移能力。

papers.title: Learning Risk Scores Robust to Unobserved Confounders
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning risk scores to prioritize individuals for scarce resources or interventions, from historical observational data affected by unobserved confounding. Decisions about who receives scarce resources are often guided by risk scores based on recorded characteristics, such as responses to a survey. These risk scores are increasingly being learned directly from observational data: historical records of individuals' characteristics, allocation decisions, and outcomes. Standard methods such as inverse propensity weighting (IPW), which corrects for the bias introduced by the historical allocation policy, can be used to learn accurate risk scores if the historical decision process is fully explained by the recorded characteristics. In practice, however, historical decisions often depend on unrecorded information, causing learned risk scores to systematically under-prioritize exactly the individuals whose unrecorded circumstances drove past prioritization. We propose a method for learning risk scores that are robust to this kind of unobserved confounding, building on IPW. Since propensity weights cannot be reliably estimated under unobserved confounding, we instead treat them as belonging to an uncertainty set determined by the observable data and domain-informed estimates of the degree of confounding, combining sensitivity analysis from causal inference with Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization. The resulting robust risk score learning problem admits a sample-based approximation that we reformulate as an exponential cone program compatible with off-the-shelf solvers. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on semi-synthetic data derived from datasets in the UCI Machine Learning Repository. Our method improves calibration by up to 29.2% over traditional benchmarks and up to 11.1% over the state of the art, without compromising other metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在历史观测数据存在未观测混杂时，标准 IPW 学出的风险评分会系统性低估那些因未记录因素而被过去政策优先照顾的个体。作者把倾向权重放进由可观测数据与领域给出的混杂程度决定的不确定性集合，用因果推断的敏感性分析结合 Wasserstein 分布式鲁棒优化 (Wasserstein DRO) 学鲁棒风险评分，并重构为指数锥规划求解。在由 UCI 数据集构造的半合成数据上，校准较传统基线最多提升 29.2%，较 state of the art 最多提升 11.1%，其他指标不受损。
Motivation: 稀缺资源分配的风险评分多从历史观测数据学得，历史决策常依赖未记录信息，导致 IPW 等去偏方法失效，评分恰好系统性低估最需要的个体。
Method: 在 IPW 基础上把倾向权重视为属于由可观测数据与领域给出的混杂程度决定的不确定性集合，结合因果推断的敏感性分析与 Wasserstein 分布式鲁棒优化；得到的样本近似形式重构为指数锥规划 (exponential cone program)，可用现成求解器求解。
Result: 在由 UCI Machine Learning Repository 数据集构造的半合成数据上，校准 (calibration) 较传统基线最多改善 29.2%，较 state of the art 最多改善 11.1%，且不牺牲其他指标。
Conclusion: 把倾向权重的不确定性显式建模为分布鲁棒问题，可以在未观测混杂下学出校准更好且不损害其他指标的风险评分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Infrastructure-Based Radar System for Highway Traffic Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Infrastructure-based radar systems offer robust and long-range solutions for traffic monitoring, yet their detection and tracking performance under real-world conditions remains insufficiently evaluated. This study introduces DRaT (Drone and Radar Trajectories), a dual-modality dataset of naturalistic vehicle trajectories collected at a highway merging segment in Fort Worth, Texas, to systematically assess radar sensing performance against drone-derived ground truth. The performance is evaluated at three levels: individual vehicle detection, trajectory tracking, and macroscopic traffic parameter estimation. For individual vehicle detection, the radar achieves an overall precision of 78% and a recall of 57%, with degraded performance under congested traffic conditions and at longer distances. At the trajectory level, the radar demonstrates reasonably strong tracking performance (IDF1 = 0.699), maintaining reliable vehicle identities when tracks are successfully established. For macroscopic traffic flow metrics, the radar accurately estimates space-mean speed (MAPE < 4%) but underestimates density and volume by approximately 23% due to missed detections. The paper also discusses practical deployment considerations and potential downstream applications of roadside radar sensing systems. To support reproducible research on infrastructure-based sensing systems, we have open-sourced the DRaT dataset on Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20171110.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE ITSC 2026. Compared with the accepted version, this version includes an expanded trajectory tracking analysis with additional evaluation metrics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DRaT 双模态数据集（无人机真值 + 路侧雷达），在 Fort Worth 高速合流段系统评估基础设施雷达的检测、跟踪与宏观参数估计：检测 precision 78%、recall 57%，IDF1 = 0.699，空间平均速度 MAPE < 4%，但密度与流量因漏检被低估约 23%。拥堵与远距离下检测性能下降。
Motivation: 路侧雷达做交通监测在真实工况下的检测与跟踪性能缺乏系统评估，缺少以无人机轨迹为真值的公开数据集支撑可复现研究。
Method: 构建 DRaT（Drone and Radar Trajectories）双模态数据集，采集 Fort Worth 高速合流段自然驾驶车辆轨迹，以无人机轨迹为 ground truth，分三层评估雷达：单车检测、轨迹跟踪（IDF1）、宏观交通参数估计（空间平均速度、密度、流量）。
Result: 单车检测 overall precision 78%、recall 57%，拥堵与更远距离下性能下降；轨迹级 IDF1 = 0.699；空间平均速度 MAPE < 4%，密度与流量因漏检低估约 23%。数据集已开源至 Zenodo。
Conclusion: 路侧雷达可靠建立轨迹后身份保持较好、宏观速度估计准，但漏检系统性压低密度与流量，部署时需针对拥堵与远距补检。

papers.title: MINER: Multi-crop INference-time Enhancement for Rare-Object Retrieval with Frozen Dual Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image retrieval with frozen dual encoders degrades when the query names a small, visually subordinate object in a cluttered scene: a single global image embedding underrepresents the localized visual evidence. We present MINER, a training-free inference framework that augments a frozen dual encoder's global image embedding with a small bank of region-level embeddings and a hubness-correcting similarity rescoring, recovering visual evidence that global pooling underweights. To evaluate this setting, we introduce ROCS, a benchmark built from high-clutter subsets of Flickr30K and MS COCO whose images are re-captioned to name a single low-salience object. Experiments on CLIP, SigLIP, and SigLIP 2 show that MINER improves retrieval on every backbone, on ROCS and on the standard splits. Analyses show that these gains come primarily from broader spatial coverage rather than precise crop placement, revealing a simple and general way to recover localized evidence from frozen representations. Code: https://github.com/aalquwayfili/MINER. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aalquwayfili/ROCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MINER 是免训练的推理时增强框架：给冻结双编码器的全局图像嵌入补一组区域级嵌入，并用 hubness 校正的相似度重打分，找回被全局池化压低的局部证据。在新基准 ROCS（由 Flickr30K 与 MS COCO 高杂乱子集重写为单一低显著度物体）上，CLIP、SigLIP、SigLIP 2 三个骨干的检索全部提升，且增益主要来自更广的空间覆盖而非精确的裁剪位置。
Motivation: 查询指向杂乱场景中细小、视觉上从属的物体时，冻结双编码器的单一全局图像嵌入低估局部证据，检索性能下降。
Method: 训练-free 推理框架：保留冻结双编码器，用小规模区域级嵌入库补充全局图像嵌入，再做 hubness 校正的相似度重打分；同时提出 ROCS 基准，从 Flickr30K 与 MS COCO 的高杂乱子集取图并重写 caption 以点名单个低显著度物体。
Result: 在 CLIP、SigLIP、SigLIP 2 上，MINER 在 ROCS 与标准划分上均提升检索；分析显示增益主要来自更广的空间覆盖 (broader spatial coverage) 而非精确裁剪位置。
Conclusion: 从冻结表示中恢复局部证据，靠扩大区域覆盖加相似度重打分即可，无需微调编码器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hierarchy-Aware Video-Language Model Evaluation and Hyperbolic Baseline for Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Surgical procedures follow a phase-to-step hierarchy, yet the video-language models used to recognize them are evaluated with flat per-level metrics that ignore cross-level coherence and error structure. In this paper we make two contributions to address this problem, (i) we introduce SurgHiBench, the first hierarchy-aware evaluation suite for surgical video understanding, with three tasks measuring recognition, consistency, and severity across granularity levels. We evaluate a general-purpose CLIP model, a Euclidean surgical model, and, as second contribution: (ii) HyperSurg, a new hyperbolic model that enforces phase-step containment via entailment cones, across four (existing) datasets spanning three procedure types. The suite reveals that two models with the same accuracy can produce predictions of very different error severity, ranging from sibling confusions within the correct phase to unrelated cross-phase predictions. Hyperbolic geometry shifts predictions toward the correct procedural neighborhood, and these gains scale with the tree-likeness of each dataset's annotation hierarchy, providing a principled indicator when hierarchy-aware geometry helps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出手术视频理解的层级感知评测套件 SurgHiBench 与双曲模型 HyperSurg：用 entailment cones 强制 phase-step 包含关系，在四个数据集、三种术式上检验。双曲几何把预测推向正确的流程邻域，且增益随标注层级的树状程度 (tree-likeness) 增强，可作为何时该用层级感知几何的判据。
Motivation: 手术流程分 phase 与 step 两级层级，但现有视频语言模型只用扁平的逐级指标评测，掩盖了跨层级一致性与错误严重度结构。
Method: 两项贡献：SurgHiBench 提出识别、一致性、严重度三个跨粒度任务；HyperSurg 用双曲几何与 entailment cones 强制 phase 到 step 的包含约束，对比对象为通用 CLIP 与一个欧氏手术模型，覆盖四个已有数据集、三种术式。
Result: 评测显示准确率相同的两个模型可给出错误严重度差异很大的预测，从同 phase 内的兄弟混淆到跨 phase 的无关预测；双曲几何使预测移向正确的流程邻域，增益随各数据集标注层级的 tree-likeness 增长。
Conclusion: 扁平准确率不足以刻画手术层级预测的错误结构，双曲几何能改善流程邻域正确性，而数据集层级的树状程度可指示层级感知几何何时有帮助。

papers.title: Super-Resolution of Solar Magnetograms via Adaptive Stratified Ensemble Learning with Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Single-image super-resolution of Sun's photospheric magnetograms enables consistent analysis across heterogeneous space-based instruments and supports long-term studies of solar magnetic field evolution. We address the super-resolution task from SOHO/MDI (low-resolution) to SDO/HMI (high-resolution) line-of-sight (LOS) magnetograms using a modified RRDBNet architecture initialized by ESRGAN pretrained weights. Through systematic per-image diagnostic analysis, we identify image complexity as the dominant predictor of reconstruction errors. To exploit this finding, we introduce an adaptive stratified specialist ensemble (SSE) of three specialist networks with uncertainty estimation, where each specialist network is trained by images from three different complexity strata using a weighted random sampling strategy. During inference, a lightweight router based on input image statistics assigns each test image to the appropriate specialist network. Our experimental results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed ensemble and its superiority over closely related methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SOHO/MDI 到 SDO/HMI 的 LOS 磁图单图超分辨率，提出自适应分层专家集成 (SSE)：先按图像复杂度把训练样本分三层，各训一个专家网络并做不确定性估计，推理时用轻量 router 依输入图像统计量选专家。逐图诊断显示图像复杂度是重建误差的主导预测因子，集成在实验中优于密切相关的对比方法。
Motivation: 异构空间仪器（SOHO/MDI 与 SDO/HMI）的磁图分辨率不一致，妨碍跨仪器一致分析与太阳磁场长期演化研究；统一超分模型受图像复杂度差异拖累，重建误差分布不均。
Method: 以 ESRGAN 预训练权重初始化的改进 RRDBNet 做单图超分；逐图诊断找出复杂度这一主导误差预测因子后，按三个复杂度层用加权随机采样分别训练三个专家网络 (specialist networks) 构成 SSE，并附不确定性估计；推理时由基于输入图像统计量的轻量 router 分派图像到对应专家。
Result: 实验中所提集成优于密切相关的对比方法；逐图诊断确定图像复杂度为重建误差的主导预测因子。
Conclusion: 按图像复杂度分层训练专家并用轻量 router 调度，是提升磁图超分重建一致性并给出不确定性估计的有效路径。

papers.title: When Clients Are Orchestrated: Strategic Gradient Manipulation to Defeat Federated Learning Servers with Efficient Defense
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning enables decentralized model training by exchanging model updates--rather than raw data--with a central parameter server (PS). While most of the existing defenses primarily assume static or independently acting adversaries, we reveal a new class of dynamically adaptive attacks that systematically bypass such protections. We propose Fed-ADR, a holistic attack framework in which a malicious orchestrator server (OS) dynamically coordinates a heterogeneous set of adversarial clients, including both targeted and untargeted attackers. Through real-time coordination by the OS, malicious clients strategically adapt their gradient updates to evade defenses deployed by the PS, while either severely degrading global model performance or steering training toward adversarial objectives.To mitigate this threat, we offer a detection mechanism that estimates each client's true gradient from historical updates, enabling real-time detection of coordinated malicious behavior without additional overhead. We further introduce an in-situ recovery mechanism that restores global model performance without restarting training, preserving convergence and minimizing recovery time. Comprehensive experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 benchmark datasets demonstrate that Fed-ADR's attack scheme can reduce global accuracy from over 90% to below 10%, bypassing several state-of-the-art defenses. When our detection and recovery modules are employed, they identify malicious clients and restore accuracy to over 90% within a few rounds, at a substantially lower cost than retraining from scratch--achieving a reduction of at least 20x in computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fed-ADR 让一个恶意编排服务器 (orchestrator server) 实时协调异构恶意客户端，按 PS 侧防御动态调整梯度更新，从而绕过现有联邦学习防御。在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上把全局准确率从 90% 以上打到 10% 以下；配套检测与原位恢复模块可在几轮内识别恶意客户端并把准确率恢复到 90% 以上，计算开销比从头重训至少降低 20 倍。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习防御大多假设对手是静态或独立行动的，挡不住由服务器统一协调、随防御实时调整的协同攻击。
Method: 提出 Fed-ADR 攻击框架：恶意编排服务器 (OS) 协调包含定向与非定向攻击者的异构客户端，使其梯度更新自适应以规避 PS 防御；防御侧用历史更新估计每个客户端的真实梯度做实时检测（无额外开销），再用原位恢复机制在不重启训练的情况下修复全局模型。
Result: 在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上，Fed-ADR 将全局准确率从超过 90% 降至低于 10%，绕过多种 SOTA 防御；启用检测与恢复模块后可在几轮内识别恶意客户端并把准确率恢复到 90% 以上，计算开销相对从头重训至少降低 20 倍。
Conclusion: 联邦学习防御必须假定对手可被服务器动态编排，且检测加原位恢复足以在不重训的前提下挽回被协同梯度操纵打崩的模型。

papers.title: PEARL: A Lightweight Prompt-based Feature Interpreter Framework for Real-Time, Anonymous, and Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneity across Collaborative Perception (CP) agents is a major challenge for emerging CP frameworks due to domain gaps from differing sensors, architectures, and training data. Prior works mitigate this challenge by aligning features in a unified space via model retraining or per-agent-type interpreters. These strategies (a) require access to neighbor configurations, (b) do not fully address real-time CP deployment, and (c) generalize poorly to unseen agents joining at run time. To overcome these challenges, we present PEARL, a Prompt-Embedding framework for Anonymous and Real-time Lightweight heterogeneous CP. PEARL supports multiple CP interpreters and selects one for a new-joining agent in real time using two lightweight, multi-scale interpreters trained in parallel: a sparse-detection (LWSD) interpreter that aligns salient regions for cooperative detection, and a dense, domain-invariant (LWDDI) interpreter that produces agent-invariant features for fast interpreter selection. Both interpreters use low-rank visual prompts to reduce computation, storage, and model complexity. Extensive experiments on simulated (OPV2V, V2XSet) and real (DAIR-V2X) datasets show that PEARL generalizes across simulated and real-world cooperative driving scenarios. Its real-time model-selection strategy yields an 8.2% Average Precision (AP) gain over a random-selection baseline while running in 1.67 ms on average. Although primarily designed for real-time CP, PEARL also outperforms state-of-the-art heterogeneous CP frameworks under traditional offline training by 5.6% AP on average while reducing communication cost by up to 34.7 times. Equally important, PEARL does not require sharing agents' configurations or model settings, thereby protecting information that may be proprietary or private. These results establish PEARL as a scalable and practical framework for heterogeneous collaborative perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEARL 用两个并行训练的轻量多尺度解释器处理异构协同感知 (CP)：稀疏检测解释器 LWSD 对齐显著区域，稠密域不变解释器 LWDDI 生成 agent 不变特征以实时为新加入的 agent 选解释器，两者都用低秩视觉 prompt 压低计算与存储。在 OPV2V、V2XSet 与 DAIR-V2X 上，实时选型比随机选型基线 AP 提升 8.2%，平均耗时 1.67 ms；离线训练下比 SOTA 异构 CP 框架平均高 5.6% AP，通信成本最多降 34.7 倍。
Motivation: 协同感知 agent 间传感器、架构与训练数据不同造成域间隙；现有对齐方案需要邻居配置、难以实时部署，且对运行时新加入的 unseen agent 泛化差。
Method: PEARL (Prompt-Embedding framework for Anonymous and Real-time Lightweight heterogeneous CP) 并行训练两个轻量多尺度解释器：LWSD 对齐用于协同检测的显著区域，LWDDI 产出 agent 不变特征供实时解释器选型；两者均用低秩视觉 prompt 降低计算、存储与模型复杂度，且不需共享 agent 配置或模型设置。
Result: 在模拟数据集 OPV2V、V2XSet 与真实数据集 DAIR-V2X 上：实时选型策略比随机选型基线 AP 提升 8.2%，平均运行 1.67 ms；传统离线训练下比 SOTA 异构 CP 框架平均 AP 高 5.6%，通信成本最多降低 34.7 倍。
Conclusion: PEARL 证明无需暴露 agent 配置即可在运行时为新 agent 实时选解释器，同时兼顾跨模拟到真实的泛化、实时性与通信开销，可作为异构协同感知的可扩展实用框架。

papers.title: From greenhouse climate to individual leaves: an organ-resolved model of lettuce growth
papers.abstract_en: Greenhouse climate management aims to improve crop production while limiting energy use. This requires knowing how a crop will respond before conditions are changed. A crop digital twin can support this decision only if it represents how plant physiology and structure develop together. A unified framework was developed to simulate lettuce growth from the physiology of individual leaves. Each leaf received the conditions at its position in the canopy and contributed carbon through photosynthesis. Part of this carbon was used for maintenance and the remainder supported growth, distributed among leaves by their age, size and local environment. The predicted leaf mass, area and age generated an evolving three-dimensional plant in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Ray tracing calculated the radiation intercepted by each leaf and returned it to photosynthesis, so structure and growth influenced each other over time. Against greenhouse measurements, the relative root mean square error was 9.5% for total dry weight and 9.2%, 12.7% and 13.1% for leaf number, canopy diameter and largest-leaf area, respectively. A 30% decrease in incident radiation reduced final dry weight by 10.4%, while the same increase raised it by 6.9%, and adding 200 ppm carbon dioxide raised it by 46.1%. Within a simulated 40-plant block, interior plants accumulated 8.6% less dry weight than border plants with identical initial states, and the leaf-specific tipburn index rose in the enclosed leaves over the period in which tipburn appeared on the greenhouse plants. Resolving individual leaves therefore explains how local exposure changes plant growth within the greenhouse. The framework provides the forward plant model needed for a bidirectional digital twin, where observations of the physical plant can update predictions and support greenhouse climate decisions.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Includes an appendix with supporting information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从单叶生理出发的器官级莴苣生长模型：每片叶按冠层位置接收光环境、经光合作用供碳，碳在维护与按叶龄/尺寸/环境分配的生长之间分配，预测的叶质量、叶面积与叶龄在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中生成不断演化的三维植株，ray tracing 把每叶截获辐射反馈回光合作用，使结构与生长互为因果。对照温室实测，总干重相对 RMSE 为 9.5%，叶数、冠径、最大叶面积分别为 9.2%、12.7%、13.1%；入射辐射降 30% 使终末干重降 10.4%，升 30% 使其升 6.9%，加 200 ppm CO2 使其升 46.1%。
Motivation: 温室气候管理要在改变环境前预知作物响应，但作物数字孪生只有在同时表示生理与结构如何共同发育时才可用于决策；块内个体间受光差异造成的生长与 tipburn 分歧此前难以解释。
Method: 统一框架从单叶生理模拟莴苣生长：每叶按冠层位置获取条件并经光合作用供碳，碳先满足 maintenance、余量按叶龄、尺寸与局部环境分配到各叶；预测的叶质量、面积与年龄在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构成演化三维植株，ray tracing 计算每叶截获辐射并反馈给光合作用，形成结构-生长闭环。
Result: 对照温室实测：总干重 rRMSE 9.5%，叶数 9.2%、冠径 12.7%、最大叶面积 13.1%。情景模拟中入射辐射降 30% 使终末干重降 10.4%，辐射升 30% 使其升 6.9%，加 200 ppm CO2 使其升 46.1%。在 40 株模拟区块内，初始状态相同的内部植株比边界植株少积累 8.6% 干重，被包围叶片的叶级 tipburn index 随温室植株出现 tipburn 的时段上升。
Conclusion: 逐叶解析能够解释同一温室内局部受光差异如何改变个体生长与 tipburn 发生；该前向植物模型是双向数字孪生的基础，可由实体植株观测更新预测并支持温室气候决策。

summary_sections.result: 对照温室实测：总干重 rRMSE 9.5%，叶数 9.2%、冠径 12.7%、最大叶面积 13.1%。情景模拟中入射辐射降 30% 使终末干重降 10.4%，辐射升 30% 使其升 6.9%，加 200 ppm CO2 使其升 46.1%。在 40 株模拟区块内，初始状态相同的内部植株比边界植株少积累 8.6% 干重，被包围叶片的叶级 tipburn index 随温室植株出现 tipburn 的时段上升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 逐叶解析能够解释同一温室内局部受光差异如何改变个体生长与 tipburn 发生；该前向植物模型是双向数字孪生的基础，可由实体植株观测更新预测并支持温室气候决策。

papers.title: Damnatio Memoriae: Adversarially and Selectively Forgetting Identities in the Embedding Space of Face Recognition Models
papers.abstract_en: A face recognition model links two images of a person recorded on separate occasions when their embedding similarity exceeds an operating threshold. We consider making chosen identities unlinkable across separate occasions while the model remains in service for the rest of the population. Deleting their images and retraining does not achieve this, since the model recognises identities never observed in training. Therefore, the embedding space must be altered against these identities, the process of which we call open-set adversarial forgetting. We propose three loss functions, one that disperses an identity's embeddings from their centroid, and two that map each image onto its own near-orthogonal target, learnt with the classifier head or fixed in advance as an almost-orthonormal frame. Each is fine-tuned alongside the classification objective on a subset of each identity's images. We evaluate them against four methods from prior work in verification and identification, at two forget scales and three backbones. Every loss acting on the embedding geometry makes the forget identities nearly unidentifiable. The orthonormal frame alone achieves strong forgetting, which holds wherever an image of that subset enters the comparison and leaves distinct forget identities unlinkable. It also surpasses a concurrent unsupervised method at a higher retain rate.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. This work might be submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在人脸识别模型的 embedding 空间里对指定身份做 open-set adversarial forgetting：提出三种损失（打散某身份的 embedding、把每张图映射到各自近正交目标），与分类目标一起微调，使被遗忘身份在验证与识别任务中几乎不可识别，且保留集识别率更高。正交框架 (orthonormal frame) 单独即可实现强遗忘，让不同被遗忘身份之间也无法互相关联，并在更高 retain rate 下超过一个同期无监督方法。
Motivation: 人脸识别模型会把训练中从未见过的身份也识别出来，因此删除图像再重训无法让选定身份在服务中的模型里变得不可关联，必须直接改写 embedding 空间。
Method: 提出三种损失函数：一种把某身份的 embedding 从其质心打散，另两种把每张图映射到各自的近正交目标（目标由分类头学习，或预先固定为近正交框架 almost-orthonormal frame）；这些损失与分类目标一起在每个身份的部分图像子集上微调，并与先前工作的四种方法在验证与识别任务上对比，覆盖两种遗忘规模和三种 backbone。
Result: 作用于 embedding 几何的每种损失都使被遗忘身份几乎不可识别；正交框架单独即达到强遗忘，只要该子集的图像进入比较就生效，并使不同被遗忘身份之间不可关联；在更高 retain rate 下超过一个同期无监督方法。评估覆盖验证与识别两个任务、两个 forget scale、三种 backbone，并对比四种先前方法。
Conclusion: 直接改写 embedding 几何（而非删数据重训）是让服务中的人脸模型对选定身份 open-set 遗忘的有效路径，近正交目标框架单靠自身即可兼顾强遗忘与较高的保留集表现。

papers.title: Feed the Panel Dimensions, Not Verdicts: Rubric-Decomposed Fusion of Vision-Language Aesthetic Judges
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are deployed as zero-shot judges of image aesthetics, and panels of several models are recommended, on thin evidence, as the way to make such judges reliable. On two human-rated datasets, EVA and PARA, we find that a panel of holistic judges never significantly beats its best member, whether the verdicts are averaged or fused by a learned combiner. What a panel is worth depends on what it is fed. We therefore have each model score each image on the five dimensions of a frozen, human-written rubric and fuse those scores, alongside each model's verdict, across model families with an out-of-fold combiner. The dimension scores measure what their labels claim: with the overall human score partialled out, a dimension prompt carries more attribute-specific information than the holistic prompt in 28 of 30 model-attribute cells. Fused, they beat the best single VLM in all ten three-family panels on EVA (against that best single model, +0.07 Spearman rho for the strongest trio and +0.10 for the pre-declared one, and +0.06 and +0.07 when averaged over twenty fold partitions; against the panel mean, the primary test gives +0.118 on its EVA design set), and on PARA they reach parity under Spearman rho and a small, non-significant loss under Kendall tau-b, where one model already captures 85% of the human noise ceiling. It is not a feature-count artefact: giving the same combiner an equal number of pure holistic columns, split from the same repetitions, does not reproduce it. The gain costs a few hundred labels, which do not transfer between datasets, and 4.8x the API calls on EVA; we report it with paired bootstraps and Kendall tau-b, alongside a failed pre-registration and the configurations that lost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图像美学评审中，把 VLM 面板从整体打分改为按冻结的五维人工评分细则 (rubric) 分维度打分再融合，才能稳定超过最强单模型。在 EVA 与 PARA 上，整体判断面板无论平均还是学习式融合都不显著优于其最佳成员；改喂维度分后，EVA 上十个三家族面板全部胜过最佳单模型（最强 trio Spearman +0.07，预注册组 +0.10），代价是 4.8 倍 API 调用且标签不跨数据集迁移。
Motivation: VLM 被当作零样本图像美学评审，且有建议称多模型面板即可提升可靠性，但作者在两个人工评分数据集上发现整体判断面板并不显著优于最佳成员，面板价值取决于喂给它的内容。
Method: 让每个模型按冻结的、人工撰写的五维 rubric 对每张图分别打分，再连同各自的整体 verdict 一起，用 out-of-fold combiner 跨模型家族融合；用剔除总体人评分的偏相关检验维度分是否携带属性特异信息，并以等数量的纯整体列喂同一 combiner 作对照，评测用 Spearman rho、Kendall tau-b 与 paired bootstrap。
Result: 在 EVA 与 PARA 上整体判断面板不显著超过最佳成员；维度提示在 30 个 model-attribute cell 中有 28 个比整体提示携带更多属性特异信息；融合后在 EVA 全部十个三家族面板胜过最佳单模型（最强 trio +0.07 Spearman，预声明组 +0.10，二十次 fold 划分平均 +0.06 与 +0.07，对面板均值主检验 +0.118），PARA 上 Spearman 打平、Kendall tau-b 小幅不显著落后（该处一个模型已达人噪声上限的 85%）；对照的纯整体列不复现增益；成本为数百个标签（不跨数据集迁移）与 EVA 上 4.8 倍 API 调用。
Conclusion: 面板的可靠性来自喂维度分而非整体 verdict 的堆叠；该增益需付出数百标签与数倍 API 调用，且标签不跨数据集迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provably Complete Generalized Planning with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Generalized planning aims to compute a plan that solves all instances of a planning domain. Recent work has used LLMs to automatically generate and debug such generalized plans in the form of Python programs and achieved perfect test data coverage for several domains. However, whether these generalized plans are actually complete, i.e. solve all instances of the domain, could only be determined by manual evaluation. Here, we present an approach for automatically generating generalized plans in Lean together with proofs of their completeness relative to a specification of the domain constraints provided as input. We introduce a semantic-preserving PDDL-to-Lean conversion, and use an LLM to generate both the generalized plan and the formal proof that it solves every instance satisfying the domain constraints. The correctness of the completeness proof is determined by Lean's kernel. We evaluate our approach on 13 commonly used benchmark domains, using GPT-5.6-Sol as the LLM. For 12 of the domains we obtain generalized plans together with valid completeness proofs. This is a major advancement of the state of the art in automatic generalized-plan completeness proofs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 在 Lean 中同时生成 generalized plan 及其完备性证明，配合语义保持的 PDDL-to-Lean 转换，证明的正确性由 Lean kernel 裁决。在 13 个常用 benchmark 域上用 GPT-5.6-Sol 评测，12 个域拿到了带有效完备性证明的 generalized plan。
Motivation: 此前 LLM 生成的 Python generalized plan 即使测试数据全覆盖，其是否真正完备（解出域内所有实例）只能靠人工判定，缺少自动、机器可检验的完备性保证。
Method: 提出语义保持的 PDDL-to-Lean 转换，把域约束规格作为输入；由 LLM 同时生成 generalized plan 与证明其解出每个满足域约束实例的形式化证明，证明正确性交由 Lean kernel 判定。
Result: 在 13 个常用 benchmark 域上以 GPT-5.6-Sol 评测，12 个域获得 generalized plan 加有效完备性证明。
Conclusion: 作者称该方法是自动 generalized-plan 完备性证明的 state of the art 的重大推进，把完备性从人工判定变为 Lean kernel 可检验。

papers.title: Intelligence Across Embodiments
papers.abstract_en: Robotic embodiment encompasses the sensing, kinematics, dynamics, geometry, actuation, and control through which an agent physically interacts with the world. These properties vary across robots and change over time. We argue that general embodied intelligence requires learning that accumulates across these differences. Prevailing methods that engineer correspondences to bridge embodiment differences offer immediate practical gains, but their assumptions limit the scope of transfer in the long run. Instead, a more general approach should discover representations that support transfer to a larger range of embodiments as experience grows. We propose embodiment diversity as a promising axis of scaling, and identify broad learned priors as a complementary ingredient. We call for evaluations that better characterize embodiment gaps and transfer performance. More broadly, cross-embodiment learning connects the practical challenge of learning from heterogeneous robot experience with a broader scientific pursuit inspired by nature - physical intelligence that adapts and co-evolves with its embodiments to gain agency over its behavior and physical forms.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 学习要靠随经验增长而扩展的通用表征，而非人工设计的对应关系来桥接机器人差异；把具身多样性 (embodiment diversity) 作为扩展轴，并以广义学习先验 (broad learned priors) 作为配套成分，同时呼吁能刻画具身差距与迁移性能的评测。
Motivation: 传感、运动学、动力学、几何、驱动与控制属性因机器人而异且随时间变化，人工构造对应关系的假设限制了长期可迁移范围。
Method: 立场/路线论文：论证发现支持更大范围具身迁移的表征优于工程化对应关系，提出以 embodiment diversity 作为 scaling 轴、broad learned priors 为互补成分，并设计刻画 embodiment gap 与迁移性能的评测。
Result: 论文为观点与研究议程性质，给出的判断是工程化对应关系虽有即时实际收益但其假设限制长期迁移范围；未给出实验数字或基准对比。
Conclusion: 跨具身智能应通过随经验扩展的通用表征与具身多样性扩展来积累学习，评测需直接度量具身差距与迁移性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pose-Aware Multimodal Automatic Tagging for Greek Traditional Music
papers.abstract_en: Automatic tagging is a core task in Music Information Retrieval (MIR), yet most tagging systems exploit only audio. Live music performance is inherently multimodal, as semantic labels such as instruments, regional styles, and dance forms are encoded simultaneously across acoustic, visual, and embodied performance cues. This is especially true of culturally specific repertoires such as Greek traditional music, which remain underrepresented in MIR benchmarks. In this paper, we investigate whether the use of dancer pose provides complementary information for automatic tagging in Greek traditional music beyond audio. Using the Lyra dataset, we extend prior audio-only work by extracting aligned video features and pose-derived skeleton streams, enabling an experimental setting for multimodal auto-tagging. We further introduce an automated pipeline for extracting primary-dancer skeleton sequences from in-the-wild dance footage, combining dance-scene detection, multi-person tracking, dancer selection, pose estimation, and quality filtering. We compare unimodal, all bimodal combinations, and trimodal systems using multiple fusion strategies. Audio remains the strongest single modality (AST: macro ROC-AUC 0.821), while skeletons, though weak in isolation, enhance performance through multimodal fusion. The best trimodal system improves macro ROC-AUC by about 4 percentage points over the strongest audio baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在希腊传统音乐自动标注 (automatic tagging) 中引入舞者姿态骨架流，与音频、视频特征做多模态融合；音频仍是最强单模态 (AST macro ROC-AUC 0.821)，骨架单独很弱，但最佳三模态系统比最强音频基线高约 4 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有音乐标注系统几乎只用音频，而现场表演的乐器、地域风格、舞蹈形式同时编码在声学、视觉与身体动作线索中；希腊传统音乐这类文化特定曲目在 MIR benchmark 中代表性不足。
Method: 在 Lyra 数据集上扩展既有纯音频工作，抽取对齐的视频特征与姿态骨架流；另提出一条自动流水线，从野外舞蹈影像中提取主舞者骨架序列，依次做舞蹈场景检测、多人跟踪、舞者选择、姿态估计与质量过滤；比较单模态、全部双模态组合与三模态系统及多种融合策略。
Result: 音频为最强单模态，AST macro ROC-AUC 0.821；骨架单独表现弱，但经多模态融合提升性能；最佳三模态系统 macro ROC-AUC 比最强音频基线提高约 4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 舞者姿态对希腊传统音乐自动标注提供超出音频的互补信息，价值主要通过融合而非单模态使用体现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Localized 12-hour Wave Over Alaska: Leveraging Meridional Wind Measurements From the Sodium Lidar
papers.abstract_en: The 12-h wave in meridional winds in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere (MLT) during the solar minimum 2018-2019 Arctic winter is investigated using sodium lidar observations at Poker Flat Research Range (PFRR), Chatanika, Alaska (64N,147W). Nightly 12-h wave amplitudes increased significantly during December-January, with amplitudes exceeding 130 m/s above 97 km on several days. This was more than double the 12-h wave amplitudes observed outside this time period. Meteor radar winds over Chatanika also showed significant increase in meridional wind 12-h wave amplitudes at altitudes between 82 and 97 km during this time period with lower amplitudes than lidar measurements. The strong variation in 12-h wave amplitudes was not correlated with SME index, though the largest amplitudes coincided with the sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) in early January. Measurements were compared to a seasonal WACCM-X model run and four days of HIAMCM. For the four dates of available HIAMCM data, 12-h wave amplitudes over Chatanika were found to be similar between both HIAMCM and WACCM-X and the lidar below 97 km, with amplitudes measured by lidar exceeding the models at altitudes between 97-105 km. All measurements followed a similar seasonal trend with increasing amplitudes at the end of December/early January. Fits of SW2 from WACCM-X show the SW2 tidal amplitude following similar seasonal trends to 12-h wave measurements. These high-resolution lidar measurements indicate that localized 12-h wave amplitudes are larger than previously reported by studies using meteor radar measurements.

papers.title: Local Evidence and Geometric Readout Repair in Trained GNNs
papers.abstract_en: Many node-classification GNNs apply a linear classifier to a nonnegative mixture of local messages. An error can reflect either poor mixture weights or a reachable logit set poorly positioned for the classifier. We separate these causes with an exact-mass linear program and two learned post-hoc repairs. Every reweighted prediction has an equivalent centered logit translation, but only translations in a message-induced displacement set are realizable by reweighting. Across eight datasets, eight GNN backbones, and ten splits, mean accuracy rises from 62.6% for the frozen models to 63.8% with reweighting and 65.3% with set-conditioned translation. A parameter-matched node-only translator reaches 64.6%, showing that translation explains most of the gain while the message set supplies a smaller additional benefit. Although oracle reweighting can correct many errors, label-free reweighting captures little of this potential: local evidence is often present but hard to select, and relaxing the evidence constraint is more effective than learning within it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把节点分类 GNN 的错误拆成两类：混合权重选错，或线性分类器面对的可达 logit 集位置不对。用精确质量线性规划 (exact-mass LP) 分离两者，再做两种事后修复：重加权与受消息位移集约束的 logit 平移。八数据集、八个 GNN backbone、十个 split 上平均准确率从冻结模型 62.6% 升到重加权 63.8%、集合约束平移 65.3%；作者主张平移解释了大部分增益，且放松证据约束比在约束内学习更有效。
Motivation: 节点分类 GNN 的线性读出错误来源混杂：可能是局部消息混合权重选错，也可能是可达 logit 集相对分类器位置不佳，二者此前无法区分，修复也无从对症。
Method: 用精确质量线性规划把每个预测分解为混合权重与 logit 位置两种成因，并给出两个学习式事后修复：重加权，以及受消息诱导位移集 (message-induced displacement set) 约束的中心化 logit 平移；核心等价性是每次重加权都对应一个中心化平移，但只有落在位移集内的平移才可由重加权实现。
Result: 在八个数据集、八个 GNN backbone、十个 split 上，平均准确率：冻结模型 62.6%，重加权 63.8%，集合约束平移 65.3%，参数量对齐的 node-only translator 64.6%。oracle 重加权可纠正大量错误，而无标签重加权只捕获其中一小部分潜力。
Conclusion: 读出错误主要由 logit 位置而非混合权重解释，消息集合只提供额外的较小增益；局部证据常在但难选中，放松证据约束比在约束内学习更有效。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Policy-as-Skill: Governed LLM Decision Support with Evidence, Deterministic Control, and Audit
papers.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly use LLMs for policy, compliance, risk, and operational decision support, requiring evidence validation, review routing, version control, and auditability. We introduce Policy-as-Skill (PaS), a modular runtime that packages these functions as executable, versioned policy capabilities. Thirteen methods are evaluated with a fixed Gemma4 backend on 600 development tasks. PaS+Audit achieves 53.8% exact accuracy, macro-F1 0.346, review F1 0.854, citation precision 1.000, policy-reference recall 0.984, and audit completeness 1.000, outperforming LLM+RAG on most governance and review metrics. Deterministic control raises aggregate accuracy to 61.2% but is strongly task dependent, supporting selective rather than universal rule-based intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Policy-as-Skill (PaS)，把证据校验、审阅路由、版本控制与审计打包成可执行、可版本化的策略能力模块，配固定 Gemma4 后端在 600 个开发任务上评测 13 种方法。PaS+Audit exact accuracy 53.8%、macro-F1 0.346、review F1 0.854、citation precision 1.000、policy-reference recall 0.984、audit completeness 1.000，多数治理与审阅指标优于 LLM+RAG；加入确定性控制后总准确率升到 61.2%，但强依赖任务，只支持选择性而非普遍的规则干预。
Motivation: 组织用 LLM 做政策、合规、风险与运营决策支持时，需要证据校验、审阅路由、版本控制与可审计性，而这些治理功能缺少可执行、可版本化的封装方式。
Method: PaS 是模块化运行时，把上述治理功能封装为可执行、可版本化的策略能力 (policy capabilities)；评测固定 Gemma4 后端，比较 13 种方法在 600 个开发任务上的表现，其中 PaS+Audit 变体叠加审计模块，另有确定性控制 (deterministic control) 变体。
Result: PaS+Audit 在 600 个开发任务上取得 exact accuracy 53.8%、macro-F1 0.346、review F1 0.854、citation precision 1.000、policy-reference recall 0.984、audit completeness 1.000，多数治理与审阅指标优于 LLM+RAG；确定性控制把总准确率提到 61.2%，但效果强依赖任务。
Conclusion: 把治理功能做成可执行策略能力并叠加审计，可在多数治理指标上胜过 LLM+RAG；确定性规则干预应按任务选择性启用，而非普遍套用。

papers.title: Crossflow: Prefill-Decode Elasticity for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: As serving capacity demand surpasses that of training, serving efficiency becomes increasingly important. Prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregation improves serving efficiency through specialization and isolation of the two phases. These benefits rest on a static partitioning. Phase demand, however, is not static. We observe that in a large LLM fleet the ratio of uncached input to output tokens has peak-to-mean ratios up to 4.7x at minute timescales, and that in a public agentic trace the hourly ratio spans a median 24.5x within a single day, while reassigning a replica takes tens of minutes. Agentic traffic sharpens the mismatch. Sizing each pool at its ninety-fifth percentile leaves up to 17% of cluster capacity unused; sizing below it converts the same imbalance into queueing and unrealized throughput. We present Crossflow, which makes this boundary elastic without changing node roles. Each decode node publishes a short-lived, revocable lease that bounds local-prefill compute, KV capacity, transfer work, and projected output. Across public and internal traces, Crossflow improves token throughput by 16.2-17.4% on geometric mean over static P/D, and by up to 43.4% at high load, while reducing mean TTFT at every evaluated point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Crossflow 让 P/D 分离的 LLM 服务在不改节点角色的前提下弹性跨界：每个 decode 节点发布短期可撤销租约，约束本地 prefill 算力、KV 容量、传输量与预计输出。在公开与内部 trace 上，token 吞吐相对静态 P/D 几何平均提升 16.2–17.4%，高负载下最高 43.4%，且各评估点平均 TTFT 均下降。
Motivation: LLM 服务容量需求已超过训练，P/D 分离靠静态分区获得收益，但流量相位需求并不静态：大型 LLM 集群中未缓存输入与输出 token 之比在分钟尺度峰值均值比达 4.7x，公开 agentic trace 中该比值单日内小时中位跨度 24.5x，而重分配一个 replica 需数十分钟。
Method: Crossflow 不改变节点角色，由每个 decode 节点发布短期、可撤销的租约 (lease)，在租约中界定本地 prefill 计算、KV 容量、传输工作量与预计输出的上界，从而让 prefill-decode 边界弹性化；在公开与内部 trace 上与静态 P/D 对比。
Result: 按 95 分位给每个池定容会留下最多 17% 集群容量闲置，定容过低则把同一失衡转成排队与吞吐损失。Crossflow 相对静态 P/D 在 token 吞吐上几何平均提升 16.2–17.4%，高负载下最高提升 43.4%，并在每个评估点都降低平均 TTFT。
Conclusion: 静态 P/D 分区在 agentic 流量下必然在容量闲置与排队之间二选一，用 decode 节点发布的可撤销租约把边界做弹性即可同时拿到更高吞吐和更低 TTFT。

papers.title: Pro-Bench: Prompt-Robust Open-Vocabulary Visual Grounding Across Real-World Heterogeneous Environments
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary visual grounding enables robots to localise task-relevant entities from natural-language queries without dependence on predefined perceptual taxonomies. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on short category labels and web-scraped imagery, leaving it unclear whether open-vocabulary models can robustly ground diverse queries and visual conditions under real deployments. We introduce \textbf{Pro-Bench}, a prompt-conditioned benchmark for open-vocabulary visual grounding in heterogeneous, real-world environments. Pro-Bench includes $13k+$ RGB frames from independent robotic domains (subterranean, industrial, indoor, outdoor, urban), with $74.5k$ manual instance annotations and $515$ target queries covering categorical, attributive, relational, affordance, state, part-whole, negative, and compositional semantics. We benchmarked $16$ open-vocabulary model configurations in strict zero-shot inference, measuring localisation accuracy across IoU thresholds, end-to-end inference latency, prompt-induced performance variation, and target recovery consistency. Our results show that prompt-robustness is strongly architecture-dependent. Most model configurations ($10/16$) perform best with short category labels, whereas free-form queries yield the highest accuracy for only one. Moreover, similar aggregate mAP can conceal substantial differences in consistent target recovery across reformulations. Pro-Bench enables systematic evaluation of these gaps and supports prompt-robust visual grounding. Pro-Bench: https://pro-bench.github.io/.

papers.title: Quantifying the Occult: A Comparative Study of Hindu and Buddhist Deities Using Machine Learning Methods
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a dual-matrix computational architecture to mathematically quantify the morphological and theological divergence of 196 Hindu and Vajrayana Buddhist esoteric deities. Physical morphology is evaluated via a discrete Gower distance matrix enhanced by a novel "Cardinality Weighting" algorithm, while theological function is mapped via dense vector embeddings generated from Large Language Model (LLM) semantic expansions, explicitly utilized as a synthetic proxy to mitigate circular reasoning. The multi-modal topological projections provide algorithmic validation of "iconographic camouflage", demonstrating how distinct visual forms structurally obscure shared cross-tradition functions. Furthermore, I computationally model the "Atin Effect" - serving simultaneously as a psychological observation of sequential cognitive bias and a machine learning benchmark - demonstrating how high-cardinality esoteric anchors (e.g., a veena or a severed head) override systemic theological disparities to mathematically cluster orthodox and Tantric entities. Cross-tradition spatial analysis establishes that the highest esoteric manifestations, such as the Hindu Chinnamasta and the Buddhist Chinnamunda, share a near-identical mathematical coordinate across both visual ($D_G = 0.288$) and semantic ($D_C = 0.068$) boundaries, indicating a 1:1 esoteric transfer. By open-sourcing this architecture, I provide a scalable, unsupervised machine learning tool for Digital Humanities scholars and comparative theologians to rigorously map latent structural continuities across qualitative cultural corpora.
papers.comment: Under peer review at Digital Scholarship in the Humanities
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用双矩阵架构量化 196 尊印度教与金刚乘佛教密教神祇的形态与神学差异：Gower 距离矩阵加 Cardinality Weighting 度量形体，LLM 语义扩展生成的稠密向量嵌入度量神学功能。跨传统空间分析显示 Chinnamasta 与 Chinnamunda 在视觉边界 D_G=0.288、语义边界 D_C=0.068 上几乎重合，指示 1:1 的密教传播。
Motivation: 比较神学与数字人文缺少对跨传统潜在结构连续性的严格、可扩展的量化手段，定性研究易陷循环论证。
Method: 构建双矩阵计算架构：形态用离散 Gower 距离矩阵加新提出的 Cardinality Weighting 算法；神学功能用 LLM 语义扩展生成稠密向量嵌入，作为缓解循环推理的合成代理；再做多模态拓扑投影，并计算建模 Atin Effect（序列认知偏差，同时作为 ML benchmark）。
Result: 覆盖 196 尊 Hindu 与 Vajrayana Buddhist 密教神祇；Chinnamasta 与 Chinnamunda 的视觉距离 D_G=0.288、语义距离 D_C=0.068，近乎同一数学坐标；高基数密教锚点（如 veena 或 severed head）在数学上把正统与 Tantric 实体聚到一起，压过系统性神学差异。
Conclusion: iconographic camouflage 可被算法验证：不同视觉形态在结构上遮蔽共享的跨传统功能，最高密教显现呈 1:1 对应；该架构以开源、无监督方式供数字人文与比较神学映射定性文化语料的潜在结构连续性。

papers.title: The Gaussian Is Enough: Flow-Matching Priors Do Not Help When Fine-Tuning Large Behavior Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern robot imitation learning increasingly relies on generative policies based on diffusion or flow-matching models, which generate actions by transforming samples from a prior distribution. A key question is whether the choice of prior matters. Replacing the standard Gaussian with a closer-to-target, non-Gaussian prior has been shown to substantially improve performance when training from scratch. A natural next step is to ask whether these gains transfer to fine-tuning pretrained Large Behavior Models (LBMs) such as LBM 1.0, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T~N1.5, where one might expect even larger gains. Surprisingly, we find that this is not the case, except possibly at very low fine-tuning data fractions. Across over 100K simulation rollouts spanning all three aforementioned LBMs on 40+ tasks in two simulation platforms, and 1250 hardware rollouts on five bimanual manipulation tasks, non-Gaussian priors that are demonstrably closer to the target yield statistically indistinguishable or worse fine-tuning performance than a standard Gaussian prior. Diagnostic analyses suggest why: fine-tuned imitation learning policies converge to similar action predictions across priors, despite their fine-tuned encoder embeddings diverging substantially from the pretrained embeddings and each other. A learning-rate ablation further confirms that encoder training is the dominant factor in fine-tuning performance, substantially outweighing the effect of prior choice. We conclude with concrete directions for future research on when and why learned priors might still matter in fine-tuning. Project page: https://cxu-tri.github.io/non_gaussian_FT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在微调 Large Behavior Model（LBM 1.0、π0.5、GR00T N1.5）时，把扩散/流匹配策略的高斯先验换成更贴近目标的非高斯先验并不带来收益：超过 100K 次仿真 rollout（40+ 任务、两个仿真平台）与 1250 次硬件 rollout（五个双臂操作任务）显示，非高斯先验的微调性能与高斯先验统计上不可区分甚至更差，仅在极低微调数据比例下可能例外。诊断分析指向原因：微调性能由 encoder 训练主导，学习率消融证实其影响远大于先验选择。
Motivation: 从零训练时换用更接近目标的非高斯先验能显著提升扩散/流匹配生成策略，人们自然预期微调预训练 LBM 时收益会更大；这一预期是否成立此前没有检验。
Method: 在 LBM 1.0、π0.5、GR00T N1.5 三个预训练 Large Behavior Model 上微调，对比标准高斯先验与可证明更接近目标的非高斯先验；辅以诊断分析（比较各先验下的动作预测与微调后 encoder embedding 相对预训练 embedding 的偏移）和学习率消融。
Result: 超过 100K 次仿真 rollout、覆盖三个 LBM、两个仿真平台上的 40+ 任务，加上五个双臂操作任务的 1250 次硬件 rollout：非高斯先验的微调性能与高斯先验统计上不可区分或更差，仅极低微调数据比例下可能例外。各先验下微调后动作预测趋于一致，而 encoder embedding 彼此及相对预训练 embedding 明显发散；学习率消融显示 encoder 训练是微调性能的主导因素，影响远超先验选择。
Conclusion: 微调 LBM 时先验分布的形状基本无关紧要，收益来自 encoder 的训练本身；学习先验是否仍有价值，取决于何时为何起作用这一待解问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Does Graph Structure Earn Its Place in Microservice Root-Cause Analysis? A Controlled Study on RCAEval, and What the Benchmark Was Really Measuring
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks dominate recent work on microservice root-cause analysis, yet recent results question whether the graph contributes. Those results compare whole pipelines, so when a flat model wins one cannot tell whether structure is useless or redundant. We run the comparison they imply on RCAEval: three learned arms with identical features, optimiser, validation split, early-stopping rule and scoring head, in which a single term separates the graph arms. Across two RCAEval benchmarks, two topology sources and four regimes we find no reliable graph-specific effect: in-distribution the graph model leads the conventional flat model by 0.003 Avg@5 (p = 0.844, n = 6 disjoint folds). Auditing the pipeline surfaced two benchmark properties that condition any result on it. RCAEval injects faults into only five services per system while exposing 12 to 70 in telemetry, and the headline metric is Avg@5: a ranker reading no telemetry at all places the true culprit in the top five on 99.7 percent of held-out incidents, scoring Avg@5 0.488. That prior, not the uniform-random 0.137, is the honest in-distribution floor, and it collapses to 0.192 across systems. The second property is a non-uniform column schema that silently zeroes telemetry for most RE1 cases. We reproduce a published baseline, BARO, RCAEval's own reference implementation; on the one system with a clean schema it reaches similar aggregate accuracy to our heuristic, within 0.004, under a different scoring rule. The audit motivated a new model. PSC-GRCA separates a candidate score into a system prior, telemetry evidence and a centred graph residual, and reaches mean Avg@5 0.915 against 0.864 for the flat baseline, while its ablations locate most of the gain in the prior term rather than the graph. We close with a twelve-item checklist for graph-versus-flat ablation studies, distilled from sixty-two recorded defects.
papers.comment: 17 pages; preprint published at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22832168
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RCAEval 上做受控消融：三个学习臂只差一个图结构项，结果没有可靠的图特异效应——同分布下图模型仅比平坦模型高 0.003 Avg@5（p = 0.844，n = 6 个不相交折）。审计发现基准本身在主导结论：不读任何遥测的排序器也能在 99.7% 的留出事件中把真凶排进前五（Avg@5 0.488），远高于均匀随机的 0.137；新模型 PSC-GRCA 把分数拆成系统先验、遥测证据与居中图残差，Avg@5 0.915 对平坦基线 0.864，但消融显示增益主要来自先验项而非图。
Motivation: 微服务根因分析 (RCA) 中 GNN 主导近期工作，但已有结果质疑图结构是否真的起作用；那些比较是整条流水线的对比，平坦模型赢了也分不清图是无用还是冗余，因此需要只差一个图项的受控比较。
Method: 在 RCAEval 上跑三个学习臂，特征、优化器、验证划分、早停规则与打分头完全一致，仅一个项区分图臂；跨两个 RCAEval 基准、两种拓扑来源、四种 regime，并审计流水线（故障注入服务数 vs 遥测列、Avg@5 指标、列 schema），复现基线 BARO（RCAEval 官方参考实现），再据此提出 PSC-GRCA，把候选分数分解为系统先验、遥测证据与居中图残差。
Result: 同分布下图模型 Avg@5 仅领先平坦模型 0.003（p = 0.844，n = 6 个不相交折），无可靠图特异效应；每个系统只向 5 个服务注入故障而遥测暴露 12–70 个，不读遥测的排序器在 99.7% 留出事件中把真凶排进前五，Avg@5 0.488（均匀随机为 0.137），跨系统塌到 0.192；RE1 多数 case 因非均匀列 schema 被静默置零遥测；BARO 在 schema 干净的那个系统上与启发式聚合精度差 0.004（打分规则不同）；PSC-GRCA 平均 Avg@5 0.915 对平坦基线 0.864，消融定位增益主要在先验项；结论附 12 项图 vs 平坦消融检查表，源自 62 个记录缺陷。
Conclusion: 图结构在 RCAEval 上没有可分辨的独立贡献，头条 Avg@5 主要被故障注入先验与列 schema 这类基准属性驱动；做图 vs 平坦消融应先审计基准先验与 schema，并按 12 项检查表执行。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ChipMEM: Verification-Grounded Memory for EDA Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents use Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools to generate and revise register-transfer-level (RTL) designs under synthesis and verification feedback. Recent methods learn from this feedback by distilling reusable skills from execution traces or by training on rewards derived from EDA-tools. Both methods are typically evaluated on the tasks that produced the experience. Repeated access to benchmark feedback on the same task can reward task-specific revision rather than creating reusable knowledge that transfers. We introduce ChipMEM, a verification-grounded memory layer for EDA agents. It combines cross-task procedural memory with within-trajectory statistical guidance. Its procedural component distills and stores a skill only after it passes synthesis, simulation, or formal checks, rather than relying on model self-assessments. A Bayesian component maintains hierarchical Beta estimates over tool-call outcomes and ranks recovery strategies that succeeded under comparable errors. A common adapter applies the same memory interface to RTL optimization and testbench-generation agents while preserving each domain's tools and acceptance criteria. We measure performance on training tasks and evaluate whether learned skills transfer to unseen tasks. On RTLRewriter-Bench, under matched model and tool settings, ChipMEM produces equivalence-passing outputs on 39/54 scored designs versus 35/54 without memory; on the 49-design short suite, mean area improvement is 8.69% versus 5.66%. On held-out CVDP tasks, ChipMEM with a frozen procedural library achieves 20/20 accepted outcomes versus 18/20 without memory in a single evaluation per setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChipMEM 为 LLM 的 EDA agent 加一层以验证为准的记忆：技能只有通过 synthesis、simulation 或 formal check 才入库，并用分层 Beta 统计对工具调用结果建模来排序恢复策略。在 RTLRewriter-Bench 上等价通过 39/54（无记忆 35/54），49 个设计的短套件平均面积改进 8.69%（对照 5.66%），held-out CVDP 上冻结程序库达 20/20（对照 18/20）。
Motivation: 从执行轨迹蒸馏技能或用 EDA 工具奖励训练的方法，通常只在产生经验的同一任务上评测；反复接触同一任务的 benchmark 反馈会奖励任务特定的修补，而不是可迁移到新任务的可复用知识。
Method: ChipMEM 由跨任务程序记忆与轨迹内统计引导组成：程序组件只在技能通过 synthesis、simulation 或 formal check 后才蒸馏存储，不依赖模型自评；Bayesian 组件对工具调用结果维护分层 Beta 估计，在同类错误下排序曾成功的恢复策略；统一 adapter 把同一记忆接口同时用于 RTL optimization 与 testbench-generation agent，并保留各自的工具与验收标准。
Result: 在 RTLRewriter-Bench、模型与工具设置对齐的条件下，ChipMEM 在 54 个计分设计中产出 39 个等价通过的输出，无记忆为 35/54；在 49 个设计的短套件上平均面积改进 8.69%，对照 5.66%；在 held-out CVDP 任务上，配冻结程序库的 ChipMEM 每个设置单次评测即达 20/20 验收，无记忆为 18/20。
Conclusion: 只有通过工具验证才入库、并按历史成功率排序恢复策略的记忆，能把 EDA agent 的经验从训练任务迁移到未见任务，且在 RTL 优化与 testbench 生成两个域共用同一接口。

papers.title: Propose, Don't Judge: An Anytime-Valid Referee for LLM Agents That Mine Investment Factors
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents now run the whole of quantitative factor research: they propose investment factors, backtest them, select the survivors and retire them. We ask which of those jobs an agent should keep. Our answer is governed self-evolution: the agent may propose, and a frozen statistical referee that the agent cannot touch must judge. The referee scores each candidate only on market outcomes revealed after submission, by betting, so its false-discovery guarantee holds at every stopping time for any proposal policy. We cross three proposers (a script, a bandit and a language model) with this referee and with three deliberately leaky ones, in a synthetic world with planted truth, a probe-authoring environment and a ten-year walk-forward on the CSI 500. Who judges sets the number of false admissions: the frozen referee admits 5-11 times fewer sub-threshold factors than the leaky referees under a scripted proposer, and no proposer closes that gap. Who proposes sets the yield: the language model beats the script, matches the bandit, and adds the one capability a bandit lacks, writing its own diagnostic probes. The certificate's price is time: an admitted true factor waits about 500 trading days, and the certified portfolio's Sharpe ratio therefore trails an ungated one. Judging belongs to the procedure; proposing and instrument-making belong to the agent.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 7 figures, 26 tables. JEL: G11, G14, C58
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把量化因子研究中的评审环节从 LLM agent 手里拿走，交给一个 agent 无法改动的冻结统计裁判：裁判只用提交后才揭示的市场结果、以 betting 方式打分，使假发现保证在任意停止时刻、对任意提案策略都成立。在合成真值世界、probe 编写环境与 CSI 500 十年 walk-forward 上，冻结裁判比三个有泄漏的裁判少放行 5–11 倍的次阈值因子，且换更强的提案者也补不上这个差距。
Motivation: LLM agent 现在包办因子提出、回测、筛选与淘汰全流程，自我修改的评审会让假发现控制失效，需要明确哪些环节该留给 agent、哪些必须冻结。
Method: 提出 governed self-evolution：agent 只负责提出，评审由不可触碰的冻结统计裁判执行，裁判仅依据提交后揭示的市场结果以 betting 打分；实验交叉三种提案者（脚本、bandit、语言模型）与该裁判及三个刻意有泄漏的裁判，环境包括含植入真值的合成世界、probe 编写环境和 CSI 500 十年 walk-forward。
Result: 在脚本提案者下，冻结裁判放行的次阈值因子比泄漏裁判少 5–11 倍，且任何提案者都无法缩小该差距；语言模型提案者胜过脚本、追平 bandit，并额外具备 bandit 没有的自行编写诊断 probe 的能力。代价是时间：被接纳的真实因子需等待约 500 个交易日，认证组合的 Sharpe ratio 因此落后于无门控组合。
Conclusion: 评审属于流程本身，提出与工具制作属于 agent：把裁判冻结并只用事后市场结果打分，才能保住任意停止时刻的假发现保证，代价是真实因子约 500 个交易日的等待与更低的 Sharpe。

papers.title: EduBehaviors: Assertion-based Schemas for Auditable Coding of Educational Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have allowed the rapid deployment of pedagogical annotations corresponding to constructs of interest, allowing a natural language interface for generating classifications on a conversational dataset. However due to the opaque nature of LLM reasoning, we have no verifiable, mechanistic insight into why a model chose a label for an utterance. We introduce the EduBehaviors framework, an interpretable, scalable approach to annotating educational data that uses LLMs to measure repeated observable behaviors relevant to many constructs of interest and then learns a classifier for the construct based on these observable behaviors. We evaluate the framework on the TalkMoves dataset, predicting the Teacher TalkMoves labels. Our best configuration results in a macro-F1 of 0.673 and 0.688 Cohen's kappa, proving competitive with direct prompting approaches. In addition, we release EduBehaviors Toolkit, two tools allowing researchers to operationalize the EduBehaviors framework in their own data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EduBehaviors 用 LLM 先把教育对话标注成可观察、可审计的重复行为，再用这些行为训练分类器预测构念标签，从而绕开 LLM 直接打标签时不可解释的推理过程。在 TalkMoves 数据集上预测 Teacher TalkMoves 标签，最佳配置 macro-F1 0.673、Cohen's kappa 0.688，与直接提示 (direct prompting) 方案相当。
Motivation: LLM 教学标注部署很快，但其推理不透明，无法给出模型为何给某句话打某个标签的可验证机制性解释。
Method: 两阶段框架：先用 LLM 测量与多种构念相关的可观察重复行为，再基于这些行为学习构念分类器；同时发布 EduBehaviors Toolkit 两个工具供研究者在自有数据上落地。
Result: 在 TalkMoves 数据集上预测 Teacher TalkMoves 标签，最佳配置 macro-F1 0.673、Cohen's kappa 0.688，与直接提示方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 用作可观察行为的测量器而非最终判官，能在保持与直接提示相当的精度的同时给出可审计的标注依据。
