papers.title: Math Reasoning in LLMs is Organized by Approach, Not Topic
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning benchmarks are typically organized by topic, but language models may organize their internal computation by reusable reasoning approach instead. In this paper, we investigate whether open math-capable LLMs organize internally by topical sub-skill or by reasoning approach, and we present evidence that the approach is the key. We introduce a generation-replay protocol: a model first generates a solution, after which we replay the exact prompt-plus-generation trajectory and extract activation-importance signatures over the reasoning tokens. We cluster these signatures without supervision across eight models and five mathematical reasoning sources, then evaluate the recovered structure with structural, semantic, and intervention tests. Across all 40 model-source cells, the recovered clusters outperform matched-size random baselines. Two independent frontier-LLM judges find approach-level coherence in 77-82% of real clusters versus 6-11% in within-source controls, and topic-pure clusters usually receive labels finer than the topic itself. In approach-controlled prompting, changing the requested reasoning approach shifts cluster assignment in seven of eight model conditions, whereas paraphrases largely preserve it. These results indicate that math-capable LLMs organize internal mathematical computation by reasoning approach rather than benchmark topic. The implication is that topic-stratified benchmarks and topic-balanced training corpora can still miss the axis that matters: even deliberately topic-balanced corpora may remain imbalanced over reasoning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用生成-回放 (generation-replay) 协议提取 LLM 在推理 token 上的激活重要性签名，无监督聚类后发现数学 LLM 的内部计算按可复用的推理方式而非题目主题组织：8 个模型 × 5 个数学来源共 40 个 cell 中聚类均优于同规模随机基线，前沿模型评审在真实聚类中判定 77–82% 具方法级一致性（同源对照仅 6–11%），且在 8 个模型条件中的 7 个里，改变要求的推理方式会移动聚类归属，而改写措辞基本不变。
Motivation: 数学推理基准与训练语料按主题划分，但 LLM 内部可能按推理方式组织计算；若主题均衡的语料在推理方式上仍失衡，按主题分层的评测与数据配比就会漏掉真正起作用的轴。
Method: 提出 generation-replay 协议：模型先生成解答，再回放该 prompt-plus-generation 轨迹，抽取推理 token 上的激活重要性签名；对签名做无监督聚类，跨 8 个模型与 5 个数学推理来源，并用结构、语义与干预三类测试评估恢复出的结构，另设同规模随机基线与同源对照。
Result: 全部 40 个 model-source cell 中，恢复的聚类均超过同规模随机基线；两个独立前沿 LLM 评审在真实聚类中给出 77–82% 的方法级一致性，同源对照仅 6–11%；主题纯净聚类的标签通常比主题本身更细；在 approach-controlled prompting 下，8 个模型条件中有 7 个在改变所要求的推理方式后聚类归属发生转移，而改写基本保持归属。
Conclusion: 数学能力 LLM 的内部数学计算按推理方式而非基准主题组织，因此按主题分层的基准与主题均衡的训练语料仍可能在推理方式这一轴上失衡。

papers.title: EMA: Elastic and Performance Transparent Memory Across GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-GPU servers have become the standard building block of modern data centers, providing aggregated capacity through high-bandwidth interconnects. At the same time, workloads such as LLM inference exhibit highly dynamic memory demands, which can cause one GPU to exhaust its local memory while others remain underutilized. This mismatch motivates a model of elastic resource sharing across GPUs. We present EMA, a memory sharing system that allows GPUs within a server to borrow and reclaim memory from each other, forming an elastic pool of capacity. EMA ensures performance transparency for both borrowers and lenders. For borrowers, prefetching hides remote access costs so that applications experience remote and local memory as indistinguishable in performance. For lenders, borrowed resources remain reclaimable on demand, guaranteeing that performance never falls below that of static partitioning. While our design focuses on memory, the same principle naturally extends to other GPU resources. Our evaluation shows that EMA improves individual user throughput by up to 52%, achieves 96% of the throughput of a system provisioned with 2X capacity, and maintains latency similar to the static local baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMA 让同一台多 GPU 服务器内的 GPU 相互借还显存，形成弹性显存池，并对借方与贷方同时保证性能透明：借方靠 prefetching 掩盖远程访问开销，使远程与本地显存在性能上不可区分；贷方被借走的资源可按需回收，性能不低于静态分区。评测中单用户吞吐最高提升 52%，达到 2X 容量配置系统吞吐的 96%，延迟与静态本地基线相当。
Motivation: LLM 推理等负载的显存需求高度动态，单 GPU 显存耗尽时同机其他 GPU 却闲置，静态分区无法匹配这种错配。
Method: EMA 是一个跨 GPU 的显存共享系统：GPU 之间可借入与回收显存组成弹性池；借方用 prefetching 隐藏远程访问成本，贷方的借出资源保持按需可回收，从而保证性能不低于静态分区；设计原则可推广到其他 GPU 资源。
Result: 单用户吞吐最高提升 52%；达到 2X 容量配置系统吞吐的 96%；延迟与静态本地基线相当。
Conclusion: 跨 GPU 弹性显存共享加 prefetching 可以在不牺牲任一方性能的前提下，把闲置显存转化为接近双倍容量配置的吞吐收益。

summary_sections.method: EMA 是一个跨 GPU 的显存共享系统：GPU 之间可借入与回收显存组成弹性池；借方用 prefetching 隐藏远程访问成本，贷方的借出资源保持按需可回收，从而保证性能不低于静态分区；设计原则可推广到其他 GPU 资源。
summary_sections.result: 单用户吞吐最高提升 52%；达到 2X 容量配置系统吞吐的 96%；延迟与静态本地基线相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨 GPU 弹性显存共享加 prefetching 可以在不牺牲任一方性能的前提下，把闲置显存转化为接近双倍容量配置的吞吐收益。

papers.title: Are Stated Reasoning Steps Causally Load-Bearing?
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that the reasoning a model writes reflects the computation that directly produces its answer. Previous faithfulness metrics have been predominantly behavioral, as they simply edit the reasoning text and observe the resulting answer. However, our methodology aims to measure faithfulness causally at the activation level, specifically on self-generated reasoning. Unlike previous causal audits, which measure degradation, our interventions carry a known predicted target. In this way, each patch should switch the answer to a specific counterfactual entity derivable by construction. Specifically, we use synthetic multi-hop lookup tasks (2-6 hops). We patch the residual stream at the token span where the model states each intermediate step with the corresponding activations from a counterfactual run. For Qwen3-4B, 76.9% +/- 2.8% of stated steps are causally load-bearing (CLB) at the most responsive mid-network layer (random-position null: 11.3%; patching the underlying prompt fact: 83%, so stated steps carry approximately 96% of the achievable effect). Moreover, the standard behavioral test on the same items yields 88.2%, which overstates causal faithfulness by 11.4 percentage points (item-matched; 111:14 discordant pairs, p < 1e-15) and, for the easiest items, by up to 20 percentage points. This gap also has a clear capability dimension. Qwen3-1.7B is far less causally faithful overall (54.8%), with its faithfulness collapsing as reasoning depth increases (68% at 2 hops to 30% at 6), while Qwen3-4B remains relatively flat. Although stated reasoning can be causally meaningful, standard behavioral tests tend to overestimate its causal faithfulness, particularly on easier examples where model reasoning appears most fluent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 2–6 跳合成查找任务上，用带已知反事实目标的激活级 patch 检验 CoT 步骤是否因果承载答案：Qwen3-4B 在最响应中层有 76.9%±2.8% 的陈述步骤为 CLB（随机位置 null 11.3%，patch 底层 prompt fact 83%，约承载可达效应的 96%），而标准行为测试给出 88.2%，高估 11.4 个百分点，最易样本高估达 20 个百分点。
Motivation: CoT 监控默认模型写出的推理就是产生答案的计算，但既有 faithfulness 指标基本是行为层面的（改文本看答案），无法证明步骤在激活层面因果起作用，且可能系统性高估可监控性。
Method: 在自生成推理上做因果干预：在模型陈述每个中间步骤的 token span 处，把 residual stream patch 成反事实运行的对应激活，干预携带可由构造推出的确定反事实实体；对照为随机位置 null 与 patch 底层 prompt fact，并与同题目的标准行为测试逐项配对比较。
Result: Qwen3-4B 在最响应中层 76.9%±2.8% 的陈述步骤为 CLB，随机位置 null 11.3%，patch prompt fact 83%，即约 96% 的可达效应；同题行为测试 88.2%，高估 11.4 个百分点（111:14 不一致配对，p < 1e-15），最易题目高估至多 20 个百分点。Qwen3-1.7B 整体仅 54.8%，随推理深度从 2 跳 68% 降到 6 跳 30%，Qwen3-4B 基本持平。
Conclusion: 陈述推理可以是因果有意义的，但标准行为测试系统性高估其因果忠实度，尤其在推理看似最流畅的简单样本上；因果忠实度还随模型能力与推理深度变化。

papers.title: Training Intelligent Voice Assistant Wakeup with Controllable Synthetic Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Wake word detection is a critical component of virtual assistants, serving as the gateway to seamless user interactions. This paper introduces a novel wake-up system that extends traditional direct keyword detection with contextual trigger detection. After an initial wake word activation, the system uses reasoning to distinguish between user commands and unrelated speech, ensuring efficient and context-aware engagement. We present a data generation architecture that produces a 62.3-hour corpus of controllable multi-speaker conversations containing direct invocations, contextual follow-ups, and non-addressed speech. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach across diverse synthetic conversational scenarios. We release the code, dataset and trained models to promote reproducibility and further advancements in intelligent assistant technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在传统唤醒词直接检测之上加入上下文触发检测：唤醒后用推理区分用户指令与无关语音，只在被真正对话时保持响应。可控合成数据架构生成 62.3 小时多说话人语料，覆盖直接唤醒、上下文追问与非指向语音；代码、数据集与模型全部开源。
Motivation: 纯关键词唤醒无法区分真正指令与背景中的无关说话，导致虚拟助手误触发或漏掉上下文追问。
Method: 提出两阶段唤醒系统：直接唤醒词检测后接上下文触发推理，判断后续语音是否为对助手的指令；配套可控合成对话数据生成架构，产出含直接调用、上下文追问、非指向语音的多说话人语料。
Result: 生成 62.3 小时可控多说话人合成语料；在多样合成对话场景上实验验证了该方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把上下文推理接在唤醒词之后可让助手按对话指向而非字面关键词决定是否响应，并以开源语料与模型支撑可复现的智能助手研究。

papers.title: An open benchmark for machine learning-based polymer property prediction
papers.abstract_en: Polymer property prediction lacks open, standardized benchmarks that enable rigorous comparison of machine-learning methods, with existing resources covering only a narrow fraction of polymer architectures, such as homopolymers. We introduce Polymer Benchmark 2026 (PolyBench26), an open dataset comprising nearly 250,000 polymer-property datapoints across eight physical properties, including data from experimental measurements, density functional theory, and molecular dynamics. The benchmark supports four evaluation tasks across homopolymers and alternating, random, and block copolymers: in-distribution property prediction, dataset-size scaling, repeat-unit complexity, and transfer to held-out polymer architectures. We compare language model, graph-based, and descriptor-based approaches and find graph-based models provide the lowest errors in property prediction, retain their advantage across the evaluated training-set sizes, and remain robust to increasing repeat-unit complexity. PolyBench26 provides a reproducible foundation for developing models for the increasingly complex polymer design space. The PolyBench26 benchmark is available open-source at https://github.com/rlearsch/PolymerBenchmark2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开放基准 PolyBench26，含近 250,000 个聚合物-性质数据点、8 项物理性质，覆盖均聚物与交替/无规/嵌段共聚物四类架构，设 4 项评测任务。对比语言模型、图模型与描述符方法后发现图模型误差最低，且在各训练集规模与更复杂重复单元下保持优势。
Motivation: 聚合物性质预测缺少开放、标准化的基准，现有资源只覆盖均聚物等很窄的一小部分聚合物架构，方法之间难以严格比较。
Method: PolyBench26 汇集实验测量、密度泛函理论 (DFT) 与分子动力学 (MD) 数据，支持分布内性质预测、数据集规模扩展、重复单元复杂度、向留出聚合物架构迁移四项任务；对比语言模型、图模型与描述符三类方法。
Result: 数据集近 250,000 个聚合物-性质数据点、8 项物理性质、4 项评测任务；图模型给出最低预测误差，其优势在所评测的各训练集规模下保持，并对递增的重复单元复杂度保持稳健。
Conclusion: 图模型是当前聚合物性质预测中误差最低且随数据量与架构复杂度最稳健的一类方法，PolyBench26 以开源形式提供可复现的评测基础。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Decomposed Subtasks
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related policy-gradient methods for training language model agents collapse an entire multi-turn rollout into a single scalar trajectory reward before it enters the policy update. When the task composes distinct skills, especially under sparse and delayed environmental feedback, this collapsing is lossy: the optimizer must implicitly infer which competency drove the outcome and how that should change behavior. We argue the right primitive is not a better scalar but a decomposition: trajectory reward should be split along subtasks before it enters the policy update. We introduce Reinforcement Learning with Decomposed Subtasks (RLDS), whose core is Subtask-Decomposed Advantage Estimation (SDAE): a replacement for the scalar GRPO advantage that splits trajectory reward into per-subtask shares on a fixed taxonomy, computes a group-relative advantage per subtask, and distributes per-token credit by weighting each subtask's advantage by its importance, concentrating it around the step where a reflection marks that subtask's execution as consequential. We evaluate on four agentic benchmarks: FrozenLake (sparse grid navigation), HotpotQA (multi-hop QA, one retrieval tool), ScienceWorld (long-horizon embodied science), and DeepResearch (long-form research, four tools, composite rubric reward). Heterogeneity diagnostics emitted during training show where decomposition pays off - gains scale with subtask heterogeneity, largest on the high-heterogeneity tasks ScienceWorld (+11.5 points, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]) and FrozenLake (+9.8 points, [+7.0, +12.8]), and within noise on HotpotQA and DeepResearch, where the diagnostics predicted little to recover. ScienceWorld is also more compute-efficient under RLDS than scalar GRPO (-10.9% wall-clock per step), as long rollouts amortize the fixed reflect-and-grade overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLDS 用 Subtask-Decomposed Advantage Estimation (SDAE) 替换 GRPO 的标量 advantage：把轨迹奖励按固定子任务分类拆成各子任务份额，逐子任务算 group-relative advantage，再按重要性加权分摊到 token 并集中在 reflection 标记为关键的步骤附近。在四个 agentic benchmark 上，增益随子任务异质性放大：高异质的 ScienceWorld +11.5 点（95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]）、FrozenLake +9.8 点（[+7.0, +12.8]），而诊断预测收益有限的 HotpotQA 与 DeepResearch 落在噪声内。
Motivation: GRPO 等 policy-gradient 方法把多轮 rollout 压成单一标量轨迹奖励，在任务由多种技能组成、环境反馈稀疏且延迟时是有损的：优化器须隐式推断是哪项能力驱动了结果。
Method: RLDS 的核心 SDAE 拆掉标量 advantage：按固定子任务 taxonomy 把轨迹奖励分成 per-subtask 份额，逐子任务做 group-relative advantage，再用子任务重要性加权分摊 per-token credit，并把 credit 集中在 reflection 判定该子任务执行产生后果的步骤附近。
Result: 在四个 agentic benchmark 上评测：ScienceWorld +11.5 点（paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]），FrozenLake +9.8 点（[+7.0, +12.8]），HotpotQA 与 DeepResearch 的差异落在噪声内；ScienceWorld 每步 wall-clock 比标量 GRPO 少 10.9%，因长 rollout 摊薄了固定的 reflect-and-grade 开销。
Conclusion: 奖励分解的收益随子任务异质性增长，异质性诊断可在训练中预测哪里值得拆分；在低异质任务上拆分不划算，长 rollout 则能摊掉额外开销。

papers.title: CVaR anchor regression protects against rare shifts
papers.abstract_en: We study prediction in new environments when training data contain rare, large shifts. Anchor regression penalizes the average of the squared mean residual across environments. It protects against shifts in an ellipsoid determined by the second moment of the training shifts. Covering rare shifts may therefore require a large penalty, expanding the ellipsoid in every direction and reducing accuracy on common environments. We propose CVaR anchor regression, which replaces the average of the squared mean residuals with a tail average. Unlike CVaR or GroupDRO applied directly to prediction risks, it does not give environments more weight solely because their noise levels are high. We prove an exact worst-case risk guarantee under a linear structural model that allows for heteroscedastic noise. For discrete environments, decreasing the CVaR tail fraction expands the robustness set from an ellipsoid to a scaled convex hull of the training shifts and their negatives. A separate parameter controls its scale. Examples show how the method can improve protection against rare shifts while retaining accuracy on common environments. We illustrate the method on New York City taxi data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CVaR anchor regression：把 anchor regression 中跨环境平均的平方平均残差换成尾部平均 (CVaR)，从而在不给高噪声环境额外权重的前提下扩大对罕见大偏移的保护。在线性结构模型下证明含异方差噪声的精确最坏情况风险保证；对离散环境，尾部分数下降使鲁棒集从椭球扩张为训练偏移及其相反数的缩放凸包，尺度由独立参数控制，示例显示能在保护罕见偏移的同时保住常见环境上的精度，并在纽约市出租车数据上说明方法。
Motivation: 训练数据含罕见大偏移时，anchor regression 要覆盖这些偏移就得加大惩罚，椭球在所有方向同时扩大，常见环境上的精度随之下降。
Method: 把 anchor regression 目标中跨环境的平方平均残差均值替换为 CVaR 尾部平均；与直接作用于预测风险的 CVaR 或 GroupDRO 不同，不因某环境噪声水平高就给它更大权重；用一个独立参数控制鲁棒集尺度。
Result: 在线性结构模型（允许异方差噪声）下证明精确最坏情况风险保证；对离散环境，减小 CVaR 尾部分数使鲁棒集从椭球扩张为训练偏移及其相反数的缩放凸包；示例表明可加强对罕见偏移的保护同时保留常见环境精度；在纽约市出租车数据上给出方法说明。
Conclusion: 对残差均值而非预测风险做尾部平均，可以在不牺牲常见环境精度的条件下扩大对罕见偏移的鲁棒保护，鲁棒集形状与尺度可由尾部分数和独立尺度参数分别控制。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 CVaR anchor regression：把 anchor regression 中跨环境平均的平方平均残差换成尾部平均 (CVaR)，从而在不给高噪声环境额外权重的前提下扩大对罕见大偏移的保护。在线性结构模型下证明含异方差噪声的精确最坏情况风险保证；对离散环境，尾部分数下降使鲁棒集从椭球扩张为训练偏移及其相反数的缩放凸包，尺度由独立参数控制，示例显示能在保护罕见偏移的同时保住常见环境上的精度，并在纽约市出租车数据上说明方法。

papers.title: WTF?! Simulation-Free Reinforcement Learning with Wasserstein-Tilted Flow Maps
papers.abstract_en: Reward fine-tuning aims to update a pre-trained flow-based generative model to improve the downstream reward of its generated samples. Existing methods typically formulate this problem as sampling from a reward-tilted distribution, the solution to a KL-regularized reward-maximization problem. Here, we introduce an optimal transport regularizer built directly from the pre-trained drift. Unlike KL reward tilting, the resulting objective transports individual samples toward higher reward rather than reweighting the base distribution. We show that the resulting problem is equivalent to a deterministic optimal control problem on the flow. Given a pre-trained flow map, this equivalence yields a simulation-free reinforcement learning algorithm for fine-tuning generative flows. We call the resulting framework Wasserstein-Tilted Flow Maps (WTF), the first end-to-end fine-tuning recipe native to flow maps. The output is a fine-tuned flow map that retains strong reward-aligned performance at few-step inference budgets without post-hoc distillation. Experiments on ImageNet-256 and text-to-image show that WTF achieves higher reward with comparable or higher diversity than baselines, while requiring up to $280\times$ less training compute. More broadly, we argue that accelerated samplers such as flow maps are essential infrastructure for efficient post-training, and that the dominant KL-regularized formulation is only one of many choices worth revisiting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WTF 用从预训练 drift 直接构造的 Wasserstein 正则替代 KL reward tilting，把奖励微调写成 flow 上的确定性最优控制，从而在不重训、不蒸馏的情况下直接微调 flow map。在 ImageNet-256 与文生图上，它以可比或更高的多样性拿到更高奖励，训练算力最多省 280 倍，且少步推理仍保持奖励对齐。
Motivation: 奖励微调通常被写成 KL 正则下的 reward-tilted 分布采样，只能重加权基分布、需要仿真式训练，且少步推理下奖励对齐常依赖事后蒸馏。
Method: 从预训练 drift 直接构造最优传输 (optimal transport) 正则，使目标把单个样本推向高奖励而非重加权；证明该问题等价于 flow 上的确定性最优控制问题，据此给出 simulation-free 的微调算法 Wasserstein-Tilted Flow Maps (WTF)，直接输出微调后的 flow map，无需 post-hoc distillation。
Result: 在 ImageNet-256 与 text-to-image 实验中，WTF 相对基线取得更高奖励且多样性相当或更高，训练算力需求最多降低 280 倍；输出在少步推理预算下仍保持强奖励对齐性能。
Conclusion: 作者主张 flow map 这类加速采样器是高效 post-training 的基础设施，并认为占主导的 KL 正则化表述只是众多可重访选择之一。

papers.title: LexLattice: Multilingual Extractive Summarization via Neural Cellular Automata on Document Hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: Faithfulness is a central concern in legal text summarization, which motivates extractive approaches that select verbatim content traceable to its source. Such methods typically rank paragraphs or other structural units in isolation, yet give little attention to consolidating evidence that is distributed across, and shares salience between, distant parts of a document. We introduce LexLattice, an extractive summarizer that reifies a legal act's hierarchy as a two-dimensional semantic lattice and consolidates over it with a masked 2D neural cellular automata before selection. LexLattice attains state-of-the-art ROUGE across all 24 languages of EUR-Lex-Sum in both multilingual and cross-lingual settings, surpassing instruction-tuned baselines with billions of parameters, despite concentrating all trainable capacity in a 1.8M parameter consolidator over a frozen multilingual encoder. A consolidator trained only on high-resource languages further transfers to unseen languages with near-lossless retention (0.99), indicating that the model operates on language-agnostic semantic geometry rather than surface form. Our results position explicit consolidation over document structure as a compact and traceable alternative to scale for multilingual legal summarization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LexLattice 把法律文本层级重构成二维语义格 (semantic lattice)，用 masked 2D 神经元胞自动机 (neural cellular automata) 在选句前跨远距离段落整合共享显著性的证据。在 EUR-Lex-Sum 全部 24 种语言的多语与跨语设置上取得 SOTA ROUGE，超过数十亿参数的 instruction-tuned 基线，而可训练容量只有冻结多语编码器之上的 1.8M 参数整合器；仅用高资源语言训练迁移到未见语言保留率 0.99。
Motivation: 抽取式摘要通常孤立地给段落等结构单元打分，无法整合分布在文档远处、彼此共享显著性的证据，而法律文本摘要又要求逐字可溯源的忠实性。
Method: 将法律法案的层级结构具体化为二维语义 lattice，在其上用 masked 2D 神经元胞自动机做跨单元证据整合，再进行抽取选择；可训练部分是 1.8M 参数的 consolidator，多语编码器保持冻结。
Result: 在 EUR-Lex-Sum 的 24 种语言上，多语与跨语设置均取得 SOTA ROUGE，超过数十亿参数的 instruction-tuned 基线；仅用高资源语言训练的 consolidator 迁移到未见语言时保留率 0.99。
Conclusion: 在文档结构上做显式整合，可以用 1.8M 参数的紧凑、可溯源方案替代以规模取胜的多语法律摘要路线，且模型依赖的是语言无关的语义几何而非表层形式。

papers.title: Loss Choice or Model Choice? The Role of Forecast Level in Cryptocurrency Volatility Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Volatility forecasts play a central role in financial risk management because their overall level and day-to-day movements affect downstream decisions. Most studies compare forecasting models while keeping the training loss fixed. Yet losses emphasise different errors and can target different properties of future volatility, so raw comparisons may combine persistent forecast-level differences with differences in daily forecast movements. This leaves unresolved whether the importance of loss choice comes mainly from the forecast level it targets or from differences that remain after level adjustment. We address this gap through a comparison of seven losses and five models across major cryptocurrencies. Validation-based alignment adjusts the forecast level before the raw and aligned forecasts are evaluated using statistical scores and one-day Value-at-Risk. Before alignment, marginal score variation is greater across losses. After alignment, model choice becomes the larger source of variation in the full five-model comparison, while cross-loss differences in VaR breach rates narrow substantially. Our contribution is a comprehensive evaluation of loss and model choice that shows why losses can appear so influential in raw comparisons and how this interpretation changes when forecast level and downstream risk are considered explicitly.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of ADMA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 加密货币波动率预测中，先用验证集把不同损失函数训练出的预测水平对齐再评分，跨损失的分数差异大幅缩小，五个模型之间的差异成为更大的变异来源，跨损失的 VaR 突破率差距也明显收窄。结论是：原始对比里损失函数看似影响很大，主要来自它锁定的预测水平，而非水平调整后仍存的日间波动差异。
Motivation: 多数研究固定训练损失只比模型，而不同损失强调不同误差、瞄准波动率的不同属性，导致原始评分把持久的水平差异与日间变动差异混在一起，无法判断损失选择的重要性究竟来自水平还是水平之外的残差。
Method: 在主流加密货币上比较七种损失函数与五个预测模型；用基于验证集的对齐 (validation-based alignment) 在评分前调整预测水平，再对原始与对齐后的预测分别用统计评分和一日 Value-at-Risk (VaR) 评估。
Result: 对齐前，跨损失的边际分数变异更大；对齐后，在完整的五模型比较中模型选择成为更大的变异来源，且跨损失的 VaR 突破率 (breach rates) 差距显著收窄。
Conclusion: 损失函数在原始对比中看似影响巨大，是因为它决定了预测水平；把预测水平与下游风险显式纳入后，这一解释会反转为模型选择主导。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks and Identity Leakage in De-Identification Systems: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the impact of adversarial attacks on identity encoders within a realistic de-identification framework. Our experiments show that the transferability of attacks transfers from an external surrogate model to the system model (e.g., CosFace to ArcFace) allows the adversary to cause identity information to leak in a sufficiently sensitive face recognition system. We present experimental evidence and propose strategies to mitigate this vulnerability. Specifically, we show how fine-tuning on adversarial examples helps to mitigate this effect for distortion-based attacks (i.e., snow, fog, etc.), while a simple low-pass filter can attenuate the effect of adversarial noise without affecting the de-identified images. Our mitigation results in a de-identification system that preserves its functionality while being significantly more robust to adversarial noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在去标识化 (de-identification) 框架中，对抗样本可从外部代理模型 (CosFace) 迁移到系统模型 (ArcFace)，使本应被遮蔽的身份信息在足够敏感的人脸识别系统中泄露。对失真类攻击（snow、fog 等）用对抗样本微调可缓解该效应，低通滤波器能在不破坏去标识图像的前提下削弱对抗噪声，最终系统保持原有功能且显著更抗对抗噪声。
Motivation: 去标识化系统依赖身份编码器隐藏人脸身份，但对抗攻击可跨模型迁移导致身份泄露，使去标识功能在真实威胁模型下失效。
Method: 在真实去标识化框架中对身份编码器做对抗攻击实验，检验从外部代理模型到系统模型的迁移性（CosFace → ArcFace）；提出两类缓解策略：用对抗样本微调，以及对图像施加低通滤波。
Result: 攻击可从外部代理模型迁移到系统模型（CosFace 到 ArcFace），导致身份信息泄露；对抗样本微调缓解失真类攻击（snow、fog 等）；低通滤波可削弱对抗噪声且不影响去标识图像；缓解后系统保持功能并对对抗噪声显著更稳健。
Conclusion: 身份编码器驱动的去标识系统对可迁移对抗攻击存在身份泄露风险，但微调与低通滤波这类轻量手段即可在保留功能的同时显著提升稳健性。

papers.title: GeoRVQ: Decoder-aware geometry for residual-token prediction in physiological signals
papers.abstract_en: Residual vector quantization (RVQ) turns physiological waveforms into compact token sequences, but conventional masked modeling treats every incorrect token as equally costly. We propose GeoRVQ, a coarse-to-fine masked token model whose objective reflects the local response of a frozen waveform decoder. Decoder-induced costs define geometry-aware soft targets and expected distortion, while quantizer-causal prediction follows residual dependencies from coarse to fine levels. In a descriptive aggregate over MIMIC-IV Waveform, VitalDB, and CODE-15\%, GeoRVQ increases exact token accuracy from $.133\pm.004$ to $.143\pm.003$, reduces decoded distance from $.606\pm.006$ to $.393\pm.007$, and increases R-peak F1 from $.784\pm.004$ to $.837\pm.008$ under matched model and training conditions. Across 45 held-out code substitutions, decoder-induced cost has a Spearman correlation of $.85$ with realized decoded cost, compared with $.54$ for Euclidean codeword distance. These results indicate that decoder-aware objectives can improve waveform and event preservation without requiring a large increase in exact token accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoRVQ 用冻结波形解码器的局部响应定义 token 代价，把等权掩码建模换成几何感知软目标与期望失真，并按残差依赖做由粗到细的 quantizer-causal 预测。在 MIMIC-IV Waveform、VitalDB、CODE-15% 的汇总上，exact token accuracy 从 .133±.004 升到 .143±.003，解码距离从 .606±.006 降到 .393±.007，R-peak F1 从 .784±.004 升到 .837±.008；45 个 held-out code substitution 上 decoder-induced cost 与实际解码代价的 Spearman 相关为 .85，欧氏 codeword 距离只有 .54。
Motivation: RVQ 把生理波形压成 token 序列后，常规掩码建模把每个错误 token 视为等价代价，与冻结解码器的真实敏感度不匹配，导致 token 准确率与波形/事件保真度脱节。

Result: 在 MIMIC-IV Waveform、VitalDB、CODE-15% 的描述性汇总上：exact token accuracy .133±.004 → .143±.003，decoded distance .606±.006 → .393±.007，R-peak F1 .784±.004 → .837±.008。45 个 held-out code substitution 上，decoder-induced cost 与 realized decoded cost 的 Spearman 相关 .85，欧氏 codeword 距离为 .54。

papers.title: Anatomy-Aware Synthesis of Post-Contrast Breast MRI from Pre-Contrast Images
papers.abstract_en: We developed an anatomy-aware deep learning framework to synthesize post-contrast breast MRI from pre-contrast images, emphasizing tumor and background parenchymal enhancement (BPE) regions. This retrospective study included 649 patients with 6,251 paired pre-contrast and post-contrast images. The framework integrates breast mask consistency, lesion-region supervision, and BPE-region supervision into an image-to-image translation model. Evaluation included quantitative image quality metrics, a reader study with two breast radiologists, and downstream Ki-67 classification. The proposed method outperformed Pix2Pix, Pix2PixHD, diffusion-based synthesis, and mask-supervised baselines in whole-image and regional evaluations. Ki-67 classification showed no statistically significant performance differences across real- and synthetic-image training and testing settings, although this does not establish equivalence. These findings suggest that anatomy-aware supervision improves synthesis fidelity and support further investigation of synthetic post-contrast MRI for contrast-free imaging workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出解剖感知的图像到图像翻译框架，从平扫乳腺 MRI 合成增强后图像，对乳腺掩膜一致性、病灶区与背景实质强化 (BPE) 区分别加监督。在 649 例患者、6,251 对配对图像的回顾性研究中，整图与分区指标均优于 Pix2Pix、Pix2PixHD、扩散合成与掩膜监督基线；用合成图训练/测试的 Ki-67 分类与真实图无统计学显著差异。
Motivation: 增强后 MRI 依赖对比剂注射，既增加成本与风险，也限制了无法打造影剂患者的检查路径；直接做图像翻译又容易忽略病灶与 BPE 这些关键区域的保真度。
Method: 在 image-to-image translation 模型中同时加入乳腺掩膜一致性约束、病灶区监督和 BPE 区监督；评测包含定量图像质量指标、两位乳腺放射科医师的 reader study，以及下游 Ki-67 分类任务。
Result: 回顾性纳入 649 例患者、6,251 对增强前后配对图像；在整图与区域评测上均超过 Pix2Pix、Pix2PixHD、基于扩散的合成与掩膜监督基线；Ki-67 分类在真实图与合成图的训练/测试各组合间无统计学显著差异，但作者指出这不等于等效。
Conclusion: 解剖感知监督能提升合成保真度，合成增强后 MRI 值得在无对比剂成像流程中进一步验证；Ki-67 结果只能说明未观察到显著差异，不能当作等效性证据。

papers.title: HYDRO: Towards Non-Reversible Face De-Identification Using a High-Fidelity Hybrid Diffusion and Target-Oriented Approach
papers.abstract_en: Target-oriented face de-identification models aim to anonymize the identity of a target individual across different images or video frames, such that the target can no longer be reliably recognized, while maintaining key characteristics of the visual data. Such models commonly leverage generative encoder-decoder architectures to manipulate facial appearances, enabling them to produce realistic high-fidelity de-identification results, while ensuring considerable attribute-retention capabilities. However, target-oriented models also carry the risk of inadvertently preserving subtle identity cues, making them (potentially) reversible and susceptible to reconstruction attacks. To address this problem, we introduce in this paper a novel (robust) face de-identification approach, called HYDRO, that combines target-oriented models with a dedicated diffusion process specifically designed to destroy any imperceptible information that may allow learning to reverse the de-identification procedure. HYDRO first de-identifies the given face image, injects noise into the de-identification result to impede reconstruction, and then applies a diffusion-based recovery step to improve fidelity and minimize the impact of the noising process on the data characteristics. To further improve image fidelity and better retain gaze directions, a novel Eye Similarity Discriminator (ESD) is also introduced and incorporated it into the training of HYDRO. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on three diverse datasets demonstrate that HYDRO exhibits state-of-the-art (SOTA) fidelity and attribute-retention capabilities, while being the only target-oriented method resilient against reconstruction attacks. In comparison to multiple SOTA competitors, HYDRO reduces the success of reconstruction attacks by 85.7% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HYDRO 把目标导向人脸去标识与专用扩散过程串联：先去标识，再注入噪声破坏可逆性，最后用扩散恢复步骤保住保真度，并加入 Eye Similarity Discriminator (ESD) 保留注视方向。在三个数据集上达到 SOTA 保真度与属性保留，且是唯一能抵御重建攻击的目标导向方法，平均将重建攻击成功率降低 85.7%。
Motivation: 目标导向去标识模型在匿名化身份的同时容易残留细微身份线索，使结果可被重建攻击逆转，匿名化失效。
Method: HYDRO 流程：对人脸做目标导向去标识，向结果注入噪声以阻碍重建，再用基于扩散的恢复步骤提升保真度并抑制噪声对数据特征的损害；训练中加入新提出的 Eye Similarity Discriminator (ESD) 以改善图像保真度并保留注视方向。
Result: 在三个多样数据集上的定量与定性实验中，HYDRO 取得 SOTA 保真度与属性保留能力，且是唯一能抵御重建攻击的目标导向方法；相比多个 SOTA 竞争方法，重建攻击成功率平均降低 85.7%。
Conclusion: 在目标导向去标识后接噪声注入加扩散恢复，可以在保持高保真与属性保留的同时切断身份线索的可逆性，使去标识不再可被重建攻击逆转。

papers.title: Sharp Convergence of Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Spectrally Nonnegative Interaction Energies
papers.abstract_en: We study the long-time behavior of Wasserstein gradient flows for interaction energies \[ \mathsf E[μ] = \frac12\iint_{M\times M}K(x,y)\,\mathrm dμ(x)\,\mathrm dμ(y) \] on a closed manifold $M$. For kernels diagonal in a Laplace eigenbasis with nonnegative spectral coefficients, we prove a differential inequality relating the relative entropy to the energy gap. Consequently, for any nonnegative initial density $u_0\in L^p(M)$, $p>1$, the energy gap is integrable in time and satisfies \[ \mathsf E[μ_t]-\mathsf E_{\min}=o(t^{-1}). \] If all spectral coefficients are positive, the flow converges weakly to the constant measure. These interaction energies need not be geodesically convex in Wasserstein space, and the associated flows contain no diffusion; their global convergence therefore does not follow from standard Wasserstein gradient flow theory. The kernels covered by our results include zonal kernels on spheres, kernels arising in transformer models, regularized Riesz kernels, and inverse fractional Laplacian kernels. We also investigate the sharpness of the $o(t^{-1})$ rate. For any smooth kernel in this class with infinitely many positive spectral coefficients and any $δ>0$, we construct a solution of the linearized flow whose energy is comparable to $t^{-1-δ}$ along a sequence of times tending to infinity. Moreover, for any $δ>0$, by choosing a suitable inverse fractional Laplacian kernel on the flat torus, we construct an exact solution of the nonlinear Wasserstein gradient flow whose energy is comparable to $t^{-1-δ}$. The nonlinear construction is based on uniform-in-time estimates for the evolution of the dyadic Fourier coefficient blocks and a blockwise energy-persistence argument. These estimates also yield a uniform-in-time quantitative comparison between the nonlinear Wasserstein gradient flow and its linearization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在闭流形上研究相互作用能量的 Wasserstein 梯度流，对 Laplace 特征基对角且谱系数非负的核，证明相对熵与能量间隙的微分不等式，得到能量间隙时间可积且 E[μ_t]−E_min=o(t^{-1})；谱系数全正时流弱收敛到常数测度。该类能量不必 geodesically convex、流中无扩散，标准理论不适用；并构造线性化与非线性解使能量达到 t^{−1−δ} 量级，说明 o(t^{-1}) 阶是 sharp 的。
Motivation: 非 geodesically convex、无扩散的 Wasserstein 梯度流缺少标准收敛理论，而 transformer 核、正则化 Riesz 核等实际核正落在这一类，其长时间行为无从判定。
Method: 对 Laplace 特征基对角、谱系数非负的核 E[μ]=½∬K dμ dμ，建立相对熵与能量间隙的微分不等式；sharpness 部分对线性化流构造解，并在平坦环面上取合适的 inverse fractional Laplacian 核构造非线性流的精确解，工具是 dyadic Fourier 系数块的一致时间估计与逐块能量保持论证，同时给出非线性流与其线性化的定量比较。
Result: 任意非负初值 u_0∈L^p(M)（p>1）下能量间隙时间可积且 E[μ_t]−E_min=o(t^{-1})；谱系数全正时弱收敛到常数测度。对任何有无穷多个正谱系数的光滑核与任意 δ>0，线性化流存在解其能量沿趋于无穷的时间序列为 t^{−1−δ} 量级；平坦环面上合适的 inverse fractional Laplacian 核给出非线性 Wasserstein 梯度流的精确解，能量同样为 t^{−1−δ} 量级。
Conclusion: 非负谱核的无扩散 Wasserstein 梯度流即使缺乏 geodesic convexity 也全局收敛，且 o(t^{-1}) 的能量衰减率不可再改进；覆盖范围包括球面上的 zonal kernels、transformer 中出现的核、正则化 Riesz 核与 inverse fractional Laplacian 核。

papers.title: Laser-Tracker-Assisted Camera-to-Robot Calibration for Mobile Robots
papers.abstract_en: We present a laser-tracker-assisted hand-eye calibration method for camera-equipped mobile robots. The method combines laser-tracker-based 3D metrology with camera-based 2D observations. Building on our previous laser-tracker-assisted camera-to-robot calibration method for ground-observing mobile robots, we present a generalized formulation for calibrating the camera pose in the coordinate system of tracker-localized mobile robots. The new approach relaxes assumptions of our previous method on robot and camera configuration by chaining multiple calibration targets resulting in a more general approach supporting various camera-equipped mobile robot systems.
papers.comment: To appear in the proceedings of Forum Bildverarbeitung 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出激光跟踪仪 (laser tracker) 辅助的相机-机器人手眼标定方法，把跟踪仪的 3D 计量与相机 2D 观测结合，用于在跟踪仪定位的移动机器人坐标系下求解相机位姿。通过串联多个标定目标，新方法放宽了此前方法对机器人与相机构型的假设，可覆盖更多相机移动机器人系统。
Motivation: 此前面向地面观测移动机器人的相机-机器人标定方法依赖特定机器人与相机构型假设，难以推广到其他相机移动机器人平台。
Method: 结合 laser tracker 的 3D 计量与相机 2D 观测，在跟踪仪定位的移动机器人坐标系中建立相机位姿标定的广义公式，并通过链接多个标定目标 (chaining multiple calibration targets) 放松构型约束。
Result: 给出面向跟踪仪定位移动机器人的广义相机位姿标定公式，支持多种相机移动机器人构型；摘要未给出定量精度或基线对比数字。
Conclusion: 多目标串联的激光跟踪仪辅助标定可把相机-机器人标定从特定构型推广到更一般的移动机器人系统。

papers.title: Topological Signatures of Cyber-Attack Classes in Natural Visibility Graph Representations of Network Traffic
papers.abstract_en: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG)-based representations provide a promising approach for capturing structural patterns in sequential network traffic. However, whether different cyber-attack classes exhibit distinctive topological signatures in such representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates the discriminative and structural characteristics of NVG-based network traffic representations using the CSE-CIC-IDS2018 dataset. Seventy-six numerical traffic features were independently transformed into NVGs within overlapping frames of 40 observations, and ten graph-theoretic metrics were extracted from each graph, resulting in 760 topological descriptors per frame. The discriminative capability of these representations was evaluated using a multi-branch convolutional neural network (CNN) with stratified five-fold cross-validation. The model achieved an average accuracy of 96.20% and a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.9566. To characterize class-specific topological differences, Kruskal-Wallis and Mann-Whitney U tests were combined with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction and effect-size measures. Of the 10,640 attack-versus-benign comparisons, 7,777 (73.1%) remained statistically significant after FDR correction, with 4,844 exhibiting large Cliff's delta effects. The strongest global differences were predominantly associated with backward-traffic and packet-length-related features combined with connectivity, clustering, and centrality measures. These findings indicate that NVG-derived representations can provide strong discriminative capability while revealing class-dependent topological patterns associated with different cyber-attack classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 76 个数值化网络流量特征各自转成 Natural Visibility Graph (NVG)，在 40 个观测的重叠窗口内提取 10 个图论指标，得到每帧 760 维拓扑描述子，用多分支 CNN 区分 CSE-CIC-IDS2018 上的攻击与良性流量。分层五折交叉验证下平均准确率 96.20%、MCC 0.9566，说明网络攻击类别在 NVG 表示中带有可判别的拓扑签名。
Motivation: 不同网络攻击类别是否在序列流量的 NVG 表示中呈现可区分的拓扑特征，此前认识不足；需要判断这种表示能否既做判别又揭示类别差异。
Method: 在 40 个观测的重叠帧内把 76 个数值流量特征各自独立转成 NVG，每个图提取 10 个图论指标，构成每帧 760 个拓扑描述子；用多分支 CNN 配合分层五-fold 交叉验证评估判别能力，并以 Kruskal-Wallis 与 Mann-Whitney U 检验结合 Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 校正和效应量刻画类别差异。
Result: 在 CSE-CIC-IDS2018 上平均准确率 96.20%、MCC 0.9566；10,640 个攻击对良性比较中 7,777 个（73.1%）经 FDR 校正后仍显著，其中 4,844 个具大 Cliff's delta 效应；最强全局差异主要来自反向流量与包长相关特征，配合连通性、聚类与中心性指标。
Conclusion: NVG 派生表示既能提供强判别能力，又能揭示与不同攻击类别相关的、依赖类别的拓扑模式，反向流量、包长度与图连通/聚类/中心性是区分攻击类别的主要拓扑信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Same evidence, different judgments: Evidence noncommutative in vision/speech-text conflicts
papers.abstract_en: For multimodal large language models, when images or speech conflict with accompanying text, measured text reliance can entangle modality preference with evidence position. Earlier studies of text bias often used a fixed evidence order or moved task instructions with the evidence, leaving the contribution of order unclear. In this paper, we use a paired comparison that keeps the instructions and evidence content fixed and swaps only the positions of the two sources to quantify this potential influence. Across vision and speech models, placing an image or recording after conflicting text consistently shifts answers toward its content. We also revisit previous studies and analyze why their experimental settings can lead to misleading conclusions. These findings reveal cross-modal evidence noncommutativity: the same evidence can lead to different judgments when its order changes, and placing perceptual evidence later can increase the model's reliance on its content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态大模型在图像/语音与文本冲突时存在证据顺序效应：保持指令与证据内容不变、只交换两段证据位置，把图像或录音放在冲突文本之后会一致地把回答推向该感知证据的内容。作者据此提出跨模态证据不可交换性 (evidence noncommutativity)，并指出先前固定证据顺序或随证据移动指令的文本偏向研究会把顺序贡献混入模态偏好，从而得出误导性结论。
Motivation: 已有文本偏向研究多用固定证据顺序，或把任务指令随证据一起移动，导致测得的文本依赖无法区分模态偏好与证据位置的贡献，结论可能被误导。
Method: 采用配对比较 (paired comparison)：指令与两段证据内容完全固定，仅交换图像/录音与冲突文本的位置，分别在视觉模型与语音模型上量化位置带来的回答偏移；并回溯分析既有研究的实验设置为何产生误导结论。
Result: 在视觉与语音两类模型上，把图像或录音置于冲突文本之后，回答一致地偏向该感知证据的内容；回溯分析显示既有研究的实验设置（固定证据顺序、指令随证据移动）会导致误导性结论。
Conclusion: 同一组证据因顺序不同可产生不同判断，即跨模态证据不可交换；把感知证据放在后面会提高模型对其内容的依赖，因此测文本依赖必须固定指令并控制证据顺序。

papers.title: Lessons learned from deploying imaging AI with the open PACS-AI platform
papers.abstract_en: We describe deploying imaging AI at six hospitals through PACS-AI, an open self-hosted platform. The binding constraint is not model accuracy but infrastructure to route studies, display results, capture feedback, and audit what runs. At one center, angiography models completed 515 of 607 jobs (84.8%); failures reflected absent diagnostic views, and 78.1% of 638 clinician ratings were positive. Publishing honest readiness levels for every model is itself a governance practice.
papers.comment: 28 pages (21 main text + 7 supplementary), 3 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在六家医院部署开源自托管 PACS-AI 影像 AI 平台，结论是瓶颈不在模型精度，而在路由检查、结果展示、反馈采集与运行审计的基础设施。单中心血管造影模型完成 607 项任务中的 515 项（84.8%），失败源于缺少诊断视角；638 条临床评分中 78.1% 为正面。
Motivation: 影像 AI 落地医院时，制约因素是把检查送进模型、把结果送回临床、并留下可审计记录的基础设施，而非模型本身的准确率。
Method: PACS-AI 为开源自托管平台，在六家医院部署，覆盖检查路由、结果展示、临床反馈采集与运行审计；血管造影模型按任务队列运行，并对每个模型公开诚实的就绪度等级 (readiness level)。
Result: 单中心血管造影模型完成 607 项任务中的 515 项（84.8%），失败由缺少诊断视角导致；638 条临床评分中 78.1% 为正面。
Conclusion: 部署影像 AI 的关键是基础设施与治理，公开每个模型的就绪度等级本身就是一种治理实践。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Resource-Efficient Distributed Recursive Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a flexible framework for learning unknown functions from noisy measurements while quantifying predictive uncertainty, making them well suited for estimation in multi-agent systems. However, when measurements are collected by multiple agents, maintaining a unified GP model without centralized processing requires efficient distributed algorithms that can operate using local measurements and communication with neighboring agents. In this work, we develop two distributed recursive GP (RGP) algorithms for multi-output GP regression: ADMM-RGP and PDMM-RGP. We analyze the stability and convergence of both algorithms and develop parameter selection strategies to accelerate convergence, thus reducing the communication burden. The proposed methods are validated on a real-world multi-output wind dataset, and their convergence behavior is examined across communication graphs with varying connectivity. Numerical experiments demonstrate that ADMM-RGP and PDMM-RGP can significantly reduce communication relative to the state of the art, while maintaining comparable estimation accuracy and network-wide consensus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两种分布式递归高斯过程回归算法 ADMM-RGP 与 PDMM-RGP，让多智能体在仅与邻居通信、无中心处理的条件下维护统一的多输出 GP 模型，并给出加速收敛的参数选择策略以降低通信负担。在真实多输出风场数据集与不同连通性通信图上，两法相对 state of the art 显著减少通信，同时保持相当的估计精度与全网共识。
Motivation: 多智能体从含噪测量学习未知函数时，维持统一 GP 模型通常需要中心化处理；缺少高效分布式算法会带来过高的通信负担。
Method: 针对多输出 GP 回归提出 ADMM-RGP 与 PDMM-RGP 两种分布式递归 GP 算法，分析二者的稳定性与收敛性，并设计加速收敛的参数选择策略以减少通信；在连通性不同的通信图上检验收敛行为。
Result: 在真实多输出风数据集 (multi-output wind dataset) 上的数值实验显示，ADMM-RGP 与 PDMM-RGP 相对 state of the art 显著降低通信量，同时保持相当的估计精度与网络共识；收敛性在不同连通性的通信图上考察。
Conclusion: 分布式递归 GP 配合针对性的参数选择可以在不牺牲估计精度与共识的前提下压缩多智能体通信开销，且收敛表现依赖通信图连通性。

papers.title: Tight Regret Bound for Online Inverse Linear Optimization via Multiscale Matrix Weights
papers.abstract_en: We study online inverse linear optimization with a fixed unknown linear utility: in each round, an environment presents a compact action set, the learner recommends an action from it, and the environment returns an action that maximizes the utility over the same set. When the utility vector and the actions lie in the $d$-dimensional Euclidean unit ball, we give a randomized algorithm whose regret---the cumulative utility shortfall relative to optimal actions---is $O(\sqrt d)$ in expectation for every time horizon, without knowledge of the horizon. The dependence on $d$ is optimal up to a constant factor by the known $Ω(\sqrt d)$ lower bound for horizons $T\ge d$. Our algorithm maintains matrix multiplicative weights on polynomial feature spaces at geometrically spaced scales. It selects a recommendation distribution by solving a linear program and updates its score matrices by comparing the available actions with the feedback action. With rational oracle outputs and feedback actions, an implementation computable relative to a linear-optimization oracle preserves the $O(\sqrt d)$ regret bound. Whether the same rate is attainable with running time polynomial in the dimension, horizon, and input length remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线逆线性优化中环境每轮给出紧致动作集、学习者推荐一个动作、环境返回同集合上最大化未知线性效用的动作；算法在几何间隔的多个尺度上对多项式特征空间维护矩阵乘性权重 (matrix multiplicative weights)，用线性规划选推荐分布。期望 regret 对任意时间跨度均为 O(√d)，且不需事先知道跨度；对 T≥d 由已知 Ω(√d) 下界知 d 依赖在常数因子内最优。
Motivation: 在线逆线性优化中效用向量未知且环境按最优性反馈动作，需要在不知道时间跨度的情况下给出对维度依赖最优的 regret 保证。
Method: 在几何间隔的多个尺度上对多项式特征空间维护矩阵乘性权重；每轮通过求解一个线性规划选择推荐分布，并用可得动作与反馈动作的比较更新分数矩阵；实现可在给定线性优化 oracle 下计算，且要求 oracle 输出与反馈动作为有理数。
Result: 在效用向量与动作均位于 d 维欧氏单位球的设定下，期望 regret 对任意时间跨度为 O(√d)，无需已知跨度；对 T≥d，已知 Ω(√d) 下界使该 d 依赖在常数因子内最优；有理 oracle 输出与反馈动作下，基于线性优化 oracle 的实现仍保持 O(√d)。
Conclusion: 多尺度矩阵乘性权重可在未知跨度下达到维度最优的 O(√d) regret；能否在运行时间关于维度、跨度与输入长度均为多项式的条件下取得同一速率仍是开放问题。

papers.title: TinyUDE: Solver-Free Universal Differential Equations on Microcontrollers via Lie-Taylor Jet Matching
papers.abstract_en: Training Universal Differential Equations (UDEs) traditionally relies on backpropagating through numerical ODE solvers, creating memory footprints far exceeding the capabilities of edge microcontrollers. We present Lie-Taylor jet matching, a solver-free training framework that fits a hybrid vector field directly to the first and second time-derivatives of observed system states. These derivatives, the truncated Lie-Taylor jet, are estimated online via Savitzky-Golay filtering, yielding fully analytic gradients without automatic differentiation software. We evaluate whether eliminating the solver compromises accuracy against a conventional baseline (fixed-step RK4 integration, multiple shooting, exact discrete adjoints, Adam) sharing identical dynamics, noise models, network architectures, and metrics. While naive derivative matching degrades under sensor noise, our noise-adaptive mechanisms close and reverse this gap: full-rate phase-shifted sampling, a reservoir buffer, cosine-annealed optimization with weight averaging, on-device noise estimation, and polynomial-misfit quality gating. On a damped pendulum and chaotic double pendulum, our method matches or exceeds baseline accuracy at matched data windows and recovers unmodeled damping coefficients. Across noise levels from 0% to 5%, it attains a geometric-mean relative field error of 0.65x that of the baseline within 108 kB of static memory, compared with megabytes of solver tape. On an ESP32 microcontroller, the on-device run reaches a field error of 0.0020 and recovers the damping coefficient to c = 0.400 (true 0.400) within 61.3 kB of static memory and 7.24 ms per update (18.1% duty cycle at 25 Hz), confirming real-time on-device training is feasible without a numerical solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TinyUDE 用 Lie-Taylor jet matching 把 UDE 训练从数值 ODE 求解器中解耦：用 Savitzky-Golay 滤波在线估计状态的一、二阶导数（截断 Lie-Taylor jet），直接对导数做拟合得到全解析梯度。在 0%–5% 传感器噪声下几何平均相对场误差为 RK4 基线的 0.65 倍，静态内存仅 108 kB；ESP32 上场误差 0.0020、阻尼系数恢复到 c = 0.400（真值 0.400），单次更新 7.24 ms。
Motivation: UDE 训练需对数值 ODE 求解器反向传播，内存占用远超边缘微控制器能力，使得在设备端训练混合动力系统模型不可行。
Method: Lie-Taylor jet matching：用 Savitzky-Golay 滤波在线估计观测状态的一、二阶时间导数，直接把混合向量场拟合到这些导数，得到无需自动微分的解析梯度。噪声自适应机制包括全速率相移采样、reservoir buffer、cosine 退火优化与权重平均、设备端噪声估计、多项式失配质量门控。基线为固定步长 RK4 积分 + multiple shooting + 精确离散伴随 + Adam，两者共享相同动力学、噪声模型、网络结构与指标；测试系统为 damped pendulum 与 chaotic double pendulum。
Result: 在 0%–5% 噪声范围内，几何平均相对场误差为基线的 0.65 倍，静态内存 108 kB（基线需 megabytes 级 solver tape）；在匹配数据窗口上精度持平或超过基线，并恢复未建模阻尼系数。ESP32 上设备端运行场误差 0.0020，阻尼系数恢复到 c = 0.400（真值 0.400），静态内存 61.3 kB，每次更新 7.24 ms（25 Hz 下 18.1% 占空比）。

papers.title: CRISP: Scalable Importance-Stratified Coresets for Imbalanced Tabular Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large imbalanced tabular datasets make repeated gradient-boosted tree training expensive. Existing coreset methods often lose accuracy when most majority examples are removed. We present CRISP (Coreset Reduction via Importance-Stratified Pruning), a linear-time method that allocates a negative-class budget across quantile strata of a proxy-model score. Sample weights account for unequal inclusion probabilities. At 95% negative-class reduction on a production fraud dataset, CRISP trains on approximately 1.70M of 25M rows and retains 99.7% of full-data Average Precision. This is a 93.2% reduction in total training rows. On public CriteoPrivateAds, CRISP has the highest mean Average Precision at each tested rate from 90% to 99.4% majority reduction. Sparkov results are mixed at lower rates, but CRISP has the highest mean at 99.2% and 99.4%. Ablations identify budget allocation and inverse-propensity weighting as the main sources of the production-dataset gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRISP 用代理模型分数的分位数分层给负类预算做线性时间 coreset 剪枝，并用逆包含概率权重校正样本，在生产欺诈数据上 95% 负类削减（25M 行只训约 1.70M，总行数降 93.2%）仍保住全量 Average Precision 的 99.7%。在 CriteoPrivateAds 的 90%–99.4% 多数类削减各档上它都取得最高平均 AP，Sparkov 低削减档结果混杂、99.2% 与 99.4% 两档最高。
Motivation: 大规模不平衡表格数据反复训练梯度提升树代价高，而现有 coreset 方法在删掉多数类样本时常常掉精度。
Method: CRISP (Coreset Reduction via Importance-Stratified Pruning)：按代理模型 (proxy model) 分数的分位数分层分配负类预算，线性时间运行，并用样本权重校正不等的入样概率 (inclusion probability)；消融把预算分配与逆倾向加权 (inverse-propensity weighting) 分离。
Result: 生产欺诈数据集 95% 负类削减下用约 1.70M/25M 行训练，保住全量数据 99.7% 的 Average Precision，总训练行数降 93.2%；CriteoPrivateAds 上在 90% 到 99.4% 各削减率均有最高平均 AP；Sparkov 低削减率结果混杂，99.2% 与 99.4% 两档最高。
Conclusion: 预算分配与逆倾向加权是生产数据集增益的主要来源，说明分层预算加概率校正能在大幅削减多数类的同时基本保住 AP。

papers.title: Untangling the Geometry and Speed for RF Sensing Spectrograms
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge in RF sensing is that Doppler signatures observed by a link entangle the target's motion with the sensing geometry, resulting in limited applicability to unconstrained real-world settings. In this paper, we establish a new foundation for physically interpretable RF sensing that disentangles reflector speed from geometry, jointly recovering the speed, geometry factor, relative amplitude, and width of each dominant Doppler ridge. More specifically, we first develop a compact parametric representation of WiFi spectrograms and establish its low-dimensional structure through a systematic computer-vision analysis of a large and diverse human-activity dataset, thereby providing a tractable foundation for learning. Building on this representation, we then design a physics-informed autoencoder whose structured bottleneck and differentiable RF forward model enforce physically meaningful estimates of reflector speed and geometry. We further introduce a synthetic-to-real training framework, eliminating the need for real WiFi training data. We extensively validate the proposed framework under both known and time-varying geometries, using both independently generated synthetic test sets and 31 real WiFi experiments. The results demonstrate the superior performance in speed and geometry extraction, robustly recovering the underlying geometry, speeds, Doppler-ridge amplitudes, and ridge widths across all settings, while substantially outperforming the strongest baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RF 感知中 Doppler 特征把目标运动与感知几何纠缠在一起，本文提出物理可解释的解耦框架：为 WiFi spectrogram 建立紧凑参数化表示，用带结构化瓶颈与可微 RF 前向模型的 physics-informed autoencoder 联合恢复每个主导 Doppler ridge 的速度、几何因子、相对幅度与宽度，并以 synthetic-to-real 训练免除真实 WiFi 训练数据。在已知与时变几何下、独立合成测试集与 31 组真实 WiFi 实验中，速度与几何提取优于最强基线。
Motivation: RF sensing 中 Doppler 特征把目标速度与感知几何耦合，限制了在非受控真实场景中的可用性；缺少把二者物理上分开的可解释表示。
Method: 先对大量多样化人体活动数据集做系统性 computer-vision 分析，建立 WiFi spectrogram 的紧凑参数化表示与低维结构；再设计 physics-informed autoencoder，其结构化瓶颈与可微 RF 前向模型约束速度与几何估计；并引入 synthetic-to-real 训练框架，无需真实 WiFi 训练数据。
Result: 在已知几何与时变几何两类设置下，用独立生成的合成测试集与 31 组真实 WiFi 实验验证：稳健恢复底层几何、速度、Doppler-ridge 幅度与 ridge 宽度，速度与几何提取性能优于最强基线。
Conclusion: 把 Doppler ridge 参数化并用可微 RF 前向模型做瓶颈约束，可以在无真实训练数据的条件下把反射体速度与感知几何分开恢复。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Transfer Learning with Conformalized Quantile Regression for Solar PV Forecasting Under Load-Shedding-Driven Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Solar photovoltaic (PV) forecasting in regions affected by load shedding is challenging because reliable historical observations are scarce. This study proposes a transfer learning framework combined with Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) to improve PV power forecasting and provide reliable uncertainty estimates under severe data scarcity. A source-domain PV dataset from Alice Springs, Australia, is used to pretrain a temporal forecasting model, which is then adapted to simulated Bangladesh PV data representing different levels of historical availability. Experimental results show that transfer learning reduces RMSE by up to 23.7% when only one month of target-domain data is available and by 13.7% with three months of data. The proposed Transfer Learning plus CQR framework achieves 94.3% empirical coverage with three months of target data while producing prediction intervals that are 14% narrower than those obtained without transfer learning. These results demonstrate that combining transfer learning with conformal uncertainty quantification can improve both point forecasting accuracy and uncertainty reliability when target-domain PV data are severely limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在限电 (load shedding) 导致历史观测稀缺的地区，用 Alice Springs 源域 PV 数据预训练时序模型，再迁移到孟加拉国仿真 PV 数据并叠加 Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR)。目标域只有 1 个月数据时 RMSE 最多降 23.7%，3 个月时降 13.7%；3 个月数据下经验覆盖率达 94.3%，预测区间比不做迁移窄 14%。
Motivation: 限电地区可靠历史 PV 观测稀缺，直接训练时序预测模型数据不足，点预测误差大且不确定性区间不可靠。
Method: 迁移学习框架：以澳大利亚 Alice Springs 的源域 PV 数据集预训练时序预测模型，再适配到代表不同历史数据可得程度的孟加拉国仿真 PV 数据；预测端用 Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) 生成分位数区间并做保形校准，给出不确定性估计。
Result: 目标域仅 1 个月数据时迁移学习使 RMSE 最多降低 23.7%，3 个月数据时降低 13.7%；迁移 + CQR 在 3 个月目标数据下经验覆盖率达 94.3%，预测区间比不带迁移学习的 CQR 窄 14%。
Conclusion: 在目标域 PV 数据严重受限时，源域迁移与保形分位数回归结合可同时改善点预测精度与不确定性可靠性，且区间更窄。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: When Post-Processing Fairness Constraints Help and When They Harm: Evidence from Eight Cross-Domain Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits in production ML typically occur once, at deployment, on a single domain. Both fail in practice: fairness can shift after retraining or a changing user base, and interventions validated on one dataset are rarely tested across the heterogeneous domains an organization deploys. We present FAPE (Fairness Auditing for Production Environments), a four-stage framework evaluating a single post-processing intervention, Fairlearn's ThresholdOptimizer, across eight domain evaluations: criminal justice, income prediction, legal admissions, credit lending, agricultural lending, a multi-domain benchmark corpus, healthcare, and education. Each is scored on demographic parity and equalized odds difference, plus disparate impact ratio and accuracy cost where computable. Intervention effectiveness tracks baseline disparity magnitude: across model-domain pairs the constraint improved disparity in 9 of 14 high-disparity cases and worsened it in 3 of 4 near-fair ones. Each of the five high-disparity exceptions reverses under one of two measurement checks, a minimum group size or thresholds fit on held-out data. A CUSUM monitor started at deployment, tested on a simulated shift, separates constrained models that never met a 0.1 parity convention from those that met it and later regressed. A single deployment-time audit is therefore an unreliable guide, which argues for baseline-disparity screening and continuous monitoring
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code, data loaders and figures: github.com/nithinnarla/fape-fairness-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAPE 用四个阶段在八个领域上评估同一个后处理公平性干预 Fairlearn 的 ThresholdOptimizer，发现干预效果取决于基线差异大小：高差异情形 14 例中 9 例改善、近公平情形 4 例中 3 例反而恶化。五个高差异反例中有每一个都会在最小群体规模或留出数据拟合阈值这两种测量检查之一下反转；部署期启动的 CUSUM 监控能在模拟分布偏移下区分从未达到 0.1 parity 约定的模型与达标后回退的模型。作者据此主张先做基线差异筛查并持续监控，而非只在部署时审一次。
Motivation: 生产环境的公平性审计通常只在部署时做一次、只覆盖单一领域，而重训或用户群变化会让公平性漂移，单一数据集上验证的干预在组织部署的异构领域间很少被检验。
Method: FAPE 四阶段框架，在刑事司法、收入预测、法律录取、信贷、农业贷款、多领域基准语料、医疗、教育八个领域评估 Fairlearn 的 ThresholdOptimizer；指标为 demographic parity、equalized odds difference，可算时加 disparate impact ratio 与 accuracy cost；另用最小群体规模与留出数据拟合阈值两种测量检查，以及部署期启动的 CUSUM 监控在模拟偏移上测试。
Result: 跨模型-领域对，高差异 14 例中干预改善 9 例，近公平 4 例中恶化 3 例；5 个高差异反例每一个都在最小群体规模或留出数据拟合阈值之一下反转；CUSUM 监控区分了从未达到 0.1 parity 约定的受约束模型与达标后回退的模型。
Conclusion: 单次部署期审计不可靠，应先按基线差异大小筛查再决定是否施加后处理约束，并对已部署模型做持续监控。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Escaping Python Dependency Hell: A Hybrid Replay-and-Repair Pipeline for Python Dependency Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Dependency conflicts in Python ecosystems arise from incompatible version constraints, missing packages, and undocumented compatibility relationships, causing many real-world code snippets to fail at execution. This paper presents PLLM+, a hybrid dependency-repair pipeline evaluated on the HG2.9K benchmark of 2,891 dependency-failing snippets. PLLM+ prioritizes inexpensive deterministic steps before invoking LLM-based repair: static AST-based interpreter inference, replay of historically successful dependency configurations from the competition-provided solutions database, and live PyPI validation of candidate package versions. When these steps do not resolve a case, the system falls back to a structured LLM-based repair loop with typed error classification and Proposer/Critic agents. On HG2.9K, PLLM+ solves 1,500 out of 2,891 snippets, compared with 1,169 solved by the PLLM baseline. It also reduces average runtime from 368.7 to 71.8 seconds per snippet. Most successful fixes come from replaying known configurations: 1,495 of the 1,500 successful fixes are produced by the solutions database, while the LLM fallback accounts for 5 additional fixes. These results suggest that, in this benchmark setting, deterministic reuse of previously validated dependency configurations is a simple and effective strategy, with LLM-based repair serving as a secondary fallback for cases not covered by prior solutions.

TL;DR: 提出 PLLM+ 混合依赖修复流水线：先跑便宜的确定性步骤（AST 解释器推断、历史成功配置 replay、PyPI 实时校验），失败再落到带类型化错误分类与 Proposer/Critic agent 的 LLM 修复循环。在 HG2.9K 的 2,891 个依赖失败代码片段上解出 1,500 个（基线 PLLM 1,169），平均耗时从 368.7 秒降到 71.8 秒；1,500 个成功修复中 1,495 个来自 solutions database，LLM 兜底只补 5 个。
Motivation: Python 生态中版本约束不兼容、缺包与未记录的兼容关系导致大量真实代码片段执行失败，纯 LLM 修复成本高且未必必要。

Result: HG2.9K 上 PLLM+ 解决 1,500/2,891，PLLM 基线解决 1,169；平均单片段运行时间 368.7 秒 → 71.8 秒。1,500 个成功修复中 1,495 个由 solutions database replay 产生，LLM fallback 仅贡献 5 个。

papers.title: Rolling Conformal Prediction in Sequential Model Training
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Rolling Conformal Prediction (rolling-CP), a distribution-free predictive inference method for the setting of sequential model training. Specifically, given a data stream $(X_1,Y_1),(X_2,Y_2),\dots$, at each time $n$ the trained model may depend on the observed history $\{(X_i,Y_i)\}_{i<n}$. This setting arises naturally in modern sequential training, including one-pass training over massive datasets and continual fine-tuning or test-time adaptation of language models during deployment. Rolling-CP first calibrates each incoming observation against the current predictor and then rolls it into future training. In this way, we avoid the need for data splitting. Remarkably, although the models at times $n=1,2,\dots$ may have entirely different properties and accuracy levels, for exchangeable data it is nonetheless possible to establish a guarantee of marginal coverage, with a familiar universal factor-two guarantee (a worst case guarantee of $1-2α$ coverage, as compared to the target level $1-α$), without any assumptions of stability or any restrictions on the model training process. For i.i.d. data streams, we further prove high-probability training-conditional validity uniformly over time; under stability conditions, coverage guarantees sharpen towards $1-α$. Numerical experiments on sequential regression, multiclass SGD, and one-pass neural-network training further demonstrate the practical effectiveness of rolling-CP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Rolling Conformal Prediction (rolling-CP)：对数据流中每个新观测先用当前预测器做校准，再把该校准结果滚入后续训练，从而免去数据切分。对可交换数据无需任何稳定性假设即可得 1-2α 的边缘覆盖保证；对 i.i.d. 流在稳定性条件下覆盖收紧到 1-α。
Motivation: 顺序训练（一遍式大数据训练、持续微调、部署期 test-time adaptation）中模型随历史不断变化，传统校准依赖的数据切分不可用，且现有覆盖保证通常要求训练过程稳定。
Method: rolling-CP 在每个时刻 n 对新到观测 (X_n,Y_n) 相对当前预测器做无分布校准，再把该校准量滚入未来训练，避免 data splitting；对可交换数据证边缘覆盖，对 i.i.d. 流证随时间一致的高概率 training-conditional validity，并在稳定性条件下收紧覆盖。
Result: 可交换数据下给出通用 factor-two 保证：最坏情形覆盖 1-2α（目标 1-α），且对模型训练过程不加任何稳定性假设；i.i.d. 流下证明随时间一致的高概率 training-conditional validity，稳定性条件下覆盖收紧至 1-α；在 sequential regression、multiclass SGD 与 one-pass 神经网络训练上给出数值实验。
Conclusion: 顺序训练下的预测区间可以不靠数据切分、也不靠训练稳定性就获得可证明的覆盖，代价是可交换情形下 1-2α 的因子二松弛；稳定性条件能把覆盖推回 1-α。

papers.title: Recognized but Not Produced: A Generation Benchmark for Culturally Specific Kinship Terms
papers.abstract_en: Current literature evaluates large language models (LLMs) on multilingual kinship understanding using multiple choice benchmarks, treating it as a recognition problem. We instead prompt five open weight LLMs to generate kinship terms in three non Western languages (Hindi, Tamil, and Korean) across two communicative tasks and pair this with a matched option-supported selection baseline. On identical relation language cells, GPT OSS120B selects the correct term in 90.67% of 75 valid cells but produces an accepted term in 36.00% of the corresponding attempts; Llama 3.370B shows the same pattern (77.92% versus 24.24%). Since the four-option condition displays the candidate terms and does not require script production, the difference is interpreted as an evaluation format gap rather than direct proof that lexical knowledge is intact. On explicitly specified L3 prompts, accuracy varies sharply, from GLM-5.1 at 72.29% to Llama-3.370B at 24.24%. The paternal-lineage advantage is language specific; it is large in Hindi but weak or reversed in Korean, while Tamil shared-term pairs provide a control for measurement variation. These results show that culturally specific kinship generation remains difficult even when the relationship is explicitly stated and motivate generation-based evaluation alongside multiple-choice testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文把多语言亲属称谓评测从选择题改成生成任务：让五个开源 LLM 在 Hindi、Tamil、Korean 三种非西方语言的两类交际任务中直接产出称谓，并配对同格的四选项选择基线。GPT-OSS-120B 在 75 个有效格上选择正确率 90.67%、生成接受率仅 36.00%，Llama-3.3-70B 为 77.92% 对 24.24%，说明选择题高分主要来自选项提示而非可产出的词汇知识。
Motivation: 现有工作用多选题评测 LLM 的多语言亲属称谓理解，把问题当成识别任务；识别成功不等于模型能在无候选提示时自行产出该称谓，评测格式本身可能夸大能力。
Method: 对五个开源权重 LLM，在 Hindi、Tamil、Korean 上设计两类交际任务的生成式提示，并在完全相同的 relation-language 格上配对四选项选择基线；L3 提示被显式指定关系信息，Tamil 的 shared-term 对作为测量差异的对照。
Result: GPT-OSS-120B 在 75 个有效格中选择正确率 90.67%，对应生成尝试的接受率 36.00%；Llama-3.3-70B 为 77.92% 对 24.24%。显式指定的 L3 提示上准确率从 GLM-5.1 的 72.29% 到 Llama-3.3-70B 的 24.24%。父系优势具有语言特异性：Hindi 中很大，Korean 中微弱或反转。
Conclusion: 生成与选择之间的落差应解读为评测格式差距 (evaluation format gap)，而非词汇知识完好的直接证据；作者主张在多选之外并行做生成式评测。

papers.title: The Computational Value of Sensory-Aligned Receptive Fields Depends on Neuronal Expressivity
papers.abstract_en: Biological sensory neurons have selective receptive fields organized along meaningful stimulus coordinates, such as frequency, motion direction, or retinotopic position. Such structure may arise from efficient coding and biological constraints on activity, connectivity, and wiring, as computational studies of simple neurons have shown across modalities. This raises a question: do structured receptive fields confer a computational advantage beyond resource efficiency itself, and does this advantage persist when individual neurons are highly expressive? We address this question in recurrent networks of Expressive Leaky Memory neurons, where we can independently vary neuronal complexity and the organization of feed-forward receptive fields. Across auditory and event-based visual classification tasks, receptive fields aligned with a task-relevant sensory coordinate improve test accuracy relative to budget-matched random receptive fields. This advantage disappears when sensory coordinates are scrambled, or when receptive fields follow task-irrelevant coordinates, showing that the benefit comes from alignment with task geometry rather than restricted connectivity alone. Increasing neuronal complexity reduces the performance advantage of structured receptive fields. Finally, generic synaptic sparsity regularization induces input selectivity and partially recovers performance, but remains substantially below explicitly structured receptive fields, suggesting that sparsity alone is insufficient to recover the full computational benefit of task-aligned receptive fields. Together, our results show that appropriate receptive fields can serve as a computational prior beyond sparsity itself, and that their value depends on the computational expressivity of individual neurons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Expressive Leaky Memory 神经元的循环网络中，沿任务相关感官坐标对齐的感受野相对预算相当的随机感受野提升听觉与事件相机视觉分类的测试精度；打乱坐标或改用任务无关坐标后优势消失，说明收益来自与任务几何的对齐而非稀疏连接本身。神经元复杂度越高，结构化感受野的增益越小；稀疏正则只能部分恢复，仍显著低于显式结构化感受野。
Motivation: 结构化感受野通常被解释为高效编码与布线约束的副产物，但它是否在资源效率之外带来额外计算优势、以及这一优势在单神经元表达能力很高时是否仍成立，此前没有分离验证。
Method: 构建含 Expressive Leaky Memory 神经元的循环网络，独立调节两个变量：单神经元复杂度（expressivity）与前馈感受野的组织方式（对齐、随机、打乱坐标、任务无关坐标），并以预算匹配 (budget-matched) 控制连接数；另加入通用突触稀疏正则作为对照，在听觉与基于事件的视觉分类任务上比较测试精度。
Result: 对齐任务相关感官坐标的感受野在听觉与事件视觉分类上测试精度高于预算匹配的随机感受野；坐标被打乱或感受野沿任务无关坐标组织时该优势消失；提高神经元复杂度会缩小结构化感受野的精度增益；稀疏正则可诱导输入选择性并部分恢复性能，但仍明显低于显式结构化感受野。
Conclusion: 任务对齐的感受野本身构成一种超越稀疏性的计算先验，其价值随单神经元表达能力升高而下降；单靠突触稀疏不足以恢复任务对齐感受野的全部计算收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Which Objectives Need a Dial? Predicting Objective Conflict and Covering Trade-offs in Steerable Pluralistic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: People hold diverse, sometimes conflicting values, so no single aligned model can satisfy everyone. Pluralistic alignment therefore calls for steerable models that can balance competing objectives differently. Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization (MODPO) does this by using an objective weight to span a continuum of trade-offs. We study two questions: when can one model improve two objectives simultaneously, and how can many trade-offs be covered without training a separate model for each? Across seven objective pairs from HelpSteer and UltraFeedback, two pre-training measurements predict whether objectives align or conflict for human-annotated data, but not for AI-annotated data, where response length and repetition confound reward-model scores. For broader trade-off coverage, selecting the nearest trained model and merging model parameters both help, but neither consistently matches direct training. These findings yield practical guidance for building steerable models that serve diverse preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MODPO 的目标权重连续体上，两个预训练期测量能预测 HelpSteer 与 UltraFeedback 上七组目标对在人工标注数据中是协同还是冲突，但在 AI 标注数据上失效，因为响应长度与重复会混淆 reward model 打分。覆盖权衡时，选最近已训练模型与参数合并都有帮助，但都不稳定地追平直接训练。
Motivation: 多元对齐 (pluralistic alignment) 需要一个可转向模型覆盖不同偏好的权衡，但目标何时能同时改进、以及如何不逐点训练就覆盖权衡，此前没有判据。
Method: 在 MODPO (Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization) 的目标权重连续体上研究七组目标对，数据来自 HelpSteer 与 UltraFeedback，用两个预训练期测量预测目标协同/冲突，并比较最近模型选择与参数合并两种覆盖权衡的方式。
Result: 七组目标对上，两个预训练期测量能预测人工标注数据的目标协同或冲突，但在 AI 标注数据上不成立，原因是响应长度与重复混淆 reward model 分数；覆盖权衡时最近模型选择与参数合并均有帮助，但两者都不稳定地匹配直接训练。
Conclusion: 目标冲突的可预测性依赖标注来源：人工标注可用预训练期测量预判，AI 标注需先剥离长度与重复的混淆；覆盖权衡目前仍以直接训练为最可靠路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Building Socio-Affective Artificial Intelligence for Interactive Multi-Agent Simulations
papers.abstract_en: The objective of this article is to provide design principles and a software architecture for enabling interaction between humans and multiple agents in simulated dynamic worlds. This connects the current era of general artificial intelligence (AI/AGI) with the proliferation of transformer-based conversational agents and the increased computational capabilities. Given an overview of current and previous multi-agent theories of mind (socially and affectively-aware agents), the existence of an integrative design of agent interactions with themselves and with humans must be crucial for understanding how to create sustainable and governance in future human-agent reasoning systems. In this work is presented a software "AGIMUD" that integrates: A. socially-aware reasoning and emotion in agent behavior and interaction, B. a design of human multimodal scheme for human users, artificial agents and simulated worlds, and C. distributing the AI processing through the network to enable multiple autonomous agents. These integrations allow the dynamic world recreation as multi-user dungeons (MUDs) where both agents and humans can interact simultaneously in real time. Find the code online in https://github.com/dberga/AGIMUD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AGIMUD 软件架构，把社会感知推理与情绪建模、人类多模态交互方案、以及跨网络分布的 AI 处理整合进 MUD 式动态世界，让多个人类用户与多个自主 agent 实时同场交互。论文给出设计原则与架构说明，代码在 github.com/dberga/AGIMUD 开源。
Motivation: 多 agent 理论（心智理论、社会与情绪感知）与 transformer 对话 agent 各自发展，但缺少把 agent 之间、agent 与人类之间交互统一起来的可实现设计，难以支撑未来人机推理系统的可持续性与治理。
Method: 提出设计原则加软件架构 AGIMUD，含三部分：A 为 agent 行为与交互中的社会感知推理与情绪；B 为面向人类用户、人工 agent 与模拟世界的人类多模态方案；C 为把 AI 处理分布到网络以支持多个自主 agent，整体复现为多用户地下城 (MUD) 式实时共存世界。
Result: 产出为架构与开源软件 AGIMUD（37 页、27 图、42 表），支持 agent 与人类在动态世界中实时同时交互；摘要给出定性架构描述，无定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 人机多 agent 交互可以靠一套整合社会情绪推理、多模态人类接口与网络化分布式推理的 MUD 架构来实现，作者据此给出可复用的设计原则与代码。

papers.title: Experts Rise Where LLMs Disagree: Using Cross-Model Disagreement to Target Expert Effort in LLM Codebook Revision for Large-Scale Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale text annotation brings expert insight to millions of documents, often through a codebook that AI annotators follow. Developing a robust codebook, however, takes months. Large language models (LLMs) could speed this process by applying an early codebook to the data, surfacing cases with strong LLM disagreement, and eliciting expert feedback to address them. We examined three ways experts can provide feedback for LLM codebook revision: (i) editing LLM-generated revisions driven by cross-LLM disagreement (Codebook Verifying), (ii) answering questions about LLM disagreements (Question Answering), and (iii) labeling disagreement cases with rationales (Rationale Labeling). Experiments on thousands of tutoring-session transcripts show that Rationale Labeling yielded the highest LLM-labeling accuracy (64.9%) against expert labels, outperforming the expert-revised codebook (57.8%). The best Question Answering setting also outperformed it (60.5%). Our work shows that LLMs can be used to strategically target expert attention, shortening months of codebook revision to days without sacrificing labeling performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用跨 LLM 分歧定位需要专家介入的样本，把专家反馈用于修订标注 codebook；在数千份辅导对话转录上，带理由标注 (Rationale Labeling) 得到的 LLM 标注准确率 64.9%，高于专家手工修订 codebook 的 57.8%，把数月的 codebook 修订压缩到数天。
Motivation: 大规模文本标注依赖 codebook，而稳健的 codebook 往往要数月才能打磨出来，专家时间难以规模化投放。
Method: 先用初版 codebook 跑 LLM 标注，挑出跨模型分歧强的样本，再比较三种专家反馈方式：编辑由分歧驱动的 LLM 修订建议 (Codebook Verifying)、回答关于分歧的问题 (Question Answering)、对分歧样本给出带理由的标注 (Rationale Labeling)。
Result: 在数千份 tutoring-session transcripts 上，Rationale Labeling 的 LLM 标注准确率对专家标签达 64.9%，超过专家修订 codebook 的 57.8%；最佳 Question Answering 设置为 60.5%，同样高于 57.8%。
Conclusion: LLM 分歧可以用来定向投放专家注意力，把数月的 codebook 修订缩短到数天而不牺牲标注性能；带理由的标注是三种反馈方式中效果最好的。

papers.title: nnFoundation: 3D Foundation Models for Radiology
papers.abstract_en: Radiological artificial intelligence has advanced rapidly, yet most systems remain narrowly task-specific, data-intensive, and fragile under domain shift. Foundation models promise more transferable and data-efficient solutions, but existing approaches are limited in scale, evaluated narrowly, and often assume that a single pretrained model can support diverse downstream tasks. Here we present nnFoundation, complementary convolutional and transformer-based 3D radiological foundation models. Developed within the Human Radiome Project (THRP), nnFoundation is trained on 2.1 million CT, MRI, and PET image volumes from 125 institutional and public datasets. We evaluate them across 108 tasks spanning segmentation, detection, classification, report generation, and image retrieval, including evaluations under domain shift, by external partners and in low-data and low-compute regimes. Across all task types, our convolution- and transformer-based nnFoundation models consistently outperform both prior 3D foundation models and training from scratch, establishing state-of-the-art performance for radiological imaging. However, performance follows a consistent task-dependent structure: the convolutional nnFoundation model dominates spatially localized tasks, whereas the transformer-based nnFoundation model excels in tasks requiring global semantic reasoning and in frozen-feature settings. Dynamically aligning the foundation model topology with the dataset characteristics post-hoc further improves transfer across heterogeneous 3D settings. These results show that transferable 3D radiological performance is governed not by a single universal model, but by the interplay of scalable pretraining, complementary architectures, and dataset-aware adaptation. We release nnFoundation models integrated into nnU-Net and nnDetection, enabling immediate application across established radiology workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: nnFoundation 是一对互补的 3D 放射学基础模型（卷积式与 Transformer 式），在 Human Radiome Project 中用 210 万例 CT/MRI/PET 体积、125 个数据集预训练，并在 108 项任务上全面超过既有 3D 基础模型与从零训练。性能呈任务依赖结构：卷积模型主导空间局部化任务，Transformer 模型擅长全局语义推理与 frozen-feature 设定，事后按数据集特征对齐模型拓扑可进一步提升迁移。
Motivation: 放射学 AI 多为单一任务、数据密集且在 domain shift 下脆弱；已有 3D 基础模型规模有限、评测狭窄，并默认单一预训练模型可覆盖所有下游任务。
Method: 在 THRP 内训练卷积与 Transformer 两类 3D 基础模型，预训练数据为 125 个机构与公开数据集的 210 万例 CT、MRI、PET 体积；在 108 项任务上评测，涵盖分割、检测、分类、报告生成与图像检索，并包含 domain shift、外部合作方评测、低数据与低算力设定；另做事后按数据集特征动态对齐模型拓扑的迁移策略，模型集成进 nnU-Net 与 nnDetection 发布。
Result: 在全部任务类型上，卷积式与 Transformer 式 nnFoundation 均持续优于既有 3D 基础模型与从零训练，达到放射影像 state-of-the-art；任务结构上卷积模型主导空间局部化任务，Transformer 模型在全局语义推理与 frozen-feature 设定占优；事后拓扑对齐在异构 3D 设定上进一步提升迁移。评测覆盖 108 项任务、210 万例预训练体积与 125 个数据集。
Conclusion: 可迁移的 3D 放射学性能不由单一通用模型决定，而取决于可扩展预训练、互补架构与数据集感知适配三者的交互；发布时按任务类型选卷积或 Transformer 拓扑并做事后对齐。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A 3D Pose-Based Ensemble Framework for Cricket Shot Classification and Automated Biomechanical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Cricket is one of the most celebrated sports world-wide, and technological advancement has become deeply embedded in how the modern game is analyzed and coached. Cricket shot classification and automated performance analysis add a further dimension to this trend. Traditional approaches rely on RGB video features or static images, which are sensitive to environmental variations such as camera angle, lighting, and background clutter, and often fail to capture the underlying biomechanics of batting actions. In this paper, we propose a system to improve cricket coaching that takes raw video data, extracts batsmen from video frames using YOLO, and extracts 3D pose data from video frames using MeTRAbs. The system produces sequential skeletal pose data of 30 body points and captures the biomechanical features of a batsman. As part of the system, we also propose a deep learning ensemble for shot classification of four shots: flick, pull, defense, and drive. The ensemble performed well, compared to existing classification works, achieving 97.68% accuracy. In addition, we analyzed the misclassification rates to identify cases where shots were incorrectly classified and examined their possible causes. Our proposed system allows novice players to obtain useful feedback, such as important joint angles relative to expert batsmen, which can also be useful for injury prevention. The shot classifier also helps track class-wise shots over time for further analysis. In addition to novice players, coaches can use the system for player evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 3D 姿态的板球击球动作分类与生物力学分析系统：原始视频经 YOLO 检出击球手、MeTRAbs 提取 30 个身体关键点的序列化骨架姿态，再用深度学习集成分类 flick、pull、defense、drive 四类击球，准确率达 97.68%。系统还能输出相对专家击球手的关键关节角度，供新手反馈与损伤预防参考。
Motivation: 传统击球分类依赖 RGB 视频特征或静态图像，对机位、光照、背景杂乱敏感，且难以捕捉击球动作的内在生物力学。
Method: 流水线为：原始视频帧 → YOLO 检出击球手 → MeTRAbs 回归 3D 姿态，得到 30 个身体点的序列化骨架数据；在此之上训练一个深度学习集成模型做四类击球（flick、pull、defense、drive）分类，并对误分类样本做错误率分析以定位误判原因。
Result: 四类击球分类集成模型达到 97.68% 准确率，摘要称其与已有分类工作相比表现良好；另对误分类率做了分析以识别误判案例及其可能成因。
Conclusion: 3D 姿态加集成分类可以在不依赖 RGB 外观特征的条件下完成击球分类，并把生物力学量（相对专家的关键关节角度）转成新手反馈、损伤预防与教练评估的可用输出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning from Histopathology and CT for Automated Renal Cell Carcinoma Grading
papers.abstract_en: Background: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) exhibits substantial clinical heterogeneity, and accurate grade assessment is essential for risk stratification and treatment planning. However, conventional grading requires invasive tissue sampling. We developed RCC-Align, a cross-modal contrastive learning framework that leverages paired histopathology and computed tomography (CT) data during training to improve noninvasive CT-based ccRCC grade prediction. Methods: RCC-Align aligns paired whole-slide histopathology images (WSIs) and CT scans through contrastive cross-modal objectives, transferring grade-discriminative information from microscopic tissue morphology to macroscopic radiologic representations. The framework was trained and evaluated on paired TCGA and CPTAC cohorts using patient-level five-fold cross-validation. Performance for low- versus high-grade ccRCC classification was compared against CT-only baselines (DINOv2-Base and DINOv2-Finetuned) and a WSI-based reference model (GigaPath-Finetuned). Cross-modal alignment was assessed using cosine similarity analysis. Results: RCC-Align achieved an AUC of 0.601 (95% CI, 0.524-0.673) and AUPRC of 0.599 (95% CI, 0.541-0.676), outperforming DINOv2-Finetuned (AUC 0.545; AUPRC 0.543) with significantly improved low-grade prediction (p = 0.004). RCC-Align also demonstrated stronger paired WSI-CT embedding alignment compared with baselines. The WSI-based GigaPath reference achieved an AUC of 0.719. Conclusion: Pathology-guided contrastive learning improves CT-based ccRCC grading while requiring only CT at inference. This approach may complement tissue diagnosis when biopsy is unsafe, infeasible, or limited by intratumoral heterogeneity. Validation in larger, multi-institutional cohorts with external testing is needed before clinical translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RCC-Align，用配对的全切片病理 (WSI) 与 CT 做跨模态对比学习，把分级判别信息从组织形态迁移到影像表征，推理时只需 CT。在 TCGA 与 CPTAC 配对队列的患者级五折交叉验证中，低级别 vs 高级别 ccRCC 分类 AUC 0.601（95% CI 0.524–0.673）、AUPRC 0.599（95% CI 0.541–0.676），优于 DINOv2-Finetuned 的 AUC 0.545、AUPRC 0.543，低级别预测提升显著（p = 0.004），但仍低于 WSI 参考模型 GigaPath-Finetuned 的 AUC 0.719。
Motivation: ccRCC 分级依赖侵入性取样，而肿瘤内异质性使活检受限；希望在只用 CT 的前提下获得接近病理的分级能力。
Method: RCC-Align 通过跨模态对比目标对齐配对的 WSI 与 CT 表征，把显微形态的分级信息转移到宏观影像表示；在配对 TCGA 与 CPTAC 队列上做患者级五折交叉验证，基线为 DINOv2-Base、DINOv2-Finetuned 与 WSI 参考模型 GigaPath-Finetuned，并用 cosine similarity 分析评估跨模态对齐。
Result: RCC-Align AUC 0.601（95% CI 0.524–0.673）、AUPRC 0.599（95% CI 0.541–0.676）；DINOv2-Finetuned AUC 0.545、AUPRC 0.543，低级别预测改善显著（p = 0.004）；GigaPath-Finetuned 参考 AUC 0.719；配对 WSI-CT 嵌入对齐强于各基线。
