papers.title: Bend the Clock: Predicting Ahead to Beat Latency in Event-Based Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras promise low-latency perception for high-speed robotic systems, where even short delays can render detections stale by the time they inform downstream robotic decisions. Yet modern event detectors still require tens of milliseconds of computation before their predictions become available. Conventional evaluation ignores this delay by comparing predictions with annotations at the observation timestamp, even though the scene may have changed by the time those predictions are produced. We study this observation-availability mismatch in event-based multi-object detection and show that state-of-the-art event detectors degrade substantially when evaluated at prediction availability rather than observation time. To address this, we introduce ChronoFuse, a causal availability-time detector that predicts object states for when its output becomes available rather than for when its input was observed. ChronoFuse performs causal cross-time fusion over a multi-scale feature hierarchy, combining current representations with cached temporal features to expose short-term temporal cues without using future observations. The fusion pathway is lightweight, adding only 0.17 million parameters and 0.84 ms of mean end-to-end latency overhead. ChronoFuse recovers 71% of the accuracy lost to latency on 1Mpx driving data and 90.8% under rapid drone motion on FRED, nearly restoring zero-delay performance. Under the extreme motion of EV-Flying, ChronoFuse reaches 20.95 sAP, compared with 2.25 for the strongest standard event detector (9.3x gain). These results show that predicting ahead can be critical for robots operating in fast-changing scenes, including autonomous driving, agile flight, and robotic interception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 事件相机检测器的数十毫秒计算延迟使预测产出时场景已变，按观测时刻评测会高估精度。ChronoFuse 作为因果的 availability-time 检测器，在多尺度特征层级上做跨时间融合，把输出预测到“可用时刻”而非“观测时刻”，在 EV-Flying 极端运动下达到 20.95 sAP，对比最强标准事件检测器的 2.25 提升 9.3 倍。
Motivation: 事件检测器需数十毫秒计算，而常规评测把预测与观测时刻的标注对齐，忽略 observation-availability mismatch；SOTA 检测器按预测可用时刻评测时精度大幅下降，导致下游机器人决策拿到的是过期结果。
Method: 提出 ChronoFuse：因果的 availability-time 多目标检测器，在多尺度特征层级上做 causal cross-time fusion，将当前表示与缓存的时序特征结合，只用历史信息暴露短期时序线索、不使用未来观测；融合通路轻量，仅增加 0.17M 参数与 0.84 ms 平均端到端延迟开销。
Result: 在 1Mpx 驾驶数据上追回因延迟损失精度的 71%，在 FRED 快速无人机运动下追回 90.8%，接近零延迟性能；在 EV-Flying 极端运动下达到 20.95 sAP，对比最强标准事件检测器的 2.25 为 9.3 倍提升。

papers.title: On Preference Coverage Collapse from Hindsight Relabeling in Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hindsight relabeling which retroactively replacing a transition's goal with the outcome the agent actually achieved is an effective tool for improving sample-efficiency in Reinforcement Learning (RL). A natural extension to preference-conditioned multi-objective RL (MORL) relabels transitions with the preference direction the agent achieved rather than the one asked for. We show that this extension is frequently harmful: across four preference-conditioned off-policy algorithms spanning two critic backbones and two preference-sampling schemes on the continuous-control MO-Gymnasium suite, it degrades 19 of 36 algorithm-environment settings by as much as four standard deviations, improves only one, and leaves the rest unaffected. The harm is not a symptom of noisy relabels; denoising the target recovers almost nothing, and neither prioritized sampling nor any buffer-structural choice reproduces it. Instead, repeated relabeling collapses the critic's coverage onto whatever narrow region of the preference space the agent happened to visit. We name this failure mode \emph{Preference Coverage Collapse}, and quantify it with abandoned preference mass (APM), a value-aware statistic that tracks the harm ($ρ= -0.73$) where a purely structural coverage count does not. We then introduce \texttt{her\_mix}, a single-parameter convex combination pulling the achieved direction back towards the requested preference. At one fixed value across every algorithm and environment, it returns 16 of the 19 harmed settings to baseline, preserves and even improves the one setting in which relabeling helps, and cuts abandoned preference mass from $69\%$ to $6\%$. Protecting coverage over the preference simplex, not filtering noisy relabels, is what makes hindsight relabeling safe for MORL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在偏好条件化的多目标强化学习 (MORL) 中，把 hindsight relabeling 改用实际达成的偏好方向会把 critic 的覆盖压塌到智能体碰过的狭窄偏好区域，作者称之为 Preference Coverage Collapse。在 MO-Gymnasium 上跨 4 个 off-policy 算法、2 种 critic backbone、2 种偏好采样，36 个设置中 19 个退化最多 4 个标准差、仅 1 个改善；单参数凸组合 her_mix 在所有算法与环境取同一值即可把 19 个受损设置中的 16 个恢复到基线，并把 abandoned preference mass 从 69% 降到 6%。
Motivation: 把 hindsight relabeling 自然推广到偏好条件化 MORL（用达成的偏好方向替换请求的方向）后性能反而下降，且原因不明——需要区分是噪声标签还是覆盖问题。
Method: 在连续控制 MO-Gymnasium 上测试 4 个偏好条件化 off-policy 算法、2 种 critic backbone、2 种偏好采样方案；提出 value-aware 统计量 abandoned preference mass (APM) 度量偏好单纯形覆盖损失；引入单参数凸组合 her_mix，把达成方向拉回请求偏好。
Result: 36 个算法-环境设置中 19 个退化最多 4 个标准差、仅 1 个改善、其余无影响；去噪目标几乎不恢复性能，prioritized sampling 与任何 buffer 结构选择都无法复现该伤害；APM 与伤害相关 ρ = -0.73，而纯结构覆盖计数不相关；her_mix 在全部算法与环境取同一固定值，使 19 个受损设置中的 16 个回到基线、保留并改善唯一有益的设置，APM 从 69% 降至 6%。
Conclusion: 使 hindsight relabeling 在 MORL 中安全的关键是保护偏好单纯形上的覆盖，而不是过滤噪声 relabel；her_mix 用单一参数即可在不牺牲有益情形的前提下修复覆盖塌缩。

papers.title: COMED: The Missing Middle Between Routing and Collaboration in Multi-LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: No single Large Language Model (LLM) is uniformly reliable across queries, motivating multi-model inference systems that either route among models or combine their outputs. However, routing stops after selecting an initial model, while dense collaboration invokes peers on every query. We show that collaboration is non-monotonic: peers can recover failures that no model solves alone, but can also corrupt initially correct answers. We introduce COMED (Controlled Model Escalation for Multi-LLM Deliberation), a post-anchor controller for selective cross-model collaboration. COMED uses anchor self-consistency, router margin, and a lightweight peer probe to accept confident answers, verify ambiguous cases, and escalate only when collaboration is likely beneficial. We formalize this trade-off with a rescue-harm decomposition showing that selective collaboration improves when rescued errors outweigh collaboration-induced harms. Across medical, scientific, and general reasoning benchmarks, COMED improves fixed and routed anchors in all 16 open-weight settings, with gains up to +10.7 percentage points on MedQA while invoking fewer models and using fewer decoded tokens than dense collaboration. On HLE with frontier models, COMED improves GPT-5.5 from 23.1% to 28.1%, outperforming dense collaboration and achieving the best results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMED 是多 LLM 推理的后锚定控制器：用锚点自一致性、路由置信间隔 (router margin) 和轻量 peer probe 决定接受、验证还是升级协作，只在协作可能有益时才召集其他模型。它把协作分解为 rescue-harm，指出被救回的错误超过协作引入的伤害时选择性协作才改善；在 16 个开源权重设置全部提升，MedQA 最高 +10.7 个百分点，HLE 上把 GPT-5.5 从 23.1% 提到 28.1%。
Motivation: 路由只选初始模型就停手，而稠密协作对每条查询都召集同伴：协作是非单调的，同伴既能救回单模型都答错的题，也会污染原本正确的答案，需要一个按收益选择性升级的机制。
Method: COMED (Controlled Model Escalation for Multi-LLM Deliberation) 作为 post-anchor controller：以锚点自一致性、router margin 和轻量 peer probe 三个信号决定接受高置信答案、验证模糊案例、或仅在协作可能有益时升级；并给出 rescue-harm 分解形式化这一权衡。
Result: 在医学、科学与通用推理基准上，COMED 在全部 16 个开源权重设置中同时提升固定锚点与路由锚点，MedQA 增益最高 +10.7 个百分点，且比稠密协作调用更少模型、解码 token 更少；在 HLE 上用前沿模型把 GPT-5.5 从 23.1% 提到 28.1%，超过稠密协作并取得最佳结果。
Conclusion: 选择性跨模型协作的收益取决于被救错误是否压过协作引入的伤害，按信号升级而非每题都协作能在更少调用与更少 token 下拿到更高准确率。

papers.title: TwinCheck: Evidence-Grounded Negative-Twin Verification for Stateful Tool Agents
papers.abstract_en: A single locally plausible tool call can derail an otherwise successful agent trajectory. Suspicion alone does not justify intervention, because the replacement itself can introduce the very failure verification is meant to prevent. We introduce TwinCheck, an inference-time verification policy that considers replacement only when the trace satisfies an evidence condition tied to a trace-local failure hypothesis. It constructs a trace-grounded counterfactual alternative, a negative twin, and replaces the agent's proposal only if the twin passes structural checks and the pairwise verifier prefers it in both candidate orders. For paired evaluation, exact replay holds the agent's parsed responses and actions fixed until the first accepted replacement, separating intervention effects from resampling. In the primary analysis of 159 multi-turn BFCL V4 tasks with complete exact-replay pairs, the complete policy raises task success for GPT-5.6 Sol from 45.3% to 58.5% (95% task-bootstrap CI [8.2, 18.8]), with no observed success-to-failure regressions. Together, these findings recast execution-boundary repair as a constrained comparison, making the counterfactual action itself the object of verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TwinCheck 是面向有状态工具智能体的推理时验证策略：只有当轨迹满足与局部失败假设绑定的证据条件时才考虑替换，并构造反事实的 negative twin，需同时通过结构检查且成对验证器在两种候选顺序下都偏好它才执行替换。在 159 个有完整 exact-replay 配对的多轮 BFCL V4 任务上，GPT-5.6 Sol 任务成功率从 45.3% 升到 58.5%（95% task-bootstrap CI [8.2, 18.8]），未观察到成功转失败的回退。
Motivation: 单次局部看似合理的工具调用就能毁掉整条本可成功的智能体轨迹，但仅凭怀疑就干预，替换动作本身可能引入验证本要防止的失败。
Method: 推理时策略分三步：先用绑定 trace-local 失败假设的证据条件决定是否考虑替换；再构造 trace-grounded 的反事实 negative twin；只有 twin 通过结构检查且成对验证器在两个候选顺序下都偏好它才替换。配对评估用 exact replay 固定智能体已解析的响应与动作直到首次被接受的替换，把干预效应与重采样分开。
Result: 主分析在 159 个有完整 exact-replay 配对的多轮 BFCL V4 任务上：完整策略使 GPT-5.6 Sol 任务成功率从 45.3% 提升到 58.5%，95% task-bootstrap CI 为 [8.2, 18.8]，且未观察到成功转失败的回退。
Conclusion: 执行边界上的修复应被重构为受约束的比较，把反事实动作本身当作验证对象，而非凭怀疑直接干预。

summary_sections.method: 推理时策略分三步：先用绑定 trace-local 失败假设的证据条件决定是否考虑替换；再构造 trace-grounded 的反事实 negative twin；只有 twin 通过结构检查且成对验证器在两个候选顺序下都偏好它才替换。配对评估用 exact replay 固定智能体已解析的响应与动作直到首次被接受的替换，把干预效应与重采样分开。
summary_sections.result: 主分析在 159 个有完整 exact-replay 配对的多轮 BFCL V4 任务上：完整策略使 GPT-5.6 Sol 任务成功率从 45.3% 提升到 58.5%，95% task-bootstrap CI 为 [8.2, 18.8]，且未观察到成功转失败的回退。
summary_sections.conclusion: 执行边界上的修复应被重构为受约束的比较，把反事实动作本身当作验证对象，而非凭怀疑直接干预。

papers.title: Small Cues, Big Consequences: Learning Pivotal Cues for Multimodal Meme Classification
papers.abstract_en: Memes often derive their harmful, hateful, or sarcastic meaning from small but decisive visual, textual, or cross-modal cues. Existing multimodal classifiers can miss such evidence when relying mainly on global image-text representations. We introduce MemeCF, a cue-focused benchmark of 9,895 memes across harm, hate, and sarcasm, with annotations identifying the modality and rationale of the pivotal evidence. We also propose MemePIVOT, a local-global architecture for meme classification. MemePIVOT uses frozen CLIP features, unbalanced optimal transport to align words with image patches while allowing irrelevant evidence to remain unmatched, and an evidential fusion head to combine local grounding with global meme context under uncertainty. Experiments on HarMeme, PrideMM, and MemeCF show consistent gains over strong text-only, image-only, multimodal, and vision-language baselines. Cross-dataset and ablation results further show that explicit pivotal-evidence modeling improves robustness and contributes meaningfully beyond global multimodal representations. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/AkshitSharma1/MemePIVOT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemePIVOT 用冻结 CLIP 特征加非平衡最优传输 (unbalanced optimal transport) 把词与图像 patch 对齐，允许无关证据保持未匹配，再由 evidential fusion head 在不确定性下融合局部 grounding 与全局语境。在 HarMeme、PrideMM 与自建 MemeCF（9,895 条）上相对纯文本、纯图像、多模态与视觉-语言基线均有一致增益，跨数据集与消融显示显式建模 pivotal evidence 提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 有害、仇恨或讽刺模因的含义常由很小但决定性的视觉、文本或跨模态线索承载，而现有分类器主要依赖全局图文表示，容易漏掉这类证据。
Method: 提出 MemeCF 基准（9,895 条模因，覆盖 harm、hate、sarcasm，标注关键证据的模态与 rationale）与 MemePIVOT 局部-全局架构：冻结 CLIP 特征，用非平衡最优传输对齐词与图像 patch 并允许无关证据不匹配，再用 evidential fusion head 在不确定性下合并局部 grounding 与全局语境。
Result: 在 HarMeme、PrideMM、MemeCF 上相对强文本单模态、图像单模态、多模态与视觉-语言基线取得一致增益；跨数据集迁移与消融结果表明显式 pivotal-evidence 建模带来鲁棒性，并在全局多模态表示之外贡献额外性能。
Conclusion: 模因分类的收益来自显式建模局部关键证据而非只靠全局图文表示，且这种建模能跨数据集迁移并提升鲁棒性；代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: CORE-STACK+: Meta-Learning for Deep Stacked Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Stacking heterogeneous vision backbones (CNNs, ViTs, and hybrids) is the de facto recipe for accuracy, calibration, and robustness, yet two coupled pathologies limit its returns. Prediction-space multicollinearity ill-conditions the meta-learner's Gram matrix, inflating weight variance and producing brittle solutions on a thin manifold. Calibration collapse compounds constituent miscalibration through naive linear stacking, so adding more models can hurt expected calibration error (ECE). Existing remedies, ridge regularization, greedy selection, model soups, and SWAG address at most one of these issues, and none jointly target conditioning and calibration in heterogeneous prediction pools. We introduce CORE-STACK+, a preconditioning pipeline with four components: (i) a kernelized redundancy filter that removes non-linear inter-model dependencies invisible to Pearson correlation, using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) [23]; (ii) a $<15$K-parameter differentiable meta-feature gate that learns per-sample attention over ensemble statistics; (iii) a spectrum-adaptive Ridge penalty $lambda^{star}=lmax(Chat)/SNR(Chat)$ derived from a Marchenko-Pastur signal-noise decomposition, eliminating nested cross-validation; and (iv) a Laplace-approximate Bayesian blender replacing inverse-RMSE heuristics. We prove a PAC-Bayes excess-risk bound that, for the first time, jointly accounts for prediction-space redundancy and meta-learner capacity. Across six benchmarks, CORE-STACK+ delivers $+1.8\%$ top-1 on ImageNet-1K, $-4.2$ mCE on ImageNet-C, $+0.9$ mIoU on ADE20K, and $+1.3$ AP on COCO, while reducing retained models by 35-57% and inference FLOPs by up to $41%$. ECE improves $2.1\times$ over deep ensembles without post hoc temperature scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE-STACK+ 用 CKA 冗余过滤、可微 meta-feature 门控、基于 Marchenko-Pastur 信噪分解的谱自适应 Ridge 惩罚与 Laplace 近似贝叶斯融合，联合解决异构视觉 backbone 堆叠的预测空间共线性与校准崩塌。在六个基准上 ImageNet-1K top-1 +1.8%、ImageNet-C mCE −4.2、ADE20K mIoU +0.9、COCO +1.3 AP，同时保留模型数减少 35–57%、推理 FLOPs 最多降 41%，ECE 相对 deep ensembles 改善 2.1× 且无需事后温度缩放。
Motivation: 异构视觉模型堆叠时预测空间多重共线性使 meta-learner 的 Gram 矩阵病态、权重方差膨胀，朴素线性堆叠又会叠加各成员的失准，导致加模型反而恶化 ECE；现有 ridge、贪心选择、model soups、SWAG 只能各治其一。
Method: 四组件预条件流水线：用 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 做核化冗余过滤，剔除 Pearson 相关看不见的非线性模型间依赖；用参数量 <15K 的可微 meta-feature gate 对集成统计量做逐样本注意力；由 Marchenko-Pastur 信噪分解导出谱自适应 Ridge 惩罚 λ*=lmax(Ĉ)/SNR(Ĉ)，免除嵌套交叉验证；以 Laplace 近似贝叶斯 blender 取代 inverse-RMSE 启发式。另证明一个 PAC-Bayes excess-risk 上界，同时计入预测空间冗余与 meta-learner 容量。
Result: 六个基准上：ImageNet-1K top-1 +1.8%，ImageNet-C mCE −4.2，ADE20K mIoU +0.9，COCO +1.3 AP；保留模型数减少 35–57%，推理 FLOPs 最多减少 41%；ECE 相对 deep ensembles 改善 2.1×，且不做事后温度缩放。
Conclusion: 把条件数与校准一起处理，异构视觉堆叠可以在更少模型、更低 FLOPs 下同时拿到精度与校准收益；谱自适应 Ridge 使嵌套交叉验证不再必要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ajar: Measuring Open Privilege in Agent Defenses
papers.abstract_en: A language model agent acts through the tools it is given. The data it reads while working on a task can redirect what it does with those tools. A growing set of techniques for safe and secure agent execution therefore sits between the agent and its tools, aiming to enforce access control, information flow or isolation at that boundary. Today these techniques are evaluated on agent-security benchmarks built around indirect prompt injection. Those benchmarks judge a defense by how far it brings the number of successful attacks down while preserving the agent's utility. A defense is judged only on the agent's execution. It can score well on both metrics while holding open a transfer, a deletion or a broad read that no task needed. Ajar measures that open privilege directly using the existing benchmarks. It attaches to an agent-security benchmark that already exists and reuses the tasks, tool schemas, reference solutions and goal states that benchmark uses to grade its own runs. For each benign task it builds candidate tool calls the task does not need, so allowing one is privilege left open. These calls are presented to the defense at every point where the agent could act. We evaluate Ajar by attaching it to AgentDojo, where open privilege becomes a third axis beside the existing attack success and benign utility. We run it on five defenses: Progent, CaMeL, AC4A, Permission Assistant, and Claude Code's Auto mode. We observed that they leave widely different amounts of privilege open. Two defenses leak by almost the same amount yet differ widely in the benign tasks they finish, and one defense buys part of its tightness by refusing calls its tasks were entitled to make. This open privilege cannot be derived from the measured attack success or benign utility. The source code of Ajar is available at https://github.com/reSHARMA/Ajar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ajar 在既有 agent 安全基准上直接度量防御留下的开放特权 (open privilege)：为每个良性任务构造任务本不需要的候选工具调用，在 agent 每个可行动作点交给防御判定，允许即为特权未关。挂到 AgentDojo 上对五种防御（Progent、CaMeL、AC4A、Permission Assistant、Claude Code Auto mode）评测，发现开放特权无法由攻击成功率和良性效用推出。
Motivation: 现有 agent 安全基准只用攻击成功率与良性效用两个轴评判防御，一个防御可以两项都好看，却仍放行任务并不需要的传输、删除或宽泛读取。
Method: Ajar 附着到已有的 agent 安全基准，复用其任务、工具 schema、参考解与目标状态；对每个良性任务生成任务不需要的候选工具调用，并在 agent 每个可行动作点呈现给防御，允许即记为开放特权。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 上把开放特权作为攻击成功率与良性效用之外的第三轴，评测五种防御（Progent、CaMeL、AC4A、Permission Assistant、Claude Code Auto mode）：它们留下的开放特权差异很大；两种防御泄漏量几乎相同但完成的良性任务数相差很大；一种防御的部分紧缩来自拒绝任务本有权执行的调用。
Conclusion: 开放特权是独立于攻击成功率与良性效用的第三维，必须单独测量；源码已开源。

papers.title: Harness as a Language: A Minimalist Agent Framework With Maximal Expressivity
papers.abstract_en: Modern language-model agents are built around the \textit{agent loop}, where the LLM is placed in an environment exposing a set of tools, and the LLM has full control over the workflow by alternating between tool calls and observing their output. However, certain workflows currently require additional engineering beyond the agent loop itself, such as memory systems and self-improving systems. We built an LLM agent framework, JAZ, to explore the extent to which a minimal harness that is little more than the agent loop itself can accomplish tasks these specialized systems are built for. JAZ exposes a single LLM-based primitive invoke and provides a set of built-in hooks that allow the programmer to apply constraints and monitoring. Generalizing existing code-mode agent loops, \texttt{invoke} is the simplest loop that satisfies two defining properties: (1) the LLM can write arbitrary executable code that can include recursive \texttt{invoke}; (2) everything visible to the LLM --- all inputs to \texttt{invoke} as well as its interaction history with the code environment --- are variables in the code environment. We motivate our design from first principles, viewing \texttt{invoke} as a language primitive representing a function whose implementation is provided at runtime by an LLM every time it is called. To validate the design of our core \texttt{invoke} primitive, we evaluate \texttt{invoke} --- with only prompting, no manually designed tools, harness, or external systems (e.g., memory or the file system) --- on workflows traditionally implemented through specialized external harnesses. On long-horizon workflows requiring recall beyond the context window, JAZ invoke outperforms Letta (MemGPT) by 8\% at half its cost on the recall-heavy portion of StuLife. On continual self-improvement, JAZ invoke outperforms ACE by 4\% at a lower cost on AppWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出极简 LLM agent 框架 JAZ，把 harness 收敛为单一原语 invoke：LLM 可写任意可执行代码并递归调用 invoke，且 LLM 可见的一切（invoke 入参与与代码环境的交互历史）都是代码环境中的变量。仅靠 prompt、不配手工工具或外部记忆系统，在 StuLife 召回密集部分比 Letta (MemGPT) 高 8% 且成本减半，在 AppWorld 持续自我改进上比 ACE 高 4% 且成本更低。
Motivation: 记忆系统、自我改进等能力目前要靠 agent loop 之外的专门工程实现，作者要检验一个几乎只等于 agent loop 的最小 harness 能否覆盖这些专用系统的任务。
Method: JAZ 暴露单一基于 LLM 的原语 invoke 与一组内置 hooks（供施加约束与监控）；invoke 是最简循环，满足两条性质：LLM 可写含递归 invoke 的任意可执行代码，且 invoke 的全部输入与代码环境交互历史都以变量形式对 LLM 可见。设计从第一性原理解释为运行时由 LLM 提供实现的函数；评测时仅用 prompt，不配手工工具、harness 或外部记忆/文件系统。
Result: 在需要超出上下文窗口召回的长程工作流上，JAZ invoke 在 StuLife 召回密集部分比 Letta (MemGPT) 高 8%、成本为其一半；在持续自我改进工作流上，JAZ invoke 在 AppWorld 上比 ACE 高 4% 且成本更低。
Conclusion: 一个只比 agent loop 多一点的最小 harness，配合 invoke 原语与 hooks，足以胜任原本要靠外部记忆与自我改进专用系统实现的工作流。

papers.title: PR-Smoother: Simulator-Preserving Non-Gaussian Smoothing for Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Many physical data assimilation (DA) workflows require smoothing methods that represent non-Gaussian posteriors over physical state variables, scale to high-dimensional simulators, train from observation windows alone, and remain compatible with calibration of the prescribed simulator. We introduce PR-Smoother, a simulator-preserving amortized smoother designed for this prescribed-simulator DA regime. Its key design principle is to keep the prescribed simulator explicit in both the evidence lower bound and the variational family: rather than learning replacement dynamics or a learned trajectory prior, PR-Smoother learns only future-conditioned corrections around the prescribed rollout. This yields an explicit non-Gaussian smoothing distribution over physical trajectories and supports joint state, parameter, and sensor-bias learning from observations alone. The variational family contains the exact smoother in deterministic and linear-Gaussian limits. Empirically, PR-Smoother captures multimodal posteriors in 4-dimensional Lorenz-96, remains accurate under ambiguous nonlinear observations and process noise in 40-dimensional Lorenz-96, and scales to joint state-parameter-bias inference in 16,384-dimensional Kolmogorov flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PR-Smoother 是一种保留给定模拟器的摊销平滑器 (simulator-preserving amortized smoother)：在 ELBO 与变分族中都显式保留 prescribed rollout，只学习未来条件下的修正项，从而得到物理轨迹上的显式非高斯平滑分布，并支持仅凭观测窗联合推断状态、参数与传感器偏差。其变分族在确定性与线性高斯极限下包含精确平滑器；在 4 维 Lorenz-96 上捕捉多峰后验，在 40 维 Lorenz-96 上于含歧义非线性观测与过程噪声时保持准确，并扩展到 16,384 维 Kolmogorov flow 的状态-参数-偏差联合推断。

papers.title: Additive Nonparametric Regression with Spatial and Network Objects
papers.abstract_en: This article is motivated by an imaging application from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, aiming to predict task-based brain activation maps from t-fMRI using cortical metrics from structural MRI (s-MRI) and brain connectivity data from resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI). Hierarchical Bayesian modeling is well-suited for integrating diverse imaging data and quantifying prediction uncertainty. However, progress in this field is limited due to challenges in designing joint priors that capture the structures and interconnections between different imaging modalities, along with computational complexity and lack of theoretical assurances. To address these challenges, the article introduces a novel regression framework that treats t-fMRI and s-MRI images as functional data, incorporating additive non-linear effects of both network and functional predictors on the functional response. Specifically, we employ Gaussian process (GP) priors on coefficients related to the functional predictors to capture their intricate functional dependencies with the response. Furthermore, a GP prior is assigned to encapsulate the non-linear nodal effects of the network predictor on the response function. The method is supported by theoretical results on predictive accuracy for the functional response, and is empirically validated through simulation studies and analysis of multi-modal neuroimaging data from the ABCD study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个加性非参数回归框架，把 t-fMRI 与 s-MRI 视作函数型数据，用高斯过程 (GP) 先验分别刻画函数预测元系数与网络预测元的非线性节点效应，用于从结构 MRI 皮层指标和静息态 fMRI 连接数据预测任务态 fMRI 脑激活图。方法带有函数响应预测精度的理论结果，并在模拟研究与 ABCD 多模态神经影像数据上得到实证验证。
Motivation: 分层贝叶斯虽适合整合多模态影像并量化预测不确定性，但设计能同时捕捉不同模态间结构与关联的联合先验困难、计算复杂度高、且缺少理论保证，制约了该领域进展。
Method: 将 t-fMRI 与 s-MRI 图像作为函数型数据，模型含函数预测元与网络预测元的加性非线性效应；对函数预测元相关系数施加 GP 先验以刻画其与响应的函数依赖，对网络预测元的非线性节点效应另设 GP 先验。
Result: 给出函数响应预测精度的理论结果，并通过模拟研究与 ABCD 研究的多模态神经影像数据分析进行实证验证；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 以加性 GP 先验分解函数与网络两类预测元的效应，可在保留分层贝叶斯不确定性量化的同时提供预测精度理论保证，适用于多模态脑影像预测。

papers.title: Marginally Correct Tool Caches Can Reverse Group-Normalized Policy Updates
papers.abstract_en: Tool-result caching reduces repeated execution in agent training, but also couples rollout randomness. We study a two-action model in which independent and shared execution preserve every rollout's conditional reward distribution. Despite this marginal agreement, sharing one stochastic result per group can reverse the expected group-normalized policy update. We derive an exact finite-group expression: against a constant alternative, the shared update follows the probability of winning minus the probability of losing, rather than the difference in expected reward. A Bernoulli specialization yields a wrong-direction region and a non-vanishing update-variance floor as group size grows. Centering without group standard-deviation scaling preserves the expected-return direction in this model, using an existing estimator control. Exhaustive finite sums verify 540 configurations and 3,240 estimator evaluations, with a separate ordered-sequence checker. An implementation audit reproduces the sharing path in a pinned, unmodified TVCache stack using 256 scripted rollouts. These results do not measure language-model training performance or refute TVCache's deterministic-output contract. They establish that marginal output validity alone cannot certify a stochastic cache as training-equivalent.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/shi1720/tool-cache-coupling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具结果缓存把同一组 rollout 共享一个随机执行结果，即使每个 rollout 的条件奖励分布与独立执行完全一致，也会反转 group-normalized 策略更新的期望方向。在两动作模型中，共享更新按「赢的概率减输的概率」而非期望奖励之差走，随组增大还留下不消失的更新方差下限；去掉组内标准差缩放、只做中心化即可保住期望回报方向。
Motivation: Agent 训练里用工具结果缓存省重复执行会把原本独立的 rollout 随机性耦合起来，而缓存的「边缘输出有效」并不足以说明它对训练等价，组归一化更新可能因此变号。
Method: 构造两动作模型，推导共享执行下 group-normalized 更新的精确有限组表达式（对常数备择为赢概率减输概率），并给出 Bernoulli 特化以定位方向反转区与方差下限；用穷举有限和验证 540 个配置、3,240 次估计器求值，另配独立的有序序列检查器，并在固定未改动的 TVCache 栈上以 256 条脚本化 rollout 复现共享路径。
Result: 穷举验证覆盖 540 个配置与 3,240 次估计器求值，另有独立有序序列检查器；实现审计在 pinned、未改动的 TVCache 栈上用 256 条 scripted rollouts 复现共享路径。Bernoulli 特化给出一个方向反转区，且组增大时更新方差存在不消失的下限；仅中心化而不除以组标准差在此模型中保持期望回报方向。
Conclusion: 边缘输出有效不足以把随机缓存认证为训练等价，组归一化更新在共享随机结果下会变号；在该模型中用中心化替代组标准差缩放可保住方向。这些结果不测量语言模型训练性能，也不反驳 TVCache 的确定性输出契约。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Safety Nudges: User-Facing Interventions for Real-Time AI Risk Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems can pose safety risks to their users such as hallucination, sycophancy, overconfidence, and anthropomorphism, but these risks are difficult for users to detect during everyday use. We introduce Safety Nudges, a browser-based tool that provides lightweight, in situ flags when concerning behavior is detected in chatbot conversations. We evaluated Safety Nudges in a two-week field study with 45 frequent chatbot users, collecting interaction logs, surveys, and feedback on individual nudges. Participants found the tool useful, clear, and minimally disruptive, with nearly all users reporting an increased awareness of potential AI harms, though we found that this improved awareness alone did not necessarily lead to discernible behavioral changes. Our results suggest that user facing safety nudges can complement model-level safeguards by helping people critically evaluate AI responses in context, while highlighting the importance of relevance, calibration, and user control in nudge design for conversational AI safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Safety Nudges 是一个浏览器端工具，在聊天对话中就地标记幻觉、谄媚、过度自信和拟人化等风险行为。对 45 名高频聊天机器人用户的两周实地研究显示，几乎所有用户都报告 AI 危害意识提升，但意识提升本身并未带来可辨识的行为改变。
Motivation: 对话式 AI 的幻觉、谄nish、过度自信与拟人化风险在日常使用中难以被用户自行察觉，仅靠模型侧防护无法让用户在具体语境中批判性评估回答。
Method: 提出浏览器端工具 Safety Nudges，在检测到可疑对话行为时给出轻量、就地 (in situ) 的提示标记；以两周实地研究评估，参与者为 45 名高频聊天机器人用户，收集交互日志、问卷调查和针对单条 nudge 的反馈。
Result: 45 名高频用户的两周实地研究中，参与者认为工具有用、清晰且干扰极小，几乎所有用户报告对 AI 潜在危害的意识提升；但这种意识提升本身未带来可辨识的行为改变。
Conclusion: 面向用户的安全 nudge 可作为模型级防护的补充，帮助人们在语境中批判性评估 AI 回答；nudge 设计的关键在于相关性、校准和用户控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Static Embedding Models for HTTP Request Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Web applications are increasingly targeted by cyberattacks that exploit HTTP requests to evade security mechanisms. Traditional web application firewalls (WAFs) rely on rule-based approaches that often exhibit high false positive rates and limited adaptability. Recent studies have explored machine learning techniques and word embedding models to improve anomaly detection in HTTP traffic. This paper presents a benchmark for static embedding models, specifically Word2Vec, FastText, and Doc2Vec, within a unified, single-class classification framework. We propose HEDA (HTTP Embedding-Based Detection Architecture), a modular detection pipeline that combines static embedding representations with single-class anomaly detection models to detect anomalies at the request level. The approach operates in an unsupervised environment, where both the embedding models and detectors are trained exclusively on benign HTTP traffic. The proposed methodology is evaluated on three datasets with heterogeneous characteristics, including both synthetic and real traffic. The experimental results show that the choice of embedding representation significantly affects detection performance, and that FastText-based embeds produce the most consistent results across all datasets, achieving high detection rates while keeping false positive rates under control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HEDA（HTTP Embedding-Based Detection Architecture）：用 Word2Vec、FastText、Doc2Vec 静态词向量加单类异常检测器，在仅用良性 HTTP 流量训练的无监督框架下做请求级异常检测。在合成与真实共三个异构数据集上，嵌入表示的选择显著影响检测性能，其中 FastText 嵌入跨数据集最一致，在保持误报率受控的同时取得高检测率。
Motivation: 针对利用 HTTP 请求规避安全机制的 Web 攻击，传统规则型 WAF 误报率高、适应性差，已有 ML 与词嵌入方案缺少统一可比的评测框架。
Method: 构建统一的单类分类 (single-class) 基准，对比 Word2Vec、FastText、Doc2Vec 三种静态嵌入；HEDA 为模块化流水线，将嵌入表示与单类异常检测模型组合做请求级检测，嵌入与检测器均只在良性 HTTP 流量上训练（无监督）。
Result: 在三个特性异构的数据集（含合成与真实流量）上评测：嵌入表示的选择显著影响检测性能；FastText 嵌入在全部数据集上结果最一致，取得高检测率同时把误报率控制在较低水平。
Conclusion: 在仅用良性数据训练的 HTTP 异常检测中，嵌入表示的选择是关键变量，FastText 是三个静态嵌入里跨数据集最稳的选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLINT: Fast Lightweight Inference for Traversability
papers.abstract_en: Navigation in off-road conditions is challenging due to the lack of structure. There is no fixed vocabulary for what is traversable. The traversability depends on both the environment and the embodiment's dynamics. Neither of these two variables can be hand-labeled at scale. Thus, traversability has to be learned by the embodiment's own experience. Modern platforms tend to use multiple sensors to estimate traversability and navigate: RGBD cameras, lidar, radar, IMU, with computationally intensive platforms to run inference on neural networks. Against this trend, we propose FLINT, a lightweight traversability estimator: a 21.6M-parameter backbone, 38\times smaller than a comparable foundation-model backbone, that scores higher on held-out terrain probes and runs at 14.7 FPS on CPU alone using a RGB camera has the only sensor. Despite that gap in scale, FLINT produces a cheaper, more accurate costmap than a deployed foundation-model system (WildOS) on 23 of 24 replayed field logs. We compare different self-supervised learning signals and deploy the resulting models on a real platform in closed-loop field trials: the best self-supervised head reaches 99% autonomy over the route, outperforming a human-label-trained baseline deployed live on the same course. Our results show that heavy sensing and computing are not necessary for traversability estimation.

papers.title: QUARTET: Quad-branch cross-Attention and Random-walk Traces for Enhancing Transformers on Relational Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-table databases as heterogeneous temporal graphs, and graph transformers currently achieve state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like RelBench. However, the current leading model, RelGT, suffers from two key limitations: its random local sampler yields loosely connected subgraphs that hinder message passing, and its global attention module relies on a single, seed-feature-based memory that ignores broader macro-level dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we introduce QUARTET, an expressive graph transformer architecture that applies full self-attention on local subgraphs while enriching global context through cross-attention branches. Specifically, QUARTET employs a Causal Random Walk (CRW) sampler based on recency-truncated Personalized PageRank (PPR) to extract compact, hub-robust, and densely connected local subgraphs without temporal leakage. Concurrently, a quad-branch cross-attention module integrates global context from four complementary perspectives: seed feature, seed topology, temporal dynamics, and collaborative dynamics. Across the RelBench v1 classification tasks, QUARTET consistently matches or outperforms the current state-of-the-art graph transformer baselines (HGT and RelGT). Ablation studies confirm that the CRW sampler significantly enriches local neighborhood quality, while the global branches provide essential, task-specific predictive gains.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for main conference track at Learning on Graphs (LoG) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QUARTET 针对 RelBench 上关系图 Transformer 的两个短板提出改进：用基于时间截断 Personalized PageRank 的 Causal Random Walk (CRW) 采样器替换随机局部采样，得到紧凑、抗 hub、稠密且无时间泄漏的子图；再用四分支 cross-attention（seed feature、seed topology、temporal dynamics、collaborative dynamics）补足全局上下文。在 RelBench v1 分类任务上与 HGT、RelGT 基线持平或更优，消融显示 CRW 显著改善局部邻域质量、各全局分支带来任务相关的增益。
Motivation: RelBench 上领先的 RelGT 有两个瓶颈：随机局部采样得到的子图连接松散、阻碍消息传递；全局注意力只用基于 seed feature 的单一 memory，忽略宏观层面的动态。
Method: CRW 采样器用 recency-truncated Personalized PageRank 抽取局部子图，保证时间上无泄漏；局部子图上跑 full self-attention，同时用 quad-branch cross-attention 从 seed feature、seed topology、temporal dynamics、collaborative dynamics 四个互补视角注入全局上下文。
Result: 在 RelBench v1 分类任务上，QUARTET 与当前 SOTA 图 Transformer 基线 HGT 和 RelGT 持平或更优；消融研究显示 CRW 采样器显著提升局部邻域质量，四个全局分支提供任务相关的预测增益。
Conclusion: 局部子图的连通质量与多视角全局上下文是关系图 Transformer 性能的关键，二者需同时设计；CRW 采样加四分支 cross-attention 是在 RelBench 上有效的组合。

papers.title: SsgCaps: A controlled dataset for the evaluation of sound scene generation algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Sound Scene Generation is about the automatic synthesis of artificial sound scenes. We introduce SsgCaps, a publicly available dataset of human-engineered sound scenes wherein each scene matches a precisely structured prompt that guides the sampling process. The corresponding prompts are sampled from a predefined action-based typology that allows extensive sampling while retaining plausibility. SsgCaps is a sound scene dataset derived from the unpublished reference dataset for Task 7 of the 2024 DCASE Challenge edition, which contained private-and public-domain audio samples. In contrast, SsgCaps contains only public-domain audio samples, allowing us to open this dataset to the community. To make this dataset useful to the community, we first elaborate on the rationale for the prompt and dataset structure. We then perform a comparative quantitative analysis of the 2 versions of the dataset. To do so, we compare both versions to the audio synthesized by the SSG algorithms submitted to the challenge using Fr{é}chet Audio Distance (FAD) and Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) as well as perceptual ratings. This analysis shows only small differences, which enables us to recommend the open version for further benchmarking of SSG algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SsgCaps 是一个公开的声音场景生成 (Sound Scene Generation) 数据集，场景由基于动作的类型学 (action-based typology) 采样出的结构化 prompt 精确约束，仅含公有领域音频。与 DCASE 2024 Task 7 未公开的参考数据集相比，用 Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD)、Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) 和感知评分比较两版数据集及参赛 SSG 算法合成音频，差异很小，因此推荐用公开版做后续 SSG 基准评测。
Motivation: DCASE 2024 Task 7 的参考数据集含私有音频无法公开，声音场景生成算法缺少可共享、prompt 结构可控的评测基准。
Method: 从 DCASE 2024 Task 7 未公开参考集出发，剔除私有音频、保留公有领域样本构建 SsgCaps；场景由预定义 action-based typology 采样的结构化 prompt 引导采样；用 FAD、KAD 与感知评分对两个版本数据集和挑战赛提交的 SSG 算法合成音频做对比定量分析。
Result: 两版数据集与 SSG 算法合成音频在 FAD、KAD 和感知评分上的差异很小。
Conclusion: 公开版 SsgCaps 与原参考集等效，推荐用它做 SSG 算法的后续基准评测。

papers.title: COPE: Continual Personalization of LLMs under Sparse User Feedback via User Embeddings and Self-Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable results across various benchmarks, their alignment with normative values often results in homogenized responses that fail to address diverse user preferences. Existing training-free methods often occupy valuable context windows through prompt engineering, while training-based methods typically remain static post-training, failing to support the continual optimization required in real-world settings. To address these challenges, we propose COPE (Continual Optimization with Personalized embedding and self-Evaluation), a novel optimization framework tailored for real-world-motivated interaction settings with sparse user feedback. Our framework assigns learnable personalized embeddings to each user and synergistically integrates preference capture, self-evaluation calibration, and personalized response optimization within a single update step. A key innovation of our method is the use of self-evaluation to generate proxy rewards, enabling continuous model updates even when explicit user feedback is unavailable. Experiments show that COPE consistently outperforms strong training-free and training-based baselines under sparse feedback, and remains complementary to Retrieval-Augmented Prompting (RAP). Further analyses confirm COPE's reliable self-evaluation, meaningful preference patterns, stable general capabilities, and robustness under shifting preferences and alternative evaluators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COPE 为每个用户分配可学习的个性化 embedding，把偏好捕获、自评估校准与个性化响应优化合到单步更新里，并用自评估生成 proxy reward，在显式反馈缺失时仍可持续更新模型。在稀疏反馈设定下 COPE 稳定超过强 training-free 与 training-based 基线，且与 RAP 互补。
Motivation: 对齐训练让 LLM 输出同质化，难以覆盖多样用户偏好；现有 training-free 方法占用上下文窗口，training-based 方法训练后即静态，无法支撑真实场景中持续的偏好优化。
Method: COPE（Continual Optimization with Personalized embedding and self-Evaluation）给每个用户分配可学习的个性化 embedding，在单个更新步内协同整合偏好捕获、自评估校准与个性化响应优化；关键设计是用 self-evaluation 生成 proxy reward，从而在无显式用户反馈时也能持续更新。
Result: 实验显示 COPE 在稀疏反馈下持续优于强 training-free 与 training-based 基线，并与 Retrieval-Augmented Prompting (RAP) 互补；进一步分析确认其自评估可靠、偏好模式有意义、通用能力稳定，并在偏好漂移与替代评估器下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 以自评估充当 proxy reward 的持续个性化优化，可在稀疏甚至缺失显式反馈时替代静态后训练，且不牺牲通用能力、可与检索增强提示叠加。

papers.title: A Leakage-Aware Multimodal Evaluation Framework for Early Intraoperative Acute Kidney Injury Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Postoperative acute kidney injury (AKI) after major non-cardiac surgery carries substantial morbidity, yet early intraoperative risk stratification remains difficult. In this retrospective cohort study, we propose SynerT, a waveform-only hybrid temporal backbone that combines a causal dilated TCN with a hierarchy of dilated recurrent layers to encode early intraoperative physiologic trajectories for AKI risk prediction. Building on SynerT, we further design two model variants that extend the backbone with structured clinical context: SynerT-MM, a late-fusion multimodal extension that integrates hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerTStack, a leakage-safe stacked ensemble that combines cross-validated predictions from SynerT-MM with strong tabular baselines at the meta-learning stage. All models are evaluated under a strict leakage-aware framework on VitalDB, a high-fidelity perioperative database, with prediction restricted to information available within the first 60 intraoperative minutes. Among 2,413 waveform-usable cases (180 AKI-positive; 7.46% prevalence), SynerT fell well below strong structured-data baselines, demonstrating that waveform-only temporal modeling is insufficient under strict early constraints. SynerTMM recovered discrimination by incorporating hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerT-Stack achieved the best overall performance across AUROC, AUPRC, and F1-max. Cross-fitted Platt recalibration substantially corrected calibration defects in both multimodal variants, and decision-curve analysis confirmed the recalibrated stacked model delivered the strongest net clinical benefit across low-to-intermediate thresholds.
papers.comment: accepted on Conference on Optimization, Modeling, Simulation, and Analytics (COMOSA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 VitalDB 上做术后急性肾损伤 (AKI) 术中早期预测，纯波形模型 SynerT（因果空洞 TCN + 空洞递归层）在严格防泄漏框架下明显弱于结构化数据基线；加入血流动力学负荷摘要与术前协变量的 SynerT-MM 恢复判别力，堆叠集成 SynerTStack 在 AUROC、AUPRC、F1-max 上整体最佳，且经 cross-fitted Platt 再校准后在低到中阈值区间净临床获益最强。
Motivation: 重大非心脏手术后 AKI 发病率高，但术中早期风险分层困难；同时该领域容易因信息泄漏高估性能，需要在只用术中前 60 分钟信息的严格约束下评估。
Method: 回顾性队列研究，提出 SynerT：因果空洞 TCN 与多层空洞递归层 (dilated recurrent layers) 组成的混合时序骨干，仅编码术中生理波形轨迹；SynerT-MM 以晚期融合 (late fusion) 加入血流动力学负荷摘要和术前协变量；SynerTStack 在元学习阶段把 SynerT-MM 的交叉验证预测与表格基线堆叠，并用 cross-fitted Platt 再校准，全部在严格 leakage-aware 框架下评估。
Result: 数据为 VitalDB 中 2,413 例可用波形病例，AKI 阳性 180 例，患病率 7.46%，预测限于术中前 60 分钟信息。纯波形 SynerT 明显低于强结构化数据基线；SynerT-MM 恢复判别力；SynerTStack 在 AUROC、AUPRC、F1-max 上整体最佳；Platt 再校准显著修正两个多模态变体的校准缺陷，决策曲线分析确认再校准后的堆叠模型在低到中阈值区间净临床获益最强。
Conclusion: 在严格的早期时间窗约束下，纯波形时序建模不足以做术中 AKI 风险分层，必须融合结构化临床上下文并配合再校准，才能获得可用的判别力与净临床获益。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 数据为 VitalDB 中 2,413 例可用波形病例，AKI 阳性 180 例，患病率 7.46%，预测限于术中前 60 分钟信息。纯波形 SynerT 明显低于强结构化数据基线；SynerT-MM 恢复判别力；SynerTStack 在 AUROC、AUPRC、F1-max 上整体最佳；Platt 再校准显著修正两个多模态变体的校准缺陷，决策曲线分析确认再校准后的堆叠模型在低到中阈值区间净临床获益最强。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在严格的早期时间窗约束下，纯波形时序建模不足以做术中 AKI 风险分层，必须融合结构化临床上下文并配合再校准，才能获得可用的判别力与净临床获益。

papers.title: Gaussian-process surrogate indicators for residual-based adaptive GMsFEM
papers.abstract_en: Residual-based adaptive GMsFEM for high-contrast elliptic problems repeatedly evaluates local weighted $H^{-1}$ indicators on every coarse neighborhood, making indicator evaluation a recurring cost in repeated-query settings. We introduce a non-intrusive Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate for the indicator scores used in Dörfler marking. The operational predictor is the GP posterior mean, algebraically equivalent to a kernel ridge regression (KRR) estimator under the stated convention; it uses compressed local solution and spectral features without changing the multiscale solve, local spectral construction, or basis enrichment. A nonuniform perturbed-marking result quantifies how pointwise score errors affect the exact indicator mass captured by surrogate-selected neighborhoods, while a conditional bounded-discrepancy KRR pathway identifies sufficient assumptions for such score bounds. In controlled held-out in-distribution tests, the surrogate-guided method gives error-versus-DoF trends comparable with classical $H^{-1}$-residual offline adaptivity and evaluates the online indicator component 2.0-2.1 times faster, excluding offline data generation and GP training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高对比度椭圆问题的残差自适应 GMsFEM 中局部加权 H^{-1} 指标反复求值的开销，提出非侵入式 GP 代理替代指标分数用于 Dörfler 标记，不改动多尺度求解、局部谱构造与基加密。在受控的 held-out 同分布测试中，代理引导方法的误差-自由度趋势与经典 H^{-1} 残差离线自适应相当，在线指标部分提速 2.0–2.1 倍（不含离线数据生成与 GP 训练）。
Motivation: 残差自适应 GMsFEM 在重复查询场景下需在每个粗邻域上反复计算局部加权 H^{-1} 指标，指标求值成为持续开销。
Method: 用非侵入式 Gaussian-process (GP) 代理预测 Dörfler 标记所用的指标分数；操作预测器取 GP 后验均值，在所述约定下代数等价于 kernel ridge regression (KRR)，输入为压缩的局部解与谱特征，不改变多尺度求解、局部谱构造或基加密。另给出非均匀扰动标记结果，量化逐点分数误差对代理所选邻域捕获的精确指标质量的影响，并给出条件性有界偏差 KRR 路径以确定分数误差界的充分假设。
Result: 在受控 held-out 同分布测试中，代理引导方法的误差-自由度 (error-versus-DoF) 趋势与经典 H^{-1} 残差离线自适应相当，在线指标求值提速 2.0–2.1 倍（不含离线数据生成与 GP 训练）。
Conclusion: 用 GP 后验均值（等价 KRR）替代在线 H^{-1} 指标求值，可在不改动多尺度求解流程的前提下保持自适应精度并显著降低在线开销，其正确性由扰动标记结果与有界偏差 KRR 假设支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuroRule: Making Black-Box Neural Networks Explainable through Rule-set Evolution
papers.abstract_en: High-capacity neural network models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse classification tasks, yet they frequently operate as black-box models, lacking the transparency necessary for critical decision-making. Such opacity creates a persistent trade-off between performance and explainability. This paper proposes a solution to address this gap: the NeuroRule knowledge distillation framework that results in explainable rule-sets from neural network models. NeuroRule adapts the EVOTER rule-set evolution infrastructure to treat neural networks as targets for the evolution process, distilling their performance into concise sets of propositional logic expressions. There are three primary contributions: (1) an evolutionary method for distilling black-box neural network models into explicit rule-set models; (2) a method for making rule sets more explainable by including a conciseness objective to evolution; and (3) a demonstration that the distillation is viable even without access to the original neural network training data. The paper thus establishes that black-box neural network models can be made explainable and therefore useful in real-world applications where trustworthiness is paramount.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroRule 用 EVOTER 规则集进化把黑盒神经网络蒸馏成简洁的命题逻辑规则集，并在进化目标中加入简洁性项以提升可解释性；摘要称即使拿不到原网络的训练数据，这种蒸馏依然可行。
Motivation: 高容量神经网络在分类任务上性能强但缺乏透明度，性能与可解释性之间存在持续取舍，关键决策场景难以信任。
Method: 在 EVOTER 规则集进化框架上把神经网络本身作为进化的打分目标（知识蒸馏），输出简洁的命题逻辑规则集；进化目标额外加入简洁性 (conciseness) 项，并支持在无法访问原网络训练数据的条件下进行蒸馏。
Result: 摘要给出三项贡献的定性结论：进化式蒸馏黑盒网络为显式规则集可行；加入简洁性目标可让规则集更易解释；在没有原网络训练数据时蒸馏依然可行。
Conclusion: 黑盒神经网络可以通过规则集进化变得可解释，从而适用于信任度要求高的真实场景；无训练数据访问的设定下蒸馏同样成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LWCal: Loss-Weighted Calibration for Tabular Classifiers with Noisy Calibration Labels
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc probability calibration is usually evaluated under an optimistic assumption: the held-out calibration labels are clean. In many AI deployment settings, however, labels come from weak annotators, historical decisions, heuristics, or distant supervision, so the same label noise that corrupts training also corrupts calibration. We study this overlooked failure mode for tabular classifiers and propose LWCal, a CPU-only post-hoc calibrator that down-weights calibration examples whose noisy labels are contradicted by the base model's held-out probability. LWCal requires no clean validation labels, no noise-rate estimate, and no retraining of the base classifier. A second variant, Gated-LWCal, adds a conservative disagreement gate that backs off toward the raw score when the calibration split appears extremely inconsistent. On nine local binary tabular tasks, six random seeds, symmetric and asymmetric label corruption, and three tree-based base learners, LWCal obtains the lowest average calibration error while Gated-LWCal obtains the best average proper-score tradeoff. In the main random-forest study over 432 noisy cells, Gated-LWCal reduces expected calibration error from 0.188 to 0.122 and negative log likelihood from 0.438 to 0.396 relative to the raw classifier. Paired bootstrap intervals for Gated-LWCal versus raw, Platt, isotonic, and beta calibration exclude zero on ECE, Brier score, and NLL. The artifact contains all scripts, result tables, figures, and the compiled paper.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LWCal 是面向表格分类器的 CPU-only 事后概率校准器，按基模型在留出集上的概率与噪声标签是否矛盾来降权校准样本，无需干净验证标签、噪声率估计或重训基模型；Gated-LWCal 再加一个保守的分歧门控，在校准划分极不一致时退回原始分数。在随机森林主实验的 432 个含噪单元上，Gated-LWCal 把 ECE 从 0.188 降到 0.122、NLL 从 0.438 降到 0.396。
Motivation: 事后校准通常假设留出的校准标签是干净的，但实际部署中标签来自弱标注、历史决策、启发式或远程监督，同样的标签噪声既污染训练也污染校准，这一失效模式在表格分类上被忽视。
Method: LWCal 对与基模型留出概率相矛盾的含噪校准样本降权，只用 CPU 做事后校准，不需干净验证标签、噪声率估计或重训基分类器；Gated-LWCal 增加保守的 disagreement gate，当校准划分极不一致时退回原始分数。评测覆盖 9 个本地二分类表格任务、6 个随机种子、对称与非对称标签破坏、3 种树模型基学习器。
Result: LWCal 取得最低的平均校准误差，Gated-LWCal 取得最好的平均 proper-score 权衡；随机森林主实验 432 个含噪单元上 Gated-LWCal 相对原始分类器把 ECE 从 0.188 降到 0.122、NLL 从 0.438 降到 0.396；对 raw、Platt、isotonic、beta calibration 的配对 bootstrap 区间在 ECE、Brier score、NLL 上均不含零。
Conclusion: 校准标签本身含噪时，用基模型概率对校准样本做损失加权、并在极端不一致时门控回退，即可在不需干净标签的前提下同时改善校准误差与 proper score。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Outcome, Different Readout: What Does a Steerable Valence Direction in LLMs Represent?
papers.abstract_en: Decodability and successful activation steering do not, by themselves, establish what an internal direction represents. This gap is especially consequential for welfare-relevant interpretations, where a proposed functional state must be distinguished from correlated features of the extraction contrast. We study this question for a good-bad outcome direction in a maze task, using controlled interventions that separate the realised outcome from the informational history through which it became known. Across multiple LLM checkpoints, directions fitted on one explicit outcome encoding transfer well to another, indicating that the readout is not tied to surface form. In contrast, when the same realised outcome is reached through announced and unannounced histories, transfer degrades substantially: even after both histories receive the same explicit outcome, the post-event readout remains strongly conditioned on the earlier announcement. In a matched maze-RL run, the post-RL direction becomes substantially more predictive of reference-MDP remaining return and the policy becomes more dependent on it at the tested sites, while this history dependence persists. These results support a functional, value-related interpretation of the direction, but not its identification with a history-invariant scalar valence state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可操控的 valence 方向在 LLM 中读出的是与价值相关的功能状态，但不是与历史无关的标量效价：方向在两种显式结果编码之间迁移良好，而同一结果经公告与未公告历史到达时迁移显著退化，事后读出仍强烈受先前公告制约。作者据此主张功能-价值解释，反对把该方向直接等同于 history-invariant scalar valence state。
Motivation: 可解码性与激活操控成功本身并不能确立内部方向代表什么；在 welfare 相关解释中，必须把真正的功能状态与提取对比中相关联的表面特征区分开。
Method: 在迷宫任务的 good-bad outcome 方向上做受控干预，把实际结果 (realised outcome) 与得知结果的信息历史 (informational history) 分离；跨多个 LLM checkpoint 比较方向在不同显式结果编码间、以及公告/未公告历史间的迁移，并在配对的 maze-RL run 中检验事后方向与策略依赖。
Result: 方向在一种显式结果编码上拟合后迁移到另一种表现良好，说明读出不绑定表面形式；同一结果经公告与未公告历史到达时迁移显著退化，即使两段历史都得到相同的显式结果，事后读出仍强烈受先前公告影响；在配对 maze-RL run 中，事后方向对 reference-MDP remaining return 的预测性显著增强，策略在被测位点对该方向的依赖加深，而历史依赖依旧存在。
Conclusion: 结果支持该方向的功能性、价值相关解释，但不支持把它认定为与历史无关的标量效价状态；历史依赖在 RL 后仍然持续。

papers.title: Locally Private Inference for Riemannian Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We develop inference for manifold-valued population minimizers when each observation belongs to a different participant and only locally private messages reach the analyst. The method releases randomized tangent gradients and combines them through Riemannian stochastic approximation and Polyak-Ruppert averaging. Directly inserting a private data surrogate into a nonlinear loss can shift its population target, whereas conditional centring of the released gradient preserves the first-order equation. We introduce symmetric-pair regression (SPR) to estimate the asymptotic variance from the same private messages used for point estimation, without holding out participants or requesting a second release. We prove the central limit theorem and consistency of the fully transcript-based sandwich covariance and intrinsic Wald region under local differential privacy. Simulations across various statistical problems and manifolds support the predicted decrease in estimation error and near-nominal coverage under moderate privacy. An application to NHANES anthropometric data illustrates private estimation of a leading body-size direction and its uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在每条观测属于不同参与者、分析端只收到本地差分隐私 (LDP) 消息的设定下，对流形值总体极小点做推断：释放随机化切空间梯度，用 Riemannian 随机逼近与 Polyak-Ruppert 平均合成估计，并以条件中心化 (conditional centring) 保住一阶方程，避免把私有数据代入非线性损失导致总体目标偏移。仿真显示估计误差随隐私强度增大而下降、在中等隐私下覆盖率接近名义水平，并在 NHANES 人体测量数据上给出体型主方向及其不确定性。
Motivation: 每条观测来自不同参与者时只能收到本地私有消息，而把私有数据替代品直接塞进非线性损失会移动总体目标，且点估计与方差估计若需分批释放会增加隐私开销。
Method: 释放随机化切空间梯度，经 Riemannian 随机逼近与 Polyak-Ruppert 平均合成；用条件中心化保持一阶方程；提出 symmetric-pair regression (SPR)，用同一批私有消息估计渐近方差，不预留参与者也不做第二次释放；证明 CLT 与完全基于 transcript 的 sandwich 协方差及内在 Wald 区域的一致性。
Result: 仿真覆盖多种统计问题与流形，显示估计误差如理论预测般下降、在中等隐私下覆盖率接近名义水平；应用到 NHANES 人体测量数据，给出体型主方向 (leading body-size direction) 的私有估计及其不确定性。
Conclusion: 在本地差分隐私下，条件中心化加 SPR 可以用同一批 transcript 同时完成流形值估计与有效的不确定性量化，无需额外释放。

papers.title: Riemannian Simultaneous Inference for Tangent Vector Field Regression
papers.abstract_en: We consider nonparametric tangent vector field regression on a Riemannian manifold without boundary. Because responses at different points lie in different tangent spaces, the proposed kernel estimator first parallel transports nearby responses to the target tangent space and then forms a volume-corrected local average. We first derive its uniform second-order bias, finite-bandwidth covariance, and stochastic rate. For simultaneous inference, the tangent norm is written as a supremum over the unit tangent bundle. Exact covariance whitening gives a unit-variance Gaussian field whose correlation length is of order $h$ along the base manifold and of order one along the fibre. Its local covariance geometry leads to a Gumbel limit with an explicit intrinsic constant. Combining this limit with Gaussian approximation and cross-fitted covariance estimation yields a feasible simultaneous confidence tube for the regression field. We further discuss improved finite-sample inference with bandwidth selection and high-order bias corrections. Simulations on various manifolds support the proposed inference procedure. A randomized reconstruction of global wind data illustrates how the tube's cross-sections describe spatially varying uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无边界的黎曼流形上做切向量场非参数回归时，把邻近响应平行移动到目标切空间再做体积校正局部平均，得到单位方差高斯场；其相关长度沿底流形为带宽 h 量级、沿纤维为 1 量级，局部协方差几何给出带显式内蕴常数的 Gumbel 极限，结合高斯逼近与交叉拟合协方差估计构造可行的同时置信管。
Motivation: 流形上不同点的响应位于不同切空间，直接平均无定义；而同时推断需要控制整条回归场的上确界范数，常规点态置信区间无法给出空间一致的不确定性描述。
Method: 核估计器先平行移动邻近响应再做体积校正局部平均，推导一致二阶偏差、有限带宽协方差与随机收敛率；把切向量范数写成单位切丛上的上确界，用精确协方差白化得到单位方差高斯场，配合 Gumbel 极限、高斯逼近与交叉拟合协方差估计构造同时置信管，并讨论带宽选择与高阶偏差修正。
Result: 在多种流形上的模拟支持该推断流程；用全球风场的随机化重建演示置信管截面如何刻画空间变化的不确定性。
Conclusion: 同时置信管可作为流形切向量场回归的可行推断工具，其不确定性沿底流形随带宽 h 缩放、沿纤维保持 1 量级。

papers.title: Weighted Quantum Signal Processing: Low-Depth Polynomial Approximation with Applications to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Signal Processing is a powerful quantum framework for generating and approximating univariate polynomials. However, QSP is often limited by circuit-depth bottlenecks and parity constraints on the class of realizable polynomials. In this work, we introduce Weighted Quantum Signal Processing, an extension of QSP in which a weight function is assigned to the central rotation operator. This formulation provides a deeper understanding of QSP, which emerges as the special case of WQSP with unit weights. The choice of weights determines the structure and expressive capabilities of WQSP circuits. When the weights are natural numbers greater than one, WQSP reduces to a pruned version of QSP, revealing parameter redundancies in the standard framework. Through appropriate selection of integer weights, WQSP achieves linear-to-exponential reductions in the number of parameters required to realize arbitrary bounded univariate polynomials while preserving approximation quality. For generic weights, we establish corresponding approximation error bounds and show that, in many cases, the approximation is exact. We analyze WQSP from both a deterministic perspective, where polynomial generation is formulated as the solution of a linear system, and a quantum machine learning perspective, where WQSP serves as a structured and expressive quantum learning model. We further employ this learning framework to parameterize learnable activation functions in Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks for multivariate function approximation. Our results show that WQSP provides a compact, flexible, and theoretically grounded framework for realizing arbitrary univariate polynomials while requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters than conventional QSP. This yields expressive and parameter-efficient neural architectures, highlighting the potential of WQSP as a scalable primitive for quantum-enhanced machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 QSP 中心旋转算子赋予权重，得到 Weighted Quantum Signal Processing (WQSP)：整数权重大于一时 WQSP 退化为 QSP 的剪枝形式，通过选取整数权重可把实现任意有界一元多项式所需参数量线性到指数级削减，同时保持逼近质量；一般权重下给出逼近误差界，且许多情形逼近是精确的。WQSP 再作为可学习激活函数参数化 Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks 的一元分量，用于多元函数逼近。
Motivation: QSP 受电路深度瓶颈与可实现多项式的奇偶约束限制，参数存在冗余，直接用作量子学习模型时表达能力与参数效率受限。
Method: WQSP 给中心旋转算子分配权重函数，标准 QSP 是单位权重的特例；从两条路径分析：确定性视角把多项式生成写成线性系统求解，量子机器学习视角把 WQSP 当作结构化学习模型；再用该学习框架参数化 Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks 中可学习的激活函数做多元函数逼近。
Result: 选取整数权重时，实现任意有界一元多项式所需参数量获得线性到指数级 (linear-to-exponential) 减少且逼近质量不变；一般权重下建立逼近误差界，并在许多情形逼近是精确的；相较常规 QSP 所需可训练参数显著更少。
Conclusion: WQSP 是 QSP 的严格推广（单位权重即还原 QSP），通过权重选择消除参数冗余，可作为参数高效、可扩展的量子增强机器学习原语，尤其用于 KAN 的激活参数化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SWE-Proof: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World Issues with Machine-Checked Proofs?
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the correctness of LLM-generated code is a core challenge for modern software engineering. Benchmarks for agentic code generation check correctness with held-out test suites, which are inherently incomplete and increasingly susceptible to memorization. Formal verification avoids both problems, but existing work covers only standalone tasks whose specifications are given as input, not real issues, which touch large repositories and state intent in vague natural language. We present Benchproofer, a pipeline that turns a coding task with a known correct patch into a formally verified one: it writes a specification for the new code, summarizes the existing functions that code calls with axioms, and admits an instance only after mechanical and adversarial gates agree. Applying it to SWE-bench Verified yields SWE-Proof, 500 real issues whose correctness is formally verified rather than tested, and it extends to SWE-bench Pro. Evaluating Claude Opus 4.8, we find that verification catches what tests miss: a quarter of test-passing patches admit counterexamples, which a structured natural-language specification does not fix, while a correct formal one lifts resolution from 85% to 95%. Writing that specification is the hard part: an agent that must write its own gains nothing over an unaided baseline, and only 56% of those specifications pass our audit. The usual failure is faithfulness, a specification that constrains part of the required behavior and leaves the rest free. Specification quality still tracks the outcome, failing on 92% of unresolved instances against 51% of resolved ones, making faithful specification synthesis a concrete open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Benchproofer 流水线，把带已知正确补丁的真实 issue 转成形式化验证任务，产出 SWE-Proof：500 个来自 SWE-bench Verified 的真实 issue，其正确性由机器检查的证明而非测试判定。评测 Claude Opus 4.8 发现四分之一通过测试的补丁存在反例，而正确的形式化规格把解决率从 85% 提到 95%；但让 agent 自写规格毫无收益，仅 56% 的规格通过审计。
Motivation: 现有代码基准用留出测试判正确性，测试集不完整且易被记忆；形式化验证虽避开这两点，但只覆盖规格作为输入的独立小任务，无法处理涉及大仓库、意图以模糊自然语言表述的真实 issue。
Method: Benchproofer 对每个已知正确补丁的新代码撰写规格，用公理总结其调用的既有函数，并要求机械检查门与对抗性检查门一致才接纳该实例；由此把 SWE-bench Verified 转成形式化验证基准 SWE-Proof，并可扩展到 SWE-bench Pro。
Result: SWE-Proof 含 500 个真实 issue。在 Claude Opus 4.8 上，四分之一通过测试的补丁存在反例，结构化自然语言规格修不了这个问题，而正确的形式化规格把解决率从 85% 提升到 95%。自写规格的 agent 相对无辅助基线没有收益，仅 56% 的规格通过审计；规格质量与结果相关，未解决实例上规格失败率 92%，已解决实例上为 51%。
Conclusion: 测试通过不等于正确，形式化规格能把解决率抬到 95%，但忠实的规格合成本身是关键瓶颈：典型失败是规格只约束了部分必需行为、其余留空。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
papers.abstract_en: Research agents working in separate sessions need to know what others have tried and which results they can build on. Agora stores their contributions as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) in Git. Each commit records a result, insight, hypothesis, verification, or report and links it to prior work. Searchable views show leading results, neglected branches, and verification status; diversity-aware recommendations suggest experiments beyond the current leaders. We report a run of nearly 12 days in which 13 language-model workers, with no assigned tasks or central planner, used Agora to solve a weight-transfer problem. Given 141 pretrained donor models and a frozen 119.6M-parameter attention-SSM hybrid whose dimensions match no donor, the workers had to initialize the target without training data or gradient updates. They published 1,703 contributions and reduced the development evaluator score from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M. The best method compresses donor next-token statistics into the target's embedding and output head, then adds short-range context through sparse edits to attention, feed-forward, and state-space blocks. Its 145-commit ancestry spans 15 accounts. Participants also posted 165 independent reproductions across 95 targets, with no reported failures. The run documents how agents reused and verified shared work. Measuring the effect on discovery per unit of compute requires a matched comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agora 把多智能体自动科研的产出存成 Git 中只追加的 DAG，每个 commit 记录结果、洞见、假设、验证或报告并链接前人工作；13 个无任务分配、无中央规划的 LM 工人在近 12 天内用它解决权重迁移问题，把开发评估分数从 3.39 降到 1.899 bits/byte，弥合了到已训练 GPT-2 124M 差距的 62%。
Motivation: 独立会话中的研究智能体彼此不知道别人试过什么、哪些结果可以复用，导致重复劳动且难以核验已有结论。
Method: 用 Git 只追加 DAG 存储贡献，每条 commit 记录结果/洞见/假设/验证/报告并链接前人工作；提供可搜索视图（领先结果、被忽略分支、验证状态）与多样性感知的实验推荐。任务是在无训练数据、无梯度更新下，从 141 个预训练 donor 模型为维度不匹配的 119.6M 参数 attention-SSM 混合模型初始化。
Result: 近 12 天、13 个 LM 工人发布 1,703 条贡献，开发评估分数 3.39 → 1.899 bits/byte，弥合到已训练 GPT-2 124M 差距的 62%；最佳方法把 donor 的 next-token 统计压缩进目标 embedding 与输出头，再对 attention、feed-forward、state-space 块做稀疏编辑加入短程上下文，其 145-commit 祖先链跨 15 个账号；另有 165 次独立复现覆盖 95 个目标，无失败报告。
Conclusion: 共享的只追加贡献图能让智能体复用并核验彼此工作，从而在无中心规划下收敛到可用解；但对单位算力的发现效率影响仍需配对对照实验。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 近 12 天、13 个 LM 工人发布 1,703 条贡献，开发评估分数 3.39 → 1.899 bits/byte，弥合到已训练 GPT-2 124M 差距的 62%；最佳方法把 donor 的 next-token 统计压缩进目标 embedding 与输出头，再对 attention、feed-forward、state-space 块做稀疏编辑加入短程上下文，其 145-commit 祖先链跨 15 个账号；另有 165 次独立复现覆盖 95 个目标，无失败报告。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享的只追加贡献图能让智能体复用并核验彼此工作，从而在无中心规划下收敛到可用解；但对单位算力的发现效率影响仍需配对对照实验。

papers.title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TabPFN-3.5, our new flagship Tabular Foundation Model. It significantly outperforms its predecessor, TabPFN-3, and all existing baselines across a broad range of tabular problems. TabPFN-3.5 sets a new state of the art on standard tabular prediction in TabArena, and extends it to the data practitioners encounter in practice: non-i.i.d. data with temporal or grouped splits, tables with strings, text and images, high-cardinality categorical features, and wide tables with many features. These gains carry over to our task-specific harnesses: state of the art on relational data and stronger time-series forecasting. For faster inference, our variant TabPFN-3.5-Fast runs up to 3x faster than TabPFN-3 while keeping most of the accuracy gains. In addition, we upgrade TabPFN-3.5-Plus, expanding our multimodal capabilities with advanced text and date handling alongside proprietary inference optimizations. Finally, we release a new version of our Thinking mode, TabPFN-3.5-Thinking, which scales inference-time computation to push the state of the art further. It benefits from our stronger base model and from inference-time improvements that make it up to 12x faster than TabPFN-3-Thinking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabPFN-3.5 作为新一代表格基础模型，在 TabArena 标准表格预测上刷新 SOTA，并把能力扩展到非 i.i.d.（时间/分组切分）、含字符串文本图像、高基数类别与宽表场景；其关系数据 harness 与时间序列预测 harness 同步达到 SOTA 或更强。TabPFN-3.5-Fast 在保留大部分精度增益的同时比 TabPFN-3 快至 3 倍，Thinking 模式比 TabPFN-3-Thinking 快至 12 倍。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在标准 i.i.d. 表格上已有进展，但实践者面对的是带时间或分组结构的非 i.i.d. 数据、混合模态列与高基数类别，前身 TabPFN-3 与现有基线在这些场景下能力不足。
Method: 以 TabPFN-3 为基础训练新的旗舰表格基础模型 TabPFN-3.5，并配套任务专用 harness（关系数据、时间序列预测）；另发布三个变体：加速推理的 TabPFN-3.5-Fast、扩展文本与日期处理及专有推理优化的 TabPFN-3.5-Plus、以及扩展推理时计算的 TabPFN-3.5-Thinking。
Result: 在 TabArena 标准表格预测上取得新 SOTA，覆盖非 i.i.d. 时间/分组切分、含字符串文本图像的表、高基数类别特征与多特征宽表；关系数据上达到 SOTA，时间序列预测更强；TabPFN-3.5-Fast 比 TabPFN-3 快至 3 倍且保留大部分精度增益；TabPFN-3.5-Thinking 比 TabPFN-3-Thinking 快至 12 倍。
Conclusion: 更强的基座模型加上推理时改进，可同时抬高表格预测、关系数据与时间序列预测的上限，并把推理成本压下来；加速变体以牺牲少量精度换取至多 3 倍吞吐。

papers.title: RAIN: Region-Aware Inversion Network for Semantic Watermark Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Semantic watermarks for diffusion models embed ownership information into the generative process while preserving perceptual quality, but Gaussian-Shading extraction conventionally requires multi-step diffusion inversion to recover the initial noise. Recent one-step methods show that this cost can be reduced substantially. We study this problem through extended flow matching and conditional regression. The key observation is that, near the high-SNR image endpoint, recovering a useful noise statistic given by the first-step output of the extended flow matching in the high-SNR regime is much simpler than reconstructing the full inverse trajectory, and Gaussian Shading only requires the recovered latent to remain in the correct watermark decision region. Based on this observation, we propose a lightweight, prompt-free extractor that decomposes endpoint recovery into an image-like anchor and a noise-oriented residual, which increases the capability of the model to utilize GPU parallel computation. The resulting method avoids iterative inversion and repeated evaluation of a diffusion-scale U-Net, providing an efficient one-step extraction pipeline with a concise theoretical interpretation. The computational cost of extracting noise is lower than that of both OSI and FARI. The github repo is there: https://github.com/TheLovesOfLadyPurple/RAIN-lightweight-NN-for-one-step-semantic-watermark-extraction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAIN 提出轻量、免 prompt 的一步式语义水印提取器，把扩展流匹配 (extended flow matching) 的端点恢复拆成图像式 anchor 与噪声式 residual 两部分，避免迭代反演和反复调用扩散级 U-Net。提取噪声的计算开销低于 OSI 与 FARI，且只需恢复的 latent 落在正确的水印判决区域即可。
Motivation: Gaussian-Shading 语义水印提取通常需要多步扩散反演来恢复初始噪声，反复评估扩散级 U-Net 代价高；已有一步方法虽降本，但缺少对端点恢复为何可行的清晰刻画。
Method: 从 extended flow matching 与 conditional regression 两个角度刻画该问题，指出高 SNR 图像端点处恢复首步输出的噪声统计量远易于重建完整反演轨迹；据此设计把端点恢复分解为 image-like anchor 与 noise-oriented residual 的轻量免 prompt 提取网络，以更好利用 GPU 并行。
Result: 一步提取避免迭代反演与扩散级 U-Net 的重复评估；提取噪声的计算开销低于 OSI 和 FARI 两种方法。
Conclusion: 只要恢复的 latent 保持在正确的水印判决区域内，就不必重建完整反演轨迹，一步式端点恢复足以支撑 Gaussian-Shading 提取并显著降低开销。

papers.title: Sci-MMR: Benchmarking Multi-Step Evidence-Grounded Scientific Reasoning in Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research agents are increasingly expected to search the literature, analyze experimental evidence, and generate scientific hypotheses. These capabilities require multi-step evidence grounded reasoning that progressively acquires, integrates, and verifies evidence before reaching a conclusion. Existing multimodal benchmarks, however, largely evaluate final-answer accuracy, leaving open whether predictions are actually supported by traceable scientific evidence. We introduce Sci-MMR, a benchmark for multi-step evidence-grounded scientific reasoning built on structured argument graphs linking scientific claims, citation-grounded knowledge, visual evidence, and supporting regions. Sci-MMR comprises 235 multi-hop reasoning tasks spanning four scientific disciplines, with an average of nine figure panels per task. Evaluating eight frontier multimodal models, we find that answer accuracy consistently exceeds complete-evidence recovery rate by more than 20%, revealing a substantial gap that answer-only evaluation is structurally unable to capture. Through controlled interventions, we identify two fundamental bottlenecks. First, evidence acquisition: models struggle to extract complete structured evidence from scientific figures, accounting for 57.2% of failures. While cropping tools yield modest gains (+4.5 points), providing gold evidence improves accuracy by up to 37.0 points, indicating difficulty in assembling complete multi-region evidence. Second, evidence integration: models struggle to translate available evidence into correct conclusions, accounting for 31.8% of failures, while even with gold evidence the strongest model achieves only 69.1% accuracy on the hardest tasks. These findings indicate that current answer-centric benchmarks substantially overestimate the evidence-grounded reasoning capabilities of multimodal research agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sci-MMR 用结构化论证图构建 235 个多跳科学推理任务（四个学科、平均每题九个图版），评测八个前沿多模态模型的证据获取与整合能力。答案正确率比完整证据恢复率高出 20% 以上，说明只看最终答案会高估证据支撑度；失败中 57.2% 归于证据获取、31.8% 归于证据整合，给出金标准证据后最难任务上最强模型也仅 69.1% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有科学多模态基准只评最终答案对错，无法判断预测是否真有可追溯证据支撑，因而系统性高估研究智能体的证据推理能力。
Method: 在结构化论证图（关联科学主张、引用锚定知识、视觉证据与支撑区域）上构建 Sci-MMR 基准，含 235 个多跳推理任务、覆盖四个学科、平均每个任务九个图版；评测八个前沿多模态模型，并用受控干预（裁剪工具、提供金标准证据）分离证据获取与证据整合两类瓶颈。
Result: 答案正确率比完整证据恢复率高出 20% 以上；失败归因中证据获取占 57.2%、证据整合占 31.8%；裁剪工具带来 +4.5 点的温和增益，提供金标准证据最多提升 37.0 点；即便有金标准证据，最强模型在最难任务上也只有 69.1% 准确率。
Conclusion: 以答案为中心的基准会实质高估多模态研究智能体的证据接地推理能力，瓶颈同时在从图中拼出完整多区域证据和把已有证据转成结论两处。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry? Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage score calibrated against independent checkpoints. On residual-MLP and GPT-2 benchmarks, the score separates fine-tuned, LoRA-merged, pruned, and quantized descendants from independent and distilled models (AUROC=1.0), distinguishing weight ancestry from behavioral similarity. Under function-preserving checkpoint laundering experiments, weight-space baselines lose margin or fail; our score remains unchanged and runs 76x faster than the nearest robust baseline on GPT-2. The projection-pairing signal appears across six language-model families and beyond, and a case study correctly identifies 3 related and 7 unrelated LLaMA-2 public checkpoints. Collectively, these results establish a passive, data-free provenance signal for compatible open-weight language-model checkpoints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据无关的白盒模型谱系验证方法：先剥离残差训练带来的共享恒等分量，再比较各残差块中 checkpoint 特有结构，得到对称谱系分数并用独立 checkpoint 校准。在 residual-MLP 与 GPT-2 上该分数把微调、LoRA 合并、剪枝、量化后代与独立/蒸馏模型分开（AUROC=1.0），在函数保持的 checkpoint 洗白实验中权重空间基线失效而该分数不变，且比最近的稳健基线快 76 倍。
Motivation: 开放权重模型常被微调、量化、剪枝、合并却无来源记录；残差训练本身会在分支产物中留下共享恒等对齐分量，单靠这一结构无法判定两个 checkpoint 是否同源。
Method: 数据无关白盒谱系验证：先移除共享恒等对齐分量，再跨 residual blocks 比较 checkpoint 特有结构，输出对称谱系分数，并以独立 checkpoint 做校准；在 residual-MLP 与 GPT-2 基准及函数保持的 checkpoint 洗白实验上检验。
Result: 在 residual-MLP 与 GPT-2 上区分微调、LoRA 合并、剪枝、量化后代与独立及蒸馏模型达 AUROC=1.0；洗白实验中权重空间基线丢失间隔或失效而该分数不变，GPT-2 上比最近的稳健基线快 76 倍；信号出现在六个语言模型家族，案例研究正确识别 LLaMA-2 公共 checkpoint 中 3 个相关、7 个无关。
Conclusion: 兼容开放权重 checkpoint 的来源信息确实留在权重结构中，剥离共享恒等分量后可作为被动、数据无关的谱系信号，且与行为相似性相区分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Federated Learning for Distributed CNC Tool Wear Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tool wear prediction is an important task in CNC machining, where accurate monitoring of tool condition supports product quality and process reliability. Machine learning methods have shown potential for this task, but their use in industrial environments is limited by the distributed nature of machining data and by restrictions on data sharing between machines, sites, or organizations. Federated learning offers a suitable framework for this setting by enabling collaborative model training without transferring raw operational data. However, it is open if federated learning can lead to accuracy gains in CNC tool wear prediction that justify the increased complexity of such a system. In this experimental study, real tool trajectories are distributed across simulated clients to represent a federated learning scenario. The federated models are compared against centralized references and local client baselines. Results show that federated learning achieves performance close to centralized learning and improves significantly over local client models. These findings indicate that federated learning can support collaborative tool wear prediction in distributed CNC manufacturing environments and the increased complexity is justified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CNC 刀具磨损预测中，把真实刀具轨迹分布到模拟客户端做联邦学习 (federated learning)，性能接近集中式训练并显著优于各客户端本地模型，说明为数据不出机付出的系统复杂度是值得的。
Motivation: CNC 加工数据天然分散在不同机床、车间与组织之间，且受数据共享限制，单机本地模型数据不足，而集中训练又难以落地。
Method: 实验研究：将真实刀具轨迹分布到模拟客户端构成联邦学习场景，联邦模型与集中式参考模型 (centralized reference) 及各客户端本地基线 (local client baselines) 对比。
Result: 联邦模型性能接近集中式学习，并相对本地客户端模型有显著提升；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 在分布式 CNC 制造环境中联邦学习可支撑协同的刀具磨损预测，其增加的系统复杂度是合理的。

papers.title: Benchmarking Text-to-SQL under Role-Based Access Control
papers.abstract_en: Given a database S and a natural language question Q, text-to-SQL systems aim to generate an SQL query that correctly answers Q when executed against S. Currently, popular text-to-SQL benchmarks mostly assume unrestricted access to S; in practice, however, user access is often restricted, e.g., through role-based access control (RBAC) policies. This leads to a potential disconnect between benchmarking results and real-world performance: an LLM with high benchmark scores might perform poorly in an access-controlled environment, by frequently violating RBAC, or rejecting a query q that could be answered with only permitted data in S. Motivated by this, we present a comprehensive text-to-SQL benchmarking framework with realistic RBAC constraints, which features an LLM-assisted workflow that augments existing text-to-SQL benchmarks with plausible user roles and access policies. To do so, we formulate the problem of role synthesis as a structured reasoning process over the database schema, in which the LLM first infers the application context from the schema, and then derives role responsibilities and access scopes consistent with this context. This process is audited by human-in-the-loop quality control, in which domain experts perform metric-guided screening on the generated roles. Besides the augmented dataset, the proposed framework also contains evaluation metrics that identify RBAC-specific failure modes, and disentangle SQL utility from access-control compliance. We apply the proposed framework to several widely-used benchmarks, and conduct a systematic empirical study of state-of-the-art text-to-SQL systems. The results show that many solutions (especially open-weight LLMs) with high benchmarking scores under an unrestricted setting suffer sharp performance degradation once access constraints are in place, due to frequent RBAC violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出带真实 RBAC 约束的 text-to-SQL 基准框架：用 LLM 在 schema 上做结构化推理合成角色与访问策略，经领域专家按指标筛选的人机协同质控，并给出把 SQL 有用性与访问控制合规性分开的评测指标。在多个常用基准上系统评测后发现，许多原本高分的系统（尤其 open-weight LLM）在访问约束下性能急剧下滑，主因是频繁违反 RBAC。
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准默认对数据库完全开放访问，与实际的 RBAC 受限环境脱节，导致高分模型上线后可能频繁越权，或误拒本可用许可数据回答的查询。
Method: 框架包含 LLM 辅助的增强流程：先把角色合成为 schema 上的结构化推理——由 LLM 从 schema 推断应用上下文，再导出与之一致的角色职责与访问范围；随后由领域专家做指标引导筛选的人机协同质控。评测指标专门识别 RBAC 特有失败模式，并把 SQL utility 与 access-control compliance 解耦。
Result: 在多个广泛使用的 text-to-SQL 基准上对若干 SOTA 系统做系统实证研究：许多在无限制设定下高分的方案（尤其 open-weight LLM）在加入访问约束后性能急剧下降，原因是频繁违反 RBAC。
Conclusion: 无访问限制下的基准分数不能代表受控环境的真实表现，评测必须把 RBAC 合规性与 SQL 有用性分开度量。

papers.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning requires rapid experimentation with agents and learning algorithms, yet large policies and long, multimodal trajectories demand substantial distributed infrastructure. We present MOLT, a lightweight, PyTorch- and Hugging Face-native framework that brings these goals together through four contributions. MOLT combines direct loading of Hugging Face models with experimentally validated trillion-parameter scalability in approximately 9.2K lines of framework code. Unified OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible interfaces integrate existing agents with automatic handling of context compaction. Fully asynchronous training overlaps agent rollouts and policy optimization, accommodating variable agent execution times. Distributed experience storage removes centralized rollout-memory bottlenecks for long, multimodal trajectories. We experimentally validate the complete RL training pipeline on a one-trillion-parameter policy and demonstrate sustained learning with a 30B mixture-of-experts agent, establishing MOLT as a lightweight foundation for large-scale agentic RL research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOLT 是 PyTorch 与 Hugging Face 原生的轻量 agentic RL 训练框架，用约 9.2K 行代码实现万亿参数策略的分布式训练：全异步训练把 agent rollout 与策略优化重叠，分布式经验存储消除长多模态轨迹的集中式 rollout 内存瓶颈。在 1T 参数策略上验证完整 RL 训练管线，并在 30B MoE agent 上展示持续学习。
Motivation: Agentic RL 需要快速试错，但大策略与长多模态轨迹要求沉重的分布式基础设施，rollout 内存与执行时间差异拖慢实验迭代。
Method: 四项贡献：直接加载 Hugging Face 模型并实验证实万亿参数可扩展性；OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容统一接口并自动做 context compaction；全异步训练重叠 rollout 与策略优化以适配可变执行时长；分布式经验存储去掉集中式 rollout 内存瓶颈。
Result: 在约 9.2K 行框架代码内实验验证 1T 参数策略上的完整 RL 训练管线，并在 30B mixture-of-experts agent 上展示 sustained learning。
Conclusion: MOLT 可作为大规模 agentic RL 研究的轻量基础框架，把万亿参数可扩展性与异步分布式经验存储收进原生 PyTorch/HF 栈。
