papers.title: CORTEX: A Structured Reasoning Benchmark for Trustworthy 3D Chest CT MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has shown strong promise in medical imaging. However, this reasoning is usually free-form text judged only by its final answer, making it hard to interpret and verify, especially in 3D radiology, where a diagnosis should be traceable to evidence in the scan. Existing chest CT question-answering datasets compound this by reducing expert radiology reports to answer-only pairs, dropping the reasoning that links findings to conclusions and omitting the patient history clinicians rely on. As a result, reasoning-capable 3D chest CT MLLMs remain out of reach, as neither the structured supervision needed to train them nor the protocol needed to verify their reasoning yet exists. We introduce CORTEX (Clinically Organized Reasoning and sTructured EXplanation), a structured reasoning benchmark for 3D chest CT. For each question, CORTEX restores the missing reasoning as a four-stage diagnostic trace mirroring a radiologist's workflow: task understanding, visual observation, diagnostic reasoning, and answer synthesis. We generate these traces using frontier large language models with broad medical and general-domain knowledge, then filter and verify them with a stage-level evaluation protocol combining automated rubric scoring with expert radiologist review. Crucially, both the reasoning structure and evaluation rubrics are designed in close collaboration with clinicians. Built on CT-RATE, a large, publicly available chest CT dataset without reasoning annotations, CORTEX comprises 76,177 validated reasoning traces across open-ended VQA, closed-ended VQA, and report generation, providing both the structured supervision and the stage-level evaluation protocol needed to build and evaluate trustworthy reasoning models for 3D chest CT. Our dataset and evaluation code is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/aneesurhashmi/cortex
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORTEX 为 3D 胸部 CT MLLM 提供结构化推理基准：在 CT-RATE 上用前沿 LLM 生成四阶段诊断轨迹（任务理解、视觉观察、诊断推理、答案合成），再经自动 rubric 打分与放射科专家复核过滤，得到 76,177 条已验证轨迹，覆盖开放式 VQA、封闭式 VQA 与报告生成。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 推理只输出自由文本、仅按最终答案判定，难以追溯到影像证据；胸部 CT QA 数据集把专家报告压成只有答案的问答对，丢掉了推理链和患者病史，导致可推理的 3D 胸部 CT 模型缺少训练所需的结构化监督与验证协议。
Method: 在公开胸部 CT 数据集 CT-RATE（本身无推理标注）之上，用具备广泛医学与通用知识的前沿 LLM 生成模仿放射科工作流的四阶段诊断轨迹；用阶段级评估协议过滤与验证，结合自动 rubric 打分和放射科专家评审，推理结构与 rubric 均与临床医生协作设计。
Result: 构建出 76,177 条已验证推理轨迹，任务覆盖开放式 VQA、封闭式 VQA 与报告生成三类；数据集与评测代码在 Hugging Face（aneesurhashmi/cortex）公开。
Conclusion: 把推理过程显式组织成四阶段轨迹并配阶段级评测 rubric，可同时提供训练 3D 胸部 CT 可信推理模型所需的结构化监督和可核验的评估协议。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A 3D-Printable Dataset for Fair Testing and Comparisons of Tactile Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Existing texture datasets for tactile sensing primarily consist of sensor readings from a specific sensor interacting with available surfaces/objects rather than describing the textures themselves, limiting fair comparison between tactile sensors and hindering reproducible research. In this work, we introduce a 3D-printable dataset of mathematically defined textures designed to be fabricated reliably across different printers and filament types. The dataset consists of six parametrically generated surface patterns derived from combinations of sine-wave and Fourier-based functions, giving controlled variation in spatial frequency, amplitude, and directional structure. We evaluate the reproducibility of these textures across three popular 3D printers and multiple filament types by measuring variance in images captured using an optical TacTip sensor under controlled contact conditions. Our results show that print quality, particularly peak sharpness and stringing, affects tactile variance, with higher-end printers producing significantly more consistent signatures. Classification experiments using neural networks and PCA-based models further demonstrate that high-quality prints support strong within-printer generalisation, while cross-printer generalisation remains challenging due to geometric inconsistencies. This work establishes the first openly available, physically reproducible 3D-printed texture benchmark, providing a foundation for fair comparison of tactile sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个可 3D 打印的数学定义纹理数据集，用正弦波与 Fourier 函数组合生成六种参数化表面图案，跨打印机与耗材评估触觉传感的可复现性。结果显示打印质量（峰值锐度与拉丝）直接决定触觉信号方差，高端打印机显著更一致；神经网络与 PCA 分类在同打印机内泛化良好，跨打印机仍因几何不一致而困难。
Motivation: 现有触觉纹理数据集记录的是特定传感器与物体的读数，而非纹理本身，导致不同触觉传感器之间无法公平比较，也阻碍可复现研究。
Method: 构建由正弦波与 Fourier 函数组合参数化生成的六种表面图案，控制空间频率、幅度与方向结构变化；在三款主流 3D 打印机与多种耗材上打印，用光学 TacTip 传感器在受控接触条件下采集图像并测量方差；再用神经网络与基于 PCA 的模型做分类实验，检验同打印机与跨打印机泛化。
Result: 打印质量（尤其峰值锐度与拉丝）影响触觉方差，高端打印机产生显著更一致的触觉签名；分类实验显示高质量打印支持强的同打印机泛化，跨打印机泛化因几何不一致仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 首个公开、物理可复现的 3D 打印纹理基准，为触觉传感器公平比较提供基础；跨打印机泛化受限于打印几何不一致。

papers.title: TukaBench: A Culturally Grounded Jailbreak Benchmark for African Languages
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) remains heavily English-centric, leaving Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), particularly African ones, critically underexplored. We introduce TUKABENCH, a jailbreak benchmark for seven African languages that extends JailbreakBench (JBB) beyond direct translation through four settings: human translation of JBB prompts, English adaptation to African contexts followed by human translation, human-curated prompts validated through interactions with GPT-5.2, and code-switched prompts combining English and African languages, isolating the effect of language, cultural grounding, and prompt evasiveness on model safety. Across closed and open models, prompting in African languages reduces refusal relative to English, with culturally adapted prompts leading to least refusal. The evaluation also surfaces two structural limitations: model comprehension failures and reduced LLM-as-a-judge reliability in LRLs. To capture the first, we introduce Deflection alongside Refused and Jailbroken; to assess the second, we validate outputs with human annotations, showing that judge-human agreement drops in lower-resource languages and less commonly supported scripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TUKABENCH 把 JailbreakBench 扩展到七种非洲语言，用四种设置分离语言、文化接地与提示规避对 LLM 安全的影响：非洲语言提示比英文更少被拒绝，文化适配提示拒绝率最低；同时暴露模型理解失败与低资源语言下 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性下降两个结构性问题。
Motivation: LLM 安全评估以英语为主，低资源语言（尤其非洲语言）的越狱行为几乎未被检验，直接翻译无法反映文化语境差异。
Method: 在 JailbreakBench 基础上构造四种设置：人工翻译 JBB 提示、先做英文文化适配再人工翻译、经 GPT-5.2 交互验证的人工整理提示、英非混合的 code-switched 提示；在闭源与开源模型上评测，并新增 Deflection 类别与 Refused、Jailbroken 并列，用人工标注校验 LLM-as-a-judge 输出。
Result: 跨闭源与开源模型，非洲语言提示相对英文降低拒绝率，文化适配提示拒绝最少；judge 与人工一致性在更低资源语言和较少支持的文种上下降；评测同时识别出模型理解失败（Deflection）与 LLM-as-a-judge 在低资源语言可靠性下降两类结构性局限。
Conclusion: 语言与文化接地会系统性改变 LLM 越狱成功率，且低资源语言下自动评判不可单独采信，需配人工标注。

papers.title: GPROF-IR: An Improved Single-Channel Infrared Precipitation Retrieval for Merged Satellite Precipitation Products
papers.abstract_en: The Integrated Multi-Satellite Retrievals for the Global Precipitation Measurement (IMERG) product combines precipitation estimates from passive microwave (PMW) and infrared (IR) sensors to provide quasi-global precipitation estimates at half-hourly resolution. Because IR observations are primarily sensitive to cloud-top properties, however, IR-based precipitation estimates are generally less accurate than PMW estimates and can introduce artifacts into the merged precipitation fields. We introduce GPROF-IR, a neural-network-based precipitation retrieval designed to provide precipitation estimates from single-channel geostationary IR observations for the upcoming IMERG V08. GPROF-IR uses a convolutional neural network to exploit spatiotemporal information from sequences of half-hourly IR observations. We validate GPROF-IR against independent surface-based precipitation measurements over land and ocean. GPROF-IR substantially improves upon existing single-channel IR retrievals, including the IR retrieval used in IMERG V07 and more recent neural-network-based approaches. During overpasses of flagship PMW sensors, GPROF-IR is more accurate than the corresponding IMERG PMW estimates over CONUS and Austria, but not Korea. Over CONUS, GPROF-IR outperforms the merged IMERG V07 product for hourly and daily precipitation accumulations. Against shipborne disdrometer observations, GPROF-IR is more accurate than IMERG V07 in the tropics but slightly less accurate in the extratropics. Since geostationary IR observations are continuously available across much of the globe since 1983, GPROF-IR provides a promising basis for improving merged precipitation products and developing long-term, temporally consistent precipitation records.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPROF-IR 用卷积神经网络吃静止单通道红外 (single-channel geostationary IR) 的半小时序列，输出降水估计，供 IMERG V08 使用。在地面独立观测检验中它明显优于 IMERG V07 的 IR 反演和更新的神经网络方法；在旗舰 PMW 传感器过境时，其精度在 CONUS 与奥地利超过 IMERG 的 PMW 估计，但在韩国没有；对船舶雨滴谱仪，热带优于 IMERG V07、中高纬略差。
Motivation: IMERG 靠 IR 补 PMW 的时空空档，但 IR 只对云顶敏感，精度低于 PMW，还会在融合场里引入伪影；需要一个更强的单通道 IR 反演来支撑 V08。
Method: GPROF-IR 是神经网络降水反演：卷积网络利用连续半小时 IR 观测序列中的时空信息，从静止单通道红外数据估计降水；用陆地和海洋上的独立地面降水观测做验证。
Result: 在地面验证中，GPROF-IR 明显优于现有单通道 IR 反演，包括 IMERG V07 所用的 IR 反演和更新的神经网络方法。旗舰 PMW 传感器过境期间，其精度在 CONUS 和奥地利高于对应 IMERG PMW 估计，韩国则不然；在 CONUS 上，对小时和日累计降水优于合并后的 IMERG V07。对船舶雨滴谱仪 (shipborne disdrometer)，热带优于 IMERG V07，中高纬略差。

papers.title: Fitting Large Nonlinear Mixed Effects Models Using Variational Expectation Maximization
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear Mixed Effects (NLME) models are widely used in pharmacometrics and related fields to analyze hierarchical and longitudinal data. However, as the number of parameters and random effects increases, traditional methods for maximizing the marginal likelihood become computationally expensive. This paper explores the Variational Expectation Maximization (VEM) algorithm, a scalable alternative for fitting NLME models. Originally introduced in the context of probabilistic graphical models and later popularized through variational autoencoders, VEM has not been extensively applied to NLME modeling. By leveraging flexible variational families and reverse-mode automatic differentiation, VEM can efficiently maximize the marginal likelihood, scaling to NLME models with over 15,000 population parameters. This work provides a detailed description of VEM, compares it to other NLME fitting algorithms, and highlights its scalability through computational experiments. Using the Pumas statistical software, we fit two test models: 1) a standard warfarin model, and 2) an unnecessarily over-parameterized DeepNLME Friberg model with 15,410 population parameters and 16 random effects. The warfarin model was fitted to completion to demonstrate the correctness of VEM, while the DeepNLME Friberg model instead demonstrates VEM's scalability on a toy but large model. VEM improves the log likelihood steadily over hundreds of iterations at a practical per-iteration cost, while FOCE fails to complete even one iteration within a day. The model is deliberately over-parameterized for its small dataset and over-fits it, so what this experiment establishes is that VEM optimizes the objective of a model of this size at a practical cost. Applying VEM to large models that are genuinely useful is left to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把变分期望最大化 (VEM) 用于拟合大型非线性混合效应 (NLME) 模型，借助灵活变分族与反向模式自动微分直接最大化边际似然，可扩展到 15,000 以上群体参数。在 Pumas 上拟合 15,410 参数、16 个随机效应的 DeepNLME Friberg 模型时，VEM 以每轮可行的代价在数百轮迭代中稳定提升 log likelihood，而 FOCE 一天内连一轮都跑不完。
Motivation: NLME 参数与随机效应增多时，最大化边际似然的传统方法计算代价过高，FOCE 等拟合算法在大模型上难以完成迭代。
Method: 采用 VEM：用灵活变分族近似后验、以反向模式自动微分计算梯度，最大化边际似然；在 Pumas 统计软件中实现，并与其他 NLME 拟合算法做计算实验对比。
Result: 两个测试模型：warfarin 模型被完整拟合以验证 VEM 正确性；DeepNLME Friberg 模型含 15,410 个群体参数与 16 个随机效应，VEM 在数百轮迭代中稳步提升 log likelihood、每轮代价可行，FOCE 一天内未能完成一轮。该 Friberg 模型相对其小数据集被刻意过参数化并过拟合。
Conclusion: VEM 能以可行代价优化这个规模的模型目标函数，但该实验只证明规模可行性，把 VEM 用于真正有用的大模型留待后续工作。

papers.title: Assessing the impact of dimensionality reduction on clustering performance - a systematic study
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality reduction is a critical preprocessing step for clustering high-dimensional data, yet comprehensive evaluation of its impact across diverse methods and data types remains limited. In this study, we systematically assess the influence of five dimensionality reduction techniques - Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Kernel Principal Component Analysis (Kernel PCA), Variational Autoencoder (VAE), Isometric Mapping (Isomap), and Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) - on the performance of four popular clustering algorithms - k-means, Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering (AHC), Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), and Ordering Points to Identify the Clustering Structure (OPTICS). We evaluate clustering quality using the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), comparing results without and with dimensionality reduction at different reduction levels recommended in the literature (i.e., k-1, where k is the number of clusters, and 25% and 50% of the original number of dimensions). Our findings underscore the importance of a careful selection of the dimensionality reduction technique and the dimensionality reduction level that should be tailored to intrinsic data geometry and clustering algorithm(s) under consideration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统评估五种降维方法（PCA、Kernel PCA、VAE、Isomap、MDS）对四种聚类算法（k-means、AHC、GMM、OPTICS）的影响，用 Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) 对比不降维与三种降维水平（k-1、25%、50% 原始维度）。结论是降维技术与降维水平的选择必须针对数据的内在几何结构和所用聚类算法来定制，不能一概而论。
Motivation: 降维是高维聚类的关键预处理步骤，但其影响在不同方法与数据类型上的系统性评估仍然有限。
Method: 对五种降维技术（PCA、Kernel PCA、VAE、Isomap、MDS）与四种聚类算法（k-means、AHC、GMM、OPTICS）做组合评估，降维水平取文献推荐的 k-1（k 为簇数）、25% 与 50% 原始维度，用 Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) 比较降维前后的聚类质量。
Result: 以 ARI 对比无降维与三种降维水平下各降维-聚类组合的表现；摘要给出的发现是降维技术与降维水平需按数据内在几何与所选聚类算法定制，未列出具体 ARI 数值。
Conclusion: 不存在普适的降维方案：降维方法与降维到多少维应与数据几何和聚类算法一同选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LitPivot: Developing Well-Situated Research Ideas Through Dynamic Contextualization and Critique within the Literature Landscape
papers.abstract_en: Developing a novel research idea is hard. It must be distinct enough from prior work to claim a contribution while also building on it. This requires iteratively reviewing literature and refining an idea based on what a researcher reads; yet when an idea changes, the literature that matters often changes with it. Most tools offer limited support for this interplay: literature tools help researchers understand a fixed body of work, while ideation tools evaluate ideas against a static, pre-curated set of papers. We introduce literature-initiated pivots, a mechanism where engagement with literature prompts revision to a developing idea, and where that revision changes which literature is relevant. We operationalize this in LitPivot, where researchers concurrently draft and vet an idea. LitPivot dynamically retrieves clusters of papers relevant to a selected part of the idea and proposes literature-informed critiques for how to revise it. A lab study ($n{=}17$) shows researchers produced higher-rated ideas with stronger self-reported understanding of the literature space; an open-ended study ($n{=}5$) reveals how researchers use LitPivot to iteratively evolve their own ideas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LitPivot 提出 literature-initiated pivot：研究者改想法时系统动态重检索相关论文簇并给出基于文献的修改批评，使起草与查证同步进行。17 人实验室研究中产出的想法评分更高、文献理解自评更强，5 人开放式研究展示迭代演化过程。
Motivation: 现有文献工具只围绕固定论文集展开，构思工具只对照静态预选论文集评估想法；想法一变、相关文献随之变化的动态交互缺乏支持。
Method: LitPivot 让研究者并行起草与查证想法：针对想法的选定部分动态检索相关论文簇，并生成 literature-informed critiques 提示如何修改；通过 n=17 的实验室研究与 n=5 的开放式研究检验使用方式。
Result: 实验室研究（n=17）中研究者产出评分更高的想法，并自评对文献空间理解更强；开放式研究（n=5）揭示研究者如何用 LitPivot 迭代演化各自想法。
Conclusion: 让文献接触触发想法修订、并由修订反过来改变相关文献集合，能同时提升想法质量与研究者对文献空间的理解。

papers.title: Calibration and transfer in indicator-based assessments of artificial consciousness
papers.abstract_en: Research on artificial consciousness increasingly shifts evaluation from behaviour to internal architecture. Theory-based indicators are used to update probability assignments. This improves on behavioural tests but raises two distinct problems. First, these assignments cannot currently be calibrated against independently established artificial consciousness outcomes. Second, their evidential relevance is transferred from biological cases without independent support that indicator-consciousness relations remain stable across substrates. This commentary distinguishes calibration from transfer and adapts the iterative natural-kind strategy by proposing a preliminary, theory-relative comparative space for cross-substrate assessment.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Author manuscript of the article published in Neuroscience of Consciousness. Revised following peer review; title and abstract updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文章区分人工意识评估中的两个不同问题：指标给出的概率赋值无法针对独立确立的人工意识结果做校准，且指标与意识的关联是从生物案例外推到其他基底、缺少跨基底稳定性证据。作者把校准与迁移分开处理，并改造迭代自然类策略，提出一个初步的、理论相对的跨基底比较空间。
Motivation: 评估重心从行为转向内部架构后，理论驱动指标被用来更新概率赋值，但这些赋值既无独立结果可校准，其证据效力也缺乏跨基底稳定的独立支持。
Method: 这是一篇评论性文章：先区分校准 (calibration) 与迁移 (transfer) 两类问题，再改造迭代自然类 (iterative natural-kind) 策略，构造一个初步的、理论相对 (theory-relative) 的跨基底比较空间用于人工意识评估。
Result: 给出概念性区分与提议的框架：校准受限于缺少独立确立的人工意识结果，迁移受限于指标—意识关系跨基底稳定性无独立支持；提出理论相对的跨基底比较空间。
Conclusion: 人工意识指标的概率赋值须把校准问题与跨基底迁移问题分开处理，跨基底评估应建立在理论相对的比较空间上而非直接沿用生物证据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 人工意识指标的概率赋值须把校准问题与跨基底迁移问题分开处理，跨基底评估应建立在理论相对的比较空间上而非直接沿用生物证据。

papers.title: PHONOS: PHOnetic Neutralization for Online Streaming Applications
papers.abstract_en: Speaker anonymization (SA) systems modify timbre while leaving regional or non-native accent cues intact, which is problematic because such cues can reveal a speaker's first-language or geographic background and narrow the anonymity set. To address this issue, we present PHONOS, a streaming module for real-time SA that performs accent neutralization in a privacy sense: reducing accent-origin cues by converting non-native segmental realizations toward a chosen target accent domain. Our approach pre-generates golden speaker utterances that preserve source timbre and rhythm but replace foreign segmentals with native ones using silence-aware DTW alignment and zero-shot voice conversion. These utterances supervise a causal accent translator that maps non-native content tokens to native equivalents with at most 40ms look-ahead, trained using joint cross-entropy and CTC losses. Our evaluations show an 81% reduction in non-native accent confidence, with listening-test accentedness ratings consistent with this shift. PHONOS also moves outputs away from the original speaker in embedding space, suggesting lower linkability under an embedding-based proxy, while running with $\leq241\,\mathrm{ms}$ end-to-end latency on a single GPU.
papers.comment: The paper is accepted for publication at SLT 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHONOS 是面向实时说话人匿名化 (speaker anonymization) 的流式口音中和模块：用静音感知 DTW 对齐与零样本语音转换预生成保留源音色节奏、但把外来音段替换为母语音段的 golden 语句，再以此监督一个最多 40ms 前视的因果口音翻译器（联合 CTE+CTC 损失）。非母语口音置信度下降 81%，听测口音度评分与之一致，输出在嵌入空间上远离原说话人，单 GPU 端到端延迟 ≤241ms。
Motivation: 现有说话人匿名化系统只改音色，仍保留地域或非母语口音线索，这些线索会暴露说话人第一语言或地理背景，从而缩小匿名集。
Method: 先用 silence-aware DTW 对齐与 zero-shot voice conversion 生成 golden 语句（保留源音色与节奏、替换外来音段），以其作为监督训练因果 accent translator，把非母语内容 token 映射为母语等价形式，前视最多 40ms，损失为联合 cross-entropy 与 CTC。
Result: 非母语口音置信度下降 81%，听测口音度 (accentedness) 评分与该方向一致；输出在嵌入空间上远离原说话人，基于嵌入的代理指标显示 linkability 降低；单 GPU 端到端延迟 ≤241ms，前视 ≤40ms。
Conclusion: 口音中和可以在不改音色的前提下进一步压缩匿名集，且能在 ≤40ms 前视的流式约束内实时运行。

papers.title: A Foundation Model for Instruction-Conditioned In-Context Time Series Tasks
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables task adaptation at inference time by conditioning on demonstrations rather than updating model parameters. Although recent time-series foundation models incorporate contextual conditioning, retrieval, or example-based prompting, they typically rely on implicit positional structure or task-specific objectives rather than explicit instruction-conditioned input-output demonstrations. We introduce iAmTime, a time-series foundation model trained with instruction-conditioned amortized meta-learning to infer tasks directly from example demonstrations. iAmTime represents each episode as a structured prompt over historical context and future-known variables using specialized semantic tokens that attend to designated time-series regions, exchange information across demonstrations, and inject task information into the query representation. The model combines a Hierarchical Multi-Scope Transformer Encoder, which captures temporal and covariate dynamics while inferring latent task structure from demonstrated input-output mappings, with a Task-Conditioned Patch Decoder, which adapts decoding through expert-based routing. We train iAmTime on large-scale real and synthetic corpora using supervised and self-supervised instruction-conditioned tasks, including forecasting, imputation, reconstruction, classification, anomaly detection, and source de-mixing. Across diverse domains, frequencies, and horizons, iAmTime improves zero-shot adaptation over strong time-series foundation baselines on probabilistic and point forecasting benchmarks, while achieving competitive or superior performance on four non-forecasting tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iAmTime 用指令条件化的摊销元学习 (instruction-conditioned amortized meta-learning) 训练时序基础模型，把每个 episode 编成含历史上下文与未来已知变量的结构化 prompt，靠语义 token 从示例演示中直接推断任务。在多领域、多频率、多预测时长上，其零样本适应在概率与点预报基准上优于强时序基础模型基线，并在四类非预报任务上达到竞争或更优表现。
Motivation: 现有时序基础模型的上下文条件化多依赖隐式位置结构或任务专用目标，缺少显式的指令条件化输入-输出演示，导致推理时难以仅凭示例推断任务。
Method: 以指令条件化的摊销元学习训练：语义 token 关注指定时序区域、在演示间交换信息并把任务信息注入查询表示；Hierarchical Multi-Scope Transformer Encoder 捕获时序与协变量动态并从演示的输入-输出映射推断潜在任务结构，Task-Conditioned Patch Decoder 通过专家路由 (expert-based routing) 调节解码；在大规模真实与合成语料上用有监督与自监督的指令条件化任务训练，覆盖 forecasting、imputation、reconstruction、classification、anomaly detection、source de-mixing。
Result: 在跨领域、跨频率、跨预测时长的评测中，零样本适应在概率预报与点预报基准上优于强时序基础模型基线；在四类非预报任务上表现竞争或更优。
Conclusion: 显式的指令条件化演示加结构化 prompt 足以让时序基础模型在推理时直接推断任务，从而把零样本适应扩展到预报之外的多类时序任务。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Using Vision Language Foundation Models to Generate Plant Simulation Configurations via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models (VLMs) can generate plant simulation configurations from imagery using in-context learning. We study this benchmark for cowpea plot reconstruction for plant simulations, where the VLM needs to generate structured JSON configurations that include field and plant information. Open-source multimodal models from Gemma 4 and Qwen3.5 families are evaluated on a synthetic cowpea dataset with known JSON ground truth and on a real drone orthophoto dataset with field-collected JSON. Five in-context learning methods are used, from format restriction instruction to few-shot image examples with auxiliary grounding information. The results show that VLMs can generate valid JSON outputs, can generally estimate days after planting (DAP), plant counts, plant locations, sun angles, and leaf chlorophyll content, and can render approximate simulations of cowpea plots. Error metrics fluctuate across model families and often remain worse than dataset baselines, particularly when VLMs' pretrained knowledge dominates over weak visual evidence. These results position image-to-simulation JSON generation as a promising but currently challenging task, and establish a benchmark for studying how multimodal reasoning, prompt design, and the sim-to-real domain gap affect plant phenotyping tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图像到仿真配置的基准：让 VLM 通过 in-context learning 从图像直接生成结构化 JSON（田块与植株信息），用于 cowpea（豇豆）小区重建仿真。VLM 能产出合法 JSON 并大致估出 DAP、株数、株位、太阳角度与叶绿素含量，但误差在模型族间波动、常差于数据集基线，尤其在预训练知识压过弱视觉证据时。
Motivation: 把图像转成可用于植株仿真的结构化配置目前缺少评测标准，且 VLM 在视觉证据弱时容易被预训练先验带偏，需要一个基准来量化 prompt 设计、多模态推理与 sim-to-real 域差的影响。
Method: 构建 cowpea 小区重建基准，含已知 JSON 真值的合成 cowpea 数据集与带野外采集 JSON 的真实无人机正射影像 (drone orthophoto) 数据集；评测 Gemma 4 与 Qwen3.5 两个开源多模态模型族，采用五种 in-context learning 方法，从格式限制指令到带辅助 grounding 信息的少样本图像示例。
Result: VLM 能生成合法 JSON，并总体可估出 days after planting (DAP)、株数、株位、太阳角度与叶绿素含量，渲染出近似的 cowpea 小区仿真；误差指标在模型族之间波动，且常劣于数据集基线，尤其当 VLM 预训练知识主导弱视觉证据时。
Conclusion: 图像到仿真 JSON 生成是有前景但目前仍有挑战的任务，该基准可用于研究多模态推理、prompt 设计与 sim-to-real 域差如何影响植物表型 (plant phenotyping) 任务。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Semantic Self-Distillation for Language Model Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models present challenges for principled uncertainty quantification, in part due to their complexity and the diversity of their outputs. Semantic dispersion, or the variance in the meaning of sampled answers, has been proposed as a useful proxy for model uncertainty, but the associated computational cost prohibits its use in latency-critical applications. We show that sampled semantic distributions can be distilled into lightweight student models which estimate a prompt-conditioned density before the language model generates an answer token. The student model predicts a semantic distribution over possible answers; the entropy of this distribution provides a prompt-level uncertainty signal, and the probability density allows answer-level reliability evaluation. Across experiments on TriviaQA and MMLU, we find our student models perform competitively relative to the teacher's sampled semantic dispersion on a hallucination prediction task, whilst offering additional uncertainty primitives for out-of-domain detection and multiple-choice answer selection. We term this technique Semantic Self-Distillation (SSD), which can serve as a general framework for distilling predictive uncertainty in complex output spaces beyond language.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version, published in Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026), PMLR 337:5427-5447
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 337:5427-5447, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把大模型采样得到的语义离散度 (semantic dispersion) 蒸馏进轻量 student 模型，使其在生成答案 token 之前就估计 prompt 条件密度：该分布的熵给出 prompt 级不确定性，概率密度给出答案级可靠性。在 TriviaQA 与 MMLU 的幻觉预测任务上，student 与 teacher 采样式 semantic dispersion 表现相当，同时额外提供域外检测与多选题选择两个不确定性原语。
Motivation: LLM 输出多样且复杂，语义离散度作为不确定性代理需要大量采样，计算成本高，无法用于延迟敏感场景。
Method: 提出 Semantic Self-Distillation (SSD)：把采样得到的 semantic distribution 蒸馏到轻量 student 模型，在 teacher 生成答案 token 之前预测 prompt 条件语义分布；熵作 prompt 级信号，概率密度作答案级可靠性评估。
Result: 在 TriviaQA 与 MMLU 上，student 模型在幻觉预测任务中相对 teacher 的采样 semantic dispersion 表现具有竞争力 (perform competitively)，并额外支持域外检测与多选题答案选择。
Conclusion: SSD 把预测不确定性蒸馏进生成前可用的轻量模型，可作为复杂输出空间（不限于语言）蒸馏预测不确定性的通用框架。

papers.title: Contextual Information Allocation in Shared-State Cognitive Models: An Information-Theoretic Bound
papers.abstract_en: Context-sensitive behavior can be modeled by enriching an internal state, by allowing a response rule to access context directly, or by preserving a shared state while introducing an auxiliary criterion or control variable. This paper isolates an information-theoretic constraint on the third architecture. Let $C$ denote context, $S$ a candidate internal or latent state, $O$ an observable response, and $M$ an auxiliary variable such that $O\perp C\mid(S,M)$. Then \[ I(C;O\mid S)\le I(C;M\mid S)\le H(M\mid S). \] Once a shared state has been specified, residual context dependence in behavior therefore lower-bounds both the context information and the conditional entropy that an auxiliary context-mediating mechanism must carry. The bound is representation-relative rather than a measure of state-space size or a universal contextuality measure. A worked recognition-memory example shows how the quantity can be computed for payoff-induced criterion shifts and compared across alternative representational allocations. Ontological contextuality and quantum probability are treated as a separate specialization rather than as prerequisites for the cognitive interpretation. More broadly, the framework provides a basis for analyzing context-memory-control trade-offs in cognitive models and artificial agents that must maintain coherent behavior across changing contexts under bounded internal representations.
papers.comment: Version 4: The manuscript was substantially revised to emphasize contextual information allocation in shared-state cognitive models. We strengthened the information-theoretic result, added tightness conditions and a worked recognition-memory example, clarified its distinction from contextuality measures, and expanded discussion of cognitive modeling and AI-agent context-memory-control trade-offs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享状态的认知模型中，若响应 O 在给定状态 S 和辅助变量 M 后与上下文 C 条件独立，则残余上下文依赖满足信息论界 I(C;O|S) ≤ I(C;M|S) ≤ H(M|S)：共享状态一旦确定，行为中剩下的上下文依赖就下界了任何上下文中介机制必须携带的上下文信息与条件熵。该界是表示相对的，不是状态空间大小或普适度量。
Motivation: 上下文敏感行为的三种建模路线（扩充内部状态、响应规则直接访问上下文、保持共享状态加辅助判据/控制变量）中，第三种缺少对辅助机制信息开销的约束刻画。
Method: 在条件独立假设 O⊥C|(S,M) 下推导信息论界 I(C;O|S) ≤ I(C;M|S) ≤ H(M|S)，给出紧致性条件，并用一个识别记忆 (recognition-memory) 的算例展示如何对 payoff 引起的判据偏移计算该量、在不同表示分配间比较；本体论 contextuality 与量子概率作为独立特化而非前提。
Result: 得到解析界 I(C;O|S) ≤ I(C;M|S) ≤ H(M|S) 及其紧致条件；识别记忆算例演示了 payoff-induced criterion shifts 下该量的计算与跨表示比较。摘要未给出数值实验。
Conclusion: 共享状态下的残余上下文依赖是辅助上下文机制信息载荷的下界，可用于分析认知模型与 AI agent 在受限内部表示下跨变化上下文保持一致行为时的 context-memory-control 权衡；该界是表示相对的，不充当普适 contextuality 度量。

summary_sections.method: 在条件独立假设 O⊥C|(S,M) 下推导信息论界 I(C;O|S) ≤ I(C;M|S) ≤ H(M|S)，给出紧致性条件，并用一个识别记忆 (recognition-memory) 的算例展示如何对 payoff 引起的判据偏移计算该量、在不同表示分配间比较；本体论 contextuality 与量子概率作为独立特化而非前提。
summary_sections.result: 得到解析界 I(C;O|S) ≤ I(C;M|S) ≤ H(M|S) 及其紧致条件；识别记忆算例演示了 payoff-induced criterion shifts 下该量的计算与跨表示比较。摘要未给出数值实验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享状态下的残余上下文依赖是辅助上下文机制信息载荷的下界，可用于分析认知模型与 AI agent 在受限内部表示下跨变化上下文保持一致行为时的 context-memory-control 权衡；该界是表示相对的，不充当普适 contextuality 度量。

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented (Knowledge Graph), and Large Language Model-Driven Design Structure Matrix (DSM) Generation of Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: We explore the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Graph-based RAG (GraphRAG) for generating Design Structure Matrices (DSMs). We test these methods on two distinct use cases--a power screwdriver and a CubeSat with known architectural references--evaluating their performance on two key tasks: determining relationships between predefined components, and the more complex challenge of identifying components and their subsequent relationships. We measure the performance by assessing each element of the DSM and overall architecture. Despite design and computational challenges, we identify opportunities for automated DSM generation, with all code publicly available for reproducibility and further feedback from the domain experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 探索用 LLM、RAG 与 GraphRAG 自动生成信息物理系统 (CPS) 的设计结构矩阵 (DSM)，在 power screwdriver 与 CubeSat 两个有已知架构参考的用例上测试两项任务：判定预定义组件间关系，以及更难的组件识别加关系识别。逐 DSM 元素与整体架构评估后，作者认为自动 DSM 生成存在可行机会，全部代码公开以供复现。
Motivation: DSM 是系统架构分析的基础工具，但手工构建组件关系矩阵耗时且依赖专家；希望检验 LLM 与检索增强方法能否承担这一步。
Method: 对比 LLM、Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 与 Graph-based RAG (GraphRAG) 三条路线生成 DSM，评测对象为 power screwdriver 和 CubeSat 两个带已知架构参考的用例，任务分两级：给定组件判定关系、以及自行识别组件再判定关系。
Result: 在两个用例上按 DSM 每个元素与整体架构两级打分，识别组件及其关系的任务被明确标为更复杂；摘要未给出具体分数，但指出设计与计算上存在挑战的同时也识别出自动 DSM 生成的机会。
Conclusion: LLM 加检索增强有潜力自动生成 DSM，代码已公开供复现并征集领域专家反馈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Bayesian Flow Network for Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Graph generation aims to sample discrete node and edge attributes while satisfying coupled structural constraints. Diffusion models for graphs often adopt largely factorized forward-noising, and many flow-matching methods start from factorized reference noise and coordinate-wise interpolation, so node-edge coupling is not encoded by the generative geometry and must be recovered implicitly by the core network, which can be brittle after discrete decoding. Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs) evolve distribution parameters and naturally support discrete generation. But classical BFNs typically rely on factorized beliefs and independent channels, which limit geometric evidence fusion. We propose Variational Bayesian Flow Network (VBFN), which performs a variational lifting to a tractable joint Gaussian variational belief family governed by structured precisions. Each Bayesian update reduces to solving a symmetric positive definite linear system, enabling coupled node and edge updates within a single fusion step. We construct sample-agnostic sparse precisions from a representation-induced dependency graph, thereby avoiding label leakage while enforcing node-edge consistency. On synthetic and molecular graph datasets, VBFN improves fidelity and diversity, and surpasses baseline methods. The reproducible code is available at https://github.com/Cello2195/VBFN.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VBFN 把图生成中的因子化贝叶斯信念提升为由结构化精度矩阵控制的联合高斯变分信念，使节点与边在单次 Bayesian 更新中耦合更新，每次更新归结为求解一个对称正定线性方程组。精度矩阵由表示诱导的依赖图构造且与样本无关，避免标签泄漏并强制节点-边一致性；在合成与分子图数据集上提升保真度与多样性并超越基线方法。
Motivation: 图扩散与流匹配方法的前向加噪和参考噪声多为因子化、坐标级插值，节点-边耦合无法进入生成几何，只能靠核心网络在离散解码后隐式恢复，容易脆弱；经典 BFN 的因子化信念与独立信道也限制了几何证据融合。
Method: 提出 Variational Bayesian Flow Network (VBFN)：变分提升到可处理的联合高斯变分信念族，由结构化精度 (structured precisions) 控制；每次 Bayesian 更新求解对称正定线性系统，实现节点与边在单个融合步内的耦合更新；精度矩阵从表示诱导的依赖图 (representation-induced dependency graph) 构造且与样本无关，避免标签泄漏。
Result: 在合成与分子图数据集上，VBFN 在保真度 (fidelity) 与多样性 (diversity) 上均有提升并超越基线方法；代码发布于 github.com/Cello2195/VBFN。
Conclusion: 把图生成的信念几何做成耦合的联合高斯结构化精度，节点-边一致性可由生成几何本身承载，而不必依赖网络在离散解码后隐式补救。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASCIIBench: Evaluating Language-Model-Based Understanding of Visually-Oriented Text
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated several emergent behaviors with scale, including reasoning and fluency in long-form text generation. However, they continue to struggle with tasks requiring precise spatial and positional reasoning. ASCII art, a symbolic medium where characters encode structure and form, provides a unique probe of this limitation. We introduce ASCIIBench, a novel benchmark for evaluating both the generation and classification of ASCII-text images. ASCIIBench consists of a filtered dataset of 5,315 class-labeled ASCII images and is, to our knowledge, the first publicly available benchmark of its kind. Alongside the dataset, we release weights for a fine-tuned CLIP model adapted to capture ASCII structure, enabling the evaluation of LLM-generated ASCII art. Our analysis shows that cosine similarity over CLIP embeddings fails to separate most ASCII categories, yielding chance-level performance even for low-variance classes. In contrast, classes with high internal mean similarity exhibit clear discriminability, revealing that the bottleneck lies in representation rather than generational variance. These findings position ASCII art as a stress test for multimodal representations and motivate the development of new embedding methods or evaluation metrics tailored to symbolic visual modalities. All resources are available at https://github.com/ASCIIBench/ASCIIBench.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2025 LLM-eval & MAR Workshops
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASCIIBench：5,315 个带类别标签的 ASCII 图像基准，同时评测 LLM 对 ASCII 图像的生成与分类，并发布一个针对 ASCII 结构微调的 CLIP 权重。分析显示 CLIP 嵌入上的余弦相似度无法区分多数 ASCII 类别，即使低方差类别也只到随机水平；内部平均相似度高的类别才可分，说明瓶颈在表示而非生成方差。
Motivation: LLM 在长文本上具备推理与流畅性，但在需要精确空间与位置推理的任务上仍然吃力；ASCII art 这类用字符编码结构的符号视觉模态缺少公开评测基准。
Method: 构建经过筛选的 5,315 个类别标签 ASCII 图像数据集，用于生成与分类两类评测；同时微调一个 CLIP 模型以捕捉 ASCII 结构并公开权重，用其嵌入上的余弦相似度做类别区分分析。
Result: CLIP 嵌入余弦相似度在多数 ASCII 类别上只有随机水平 (chance-level) 表现，低方差类别也不例外；内部平均相似度高的类别则表现出清晰可分性。数据集规模 5,315 个图像，据作者所知是首个公开的同类基准。
Conclusion: ASCII art 可作为多模态表示的压力测试：分类失败的瓶颈在表示层而非生成方差，因此需要面向符号视觉模态的新嵌入方法或评测指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GLOW: Global Illumination-Aware Inverse Rendering of Indoor Scenes Captured with Dynamic Co-Located Light & Camera
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering of indoor scenes remains challenging due to the ambiguity between reflectance and lighting, exacerbated by inter-reflections among multiple objects. While natural illumination-based methods struggle to resolve this ambiguity, co-located light-camera setups offer better disentanglement as lighting can be easily calibrated via Structure-from-Motion. However, such setups introduce additional complexities like strong inter-reflections, dynamic shadows, near-field lighting, and moving specular highlights, which existing approaches fail to handle. We present GLOW, a Global Illumination-aware Inverse Rendering framework designed to address these challenges. GLOW integrates a neural implicit surface representation with a neural radiance cache to approximate global illumination, jointly optimizing geometry and reflectance through carefully designed regularization and initialization. We then introduce a dynamic radiance cache that adapts to sharp lighting discontinuities from near-field motion, and a surface-angle-weighted radiometric loss to suppress specular artifacts common in flashlight captures. Experiments show that GLOW substantially outperforms prior methods in material reflectance estimation under both natural and co-located illumination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLOW 针对手电筒式同位光源-相机 (co-located light-camera) 室内场景的逆渲染，用神经隐式表面加神经辐射缓存 (neural radiance cache) 近似全局光照，并引入随近场运动适应光照突变的动态辐射缓存与表面角度加权的辐射度损失。实验显示其在自然光与同位光照两种设置下的材质反射率估计上均显著优于已有方法。
Motivation: 室内逆渲染中反射率与光照本身存在歧义，多物体间反射进一步加剧；同位光源-相机虽便于用 Structure-from-Motion 标定光照，却带来强互反射、动态阴影、近场光照与移动高光等新问题，已有方法处理不了。
Method: GLOW 将神经隐式表面表示与神经辐射缓存结合以近似全局光照，通过专门设计的正则化与初始化联合优化几何与反射率；再加入动态辐射缓存以适应近场运动造成的锐利光照不连续，并用表面角度加权的辐射度损失抑制手电筒拍摄常见的镜面伪影。
Result: 实验表明 GLOW 在自然光照与同位光照两种设置下的材质反射率估计上均大幅优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 把全局光照近似（辐射缓存）与针对同位手电筒成像的动态缓存、角度加权损失一起设计，可以缓解室内逆渲染中反射率与光照的歧义并改善材质估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Construction of the Rashomon Slice for Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: In many machine learning problems, there may exist multiple models that achieve nearly identical predictive performance while relying on fundamentally different internal logic. However, standard training procedures produce a single model, offering no practical way to explore alternatives that may better suit downstream needs. The set of these equally accurate models is known as the Rashomon set. Exploring the Rashomon set is particularly challenging in large and complex hypothesis spaces, such as Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs), which are widely used in computer vision to make predictions through intermediate, human-understandable concepts. In this paper, we provide a method for efficiently exploring the Rashomon set of CBMs. Our framework introduces a specialized parallel parameter-efficient adaptation module, combined with a checkpointing scheme and a concept diversity objective, to generate multiple equally accurate CBMs from a single training process. Empirical results show that our method finds models with better diversity than baselines while using much less memory. We further demonstrate that access to these diverse yet accurate CBMs enables trustworthy model selection, resolution of inter-class confusion, and reliable abstention in decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从单次训练高效生成多个同等精度 Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) 的框架：并行的参数高效适配模块配合 checkpointing 与概念多样性目标，一次训练产出 Rashomon slice 上的一组模型。实证显示该方法比基线找到多样性更好的模型且内存占用大幅降低，并支撑可信模型选择、类间混淆消解与可靠拒答。
Motivation: 标准训练只产出单一模型，无法探索预测性能相近但内部逻辑不同的 Rashomon set；在 CBM 这类大而复杂的假设空间中这种探索尤其困难。
Method: 框架包含专门设计的并行参数高效适配模块 (parameter-efficient adaptation)、checkpointing 方案，以及概念多样性目标 (concept diversity objective)，从单一训练过程生成多个同等精度的 CBM。
Result: 实证结果表明该方法找到的模型多样性优于基线，同时内存占用显著更少；这些多样且准确的 CBM 支持可信模型选择、解决类间混淆，并在决策中实现可靠拒答 (abstention)。
Conclusion: Rashomon set 的探索可以通过参数高效适配在单次训练中完成，产出的多样化等精度 CBM 直接服务于模型选择与拒答等下游需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fine-Tune, Then Rectify
papers.abstract_en: Driven by recent advances in artificial intelligence, a growing literature has demonstrated the potential of using large language models (LLMs) as scalable surrogates to generate human-like responses. Two common approaches to improve the performance of LLMs include: fine-tuning, which aligns the LLM more closely with human responses, and rectification, which corrects biases in LLM outputs. In this paper, we develop a two-stage framework that combines fine-tuning and rectification, and optimally allocates limited labeled samples across the two stages. A key insight is that the conventional fine-tuning objective of minimizing mean squared prediction error is generally not aligned with the downstream rectification stage. For mean estimation, we propose to minimize the variance of the prediction errors; for general M-estimation, we propose to minimize a scalarized variance metric as the fine-tuning objective. Building on this insight, we leverage the scaling law of fine-tuning to optimally allocate the limited labeled human data between the fine-tuning and rectification stages. Our empirical analysis validates the fine-tuning scaling law and confirms that our proposed optimal allocation rule reliably identifies the optimal sample allocation. We demonstrate substantial efficiency gains in estimation and inference performance relative to fine-tuning or rectification alone, or to employing the conventional mean squared error objective within the fine-tuning then rectification framework. Such efficiency gains translate to significant cost savings for making reliable decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出「先微调后校正」(fine-tune then rectify) 两阶段框架，用微调阶段最小化预测误差方差（M-估计下为标量化方差度量）而非 MSE，使微调目标与下游校正对齐，再借微调 scaling law 在两阶段间最优分配有限标注样本。实证验证了微调 scaling law 与最优分配规则，并相对单独微调、单独校正或框架内使用 MSE 目标取得显著效率增益。
Motivation: 用 LLM 作可扩展代理做人类响应估计时，标注的人类数据有限；而常规微调所用的 MSE 目标与下游校正阶段并不一致，导致样本分配与目标函数都次优。
Method: 两阶段框架：先微调再对输出偏差做校正 (rectification)。均值估计下把微调目标改为最小化预测误差方差；一般 M-估计下改为最小化标量化方差度量。利用微调的 scaling law 在微调与校正两阶段间最优分配有限标注人类数据。
Result: 实证分析验证了微调 scaling law，并确认所提最优分配规则能可靠识别最优样本分配；相对单独微调、单独校正，或在 fine-tune-then-rectification 框架内沿用传统 MSE 目标，估计与推断效率均有 substantial 提升，并转化为显著成本节约。
Conclusion: 微调目标应按下游校正阶段来选（最小化误差方差而非 MSE），并据此用 scaling law 分配标注样本，才能在有限人类数据下同时提高估计推断效率并降低决策成本。

papers.title: Adaptive double-phase Rudin--Osher--Fatemi denoising model
papers.abstract_en: Even though more than 30 years have passed since the seminal Rudin--Osher--Fatemi (ROF) paper on total variation (TV) denoising, it remains relevant due to its simplicity, robustness and interpretability. However, it is known to suffer from artifacts such as the staircasing effect. Many variants of the model have been proposed with the aim of countering this. Recently, against the backdrop of immense research output on double-phase problems in the mathematical analysis community, a double-phase type integral functional, comprising of TV and a weighted term of quadratic growth, was suggested as a regularizer for image restoration. Here, we propose an adaptive variant of the ROF denoising model based on that regularizer. Variable growth of the double-phase functional allows for qualitatively different behavior at image contours, which are captured by an initial ROF reconstruction step. The model is designed to reduce staircasing with respect to the classical ROF model, while preserving the edges of the image in a similar fashion. We derive a closed-form resolvent formula and adapt the primal-dual Chambolle--Pock scheme for the numerical solution of the model. We also propose a practical noise-dependent parameter prescription and evaluate its performance on synthetic and natural images over a range of noise levels. Compared to established models with similar interpretability, we observe an improved or similar performance in terms of similarity metrics SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS, while the staircasing effect is visibly reduced.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 22 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary material available at: https://github.com/wojciechgorny/double-phase-ROF-model/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于双相 (double-phase) 泛函的自适应 ROF 去噪模型：先用经典 ROF 重建定位图像轮廓，再让含 TV 与二次增长加权项的双相泛函在轮廓内外呈现不同增长，从而在保持边缘的同时减轻阶梯效应 (staircasing)。推导了闭式 resolvent 公式并改造 primal-dual Chambolle--Pock 求解，给出噪声依赖的参数选取式；在合成与自然图像、跨多个噪声水平上，SSIM、PSNR、LPIPS 相对同等可解释性模型为相当或更优，且阶梯效应肉眼可见地减少。
Motivation: 经典 ROF 全变分去噪虽简单稳健可解释，但存在阶梯效应等伪影；已有变体多以牺牲可解释性为代价，需要在保留 ROF 式可解释性的同时抑制阶梯。
Method: 以双相型积分泛函（TV 加二次增长加权项）作正则项构造自适应 ROF 变体：初始 ROF 重建步捕捉轮廓，泛函的可变增长在轮廓处产生定性不同的行为；推导闭式 resolvent 公式，改造 primal-dual Chambolle--Pock 数值求解，并提出噪声依赖的参数选取规则。
Result: 在合成与自然图像、覆盖一系列噪声水平的评测中，相对同等可解释性的既有模型，SSIM、PSNR、LPIPS 相似度指标表现相当或更优，且阶梯效应明显减少；论文共 26 页、22 图、10 表。
Conclusion: 双相增长的自适应正则化可以在不牺牲 ROF 式可解释性与边缘保持的前提下减轻阶梯伪影，配合闭式 resolvent 与 Chambolle--Pock 求解及噪声依赖参数即可实用化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discrete optimal transport is a strong audio adversarial attack
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate discrete optimal transport (DOT) as a black-box attack against modern automatic speaker verification (ASV) and anti-spoofing countermeasure (CM) systems. Our attack operates as a post-processing distribution-alignment step. Frame-level WavLM embeddings of generated speech (or another person speech) are aligned to an unpaired bona fide speech pool using entropic optimal transport and a top-k barycentric projection, followed by neural vocoding. Unlike gradient-based attacks, the proposed method requires no access to model parameters, gradients, or training data. Experiments on ASVspoof2019 and ASVspoof5 demonstrate that DOT attack substantially increases CM EER and substantially degrades ASV performance across multiple spoofing attacks. The attack transfers across datasets and remains effective after CM fine-tuning. Analysis using speaker similarity, Fréchet Audio Distance, and visualization of embedding distributions suggests that DOT succeeds by shifting source speech toward bona fide regions of the representation space rather than by maximizing speaker similarity. These results indicate that optimal-transport-based distribution alignment represents a previously underexplored attack vector for contemporary ASV and anti-spoofing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离散最优传输 (DOT) 用作针对自动说话人验证 (ASV) 与其反欺骗对策 (CM) 的黑盒后处理攻击：对生成语音的帧级 WavLM 嵌入用熵最优传输对齐到未配对的真实语音池，再做 top-k 重心投影与神经声码。在 ASVspoof2019 与 ASVspoof5 上该攻击显著抬高 CM 的 EER、显著劣化 ASV 表现，可跨数据集迁移且在 CM 微调后仍有效。
Motivation: 现有语音对抗攻击多依赖模型参数、梯度或训练数据，而面向 ASV 与反欺骗系统的黑盒、后处理式分布对齐攻击路径此前基本未被探索。
Method: 以 DOT 做后处理分布对齐：取生成语音（或他人语音）的帧级 WavLM 嵌入，用熵最优传输 (entropic OT) 对齐到未配对 bona fide 语音池，接 top-k 重心投影，再经神经声码器还原波形；全程不访问模型参数、梯度或训练数据。
Result: 在 ASVspoof2019 与 ASVspoof5 上，DOT 攻击在多种欺骗攻击下大幅提高 CM EER 并显著降低 ASV 性能；攻击可跨数据集迁移，且在 CM 微调后依然有效。用说话人相似度、Fréchet Audio Distance 与嵌入分布可视化分析，表明其机制是把源语音推向表征空间中 bona fide 区域，而非最大化说话人相似度。
Conclusion: 基于最优传输的分布对齐是当代 ASV 与反欺骗系统一个此前被低估的攻击面，黑盒、无需梯度的后处理对齐即可实质性破坏其判别能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Uncertainty for Detecting and Correcting Hallucinations in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are known to hallucinate, generating linguistically plausible but incorrect answers to questions. Uncertainty quantification has been proposed as a strategy to detect such behaviour, but existing methods lack a unified framework to assess reliability at both the prompt and answer level. We introduce a geometric framework which quantifies language model uncertainty at both levels by explicitly modelling a prompt-conditioned semantic distribution in answer embedding space. Our approach is black-box and sampling-based; we generate multiple answers per prompt, and use archetypal analysis to estimate a geometric support for the answer distribution. At the prompt level, we approximate the distribution entropy to quantify uncertainty; for each individual answer, we then use notions of atypicality to assess its reliability relative to the batch. We employ our framework to not only detect hallucinations but correct them, by selecting the batch example deemed most reliable. Experiments show that our framework performs comparably to or better than prior methods on short form question-answering datasets, and achieves superior results on medical datasets where hallucinations carry particularly critical risks. Beyond pure performance, we suggest the theoretical grounding of our work provides support for semantic distributions as useful objects of study for language model uncertainty.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures. Camera-ready version, published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=5UVv7gkgUD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑盒、采样式的几何不确定性框架：对每个 prompt 生成多个答案，在答案嵌入空间中用 archetypal analysis 估计语义分布的几何支撑，用近似分布熵度量 prompt 级不确定性，用 atypicality 度量单个答案相对同批的可靠性，并把最可靠样本选作纠正后的答案。在短问答数据集上与已有方法相当或更好，在医疗数据集上取得更优结果。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法缺少统一框架，无法同时在 prompt 级与答案级评估可靠性，检测幻觉后也难以直接纠正。
Method: 黑盒采样式框架：每个 prompt 采样多个答案，用 archetypal analysis 在答案嵌入空间估计 prompt 条件语义分布的几何支撑；prompt 级用近似分布熵作不确定性，答案级用 atypicality 评估相对同批的可靠性，并从批中选出最可靠样本来纠正幻觉。
Result: 在短形式问答数据集上表现与已有方法相当或更好；在医疗数据集（幻觉风险尤其关键）上取得更优结果。
Conclusion: 语义分布可作为研究语言模型不确定性的有用对象，其理论支撑同时支持幻觉的检测与纠正。

papers.title: Integrated Multivariate Segmentation Tree for Heterogeneous Credit Data Analysis in Small- and Medium-Sized Enterprises
papers.abstract_en: Traditional decision tree models, which rely exclusively on numerical variables, often face challenges in handling high-dimensional data and are limited in their ability to incorporate textual information effectively. To address these limitations, we propose the integrated multivariate segmentation tree (IMST), a comprehensive framework designed to improve credit evaluation for small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by integrating financial data with textual sources. This method comprises three core stages: (1) transforming textual data into numerical matrices through matrix factorization, (2) selecting salient financial features using Lasso regression, and (3) constructing a multivariate segmentation tree based on either the Gini index or entropy, with weakest-link pruning applied to control model complexity. Experimental results based on a dataset of 1,428 Chinese SMEs demonstrated that IMST achieved an accuracy rate of 88.9%, surpassing both baseline decision trees (87.4%) and conventional models such as support vector machines and neural networks. Furthermore, the proposed model demonstrated superior interpretability and computational efficiency, featuring a more streamlined architecture and improved risk detection capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IMST（integrated multivariate segmentation tree），把 SME 文本经矩阵分解转成数值矩阵，用 Lasso 筛金融特征，再按 Gini 或熵构建多变量分割树并以 weakest-link 剪枝控复杂度。在 1,428 家中国中小企业数据上准确率 88.9%，高于基线决策树 87.4% 及 SVM、神经网络。
Motivation: 传统决策树只用数值变量，难以处理高维数据，也无法有效纳入文本信息，限制了中小企业信用评估的准确性与可解释性。
Method: IMST 三阶段框架：矩阵分解将文本转为数值矩阵；Lasso 回归筛选关键金融特征；基于 Gini 指数或熵构建多变量分割树，并用 weakest-link pruning 控制模型复杂度。
Result: 在 1,428 家中国 SME 数据集上，IMST 准确率 88.9%，基线决策树 87.4%，并超过 SVM 与神经网络；同时在可解释性、计算效率与风险检测能力上更优，架构更精简。
Conclusion: 把文本数值化与特征筛选嵌入决策树框架，可在保持可解释性与计算效率的同时提升中小企业信用评估准确率。

summary_sections.result: 在 1,428 家中国 SME 数据集上，IMST 准确率 88.9%，基线决策树 87.4%，并超过 SVM 与神经网络；同时在可解释性、计算效率与风险检测能力上更优，架构更精简。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把文本数值化与特征筛选嵌入决策树框架，可在保持可解释性与计算效率的同时提升中小企业信用评估准确率。

papers.title: FastManly: An EM-Gradient Algorithm for Manly Mixture Models
papers.abstract_en: A faster implementation of mixtures of Manly transformations is proposed. This method, called FastManly, uses Newton's method for optimization in an EM gradient algorithm instead of Nelder-Mead in a traditional EM. A gradient and full Hessian are derived. Simulations show improved performance with noticeable speedups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastManly 把 Manly 变换混合模型的传统 EM 中的 Nelder-Mead 换成基于梯度的 Newton 优化，并推导出完整梯度与 Hessian。模拟显示其性能更好且有明显加速。
Motivation: Manly 变换混合模型的传统 EM 依赖 Nelder-Mead 这类无导数优化，速度慢、性能受限，需要更快的实现。
Method: 提出 FastManly：在 EM gradient 框架内用 Newton's method 做优化替代传统 EM 中的 Nelder-Mead，并推导出梯度与完整 Hessian。
Result: 模拟实验显示性能提升，并有明显加速 (noticeable speedups)；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用带解析梯度与 Hessian 的 Newton 优化替换无导数搜索，可让 Manly 混合模型的 EM 更快且表现更好。

papers.title: Silent Failures in Agent-Tool Interaction: An Audit of ToolUniverse
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are increasingly adopting automated pipelines that integrate multiple tools. While prior research and benchmarks have studied about task success and task completion of these agentic systems, the research about agent to tool interaction, specifically in biology agentic workflow is limited. This study investigates specific failures in agent to tool interaction where a tool invocation appears successful, some or all of the information or functionality from the tool via API/ wrapper is incomplete or missing and there are no communications / notifications to the user or the agent about such missing information. We call this a silent failures as the user or the agents are not aware that such failure has occurred. For the purposes of this study we developed an audit mechanism to identify such silent failures in Agent to tool interaction, by examining 15 scientific tools (and their associated API documentation and tool documentations) integrated within ToolUniverse environment (ToolUniverse serves as our experimental environment rather than the object of the study itself). We structure our study around 7 failure locus characterising where the failure occurs in the chain. We observed 91 failures (manually validated post LLM based candidate discovery and automated testing), most frequent of them being missing data or fields and inconsistencies in search, filtering or ranking criteria. Most of the 91 failures occurred in API layer (51) or wrapper layer (25), with a potential of silent failure amplification downstream. The results show that silent failures originate upstream of the event and propagate downstream into apparently valid scientific outputs. We propose a concept of contextual reliability to handle such failures and suggest mechanisms for testing, disclosing, monitoring, and measuring such failures across the agent-tool interaction pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 ToolUniverse 中 15 个科学工具做 agent-tool 交互审计，发现 91 例“静默失败”：调用看似成功但返回信息缺失且无任何告警，其中 51 例在 API 层、25 例在 wrapper 层，最常见的是字段缺失与搜索/过滤/排序不一致。作者据此提出 contextual reliability 概念，主张在整条交互链路上做测试、披露、监控与度量。
Motivation: 既有 agent 基准只看任务成功率与完成度，对生物学 agentic workflow 中“调用成功但信息残缺且无告警”这类静默失败缺少研究与审计手段。
Method: 开发一套静默失败审计机制：以 LLM 生成候选失败再经自动化测试与人工校验，检查 ToolUniverse 内 15 个科学工具的 API 文档与工具文档，并按 7 个 failure locus 刻画失败在链路中的位置；ToolUniverse 仅作实验环境而非研究对象。
Result: 共确认 91 例静默失败，最频繁的是数据/字段缺失与搜索、过滤、排序标准不一致；按层次分布为 API 层 51 例、wrapper 层 25 例，其余落在其他 locus，且上游失败会向下游传播成看似合法的科学输出。
Conclusion: 静默失败起源于事件上游并沿 agent-tool 链路放大，因此需要用 contextual reliability 概念配合测试、披露、监控与度量机制来处理，而非只看任务成功率。

papers.title: Spec2COBOLRot: An Agentic-AI Degradation Loop for Realistic COBOL Corpus Generation
papers.abstract_en: COBOL remains widely deployed, yet representative corpora reflecting real production code are rarely available, limiting rigorous benchmarking of modernization approaches. We propose a systematic agentic AI pipeline for generating realistic COBOL programs, combining specification-driven generation with iterative degradation guided by patterns and complexity targets extracted from real production code. Here, realism is understood as structural fidelity to production code as captured by our metrics. We evaluate whether degradation reaches target complexity levels while preserving business behavior, and examine the limits of the approach, across three programs from distinct business domains. Results show the pipeline reliably produces syntactically valid programs and moves them toward realistic structural complexity. However, preserving business behavior is not always achieved by construction, and targeting structural metrics independently of business logic risks producing programs whose complexity does not reflect a plausible maintenance history. We discuss these limitations and outline a more realistic alternative as a direction for future work, generating legacy programs from scratch along a simulated development history.
papers.journal_ref: The 2nd International Workshop on AI for Software Modernization (AISM 2026) co-located with Automated Software Engineering Conference, Oct 2026, Munich (Allemagne), Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spec2COBOLRot：用 agentic AI 流水线先按规格生成 COBOL 程序，再依据从真实生产代码提取的模式与复杂度目标做迭代退化 (iterative degradation)。在三个不同业务领域的程序上，该流水线能稳定产出语法有效、结构复杂度趋近目标的程序，但业务行为保持并非总能达成。
Motivation: 反映真实生产代码的 COBOL 语料稀缺，导致现代化方法缺乏严格基准；且脱离业务逻辑单独逼近结构指标，会产出不反映真实维护历史的程序。
Method: 规格驱动生成 (specification-driven generation) 与迭代退化相结合：从真实生产代码中提取模式与复杂度目标，agentic AI 流水线反复退化程序以逼近目标结构复杂度，同时检验业务行为是否保持。
Result: 在三个不同业务领域的程序上评估：流水线可靠产出语法有效程序并使其结构复杂度趋近目标；但业务行为保持并非总能由构造保证，独立于业务逻辑瞄准结构指标存在产出不合理维护历史的风险。
Conclusion: 作者认为更现实的替代路径是从零生成遗留程序并模拟其开发历史，而非在生成后单独做结构退化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Validation and Simulation Catch Different Errors: Four Levels of Evaluation for LLM-Generated Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Simulation success is not equivalent to structural correctness for LLM-generated circuits. We define and measure four evaluation levels -- schema validity, topological validity, backend executability, and component-set agreement -- on a 150-circuit trilingual benchmark, through a deployed pipeline built on a typed circuit interchange representation. The levels are not nested. On gpt-4o-mini, 16 of 150 circuits (10.7%, 95% CI 6.7-16.6) were rejected by the topological validator but executed in ngspice with no error or warning; 12 of these contained exactly the requested components, with one terminal disconnected. Conversely, 7 circuits (4.7%) passed the validator and ngspice refused them. Ten failed both checks and 117 passed both, so each check detects a class the other misses. A minimal three-component divider shows the cost: a dangling resistor reports 5.00 V instead of 2.50 V while ngspice stays silent. A paired ablation, in which every arm is evaluated from the same model sample rather than a fresh one, separates each repair stage from sampling noise. On a stratified 45-circuit subsample, model repair raised topological validity from 40.0% to 84.4% (+20 circuits, no regressions) while moving executability by a net 6 (+7, -1), an effect this sample size does not resolve, and component agreement by 2. One circuit moved in opposite directions at two levels in a single repair step. Against a direct-netlist baseline the pipeline executed 88.7% against 47.3%, or 62.7% under an accounting that credits the baseline with every failure we cannot confidently attribute to the netlist. These results support a narrow methodological conclusion: structural validation and simulation should be reported as distinct evaluation stages for LLM-generated circuits. A circuit that runs is not necessarily structurally valid, and a structurally valid circuit is not necessarily executable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 生成电路的仿真成功不等于结构正确：在 150 电路三语言基准上，gpt-4o-mini 有 16 个（10.7%）被拓扑校验拒绝却在 ngspice 中无错无警告运行，另有 7 个（4.7%）通过校验却被 ngspice 拒绝，两类检查各抓到对方漏掉的错误。作者据此主张把结构校验与仿真作为两个独立评测阶段分别报告。
Motivation: LLM 生成电路常以仿真能否跑通作为唯一验收标准，但悬空元件等结构缺陷会让 ngspice 静默给出错误结果（分压器中悬空电阻报 5.00 V 而非 2.50 V），仿真成功掩盖结构错误。
Method: 基于带类型的电路中间表示构建已部署的流水线，定义并测量四个评测层级：schema validity、topological validity、backend executability、component-set agreement；在 150 电路三语言基准上评测 gpt-4o-mini，并用配对消融（每个臂从同一模型样本而非新样本评估）把各修复阶段与采样噪声分离。
Result: 150 电路中 16 个（10.7%，95% CI 6.7–16.6）被拓扑校验拒绝但 ngspice 正常执行，其中 12 个恰含请求元件、仅一个端子悬空；7 个（4.7%）通过校验但 ngspice 拒绝；10 个两项都失败，117 个两项都通过。分层 45 电路子样本上，模型修复把拓扑有效率从 40.0% 提到 84.4%（+20 个电路，无回归），可执行性净 +6（+7、−1，该样本量无法分辨），元件一致性 +2；一个电路在单次修复中两个层级反向变化。相对 direct-netlist 基线，流水线执行率 88.7% 对 47.3%，在把无法归因于 netlist 的失败都记给基线的口径下为 62.7%。
Conclusion: 结构校验与仿真必须作为两个独立评测阶段分别报告：能运行的电路未必结构有效，结构有效的电路也未必可执行。

papers.title: Faithful, Interpretable Chest X-ray Diagnosis with Artifact-free B-cos Networks
papers.abstract_en: Faithfulness and interpretability are essential for deploying deep neural networks (DNNs) in safety-critical domains such as medical image analysis. B-cos networks modify the parameterization of convolutional and classification layers to measure class evidence via feature-weight alignment, enabling built-in, class-specific contribution maps without post-hoc explanations. While maintaining diagnostic performance competitive with state-of-the-art DNNs, standard B-cos networks exhibit severe aliasing artifacts in their explanation maps, rendering them unsuitable for clinical use, where clarity is essential. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing anti-aliasing strategies using ASAP and BlurPool (BP) to significantly improve explanation quality. Our experiments on chest X-ray datasets demonstrate that the modified $\text{B-cos}_\mathrm{ASAP}$ and $\text{B-cos}_\mathrm{BP}$ preserve strong predictive performance while providing faithful and artifact-free explanations suitable for clinical application in multi-class and multi-label settings. Code is available at: https://github.com/shrebox/Artifact-free-B-cos-Networks.
papers.comment: First two listed authors have equal contributions. Accepted at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: B-cos 网络用特征-权重对齐直接给出类别证据图，但标准版本的解释图有严重混叠伪影 (aliasing artifacts)，不适合临床使用。引入 ASAP 与 BlurPool 两种抗混叠策略得到 B-cos_ASAP 与 B-cos_BP，在胸部 X 光数据集上保持强预测性能的同时给出无伪影、忠实的解释，覆盖多类与多标签两种设定。
Motivation: 医疗影像等安全攸关场景要求解释本身清晰可靠，而标准 B-cos 网络的解释图存在严重混叠伪影，使其无法直接用于临床。
Method: 在 B-cos 网络的卷积与分类层参数化基础上加入抗混叠策略 ASAP 与 BlurPool，得到 B-cos_ASAP 与 B-cos_BP，用特征-权重对齐 (feature-weight alignment) 生成内置的类别专属贡献图，无需事后解释方法；在胸部 X 光数据集上做实验，覆盖多类与多标签设定。
Result: 在胸部 X 光数据集上，修改后的 B-cos_ASAP 与 B-cos_BP 显著改善解释质量，同时保持与最先进 DNN 竞争的强预测性能；评估覆盖多类与多标签设定。
Conclusion: 抗混叠改造能让 B-cos 网络在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下产出无伪影、忠实的解释，从而可用于临床。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Bridging LLM Serving and CXL-SSDs with Chunk-Aware KV Cache Management
papers.abstract_en: NAND-backed storage offers the capacity needed to scale LLM prefix caching, but its block I/O path incurs CPU cache contention and host-DRAM staging in addition to NAND latency. Our characterization shows that these interface costs persist even with DRAM as the storage medium, motivating CXL-SSDs for byte-addressable access to NAND-backed capacity. Surprisingly, however, a stock CXL-SSD remains about 3$\times$ slower than local DRAM and no faster than an NVMe SSD, while generic prefetching provides little benefit. We present LM-CXD, a CXL-SSD specialized for LLM prefix caching. LM-CXD bridges the semantic gap between the serving engine, which knows which KV chunks will be consumed, and the device, which controls their placement and movement. It makes KV chunks device-visible I/O units, exposes NAND-to-DRAM progress to the serving engine, and uses device DRAM as a GPU-accessible buffer. LM-CXD further coordinates request scheduling with windowed prefetching and pipelines layerwise KV movement with GPU computation to hide NAND latency under limited device DRAM. Across five LLM models, LM-CXD reduces average TTFT over a stock CXL-SSD by up to 2.6$\times$ with compute asynchronous prefetching and 4.03$\times$ with layerwise prefetching, achieving TTFT within 1.5$\times$ of local DRAM on average.

papers.title: What Makes a Terminal-Bench Task Hard? Separating Genuine Hardness from Fake-Hardness on an Adjudicated Agentic Corpus
papers.abstract_en: Frontier benchmarks need tasks that current models cannot solve. But a task that no model solves is not automatically a hard task. The same zero pass rate can come from a real capability gap, but it can also come from missing context, a broken reference solution, infrastructure failure, or a verifier that can be bypassed. In this paper, we study this issue using a frozen Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 production record with 1,081 pull requests, 639 scored tasks, 28,801 trials, and $105,933 in logged agent spend. We ask what an all-fail task actually certifies. For the 125 tasks with no honest pass, we combine task artifacts, reference-solution runs, empty-solution controls, adversarial trials, trajectories, telemetry, and review records, and apply an ordered validity screen. Only 78 of the 125 tasks survive as certified-unsolved candidates. The remaining tasks include 14 with broken oracles, 8 dominated by infrastructure failures, 4 that are only passable through verifier bypasses, and 21 whose solvability is not certified by the available evidence. Thus, lack of saturation and genuine difficulty are not the same thing. The certified-unsolved label is also narrow: it means that the authored route passed, infrastructure did not dominate, no strict bypass was observed, and all evaluated agents failed. It does not prove intrinsic hardness, verifier completeness, or failure at the intended capability. We further analyze rejected submissions and passing tasks to show that pass rate alone cannot explain why a task is difficult. Overall, our results suggest that frontier benchmarks should report the evidence behind their all-fail tasks before using them as capability claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零通过率不等于任务真难：在冻结的 Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 生产记录上，对 125 个无诚实通过的任务做有序有效性筛查，只有 78 个能认证为 unsolved，其余来自坏 oracle、基础设施故障、可绕过 verifier 或证据不足。作者主张前沿基准在把 all-fail 任务当作能力主张之前，必须先公开支撑该任务的证据。
Motivation: 前沿基准需要模型做不出的任务，但同一个零通过率可能来自真实能力缺口，也可能来自缺失上下文、坏掉的参考解、基础设施故障或可被绕过的 verifier，导致能力主张失真。
Method: 用冻结的 Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 生产记录（1,081 个 pull request、639 个计分任务、28,801 次 trial、105,933 美元 agent 开销），对 125 个无诚实通过的任务综合任务工件、参考解运行、空解对照、对抗性 trial、轨迹、遥测与评审记录，施加有序有效性筛查 (ordered validity screen)；另分析被拒提交与通过任务。
Result: 125 个全败任务中仅 78 个存活为 certified-unsolved 候选；其余含 14 个坏 oracle、8 个以基础设施故障为主、4 个只能靠绕过 verifier 通过、21 个可解性未获现有证据认证。
Conclusion: 未饱和与真正困难不是一回事，pass rate 本身无法解释任务为何难；all-fail 任务在用作能力主张前应先报告其证据，且 certified-unsolved 只认证作者路径可通、基础设施未主导、无严格绕过、所有被评 agent 失败，不证明内在难度或 verifier 完备性。

papers.title: HARN: Hierarchical Associative Resonance Network for Event-Driven Multi-Timeframe Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Financial time series evolve across multiple temporal resolutions, challenging forecasting systems to incorporate newly available information without repeatedly recomputing unchanged representations. We introduce HARN, a Hierarchical Associative Resonance Network for event-driven multi-timeframe forecasting. HARN maintains persistent representations across temporal levels and updates each level only when its corresponding completed bar becomes available. The architecture combines causal multi-scale temporal encoding, gated associative memory, cross-level resonance, and hierarchical evidence aggregation, with forecasting performed in basis-point space and reconstructed to the original price scale. We evaluate HARN on four assets spanning equity, foreign exchange, and commodity markets using multiple random seeds and component ablations. HARN achieves competitive reconstructed-price forecasting errors against single-timeframe PatchTST and TimeXer baselines, while ablations reveal the effects of removing individual components across assets and timeframes. A code-level audit further examines consistency between the implementation and the defined event-driven causal protocol. The results position HARN as a persistent multi-timeframe forecasting framework rather than evidence of universal predictive superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HARN 面向金融多时间框架预测，只在对应周期的完整 bar 到达时增量更新该层级表示，避免重复重算未变的表征。在股票、外汇、商品四类资产上，其重建价格误差相对单时间框架的 PatchTST 与 TimeXer 具有竞争力，消融显示各组件在不同资产与时间框架上的作用。作者明确定位为持久化多时间框架预测框架，而非普适预测优势的证据。
Motivation: 金融时间序列跨多个时间分辨率演化，新信息到来时系统往往要反复重算未变化的表示，计算浪费且难以事件驱动地吸收增量信息。
Method: HARN 由因果多尺度时间编码、门控联想记忆 (gated associative memory)、跨层级共振 (cross-level resonance) 与层级证据聚合组成；预测在 basis-point 空间进行再重建回原始价格尺度，各层级仅在对应完整 bar 可用时更新。评测覆盖股票、外汇、商品四类资产，使用多个随机种子与组件消融，并做实现与事件驱动因果协议一致性的代码级审计。
Result: 在四类资产上，HARN 的重建价格预测误差相对单时间框架的 PatchTST 与 TimeXer 基线具有竞争力；组件消融揭示移除单个组件在各资产与时间框架上的影响。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: HARN 的定位是持久化多时间框架预测框架，其结果不构成普适预测优越性的证据。

papers.title: Signal2Symbol: Neuro-Symbolic Temporal Reasoning for Explainable Physiological Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Physiological time series such as electrocardiograms (ECG) and electroencephalograms (EEG) exhibit complex temporal structure, substantial acquisition variability, and a strong need for transparent decision-making. Although deep models can achieve high detection performance, they often provide limited insight into why a segment is anomalous, how local anomalies relate over time, and whether a detection belongs to a broader recurring pattern. We propose Signal2Symbol, a neuro-symbolic framework for explainable biosignal anomaly detection. The method first converts ECG/EEG signals into symbolic sequences using either a learned VQ-VAE (Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder) codebook or a SAX (Symbolic Aggregate approXimation) baseline. It then constructs bigram enriched token-window transactions and scores anomalies through rare itemset evidence derived from minimal rare itemset mining. Detected anomalous windows are merged into intervals and related using Allen interval algebra, enabling composite temporal explanations such as escalation chains, artifact overlap, and cross-channel synchrony. Finally, we introduce a rare temporal concept lattice based on Formal Concept Analysis (FCA), which groups anomalous intervals by shared rare symbolic evidence, Allen temporal relations, channel context, and robustness attributes. The resulting Galois lattice compresses many local detections into interpretable families of temporal-symbolic anomalies. We evaluate on three public benchmarks: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia (beat-level ECG), PTB-XL (record-level ECG), and the Bonn EEG dataset (segment-level EEG). We stress-test robustness under additive noise and baseline-wander perturbations. The results highlight the value of neuro-symbolic tokenization for temporal anomaly analysis and show that Allen/FCA reasoning provides compact, interpretable summaries of local detections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Signal2Symbol 把 ECG/EEG 转成符号序列，用稀有项集证据打分异常窗口，再以 Allen 区间代数与 FCA 概念格把局部检测压缩成可解释的时间-符号异常族。在 MIT-BIH、PTB-XL、Bonn EEG 三个公开基准上评估并做加噪与基线漂移扰动的鲁棒性压力测试，结论是神经符号分词配合 Allen/FCA 推理能给出紧凑可解释的汇总。
Motivation: 深度模型检测生理信号异常性能高，却难以说明某段为何异常、局部异常如何随时间关联、以及是否属于更大范围的复发模式；ECG/EEG 又有强采集变异性，需要透明决策。
Method: 先用学习到的 VQ-VAE codebook 或 SAX 基线把 ECG/EEG 转为符号序列，构造 bigram 增强的 token-window 事务，用 minimal rare itemset mining 的稀有项集证据给异常打分；异常窗口合并为区间后用 Allen interval algebra 关联，产生 escalation chains、artifact overlap、cross-channel synchrony 等复合时间解释；再用基于 Formal Concept Analysis 的 rare temporal concept lattice 按共享稀有符号证据、Allen 时间关系、通道上下文与鲁棒性属性对异常区间分组。
Result: 在三个公开基准上评估：MIT-BIH Arrhythmia（beat-level ECG）、PTB-XL（record-level ECG）、Bonn EEG dataset（segment-level EEG），并在加性噪声与基线漂移 (baseline-wander) 扰动下做鲁棒性压力测试；结果突出神经符号分词对时间异常分析的价值，并显示 Allen/FCA 推理给出紧凑、可解释的局部检测汇总。
Conclusion: 把生理信号异常检测做成符号化加时间代数推理的管线，可以在压缩大量局部检测的同时保留可解释的异常族结构，且对噪声与基线漂移扰动具备鲁棒性。

papers.title: Learning Stiffness Dependent Fluid Structure Dynamics from Coarse Flow Representations
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a data-driven framework for long-term prediction of fluid--structure interaction (FSI) dynamics, focusing on the flow-induced vibration (FIV) of a flexible plate. A stiffness-conditioned neural evolution operator jointly represents the Eulerian flow field and Lagrangian structural state. The plate is represented by 101 ordered structural tokens carrying nodal coordinates and velocities, with nondimensional bending stiffness as a global conditioning variable. Bidirectional cross-attention couples fluid and structural representations within a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. Trained with staged multi-step autoregressive rollouts and symmetry-reflected trajectories, a single operator captures three stiffness-dependent response regimes: deflected--flapping, deflected, and flapping. The predicted trajectories preserve the principal flow structures, structural oscillations, and dominant frequencies, while blind 1000-step rollouts remain bounded. The operator also interpolates to stiffness values excluded from training. To reduce sensitivity to under-resolved near-wall gradients in force reconstruction, we develop a differentiable aerodynamic-force module based on the derivative-moment transformation (DMT). Conventional wall-stress surface integrals are replaced by an enclosed 2D curve integral around the core vortex region, enabling accurate reconstruction of lift and drag. A Signed Distance Function (SDF) and smoothed Dirac-delta formulation make the integration fully differentiable while preserving gradient flow. The proposed framework provides an accurate and differentiable surrogate for stiffness-dependent FSI dynamics, enabling efficient parameter studies and future stiffness optimization for flow-energy-harvesting applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出刚度条件化的神经演化算子 (stiffness-conditioned neural evolution operator)，用混合 CNN-Transformer 双向交叉注意力联合表示柔性板 FSI 的 Eulerian 流场与 Lagrangian 结构态，单一算子覆盖 deflected-flapping、deflected、flapping 三种刚度响应区。1000 步盲外推轨迹保持有界，并可插值到训练未见的刚度值；气动力改用 DMT 曲线积分后升阻力可精确重构。
Motivation: 流致振动 (FIV) 中柔性板响应随弯曲刚度切换多个区制，传统 CFD 逐参数重算代价高，且近壁梯度欠分辨使壁面应力积分重构的力对网格敏感。
Method: 板用 101 个有序结构 token 表示节点坐标与速度，无量纲弯曲刚度作全局条件变量；双向交叉注意力耦合流体与结构表示，采用混合 CNN-Transformer 架构。训练用分阶段多步自回归 rollout 加对称反射轨迹；气动力部分用可微的 derivative-moment transformation (DMT)，以核心涡区外围 2D 闭合曲线积分替代壁面应力面积分，配合 Signed Distance Function (SDF) 与平滑 Dirac-delta 保持梯度流。
Result: 单一算子捕获三种刚度相关响应区制 (deflected-flapping、deflected、flapping)；预测轨迹保持主要流动结构、结构振荡与主频，1000 步盲 rollout 保持有界；可插值到训练中被排除的刚度值；DMT 曲线积分实现升力与阻力的精确重构。
Conclusion: 把刚度作为条件变量并配合可微气动力模块，可得到一个覆盖多刚度区制、可外推可微的 FSI 代理，用于参数研究与流向集能的刚度优化。

papers.title: An improved periodic activation for PINNs reconstructing convective flows
papers.abstract_en: Architectures with periodic activation functions have already been shown to be beneficial in comparison to monotonic counterparts for a wide range of applications of physics-informed neural networks. Here, we investigate a network architecture which uses the complex exponential function, generating pairs of sine and cosine outputs as activation functions. Testing it against comparable, sine-activated multi-layer perceptrons for the task of temperature reconstruction from sparse velocity data for cubic Rayleigh-Bénard convection reveals significant improvements in the reconstruction quality without a substantial increase in computational cost per training step. Vice versa, the improved architecture enables reaching similar reconstruction qualities for a fraction of the expense. Analyzing the mathematical structure of these networks points to the improvements being rooted in the property of passing both a sine and cosine function forward. This way, the subsequent layer is able to adapt the phase of the provided latent periodic functions, and doing it individually for each of its neurons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 中用复指数函数作激活，使每个神经元同时前向传播 sine 与 cosine 对，从而让下一层可逐神经元调整潜在周期函数的相位。用于从稀疏速度数据重建立方 Rayleigh-Bénard 对流的温度场，重建质量显著优于同等规模的 sine 激活 MLP，而每步训练开销没有实质增加；反之达到同等重建质量只需一小部分代价。
Motivation: 从稀疏速度数据反演对流温度场是病欠定的反问题，单调激活的 PINN 表达周期结构效率低，sine 激活虽好但相位无法逐神经元调节。
Method: 提出以复指数函数为激活的网络架构，每个单元同时产生 sine 与 cosine 输出对，供下一层逐神经元调整相位；对照组为结构可比的 sine 激活多层感知机 (MLP)，任务是立方 Rayleigh-Bénard 对流中由稀疏速度数据重建温度，并从数学结构上分析改进来源。
Result: 在立方 Rayleigh-Bénard 对流的稀疏速度→温度重建任务上，复指数激活相对 sine 激活 MLP 显著提升重建质量，且每步训练成本没有实质增加；反向看，达到相同重建质量只需一小部分计算代价。
Conclusion: 改进来自同时前向传递 sine 与 cosine：后续层得以逐神经元调节潜在周期函数的相位，因此复指数激活在 PINN 周期性任务上以不增的单步成本换到更高质量或更低成本。

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Fusion Network for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-source remote sensing image classification has attracted increasing attention due to the complementary spectral, structural, and geometric information. However, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: insufficient semantic contextual modeling and unreliable feature fusion caused by slight spatial misalignment. To address these issues, we propose a Semantic-Guided Fusion Network (SGFNet) for multi-source remote sensing image classification. Specifically, the Semantic Mixing Convolution Block (SMCB) is designed to dynamically generate semantic-aware convolution kernels according to contextual relationships among feature representations. In addition, the Frequency Modulated Fusion Block (FMFB) is introduced to perform cross-modal interaction in the frequency domain, which effectively alleviates the influence of slight spatial misalignment and improves complementary information fusion. Extensive experiments conducted on the Augsburg and Houston 2018 datasets demonstrate that the proposed SGFNet consistently outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/oucailab/SGFNet .
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE GRSL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义引导融合网络 SGFNet，用语义混合卷积块 (SMCB) 按特征上下文动态生成语义感知卷积核，并用频率调制融合块 (FMFB) 在频域做跨模态交互，以缓解轻微空间失配导致的不可靠融合。在 Augsburg 与 Houston 2018 多源遥感分类数据集上，SGFNet 一致优于多种现有先进方法。
Motivation: 多源遥感图像分类中，现有方法的语义上下文建模不足，且轻微空间失配会造成特征融合不可靠。
Method: SGFNet 含两个核心模块：SMCB 依据特征表征间的上下文关系动态生成语义感知卷积核；FMFB 在频域执行跨模态交互，抑制轻微空间失配的影响并促进互补信息融合。
Result: 在 Augsburg 和 Houston 2018 数据集上，SGFNet 的分类表现一致超过多种 state-of-the-art 方法；代码已公开于 github.com/oucailab/SGFNet。
Conclusion: 语义感知的动态卷积加频域跨模态融合，是提升多源遥感图像分类精度的有效组合，且对轻微空间失配更稳健。

papers.title: The Drift Contract: Spectral Updates for Depth-Robust Local Learning
papers.abstract_en: Local learning trains each layer with its own auxiliary loss and no global backward pass, which makes layer updates structurally parallel. Two problems have kept it marginal: accuracy degrades as depth grows, and hyperparameters are fragile. We apply Muon-style spectral update geometry (momentum orthogonalization with spectral step scaling) to per-layer local updates, an intersection not previously studied. On CIFAR-10 MLP benchmarks with local linear heads, a single step-size setting is the best value in our tested grids from width 128 to 2048 and from depth 12 to 48, while local Adam requires re-tuning along both axes and still collapses at depth 48 (31.3 percent re-tuned per depth, 19 percent with its depth-12 setting transferred, vs 42.7 percent for the spectral update at its unchanged setting). At five seeds and width 512 the spectral update leads local Adam by a clear margin (48.9 +/- 0.5 vs 46.6 +/- 0.3). Prospectively specified controls attribute the transfer and most of the depth robustness to the spectral geometry itself rather than to any step-size rule on top of it. We additionally formulate the step size as a drift contract, lr = epsilon / RMS(input), which bounds each layer's weight-induced pre-activation change per step, conditioned on its current input. The contract yields a small gain over the best fixed learning rate where that baseline is measured, makes the step size interpretable, and provides a per-layer, input-conditioned drift bound that standard optimizers do not offer. We report one negative result: with RMSNorm and weight decay in the trunk, the stability benefit of spectral updates accrues to global rather than local training, so the local advantage concentrates precisely where normalization is absent.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Code and raw results: https://github.com/infinition/drift-contract
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Muon 式谱更新几何（动量正交化 + 谱步长缩放）用于逐层局部学习 (local learning)，使单一学习率在宽度 128–2048、深度 12–48 上都取到网格最优，而 local Adam 需沿两轴重调且在深度 48 崩溃。CIFAR-10 MLP 上深度 48 时谱更新 42.7% vs local Adam 重调后 31.3%、迁移设置 19%；宽度 512 五种子下 48.9±0.5 vs 46.6±0.3。作者同时给出漂移契约 lr = ε/RMS(input)，并报告带 RMSNorm 与 weight decay 时稳定性收益转向全局训练的负结果。
Motivation: 局部学习免去全局反向传播、层间可结构并行，但精度随深度下降、超参脆弱，因此一直停留在边缘位置。
Method: 将 Muon 式谱更新几何（momentum orthogonalization 加谱步长缩放）施加到逐层局部更新这一未被研究的组合上；在 CIFAR-10 MLP 基准（局部线性头）上做宽度 128–2048、深度 12–48 的步长网格搜索与五种子对照，并用事先指定的 controls 归因来源；另把步长写成漂移契约 lr = ε/RMS(input)，按当前输入约束每层权重引起的 pre-activation 单步变化。
Result: 单一谱步长在宽度 128–2048、深度 12–48 的测试网格中均为最优值，local Adam 需沿两轴重调；深度 48 处 local Adam 重调后 31.3%、沿用其深度 12 设置 19%，谱更新在不变设置下 42.7%。宽度 512、五随机种子下谱更新 48.9±0.5，local Adam 46.6±0.3。漂移契约在测得该基线处相对最优固定学习率有小幅增益；带 RMSNorm 与 weight decay 的主干中，谱更新的稳定性收益归于全局训练而非局部训练。
Conclusion: 深度鲁棒性与步长可迁移性主要来自谱几何本身而非其上的步长规则，局部优势集中在没有 normalization 的地方；漂移契约额外提供标准优化器没有的逐层、输入条件化漂移界。
