papers.title: AgroBench: A Reproducible Multimodal Benchmark for Weakly Supervised Crop Yield Learning from County Statistics and Pixel Observations
papers.abstract_en: Reliable agricultural yield statistics are typically reported at coarse administrative scales, whereas modern geospatial machine learning methods require spatially explicit, pixel level supervision. This mismatch has limited the development of large-scale benchmarks for crop yield learning using multimodal Earth observation data. A reproducible benchmark, AgroBench, is presented for transforming publicly available U.S. county level crop yield statistics into weakly supervised pixel-level crop time series. Each crop pixel time series is paired with a county-level yield value as a weak supervisory signal rather than a directly measured pixel-level yield label. Our geospatial data generation pipeline integrates USDA crop yield statistics with crop-specific land cover masks, Sentinel 2 multispectral imagery, Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar observations, climatic variables, and terrain information to produce temporally aligned multimodal sequences describing individual crop pixels throughout the growing season. The resulting benchmark contains over 13 million observations from 788,654 unique crop pixels spanning 5,107 county year combinations across eight growing seasons (2017 to 2024) for five major U.S. crops. To facilitate standardized evaluation, we establish a crop yield prediction benchmark using a Leave-One-Year-Out evaluation protocol and provide baseline results using representative machine learning models. By releasing the complete data generation pipeline, benchmark dataset, and evaluation protocol, AgroBench provides a reproducible foundation for future research in weakly supervised learning, multimodal remote sensing, spatiotemporal modeling, and geospatial foundation models for agriculture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgroBench 把美国县级作物单产统计转成弱监督的像素级作物时间序列，用 USDA 单产、Sentinel-1/2、气候与地形构建可复现基准。数据集含超过 1300 万条观测、788,654 个作物像素、5,107 个 county-year 组合、2017–2024 八个生长季、五种主要作物，并以 Leave-One-Year-Out 协议给出代表性 ML 模型的基线结果。
Motivation: 可靠的单产统计只到粗粒度行政区，而地理空间 ML 需要像素级监督，这种错配限制了多模态地球观测作物单产学习的大规模基准建设。
Method: 数据生成管线把 USDA 县级单产统计与作物专属土地覆盖掩膜、Sentinel-2 多光谱、Sentinel-1 SAR、气候变量和地形信息对齐，产出逐像素的生长季多模态序列；每个像素序列配一个县级单产值作为弱监督信号，评测采用 Leave-One-Year-Out 协议并提供代表性 ML 模型基线。
Result: 基准含超过 1300 万条观测、788,654 个独立作物像素、5,107 个 county-year 组合、2017–2024 八个生长季、五种美国主要作物；发布完整数据生成管线、基准数据集与评测协议，并给出代表性机器学习模型的基线结果。
Conclusion: 县级统计可以被系统性地转成像素级弱监督信号，从而为多模态遥感、时空建模与农业地理空间基础模型提供可复现的评测基础。

papers.title: Gödel's and Scott's Variants of the Ontological Argument in Lean 4
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a complete, structure-preserving port to Lean 4 of the Isabelle/HOL dataset accompanying Benzmüller and Scott's study of Gödel's modal ontological argument and Scott's variant of it. The port comprises 30 Lean 4 modules, one per Isabelle/HOL theory, retaining the section structure, the declaration order and the name of every axiom, definition, lemma and theorem; a comparison tool certifies all 548 statements identical. Everything the Isabelle/HOL development proves is proved again, including the inconsistency of Gödel's 1970 axioms, the repaired Gödel variants, Scott's variant, modal collapse, monotheism and the ultrafilter property of the positive properties; five statements the original leaves unreplayed after an automated prover had found a proof, one of which it then postulates, are proved as well. The 45 remaining unproved statements are exactly those the original refutes by nitpick (35) or leaves open (10); they are anonymous sorrys on which nothing depends. Two features of Lean 4 shape the result. It has neither a sledgehammer nor a model finder, so the one-line automated proofs become explicit proof terms and the 72 nitpick invocations are recorded as documentation. And #print axioms reports the postulates each proof consumes, giving for every result an upper bound on the modal logic it requires: Scott's necessary-existence theorem and modal collapse need only symmetry of the accessibility relation (logic KB); the essence and monotheism lemmas and the possible existence of a God-like being need no frame condition (the latter with the one exception the original records, the mixed-quantifier setting); and the inconsistency of Gödel's 1970 axioms needs none either. The development depends on no library beyond Lean 4's core; sources, comparison tools and two Isabelle cross-check sessions are included as ancillary files.

TL;DR: 把 Benzmüller 与 Scott 的 Gödel 模态本体论证明 Isabelle/HOL 数据集整体移植到 Lean 4，30 个模块逐一对应原理论并保留章节结构、声明顺序与全部名称，比较工具认证 548 条语句完全一致。#print axioms 给出每个结论所消费的公理上界：Scott 必然存在定理与 modal collapse 只需可达关系对称（KB 逻辑），本质与一神论引理及上帝存在不需任何 frame 条件。
Motivation: 原 Isabelle/HOL 开发依赖 Sledgehammer 自动证明与 nitpick 模型查找，五个语句未回放、其中一个被直接公理化，证明所需的模态逻辑强度也没有逐条核算。
Method: 移植为 30 个 Lean 4 模块（Lean 4.33.1，lake package），逐一对应 Isabelle/HOL 理论并保留公理、定义、引理、定理的名称与顺序；编写语句比较工具与依赖制表工具，另附两个 Isabelle2025-2 交叉检查会话。因 Lean 4 无 Sledgehammer 与模型查找器，一行自动证明改写为显式 proof term，72 次 nitpick 调用记录为文档。
Result: 比较工具认证 548 条语句与原开发完全一致；30 个模块覆盖原开发所证全部内容，含 Gödel 1970 公理的不一致性、修复版 Gödel 变体、Scott 变体、modal collapse、monotheism 与正性质的 ultrafilter 性质；原开发未回放的 5 条语句（含 1 条被公理化的）全部补证。剩余 45 条未证语句恰为原开发用 nitpick 反驳的 35 条与悬而未决的 10 条，均为无人依赖的匿名 sorry。#print axioms 给出逻辑强度上界：Scott 必然存在定理与 modal collapse 只需可达关系对称（KB）；本质、一神论引理与上帝存在不需 frame 条件（后者仅原记录的 mixed-quantifier 例外）；Gödel 1970 公理不一致性亦无需 frame 条件。
Conclusion: 结构保持的跨证明助理移植可以逐语句认证等价，并用 #print axioms 把每个本体论结论所需的模态逻辑强度变成可核算的上界；开发只依赖 Lean 4 core，无外部库。

papers.title: Backdoors Leave Structural Traces: FedMAST for Backdoor Detection and Containment in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables distributed training of a shared model without requiring clients to share their raw data. However, its reliance on the integrity of the client-submitted updates exposes the global model to stealthy backdoor poisoning. Although existing defenses often inspect isolated evidence sources, stealth-constrained attacks can adapt to these signals. In this paper, we show that such attacks can suppress isolated anomaly signals, but their poisoned updates still leave residual structural traces. We propose FedMAST, a Federated Multi-Axis Structural Tracing defense for backdoor detection in federated learning. FedMAST scores client updates using complementary structural, spectral, and historical evidence and then applies tiered filtering and round-level containment to limit adversarial influence. To capture traces that isolated signals may miss, FedMAST uses squeeze-pair coherence scoring to expose coupled feature distortions and signed spectral-drift tracking to reveal persistent directional changes over time. Across six federated backdoor attacks, namely Constrain-and-Scale, Neurotoxin, BC-Layers, LGA, DBA, and 3DFed, FedMAST achieves lower ASR than baseline defenses in all nine evaluated attack--defense comparisons. Across the complete 200-round runs, it attains an average ASR of 1.51% while maintaining 94.84% average main-task accuracy. Under the method-aware CovertLayers attack, FedAvg, MultiKrum, AlignIns, and FLAME yield full-run ASRs of 100.00%, 99.67%, 99.53%, and 32.84%, respectively. FedMAST achieves the lowest ASR among all evaluated methods, reducing it to 1.53% while maintaining 92.26% main-task accuracy.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted to be presented in the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedMAST 用结构、谱、历史三轴证据给联邦客户端更新打分，再做分层过滤与轮级遏制；在六种联邦后门攻击、200 轮完整运行下平均 ASR 1.51%、主任务准确率 94.84%，在方法感知的 CovertLayers 攻击下把 ASR 压到 1.53%（FedAvg 100.00%、MultiKrum 99.67%、AlignIns 99.53%、FLAME 32.84%）。
Motivation: 联邦学习依赖客户端更新的完整性，现有防御只检查孤立异常信号，而受隐蔽性约束的攻击可以压制这些信号，使后门检测失效。
Method: FedMAST（Federated Multi-Axis Structural Tracing）对客户端更新做结构、谱与历史三类互补打分：squeeze-pair coherence scoring 暴露耦合特征畸变，signed spectral-drift tracking 追踪跨轮的持续方向性变化；随后施加分层过滤与轮级遏制以限制对抗影响。
Result: 在 Constrain-and-Scale、Neurotoxin、BC-Layers、LGA、DBA、3DFed 六种攻击的全部九组攻击-防御对比中，FedMAST 的 ASR 均低于基线防御；200 轮完整运行平均 ASR 1.51%、平均主任务准确率 94.84%。在方法感知的 CovertLayers 攻击下，FedAvg、MultiKrum、AlignIns、FLAME 全程 ASR 分别为 100.00%、99.67%、99.53%、32.84%，FedMAST 降至 1.53% 且主任务准确率 92.26%。
Conclusion: 隐蔽约束的后门攻击能压掉孤立异常信号，但残留的结构痕迹仍可被多轴追踪捕获，从而在不牺牲主任务精度的前提下把 ASR 压到 1.5% 量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Some LLM-based recommendation rerankers are evaluated under an oracle protocol that guarantees the ground-truth item is present in the scored set, either by injecting it into the candidate list or by scoring it against sampled negatives. Across three primary Amazon datasets, we show that this protocol overestimates realistic NDCG@10 by 92--95%. The cause is a recall ceiling: realistic retrieval covers only 2--19% of relevant items at $K=100$ across eight datasets in three domains, imposing a deterministic upper bound on any closed-candidate reranker's top-$k$ NDCG. Under leave-one-out evaluation, $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{NDCG}@k] \leq \mathrm{Recall}@|W_π|$, where $W_π$ is the reranker's candidate window. Under realistic retrieval, none of the tested optimisation strategies significantly improves over the collaborative-filtering baseline on our primary Amazon datasets. These strategies include prompt engineering, model scaling over a 168$\times$ parameter range, sequential models, supervised neural rerankers, LoRA fine-tuning, hybrid retrieval, score-aware prompting, and LLM+CF fusion. Text-aware retrieval increases recall on one dataset but does not improve end-to-end NDCG, while providing upstream CF scores mainly makes the LLM reproduce the CF order. We therefore propose the Recall-Aware Evaluation Protocol (RAEP): first classify the retrieval-recall regime, then evaluate reranking where the ceiling permits meaningful differentiation. In the low-recall regimes measured here, improving retrieval is more consequential than increasing reranker sophistication; this ordering need not hold in production systems with higher recall, richer features, or online feedback.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at CIKM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 推荐重排在 oracle 评测协议下被高估：该协议保证真值物品进入打分集合，使三个主 Amazon 数据集上的真实 NDCG@10 被高估 92–95%。原因是召回天花板——八个数据集、三个领域在 K=100 时真实检索只覆盖 2–19% 的相关物品，对闭集重排的 top-k NDCG 施加确定性上界；在实测的低召回区间，改进检索比堆重排器更关键。
Motivation: LLM 重排的评测常把真值物品注入候选集或对采样负例打分，掩盖了真实检索召回不足对重排指标的硬约束，导致方法比较失真。
Method: 在三个主 Amazon 数据集上对比 oracle 与真实检索协议；给出留一法下的理论上界 E[NDCG@k] ≤ Recall@|W_π|（W_π 为候选窗口）；系统测试 prompt 工程、168× 参数规模的模型扩展、序列模型、有监督神经重排、LoRA 微调、混合检索、score-aware prompting、LLM+CF 融合等策略，并提出 Recall-Aware Evaluation Protocol (RAEP)：先判定检索召回区间，再在天花板允许区分的区间内评测重排。
Result: oracle 协议使三个主 Amazon 数据集的真实 NDCG@10 被高估 92–95%；K=100 时真实检索在三个领域八个数据集上仅覆盖 2–19% 相关物品。在真实检索下，所测全部优化策略在主 Amazon 数据集上均无一显著优于协同过滤基线；文本感知检索仅在一个数据集上提升召回但不改善端到端 NDCG，提供上游 CF 分数主要让 LLM 复现 CF 排序。
Conclusion: 在实测的低召回区间，提升检索比提升重排器复杂度更关键；作者同时指出该排序在召回更高、特征更丰富或有在线反馈的生产系统中未必成立，RAEP 要求先分类召回区间再评测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ScoutNeRV: Rapid Encoding of Grid-Based Video INRs via ScoutNet
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for video compression, providing compact neural representations with flexible spatial and temporal reconstruction. Hierarchical grid-based architectures such as HiNeRV achieve strong rate--distortion performance, but require extensive per-video optimization, resulting in high encoding costs. To address this limitation, we propose ScoutNeRV, a content-adaptive initialization framework for accelerating the optimization of hierarchical video INRs. ScoutNeRV employs a lightweight, offline-trained scout network that analyzes a small number of sampled frames and selects a suitable pre-trained expert from a memory bank through hard routing. The hierarchical grid and decoder parameters of the selected expert are then transferred to initialize the target HiNeRV model before video-specific fine-tuning. On the unseen ReadySetGo sequence, ScoutNeRV achieves an initial PSNR of $34.95$~dB, compared with $13.70$~dB for standard initialization, corresponding to a $21.25$~dB improvement before fine-tuning. After only 37 epochs, ScoutNeRV reaches $36.92$~dB and remains within $0.42$--$0.80$~dB of the 300-epoch HiNeRV baseline across the evaluated rate--distortion configurations. Furthermore, the proposed initialization achieves a $9.25\times$ wall-clock speedup in the reported runtime experiment. These results demonstrate that content-aware expert initialization can substantially reduce the optimization cost of hierarchical video INRs while retaining competitive reconstruction and compression performance. The code is available at https://github.com/nasserdeveloper/ScoutNeRV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScoutNeRV 用离线训练的轻量 ScoutNet 分析少量采样帧，经硬路由从 memory bank 选预训练专家来初始化 HiNeRV，把逐视频的昂贵优化压到 37 epoch。在未见的 ReadySetGo 序列上初始 PSNR 34.95 dB（标准初始化 13.70 dB，微调前提升 21.25 dB），37 epoch 达 36.92 dB，距 300-epoch HiNeRV 基线仅 0.42–0.80 dB，wall-clock 加速 9.25×。
Motivation: HiNeRV 这类分层网格视频 INR 率失真性能好，但每个视频都要大量逐条优化，编码成本高，限制了实际压缩使用。
Method: 内容自适应初始化框架：轻量、离线训练的 ScoutNet 读取少量采样帧，通过 hard routing 从 memory bank 中选出一个预训练专家，把该专家的 hierarchical grid 与 decoder 参数迁移为 HiNeRV 的初始化，再做视频特定 fine-tuning。
Result: 在未见 ReadySetGo 序列上：初始 PSNR 34.95 dB vs 标准初始化 13.70 dB（微调前 +21.25 dB）；仅 37 epoch 达 36.92 dB；在所评估的各率失真配置上距 300-epoch HiNeRV 基线 0.42–0.80 dB；runtime 实验中取得 9.25× wall-clock 加速。
Conclusion: 内容感知的专家初始化能大幅降低分层视频 INR 的优化成本，同时保持有竞争力的重建与压缩性能。

papers.title: VIVAS: Vitalizing Visual Perception in VLM Pre-training via Vision-language Unified Autoregressive Supervision
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities, they continue to suffer from a critical limitation: insufficient fine-grained visual perception, which fundamentally limits their multimodal understanding. We attribute this bottleneck to text-dominant optimization biases during pre-training, which encourage the model to overlook fine-grained visual details, thereby limiting the capability of multimodal understanding. We investigate that overcoming this bottleneck requires two key elements: (1) a unified token space paradigm that ensures stable training dynamics, and (2) a modality-aligned dense visual supervision signal enriched with both structural granularity and semantic information to capture critical visual representations. Based on these insights, we propose VIVAS, a framework built upon the unified token space paradigm, which introduces a dense-structural-semantic vision tokenizer, which expands the textual vocabulary into a unified vision-language vocabulary by incorporating a visual vocabulary. During pretraining, VIVAS performs vision-language unified autoregressive supervision over both visual details and linguistic content, thereby enhancing visual perception to improve multimodal understanding. Trained end-to-end on 12.4T tokens, VIVAS achieves state-of-the-art performance across 7 tasks and 39 multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIVAS 把视觉词表并入文本词表构成统一 vision-language vocabulary，用 dense-structural-semantic vision tokenizer 在预训练中对视觉细节与语言内容做统一自回归监督，以纠正文本主导的优化偏置。端到端训练 12.4T tokens 后，在 7 类任务、39 个多模态基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: VLM 预训练中文本主导的优化偏置让模型忽略细粒度视觉细节，多模态理解因此受限。
Method: 基于统一 token space 范式，引入 dense-structural-semantic vision tokenizer，把视觉词表并入文本词表扩展为统一 vision-language vocabulary；预训练阶段对视觉细节与语言内容做 vision-language unified autoregressive supervision，端到端训练 12.4T tokens。
Result: 在 7 个任务、39 个多模态基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，训练规模为 12.4T tokens。
Conclusion: 细粒度视觉感知的瓶颈来自文本主导偏置，统一 token 空间加模态对齐的稠密视觉监督可在预训练阶段同时提升视觉感知与多模态理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UVU: Improving Multimodal Understanding via Vision-Language Unified Autoregressive Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their fine-grained visual understanding is constrained by a primary reliance on sparse textual supervision. Existing efforts to introduce visual supervision typically do so during post-training, when visual representations have already been largely fixed, causing such signals to act mainly as auxiliary constraints rather than as a primary force for shaping perceptual features. In this paper, we aim to fundamentally reshape the model's perceptual backbone by incorporating vision supervision directly into the pre-training stage. We observe that pixel-level image patches and textual tokens naturally coexist in a shared, raw high-dimensional space characterized by an inherent input symmetry. Leveraging this insight, we propose UVU, a novel vision-language unified autoregressive framework that eschews vector quantization. It uniquely employs continuous visual encoding for lossless representation of visual inputs and proposes a large-scale iterative hierarchical clustering algorithm to construct a pixel-level visual codebook, thereby extending the vocabulary for unified supervision and enabling autoregressive generation of pixel-level image tokens alongside textual tokens. UVU effectively synergizes pixel-level visual perception with semantic-level visual understanding, internalizing visual reconstruction capabilities and unlocking the facilitative role of visual supervision in enhancing understanding in the pre-training stage. Extensive experiments across multiple tasks demonstrate that MLLMs are capable of achieving superior multimodal understanding performance under the supervised learning paradigm of UVU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UVU 把像素级视觉监督直接放进 MLLM 预训练阶段，用连续视觉编码加大规模迭代层次聚类构造像素级 visual codebook，绕开 vector quantization，让图像 token 与文本 token 在同一自回归框架下统一生成。多任务实验显示该监督范式下 MLLM 的多模态理解性能更优。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的细粒度视觉理解主要依赖稀疏文本监督；视觉监督多在 post-training 注入，此时视觉表征已基本固定，只能当辅助约束，无法真正塑造感知 backbone。
Method: 提出 vision-language unified autoregressive 框架 UVU：以连续视觉编码无损表示输入，用大规模迭代层次聚类算法构建 pixel-level visual codebook 扩展词表，在预训练阶段对像素级图像 token 与文本 token 做统一自回归监督，不使用 vector quantization。
Result: 在多个任务上的实验表明，UVU 的监督学习范式下 MLLM 能取得更优的多模态理解性能（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 视觉监督应在预训练阶段就参与塑造感知 backbone，而非 post-training 追加；像素级重建能力可与语义级理解在同一自回归框架内协同。

papers.title: Conformal Bayes under Continuous Label Shift: Sensitivity Analysis and the Limits of Exact Validity
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Bayes combines Bayesian posterior predictive scores with conformal calibration, but under continuous label shift both the score and calibration weight depend on the unknown response-marginal density ratio. Existing methods typically estimate one shift parameter from pseudo-labels or predictive samples and plug it into calibration. We instead propose Joint Tilt-Sensitivity Conformal Bayes (JTS-CB), which performs sensitivity analysis over a prespecified set of plausible tilts; its split-conformal realization is JTS-SCB. Each tilt jointly determines the Bayesian conformal score and conformal importance weight. JTS-SCB forms a bounded sensitivity envelope over candidate tilts, but its calibration-only construction does not inherit the exact finite-sample weighted-conformal guarantee. We therefore study a separate candidate-weighted exact counterpart and show that its usefulness depends sharply on tail behavior. For scalar linear exponential tilts, any nonzero candidate tilt makes the exact set unbounded. More generally, tail-growing density ratios produce the same pathology, whereas quadratic tilts with a negative coefficient on \(y^2\) have vanishing tail weights and admit bounded exact inference on the original target. Ratio clipping provides a complementary bounded exact construction for a surrogate target when tails grow. Experiments show that strong plug-in predictive sampling can match the oracle when the shift is well identified, while sensitivity analysis is most useful for richer, weakly identified, or systematically biased shift models, at the cost of wider prediction sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连续标签偏移 (continuous label shift) 下，Conformal Bayes 的打分与校准权重都依赖未知的响应边缘密度比，本文提出 JTS-CB（split-conformal 版本为 JTS-SCB）对一组预设候选 tilt 做敏感性分析，每个 tilt 联合决定贝叶斯 conformal 分数与重要性权重。理论上证明标量线性指数 tilt 只要候选 tilt 非零，exact 集合就无界；尾部增长的密度比同样病态，而 y² 系数为负的二次 tilt 尾部权重消失、可在原目标上给出有界 exact 推断，尾部增长时可用 ratio clipping 换 surrogate target。实验显示 shift 被良好辨识时强 plug-in 采样可追平 oracle，敏感性分析则在更丰富、弱辨识或系统性有偏的 shift 模型下更有用，代价是预测集变宽。
Motivation: 连续标签偏移下密度比未知，现有方法通常从伪标签或预测样本估一个 shift 参数再代入校准，既掩盖了辨识不确定性，也缺少对 exact 有限样本有效性的刻画。
Method: JTS-CB 在预设候选 tilt 集合上做敏感性分析，每个 tilt 联合决定贝叶斯 conformal 分数与 conformal 重要性权重；其 split-conformal 实现为 JTS-SCB，构造跨候选 tilt 的有界敏感性包络。另设一个 candidate-weighted exact 版本并分析其尾部行为，尾部增长时用 ratio clipping 构造 surrogate target 上的有界 exact 方案。
Result: 标量线性指数 tilt 下任何非零候选 tilt 都使 exact 集合无界；尾部增长的密度比产生同样病态，y² 负系数的二次 tilt 尾部权重消失、原目标上可做有界 exact 推断。实验中 shift 被良好辨识时强 plug-in 预测采样可匹配 oracle；敏感性分析在更丰富、弱辨识或系统性有偏的 shift 模型下更有用，代价是预测集更宽。
Conclusion: exact validity 在连续标签偏移下受 tilt 尾部行为根本制约：尾部增长即失效，负二次 tilt 或 ratio clipping 才保住有界 exact 推断；实践上 shift 辨识良好时 plug-in 足够，弱辨识或有偏时才值得付敏感性分析的宽度代价。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Fourth-Moment Strong Universality for Finite-Type Transpose-Correlated Random Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We prove a strong-universality theorem at the exact fourth-moment threshold for finite families of non-Hermitian random matrices assembled from independent unordered-pair vector atoms. Within one atom, the matrix colors and the two endpoint orientations may have arbitrary joint real covariance, subject to reversal consistency across ordered type pairs and endpoint exchangeability in same-type blocks; the law may also depend on finitely many endpoint types. The matrices may be adjoined to an arbitrary deterministic tuple that converges jointly strongly with the type projections. For every fixed matrix amplification and fixed noncommutative \(*\)-polynomial, the resulting tuple converges strongly to an explicit covariance-matched free Gaussian family. Cross-type blocks are described by masked circular variables, whereas same-type blocks split into independent endpoint-symmetric and endpoint-antisymmetric semicircular sectors. Only a finite radial fourth moment is assumed off the diagonal, and a finite second moment suffices on the diagonal. The mode of convergence depends on the coupling: corners of one infinite array converge almost surely on a common event, while fixed-law nonnested triangular arrays converge in probability for each fixed test. As an application, we obtain exact-fourth-moment strong limits for finite-separable continuous left/right profiles, including separately weighted literal-transpose terms. For the nested almost-sure formulation, the fourth-moment threshold is sharp already on the Wigner subfamily; at this threshold arbitrary fresh rows admit no coupling-invariant almost-sure upgrade of our in-probability conclusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非厄米随机矩阵的独立无序对向量原子模型上，证明精确四阶矩阈值处的强 universality 定理：任意固定矩阵放大与固定非交换 *-多项式生成的元组强收敛到显式协方差匹配的自由高斯族，跨类型块由 masked circular 变量刻画、同类型块分裂为端点对称与反对称 semicircular 扇区。阈值在 Wigner 子族上已 sharp，且在该阈值处任意新行不存在耦合不变的几乎必然升级。
Motivation: 有限类型转置相关随机矩阵在仅假设对角外有限四阶矩、对角上有限二阶矩时，缺少精确四阶矩阈值处的强 universality 判定，且不清楚该阈值是否可改进。
Method: 以独立无序对向量原子组装非厄米矩阵，允许同一原子内矩阵颜色与两端点取向具任意联合实协方差（须满足有序类型对的反转一致性与同类型块的端点可交换性），并可伴随任意确定性元组联合强收敛；结论对任意固定矩阵放大与固定非交换 *-多项式给出显式协方差匹配自由高斯极限，应用覆盖有限可分连续左右 profile（含单独加权的 literal-transpose 项）。
Result: 对角外仅需有限径向四阶矩、对角上仅需有限二阶矩；嵌套情形在公共事件上几乎必然收敛，非嵌套固定律三角阵列对每个固定检验依概率收敛；嵌套几乎必然表述下四阶矩阈值在 Wigner 子族上已 sharp，且在该阈值处任意新行不存在耦合不变的几乎必然升级。
Conclusion: 精确四阶矩是该类转置相关随机矩阵强 universality 的临界点：其下可得强高斯极限，其上（Wigner 子族）无法把依概率结论无条件升级为几乎必然。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Detect Symbolic Failure: Machine Learning and the Limits of Black-Scholes
papers.abstract_en: We treat options pricing as a representation problem: can machine learning detect systematic deviations from Black-Scholes using 2.6M real option contracts? We compare three regimes: learned abstract embeddings (Kernel PCA), preserved domain structure (tree-based ensembles), and neural network validation. Tree-based methods outperform kernel dimensionality reduction by 21.5 percentage points (93.8% vs 72.3%), and domain-expert features (Greeks, moneyness) outperform engineered features. NN-based and BS-based deviation labels agree 99.9974% of the time, suggesting deviations reflect market structure rather than model artifact. We conclude that in domains with expert-designed symbolic features, preserving structure beats learning abstractions. We make no claim of exploitable mispricings.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, accepted to Machina Stanford Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把期权定价当作表示问题，用 260 万份真实期权合约检测相对 Black-Scholes 的系统性偏离，比较三种表示路线：Kernel PCA 学到的抽象嵌入、保留领域结构的树集成、以及神经网络验证。树集成比核降维高 21.5 个百分点（93.8% 对 72.3%），且由 Greeks、moneyness 构成的领域专家特征优于人工构造特征；作者据此主张在专家符号特征成熟的方向上，保留结构胜过学习抽象。
Motivation: 机器学习在有成熟专家符号特征（如 Greeks、moneyness）的领域里，学到的抽象表示是否反而丢失可判别结构，这一点缺少直接的对照证据。
Method: 以 2.6M 份真实期权合约为样本，把期权定价表述为表示问题，对比三条路线：Kernel PCA 学到的抽象嵌入、树模型集成保留的领域结构、以及神经网络给出的偏离标签；特征侧比较领域专家特征（Greeks、moneyness）与工程化特征。
Result: 树集成相对 Kernel PCA 高 21.5 个百分点（93.8% vs 72.3%）；领域专家特征优于工程化特征；神经网络标签与 Black-Scholes 标签的一致率达 99.9974%。
Conclusion: 在专家设计符号特征的领域，保留结构的模型胜过学习抽象；99.9974% 的标签一致率提示偏离反映市场结构而非模型伪影，作者明确不主张存在可利用的错误定价。

papers.title: Linear RNN Scaling Laws: When Longer Sequences Beat More Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Empirical scaling laws for autoregressive language models relate prediction loss to model size, data size, and optimization compute, but their theoretical origin is still poorly understood in sequential pretraining settings. We study this question in a tractable teacher--student model where a stable latent linear RNN generates trajectories and a sketched linear recurrent student is trained by safeguarded full-batch WSD gradient descent on next-token prediction. The sketch dimension $M$ plays the role of model size, while $N$ independent trajectories of length $P$ provide the training tokens. We allow the innovation and initialization covariances to have different power-law exponents $α$ and $θ$. The induced design spectrum produces explicit approximation, optimization, and statistical scaling laws separated by spectral crossovers. When $θ\geα$, the original one-scale rates $M^{1-β_α}$, $R^{(1-β_α)/α}$, and $(NP)^{-1}\min\{M,R^{1/α}\}$ are recovered. When $α-2r\leθ<α$, the heavier initialization tail changes the rates beyond $P$-dependent model and optimization crossovers. The proof uses a covariance event only internally and a globally safeguarded step size on its complement. The variance retains the factor $(NP)^{-1}$, while sequence length also suppresses the initialization transient, so $N$ and $P$ cease to be fully interchangeable in the two-scale regime.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: I-SplineFlow: Learning Monotone Spline Stochastic Interpolant Schedulers for Few-Step Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-step generation with pretrained diffusion and flow models can be accelerated by lightweight training that optimizes the sampling trajectory rather than the network. A recent approach parameterizes the stochastic interpolant (SI) scheduler as a smooth curve whose control points enforce the three properties an SI scheduler must satisfy: fixed boundary conditions, a monotone signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and differentiability. Existing parameterizations use globally supported polynomial bases, where every control point moves the whole curve and higher expressiveness needs a higher degree, which couples distant regions of the schedule during optimization. We introduce \emph{I-SplineFlow}, which parameterizes the scheduler with integrated monotone splines (I-splines). I-splines decouple the polynomial degree from the number of mixture weights, so support width and smoothness can be chosen per model at a fixed weight count, and the compactly supported derivative basis makes the scheduler Jacobian orders of magnitude better conditioned than a Bézier basis. Boundary conditions and a strictly monotone SNR hold by construction, with no ordering constraint on the parameters and closed-form velocity derivatives. Across diffusion (EDM) and flow (ReFlow, Simple ReFlow) models, I-SplineFlow improves few-step FID over Bézier scheduling in most settings, most clearly at the lowest NFEs, and trains in minutes. Ablations show that both the degree freedom and the monotonicity constraint are needed. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: I-SplineFlow 用积分单调样条 (I-splines) 参数化随机插值 (stochastic interpolant) 调度器，在固定权重数下把多项式次数与支撑宽度解耦，边界条件与严格单调 SNR 由构造保证、无需排序约束且速度导数有闭式。在 EDM、ReFlow、Simple ReFlow 上多数设置的少步 FID 优于 Bézier 调度，最低 NFE 处提升最明显，训练只需几分钟。
Motivation: 现有 SI 调度器用全局支撑多项式基（如 Bézier），每个控制点都牵动整条曲线，提高表达力只能加次数，远端区段在优化中被耦合，且 Jacobian 条件数差。
Method: 以 I-spline 基参数化调度器：次数与混合权重数解耦，紧支撑导数基改善 Jacobian 条件数；固定边界条件与单调 SNR 由构造满足，速度导数闭式给出。只训练调度曲线而不改网络，覆盖扩散 (EDM) 与流模型 (ReFlow、Simple ReFlow)，并做去掉次数自由度与单调约束的消融。
Result: 在 EDM、ReFlow、Simple ReFlow 上，多数设置的少步 FID 相对 Bézier 调度提升，最低 NFE 处最明显；调度训练耗时数分钟；消融显示次数自由度与单调性约束两者都必需。
Conclusion: 紧支撑单调样条是比全局多项式更好的 SI 调度参数化：在不加约束的前提下保证单调 SNR 并改善优化条件，从而在极低 NFE 下拿到更好的少步生成质量。

papers.title: Local SVD-Entropy Maps as a Complementary Structural Representation for Full-Reference and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: We investigate a local spectral-complexity representation for perceptual image quality assessment (IQA) based on Shannon entropy of singular values computed directly from two-dimensional image patches. For each $3\times3$-pixel grayscale patch, SVD is applied directly and the normalized singular-value entropy defines one HSVD-map value. The construction requires neither flattening nor delay embedding, uses no boundary padding, and is invariant to $90^{\circ}$ rotations and mirror reflections at the local-descriptor level. A nested salt-and-pepper experiment on Lena separates absolute similarity to a clean reference from sensitivity to an additional degradation step. HSVD-SSIM responds more strongly to local corruption and retains a larger neighboring-state response at severe noise levels. Validation on all 10,125 distorted KADID-10k images shows that HSVD-SSIM is weaker than conventional SSIM as a standalone full-reference metric (SRCC $0.450$ vs. $0.619$), but complementary when combined with it: grouped cross-validation increases SRCC from $0.618$ to $0.659$, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of $[0.036,0.046]$ for the gain. In a no-reference experiment, adding HSVD-derived single-image descriptors improves the best nonlinear model from SRCC $0.528$ to $0.575$ (95\% CI $[0.033,0.061]$) and also improves prediction of quality changes between neighboring distortion states. These results support direct local SVD entropy as an interpretable structural channel that complements conventional image-domain similarity and remains informative without a pristine reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HSVD-map：对 3×3 灰度块直接做 SVD，用归一化奇异值 Shannon 熵作为局部结构描述，无需展平或延迟嵌入，且在局部描述层面 90° 旋转与镜像不变。在 KADID-10k 全部 10,125 张失真图上，HSVD-SSIM 单独作全参考指标弱于 SSIM（SRCC 0.450 vs 0.619），但与 SSIM 组合经分组交叉验证把 SRCC 从 0.618 提到 0.659；无参考场景加入 HSVD 单图描述子把最佳非线性模型 SRCC 从 0.528 提到 0.575。
Motivation: 常规 IQA 相似度指标对局部突发失真与无参考场景的结构变化刻画不足，需要一个不依赖干净参考、可解释的补充结构通道。
Method: 对每个 3×3 灰度块直接 SVD，归一化奇异值得到 HSVD-map；在 Lena 上做嵌套 salt-and-pepper 实验分离绝对相似度与额外退化步的敏感性；在 KADID-10k 上用分组交叉验证与 bootstrap 置信区间检验与 SSIM 的组合效果，并构建无参考非线性模型。
Result: KADID-10k 全部 10,125 张失真图上，HSVD-SSIM 单独 SRCC 0.450，SSIM 0.619；与 SSIM 组合后分组交叉验证 SRCC 0.618 → 0.659，增益 bootstrap 95% CI [0.036, 0.046]。无参考实验加入 HSVD 单图描述子后最佳非线性模型 SRCC 0.528 → 0.575（95% CI [0.033, 0.061]），并改善相邻失真状态间质量变化的预测。
Conclusion: 直接局部 SVD 熵是可解释的结构通道，单独作全参考指标不如 SSIM，但作为补充在有参考与无参考两种设定下都能稳定提升 SRCC。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CS-WCP: Robust Conformal Sets for LLM-Judge Traffic Shifts with Uncertain Group Proportions
papers.abstract_en: Prediction sets built from an LLM judge can undercover when deployment traffic changes the prevalence of task or policy groups. Weighted conformal prediction is exact under covariate shift when the density ratio is known, but group proportions must usually be estimated from finite unlabeled samples. We introduce confidence-set weighted conformal prediction (CS-WCP), which constructs simultaneous exact intervals for source and target group masses and returns the union of weighted conformal sets over every compatible ratio vector. For a fixed or independently learned finite partition, CS-WCP attains coverage at least 1-alpha-delta_w-tau_A-kappa, where tau_A measures within-cell covariate mismatch and kappa measures conditional shift. A linear endpoint rule computes the robust union in O(G|Y|) time. Across 336 constructed shared-support traffic shifts, CS-WCP reaches 0.973 mean coverage with 13 point failures, compared with 0.954 and 44 failures for source conformal prediction, at mean binary set sizes 1.74 and 1.65. On 336 natural cross-task transfers, coverage rises from 0.882 to 0.962, but mean set size reaches 1.87 and a size-matched group plug-in baseline is competitive. The method therefore supplies an auditable coverage safeguard under uncertain mixture weights; its value is conservative tail protection, not scalar probability calibration or uniformly smaller sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CS-WCP 针对 LLM judge 部署流量中组比例未知导致的预测集欠覆盖，对源域与目标域组质量构造同时精确区间，并在所有相容密度比向量上取加权 conformal 集的并集，覆盖率下界为 1-alpha-delta_w-tau_A-kappa，线性端点规则以 O(G|Y|) 时间求解。336 个构造的共享支撑流量偏移上平均覆盖 0.973（源域 conformal 0.954），336 个自然跨任务迁移上从 0.882 升到 0.962。
Motivation: 部署流量改变任务或策略组的占比时，基于 LLM judge 的预测集会欠覆盖；加权 conformal prediction 在密度比已知时精确，但组比例通常只能从有限无标签样本估计。
Method: 对源域与目标域组质量构造同时精确置信区间，在所有相容比例向量上取加权 conformal 集的并集；固定或独立学习的有限划分下给出覆盖下界 1-alpha-delta_w-tau_A-kappa（tau_A 度量单元内协变量失配，kappa 度量条件偏移），并用线性端点规则在 O(G|Y|) 时间内算出稳健并集。
Result: 在 336 个构造的共享支撑流量偏移上，CS-WCP 平均覆盖 0.973、13 次点失败，源域 conformal prediction 为 0.954、44 次失败，平均二元集合大小分别为 1.74 与 1.65；在 336 个自然跨任务迁移上覆盖从 0.882 升至 0.962，但平均集合大小达 1.87，且集合大小匹配的组 plug-in 基线具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 在混合权重不确定时 CS-WCP 提供可审计的覆盖保障，其价值在于保守的尾部保护，而非标量概率校准或一致更小的集合。

papers.title: When Accuracy Gaps Fail to Certify: Auditing Cross-Domain Recalibration of LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: A scalar recalibration map fitted for an LLM judge on one task can fail when the task distribution changes, but the source-target accuracy gap is often treated as a proxy for that failure. We test what this gap can predict and what it can certify across thirteen judges, two generators, eight domains, and 1,176 predeclared transfers. After accounting for mean score shift, the gap yields a population lower bound on target calibration error, yet identical gaps can induce opposite transfer outcomes. Exact importance weighting recovers target proper loss under covariate shift, so failure of an estimated weighting pipeline does not by itself establish conditional shift. A finite-sample simultaneous lower certificate converts the population bound into a one-sided rejection rule using audit labels disjoint from evaluation outcomes. The leak-free gap correlation is 0.25 (95% CI [-0.09, 0.55]), falls to 0.09 on the second generator, and does not support a generator-invariant association. The certificate retains nominal coverage but has power 0.13 even at m=1024, whereas target-domain temperature scaling with 16 labels reaches harm rate 0.09, compared with 0.34 for source-fitted Platt scaling. Accuracy gaps are therefore weak warning signals for scalar probability transfer, not deployment certificates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 源任务与目标任务的准确率差 (accuracy gap) 无法认证 LLM judge 标量概率映射的跨域迁移：13 个 judge、2 个生成器、8 个领域、1,176 次预注册迁移上，去泄漏后的 gap 与迁移失败相关性仅 0.25（95% CI [-0.09, 0.55]），换第二个生成器降到 0.09。有限样本下界证书在 m=1024 时功效仅 0.13，而目标域 16 个标签的 temperature scaling 就把 harm rate 压到 0.09（源域拟合 Platt 为 0.34）。结论是 gap 只能当弱预警信号，不能当部署证书。
Motivation: LLM judge 在一个任务上拟合的标量重校准映射（如 temperature/Platt）换任务分布后会失效，但业界常把源-目标准确率差当作这种失效的代理指标，缺少对 gap 究竟能预测什么、能认证什么的检验。
Method: 在 13 个 judge、2 个生成器、8 个领域上做 1,176 次预注册迁移实验；先扣除均值分数偏移估计 gap 对目标校准误差的总体下界，再构造基于独立审计标签（与评估结果不相交）的有限样本同时下界证书作为单侧拒绝规则，并对比 exact importance weighting、目标域 temperature scaling 与源域拟合 Platt scaling。
Result: 去泄漏后 gap 与迁移失败的相关性为 0.25（95% CI [-0.09, 0.55]），第二个生成器上降至 0.09，不支持生成器不变的关联；有限样本证书保持名义覆盖但 m=1024 时功效仅 0.13；目标域 temperature scaling 用 16 个标签达到 harm rate 0.09，源域拟合 Platt scaling 为 0.34。
Conclusion: 准确率差对标量概率迁移只是弱预警信号而非部署证书；估计的 importance weighting 失败本身也不能证明 conditional shift，认证应改用独立审计标签的下界证书加少量目标域校准标签。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM judge 在一个任务上拟合的标量重校准映射（如 temperature/Platt）换任务分布后会失效，但业界常把源-目标准确率差当作这种失效的代理指标，缺少对 gap 究竟能预测什么、能认证什么的检验。
summary_sections.method: 在 13 个 judge、2 个生成器、8 个领域上做 1,176 次预注册迁移实验；先扣除均值分数偏移估计 gap 对目标校准误差的总体下界，再构造基于独立审计标签（与评估结果不相交）的有限样本同时下界证书作为单侧拒绝规则，并对比 exact importance weighting、目标域 temperature scaling 与源域拟合 Platt scaling。
summary_sections.result: 去泄漏后 gap 与迁移失败的相关性为 0.25（95% CI [-0.09, 0.55]），第二个生成器上降至 0.09，不支持生成器不变的关联；有限样本证书保持名义覆盖但 m=1024 时功效仅 0.13；目标域 temperature scaling 用 16 个标签达到 harm rate 0.09，源域拟合 Platt scaling 为 0.34。
summary_sections.conclusion: 准确率差对标量概率迁移只是弱预警信号而非部署证书；估计的 importance weighting 失败本身也不能证明 conditional shift，认证应改用独立审计标签的下界证书加少量目标域校准标签。

papers.title: Enhancing Multiclass Malware Classification in Resource-Constrained Environments
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of multi-class malware attacks such as ransomware, spyware, trojans, etc., presents an increasing and serious threat to cybersecurity, particularly in resourceconstrained environments like IoT devices. Existing machine learning models have achieved nearly perfect accuracy in binary malware classification but fall short in terms of classifying malware families and individual malware. Additionally, the complexity of these multi-class malware attacks presents a significant challenge of detection in resource-constrained environments, as multi-class detection usually requires high computational capability. This research bridges the gap by enhancing the detection accuracy of multi-class malware classification as well as developing a lightweight model that can run efficiently on resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we propose a robust, lightweight machine learning model featuring LightGBM classifier with SMOTE oversampling and SOM-US undersampling techniques for data balancing, as well as well-engineered feature selection through Genetic Algorithm. The model performed better than the current state-of-the-art models developed on the same dataset in both malware family classification (4 classes) and individual malware type classification (16 classes) with accuracy of 89.1% and 76% respectively. Thus, maintaining a balance between classification accuracy and computational efficiency in resource-constrained environments. Furthermore, we propose another model using Random Forest classifier with an accuracy of 91.2% in malware family classification and 78.7% in individual malware classification. Demonstrating a significant enhancement in terms of accuracy from the current state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 IoT 等资源受限环境的多类恶意软件分类，提出 LightGBM + SMOTE 过采样与 SOM-US 欠采样平衡、遗传算法 (Genetic Algorithm) 特征选择的轻量模型，在 4 类恶意软件家族分类上达 89.1%、16 类个体恶意软件分类上达 76%，均优于同数据集上的现有 SOTA；另给出 Random Forest 版本，两类任务分别 91.2% 与 78.7%。
Motivation: 二分类恶意软件检测已接近满分，但家族级与个体级多类分类仍差，且多类检测通常需要高算力，在 IoT 等资源受限设备上难以部署。
Method: 以 LightGBM 为分类器，用 SMOTE 过采样与 SOM-US 欠采样做类别平衡，配合遗传算法做特征选择，构造可在资源受限设备上高效运行的轻量模型；另训练一个 Random Forest 分类器作为对比方案。
Result: LightGBM 模型在恶意软件家族分类 (4 类) 上准确率 89.1%，个体恶意软件类型分类 (16 类) 上 76%，两项均优于同数据集上的当前 SOTA 模型；Random Forest 模型对应准确率分别为 91.2% 与 78.7%。
Conclusion: 在资源受限环境下，类别平衡加遗传算法特征选择的轻量树模型能同时保住多类恶意软件分类精度与计算效率，Random Forest 版本相对 LightGBM 进一步提升两类任务准确率。

papers.title: From Sentiment Classification to Actionable and Responsible Feedback: A Scoping Review and Evidence Map of NLP in Student Evaluation of Teaching, 2015-2026
papers.abstract_en: Natural language processing (NLP) applied to open-ended teaching-evaluation comments (Student Evaluation of Teaching, SET) has tracked the field's technical evolution--from lexicons and conventional classifiers to transformers and large language models (LLMs)--but it is not evident that this technical diversification has been accompanied by corresponding gains in educational value and robustness of the evidence. This scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) maps 421 studies (2015-2026, 2026 partial) along a technical axis (RQ1) and four value dimensions (RQ2-RQ5). Dual mutually blinded LLM screening with sampled human adjudication coded seven extraction domains, with targeted codebook-boundary review at synthesis. The joint map's sharpest quantified gap is the actionability discontinuity: demonstrated output or stronger (A2+: 258/421; 61.3%) versus intended-user evaluation or stronger (A3+: 49/421; 11.6%), a 49.7 percentage-point drop. Sentiment analysis remains the modal task (300/421); diagnostic and generative depth is a substantial minority (D4-D5: 28.2% of resolved cases); a formal fairness metric is rare (1.9%). The findings are descriptive and do not support causal claims of progress: technological coexistence and uneven reporting are part of the map, but the A2+ to A3+ cliff is the contribution, not a quality ladder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇对 2015–2026 年用 NLP 处理开放式教学评价 (SET) 文本研究的范围综述 (PRISMA-ScR)，映射 421 项研究的技术路线与四个价值维度。最尖锐的量化缺口是可行动性断层：达到“有演示输出”及以上 (A2+) 的占 258/421 (61.3%)，而达到“面向目标用户评估”及以上 (A3+) 仅 49/421 (11.6%)，落差 49.7 个百分点；情感分析仍是主流任务 (300/421)，正式公平性指标仅 1.9%。
Motivation: NLP 在 SET 上的技术栈从词典、传统分类器一路扩展到 transformer 与 LLM，但技术多样化是否带来教育价值与证据稳健性的同步提升并不明确，缺少系统映射。
Method: 采用 PRISMA-ScR 范围综述，按一条技术轴 (RQ1) 与四个价值维度 (RQ2–RQ5) 编码 421 项研究 (2015–2026，2026 年不完整)；用双人互相盲评的 LLM 筛选加抽样人工仲裁，编码七个抽取域，并在综合阶段做针对性的 codebook 边界复核。
Result: A2+ 为 258/421 (61.3%)，A3+ 为 49/421 (11.6%)，两者相差 49.7 个百分点；情感分析为主流任务 300/421；诊断与生成深度 (D4–D5) 占已解决案例的 28.2%；正式公平性指标仅 1.9%。
Conclusion: 作者主张 A2+ 到 A3+ 的断崖是本文的核心贡献而非质量阶梯，发现属描述性，不支持关于进展的因果论断；技术共存与报告不均衡也是这张图谱的一部分。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quality over Quantity: Semi-Supervised Detection of Illicit Bitcoin Flows via Feature Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Detecting illicit cryptocurrency transactions is hampered by extreme class imbalance, adversarial obfuscation, and a scarcity of reliable labels. While semi-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising solution by leveraging unlabeled data, we show that its success is not guaranteed by data volume alone but is contingent on data quality. We introduce an SSL framework for detecting illicit Bitcoin flows in Shared Send Mixers (SSM) transactions, built on a comprehensive historical dataset comprising 163 million transactions. Our main conclusion is that the success of SSL depends on data quality rather than volume: high-fidelity features such as KeyLinker address clustering and Shared Send Untangling (SSU) complexity metrics achieve an F1 score of 0.84 on unlabeled data. Finally, we empirically show that common heuristics like One-Time Change (OTC), though abundant, introduce noise, while strategic reliance on higher-fidelity features like KeyLinker is essential. Our work establishes that in blockchain forensics, the path to better performance lies in smarter feature engineering for data quality, not just larger datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对比特币非法资金流检测中标签稀缺与极端类不平衡，提出基于特征工程的半监督学习 (SSL) 框架，在 1.63 亿笔交易的历史数据集上，用 KeyLinker 地址聚类与 Shared Send Untangling (SSU) 复杂度等高保真特征在无标签数据上取得 F1 0.84。结论是 SSL 成败取决于数据质量而非数据量：高保真特征有效，而量大但含噪的 One-Time Change (OTC) 启发式会引入噪声。
Motivation: 加密货币非法交易检测面临极端类不平衡、对抗性混淆与可靠标签稀缺，半监督学习虽可利用无标签数据，但其成功并不由数据量保证。
Method: 构建覆盖 1.63 亿笔交易的比特币历史数据集，聚焦 Shared Send Mixers (SSM) 交易，设计以高保真特征为核心的 SSL 框架：采用 KeyLinker 地址聚类与 SSU 复杂度指标，并对比 OTC 等常见启发式特征的作用。
Result: KeyLinker 地址聚类与 SSU 复杂度等高保真特征在无标签数据上达到 F1 0.84；经验上表明 OTC 等常见启发式虽量大但引入噪声，而依赖 KeyLinker 等高保真特征是必要的。
Conclusion: 在区块链取证中，提升性能的路径是更聪明的特征工程以保证数据质量，而非单纯扩大数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Binary Quantized Neural Network Training Is W[1]-Hard Parameterized by Input and Output Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Ganian et al. (ICLR 2026) proved that quantized neural network training is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized jointly by architecture treewidth, input dimension $α$, and output dimension $ω$, and left open whether $α+ω$ alone yields fixed-parameter tractability. We prove that 2-QNNT is W[1]-hard parameterized by $α+ω$. The hardness already holds with zero error on $D_k=\{(ξ^{(r)},ξ^{(r)}):0\le r\le k\}$, where every input equals its target, $|D_k|=α=ω=k+1$, and the examples form a coordinatewise prefix chain. It also holds when every non-source bias is fixed to zero. Under the Exponential Time Hypothesis, no algorithm runs in $f(α+ω)|I|^{o(α+ω)}$ for any computable $f$. The reduction starts from DAG edge-disjoint paths, converts edge capacity to vertex capacity with a directed line graph, and normalizes the result into a valid layered architecture. The key structural step is a one-flip routing equivalence: on the prefix-chain inputs, nonnegative binary weights make every activation monotone, and each required output transition has a weight-one predecessor making the same transition. Iterating this relation backward extracts a path from the unique changing input, while different transitions yield vertex-disjoint paths. In particular, every neuron on these inputs has only $k+1$ possible activation profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明二值量化神经网络训练 (2-QNNT) 在仅以输入维度 α 与输出维度 ω 之和为参数时是 W[1]-hard，即使训练集零误差、偏置全为零也成立；即 α+ω 单独不足以得到固定参数可解性，架构 treewidth 不能被去掉。
Motivation: Ganian 等 (ICLR 2026) 已证明量化神经网络训练在以架构 treewidth、输入维度 α、输出维度 ω 联合参数化时固定参数可解，并留下 α+ω 单独是否足够的公开问题。
Method: 从 DAG 边不交路径 (edge-disjoint paths) 问题做参数化归约：先用有向线图把边容量转成顶点容量，再把结果规范化为合法分层架构；关键结构步骤是 prefix-chain 输入上的 one-flip routing 等价——非负二值权重使激活单调，每个所需输出转变都有一个权重为 1 的前驱做同样转变，反向迭代即可从唯一变化的输入抽出路径，不同转变给出顶点不交路径。
Result: 证明 2-QNNT 对 α+ω 是 W[1]-hard；硬度在零误差数据集 D_k={(ξ^(r),ξ^(r)):0≤r≤k} 上已成立，其中 |D_k|=α=ω=k+1、样本构成 coordinatewise prefix chain，且所有非源偏置固定为零。在 Exponential Time Hypothesis 下不存在 f(α+ω)|I|^{o(α+ω)} 时间的算法（对任意可计算 f）。归约中每个神经元在这些输入上只有 k+1 种可能的激活轮廓。
Conclusion: α+ω 单独不能参数化 2-QNNT 的固定参数可解性，Ganian 等的 treewidth 条件不可省；除非 ETH 失败，也不存在以 α+ω 为指数的次基线算法。

papers.title: Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Trees with Gaussian Process Splits: A Bayesian Nonparametric Framework with Posterior Contraction Rate
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Bayesian nonparametric mixture of regression trees with a Dirichlet process prior over tree-parameter pairs, enabling data-driven selection of ensemble size and unifying CART, BART, random forests, and boosting. A novel splitting rule driven by the posterior predictive of a Gaussian process within each terminal node generates flexible, smooth decision boundaries; remarkably, the GP density cancels exactly in the Metropolis--Hastings ratio for GROW/PRUNE moves, ensuring computational feasibility. An exact Gibbs sampler for posterior predictive inference propagates uncertainty through random tree traversal. A parallel MPI implementation distributes independent tree updates across processors, achieving adequate speedups. We prove posterior consistency at rate $n^{-1/4}$ in Hellinger distance under only continuity of the true regression function, allowing misspecification, via the identity $h(Θ)=0$. Simulations on Friedman benchmark show near-nominal coverage (0.94 Gaussian, 0.92 Cauchy), robust to high-dimensional noise and heavy tails, outperforming BART and bagged CART. Applications to QSAR toxicity, crime, riboflavin, wheat genomics, and air quality confirm reliable credible intervals and automatic sparsity. The DP mixture offers a principled, robust, theoretically justified alternative for challenging regression with honest uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以 Dirichlet process 先验置于树-参数对上的回归树混合模型，用终端节点内 Gaussian process 后验预测驱动分裂规则，且 GP 密度在 GROW/PRUNE 的 Metropolis–Hastings 比中精确抵消。证明在仅假设真实回归函数连续、允许模型误设时 Hellinger 距离下后验收缩率为 n^{-1/4}；Friedman 基准上覆盖率近名义水平（高斯 0.94、Cauchy 0.92），优于 BART 与 bagged CART。
Motivation: 回归树集成的集成规模需人工指定，分裂边界不光滑，且在模型误设下缺少诚实不确定性量化的理论保证。
Method: 对树结构与节点参数的配对施加 Dirichlet process 混合先验，数据驱动决定集成规模；分裂规则由终端节点内 Gaussian process 的后验预测给出，GP 密度在 GROW/PRUNE 的 MH 比中抵消；后验预测用精确 Gibbs 采样经随机树遍历传播不确定性，并用 MPI 并行独立树更新。

papers.title: GaussianDS: Depth-supervised Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for 3D reconstruction, and recent extensions attach semantic attributes to Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding. However, lifting view-dependent 2D foundation-model outputs into 3D space introduces cross-view inconsistencies and weak geometric grounding, leading to severe semantic drift and boundary leakage. We propose GaussianDS, a depth-supervised semantic 3DGS framework that treats semantic lifting as a supervision-alignment problem and jointly optimizes RGB appearance, rendered depth, and compact semantics from scratch. Specifically, GaussianDS organizes unordered multi-view images into a pose-aware pseudo-video trajectory to propagate view-consistent masks via SAM2. During joint optimization, scale-shift-aligned monocular depth supervision and depth total-variation regularization stabilize Gaussian geometry, while a depth-edge-aware refinement loss explicitly anchors semantic transitions onto physical geometric discontinuities. Extensive evaluations show that our end-to-end framework not only retains high-fidelity 3D reconstruction and real-time rendering, but also establishes superior semantic understanding. GaussianDS sets new state-of-the-art performance on LERF (60.5% mIoU) and 3D-OVS (97.79% mIoU, 90.28% mBIoU) by mitigating semantic leakage, while seamlessly facilitating downstream 3D object removal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GaussianDS 用深度监督把 2D 语义提升到 3D Gaussian Splatting：把无序多视图像排成位姿感知伪视频轨迹，用 SAM2 传播视图一致的掩码，再联合优化 RGB、渲染深度与紧凑语义，并用深度边缘感知损失把语义边界钉在几何不连续处。在 LERF 上取得 60.5% mIoU、3D-OVS 上 97.79% mIoU 与 90.28% mBIoU，达到 SOTA 并缓解语义泄漏，同时保持高保真重建与实时渲染。
Motivation: 把视点相关的 2D 基础模型输出提升到 3D 会造成跨视不一致与几何接地薄弱，导致语义漂移和边界泄漏，开放词汇场景理解因此不可靠。
Method: GaussianDS 把语义提升当作监督对齐问题，从零联合优化 RGB 外观、渲染深度与紧凑语义：以位姿感知伪视频轨迹组织多视图像并用 SAM2 传播一致掩码，配合 scale-shift 对齐的单目深度监督与深度全变差正则稳定 Gaussian 几何，再用深度边缘感知细化损失锚定语义过渡。
Result: 在 LERF 上 mIoU 60.5%，在 3D-OVS 上 mIoU 97.79%、mBIoU 90.28%，均为新 SOTA；同时保留高保真 3D 重建与实时渲染，并支持 3D 物体移除等下游任务。
Conclusion: 把语义提升与深度监督、几何不连续对齐一起优化，可以在不牺牲重建质量与渲染速度的前提下消除语义泄漏，使 3DGS 的开放词汇理解达到 SOTA。

papers.title: Spread and Scale: What Determines Whether Test-Time Budget Allocation Pays
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization solvers generate many candidate solutions per instance and report the best one found, using the same sample budget for every instance regardless of difficulty. A companion study showed that reallocating a fixed budget toward harder instances can improve solution quality, but that the standard way of measuring this improvement is biased: deciding an allocation and evaluating it on the same data can manufacture an apparent gain even when none exists. This left open what property of a workload determines whether reallocation is worth doing, and whether a policy that spends part of the budget to decide how to allocate the rest still pays once that cost is counted. This paper answers both questions through pre-registered confirmatory experiments -- analysis and verdict criteria fixed before data collection -- across three independently trained solvers and two ways of constructing harder workloads on the traveling salesman problem. Within the workloads we study, the deciding property is how varied the instances within a workload are in difficulty, not how difficult the workload is on average: a uniformly easy or uniformly hard workload offers little room for reallocation, while a mixed workload offers substantial room. A budget-aware policy that pays for its own information about instance difficulty recovers most, though not all, of the improvement available when that information is assumed free. Every experiment was independently recomputed from its written specification, and every correction to an earlier version -- including two that weakened the paper's own claims -- is reported with the direction it moved the conclusion. The paper offers a specific empirical answer and a template for verifying that answer is not an artifact of how it was measured.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Code, cost arrays, and the full pre-registration record (including every amendment and its direction) at https://github.com/nepersoned/best-of-k-allocation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对神经组合优化求解器对每个实例固定采样预算的做法，论文用预注册确认实验回答：预算重分配是否值得，取决于实例难度的离散度（spread）而非平均难度——难度均匀（全易或全难）的工作负载重分配空间小，混合难度工作负载空间大。自付信息成本的预算感知策略能收回大部分（但非全部）信息免费时的改进。
Motivation: 伴生研究发现把固定预算向难实例倾斜可提升解质量，但同一数据上既定分配又评估会产生虚假增益的测量偏差；且尚不清楚工作负载的什么性质决定重分配是否值得，以及自付决策成本后策略是否仍净赚。
Method: 在 traveling salesman problem 上，对三个独立训练的求解器、两种构造更难工作负载的方式做预注册（pre-registered）确认实验，分析与判定标准在采集数据前固定；每个实验从书面规范独立重算，所有更正（含两处削弱本文自身结论的更正）连同方向一并报告。
Result: 决定重分配是否值得的性质是工作负载内实例难度的离散度而非平均难度；预算感知策略收回了信息免费时可得改进的大部分但非全部；全部实验独立复算，两处更正削弱了论文自身结论。
Conclusion: 在所研究的工作负载内，重分配收益由难度方差驱动，且计入信息成本后仍为正但缩水；论文同时给出一个可验证结论非测量伪影的模板。

papers.title: Reliable Fusion of Conflicting Experts
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of aggregating opinions from multiple black-box experts in noisy, conflict-prone settings where expert reliability varies across inputs. Static aggregation methods, such as majority voting, fail to capture this variability and often yield unreliable outcomes under disagreement. We propose a tractable, probabilistic-circuit-based fusion framework that dynamically combines expert responses using context-specific credibility estimates, enabling principled and reliable reasoning. The framework is agnostic to the underlying experts and does not require access to their internal representations or any retraining. We empirically validate our approach on multiple-choice question answering tasks using multiple LLMs as experts, comparing against individual models and static ensemble baselines. Our method consistently improves predictive performance and produces more reliable decisions under conflict, highlighting the effectiveness of context-aware credibility modeling for robust multi-expert fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于概率电路 (probabilistic circuit) 的多专家融合框架，按输入上下文动态估计各专家的可信度 (context-specific credibility) 来加权黑盒专家意见，无需访问专家内部表示或重训练。在以多个 LLM 为专家的多选题问答任务上，相比单模型与静态集成基线一致提升预测性能，并在专家冲突时给出更可靠的决策。
Motivation: 多数投票等静态聚合无法刻画专家可靠性随输入变化的问题，在专家意见分歧时结果不可靠。
Method: 用概率电路构建可高效推断的融合框架，依据上下文相关的可信度估计动态组合专家响应；对底层专家保持黑盒、不需内部表示也不需重训练。
Result: 在多选题问答任务上以多个 LLM 为专家，对比单个模型与静态集成基线，方法一致提升预测性能，并在冲突情形下产生更可靠的决策；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 上下文感知的可信度建模能使多专家融合在冲突场景下更稳健，且可直接套用于任意黑盒专家而无需重训练。

papers.title: Global tree forecasters collapse at the hierarchical aggregate: a five-panel failure characterization
papers.abstract_en: Global forecasting models pool many series and learn one shared function. Gradient-boosted trees are their most common form. We measure a failure of this design that has not, to our knowledge, been documented. Train a global tree on the individual series of a hierarchy, then ask it for the hierarchical aggregate. The aggregate sits far outside the model's training range, and the forecast collapses. The model under-predicts the total by 30-50x in our production deployment, and by up to 496x in a public M5 reconstruction. The mechanism is known: beyond its training range, a tree predicts a constant. It surfaces at the aggregate because the total dwarfs every training series. The cure is not new. Per-series scaling, the preprocessing step that Montero-Manso and Hyndman (2021) recommend, prevents the collapse. So do a weighted aggregate-level training row and seasonal differencing. Our contribution is the characterization. The collapse reproduces on five panels: a production business-to-business marketplace, a synthetic hierarchy, M5, Australian Tourism, and a public business-buyer panel. It holds on three tree libraries, is invariant across training seeds, and is statistically significant. Its onset is immediate and tracks a simple support bound: a scale gap of only 1.15x already costs a third of the total. No standard configuration change prevents it: pooling every hierarchy level into training fails at scale, and the one knob that fits linear models in the leaves softens it without curing it. Rolling the forecasts forward recursively separates the cures: the aggregate-row cure re-collapses, per-series scaling degrades but stays low, and only seasonal differencing keeps its one-step accuracy unchanged. We close with a three-step procedure for diagnosing and preventing the failure in deployed systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 全局梯度提升树在层级序列上预报聚合总量时会崩溃：总量远超训练样本的取值范围，树在训练范围外输出常数，生产部署中总量被低估 30–50 倍，公开 M5 重建中最高达 496 倍。逐序列缩放 (per-series scaling)、聚合层加权训练行、季节差分三种既有方法都能阻止崩溃；但只有季节差分在递归滚动预报下保持一步精度不变。作者给出部署系统的三步诊断与预防流程。
Motivation: 全局模型把所有序列池化训练，但层级聚合值落在训练范围之外这一失效此前未见记录，且会直接摧毁生产系统中的总量预报。
Method: 在层级个体序列上训练全局树（梯度提升），再要求模型预报聚合层；在五个面板上复现（生产 B2B marketplace、合成层级、M5、Australian Tourism、公共 business-buyer 面板），跨三个树库与多个随机种子检验，并对比逐序列缩放、聚合层加权训练行、季节差分三种预处理，以及递归滚动预报。
Result: 生产部署中总量被低估 30–50 倍，M5 公开重建中最高低估 496 倍；失效在三个树库上复现、跨训练种子不变且统计显著；起效即时并跟随简单支撑界——尺度差仅 1.15 倍就损失总量的三分之一。把层级各层都并入训练在大尺度下仍失败，面向线性模型的叶子参数只缓解不治愈；递归滚动下聚合行方案重新崩溃，逐序列缩放退化但仍低，只有季节差分保持一步精度不变。
Conclusion: 崩溃是全局树外推常数行为在聚合层的必然表现，逐序列缩放即可预防；但要让递归多步预报也稳健，应采用季节差分。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Spatiality-Frequency Domain Video Forgery Detection System Based on ResNet-LSTM-CBAM and DCT Hybrid Network
papers.abstract_en: As information technology advances, digital content has become widely adopted across diverse fields such as news broadcasting, entertainment, commerce, and forensic investiga?tion. However, the availability of sophisticated multimedia editing tools has significantly increased the risk of video and image forgery, raising serious concerns about content authenticity at both societal and individual levels.To address the growing need for robust and accurate detection methods, this study proposes a novel video forgery detection model that integrates both spatial and frequency-domain features. The model is built on a ResNet-LSTM framework enhanced by a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for spatial feature extraction, and further incorporates Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) to capture frequency domain information. Comprehensive experiments were conducted on several mainstream benchmark datasets, encompassing a wide range of forgery scenarios. The results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves superior performance in distinguishing between authentic and manipulated videos. Additional ablation and comparative studies confirm the contribution of each component in the architecture, offering deeper insight into the models capacity. Overall, the findings support the proposed approach as a promising solution for enhancing the reliability of video authenticity analysis under complex conditions.

Motivation: 多媒体编辑工具日益成熟，视频与图像伪造风险上升，内容真实性在社会与个人层面受到威胁，需要更鲁棒准确的检测方法。
Method: 以 ResNet-LSTM 为骨干，加入 Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) 做空间特征提取，并引入 Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) 捕获频率域信息，联合空间与频域特征做真伪判别。

papers.title: A Resilience Recovery Method for Complex Traffic Network Security Based on Trend Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Due to the rapid development of information technology, a huge and complex traffic network has been established across various sectors, including aviation, aerospace, vehicles, ships, electric power, and industry. However, because of the complexity and diversity of its structure, the complex traffic network is vulnerable to being attacked and faces serious security challenges. Therefore, this paper innovatively proposes a traffic network resilience recovery method based on resilience trend forecasting. In this paper, the risk value is introduced into the analysis of the network fault propagation process, and the Susceptible, Infectious, Recovered, Dead-Risk (SIRD-R) fault propagation model is established. The resilience model of traffic network, which encompasses real-time resilience and overall resilience, is constructed through the integration of network resilience bearing capacity and resilience recovery capacity. Ten, the resilience of complex traffic networks is forecasted by using long short-term memory networks, and the resilience recovery strategy of complex traffic networks based on forecasting is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed method are demonstrated through experimental analysis conducted on a diverse range of complex traffic networks, affirming its applicability in real-world scenarios

papers.title: Image Denoising Using Lower Semi-Frames
papers.abstract_en: A blind image denoising framework based on an infinite directional lower semi-frame (DLSF) is proposed for additive white Gaussian noise. The model employs scale-dependent directional analysis with resolvent regularization of the unbounded semi-frame operator. Noise variance is estimated directly in the DLSF domain by modeling the joint covariance of four directional difference channels and applying covariance whitening to obtain a chi-square statistic. A lower-tail moment estimator provides blind noise estimation without median absolute deviation. The estimated noise level is incorporated into channel-wise Wiener-type shrinkage and canonical-dual synthesis, followed by a data-consistent iterative reconstruction with automatic stopping. Experiments on three standard grayscale images at noise levels 15--30 yield a mean relative noise-estimation error of 3.28\%, with average improvements of 7.45 dB in PSNR and 0.367 in SSIM. At 30/255 noise, the estimation error decreases to 1.73\%, with a mean PSNR gain of 8.31 dB. Results demonstrate effective noise suppression and structural preservation, with the strongest performance on smooth and edge-dominated images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于无限维方向低半框架 (DLSF) 的盲图像去噪框架，用尺度相关方向分析加 resolvent 正则处理无界半帧算子，在 DLSF 域内对四个方向差分通道的联合协方差做白化得到卡方统计量，再用低尾矩估计器盲估噪声。在三张标准灰度图、噪声水平 15–30 上平均相对噪声估计误差 3.28%，PSNR 平均提升 7.45 dB、SSIM 提升 0.367；噪声 30/255 时估计误差降到 1.73%，PSNR 平均增益 8.31 dB。
Motivation: 加性高斯白噪声去噪中，噪声方差通常要靠中位数绝对偏差 (MAD) 等外部估计，且无界半帧算子直接正则化困难，需要在变换域内自估噪声并保持结构。
Method: DLSF 域内做尺度相关方向分析，对无界半帧算子施加 resolvent 正则；建模四个方向差分通道的联合协方差并做 covariance whitening 得到卡方统计量，用低尾矩估计器替代 MAD 做盲噪声估计；估计出的噪声水平送入逐通道 Wiener 型收缩与 canonical-dual 合成，再做数据一致的迭代重建并自动停止。
Result: 在三张标准灰度图像、噪声水平 15–30 上，平均相对噪声估计误差 3.28%，PSNR 平均提升 7.45 dB，SSIM 平均提升 0.367；噪声 30/255 时估计误差降至 1.73%，PSNR 平均增益 8.31 dB；在平滑与边缘主导图像上表现最强。
Conclusion: 在 DLSF 域内用协方差白化加低尾矩估计可以替代 MAD 完成盲噪声估计，并与 Wiener 型收缩结合同时实现噪声抑制与结构保持，优势集中在平滑和边缘主导图像。

papers.title: Schrödinger's Code Repository: Have LLMs Learned SWE-bench or Memorized It?
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level coding benchmarks have become the standard for evaluating coding agents, yet they inherently suffer from data leakage because they are built upon popular open-source repositories repeatedly used for training. Consequently, strong performance may reflect memorization of canonical repository cues rather than robust repository reasoning. We propose SchrodingerRepo (Schrödinger's Repository), an evaluation framework for testing coding agents under dynamically instantiated repository representations. Instead of repeatedly using a static representation of the test repository, SchrodingerRepo treats the test repository as an evaluation-time latent variable that is dynamically instantiated only when the agent enters the evaluation environment. The instantiated repository preserves the original executable behavior while eroding familiar cues such as naming conventions, file layouts, and implementation patterns through four transformation levels: problem statement reconstruction, namespace remapping, intra-file layout reordering, and functionality-preserving code rewriting. We evaluate popular LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-QA. Results show that removing familiar repository cues consistently degrades agent performance and substantially increases interaction costs across models. Further analysis reveals that the additional cost is primarily caused by increased difficulty in repository exploration and localization. These findings suggest that current coding agents may partially rely on memorized repository-side cues, highlighting the need for evaluation under dynamically instantiated repository representations.
papers.comment: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cslsolow/Schrodinger-Repo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SchrodingerRepo：把测试仓库当作评估时的潜变量，进入评估环境才动态实例化，在保持可执行行为不变的前提下用四级变换抹掉命名、文件布局与实现模式等熟悉线索。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-QA 上评测多个主流 LLM，移除仓库线索会一致拉低智能体表现并显著抬高交互成本，额外成本主要来自仓库探索与定位变难。
Motivation: 仓库级编码基准建立在被反复用于训练的热门开源仓库上，天然存在数据泄漏，高分可能只反映记住了规范仓库线索而非真正的仓库推理能力。
Method: SchrödingerRepo 将测试仓库作为评估时潜变量，仅在智能体进入评估环境时动态实例化，并施加四级变换：problem statement reconstruction、namespace remapping、intra-file layout reordering、functionality-preserving code rewriting，同时保持原始可执行行为。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-QA 上评测多个主流 LLM：移除熟悉仓库线索后各模型表现一致下降、交互成本显著上升；进一步分析表明额外成本主要来自仓库探索与定位难度增加。
Conclusion: 当前编码智能体部分依赖记忆化的仓库侧线索，因此需要在动态实例化的仓库表示下做评估。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RelCheck: Dual-Evidence Spatial Grounding for VLM Hallucination Correction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) fre- quently generate text that is inconsistent with the input image. While object- and attribute-level hallucinations have received considerable attention, relational hallucinations (incorrect de- scriptions of spatial or interactive relationships between objects) remain largely unaddressed by existing post-hoc correction methods. We present RelCheck, a training-free post-hoc correction pipeline that augments object-level visual grounding with dual relational evidence: learned scene-graph triples from RelTR and deterministic spatial predicates from bounding-box geometry. These combine with a Woodpecker-style object claim layer to form a three-layer visual knowledge base, which a language model corrector uses to rewrite hallucinated text. Evaluated on LLaVA v1 13B, RelCheck achieves a total MME hallucination score of 630.0 versus 585.0 for a Woodpecker-style baseline, with the largest gain on the position subtask (+31.7 points, accuracy+ improving from 0.367 to 0.600). A four-configuration ablation confirms that both relational layers contribute independently (McNemar p = 0.025). These results show that structured relational evidence meaningfully improves post-hoc hallucination correction on the spatial reasoning subtasks where current MLLMs are most deficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelCheck 是免训练的后处理管线，用 RelTR 学到的场景图三元组与包围盒几何推出的确定性空间谓词作为双重关系证据，与 Woodpecker 式对象声明层合成三层视觉知识库，再由语言模型改写器纠正 MLLM 的关系幻觉。在 LLaVA v1 13B 上 MME 幻觉总分 630.0 对基线 585.0，position 子任务提升最大（+31.7 分，accuracy+ 从 0.367 到 0.600）。
Motivation: 对象级与属性级幻觉已有较多后处理纠正方法，但空间与交互关系层面的关系幻觉 (relational hallucination) 基本未被现有 post-hoc correction 覆盖，而这正是当前 MLLM 空间推理最薄弱之处。
Method: 免训练后处理管线：以 RelTR 学到的场景图三元组和包围盒几何导出的确定性空间谓词作为双重关系证据，与 Woodpecker 式对象声明层合并为三层视觉知识库，再由语言模型改写器依据该库重写含幻觉的文本；在 LLaVA v1 13B 上评测并做四配置消融。
Result: MME 幻觉总分 630.0，对比 Woodpecker 式基线 585.0；position 子任务 accuracy+ 从 0.367 提升到 0.600（+31.7 分）；四配置消融显示两层关系证据各自独立贡献，McNemar p = 0.025。
Conclusion: 结构化的关系证据能实质改善 post-hoc 幻觉纠正，收益集中在 MLLM 最欠缺的空间推理子任务上，且两层证据的作用可分离。

papers.title: A Shared Encoder Is Not a Shared Task: Conditional Comparison for Deep Expert Pools
papers.abstract_en: Sharing a deep encoder does not, by itself, fix the central confound of task-comparison scores. We show that cross-evaluated heads on a frozen shared representation inherit the extrapolation confound of shallow exchange scores: pure input rotations with fixed labels inflate a deep exchange score from about 0 to 0.80, while representation-novelty scores are blind in the complementary direction (flat under label permutations that change the task completely). Transplanting a conditional two-discriminator discrepancy into the embedding space resolves both blind spots: the functional axis stays within +-0.001 under rotations and tracks label-permutation drift mass monotonically. Built into a mixture-of-heads lifecycle, the two-axis gate attains better decision quality with fewer heads than exchange or novelty triggers at a matched training budget. On generalized category discovery, the same chunk-level functional axis separates semantic novelty from photometric shift with AUROC 0.98-0.99 where per-input OOD scores (MSP, Energy, Mahalanobis, KNN) sit near chance for that distinction. All findings replicate across frozen ImageNet-21k ViT-B/16 and self-supervised DINOv2 backbones on CIFAR-100, and extend to residual adapter pools with recurrence, where a null-calibrated novelty trigger never fires on mechanism changes while the two-axis gate handles them with full recurrence reuse. We state explicitly the common-factoring condition under which embedding-space conclusions transfer to the original mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 共享编码器并不能消除任务比较分数的混淆：在冻结共享表征上交叉评测头会继承浅层交换分数的外推混淆。作者把条件双判别器差异移植到嵌入空间，构造功能轴与新颖性轴的双轴门控，功能轴在纯输入旋转下稳定在 ±0.001 内、随标签置换质量单调变化，并在相同训练预算下用更少的头达到更好的决策质量。

Method: 把条件双判别器 (conditional two-discriminator) 差异移植到嵌入空间，得到功能轴与新颖性轴；将双轴门控 (two-axis gate) 嵌入 mixture-of-heads 生命周期，与 exchange、novelty 触发器在匹配训练预算下比较；在冻结的 ImageNet-21k ViT-B/16 与自监督 DINOv2 骨干上、CIFAR-100 上复现，并扩展到带 recurrence 的残差 adapter 池。
Result: 纯输入旋转加固定标签把 deep exchange score 从约 0 抬到 0.80；移植后的功能轴在旋转下保持在 ±0.001 内，并随标签置换漂移质量单调变化；双轴门控在匹配训练预算下用更少的头取得更好的决策质量；在 generalized category discovery 上，chunk 级功能轴区分语义新颖性与光度偏移的 AUROC 为 0.98–0.99，而逐输入 OOD 分数 (MSP、Energy、Mahalanobis、KNN) 接近随机水平；null 校准的 novelty 触发器在机制变化时从不触发，双轴门控则能处理并完整复用 recurrence。

papers.title: False-science induction in autonomous scientific discovery
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop discovery systems increasingly execute experiments and update decisions autonomously, turning record integrity into part of the experimental apparatus. We show that false-science induction arises when legitimate physical objects and measurements are paired incorrectly, driving neural surrogates to faithfully learn record-induced associations that do not correspond to the true object-outcome relationship while marginal data distributions remain unchanged. Across green fluorescent protein fitness and materials band-gap prediction loops, coherent paired misbinding systematically redirects experimental budgets toward low-performing basins, whereas same-volume random swaps have negligible effects. These observations identify error coherence, rather than raw error frequency, as the primary variable controlling this budget misallocation in the tested loops. The resulting binding identifiability boundary supports monitored-axis quarantines and feedback-conflict triage, which intercept over-concentrated proposals before execution and isolate the corrupted hypothesis axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 闭环自主科学发现中，合法的物理对象与测量被错误配对时会诱发 false-science induction：神经代理忠实学到记录诱导的伪关联，而边缘数据分布保持不变。在 GFP fitness 与材料 band-gap 预测回路中，连贯的错配 (coherent paired misbinding) 系统性把实验预算推向低性能盆地，同体量随机交换则影响可忽略，说明起作用的是错误连贯性而非错误频率。
Motivation: 闭环系统开始自主执行实验并更新决策，记录完整性本身成为实验装置的一部分；配对错误不改变边缘分布，常规数据质检难以发现，却会让代理学到与真实对象-结果关系不符的关联并错误分配实验预算。
Method: 在 green fluorescent protein fitness 与 materials band-gap prediction 两个闭环发现回路上，对比连贯配对错位 (coherent paired misbinding) 与同体量随机交换两种扰动，考察神经代理学到的关联与预算去向；据此给出 binding identifiability boundary，并设计 monitored-axis quarantines 与 feedback-conflict triage 两个拦截机制。
Result: 连贯配对错位在两个回路中都系统性把实验预算重定向到低性能盆地，同体量随机交换影响可忽略；决定预算误分配的主变量是错误连贯性 (error coherence) 而非原始错误频率，且这一结论限定在所测试的回路中。
Conclusion: 预算误分配由错误的连贯结构驱动，因此防线应放在执行前拦截过度集中的 proposal 并隔离被污染的假设轴，而不是只统计错误数量。

papers.title: Noise-Induced Predictability Redistribution Across Forecast Horizons of Extreme Events in Chaotic Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Extreme events (EEs) in chaotic dynamics are rare broad excursions whose forecastability can be altered by dynamical noise. We investigate how noise changes EE occurrence and prediction skill across forecast horizons in a third-order autonomous chaotic flow. A single clean-data threshold is frozen for all realizations, broad events are defined by one maximum per excursion, and a future window W=15 is predicted from a 15-time-unit history using HistGradientBoosting with chronological data separation. As the forecast gap G between the observed history and the future event window increases, the clean Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) decreases from 0.641 at G=0 to 0.165 at G=15. Noise dependence is evaluated with ten paired realizations at eight amplitudes. The mean short-horizon score increases from 0.456 in clean data to 0.546 at sigma=0.007; the paired gain is 0.0895 (95% CI 0.0494-0.1295; Holm-adjusted p=0.0234). Noise strongly increases EE occurrence while event amplitude and width remain comparatively stable. Equalizing positive training counts across noise levels substantially attenuates the short-horizon gain, whereas strong noise reduces intermediate-horizon skill. We term this horizon-dependent, nonuniform change in forecast skill noise-induced predictability redistribution (NIPR).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三阶自治混沌流的极端事件 (extreme events) 预测中，动力噪声把短时技能抬高、把中时技能压低，即时距 G=0 时 MCC 从干净数据 0.456 升到 sigma=0.007 的 0.546（配对增益 0.0895，95% CI 0.0494–0.1295，Holm 校正 p=0.0234），而强噪声降低中时技能；作者称之为噪声诱导可预报性再分配 (NIPR)。若把各噪声水平的正类训练样本数对齐，短时增益大幅衰减，说明该增益主要来自噪声抬高的事件发生率而非信号本身。
Motivation: 混沌系统中极端事件稀有且预报性受动力噪声调制，但噪声如何随预报时距重新分配技能尚不清楚；单一技能指标会掩盖短时受益、中时受损的相反方向。
Method: 在三阶自治混沌流上生成数据，用统一的干净数据阈值定义极端事件（每次偏移取一个极大值），以 15 个时间单位历史预测未来窗口 W=15，模型为 HistGradientBoosting，按时间顺序切分训练与检验；噪声评估用 8 个幅度、每个幅度 10 组配对实现，并做配对显著性检验与 Holm 校正。
Result: 干净数据 MCC 随预报间隔 G 从 0.641 (G=0) 降至 0.165 (G=15)；短时（G=0）均值分从干净 0.456 升至 sigma=0.007 的 0.546，配对增益 0.0895（95% CI 0.0494–0.1295，Holm 校正 p=0.0234）；噪声显著提高极端事件发生率，而事件幅度与宽度相对稳定；对齐各噪声水平的正类训练样本数后短时增益大幅衰减，强噪声降低中时技能。
Conclusion: 噪声对极端事件可预报性的作用随时距非均匀再分配：短时技能提升部分源于事件更频繁（训练正样本更多），而非事件本身更易预测；评估噪声效应必须按时距并控制正类计数。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Bounded Loops: Pre-Run Spend Bounds, Proved Termination, and Verified Completion for Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: In mainstream agent frameworks, a step ends when the agent's own output says it has finished. Durable-execution platforms bound retries and time, but their checker conventionally lives in the same codebase as the work: a discipline the deployment is trusted to keep, not a property the harness enforces. We state what an agent harness must guarantee, prove it, and build the instrument that measures whether a harness delivers it. A bounded loop is a worker, an independent gate the worker cannot write to, and a declared budget; a bounded-loop graph composes them with a repair relation that lets a downstream failure re-run a finished upstream node. Three guarantees follow. It finishes: termination holds under repair, with the worst-case attempt total in closed form, if the repair budget is global not per node. It does not drift: no node reaches DONE without a gate verdict in an append-only hash-chained ledger, proved from control flow, since repair leaves no topological order to induct along. It does not overspend: the ceiling is enforced inside an attempt, not between attempts. Gates are measured against a two-tier held-out mutant corpus. We characterise two classes that let a sound-looking check pass anything: vacuity, satisfied by the absence of the thing checked, and self-attestation, where the subject supplies the value the check is applied to. On a 69-loop catalogue the instrument found 47 vacuous gates in shipped, reviewed code. Against the repaired gates it reports no false accepts over 209 destroying mutants ($α\le 1.8\%$, Wilson 95%); that figure is saturation, not quality: freezing the gates and applying a fresh operator family recovers a 23.3% false-accept rate where the exhausted corpus reported none. A rate belongs to a specific gate; the apparatus, not our number, is the contribution. Engine, catalogue and corpus are Apache-2.0.
papers.comment: 74 pages. Engine, catalogue and corpus at https://github.com/qualixar/bounded-loops (Apache-2.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 bounded loop（worker + worker 不可写的独立 gate + 声明预算）与带 repair 关系的图，证明终止、不漂移、不超支三条保证，并造出测量 gate 是否真起作用的仪器。在 69 个 loop 的目录上查出 47 个 vacuous gate；对 209 个 destroying mutants 报告 0 次 false accept（α≤1.8%，Wilson 95%），但换算子族后 false-accept 率回升到 23.3%。
Motivation: 主流 agent 框架以 agent 自报完成作为步结束条件，durable-execution 平台的检查器与业务代码同库，只是部署自律而非 harness 强制的性质。
Method: 定义 bounded loop 为 worker、worker 不可写的独立 gate、声明预算三元组；bounded-loop graph 用 repair 关系让下游失败重跑已完成的上游节点。给出三条证明：repair 预算为全局而非每节点时终止且最坏尝试总数有闭式；append-only 哈希链账本上无 gate 判决不得进 DONE；上限在单次 attempt 内强制。配套仪器在两级 held-out mutant corpus 上测 gate，识别 vacuity 与 self-attestation 两类失效。
Result: 69-loop 目录中查出 47 个 vacuous gate，位于已发布、已评审代码；对 209 个 destroying mutants，相对修复后 gate 的 false accept 为 0（α≤1.8%，Wilson 95%）；冻结 gate 换用新算子族后 false-accept 率 23.3%，而原已耗尽的 corpus 报告为 0。
Conclusion: 作者主张贡献是测量装置而非那个数字：false-accept 率属于特定 gate，饱和的 mutant corpus 会掩盖真实质量；engine、catalogue、corpus 以 Apache-2.0 发布。

papers.title: Learning What to Activate: Combinatorial Capability Allocation for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon multimodal agents rely on specialized capabilities for perception, retrieval, reasoning, verification, and execution. Existing designs typically activate a fixed capability set or invoke a predefined workflow, incurring substantial computational overhead while failing to accommodate stage-dependent capability demands. In this paper, we study the \textit{combinatorial capability allocation} problem for long-horizon multimodal agent systems, where the system selects a cost-sensitive subset of specialized capabilities at each interaction stage, which is nontrivial since capability values depend on the selected subset, while previous allocations alter the states encountered by subsequent decisions. We introduce \textsc{CoCA}, an on-policy learning framework that recovers a deployable capability-subset policy from sparse conditional comparisons. On states visited by the student policy, the stronger teacher compares the marginal net values of candidate capabilities, conditioned on the currently selected subset. Then, we adopt a conditional utility model to transform such comparisons into an autoregressive capability-subset policy, avoiding explicit enumeration. We further introduce dual-level on-policy distillation to address distribution mismatch both across environment states and within the partial subsets encountered during set construction. Finally, trajectory-level reinforcement learning refines the distilled policy toward task success, activation cost, and allocation stability. At inference time, allocation is performed solely by the lightweight student policy without teacher queries or online updates. Experiments on long-horizon multimodal environments and controlled capability-demand shifts demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state-of-the-art baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCA 针对长时程多模态 agent 的组合能力分配问题：在每个交互阶段选择一个有成本的专用能力子集，用条件效用模型把 teacher 的边际净价值比较转成自回归子集策略，并以双层 on-policy 蒸馏加轨迹级 RL 对齐任务成功、激活成本与分配稳定性。推理时只靠轻量 student 策略选子集，无需 teacher 查询或在线更新，在长时程多模态环境与受控能力需求偏移上优于 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有 agent 要么固定激活一组能力，要么走预定义工作流，算力开销大且无法适应各阶段不同的能力需求；而能力价值依赖已选子集、先前选择又改变后续状态，使逐阶段子集分配本身很难解。
Method: CoCA 是 on-policy 学习框架：在 student 策略访问到的状态上，让更强的 teacher 在当前已选子集条件下比较候选能力的边际净价值；用条件效用模型把这种稀疏成对比较转成自回归能力子集策略，避免显式枚举；再用双层 on-policy 蒸馏同时处理环境状态层面和集合构建中部分子集层面的分布错配，最后以轨迹级强化学习按任务成功、激活成本与分配稳定性微调。
Result: 在长时程多模态环境与受控能力需求偏移 (controlled capability-demand shifts) 的实验中，该方法优于 state-of-the-art 基线方法；摘要给出的是定性比较结论，未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按阶段用轻量 student 策略做成本敏感的能力子集分配是可行的：teacher 只在训练期提供条件比较，部署时无需 teacher 查询或在线更新，仍能在能力需求变化下保持优势。
