papers.title: TopoGS: Topology-Aware Anchor Feature Aggregation for Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Octree-based 3D Gaussian Splatting organizes anchors into multi-level hierarchies for level-of-detail rendering, but features at different levels are typically optimized independently, leaving the octree topology underused during feature learning. We observe that uniform cross-level aggregation produces asymmetric effects: fine-level anchors benefit from coarse context, whereas coarse-level anchors require selective information from their descendants. We therefore propose TopoGS, a topology-aware anchor feature aggregation framework with two lightweight components. Hierarchical Anchor Coupling establishes bidirectional cross-level gradient pathways by fusing per-level context triplets with a residual MLP. Structure-Aware Containment Aggregation uses octree containment and hash-based matching to distinguish anchors with valid parent-child relations from isolated anchors, then applies soft weighting to accommodate varying topological sparsity. Experiments on ten scenes from Mill19, UrbanScene3D, Tanks & Temples, MatrixCity, and WHU show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods. TopoGS achieves average PSNR gains of 2.13, 1.78, and 0.29 dB over the strongest reported baseline on aerial, ground-level, and synthetic-cartographic scenes, respectively, while rendering faster and using less memory. Code is available at https://github.com/WZ-CS/TopoGS.
papers.comment: 9 figures, 7 tables; supplementary material included. Code is available at https://github.com/WZ-CS/TopoGS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoGS 针对八叉树 3D Gaussian Splatting 中各层级特征独立优化、拓扑结构未被利用的问题，提出层级锚点耦合与结构感知包含聚合两个轻量组件，建立双向跨层梯度通路并按父子关系软加权聚合特征。在 Mill19、UrbanScene3D、Tanks & Temples、MatrixCity、WHU 十个场景上，相对最强基线平均 PSNR 提升分别为航拍 2.13 dB、地面 1.78 dB、合成制图 0.29 dB，且渲染更快、显存占用更低。
Motivation: 八叉树 3DGS 的多层级锚点特征被逐层独立优化，八叉树拓扑在特征学习中基本闲置；均匀跨层聚合又对粗细层作用不对称，细层受益于粗层上下文而粗层需要从后代中选择性取信息。
Method: Hierarchical Anchor Coupling 用残差 MLP 融合各层 context triplet，建立双向跨层梯度通路；Structure-Aware Containment Aggregation 借助八叉树包含关系与 hash 匹配区分有效父子锚点与孤立锚点，再用软加权适应不同拓扑稀疏度。
Result: 在 Mill19、UrbanScene3D、Tanks & Tempals、MatrixCity、WHU 共十个场景上相对最强已报告基线的平均 PSNR 增益：航拍 2.13 dB、地面 1.78 dB、合成制图 0.29 dB，同时渲染更快、内存占用更少。
Conclusion: 把八叉树拓扑显式接入特征聚合（双向跨层耦合 + 按父子关系选择性加权）能在大尺度 3DGS 上稳定提升重建质量并降低渲染开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation Choices Decide the Forecasting Leaderboard: Evidence from a Production Marketplace Panel
papers.abstract_en: A forecasting benchmark reports which method won. We show that the answer is set by the evaluator's choices before any model is fitted. We benchmark 24 forecasting methods and one textbook reference, including six 2025-era time series foundation models, on a production marketplace panel of 1,887 business customers over 67 months. We hold the data, the horizon and the period fixed, and vary only the evaluation design. Three choices each reverse or dissolve a headline conclusion. Changing the unit of analysis from the market total to the individual customer moves our production baseline from second of nineteen, beaten by nothing, to twenty-third of twenty-five. Nineteen of its twenty-four challengers beat it there. Changing how much error is pooled decides whether a Diebold-Mariano test finds anything at all. Scoring prediction intervals rather than point forecasts reorders the field almost completely, with a rank correlation of 0.02 on intermittent demand. We then measure what the deployed system gets from this. Its selection rule captures 55% of the distance between doing nothing and choosing with hindsight. The reversal is not a quirk of our data. We ran the released protocol, unchanged, on the public M5 retail panel. The same baseline shape places first at the market total and last per series, beaten by everything, and a replayed selection rule closes 64.7% of the same floor-to-ceiling distance there. Adding five zero-shot foundation models to that roster changes who wins at the total, not the shape. The bands' blind spot travels too: conformal bands under-cover most on the spikiest items. Splitting our own panel into ever smaller groups turns the contrast into a curve: the baseline's rank worsens at every level of disaggregation. We release the evaluation protocol and report an error of our own that inverted a result before we caught it.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 1 figure. Evaluation protocol and audit scripts included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文用生产环境面板证明：预测榜单的冠军在模型训练之前就被评测设计决定。固定数据、预测步长和时段，只改评测设计，三个选择各自就能推翻或消解头条结论——把分析单元从市场总量换成单个客户，生产基线从十九个方法中第 2 名跌到二十五个方法中第 23 名；改误差聚合方式决定 Diebold-Mariano 检验是否显著；用预测区间而非点预测打分，间歇性需求上排名相关性仅 0.02。
Motivation: 预测基准报告谁赢了，但赢家可能反映的是评测者的选择而非模型优劣；作者要证明这一反转不是数据巧合，并量化已部署系统实际拿到的收益。
Method: 在 1,887 个商业客户、67 个月的生产 marketplace 面板上评测 24 个预测方法加 1 个教科书参考方法（含六个 2025 年代时序基础模型），固定数据/步长/时段，只变评测设计：分析单元（市场总量 vs 单客户）、误差聚合方式、点预测 vs 预测区间打分；再把同一套协议原封不动跑在公开的 M5 零售面板上复现，并加入五个零样本基础模型检验榜单形状是否改变。
Result: 生产基线在市场总量口径下十九个方法中排第 2、无人击败，换成单客户口径跌至二十五个方法中第 23 名，其 24 个挑战者中有 19 个击败它；间歇性需求上区间打分与点预测打分的排名相关性为 0.02；已部署系统的选型规则捕获了“什么都不做”到“事后最优”之间 55% 的距离；在 M5 面板上同一基线在总量口径排第 1、按序列排最后（被全部击败），重放的选型规则弥合 64.7% 的同一天花板-地板距离；conformal 区间在最尖峰的商品上欠覆盖最严重；逐级细分面板，基线排名在每一层都变差。
Conclusion: 预测榜单的头条结论对评测设计（分析单元、误差聚合、点预测 vs 区间）高度敏感，同一基线可在总量口径称王、在序列口径垫底；评测协议与审计脚本已随论文发布，作者并公开报告了自己曾导致结论反转的一处错误。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: What Changed? Drift Detection with Real, Virtual, and Incomparable Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Sharing a deep encoder does not, by itself, fix the central confound of task-comparison scores. We show that cross-evaluated heads on a frozen shared representation inherit the extrapolation confound of shallow exchange scores: pure input rotations with fixed labels inflate a deep exchange score from about 0 to 0.80, while representation-novelty scores are blind in the complementary direction (flat under label permutations that change the task completely). Transplanting a conditional two-discriminator discrepancy into the embedding space resolves both blind spots: the functional axis stays within +-0.001 under rotations and tracks label-permutation drift mass monotonically. Built into a mixture-of-heads lifecycle, the two-axis gate attains better decision quality with fewer heads than exchange or novelty triggers at a matched training budget. On generalized category discovery, the same chunk-level functional axis separates semantic novelty from photometric shift with AUROC 0.98-0.99 where per-input OOD scores (MSP, Energy, Mahalanobis, KNN) sit near chance for that distinction. All findings replicate across frozen ImageNet-21k ViT-B/16 and self-supervised DINOv2 backbones on CIFAR-100, and extend to residual adapter pools with recurrence, where a null-calibrated novelty trigger never fires on mechanism changes while the two-axis gate handles them with full recurrence reuse. We state explicitly the common-factoring condition under which embedding-space conclusions transfer to the original mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 共享深度编码器并不能消除任务比较分数的混淆：在冻结共享表征上交叉评测 head，纯输入旋转（标签不变）会把 deep exchange score 从约 0 抬到 0.80，而 representation-novelty 分数在标签置换下完全失明。把条件双判别器差异 (conditional two-discriminator discrepancy) 移植到 embedding 空间后，functional 轴在旋转下稳定在 ±0.001 内，并随标签置换漂移质量单调变化，两轴门控用更少的 head 达到更好的决策质量。
Motivation: 任务比较分数的核心混淆——输入分布变化与任务本身变化无法区分——即使共享深度 encoder 也依然存在：exchange 分数对纯输入旋转过敏，novelty 分数对完全改变任务的标签置换失明，两者盲区互补。
Method: 把条件双判别器差异移植到 embedding 空间，构造 functional 与 novelty 两个轴，做成 mixture-of-heads 生命周期中的两轴门控 (two-axis gate)；在冻结的 ImageNet-21k ViT-B/16 与自监督 DINOv2 backbone 上、CIFAR-100 上复现，并扩展到带 recurrence 的 residual adapter pool。
Result: 纯输入旋转使 deep exchange score 从约 0 升到 0.80；标签置换下 novelty 分数保持平坦（对任务完全变化失明）。移植后的 functional 轴在旋转下保持 ±0.001 以内，并对标签置换漂移质量单调响应。在 matched training budget 下，两轴门控以更少的 head 优于 exchange 与 novelty 触发器。在 generalized category discovery 上，chunk-level functional 轴区分语义新颖性与光度偏移的 AUROC 为 0.98–0.99，而 per-input OOD 分数 (MSP、Energy、Mahalanobis、KNN) 在该区分上接近随机水平。null 校准的 novelty 触发器在机制变化时从不触发，两轴门控则以完全 recurrence reuse 处理机制变化。
Conclusion: 共享 encoder 不足以解决任务比较的混淆，需要 exchange 与 novelty 两个互补轴联合门控；embedding 空间的结论能否迁移到原机制，取决于明确的 common-factoring 条件。

papers.title: A hierarchy of faithfulness criteria for knowledge base completion
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion is evaluated by ranking observed triples above randomly corrupted ones, which treats every unobserved fact as false. When the object being completed is a description logic knowledge base rather than a plain graph, the open world assumption and deductive closure make this inadequate: relative to the knowledge base, a candidate axiom is entailed, contradictory, or undetermined, and a model that cannot separate a logically impossible axiom from a plausible novel one is not merely less accurate but semantically incorrect. We ask what it means for a knowledge base completion model to be logically faithful, and whether current embedding models are. We define a hierarchy of four increasingly strict criteria, discrimination, logical admissibility, monotonic logical faithfulness, and probabilistic logical faithfulness, and prove that they form a strict chain of implications. We ground the strongest criterion in the relative model count $P(α\mid\mathcal{O}) = \#(\mathcal{O}\cup\{α\})/\#(\mathcal{O})$, which recovers the trichotomy at its endpoints and ranks undetermined axioms in between. Evaluating knowledge graph and logic-geometric embedding models on $\mathcal{EL}$ ontologies, with entailed, contradictory, and undetermined test sets generated by a reasoner, we find that ranking accuracy does not imply logical faithfulness and that none of the evaluated models is faithful across the hierarchy. The code is available at https://github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/kbc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对描述逻辑知识库补全，提出四级递进的逻辑忠实性判据（discrimination、logical admissibility、monotonic logical faithfulness、probabilistic logical faithfulness），并证明四者构成严格蕴含链。以相对模型计数 P(α|O)=#(O∪{α})/#(O) 定义最强判据，可复原蕴含/矛盾/未定三分类并把未定公理排在中间。在由 reasoner 生成的蕴含、矛盾、未定测试集上评测知识图谱与 logic-geometric embedding 模型，发现排序准确率不蕴含逻辑忠实性，且没有一个被评模型在整个判据层级上忠实。
Motivation: 标准知识图谱补全把未观测三元组一律当负例，但在开放世界与演绎闭包下，候选公理相对知识库可能是蕴含、矛盾或未定；无法区分逻辑上不可能的公理与合理新事实的模型在语义上就是错的，而不只是精度低。
Method: 定义四级递进判据并证明其构成严格蕴含链；用相对模型计数 P(α|O)=#(O∪{α})/#(O) 落地最强判据，在端点复原三分类、中间对未定公理排序；在 EL 本体上用 reasoner 生成蕴含、矛盾、未定三类测试集，评测知识图谱与 logic-geometric embedding 模型。
Result: 在 EL 本体的 reasoner 生成测试集上，排序准确率不蕴含逻辑忠实性，且所有被评模型（知识图谱与 logic-geometric embedding）没有一个在整个判据层级上忠实。
Conclusion: 知识库补全的排序准确率不足以保证语义正确：忠实性必须按这四级判据逐级检验，最强判据由相对模型计数给出。

papers.title: Exact Minimax One-Bit Unbiased Compression: Heavy-Tail Necessity and Finite-Randomness Approximation
papers.abstract_en: A pointwise-unbiased one-bit compressor reconstructs every real input in expectation while transmitting one bit. For a scalar source $P$ with CDF $F$, mean $m$, and $\mathcal J(P)=\int_{\mathbb R}\sqrt{F(r)(1-F(r))}\,dr$, we prove that the infimum of the source-averaged reconstruction second moment over all public-coin one-bit codes unbiased on $\mathbb R$ is $m^2+\mathcal J(P)^2$. For regular full-support sources, a distribution-centered random-threshold code attains this value; a converse over arbitrary randomized binary encoders and an equality analysis characterize every attaining code up to null sets, bit relabeling, and public-seed refinement. For the Gaussian location family $\mathcal N(μ,σ^2)$ with $|μ|\le cσ$, the equal prior on the endpoint means is least favorable and the minimax value is $σ^2Λ_c^2$. Exact Gaussian minimax optimality forces a critical heavy tail: at the endpoint means, absolute moments are finite exactly for $p<3$, and $\Pr(W>t)=Θ(t^{-3}/\sqrt{\log t})$. A Cauchy-mixture robustification inflates the second moment by at most $1/(1-η)$ while making every positive-order absolute moment finite. Finite-support public randomness with finite decoder means cannot achieve exact unbiasedness on $\mathbb R$, but a bounded-output approximation using exactly $R$ shared random bits has explicit bias and second-moment bounds converging to the minimax constant. Finally, coordinate allocation communicates exactly $B$ bits per Gaussian-gradient query. On Kim's continuous quadratic hard family, the expected optimization guarantee matches the lower bound in its dependence on $(σ,d,B,\varepsilon)$, and a finite-variance high-probability bound incurs only a logarithmic confidence factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 one-bit 无偏压缩的极小极大理论论文：证明标量源在所有 public-coin 一位无偏编码下的源平均重构二阶矩下确界为 m²+𝒥(P)²，高斯位置族的 minimax 值为 σ²Λ_c²，并指出精确高斯极小极大最优强制临界重尾（p<3 阶绝对矩有限，尾部 Θ(t^{-3}/√log t)）。
Motivation: 一位压缩要在只传一比特的同时保持逐点无偏，但最优二阶矩、达到该值的编码刻画、以及有限共享随机数下的可行逼近此前缺少精确刻画。
Method: 对 CDF 为 F 的标量源定义 𝒥(P)=∫√(F(r)(1-F(r)))dr，证明下确界并用分布居中随机阈值码达到；对 |μ|≤cσ 的高斯位置族取端点均值等先验作 least favorable 分析；用 Cauchy-mixture robustification 控制二阶矩膨胀，给出有限 R 比特共享随机数的有界输出近似及偏差/二阶矩界，并在 Kim 连续二次困难族上做坐标分配（每梯度查询恰好 B 比特）。
Result: 下确界为 m²+𝒥(P)²；高斯 minimax 值 σ²Λ_c²；端点均值处绝对矩恰在 p<3 有限，Pr(W>t)=Θ(t^{-3}/√log t)；Cauchy 混合使二阶至多膨胀 1/(1-η) 并令所有正阶绝对矩有限；有限 R 共享随机数的偏差与二阶矩界收敛到 minimax 常数；在 Kim 困难族上期望优化保证对 (σ,d,B,ε) 的依赖与下界匹配，有限方差高概率界仅多一个对数置信因子。
Conclusion: 精确的高斯 minimax 一位无偏压缩必须付出临界重尾的代价，而有限随机性只能以显式偏差换取逼近；梯度查询的比特分配在 Kim 困难族上达到下界阶。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChronosAttack: Adversarial Tool Scheduling Attacks on LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents often process external tool responses as they arrive, making response timing part of the decision process. We introduce ChronosAttack, a delay-only scheduling attack that changes when authentic tool responses arrive without modifying, adding, removing, or accelerating them. Bounded delays can change the order of the same evidence and alter the final decision. We evaluate ChronosAttack on GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude show strong targeted shifts in vulnerable settings, Gemini shows large shifts in the opposite direction, and DeepSeek is more stable under the tested schedules. We also find that sequential agent state is not always required and that a single scheduling inversion can cause a large decision change. Synchronization and order-consistency defenses reduce attacker control over observation order. These results show that tool-response timing can itself form an attack surface in asynchronous LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronosAttack 是一种只延迟、不篡改内容的工具响应调度攻击：通过有界延迟改变同一组真实证据的到达顺序，从而改变异步 LLM agent 的最终决策。在 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 上出现强定向偏移，Gemini 3.6 Flash 出现反向大幅偏移，DeepSeek V4 Flash 在所测调度下更稳定；单次顺序反转即可造成大幅决策变化。
Motivation: LLM agent 把外部工具响应到达即处理，响应时序本身进入决策回路，但这一时序面此前未被视为可攻击的攻击面。
Method: 提出仅延迟的调度攻击 ChronosAttack：不修改、不增删、不加速任何真实工具响应，只用有界延迟改变其到达顺序；在 GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.6 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6 上评估，并测试同步与顺序一致性 (order-consistency) 防御。
Result: GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude 在易感设置下出现强定向偏移，Gemini 出现反方向的大幅偏移，DeepSeek 在所测调度下更稳定；发现顺序式 agent 状态并非总是必需，单次调度反转即可造成大幅决策变化；同步与顺序一致性防御可降低攻击者对观测顺序的控制。
Conclusion: 工具响应的到达时序本身构成异步 LLM agent 的攻击面，防御应约束观测顺序而非只校验内容完整性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reachable Global Optimization in AI Systems: How Global Is Global?
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly claim to optimize prompts, policies, architectures, plans, tool-use trajectories, reasoning traces, and test-time computation. This paper argues that such claims are underspecified unless they state the region actually reachable by the system that performed the optimization. We introduce Reachability-Induced Optimization (RIO), a model in which a generator, verifier, controller, memory, tools, and budget induce a reachable candidate region. The returned solution is therefore a best visited point, an approximate reachable optimum, or an exact global optimum only when additional certificates relate the reachable region to the full formal space. We prove reachable-optimality, false-globality, gap- decomposition, certificate, escape, pruning, and control-value results. The full benchmark record contains 66,150 executed trials over six known-optimum landscape families, seven control policies, 270 landscapes, and 35 runs per landscape-method. The online appendix includes raw trial records, aggregate tables, figures, benchmark code, validation scripts, and checksums. The results show that control can restrict, expand, or misdirect reachability, and that optimization quality, reachability quality, and control reliability must be reported separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 AI 系统宣称的「全局优化」在未说明系统实际可达区域时是含糊的，提出 Reachability-Induced Optimization (RIO)：由生成器、验证器、控制器、记忆、工具与预算共同诱导出可达候选区域，返回解只能称为已访问最优点或可达近似最优，除非有证书把可达区域与完整形式空间关联才可称精确全局最优。基准记录含 66,150 次执行试验、六个已知最优的 landscape 族、七种控制策略、270 个 landscape、每 landscape-method 35 次运行；结果表明控制会限制、扩展或误导可达性，优化质量、可达性质量与控制可靠性必须分开报告。
Motivation: AI 系统对 prompt、策略、架构、规划、工具轨迹、推理链与 test-time 计算的「全局优化」声明缺少对实际可达区域的界定，导致最优性声明无法核验。
Method: 提出 Reachability-Induced Optimization (RIO) 模型，把生成器、验证器、控制器、记忆、工具与预算形式化为诱导可达候选区域的组件；证明 reachable-optimality、false-globality、gap-decomposition、certificate、escape、pruning、control-value 等结果，并在六个已知最优 landscape 族、七种控制策略、270 个 landscape 上以每 landscape-method 35 次运行做基准。
Result: 基准记录共 66,150 次执行试验，覆盖六个已知最优 landscape 族、七种控制策略、270 个 landscape、每 landscape-method 35 次运行；结果显示控制可以限制、扩展或误导可达性，优化质量、可达性质量与控制可靠性三者需分别报告。
Conclusion: 只有当额外证书把可达区域与完整形式空间关联时，返回解才可称为精确全局最优；否则应报告为可达近似最优，并将优化质量、可达性质量与控制可靠性分开陈述。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agentic Governance and Adversarial Verification for Policy-Constrained LLM Healthcare Appeal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Claim denial management costs U.S. healthcare approximately $260 billion annually in administrative overhead. Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can produce fluent clinical text, but single-agent architectures fail in high-stakes healthcare: they introduce unsupported clinical details and lose the logical structure of hierarchical payer policy. We propose AGVF (Agentic Governance and Adversarial Verification Framework), a multi-agent architecture for medical-necessity appeal generation under explicit policy and evidence constraints. AGVF models appeal synthesis as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) over five agents: policy formalization, evidence retrieval, gap analysis, adversarial critique, and gated synthesis. We prove that refinement over a fixed policy constraint graph monotonically reduces evidence-deficiency and terminates with either a complete satisfying frontier or a localized evidence gap. A deterministic citation- grounding gate prevents assertions without admissible evidence from entering shared state. We provide a reference implementation and validate it on 1,000 synthetic appeal cases parameterized from de-identified public hospital discharge data. The validation confirms zero citation-grounding violations across all AGVF cases and monotone deficiency reduction in every episode; ablating the gate raises violations to 100%, confirming it is load-bearing. The study uses no real patient records and does not measure clinical efficacy. AGVF thus contributes a theory-backed agentic architecture and verified reference implementation for policy-constrained LLM generation in healthcare.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. This manuscript is under review at ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AGVF：把医保拒付申诉写作约束马尔可夫决策过程 (CMDP)，由政策形式化、证据检索、差距分析、对抗批判、门控合成五个 agent 协同，并用确定性引用接地门禁止无证据断言进入共享状态。在 1,000 例由公开出院数据参数化的合成申诉上，引用违规为 0、每轮证据缺口单调收敛；去掉该门违规率升到 100%。
Motivation: 美国拒付管理每年约 2,600 亿美元行政开销；单 agent LLM/RAG 会编造临床细节并丢失分层 payer 政策的逻辑结构，高风险场景不可用。
Method: AGVF 将申诉合成建模为 CMDP，五个 agent 依次处理政策形式化、证据检索、差距分析、对抗批判与门控合成；固定政策约束图上的精化过程带确定性引用接地门，并给出参考实现。
Result: 在 1,000 例由去标识公开住院出院数据参数化的合成申诉上，AGVF 全部案例引用接地违规为 0，且每个 episode 证据缺口单调下降；消融掉接地门后违规率升至 100%。研究未使用真实患者记录，也未测量临床疗效。

papers.title: From Reasoning Strings to Partial Orders: Verifier-Certified Rule Transport through Quotient Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many computations admit several valid execution orders because independent subgoals or disjoint state updates can commute. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards usually treats each successful trace as a separate token sequence, so serialization choices can be mistaken for logical dependencies. We introduce Verifier-Certified Rule Transport (VCRT), which replays adjacent operation pairs with native verifiers. Pairs whose two orders are accepted and reach the same canonical state provide commutation certificates; rejected or state-changing reversals provide anti-diamonds. VCRT uses anti-diamonds to preserve genuine prerequisites and assigns policy credit to the total probability mass of each certified orbit. It also constrains post-swap consistency, source retention, and policy drift. We evaluate leave-one-environment-out transfer across ProofWriter, CLRS, and Lean through a shared anonymized relation-graph interface. All training and checkpoint decisions are frozen before held-out evaluation, which uses one greedy trajectory per item without search or verifier feedback. VCRT obtains a 77.60% macro pass rate versus 64.53% for the strongest matched baseline, a paired gain of 13.06 points (95% bootstrap CI [12.58, 13.54]). Lean accounts for most of this gain at 33.49 points, while ProofWriter and CLRS improve by 2.85 points on average. Mechanism tests consistently favor anti-diamond supervision, whereas No-Orbit is statistically indistinguishable from full VCRT. The evidence does not establish a general benefit from exact orbit aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCRT 把可交换的操作对重放成交换证书与反菱形 (anti-diamond)，按认证轨道的总概率质量分配策略信用，从而把序列化选择与真实逻辑依赖分开。在 ProofWriter、CLRS、Lean 的 leave-one-environment-out 迁移上，宏通过率 77.60% 对最强匹配基线 64.53%，配对增益 13.06 点（95% bootstrap CI [12.58, 13.54]），其中 Lean 贡献 33.49 点。
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习把每条成功轨迹当作独立 token 序列，独立子目标的可交换序列化会被误当成逻辑依赖，导致规则在环境间迁移时学到虚假顺序约束。
Method: 用原生验证器重放相邻操作对：两种顺序都被接受且到达同一规范状态则记为交换证书，被拒绝或改变状态的反转记为反菱形；以反菱形保住真实前置依赖，把信用赋给每个认证轨道的总概率质量，并约束换序后一致性、源保留与策略漂移。三个环境通过共享的匿名关系图接口对接，训练与检查点决策在留出评测前冻结，评测每题只跑一条贪心轨迹、不搜索也不用验证器反馈。
Result: 留出环境迁移上 VCRT 宏通过率 77.60%，最强匹配基线 64.53%，配对增益 13.06 点（95% bootstrap CI [12.58, 13.54]）；Lean 单独贡献 33.49 点，ProofWriter 与 CLRS 平均提升 2.85 点。机制检验一致支持反菱形监督，而 No-Orbit 与完整 VCRT 统计上无差别。
Conclusion: 作者主张收益主要来自反菱形监督而非精确轨道聚合，并明确指出证据不支持精确 orbit aggregation 具有普遍收益。

papers.title: Theoretical Study on the Evidential Learning-based Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: A normal--inverse-gamma (NIG) latent hierarchy has four parameters, but its induced latent law does not identify all four. For $σ^2\sim\mathrm{InvGamma}(α,β)$, $μ\midσ^2\sim\mathcal{N}(γ,σ^2/ν)$, and $z\midμ,σ^2\sim\mathcal{N}(μ,σ^2)$, the marginal law of $z$ depends on $(ν,β)$ only through $c=β(1+1/ν)$. Hence the reconstruction-visible parameter space is the three-dimensional quotient $(γ,α,c)$, with a one-dimensional fiber degree of freedom. For a fixed hierarchical variational objective, exact partial minimization of the forward KL divergence to a complete NIG prior selects a unique prior-relative representative on each fiber, yielding an exact three-coordinate reduction with the same optimum as the four-coordinate objective. Writing $ρ_0=2β_0/ν_0$ and $T=c/\{α[(γ-γ_0)^2+ρ_0]\}$, we show that inverse canonical allocation $1/ν_{\rm can}$ is an explicit strictly increasing function of $T$. For $α>1$, the ratio $u_{\rm epi}/u_{\rm var}=1/ν_{\rm can}$ is therefore determined by the quotient state and prior; for rank-only use under a common calibration, $T$ contains the same coordinatewise ordinal information. The residual prior gauge is characterized rather than eliminated: $(γ_0,ρ_0)$ govern ordinal dependence, while $(ν_0,α_0)$ determine numerical calibration and the analytic ceiling of $1/ν_{\rm can}$.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 0 figures. Theoretical study of the NIG latent bottleneck in ELVAE; related to arXiv:2608.10398
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 NIG 潜变量层的四个参数在边缘分布下不可辨识：z 的边缘律只通过 c=β(1+1/ν) 依赖 (ν,β)，可见参数空间是三维商空间 (γ,α,c)。对固定变分目标，前向 KL 到完整 NIG 先验的精确部分极小化在每条纤维上选出唯一先验相对代表，得到与四坐标目标同最优值的三坐标约化；并证明 1/ν_can 是 T 的严格增函数，从而 epistemic/variational 方差比由商状态与先验决定。
Motivation: NIG 潜瓶颈 (ELVAE) 用四个参数刻画潜分布，但其中一维自由度对重构不可见，导致参数冗余、变分目标存在冗余坐标与先验规范 (gauge) 歧义。
Method: 对 σ²~InvGamma(α,β)、μ|σ²~N(γ,σ²/ν)、z|μ,σ²~N(μ,σ²) 推导边缘律，识别三维商空间与一维纤维；在固定层级变分目标下对到完整 NIG 先验的前向 KL 做精确部分极小化，选出纤维上唯一代表；定义 ρ₀=2β₀/ν₀ 与 T=c/{α[(γ−γ₀)²+ρ₀]}，分析 1/ν_can 随 T 的单调性。
Result: z 的边缘律只通过 c=β(1+1/ν) 依赖 (ν,β)，故可见参数空间为三维商空间 (γ,α,c) 加一维纤维自由度；三坐标约化与四坐标目标具有相同最优值；对 α>1，比值 u_epi/u_var=1/ν_can 是 T 的严格增函数，且秩用途下 T 含逐坐标相同的序信息。
Conclusion: NIG 潜瓶颈的四参数存在结构性不可辨识，可用先验相对规范约化为三坐标而不损失最优性；残余规范中 (γ₀,ρ₀) 决定序依赖，(ν₀,α₀) 决定数值标定与 1/ν_can 的解析上界。

papers.title: Geometry-anchored PET-aware multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis for whole-body attenuation correction: the BIC-MAC Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The BIC-MAC challenge targets whole-body pseudo-CT synthesis from NAC-PET, Dixon MRI, and a 2D topogram for CT-less PET attenuation correction. We propose GeoPACT, a geometry-anchored multimodal framework that uses NAC-PET as the spatial reference and incorporates topogram and MRI features through gated residual fusion. Absolute coordinates and whole-body conditioning support anatomically consistent patch-based prediction. Training combines attenuation-map supervision with a differentiable PET-response surrogate to reduce errors relevant to downstream PET reconstruction. Full-resolution pseudo-CT volumes are generated using sliding-window inference without requiring CT or PET labels at test time.
papers.comment: Challenge paper for the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) Challenge at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPCT 为 BIC-MAC 挑战赛提出以 NAC-PET 为空间参考的几何锚定多模态伪 CT 合成框架，用门控残差融合接入 topogram 与 Dixon MRI 特征，配合绝对坐标与全身条件化实现解剖一致的分块预测。训练同时用衰减图监督和可微 PET 响应代理损失，测试时无需 CT 或 PET 标签即可滑窗推理出全分辨率伪 CT 体积。
Motivation: PET 衰减校正依赖 CT，但 CT-less 场景下缺少可靠衰减图；跨模态（NAC-PET、Dixon MRI、topogram）合成伪 CT 时分块预测容易出现解剖不一致，且合成误差会传导到下游 PET 重建。
Method: GeoPCT 以 NAC-PET 作为空间参考，通过门控残差融合 (gated residual fusion) 引入 2D topogram 与 MRI 特征；加入绝对坐标与全身条件化保证分块预测的解剖一致性。训练损失为衰减图监督加可微 PET 响应代理 (differentiable PET-response surrogate)，推理用滑窗生成全分辨率伪 CT，测试阶段不使用 CT 或 PET 标签。
Result: 在 BIC-MAC（Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction，MICCAI 2026）挑战赛设定下提出 GeoPCT，输出全分辨率全身伪 CT 体积用于 CT-less PET 衰减校正；摘要给出的是框架与训练/推理设计，无定量指标。
Conclusion: 以 NAC-PET 为几何锚、把下游 PET 重建相关的响应误差写进训练目标，可以在无 CT 标签的条件下做解剖一致的全身伪 CT 合成。

papers.title: Query Implied Generative Engine Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The landscape of search has changed drastically with how people look for information online. Traditional search engines are being replaced by Generative Search Engines (GSEs), which use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate natural language responses to user queries. For content creators, visibility is no longer solely determined by ranking in search results but by being cited within generated responses. But Generative Search Engines are black-boxes, leading to the emergence of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), a set of techniques aimed at improving content visibility in generative search settings. Most existing approaches rely on the explicit queries or query derived signals to align content to better suit user needs. We propose Query Implied Generative Engine Optimization (QI-GEO) to infers user intent directly from the document. Our approach approximates document's intent space and identifies content that may be missing yet relevant to answer potential user queries. Evaluation on GEO-Bench and Extended GEO-Bench demonstrated improvements across objective and subjective metrics. QI-GEO improved objective scores by up to 15.9% and subjective scores by up to 17.6%, while yielding nearly twice as many citation gains as citation losses. These results suggest that document-derived approximations of user intents can improve visibility without relying on explicit query inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QI-GEO 直接从文档本身推断用户意图空间，找出回答潜在查询时缺失但相关的内容，而不依赖显式 query 或 query 派生信号。在 GEO-Bench 与 Extended GEO-Bench 上，客观指标最高提升 15.9%，主观指标最高提升 17.6%，引用增益约为引用损失的两倍。
Motivation: GSE 是黑盒，现有 GEO 方法都依赖显式查询或 query 派生信号来对齐内容，无法覆盖文档本身隐含、用户可能提出但未被显式表达的查询。
Method: 提出 Query Implied Generative Engine Optimization (QI-GEO)：从文档近似其意图空间 (intent space)，识别回答潜在用户查询时缺失但相关的内容，再据此优化内容可见性。
Result: 在 GEO-Bench 与 Extended GEO-Bench 上，客观指标最高提升 15.9%，主观指标最高提升 17.6%，引用增益约为引用损失的两倍（nearly twice as many citation gains as citation losses）。
Conclusion: 文档自身推断出的用户意图近似可以在不依赖显式 query 输入的情况下提升内容在生成式搜索中的可见性。

papers.title: Optimal State-Space Order for Spectral Gaps of Sliding-Window Occupation Counts
papers.abstract_en: Let $P$ be an irreducible reversible Markov kernel on a $m$-state space $Ω$, and denote its right spectral gap $γ=1-λ_2(P)$. From a stationary trajectory, let $K_t$ be the occupation-count vector of the length-$n$ window beginning at time $t$. The stationary pair $(K_0,K_1)$ defines a reversible projected count kernel $\widetilde P_n$. For every $m\ge2$, let \[ c_m^\star= \inf_{\substack{ P,\; n \ge 2}} \frac{n\Gap(\widetilde P_n)}{\Gap(P)}. \] We prove \[ \frac1{1080m}\le c_m^\star\le q_{m-2}, \qquad q_0=\frac14,\quad q_{r+1}=q_r(1-q_r). \] We also show $q_{m-2}=(m+\log m+O(1))^{-1}$, which implies that $c_m^\star=Θ(m^{-1})$. Thus, the optimal comparison coefficient has order $m$, although its exact value remains open. The lower bound also holds for $n=1$ and is uniform in $P$, including sparse and periodic kernels. Its proof combines short-window decorrelation with an averaged anchor-excursion decomposition, a Green-kernel hitting estimate, and a stopped Carleson--Hardy inequality. A nested rare-state construction produces finite $m$-state witnesses whose normalized Rayleigh quotients approach $q_{m-2}$ through an ordered sequence of limits. For every fixed finite irreducible reversible aperiodic kernel on at least two states, $\Gap(\widetilde P_n)=Θ_P(n^{-1})$.

papers.title: A Non-Invasive Cloud-Based Migration Strategy for Post-Quantum Cybersecurity in Smart HVAC Systems: Architecture, Implementation, and Empirical Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Legacy smart HVAC controllers rely on vendor-cloud TLS secured by ECDH and RSA, both broken by Shor's algorithm, and typical 10-15 year lifespans mean today's devices remain in service through the quantum-threat era. Direct on-device post-quantum cryptography is infeasible: an ESP32-S3, representative of capable HVAC hardware, has only 339 KB free heap against the 900 KB ML-KEM-768 requires, and even classical ECDH-P256 keygen (111.93 ms) dwarfs hardware AES-128 (0.032 ms). We propose a non-invasive PQC proxy, requiring no device, firmware, or vendor-cloud changes, performing ML-KEM-768 encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 authentication (NIST FIPS 203/204) with AES-256-GCM session keys via HKDF, implemented with Open Quantum Safe liboqs on a Raspberry Pi 4B gateway. Over 500 runs, the post-quantum handshake (Steps 1-6) completes in 2.48 ms, 0.38 ms slower than classical baseline, with PQC computation around 8% of handshake time at 20 ms simulated round-trip network latency. The gateway sustains 443 sessions/second, 100% success under 32 concurrent connections, extrapolating to 3546 sessions/second on a 32-core cloud instance. Five side-channel tests, including verified in-place session-key zeroization and a fixed-vs-random TVLA timing analysis, found no exploitable timing leakage or susceptibility to man-in-the-middle attacks. The architecture is vendor-agnostic and becomes unnecessary once vendors adopt NIST PQC natively.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 12 figures (3 architecture diagrams, 9 experimental plots), 6 tables. Preprint; work in progress. Presents a non-invasive post-quantum cryptography proxy for smart HVAC systems with empirical evaluation on Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3 hardware (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, liboqs)

papers.title: CAST: Context- and Anomaly Structure-Conditioned Time Series Anomaly Generation
papers.abstract_en: Anomalous time series play a critical role in safety-critical domains, yet they are inherently scarce, heterogeneous, and costly to obtain. Existing time series generation methods predominantly focus on synthesizing normal data, providing limited value when anomalous samples are needed. We identify two fundamental challenges in anomaly generation: (i) the scarcity of anomaly data, and (ii) the heterogeneous morphological characteristics of anomalies. To address these challenges, we propose CAST, a Context- and Anomaly Structure-conditioned Time series anomaly generation framework with principled two-stage pretraining and finetuning strategy. In pretraining stage, we leverage abundant normal time series data to learn underlying system dynamics and substantially mitigate the limited availability of anomaly data. During finetuning, CAST explicitly conditions the generator on learned anomaly structure representations, enabling it to capture heterogeneous anomaly morphologies under similar contextual conditions. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world univariate and multivariate datasets demonstrate that CAST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art anomaly generation methods in terms of both generation fidelity and downstream task utility, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAST 用两阶段预训练-微调把正常时序中学到的系统动力学迁移到异常生成：预训练阶段用大量正常数据学动力学以缓解异常稀缺，微调阶段让生成器显式以学到的异常结构表征为条件，从而在相似上下文下刻画异质异常形态。在多个真实单变量与多变量数据集上，CAST 在生成保真度与下游任务效用两方面持续优于现有异常生成方法。
Motivation: 安全关键领域的异常时序样本天然稀缺、形态异质且获取昂贵，而现有时序生成方法主要合成正常数据，在需要异常样本时价值有限。
Method: CAST 框架分两阶段：预训练用大量正常时序数据学习底层系统动力学，微调时以学到的异常结构表征 (anomaly structure representations) 显式条件化生成器，使其在相似上下文条件下捕捉异质异常形态。
Result: 在多个真实世界单变量与多变量数据集上的实验中，CAST 在生成保真度 (generation fidelity) 与下游任务效用 (downstream task utility) 两方面均持续优于 SOTA 异常生成方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 两阶段预训练加结构条件化是缓解异常样本稀缺并覆盖异质异常形态的有效生成范式，其收益体现在生成保真度与下游任务效用上。

papers.title: Type-II Error Bounds for Test Supermartingales from Lower-Tail Hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: In safe hypothesis testing with test supermartingals, Ville's inequality provides anytime-valid type-I error guarantees for every significance level $α\in(0,1]$, if one rejects the null hypothesis whenever the wealth process first exceeds $\frac{1}α$. Due to an inherent asymmetry, the type-II error does not have such guarantees: a heavy concentration of the probability on the lower tail of the log-increments can lead to one catastrophic bet that undoes any amount of accumulated evidence. This paper studies how different hypotheses on those lower-tail probabilities lead to different bounds on the type-II error of the sequential test. They all reduce to one master inequality, which bounds the type-II error at level $α$, at a fixed horizon and sequentially, in terms of a one-sided Legendre transform of the (inverse-)moment generating function of the e-variables, evaluated at one number: the amount by which the lower bound of the accumulated e-powers exceeds $\log\frac{1}α$. And, the step is lossless, in the sense, that it extracts exactly a constrained information projection. Every bound presented here is a corollary, obtained by a certain majorant of the above function. The hypotheses are: a finite negative moment; an exponentially small crash probability with a moment on the winning side; a wealth floor with a conditional variance, and its Bernstein variant, which interpolates between a Gaussian regime set by the variance and an exponential one set by the scale; a sub-Gaussian or bounded-tilt lower tail; bounded log-increments; and i.i.d. increments, where the majorant is the truth. We also provide an empirical-Bernstein variant. Each hypothesis may either be read as a condition on the e-variables one has, or as the price of betting with an approximation to the likelihood ratio rather than the ratio itself, which satisfies the weakest condition for free.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在安全序贯检验中，Ville 不等式只保证 type-I 误差，而 log-增量下尾重尾可让一次灾难性下注抵消全部累积证据。论文证明对下尾概率的不同假设都归约到同一个 master inequality：用 e-variable 矩生成函数（MGF）的单侧 Legendre 变换，在“累积 e 幂下界超出 log(1/α) 的量”这一点取值，给出固定时点与序贯的 type-II 误差界，且该步无损、恰好提取一个受约束信息投影。
Motivation: test supermartingale 的序贯检验中 type-I 有 anytime-valid 保证，但 type-II 没有对应保证：log-增量下尾概率集中会导致一次 catastrophic bet 抵消任意多累积证据，需要在不同下尾假设下给出可算的 type-II 界。
Method: 把各类下尾假设——有限负矩、指数级小 crash 概率加赢侧矩、带条件方差的 wealth floor 及其在高斯与指数体制间插值的 Bernstein 变体、sub-Gaussian 或 bounded-tilt 下尾、有界 log-增量、i.i.d. 增量——统一写成一个 master inequality，各具体界均为该式某一 majorant 的推论；并给出 empirical-Bernstein 变体。每个假设既可读作对已有 e-variable 的条件，也可读作用近似似然比下注的代价。
Result: 得到固定时点与序贯两种 type-II 界，统一由 (反)MGF 的单侧 Legendre 变换在“累积 e 幂下界减 log(1/α)”处取值给出；该归约无损，恰好等于一个受约束信息投影；i.i.d. 增量情形下所用 majorant 即为真值。
Conclusion: type-II 界可由下尾假设经一个 master inequality 统一导出，界的质量取决于所选 majorant；i.i.d. 情形该 majorant 是紧的。

papers.title: The Type-II Error of Test Supermartingales: e-Power versus the Chernoff-Stein Exponent
papers.abstract_en: In safe hypothesis testing with test supermartingales, Ville's inequality provides anytime-valid type-I error guarantees for every significance level $α\in(0,1]$, if one rejects the null hypothesis whenever the wealth process first exceeds $1/α$. Due to an inherent asymmetry, the type-II error behaves differently. We prove two things about the latter, for a simple null and alternative. First, the mean growth rate $\mathbb{E}_{P_1}[\log E]$, the e-power, that Kelly betting and growth-rate-optimal e-variables maximise, bounds nothing on its own. For every level $c>0$, every $α$ and horizon $t$ we construct e-variables of conditional e-power exactly $c$ whose probability of not rejecting by $t$ is arbitrarily close to one. It forces eventual rejection, but no finite-horizon guarantee follows. Second, the quantity that does control the type-II error is the Chernoff-Stein exponent of an e-variable, $Λ(E)=\sup_{s\ge0}\{-\log \mathbb{E}_{P_1}[E^{-s}]\}$, whose range is exactly determined: $\sup_E Λ(E)=\mathrm{KL}(P_0\|P_1)$, the classical Chernoff-Stein exponent, and so the ceiling of its own per-e-variable form. One conditional application of Hoelder's inequality per step gives it, for every test supermartingale on an arbitrary filtered space, with no independence or product structure; the i.i.d. case adds that it is matched, and attained by nothing. The e-power has its own ceiling, $\mathrm{KL}(P_1\|P_0)$, and that one is attained, $P_0$-a.s. uniquely, by the likelihood ratio $R$. The two optima are the same divergence in opposite arguments, at opposite ends of the flattened family $R^β/\mathbb{E}_{P_0}[R^β]$: the ceiling as $β\downarrow0$, $R$ at $β=1$. Which $β$ is best is settled by the horizon, exactly: $R$ is optimal at $t=\log(1/α)/\mathrm{KL}(P_1\|P_0)$ alone, beaten by sharpening $(β>1)$ below it and by flattening above.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在检验超鞅 (test supermartingale) 的安全假设检验中，证明 e-power 均值增长率本身对 type-II error 不给出任何有限时域界：对任意条件 e-power c、任意 α 与时域 t，可构造 e-variable 使 t 时刻不拒绝概率任意接近 1。真正控制 type-II error 的是 Chernoff-Stein 指数 Λ(E)，其上确界恰为 KL(P0‖P1)；e-power 自身的天花板是 KL(P1‖P0)，由似然比 R 唯一达到。
Motivation: Ville 不等式只给 type-I error 的 anytime-valid 保证，type-II error 因不对称而行为不同；e-power 作为 Kelly 投注与增长率最优 e-variable 最大化的量，直觉上应控制漏检风险，但缺少有限时域的判定条件。
Method: 对简单原假设与备择，逐步用一次条件 Hölder 不等式，在任意滤过空间上对任意检验超鞅（无需独立或乘积结构）给出 Λ(E) 的界；再沿扁平族 R^β/E0[R^β] 比较两个最优量，并在 i.i.d. 情形讨论可达性。
Result: 证明 sup_E Λ(E)=KL(P0‖P1)，i.i.d. 下该上界被匹配但不被任何 e-variable 达到；e-power 上界 KL(P1‖P0) 被似然比 R 以 P0-a.s. 唯一方式达到。R 在时域 t=log(1/α)/KL(P1‖P0) 这一点上最优：低于该时域被 β>1 的锐化超过，高于则被压平 (β<1) 超过。
Conclusion: 有限时域 type-II 保证必须由 Chernoff-Stein 指数而非 e-power 承担；两个最优量是同一散度在相反参数位置，选哪个 β 由时域精确决定。

papers.title: Groundbench: Multi-Resolution Polygon Grounding Exposes the Geometry Gap in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Bounding-box scores on RefCOCO-family grounding leave little room to distinguish frontier vision-language systems, yet boxes discard object shape. We introduce GroundingBench, a matched benchmark that re-targets the same 1,500 image-expression-referent triples to exact-N polygons at five vertex budgets. A fixed-denominator harness separately audits filled-region intersection over union (IoU) and legal-polygon completion. The strongest tested configuration reaches 88.2 box IoU and 97.1 accuracy at IoU >= .5 (Acc@.5), versus 57.7 and 69.2 for direct polygons; because these headline scores use different references, we also compare direct polygons with predicted boxes rasterised against the same contour target, obtaining 57.7 versus 57.3 when pooled. Performance is non-monotone in N and collapses at the densest budget, where legality failures compound residual geometric error. Qwen's thinking-setting contrast is the largest tested input-preserving configuration difference; under frozen templates, false spatial cues are more damaging than false colour cues, and target preference can remain high while contour tracing is poor. Alternate masks and a continuous-area scorer preserve the principal ordering. GroundingBench therefore measures an operational output-geometry gap spanning localisation, boundary construction, serialisation, and topology, rather than latent boundary perception alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Groundbench 把 RefCOCO 式 grounding 的 1,500 个图像-表达式-指称三元组改造成五档顶点预算的精确多边形任务，用固定分母分别审计填充区域 IoU 与合法多边形完成率。最强配置 box IoU 88.2、Acc@.5 97.1，直接多边形仅 57.7 与 69.2；与同一轮廓目标栅格化对比后 57.7 对 57.3，说明差距出在输出几何而非边界感知。
Motivation: RefCOCO 系列的 bounding-box 分数已难以区分前沿 VLM，而框本身丢弃物体形状，需要一个能分离定位、边界构建、序列化与拓扑的评测。
Method: GroundingBench 将同一批 1,500 image-expression-referent 三元组重定向到五个顶点预算的 exact-N 多边形；固定分母 harness 分别审计 filled-region IoU 与 legal-polygon completion，并用 alternate masks 与 continuous-area scorer 做稳健性对照。
Result: 最强配置 box IoU 88.2、Acc@.5 97.1；直接多边形 57.7 与 69.2。直接多边形与预测框栅格化到同一轮廓目标对比为 57.7 对 57.3（合并）。性能随 N 非单调并在最密顶点预算处崩溃，legal-polygon 失败与残余几何误差叠加；Qwen thinking-setting 对比是最大的输入保持配置差异；冻结模板下假空间线索比假颜色线索更具破坏性。
Conclusion: Groundbench 度量的是横跨定位、边界构建、序列化与拓扑的操作性输出几何差距，而非潜在边界感知本身；顶点预算加密反而因合法性失败而恶化。

papers.title: When Adaptation Hurts: Split Sensitivity and Person-Level Negative Transfer in Federated Wearable Onboarding
papers.abstract_en: Federated wearable models eventually serve people absent from source training, but favorable average accuracy does not establish that unlabeled onboarding helps each person. We evaluate six core onboarding strategies on five wearable datasets under a leakage-controlled protocol that fixes source checkpoints, estimates normalization from source data only, separates calibration from evaluation recordings, and performs inference over held-out people rather than windows, devices, or random seeds. Completing all eligible HHAR and PAMAP2 outer-person rotations materially changes the conclusion obtained from the original frozen fold. On HHAR, balanced accuracy on that single person is 95.6-97.2% across methods versus 78.3-83.0% over all nine users, a reduction of 13.8-17.8 percentage points (pp). The displayed mean leader changes on both datasets, while paired leader-runner bootstrap intervals include zero and do not resolve a superior method. No adaptive core mechanism combines positive mean gain in all five datasets with zero seed-averaged person-level losses greater than 2 percentage points (pp). FedBN has one such loss and ATP-style adaptation has eight; Feature-only has none after seed averaging, but its exact one-sided 95% upper bound is 7.6%. A complementary seed-person stress audit records 4, 22, and 10 harmful realizations out of 114 for FedBN, ATP-style, and Feature-only, respectively; these are repeated realizations, not independent participants. Tail quality, calibration availability, and fall-window specificity reveal additional failures hidden by mean accuracy. The study therefore provides an auditable development benchmark and failure map rather than a universal-superiority or deployment-safety claim.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material included. Code and supplementary scripts: https://github.com/TitanRahil/When-Adaptation-Hurts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在联邦可穿戴 onboarding 场景下，六种自适应策略在五个数据集上的平均准确率会掩盖个体级负迁移：HHAR 上单人 balanced accuracy 达 95.6–97.2%，而九人整体只有 78.3–83.0%，下降 13.8–17.8 pp。补全外层人员轮换后数据集均值冠军改变，但配对 bootstrap 区间含零，无法判定优胜方法；作者据此把工作定位为可审计的失败图谱而非普适优越性或部署安全性主张。
Motivation: 联邦可穿戴模型最终服务的是训练时不在场的人，但平均准确率高并不等于无标签 onboarding 对每个人都有帮助；原冻结折上的结论在补全人员轮换后会翻转。
Method: 在五个可穿戴数据集上评测六种 onboarding 策略，采用泄漏受控协议：固定 source checkpoint、归一化只用 source 数据估计、校准与评估记录分离，并按 held-out 人员（而非窗口、设备或随机种子）做推理；另做 seed-person 压力审计与配对 leader-runner bootstrap。
Result: HHAR 上单人 balanced accuracy 95.6–97.2%（各方法）对全体九名用户 78.3–83.0%，降幅 13.8–17.8 pp；两个数据集的均值领先方法都改变，配对 bootstrap 区间含零。五个数据集中没有自适应核心机制同时做到正的平均增益且 seed 平均后个体损失不超过 2 pp：FedBN 有 1 例、ATP-style 有 8 例、Feature-only 为 0 例但其单侧 95% 上界为 7.6%。seed-person 审计记录有害实现数：FedBN 4、ATP-style 22、Feature-only 10，分母均为 114。
Conclusion: 平均准确率不足以支撑个体级无害性，评估必须按 held-out 人员报告尾部损失与校准；该基准给出的是失败图谱，不是通用最优或可部署安全的结论。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Safe Multi-Robot Coordination via VLM-LLM Reasoning and Reachability Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Safe coordination in heterogeneous machine-to-machine (M2M) robotic systems is challenging when robots differ in sensing capabilities, environmental awareness, and motion execution roles. This paper presents a centralized safety-aware M2M framework for cooperative goal-directed navigation in a heterogeneous mobile robot team comprising a vision-capable quadruped and a camera-less robotic vehicle. The objective is to guide both platforms toward a goal region while avoiding static and dynamic obstacles and preventing unsafe inter-robot interactions. Under the principle of shared perception, the vision-capable robot provides semantic environmental awareness through a centralized server over an MQTT broker, enabling the camera-less platform to navigate using this shared scene representation alongside its own odometry, IMU, and state feedback. A vision-language model (VLM) interprets the visual stream, and the extracted semantic data is mapped into conservative metric geometric constraints, including inflated obstacle sets, safe corridors, and goal regions. A large language model (LLM) proposes high-level task allocations, while physical command authority is restricted to a robot-specific zonotope reachability gate. This verification engine propagates independent reachable tubes to evaluate obstacle avoidance, safe-corridor containment, and inter-robot separation predicates before approving commands. Online experiments across clear-path and dynamic-obstacle scenarios show that the pipeline reliably approves safe motion, triggers conservative replanning or holding maneuvers upon constraint violation, and enforces a strict architectural separation between advisory semantic reasoning and formally verified motor execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向异构移动机器人（带视觉四足 + 无相机车辆）提出集中式 M2M 安全框架：VLM 解释视觉流并映射为保守几何约束，LLM 分配任务，所有物理指令须经 zonotope reachability gate 形式化验证后才下发。在线实验在畅通路径与动态障碍场景下，管道可靠批准安全运动，并在约束违反时触发保守重规划或保持。
Motivation: 异构机器人在感知能力、环境感知与运动角色上不一致，机器间直接协作时难以保证避障、安全走廊与机器人间安全距离。
Method: 共享感知：带视觉机器人经 MQTT broker 向集中服务器提供语义环境，无相机平台结合自身 odometry、IMU 与状态反馈导航。VLM 解释视觉流，语义数据映射为膨胀障碍集、安全走廊、目标区域等保守度量几何约束；LLM 提出高层任务分配；物理指令权限受限于机器人专属 zonotope reachability gate，该验证引擎传播独立可达管道 (reachable tubes) 判定避障、走廊包含与机器人间分离谓词。
Result: 在线实验覆盖 clear-path 与 dynamic-obstacle 两类场景：管道可靠批准安全运动，在约束违反时触发保守重规划或保持机动，并在语义推理与形式化验证的电机执行之间保持严格架构分离。
Conclusion: 把语义推理（VLM/LLM）限定为建议层、把执行权交给形式化验证的可达性门控，可在异构机器人 M2M 导航中同时实现语义灵活性与可验证的安全性。

papers.title: Evaluating ADC-only deep learning pipelines for breast cancer detection and segmentation using standalone diffusion-weighted MRI
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) imaging is the gold standard technique for the detection and characterization of breast cancer using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, DCE-MRI requires long acquisition times and the administration of contrast into the bloodstream, which can cause allergic reactions. Alternatively, diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) is a standard complementary technique for breast MRI that does not require contrast, has shorter acquisition times, and enables calculation of apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps that correlate with tumor cellularity. Yet, despite these technical advantages, deep learning research has focused on DCE-based models and has barely explored the tumor detection performance of DW-MRI and ADC maps either in combination with DCE-MRI or as standalone alternatives. Here, we evaluate the application of different state-of-the-art deep learning techniques for detection and segmentation of breast cancer using ADC-only images. This is, to our knowledge, the first comprehensive evaluation of ADC-only breast cancer pipelines for classification, detection, and segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅用 ADC 图（DW-MRI 派生、无对比剂）的条件下评估多种前沿深度学习技术做乳腺癌分类、检测与分割，声称是首个对 ADC-only 乳腺癌管线的综合评估，结论是无对比剂的 DW-MRI 路线可作为 DCE-MRI 的独立替代方向。
Motivation: DCE-MRI 是乳腺癌检测金标准，但采集时间长且需注射对比剂、可能引发过敏；深度学习研究几乎都押在 DCE 上，DW-MRI 与 ADC 图作为无对比剂替代方案的检测性能基本没被系统探索。
Method: 以 ADC-only 图像为唯一输入，评估多种 state-of-the-art 深度学习技术，覆盖分类、检测（detection）与分割（segmentation）三类任务，构成 ADC-only 管线的综合评测。
Result: 摘要给出的定位是：据作者所知，这是首个覆盖分类、检测与分割三任务的 ADC-only 乳腺癌管线综合评估；摘要未列出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 无对比剂、短采集的 DW-MRI/ADC 图值得作为独立输入被系统评测，而不只是 DCE-MRI 的补充；其价值在于绕开对比剂过敏与长采集时间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LabourCrew: A Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Trustworthy Adversarial Deliberation and Statutory Reasoning over Labour Law
papers.abstract_en: In statutory question answering, every claim must be traceable to evidence, not merely relevant, since unverifiable labour-rights answers carry serious legal consequences. Current systems fall short: single-pass RAG cannot detect insufficient evidence, while multi-agent legal-debate systems treat grounding as a prompting convention, letting agents cite unretrieved evidence. To address this gap, we introduce LabourCrew, a multi-agent RAG framework built around three grounding mechanisms: StatuteGraph, a graph index that explicitly links chapter, section, proviso, and cross-reference structure rather than fixed-length spans; an Evidence Exchange Protocol that confines advocates and an interpreter to an evidence ledger, making citation to unretrieved text impossible, while a fault-tolerant supervisor board runs advocates in parallel so individual failures degrade rather than crash the system; and a Calibrated Trust Gate that replaces categorical accept/reject decisions with a trust score, thresholded via conformal risk control for a distribution-free bound on the false-accept rate. We evaluate on LabourActQA, a 500-item Bangla question set from the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006, spanning seven reasoning categories and three difficulty tiers. The framework drives the empirical false-accept rate to 0.081, within the target level ($α= 0.10$), achieves the highest Answer Relevancy among HyDE RAG, Graph-RAG, and Hierarchical RAG (0.862 $>$ 0.839, 0.815, 0.828), and degrades gradually rather than catastrophically as question difficulty increases. These results show that calibrated abstention, not retrieval quality alone, is what makes legal question answering auditable in low-resource statutory domains.

TL;DR: LabourCrew 是面向劳动法法条问答的多智能体 RAG 框架，用 StatuteGraph 图索引、Evidence Exchange Protocol 证据账本和 Calibrated Trust Gate 三重 grounding 机制，把引用限制在已检索证据内，并用 conformal risk control 校准信任阈值。在 LabourActQA（孟加拉劳动法 2006，500 条 Bangla 问题）上经验 false-accept rate 降到 0.081，低于目标 α=0.10，Answer Relevancy 0.862 高于 HyDE RAG 0.839、Hierarchical RAG 0.828、Graph-RAG 0.815。
Motivation: 单遍 RAG 无法察觉证据不足，多智能体法律辩论系统把 grounding 当作提示约定，允许 agent 引用未检索到的证据；在低资源法条问答中不可核验的答案有严重法律后果。
Method: 三个组件：StatuteGraph 以章、节、款、交叉引用结构建图索引而非固定长度切片；Evidence Exchange Protocol 把辩方与解释者限制在证据账本内使未检索引用不可能，并由容错 supervisor board 并行运行辩方；Calibrated Trust Gate 用信任分数替代二元接受/拒绝，阈值经 conformal risk control 标定以给出 false-accept rate 的分布无关上界。
Result: 在 LabourActQA（Bangladesh Labour Act 2006，500 条 Bangla 问题，七个推理类别、三个难度层级）上经验 false-accept rate 0.081，落在目标 α=0.10 之内；Answer Relevancy 0.862，对比 HyDE RAG 0.839、Graph-RAG 0.815、Hierarchical RAG 0.828 为最高；随问题难度上升性能渐进退化而非崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者主张在低资源法条领域，使法律问答可审计的关键是校准的弃答 (calibrated abstention)，而不只是检索质量。

papers.title: Task-Prototype Guided Flow Matching for Few-Shot Generalization in Vision-Language Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language robot manipulation policies can follow semantic instructions, but adapting them to a new procedure from only a few demonstrations remains difficult because language underspecifies contact timing, motion phases, corrective behavior, and execution style. This paper presents Task-Prototype Guided Flow Matching (TP-Flow), a few-shot manipulation framework that converts support demonstrations into structured task-prototype tokens and uses them to guide both the initial flow prior and the velocity field. TP-Flow employs symmetric cross-attention with learnable queries to extract phase-level prototypes, parameterizes a task-adaptive initial distribution, and injects prototype information through gated adaptive normalization. It is trained with an episodic support-query objective and prototype contrastive regularization, so few-shot adaptation is simulated during training while nuisance information is suppressed. On the LEROBOT-ARM-SO101 platform, TP-Flow achieves 66.8\%, 79.6\%, and 82.1\% success rates under 1-, 4-, and 6-shot settings, with a 75.5\% few-shot AUC. At 1-shot, it improves over CFM, Pooled-Demo CFM, and In-Context Flow by 29.8, 14.5, and 9.9 percentage points. It also improves held-out target-group generalization across novel-object transfer, goal recombination, long-horizon composition, and contact/correction tasks. TP-Flow maintains real-time execution with six online prototype tokens, 54.3 ms latency, 3.9 GB peak memory, and a 10 Hz control rate, while reducing the noisy-support success drop to 6.2\%. Theoretical diagnostics show that prototype distance aligns with action-distribution distance, the adaptive prior reduces transport cost, and gated modulation keeps measured trajectory deviations below the derived ODE bound. The code repository is omitted for anonymous review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TP-Flow 把少量支撑示范编码为结构化任务原型 token，同时引导 flow matching 的初始先验与速度场，使视觉-语言操作策略能从 1–6 个示范适配新流程。在 LEROBOT-ARM-SO101 上 1/4/6-shot 成功率 66.8%/79.6%/82.1%，few-shot AUC 75.5%，1-shot 比 CFM 高 29.8 个百分点，且 54.3 ms 延迟、10 Hz 控制下保持实时。
Motivation: 语言指令无法规定接触时机、运动阶段、纠偏行为与执行风格，导致视觉-语言操作策略难以仅凭少量示范适配新流程。
Method: TP-Flow 将支撑示范转为任务原型 token：用带可学习 query 的对称交叉注意力提取 phase-level 原型，参数化任务自适应初始分布，经 gated adaptive normalization 注入原型信息；训练采用 episodic support-query 目标加原型对比正则。
Result: LEROBOT-ARM-SO101 上 1/4/6-shot 成功率 66.8%/79.6%/82.1%，few-shot AUC 75.5%；1-shot 比 CFM、Pooled-Demo CFM、In-Context Flow 分别高 29.8、14.5、9.9 个百分点；含噪支撑下成功率仅降 6.2%；实时性为 6 个在线原型 token、54.3 ms 延迟、3.9 GB 峰值内存、10 Hz 控制率；理论诊断显示原型距离与动作分布距离对齐、自适应先验降低传输成本、门控调制使轨迹偏差低于推导的 ODE 界。
Conclusion: 把示范结构化为原型 token 同时调制先验与速度场，可在极少示范下完成新流程适配，并在新颖物体迁移、目标重组、长程组合与接触/纠偏任务上保持对未见目标组的泛化。

papers.title: Fusion-Aware Direct 3D Gaussian Generation with Structured Patch Latent Flows
papers.abstract_en: Class-guided 3D object generation is important for intelligent content creation, virtual environments, and digital asset design. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers an explicit and render-efficient representation, directly generating 3D Gaussian objects is difficult because Gaussian primitives are unordered, variable-sized, locally dense, and highly sensitive to rendering. Existing 3DGS generation methods usually depend on multi-view synthesis, reconstruction, or lifted 2D priors, fusing information mainly from observed views rather than modeling the intrinsic structural distribution of 3D Gaussian objects. This paper proposes a fusion-aware hierarchical Gaussian patch representation for direct class-guided 3DGS generation with rectified flow. Irregular Gaussian sets are decomposed into canonical local patches and encoded as structured tokens. The resulting hierarchical latent space fuses global class semantics, patch-level geometry and appearance, spatial correspondence, and rendering-sensitive cues. On this basis, we design a structure-aware rectified flow model with patch-position conditioning, global-local coupled velocity prediction, and density-aware velocity weighting, enabling direct latent generation of class-conditioned 3DGS objects within seconds. A render-feedback fusion strategy further aligns latent flow learning with decoded multi-view rendering quality. Experiments show that the proposed method generates 3D Gaussian objects with more coherent geometry, sharper local details, and better multi-view consistency than baseline latent generative models. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of hierarchical information fusion, global-local coupling, density-aware supervision, and render-feedback learning while preserving practical sampling efficiency overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出融合感知的分层 Gaussian patch 表示与结构化 rectified flow，把无序变长的 3D Gaussian 集合拆成 canonical 局部 patch 编码为结构化 token，直接生成类别条件的 3DGS 物体，秒级出结果，几何更连贯、多视角更一致。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示显式且渲染高效，但 Gaussian 原语无序、变长、局部稠密且对渲染敏感，直接生成困难；现有方法依赖多视角合成、重建或 2D 先验，只融合观测视角信息而未建模 3D Gaussian 对象的内在结构分布。
Method: 提出 fusion-aware 分层 Gaussian patch 表示：把不规则 Gaussian 集合分解为 canonical 局部 patch 并编码为结构化 token，分层 latent 空间融合全局类别语义、patch 级几何外观、空间对应与渲染敏感线索；其上构建 structure-aware rectified flow，含 patch-position 条件、全局-局部耦合速度预测、密度感知速度加权，并用 render-feedback fusion 对齐 latent 学习与解码多视角渲染质量。
Result: 实验显示所提方法生成的 3D Gaussian 物体在几何连贯性、局部细节锐度与多视角一致性上优于 baseline latent 生成模型；消融确认分层信息融合、全局-局部耦合、密度监督与 render-feedback 学习各自的贡献，同时整体保持实用采样效率，类别条件 3DGS 生成在数秒内完成。
Conclusion: 直接在结构化 patch latent 上做 rectified flow 生成，配合渲染反馈对齐，可在保持秒级采样效率的前提下生成更连贯、细节更清晰、多视角更一致的类别条件 3DGS 物体。

papers.title: DMM-Align: Closed-Loop Optimization for 2D-3D Registration with Dual-Role Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: 2D-3D registration remains brittle in challenging scenarios such as low overlap, occlusion, repetitive structures, and severe cross-modal ambiguity. A key reason is that existing methods improve representation learning, correspondence estimation, or pose computation in isolation, while the dominant failure mode is inherently cross-level, where errors propagate between features, correspondences, and pose. To address this limitation, we propose DMM-Align: Diffusion-based Matching Matrix Alignment, a closed-loop framework that couples correspondence refinement, pose estimation, and representation learning through a shared differentiable geometric state. Our method leverages diffusion in two coordinated roles: a geometry-aware diffusion process refines the soft matching matrix for robust correspondence estimation, while a geometry-conditioned diffusion teacher injects pose-induced supervision back into feature learning. These processes are connected via a differentiable geometric hinge that converts correspondences into a global pose and exposes geometric inconsistency to upstream modules. Extensive experiments on 7-Scenes and RGB-D Scenes V2 demonstrate that DMM-Align consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially under low-overlap and heavy-occlusion conditions, highlighting the effectiveness of closed-loop geometric feedback for robust 2D-3D registration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMM-Align 用一个可微几何 hinge 把对应关系求解、位姿估计与特征学习闭环耦合，几何感知 diffusion 精化软匹配矩阵，几何条件 diffusion teacher 把位姿诱导的监督反灌回特征学习。在 7-Scenes 与 RGB-D Scenes V2 上稳定超过强基线，低重叠与重度遮挡条件下优势更明显。
Motivation: 2D-3D 配准在低重叠、遮挡、重复结构与跨模态歧义下脆弱，现有方法只分别改进表示学习、对应估计或位姿计算，而主导失效模式是跨层级的：误差在特征、对应与位姿之间传播。
Method: 提出 DMM-Align（Diffusion-based Matching Matrix Alignment）闭环框架：几何感知 diffusion 过程精化软匹配矩阵以得到鲁棒对应；几何条件 diffusion teacher 把位姿诱导的监督注入特征学习；两者经由可微几何 hinge 连接，该 hinge 把对应转换为全局位姿并把几何不一致暴露给上游模块。
Result: 在 7-Scenes 与 RGB-D Scenes V2 上的大量实验中，DMM-Align 持续优于强基线，在低重叠与重度遮挡条件下提升尤其明显。
Conclusion: 闭环几何反馈（对应—位姿—表示三者通过可微几何状态耦合）是提升鲁棒 2D-3D 配准的关键，优于各模块孤立优化。

papers.title: DualStabSleepNet: A Dual-Domain Diffusion Stabilization Network for Robust Sleep Staging
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep learning approaches for automatic sleep staging suffer from limited robustness under heterogeneous recording conditions, where non-stationary noise, inter-subject differences and cross-dataset distribution shifts cause unstable features and poor generalization. This work proposes DualStabSleepNet (DSSNet), a dual-domain diffusion stabilization network for robust sleep staging, which improves robustness in both data and feature domains. After preprocessing multi-channel polysomnography (PSG), a continuous-scale diffusion-based stabilization module suppresses noise while preserving physiological signal structures. Stabilized signals are converted to time-frequency representations and fed into a Vision Transformer backbone. A teacher-student guided diffusion feature stabilization module further mitigates feature drift and enforces multi-level feature consistency. Evaluated on four public PSG datasets SleepEDF-20, SleepEDF-78, SHHS and ISRUC-S3, DSSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 89.2%, 88.0%, 89.7%, 86.7% with improved macro-F1 and Cohen's kappa. It obtains notable improvements on hard transitional stages (e.g., 12.5% gain for N1 on SHHS) and boosts N2/REM recognition. Under cross-dataset settings, DSSNet is robust to distribution shift and performs on par with or superior to target-dataset trained baselines, demonstrating its practical potential for real-world sleep staging across heterogeneous cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualStabSleepNet (DSSNet) 用连续尺度扩散在数据域去噪、用 teacher-student 引导的扩散在特征域抑制漂移，把多通道 PSG 稳定后送入时频表示与 Vision Transformer 做睡眠分期。在 SleepEDF-20、SleepEDF-78、SHHS、ISRUC-S3 四个公开数据集上准确率分别达 89.2%、88.0%、89.7%、86.7%，跨数据集设定下与目标数据集训练的基线持平或更好。
Motivation: 异构采集条件下非平稳噪声、个体差异与跨数据集分布偏移使深度睡眠分期模型特征不稳、泛化差，跨队列部署时性能不可靠。
Method: 预处理多通道 PSG 后，用连续尺度扩散稳定模块 (continuous-scale diffusion-based stabilization) 在数据域抑制噪声并保留生理信号结构；信号转为时频表示输入 Vision Transformer 主干，再用 teacher-student 引导的扩散特征稳定模块抑制特征漂移并约束多层级特征一致性。
Result: 四个公开 PSG 数据集上准确率分别为 SleepEDF-20 89.2%、SleepEDF-78 88.0%、SHHS 89.7%、ISRUC-S3 86.7%，macro-F1 与 Cohen's kappa 同步提升；SHHS 上困难过渡期 N1 提升 12.5%，N2/REM 识别也提高；跨数据集设定下与目标数据集训练的基线持平或更优。
Conclusion: 在数据域与特征域同时做扩散稳定，可让睡眠分期在异构队列与分布偏移下保持接近目标域训练的性能，具备真实场景部署潜力。

papers.title: Ask Which, Not How Good: Sizing Benchmarks Scored by an LLM
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks scored by an LLM judge routinely adjudicate differences of a tenth of a point, but the resolution of those benchmarks has never been measured. Existing sample-complexity work covers accuracy benchmarks and leaves the judged case open. Treating the system as the object of measurement, we decompose 373,019 judgments into system, item, judge and interaction components using generalizability theory. The central result is structural: under a single judge, generalizability asymptotes to sigma2_s/(sigma2_s+sigma2_sj) regardless of item count, because the system-by-judge term carries no n_i. Items saturate; judges do not. The item cost of a target diverges as the target nears that ceiling. The ceiling is a property of pointwise rubric scoring, not of LLM judging. Run as a pairwise preference in both presentation orders, sigma2_sj falls two orders of magnitude below sigma2_s and the ceiling rises to 0.986 (bootstrap [0.934, 1.000] on 11 systems), so one judge suffices. Pairwise buys a different problem: a system presented first wins 8.6 percentage points more often than the same system presented second, a bias 1.23x the median improvement claimed in the 53 published win-rate comparisons we recovered. Protocol design dominates panel size. Measured floors are 0.41-1.24 points on a 0-5 scale at native item counts, against a median reported improvement of 0.28 points; on the one benchmark recurring often enough for an exactly matched comparison, all 17 recovered MT-Bench improvements fall below MT-Bench's own floor, and 70% of the win-rate claims fall below the pairwise floor. An audit of 628 arXiv papers, double-coded by two independent models and validated against blind human coding (kappa=0.73), finds fewer than one paper in four states whether its evaluation was run more than once, and only 46-67% report uncertainty of any kind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 generalizability theory 分解 373,019 次 LLM judge 判分，证明单 judge 的点式 rubric 评分存在与题目数无关的天花板 σ²_s/(σ²_s+σ²_sj)：题目饱和而 judge 不饱和。改成双向 pairwise 后 σ²_sj 比 σ²_s 低两个数量级、天花板升到 0.986（11 个系统 bootstrap [0.934, 1.000]），但引入 8.6 个百分点的首位优势，是所恢复 53 项已发表胜率比较中位改进的 1.23 倍。
Motivation: LLM judge 打分的 benchmark 常以 0.1 分之差判定高下，但其分辨率从未被测量；已有 sample-complexity 工作只覆盖 accuracy benchmark，留下 judged case 这一空白。
Method: 把被测系统当作测量对象，用 generalizability theory 将 373,019 次判分分解为 system、item、judge、interaction 四个方差分量；再以双向呈现的 pairwise preference 对比，并审计 628 篇 arXiv 论文（两个独立模型双编码，对照盲法人工编码，kappa=0.73）。
Result: 单 judge 下 generalizability 收敛于 σ²_s/(σ²_s+σ²_sj)，与题目数无关；pairwise 使 σ²_sj 比 σ²_s 低两个数量级，天花板 0.986（bootstrap [0.934, 1.000]，11 个系统）。首位呈现比后位多赢 8.6 个百分点，为 53 项已发表胜率比较中位改进的 1.23 倍。原生题目数下测得地板 0.41–1.24 分（0–5 量表），而报告的中位改进仅 0.28 分；MT-Bench 上恢复的全部 17 项改进都低于其自身地板，70% 的胜率宣称低于 pairwise 地板。628 篇论文中不足四分之一说明评测是否重复运行，仅 46–67% 报告任何形式的不确定性。
Conclusion: 协议设计（点式 rubric 还是双向 pairwise）比增加 judge 数量更决定性：点式评分的天花板是该评分方式本身的属性而非 LLM judge 的属性，而大量已发表的微小改进宣称落在测得的分辨率地板之下。

papers.title: Financial Tail Risk Beyond Lipschitz Continuity via Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Financial returns are heavy-tailed, and accurate tail risk estimation is central to portfolio risk management. Modern neural generators sample by pushing a simple base distribution through a learned map, and for training stability that map is built from Lipschitz components. This is the binding constraint: a Lipschitz map of a Gaussian is sub-Gaussian, so heavier-tailed targets admit no exact match at any finite Lipschitz constant. The Monge--Ampère equation ties the Brenier map's local distortion to the density ratio $f/(g\circ T)$, so a deeper trough in the target density requires a higher-gain map and yields a higher-variance estimator. The argument needs only bounded distortion, so it covers normalizing flows, flow matching, GANs, and diffusion samplers alike. Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (SDOT) relaxes the map's regularity rather than the source's tail class. Its power diagram gives every training observation a cell holding exactly $1/N$ of the source measure, and tail observations are reached by crossing a cell boundary rather than by stretching. Our primary experiment sweeps severity over a calibrated Merton jump-diffusion spanning kurtosis 94 to 1,679. SDOT holds tail ratios at $0.85$--$0.94$ with cross-seed standard deviations below $0.025$, while every learned generator either compresses the tails or inflates them with a variance that grows alongside. Further experiments carry the result to real S\&P~500 returns and to a 21-year backtest, where SDOT gives the best risk-adjusted market-neutral strategy under CVaR optimization (Sharpe $0.70$, max drawdown $-2.60\%$, against $0.40$ for the next-best generator).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 金融收益重尾下，用 Lipschitz 映射把高斯推成重尾目标在有限 Lipschitz 常数下不可能精确匹配；改用半离散最优传输 (SDOT) 的 power diagram，让每个训练样本占一个恰好含源测度 1/N 的胞元，尾部观测靠跨越胞元边界而非拉伸映射到达。在峰度 94 至 1,679 的标定 Merton 跳扩散扫描上，SDOT 尾比保持 0.85–0.94、跨种子标准差低于 0.025，而所有学习型生成器要么压缩尾部要么以随严重度增长的方差膨胀尾部。
Motivation: 神经生成器为训练稳定把映射建成 Lipschitz 组件，但 Lipschitz 高斯映射是次高斯的，重尾目标在任何有限 Lipschitz 常数下都无精确匹配，尾部风险估计因此被系统性扭曲。
Method: 论证从 Monge–Ampère 方程出发，把 Brenier 映射的局部畸变与密度比 f/(g∘T) 绑定，说明目标密度凹陷越深所需增益越高、估计方差越大；该论证只需有界畸变，覆盖 normalizing flows、flow matching、GAN 与 diffusion samplers。SDOT 放松映射正则性而非源分布尾类，用 power diagram 为每个观测分配含源测度 1/N 的胞元。
Result: 主实验在峰度 94 至 1,679 的标定 Merton 跳扩散上扫描严重度：SDOT 尾比保持 0.85–0.94，跨种子标准差低于 0.025；所有学习型生成器或压缩尾部或以随严重度增长的方差膨胀尾部。结果延伸到真实 S&P 500 收益与 21 年回测，在 CVaR 优化下 SDOT 给出最优风险调整的市场中性策略：Sharpe 0.70、最大回撤 -2.60%，次优生成器为 0.40。
Conclusion: 尾部风险估计的瓶颈在映射正则性而非源分布选择，放松 Lipschitz 约束的 SDOT 能在重尾收益上稳定保持尾比并取得更好的风险调整收益。

papers.title: EidosDoc: Implicit Structure Encoding for Cost-Effective Semi-Structured Document QA
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured documents are ubiquitous in scientific reports, financial statements, and technical manuals. Question answering over such documents requires simultaneous understanding of text, tables, charts, and complex hierarchical layouts. Existing methods either rely on repeatedly calling large language models for structure parsing and retrieval, leading to high cost and large latency, or they flatten the document and lose layout and hierarchy information, sacrificing answer accuracy. To address this, we propose EidosDoc, a novel system that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with minimal computational expense. Our approach introduces three core innovations. (1) An Implicit Structure Encoder trained via contrastive learning and a structure consistency loss. This module jointly embeds hierarchical relationships, spatial positions, and textual content into a dense vector space, capturing document structure holistically without the need for manually defined and error-prone constructions. (2) A Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline that leverages BM25, layout fingerprints, and a lightweight cross-encoder to perform high-precision retrieval entirely without invoking an LLM, drastically reducing cost and latency. (3) A Dynamic Evidence Expansion mechanism that adaptively retrieves spatially adjacent and structurally related evidence, overcoming the evidence omission common in fixed-path retrieval methods. We evaluate EidosDoc on four benchmarks, and comprehensive evaluations show that EidosDoc achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy on the four benchmarks. Crucially, it does so with a 50 times reduction in cost and 4 times lower latency compared to the previous state-of-the-art Method. These results demonstrate that EidosDoc establishes a new optimal trade-off among accuracy, cost, and speed, offering a practical and scalable path for accurate semi-structured document analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EidosDoc 用对比学习训练的 Implicit Structure Encoder 把层级关系、空间位置与文本内容联合嵌入，配合不调用 LLM 的 BM25+布局指纹+轻量 cross-encoder 混合检索与动态证据扩展，做半结构化文档问答。在四个 benchmark 上达到新 SOTA，同时相对前一 SOTA 把成本降到 1/50、延迟降到 1/4。
Motivation: 半结构化文档 QA 要同时理解文本、表格、图表与层级布局；现有方法要么反复调 LLM 解析检索导致高成本高延迟，要么把文档拍平丢掉布局层级、牺牲准确率。
Method: 三部分：经对比学习与 structure consistency loss 训练的 Implicit Structure Encoder，把层级、空间、文本联合嵌入稠密向量空间；Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline 用 BM25、layout fingerprints 与轻量 cross-encoder 完全不调 LLM 做高精度检索；Dynamic Evidence Expansion 自适应补取空间相邻与结构相关的证据。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 上取得新的 SOTA 准确率；相对前一 SOTA 方法成本降低 50 倍、延迟降低 4 倍。
Conclusion: 不调用 LLM 的结构感知检索即可在半结构化文档 QA 上同时拿到准确率、成本与速度的更优折中，为大规模文档分析给出可扩展的实用路径。

papers.title: Visibility-Guided Structured Measure Flow for Class-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Generation
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has made real-time, high-fidelity 3D rendering practical, yet turning this explicit representation into a native generative space remains an open challenge. Directly generating 3DGS objects is difficult because Gaussian primitives are unordered, variable-sized, locally dense, and highly sensitive to rendering behavior. We present VISTA-GS, a visibility-guided structured measure flow framework for class-conditioned 3D Gaussian generation. Instead of treating a 3DGS object as a flat primitive sequence or a generic latent token grid, we formulate it as a structured Gaussian measure weighted by opacity, anisotropic covariance, and multi-view visibility. Based on this formulation, we introduce a visibility-aware measure VAE that learns permutation-invariant, variable-size-compatible, and rendering-aware latent representations of 3DGS objects. We further develop a renderer-consistent measure flow that transports class-conditioned priors toward the learned 3DGS measure distribution while aligning the decoded objects with their multi-view rendering distributions. To preserve object layout and local details, VISTA-GS incorporates structure-preserving patch transport that couples global class semantics, local Gaussian measure patches, and spatial anchors during flow prediction. On VISTA-Obj30, VISTA-GS improves over the strongest baseline by roughly 60--72\% across geometry, appearance, view-consistency error, and generation speed. This design enables efficient generation of coherent, detailed, and view-consistent 3D Gaussian objects without relying on per-instance optimization, multi-view image synthesis, or reconstruction-based lifting pipelines. Project code and model checkpoints will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA-GS 把 3DGS 物体表述为按不透明度、各向异性协方差与多视角可见性加权的结构化 Gaussian measure，用可见性感知 measure VAE 与 renderer-consistent measure flow 做类条件生成。在 VISTA-Obj30 上，相对最强基线在几何、外观、视角一致性误差与生成速度上提升约 60–72%。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian 原语无序、变长、局部稠密且对渲染行为敏感，直接把 3DGS 当作生成空间缺乏合适表示，扁平序列或通用 latent token 网格都难以处理。
Method: 将 3DGS 物体建模为结构化 Gaussian measure；可见性感知 measure VAE 学习置换不变、变长兼容、渲染感知的 latent；renderer-consistent measure flow 把类条件先验输运到学到的 measure 分布并对齐多视角渲染分布；structure-preserving patch transport 在流预测中耦合全局类语义、局部 Gaussian patch 与空间锚点。
Result: 在 VISTA-Obj30 上，VISTA-GS 相对最强基线在几何、外观、视角一致性误差与生成速度四项上提升约 60–72%。
Conclusion: 结构化 measure 表示加可见性引导的流式生成，可在不依赖逐实例优化、多视角图像合成或重建式 lifting 的前提下产出连贯、细节充分、视角一致的 3D Gaussian 物体；代码与 checkpoint 计划发布。

papers.title: Beyond Unsafe Detection: Counterfactually Anchored Evidence Attribution for Multi-Turn LLM Safety Failures
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) move from conversational assistants to advanced agentic systems, guardrail failures can convert adversarial intents into harmful executions. However, most guardrail evaluation frameworks focus only on the result and assess whether a user request is safe or unsafe. This approach is insufficient for multi-turn failures, where adversarial intent is distributed across multiple turns. This motivates us to go beyond detection to identify the turns and tokens that push the conversation toward unsafe trajectories. To support this, we construct a multi-turn dataset with behavioral validation and tiered evidence supervision. The dataset contains 1,762 conversations, including adversarial conversations, benign twins, and benign variants with high-risk vocabulary. We train a lightweight hierarchical attribution model that predicts safety violations and attributes them to contributing user turns and token spans. The model achieves strong detection performance (F1=0.988), and removing the top 15% of attributed tokens reduces the adversarial classification confidence by 51.1%. The model preserves low false positive rates on benign conversations with high-risk vocabulary, with false positives below 1% on both borderline benign and benign high-risk vocabulary conversations, compared to 37.3% and 94.7% for a keyword-based surface-risk baseline. Independent human annotation supports the model's attribution performance, with the top-five attributed turns containing a human-identified evidence-bearing turn in 84.5% of adversarial cases.
papers.comment: This work is currently under review for EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多轮 LLM 安全失败只判 safe/unsafe、无法定位责任的问题，构建含 1,762 段对话的多轮数据集（对抗对话、benign twins、含高风险词的 benign variants），并训练轻量级层级归因模型同时做违规检测与归因到具体轮次和 token span。检测 F1=0.988；删除归因最高的 15% token 使对抗分类置信度下降 51.1%；在两类 benign 高风险词对话上假阳性均低于 1%，而关键词 surface-risk 基线分别为 37.3% 与 94.7%；人工标注显示 top-5 归因轮次中含证据轮的比例为 84.5%。
Motivation: 现有 guardrail 评估框架只判断请求安全与否，而多轮失败中对抗意图分散在多个轮次，单点检测无法指出是哪些轮次和 token 把对话推向不安全轨迹。
Method: 先构建带行为验证与分层证据监督 (tiered evidence supervision) 的多轮数据集，含 1,762 段对抗对话、benign twins 与含高风险词汇的 benign variants；再训练轻量级层级归因模型，同时预测安全违规并把违规归因到贡献的用户轮次与 token span。
Result: 检测 F1=0.988；移除归因最高的 15% token 使对抗分类置信度下降 51.1%；在 borderline benign 与 benign high-risk vocabulary 两类对话上假阳性均低于 1%，而关键词 surface-risk 基线分别为 37.3% 与 94.7%；独立人工标注中，top-5 归因轮次包含人标证据轮的对抗案例占 84.5%。
Conclusion: 把安全评估从结果检测推进到轮次与 token 级证据归因是可行的：归因既压低高风险词 benign 对话的误报，又与人工标注证据高度一致。

papers.title: Surrogate inference for threshold-derived environmental indices depends on null placement and seasonal event concentration
papers.abstract_en: Threshold-derived environmental indices convert native-resolution variables into event indicators and aggregated counts, but surrogate tests may impose their null constraints either before or after this transformation. We show that these choices define different inferential targets. A threshold--copula representation separates temporal dependence from the seasonal event-probability vector and makes seasonal concentration an explicit experimental coordinate. In a prespecified benchmark of 13,500 short-memory monthly trajectories, an index-resolution marginal-and-spectrum surrogate and a constrained native-resolution surrogate produced strongly asymmetric paired conclusions: 1084 trajectories rejected only at index resolution, compared with 16 only at native resolution. Holding the expected annual event count fixed while concentrating event probability within the seasonal cycle increased index-only discordance from 4.4\% to 16.2\%. In an independent experiment, equalizing monthly event probability reduced the corresponding rate from 15.9\% to 3.9\%; the mitigation persisted when monthly percentiles were estimated from an independent 30-year reference period. Native-resolution inference was calibrated under the benchmark null but had strongly mechanism-dependent sensitivity: the strongest prespecified history-feedback alternative had a 30.7\% detection rate under the fixed synthetic gate, with substantially lower sensitivity to a persistent-regime alternative. A Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 Amazon dry-month case study was non-discriminating, illustrating why null placement and design-specific detectability should be reported together. The results provide a practical framework for surrogate inference on threshold-derived hydroclimatic and environmental indices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 阈值衍生环境指数的 surrogate 检验，把零约束放在指数分辨率还是原生分辨率会定义不同的推断目标，产生严重不对称的配对结论：13,500 条短记忆月序列基准中仅在指数分辨率拒绝的有 1084 条，仅在原生分辨率拒绝的只有 16 条。固定年期望事件数、把事件概率集中到季节内，指数侧不一致率从 4.4% 升到 16.2%；把月事件概率均摊则从 15.9% 降到 3.9%，且用独立 30 年参考期估计月百分位后仍保持。作者主张 null placement 与设计相关的可检测性必须一并报告。
Motivation: 阈值指数把连续变量压成事件计数，surrogate 检验可在变换前后施加零约束，两种选择指向不同推断目标，而季节性事件集中会放大这种分歧，影响水文气候指数的显著性判读。
Method: 用 threshold--copula 表示把时间依赖与季节事件概率向量分离，使季节集中成为显式实验坐标；在预设的 13,500 条短记忆月序列基准上配对比较指数分辨率的 marginal-and-spectrum surrogate 与受约束的原生分辨率 surrogate，并另做均摊月事件概率的独立实验与 CM6 Amazon 干月案例。
Result: 13,500 条轨迹中 1084 条仅在指数分辨率拒绝、16 条仅在原生分辨率拒绝；固定年期望事件数并集中季节事件概率使指数侧不一致率 4.4%→16.2%，均摊月事件概率使其 15.9%→3.9%（独立 30 年参考期估计百分位时仍保持）。原生分辨率推断在基准零下校准，但对最强的预设 history-feedback 备择在固定合成 gate 下检出率仅 30.7%，对 persistent-regime 备择灵敏度明显更低；CM6 Amazon 干月案例不具判别力。
Conclusion: null 放在指数分辨率还是原生分辨率会改变检验对象并造成系统性不对称结论，因此报告时必须同时给出 null placement 与该设计下的可检测性；均摊季节事件概率可压低指数侧不一致率。
Relevance: 38
