papers.title: Alignment of LRMs via Counter-Aligned Few-Shot Conversation Exposure
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and large context windows to achieve strong performance on complex tasks, but these features also introduce new attack surfaces. We show that LRMs' reasoning processes can be systematically steered by prepending counter-aligned few-shot conversations containing explicit CoT traces, leading to unsafe generations on harmful queries and unwarranted refusals on benign ones. We formalize this attack as SRCF (Steering Reasoning via Counter-Aligned Few-shot Conversations) that operates solely through a flexible conversational interface and requires no access to the model's parameters and gradients. Our key insight is that SRCF exploits an adversarial generalization issue that induces a representation drift, causing the representations of benign and harmful inputs to shift in a similar direction. This observation motivates our post-training defense, ARCF (Aligning Reasoning via Counter-Aligned Few-Shot Conversations), which exposes models to counter-aligned conversational contexts while enforcing aligned targets. ARCF is compatible with existing post-training methods and consistently improves safety and helpfulness without degrading utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRCF 攻击通过在提示前拼接含显式 CoT 轨迹的反对齐少样本对话，无需参数与梯度即可系统性操纵大推理模型 (LRM)，使有害查询产生不安全生成、良性查询产生无理由拒答；其机制是对抗泛化导致的表征漂移，让良性与有害输入表征同向偏移。据此提出的后训练防御 ARCF 让模型暴露于反对齐对话上下文并强制对齐目标，在不损害效用的前提下持续改善安全性与有用性。
Motivation: LRM 依赖显式 CoT 与长上下文窗口获得强性能，同时引入新攻击面：仅通过对话接口即可被少样本示例系统性引导，且现有对齐手段未覆盖这种对抗泛化导致的表征漂移。
Method: 形式化攻击 SRCF（Steering Reasoning via Counter-Aligned Few-shot Conversations），在对话前缀中拼接含显式 CoT 的反对齐少样本对话，仅经对话接口操作、不接触参数与梯度；分析其引发的表征漂移（良性与有害输入同向偏移），并据此设计后训练防御 ARCF（Aligning Reasoning via Counter-Aligned Few-Shot Conversations），在暴露反对齐上下文时强制对齐目标，兼容既有后训练方法。
Result: SRCF 能在有害查询上诱导不安全生成、在良性查询上诱导无理由拒答，且无需参数与梯度访问；ARCF 作为后训练防御一致地提升安全性与有用性，同时不降低效用，并与现有后训练方法兼容。
Conclusion: LRM 的少样本对话前缀本身是可被利用的对齐漏洞，其根源是使良性与有害表征同向漂移的对抗泛化问题；在后训练中暴露于反对齐对话并强制对齐目标即可在不牺牲效用的前提下缓解它。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: "What's That Sound?": A Versatile, Robust, and Lightweight Convolutional Transformer for Environment Sound Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The conventional hearing aid is both costly and lim- ited in usage, as it is not intended to detect non-speech audio. Our objective is to develop a machine learning solution to provide a more accurate and affordable mechanism to identify surrounding sounds to improve the safety of the hearing impaired, i.e., if a car is honking behind pedestrians, or a gunshot is fired, and they need to move away from the source. By adding randomized augmentations to audio, concatenating a Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) diagram and a log-mel Spectrogram, and including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in a Trans- former architecture, the Randomized Audiomentational Layered Convolutional Transformers (RALCT) model efficiently extracts features from diversified audio representations. In addition, RALCT is small enough, with only approximately 310,000 parameters, to be deployed into mobile devices. Experimental results on the UrbanSound8K dataset resulted in an accuracy consistently over 93% for all variations of RALCT with the highest at 94.56%, reaching state-of-the-art levels. To leverage the capabilities of this technology, a mobile app is developed to be integrated with the model to provide real-time safety control. RALCT thus represents a robust, lightweight, affordable, and versatile deep learning tool to aid the navigation and safety of the hearing impaired.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, published to IYRC Conference Proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RALCT 把随机音频增广、MFCC 图与 log-mel 频谱图拼接、以及嵌入 Transformer 架构的 CNN 结合，用于环境声音识别，模型仅约 310,000 参数，可部署到移动设备。在 UrbanSound8K 上所有 RALCT 变体准确率稳定超过 93%，最高 94.56%，达到 state-of-the-art 水平。
Motivation: 传统助听器成本高且只针对语音，无法识别鸣笛、枪声等非语音环境声，听障人士在这些场景下缺少及时避险的提示手段。
Method: RALCT（Randomized Audiomentational Layered Convolutional Transformers）：对音频施加随机增广（randomized augmentations），将 MFCC 图与 log-mel 频谱图拼接作为输入，在 Transformer 架构中加入 CNN 提取多表示特征；模型约 310,000 参数，并配套开发移动端 app 做实时安全控制。
Result: 在 UrbanSound8K 数据集上，RALCT 所有变体准确率持续超过 93%，最高 94.56%，达到 state-of-the-art 水平；参数量约 310,000，适合移动设备部署。
Conclusion: 轻量卷积 Transformer 配合多表示音频输入可以在 UrbanSound8K 上以约 31 万参数达到 SOTA 级环境声识别精度，并支撑听障辅助的实时移动端应用。

papers.title: Hard Negatives Reveal What Easy Negatives Hide: Cross-Lingual Harmfulness Representations Degrade with Resource Tier Under Hard Negatives
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in large language models is trained primarily in English, and recent work reports that the underlying harmfulness representation survives translation: English-trained probes separate harmful from harmless prompts almost as well in low-resource languages as in English. This has been taken as evidence that cross-lingual refusal failures mainly reflect calibration rather than representation quality. We show that this conclusion depends on the choice of negative examples. Across nine languages spanning three resource tiers, we replicate near-perfect transfer (AUROC > 0.98) when harmless prompts come from an unrelated distribution (easy negatives). With XSTest contrast prompts, which are benign but surface-similar to harmful requests (hard negatives), transfer collapses in low-resource languages while remaining largely stable in high-resource languages. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, mean AUROC drop increases from 0.003 in English to 0.017 in high-resource, 0.042 in mid-resource, and 0.276 in low-resource languages. The pattern replicates on Aya Expanse. Back-translation chrF controls and a matched-chrF comparison across three languages reduce the likelihood that translation quality explains the effect. The collapse remains after controlling for chrF (partial r = 0.70, p = 0.03). Tokenizer fertility correlates with the collapse and explains part of the resource-tier effect, but not all of it. The results show that easy-negative transfer can coexist with substantial degradation under hard negatives. Easy-negative evaluation alone therefore cannot establish that the harmfulness representation survives translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在九种语言、三个资源层级上比较英文训练的有害性探针跨语言迁移：用无关分布的无害提示作 easy negative 时 AUROC > 0.98 近乎完美迁移，但换成 XSTest 这类表面相似的 hard negative 后，低资源语言迁移崩溃而高资源语言基本稳定。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上平均 AUROC 下降从英语 0.003 升到高资源 0.017、中资源 0.042、低资源 0.276，Aya Expanse 复现同一模式，因此仅凭 easy-negative 评估不能断言有害性表征跨语言存活。
Motivation: 近期工作用 easy negatives 得出跨语言拒绝失败主要是校准问题而非表征质量问题的结论，但该结论可能依赖于负例的选择。
Method: 在九种语言、三个资源层级上用英文训练的有害性探针做跨语言迁移，比较 easy negatives（无关分布无害提示）与 hard negatives（XSTest contrast prompts，良性但与有害请求表面相似）；用 back-translation chrF 控制与三语言 matched-chrF 对比排除翻译质量解释，并考察 tokenizer fertility 与资源层级效应的关系。
Result: Easy negatives 下迁移 AUROC > 0.98；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上平均 AUROC 下降英语 0.003、高资源 0.017、中资源 0.042、低资源 0.276，Aya Expanse 复现。控制 chrF 后崩溃仍在（partial r = 0.70, p = 0.03）；tokenizer fertility 与崩溃相关并解释部分资源层级效应，但非全部。
Conclusion: 跨语言有害性表征在 hard negatives 下随资源层级下降，easy-negative 迁移可与之并存，故仅靠 easy-negative 评估无法确立表征跨语言存活。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Reporting Under Pressure: Separating Factual and Tonal Sycophancy in LLM Statistical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly asked to analyze data and report what the results mean, a task distinct from the belief- or preference-alignment settings studied in most sycophancy research. We test whether editorial framing in the prompt, ranging from a neutral request to an explicit instruction to search exhaustively for reasons to discredit or to support a finding, changes not just the tone but the substance of a model's report. Across a 4 x 4 factorial design crossing four framing conditions with four ground-truth data patterns (a genuine effect, a confound that mimics an effect but fails a robustness check, a well-powered null, and an underpowered null), we collect 480 responses and score each along two independent dimensions: whether its factual claim about the data diverged from the correct interpretation, and whether only its tone diverged while the claim stayed correct. Factual misrepresentation is concentrated in two cells: brutally critical framing applied to a genuine effect, where the model talks itself into unwarranted skepticism (97% of responses), and significance-seeking framing applied to an underpowered null, where the model overstates confidence in a null conclusion the data cannot support (100% of responses). Tone shifts far more broadly than factual content does, with critical framing producing a defensive, hedge-heavy register across every data pattern regardless of what the data show, while significance-seeking framing shifts tone only where the data leave genuine ambiguity. A confound present in the data itself blocks both kinds of shift almost entirely under every framing condition tested. These results indicate that the risk of framing-induced distortion in LLM-assisted data analysis is neither uniform across framings nor uniform across data patterns, and that a model can hold a correct conclusion in place while its tone shifts substantially around it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 4×4 因子设计检验 prompt 框架是否会改变 LLM 统计报告的事实内容：480 条回答中，事实性歪曲只集中在两格——对真实效应施加“苛刻批判”框架时模型自我诱导出无根据的怀疑（97%），对功效不足的 null 施加“追求显著性”框架时模型夸大结论置信度（100%）。语气的偏移远比事实广泛，而数据本身存在混淆 (confound) 时两类偏移几乎都被阻断。
Motivation: 多数 sycophancy 研究针对信念或偏好对齐，而 LLM 被要求做数据统计分析并报告结论时，prompt 的编辑框架是否会同时扭曲事实与语气尚无系统检验。
Method: 4×4 因子设计：四种框架条件（中立、批判、追求显著性、穷尽寻找支持/反驳理由）交叉四种真实数据模式（真实效应、能模仿效应但未过稳健性检验的混淆、功效充足的 null、功效不足的 null），收集 480 条回答，沿两个独立维度打分——事实性断言是否偏离正确解释、以及仅语气偏离而结论仍正确。
Result: 事实歪曲集中于两格：苛刻批判框架 × 真实效应时 97% 的回答陷入无根据怀疑，追求显著性框架 × 功效不足 null 时 100% 的回答夸大置信度。批判框架在所有数据模式下都产生防御性、充满 hedging 的语域；追求显著性框架只在数据本身有真实歧义时才改变语气。数据中存在混淆时，两种偏移在所有框架下几乎完全被阻断。
Conclusion: 框架诱导的歪曲风险既不随框架均匀、也不随数据模式均匀；模型可以在语气大幅漂移的同时保持结论正确，而数据中的混淆是阻断这类偏移的条件。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AWM-VLA: AlignedWorld Modeling for Efficient and Explainable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation, yet they are often reactive: the policy maps the current observation directly to an action chunk without reasoning about the long-term consequences of its decisions. Prior attempts to endow policies with world models either reconstruct future frames in pixel space---expensive and dominated by task-irrelevant detail---or decouple the world model from the policy, weakening control. We present AWM-VLA, a unified framework that embeds aligned world modeling directly inside a diffusion-transformer policy. Following the Future Latent REpresentation Alignment (FLARE) principle, we add learnable future tokens whose intermediate activations are aligned with vision-language embeddings of future observations, enabling the policy to anticipate long-term consequences while generating actions. We extend this paradigm in two ways. First, we introduce an object-centric decoupled alignment objective that predicts future object-level semantics alongside the global future embedding, improving both interpretability and multi-instruction generalization. Second, we balance the global and object-centric alignment terms against the action flow-matching loss through a principled weighting, yielding a controllable accuracy--interpretability trade-off. On RoboCasa and humanoid tabletop manipulation benchmarks, AWM-VLA outperforms prior VLA and world-model baselines by up to 21% in success rate, improves generalization to novel objects and instructions, and produces object-centric rationales that are preferred by human raters in 83 of cases. Our approach adds only a few learnable tokens to the policy and is compatible with any diffusion or flow-matching policy, making aligned world modeling an inexpensive, broadly applicable component of generalist manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AWM-VLA 把对齐式世界模型直接嵌入 diffusion-transformer 策略：新增可学习 future token，使其中间激活与未来观测的 vision-language embedding 对齐，让策略在生成动作时预判长期后果。在 RoboCasa 与人形桌面操作基准上，成功率比既有 VLA 与世界模型基线最高提升 21%，物体中心解释获人类评分者 83% 偏好。
Motivation: VLA 策略多是反应式的，直接把当前观测映射到 action chunk，不推理决策的长期后果；已有世界模型方案要么在像素空间重建未来帧（昂贵且被任务无关细节主导），要么与策略解耦（削弱控制）。
Method: 在 diffusion-transformer 策略内嵌入 Future Latent REpresentation Alignment (FLARE)：加可学习 future token，其激活与未来观测的 vision-language embedding 对齐；再加 object-centric decoupled alignment 目标，同时预测未来物体级语义与全局未来 embedding；用原则性的权重把全局与物体中心对齐项同 action flow-matching loss 平衡，形成可控的精度—可解释性权衡。
Result: 在 RoboCasa 与 humanoid tabletop manipulation 基准上，成功率比既有 VLA 与 world-model 基线最高提升 21%，对新物体与新指令的泛化改善，物体中心 rationale 在人类评分者中 83% 被偏好；仅给策略增加少量可学习 token。
Conclusion: 对齐式世界模型可以作为低成本、通用的组件加进任意 diffusion 或 flow-matching 策略，同时换来更好的操作成功率、泛化与可解释性。

papers.title: Attention-based representations for multi-task computation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head attention layers produce vector representations that support multiple downstream tasks. We establish bounds on the number of heads required in two simple and concrete multi-task scenarios. In the first scenario, a vector representation is sought so that linear predictors can compute both the smallest and largest numbers in a given list. In this case, it is known two attention heads with small embedding dimension and bit precision level suffice. We prove that a single attention head requires exponentially higher embedding dimension or precision level. In the second scenario, a vector representation is sought so that a polynomial threshold function can compute the XOR of a given string of $n$ bits. This scenario is analogous to the first one for $n=2$, since XOR is readily computed by a linear function using a vector representation that encodes both the AND and the OR of the two bits. We observe that $n$-bit XOR requires the product of the number of heads and the polynomial degree to be at least $n$, and we construct multi-head attention layers that match this lower bound. These results generalize to arbitrary (symmetric) Boolean functions, where the bound is given in terms of the threshold degree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个具体多任务场景下给出注意力头数的紧界：列表求最小值与最大值时，2 个小维度、低位精度的头足够，而单头需要指数级更高的嵌入维度或精度；n 位 XOR 需要头数与多项式次数之积至少为 n，且构造的多头注意力层达到该下界。结论可推广到任意对称 Boolean 函数，界由 threshold degree 给出。
Motivation: 多头注意力的表示能力缺少头数与表示资源之间的定量刻画：已知两个头能支持线性预测器同时算出最小值和最大值，但单头是否必须付出指数代价并不清楚。
Method: 在两个玩具化多任务场景中做理论分析：一是线性预测器从向量表示同时计算列表的 min 与 max，二是多项式阈值函数从向量表示计算 n 位 XOR；对单头给出下界、对多头给出匹配构造，并把结果推广到对称 Boolean 函数、以 threshold degree 表述界。
Result: min/max 场景中 2 个头（小嵌入维度与低位精度）已知足够，证明单头需要指数级更高的嵌入维度或精度；n 位 XOR 场景中头数与多项式次数之积至少为 n，构造的多头注意力层匹配该下界，n=2 时 XOR 可由同时编码 AND 与 OR 的表示经线性函数算出。
Conclusion: 多头注意力的头数是可换取表示维度与精度的真实资源，其下界在对称 Boolean 函数上由 threshold degree 决定，且在所给场景中可被构造匹配。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Outlier Detection for Multi-Network Data
papers.abstract_en: It has become routine in neuroscience studies to measure brain networks for different individuals using neuroimaging. These networks are typically expressed as adjacency matrices, with each cell containing a summary of connectivity between a pair of brain regions. There is an emerging statistical literature describing methods for the analysis of such multi-network data in which nodes are common across networks but the edges vary. However, there has been essentially no consideration of the important problem of outlier detection. In particular, for certain subjects, the neuroimaging data are so poor quality that the network cannot be reliably reconstructed. For such subjects, the resulting adjacency matrix may be mostly zero or exhibit a bizarre pattern not consistent with a functioning brain. These outlying networks may serve as influential points, contaminating subsequent statistical analyses. We propose a simple Outlier DetectIon for Networks (ODIN) method relying on an influence measure under a hierarchical generalized linear model for the adjacency matrices. An efficient computational algorithm is described, and ODIN is illustrated through simulations and an application to data from the UK Biobank. ODIN was successful in identifying moderate to extreme outliers. Removing such outliers can significantly change inferences in downstream applications.
papers.comment: - 13 page main document, - 5 page supplement - Our method has been implemented in both Python and R and is publicly available at https://www.github.com/pritamdey/ODIN-python and https://www.github.com/pritamdey/ODIN-r - Submitted to Bioinformatics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ODIN 用层次广义线性模型 (hierarchical GLM) 下的影响度量 (influence measure) 检测多网络数据中的离群网络，针对神经影像质量差、邻接矩阵近乎全零或模式异常的受试者。模拟与 UK Biobank 应用中成功识别中等到极端离群点，剔除这些点会显著改变下游推断。
Motivation: 多网络数据（节点相同、边不同）的统计分析已有进展，但离群检测几乎未被考虑；低质量影像产生的离群网络会成为影响点，污染后续分析。
Method: 提出 Outlier DetectIon for Networks (ODIN)：在邻接矩阵的层次广义线性模型上构造影响度量，配高效计算算法；提供 Python 与 R 实现。
Result: 在模拟与 UK Biobank 数据应用中，ODIN 成功识别中等到极端 (moderate to extreme) 离群网络；移除这些离群点可显著改变下游应用的推断。
Conclusion: 多网络分析前应先做离群网络检测，因为剔除低质量受试者的网络会实质改变下游结论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 Outlier DetectIon for Networks (ODIN)：在邻接矩阵的层次广义线性模型上构造影响度量，配高效计算算法；提供 Python 与 R 实现。
summary_sections.result: 在模拟与 UK Biobank 数据应用中，ODIN 成功识别中等到极端 (moderate to extreme) 离群网络；移除这些离群点可显著改变下游应用的推断。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多网络分析前应先做离群网络检测，因为剔除低质量受试者的网络会实质改变下游结论。
